A New Beginning#050.dst: Esta deve ser a chave que abre o arquivo.

A New Beginning#053.src: Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#053.dst: Sujeito trazido a {p} pelo condutor. (Nota: perguntar ao condutor o motivo.)
A New Beginning#053.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#054.src: Seems to originate from Wynn Province. Matches description of one Queen's Tournament participant.
A New Beginning#054.dst: Parece vir da província de Wynn. Bate com a descrição de um participante do Torneio da Rainha.

A New Beginning#055.src: Do not engage without backup or blessed equipment. Subject is dangerous, and has shown no regard for military life.
A New Beginning#055.dst: Não enfrentar sem reforços ou equipamento abençoado. O sujeito é perigoso e não respeita a vida dos soldados.

A New Beginning#056.src: If sighted, report to superiors immediately. Keep an eye on subject, but do not engage. Keep them in sight until-
A New Beginning#056.dst: Se avistado, avisar os superiores na hora. Vigiar o sujeito, sem atacar. Mantê-lo à vista até-

A New Beginning#057.src: You can't afford to be spotted. You need to take the records, and find a way out without alerting the guards.
A New Beginning#057.dst: Você não pode ser visto. Pegue os registros e ache uma saída sem alertar os guardas.

A New Beginning#059.src: ...I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#059.dst: ...A-achei que você estava i-inventando de novo.
A New Beginning#059.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#060.src: Excuse you? I don't make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#060.dst: Como é? Eu não invento nada! Pergunta pro Mora, ele também viu.
A New Beginning#060.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#061.src: If you s-say so... I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off... um... m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#061.dst: Se você d-diz... É que- e-e-eu achei que não sobrava n-ninguém lá fora. A C-Coroa mantém uma g-guarnição inteira para c-combater... hã... m-m-monstros.
A New Beginning#061.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#062.src: Wh- I d-don't know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#062.dst: Q- E-eu não sei! P-p-pareceu convincente!
A New Beginning#062.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#063.src: Ugh, whatever! I don't have time for this, Zeph, I have work to do. Just... stay on your guard. I don't trust whatever's going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#063.dst: Argh, que seja! Não tenho tempo para isso, Zeph, tenho trabalho. Só... fique de olho. Não confio no que está rolando com esse forasteiro.
A New Beginning#063.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#064.src: How'd you know I needed help?

A New Beginning#065.src: The breeze carries the sounds of windchimes...
A New Beginning#065.dst: A brisa traz o som de sinos de vento...

A New Beginning#066.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this - you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#066.dst: Então vamos direto ao assunto. Começo por isto - você é da província de Wynn, não é?

A New Beginning#067.src: You trust me enough to tell me that?
A New Beginning#067.dst: Confia em mim para me contar isso?

A New Beginning#068.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets - and if anyone even believed you - you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#068.dst: Mesmo que decidisse revelar meus segredos - e alguém acreditasse em você - nada garantiria sua própria segurança.
A New Beginning#068.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#069.src: Something strange is happening here. I can feel it.
A New Beginning#069.dst: Algo estranho está acontecendo aqui. Eu sinto.

A New Beginning#070.src: The power you carry - the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#070.dst: O poder que você carrega - a maldição que você suporta. Já vi coisas assim, mas sempre de longe. Nunca de perto.
A New Beginning#070.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#071.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to some extent.
A New Beginning#071.dst: ...Como pode imaginar, vejo essa história de outro jeito. A Coroa fez mal a mim e a muitos outros. Ainda assim, as histórias têm alguma verdade.
A New Beginning#071.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#072.src: I've only ever known it as magic. Where I'm from, most people can wield it.
A New Beginning#072.dst: Sempre conheci isso como magia. De onde venho, quase todo mundo sabe usar.

A New Beginning#073.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength will be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#073.dst: Isso me leva ao meu último pedido. Você se juntaria à nossa causa e ajudaria nosso grupo de resistência? Seu conhecimento e sua força serão muito bem-vindos.
A New Beginning#073.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#075.src: Um... wait, can I ask- actually... nevermind.
A New Beginning#075.dst: Hã... posso perguntar- na verdade... esquece.
A New Beginning#075.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#076.src: Well, welcome to the Leaves in the Wind! Pardon the hesitation earlier, the cursed are a... sensitive subject. If Syndra believes you to be safe, I will choose to believe her.
A New Beginning#076.dst: Pois bem-vindo às Folhas ao Vento! Perdoe a hesitação de antes, os amaldiçoados são um assunto... delicado. Se Syndra acha você confiável, escolho acreditar nela.
A New Beginning#076.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#077.src: It's always nice to have some fresh blood under our canopy! No matter how abnormal. We may wait for Syndra's return before getting you properly settled in.
A New Beginning#077.dst: Sempre é bom ter sangue novo sob nossa copa! Por mais anormal que seja. Talvez esperemos Syndra voltar antes de te acomodar direito.
A New Beginning#077.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#078.src: If you have any issues whatsoever, don't hesitate to inform me!
A New Beginning#078.dst: Se tiver qualquer problema, não hesite em me avisar!
A New Beginning#078.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#079.src: I am Syndra's right hand! I deal with many of the tasks involving our family here, to lighten the workload she places upon herself.
A New Beginning#079.dst: Sou o braço direito de Syndra! Cuido de muitas tarefas da nossa família aqui, para aliviar a carga que ela se impõe.
A New Beginning#079.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#080.src: Such tasks could include onboarding new recruits, assigning members to various missions... handling disputes- that sort of thing.
A New Beginning#080.dst: Tarefas como receber novos recrutas, designar membros para missões... resolver disputas- esse tipo de coisa.
A New Beginning#080.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#081.src: Of course, my "official" occupation by the crown's terms is that of a lumberjack. Fighting for a better future isn't exactly a well paying job, hoho!
A New Beginning#081.dst: Claro que, nos termos da Coroa, minha profissão "oficial" é lenhador. Lutar por um futuro melhor não paga muito bem, hoho!
A New Beginning#081.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#083.src: I'm a tactician, otherwise. Not the tactician- that'd be Syndra- but... y'know.
A New Beginning#083.dst: Fora isso, sou estrategista. Não a estrategista- essa é a Syndra- mas... sabe.
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#084.src: No, you didn't- ugh! It's not you personally, it's just...
A New Beginning#084.dst: Não, você não- argh! Não é com você, é só que...
A New Beginning#084.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#085.dst: E para onde vai a Syndra?

A New Beginning#089.src: Yes... A toddler could calculate that by watching you. I'll solve that problem for you. Keep them out of trouble, and we won't have any issues- as usual.
A New Beginning#089.dst: Sim... Uma criança calcularia isso olhando para você. Resolvo isso por você. Mantenha-os longe de encrenca e não teremos problemas- como sempre.
A New Beginning#089.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#091.src: Simple - I don't. You don't need to worry about him. As I said, we have an agreement. He doesn't know about anything we do.
A New Beginning#091.dst: Simples - não confio. Não precisa se preocupar com ele. Como eu disse, temos um acordo. Ele não sabe de nada do que fazemos.
A New Beginning#091.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#092.src: You shouldn't get near a running saw that big! Find a way to disable it first.
A New Beginning#092.dst: Não chegue perto de uma serra enorme ligada! Ache como desligá-la antes.

A New Beginning#095.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#095.dst: Alto! Preciso ver algum documento de identificação.
A New Beginning#095.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#096.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#096.dst: Nova regra, desculpe o incômodo. Estamos reforçando a segurança por aqui.
A New Beginning#096.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#097.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#097.dst: Não vai tomar muito do seu tempo, relaxa! É só mostrar seus documentos de cidadão e deixamos você passar.
A New Beginning#097.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#101.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#101.dst: Por que a demora? Não pode ser tão difícil achar. Você devia andar com eles sempre.
A New Beginning#101.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#102.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#102.dst: É uma restrição bem nova. Houve um incidente aqui perto. Não sei os detalhes, mas-
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#103.src: It's a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I'm not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#103.dst: É uma restrição bem nova. Houve um incidente aqui perto. Não sei os detalhes, mas-
A New Beginning#103.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#104.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#104.dst: Chega de enrolar. Cadê os documentos?
A New Beginning#104.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#105.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#105.dst: Se não apresentar identificação, vou ter que levar você para interrogatório.
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#106.src: If you don't present identification, I'm going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#106.dst: Se não apresentar identificação, vou ter que levar você para interrogatório.
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#107.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#107.dst: O-oh, ei, a-aí está você! Nossa, eu estava me p-perguntando aonde você tinha ido!

A New Beginning#108.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#108.dst: Ha... n-não me diga que esqueceu os documentos de novo! Eu v-vivo dizendo para andar com e-eles...

A New Beginning#109.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...
A New Beginning#109.dst: Um d-dia desses você lembra! C-com certeza...

A New Beginning#110.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#110.dst: Não e-esqueceu nossa conversa também, n-né? D-d-desculpe meu amigo, senhor!

A New Beginning#111.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#111.dst: Hum. Ainda preciso ver identificação se quiserem entrar na cidade.
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#112.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...

A New Beginning#113.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be-
A New Beginning#113.dst: ...Estão p-por aqui em a-a-algum lugar, com certeza... Acho que p-podem estar-

A New Beginning#114.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!
A New Beginning#114.dst: Ahá! Aqui! Papéis de identidade, só p-pro s-senhor!

A New Beginning#115.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#115.dst: ...Que diabos é isso? Mal consigo ler a letra... Isso é a assinatura do Soberano Selium? O soberano anterior?
A New Beginning#115.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#116.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under-
A New Beginning#116.dst: Cansei desses joguinhos. Vocês dois estão pre-
A New Beginning#116.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#119.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#119.dst: Recebemos mais informações sobre o incidente em {p}. Há um novo amaldiçoado para vigiar. Dezenas de soldados morreram tentando capturá-lo.
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#120.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#120.dst: Vamos levar reforços ao forte, mas preciso que fiquem em seus postos. Fiquem de olho em qualquer suspeito.
A New Beginning#120.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#121.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#121.dst: ...E-esta pode ser uma boa hora para fugir. Enquanto se distraem! Rápido, m-me siga!

A New Beginning#123.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#123.dst: Ufa... A-ainda bem que saímos de lá...

A New Beginning#124.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#124.dst: E-enfim. No que você estava p-pensando? Tentar entrar na cidade sem d-documentos...

A New Beginning#125.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#125.dst: Você é n-novo por aqui, né? Transferido d-de outro lugar. M-mas você é interessante.

A New Beginning#126.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#126.dst: Mas, se v-você tiver interesse... O exército g-guarda registros dessas coisas! E-eles querem tudo documentado... ou a-algo assim.

A New Beginning#127.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#127.dst: Você n-não ouviu isso de mim... mas as f-folhas sussurraram algo sobre o l-local de um arquivo. Aqui, me dá esse s-seu livro...

A New Beginning#128.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#128.dst: Boa sorte, f-forasteiro! Se perguntarem, nunca nos v-vimos. Mas, hã... p-pode me chamar de Zeph.
A New Beginning#128.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#129.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#129.dst: Encontre seu relatório no arquivo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#130.src: Find your record inside the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#130.dst: Encontre sua ficha dentro do arquivo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#132.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under-
A New Beginning#132.dst: ALTO! Intruso! Por invadir área restrita, você está pre-
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#133.dst: Estão atrás... do Soberano Zhiraok... N-não... v...você...
A New Beginning#133.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#134.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#134.dst: E então? Você já fez as contas. Me dê o relatório.
A New Beginning#134.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#135.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#135.dst: ...de todas as possibilidades. Como isso pôde dar esse resultado...? Hm. Quem era o oficial no comando? A versão dele ajudaria a fechar a equação.
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#136.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#136.dst: Bem... parece que era o comandante Lilles, senhor. Mas ele foi uma das baixas do incidente, e ainda não promoveram um substituto.
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#137.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#137.dst: Naturalmente... Depois vou ter que falar com a família dele e dar a notícia. O que mais você tem sobre o amaldiçoado?
A New Beginning#137.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#138.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#138.dst: Ouvi relatos de que é... de fora. Talvez um dos convidados à nossa província recentemente, mas ninguém parece ter certeza.
A New Beginning#138.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#139.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#139.dst: Já reforçamos a segurança em {p}, e há tropas a caminho de Torann.
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#140.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#140.dst: Um positivo num mar de negativos, suponho. Bom trabalho. Arquive o relatório na sala de registros, e depois vamos ver os estragos pessoalmente.
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#141.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so-
A New Beginning#141.dst: Mais uma coisa. Como Torann caiu, tomamos a liberdade de guardar aqui o relatório do amaldiçoado, então-
A New Beginning#141.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#142.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#142.dst: Não temos uma prioridade maior agora?!
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#143.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought-
A New Beginning#143.dst: ...N-n-não, senhor. Me- me desculpe. Eu só pensei-
A New Beginning#143.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#144.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#144.dst: Não temos tempo para ficar parados assim com uma tragédia desse tamanho para investigar! Temos que chegar a {p}, para ontem!
A New Beginning#144.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#145.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#145.dst: Encontre a chave na torre leste e recupere seu relatório.

A New Beginning#147.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#147.dst: Alguém esteve aqui... revistem o posto, rápido!

A New Beginning#149.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#149.dst: O-oi de novo, na j-janela! Situação d-difícil, hein?
A New Beginning#149.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#150.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#150.dst: A-achei que precisaria de ajuda... Afaste-se um m-momento.
A New Beginning#150.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#152.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#152.dst: J-já desço. Só s-segure firme na corda e vai ficar t-tudo bem!
A New Beginning#152.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#153.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#153.dst: Fale com Rex e Zeph em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#154.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#154.dst: Ufa! T-tiramos você de lá. M-mas bom trabalho lá dentro!
A New Beginning#154.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#156.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is-
A New Beginning#156.dst: N-não liga pra ela, ela é assim mesmo. Rex, este é-
A New Beginning#156.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#157.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#157.dst: O forasteiro que você pegou tentando entrar em {p} sem identificação, eu sei. Precisa mesmo que eu continue aqui?
A New Beginning#157.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#158.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#158.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#160.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#160.dst: Hã... a-acho que não p-p-peguei seu nome.
A New Beginning#160.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#161.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#161.dst: {u}... então, d-de onde você é? D-deve ter sido transferido de o-outra região, né?
A New Beginning#161.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#162.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#162.dst: Outra... hã... c-como assim-... você n-não sabe?
A New Beginning#162.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#163.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
A New Beginning#163.dst: É óbvio que não é daqui, Zeph! Lembra daquilo que te contei? Aquele grande espetáculo com gente de além dos portões?
A New Beginning#163.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#165.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#165.dst: V-v-você o quê?! Mas, isso- i-isso não é possível...
A New Beginning#165.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#166.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#166.dst: Possível ou não, é óbvio que vem de fora da província! Deve ter a ver com aquele grande espetáculo com gente de além dos portões de que eu te falei.
A New Beginning#166.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#168.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#168.dst: Ela- hã... ela n-não costuma ser assim. D-desculpa.
A New Beginning#168.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#170.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#170.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#171.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#171.dst: Um f-forasteiro chega à nossa região sem d-documentos e seria um a-amaldiçoado? Eu não ia te deixar ir a-assim tão fácil!
A New Beginning#171.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#172.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#172.dst: A-ah! N-não tem de quê! Não foi... n-não foi nada. V-você fez quase tudo.
A New Beginning#172.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#173.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#173.dst: N-Nixeph não é... n-nada fácil de invadir! A-acho que os guardas tinham saído.
A New Beginning#173.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#174.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#174.dst: Mas, hã... v-você tem o que queria, e eu o que- o que eu queria, e-então...
A New Beginning#174.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#175.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#175.dst: A-além disso! Eu tinha que p-pegar uma coisa no... n-no posto, de qualquer jeito.
A New Beginning#175.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#176.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#176.dst: Hã... t-tem alguém que você devia conhecer. Me pediram para passar um r-recado...
A New Beginning#176.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#177.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#177.dst: E- e desta vez você vai s-sozinho. N-nada de ajuda minha!
A New Beginning#177.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#178.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#178.dst: O r-recado é: a o-oeste, o gigante finca raízes. Quando o vento sopra, elas c-cantam junto.
A New Beginning#178.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#179.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#179.dst: "A oeste, o gigante finca raízes. Quando o vento sopra, elas cantam junto."

A New Beginning#180.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.
A New Beginning#180.dst: Fale com a mulher na caverna.

A New Beginning#181.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#181.dst: Ora, ora. Se não é uma brisa fresca dançando entre as folhas...

A New Beginning#182.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#182.dst: Você deve ser o amaldiçoado que causou tanto alvoroço em Torann, não? A notícia dos seus atos correu rápido.

A New Beginning#183.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#183.dst: Me impressiona você ter me encontrado.

A New Beginning#184.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#184.dst: Imaginei... Você certamente não é daqui. Mas eu recomendaria guardar bem essa informação.

A New Beginning#185.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#185.dst: Pouquíssimos conhecem o mundo lá fora, e os que conhecem... são os que estarão atrás de você. Melhor não chamar a atenção deles.

A New Beginning#186.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#186.dst: Mas eu devia me apresentar. Meu nome é Syndra, líder do grupo de resistência Folhas ao Vento.
A New Beginning#186.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#187.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#187.dst: Chame de aposta. Dada a sua... digamos, explosiva entrada na província, acho improvável que você esteja com a Coroa.
A New Beginning#187.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#188.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#188.dst: Sim. Você não está aqui há muito tempo, mas já sentiu, não é? A Coroa tem raízes fundas nesta província, e não é gentil com todos.
A New Beginning#188.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#189.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#189.dst: Os que ela considera descartáveis… raramente vão longe. Por isso assumi meu papel. Quero ver o dia em que ninguém fique para trás.
A New Beginning#189.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#190.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#190.dst: Mas chega de falar de mim. Vamos a você. Por que está aqui, amaldiçoado? Com que propósito veio a Fruma?
A New Beginning#190.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#191.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#191.dst: Interessante. Sentir que algo não está certo...
A New Beginning#191.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#192.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#192.dst: Para dizer a verdade, eu também a tenho há um bom tempo. Mas provavelmente por outro motivo.
A New Beginning#192.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#194.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#194.dst: Uma causa nobre… Que posso apoiar de todo o coração.
A New Beginning#194.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#195.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#195.dst: Num mundo assim, às vezes o máximo que podemos fazer é nos agarrar a quem amamos. Não perca essa garra.
A New Beginning#195.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#196.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#196.dst: Então lhe peço mais uma coisa. Um teste, de certo modo...
A New Beginning#196.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#197.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#197.dst: Peço um duelo. Nada perigoso ou letal... Tenho minhas proteções, então não teste meus limites. Quando eu mandar, paramos.
A New Beginning#197.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#198.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#198.dst: Só quero ver de perto a força de um amaldiçoado em combate. Então. Vamos começar!
A New Beginning#198.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#201.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#201.dst: Impressionante. Muito impressionante. Nunca vi um amaldiçoado com tanto controle e técnica...
A New Beginning#201.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#202.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#202.dst: Se eu não soubesse a verdade, diria que você foi abençoado pela própria Coroa.
A New Beginning#202.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#203.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#203.dst: Seu poder, seus feitiços. A capacidade de dobrar o mundo à sua vontade, de usar os elementos a seu favor.
A New Beginning#203.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#204.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#204.dst: Há eras, dizem as histórias, o mundo era puro e equilibrado. Nosso povo vivia com a terra, contente com o que tinha.
A New Beginning#204.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#205.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#205.dst: Mas uma força maligna espreitava dentro de nós, uma malícia que desprezava nossa paz e felicidade. Um dia ela irrompeu, dando poder inimaginável a quem julgava digno...
A New Beginning#205.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#206.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#206.dst: Seu poder não podia ser controlado. Os amaldiçoados por seu toque dilaceraram a terra, destruindo cidades e vilas... o medo tomou conta, ninguém estava seguro.
A New Beginning#206.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#207.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#207.dst: Até que ela chegou, uma força do bem contra o mal. Concedeu suas próprias bênçãos ao povo de Fruma, um poder controlável para banir os amaldiçoados.
A New Beginning#207.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#208.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#208.dst: Ela salvou nossa província e se tornou nossa Rainha imortal. Sempre zelando pelo povo, sempre atenta à presença do mal... pois ele não podia ser morto, só contido.
A New Beginning#208.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#209.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#209.dst: Os amaldiçoados nunca se foram. Só ficaram mais espertos, mais hábeis em se esconder do olhar da Coroa.
A New Beginning#209.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#210.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#210.dst: E assim ela diz ao povo: estejam sempre atentos. Procurem sempre os amaldiçoados. É só questão de tempo até que eles os machuquem.
A New Beginning#210.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#211.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#211.dst: Por isso seu controle sobre o próprio poder me interessa. Tem mais traços das bênçãos da Coroa do que das maldições do mal, e ainda assim...
A New Beginning#211.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#212.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#212.dst: Magia... sim, esse termo já foi usado nos estudos avançados da Universidade.
A New Beginning#212.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#213.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#213.dst: Mas uma terra cheia de amaldiçoados... e não foi destruída? Acho que nunca tive motivo para acreditar nos relatos da Coroa sobre ela, mas...
A New Beginning#213.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#214.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#214.dst: Preciso de tempo para digerir isso. Mas gostaria de conversar mais com você sobre o assunto, num outro momento, se estiver disposto.
A New Beginning#214.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#215.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#215.dst: Obrigada. Vou levar você para conhecer os outros, então. Nosso lar fica logo a sudoeste, difícil não ver. Encontro você lá.
A New Beginning#215.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#216.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#216.dst: Siga Syndra até a base da resistência em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#217.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#217.dst: Aí está você, {u}. Vejo que achou o caminho sem problemas.
A New Beginning#217.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#218.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#218.dst: Se vai se juntar a nós, devo te apresentar aos outros.
A New Beginning#218.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#219.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#219.dst: Hum... Crianças, venham aqui! Temos um novo membro que quero que conheçam.
A New Beginning#219.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#220.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#220.dst: Nos r-revemos! Sabia que você ia se e-encaixar!
A New Beginning#220.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#221.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#221.dst: É, Zeph, a gente sabe. Você fala isso há horas...
A New Beginning#221.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#222.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#222.dst: Ah, relaxa, Rex. Bem-vindo às Folhas, amigo! Não importa sua origem, se Syndra acha você confiável, assim deve ser.
A New Beginning#222.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#223.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#223.dst: Falando nisso, {u} aqui é de fora da nossa província. Vai se juntar à nossa resistência contra a Coroa...
A New Beginning#223.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#224.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#224.dst: ...e, com sorte, vai me ajudar a resolver algumas teorias que tenho sobre a natureza das maldições e bênçãos.
A New Beginning#224.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#226.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#226.dst: Sim. Mas não é uma ameaça para nós. Temos os mesmos inimigos. E ter esse poder do nosso lado pode fazer muita diferença nos nossos esforços.
A New Beginning#226.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#227.src: Hm... are you certain, miss? I do trust your judgment, but perhaps it would be best to err on the side of caution when dealing with the cursed.
A New Beginning#227.dst: Hm... tem certeza, senhorita? Confio no seu julgamento, mas talvez seja melhor pecar pelo excesso de cautela ao lidar com amaldiçoados.
A New Beginning#227.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#228.src: The curse is the least of our problems! Are we really blindly trusting someone who says they're from Wynn? People don't just... just... come back from there!
A New Beginning#228.dst: A maldição é o menor dos problemas! Vamos mesmo confiar cegamente em alguém que diz ser de Wynn? As pessoas não... não... voltam de lá!
A New Beginning#228.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#229.src: That's enough, Rex. I understand your misgivings, but I have reasons for my trust. I would ask you to have faith in me.
A New Beginning#229.dst: Chega, Rex. Entendo suas desconfianças, mas tenho motivos para confiar. Peço que tenha fé em mim.
A New Beginning#229.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#231.src: Now. I still need to acquire the proper papers for {u} to be able to access {p}. In the meantime, why don't you all get to know each other properly?
A New Beginning#231.dst: Bem. Ainda preciso conseguir os documentos certos para {u} poder entrar em {p}. Enquanto isso, por que vocês não se conhecem direito?
A New Beginning#231.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#233.src: ...What do you want? Do you need something?
A New Beginning#233.dst: ...O que você quer? Precisa de alguma coisa?
A New Beginning#233.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#235.src: I... shoot things? With my bow?
A New Beginning#235.dst: Eu... atiro em coisas? De arco?
A New Beginning#235.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#236.src: ...You don't know. Because- look, it doesn't matter what I do! Not to you, at least.
A New Beginning#236.dst: ...Você não sabe. Porque- olha, não importa o que eu faço! Não para você, pelo menos.
A New Beginning#236.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#238.src: What, are you looking for gossip?
A New Beginning#238.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#239.src: Well, you're not going to get any out of me.
A New Beginning#239.dst: Pois de mim você não vai tirar nada.
A New Beginning#239.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#242.src: You're cursed, and you say you're from Wynn. Both of those are problems.
A New Beginning#242.dst: Você é amaldiçoado e diz ser de Wynn. As duas coisas são um problema.
A New Beginning#242.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#243.src: I don't know what Syndra sees in you... but whatever it is, it'd better make up for both of those things.
A New Beginning#243.dst: Não sei o que Syndra vê em você... mas seja o que for, é bom que compense essas duas coisas.
A New Beginning#243.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#245.src: Now, what could I do for you?
A New Beginning#245.dst: E então, em que posso ajudar?
A New Beginning#245.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#246.src: Ah! Yes, well, these are not our full numbers. The others live elsewhere, either in town or in various villages. They stop by every so often, so perhaps you’ll have the chance to meet them later!
A New Beginning#246.dst: Ah! Sim, bem, não estamos todos aqui. Os outros moram em outros lugares, na cidade ou em várias aldeias. Passam por aqui de vez em quando, então talvez você os conheça mais tarde!
A New Beginning#246.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#247.src: We all are the ones who live here full-time. Nowhere else in particular we can go, if you catch my meaning.
A New Beginning#247.dst: Nós somos os que moram aqui o tempo todo. Não temos outro lugar para ir, se é que me entende.
A New Beginning#247.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#248.src: If you’re from beyond our province’s walls, I expect we’ll be wanting to set you up with a room of your own sometime… but we can discuss that later.
A New Beginning#248.dst: Se você vem de além dos muros da província, imagino que vamos querer te arranjar um quarto só seu algum dia… mas falamos disso depois.
A New Beginning#248.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#249.src: Indeed. I hope we can do some good work together, young leaf!
A New Beginning#249.dst: De fato. Espero que façamos bom trabalho juntos, jovem folha!
A New Beginning#249.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#250.src: Um... nice to meet you, I guess?
A New Beginning#250.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#251.src: Oh... I take care of the injured. I also cook... sometimes.
A New Beginning#251.dst: Ah... eu cuido dos feridos. Também cozinho... às vezes.
A New Beginning#251.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#252.src: I'm not really much of a fighter... not much of, um, anything, really.
A New Beginning#252.dst: Não sou muito de lutar... nem de, hã, nada, na verdade.
A New Beginning#252.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#253.src: I'm mostly just here because of Mora... he's, um, my brother.
A New Beginning#253.dst: Estou aqui mais por causa do Mora... ele é, hã, meu irmão.
A New Beginning#253.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#256.src: I'm g-glad you were able to c-convince Syndra to let you j-join! It'll be n-nice having someone new a-around.
A New Beginning#256.dst: Que b-bom que você convenceu a Syndra a te deixar e-entrar! Vai ser l-legal ter alguém novo por a-aqui.
A New Beginning#256.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#258.src: I... d-don't know, actually. It looks like she's h-heading towards the F-Frog Tavern... but why...?
A New Beginning#258.dst: Eu... n-não sei, na verdade. Parece que ela está i-indo para a T-Taverna do Sapo... mas por quê...?
A New Beginning#258.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#259.src: Hey... {u}. How'd you l-like to have your first of-official resistance mission with me?
A New Beginning#259.dst: Ei... {u}. Que tal fazer sua primeira missão o-oficial da resistência comigo?
A New Beginning#259.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#260.src: I-I want to f-follow her and see what she g-gets up to at a r-random bar, of all places...
A New Beginning#260.dst: E-eu quero s-seguir ela e ver o que ela a-apronta num b-bar qualquer, logo lá...
A New Beginning#260.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#261.src: You know, I-I-I've always suspected that the t-tavern isn't what it a-appears to be!
A New Beginning#261.dst: Sabe, e-e-eu sempre desconfiei que a t-taverna não é o que p-parece!
A New Beginning#261.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#264.src: Wh- I- n-no! I j-just want to m-m-make sure she's okay. Th-that's all.
A New Beginning#264.dst: Q- E- n-não! Só q-quero ter c-c-certeza de que ela está bem. S-só isso.
A New Beginning#264.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#265.src: Let's m-meet up at the tavern. It's j-just to the north of here.
A New Beginning#265.dst: Vamos nos e-encontrar na taverna. Fica l-logo ao norte daqui.
A New Beginning#265.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#266.src: I m-mainly gather intel for the resistance! Th-that usually involves needing to st-stay hidden.
A New Beginning#266.dst: Eu c-coleto informações para a resistência! Isso c-costuma exigir ficar e-escondido.
A New Beginning#266.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#267.src: I've picked up a t-t-trick or two over the y-years.
A New Beginning#267.dst: Aprendi um t-t-truque ou dois com os a-anos.
A New Beginning#267.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#268.src: S-sometimes I sell stuff I f-find in the forest in town! B-but that's not really f-for the resistance. That's for m-me.
A New Beginning#268.dst: Às v-vezes vendo na cidade coisas que a-acho na floresta! M-mas isso não é bem p-para a resistência. É para m-mim.
A New Beginning#268.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#269.dst: O que você pegou em Nixeph?

A New Beginning#270.src: Huh? Oh, r-right! I was l-looking for guard rotations, for th-the upcoming festival.
A New Beginning#270.dst: Hã? Ah, c-claro! Eu estava a-atrás das escalas da guarda, para o p-próximo festival.
A New Beginning#270.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#271.src: S-security is usually pretty high, so... it's g-good to know where and when is s-s-safe.
A New Beginning#271.dst: A s-segurança costuma ser bem alta, então... é b-bom saber onde e quando é s-s-seguro.
A New Beginning#271.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#273.src: I-I've been wondering the s-same thing...
A New Beginning#273.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#274.src: She usually isn't l-like this! I wonder if s-something's wrong...
A New Beginning#274.dst: Ela não costuma ser a-assim! Será que tem a-algo errado...
A New Beginning#274.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#275.src: ...I can t-talk to her about it later.
A New Beginning#275.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#277.src: Meet up with Zeph outside the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#277.dst: Encontre Zeph do lado de fora da Taverna do Sapo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#278.src: W-wait. We can't j-just go through the f-front, she'll s-see us.
A New Beginning#278.dst: E-espera. Não dá para entrar pela f-frente, ela vai nos v-ver.
A New Beginning#278.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#280.src: You'll get s-spotted! Let's get in from above i-instead.
A New Beginning#280.dst: Vão te v-ver! Vamos entrar por c-cima.
A New Beginning#280.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#281.src: Sneak into the Frog Tavern at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A New Beginning#281.dst: Entre escondido na Taverna do Sapo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#282.src: R-right behind you. D-don't get spotted!
A New Beginning#282.dst: L-logo atrás de você. Q-que não te vejam!
A New Beginning#282.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#283.src: Th-there she is! I w-wonder what she's-
A New Beginning#283.dst: A-ali está ela! Será q-que ela está-
A New Beginning#283.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#286.src: You interrupt my sequence like this and won't even say my name? Come on, now.
A New Beginning#286.dst: Você interrompe minha sequência assim e nem diz meu nome? Ora, vamos.
A New Beginning#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#287.src: Bartender, my usual mix. I need a boost.
A New Beginning#287.dst: Garçom, o de sempre. Preciso de um gás.
A New Beginning#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#289.src: Oh, thank you for noticing! It's because of the stress. Look, I know you're aware of the attack on Torann by now. You've always kept up with the details.
A New Beginning#289.dst: Ah, obrigado por notar! É por causa do estresse. Olha, sei que você já soube do ataque a Torann. Sempre está por dentro dos detalhes.
A New Beginning#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#290.src: But how about we accelerate this. You know how little time I have and you didn't bring me here just for drinks.
A New Beginning#290.dst: Mas que tal acelerarmos isso? Você sabe o pouco tempo que tenho, e não me trouxe aqui só para beber.
A New Beginning#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#291.src: Skipping the small talk, I see. Are my intentions really that transparent?
A New Beginning#291.dst: Sem conversa fiada, vejo. Minhas intenções são tão transparentes assim?
A New Beginning#291.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#292.src: Predictable, more like, after all this time. You've always got an angle you're working towards when you call me here.
A New Beginning#292.dst: Previsíveis, eu diria, depois de tanto tempo. Você sempre tem algum ângulo em mente quando me chama aqui.
A New Beginning#292.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#293.src: Maybe I just like the ambience.
A New Beginning#293.dst: Talvez eu só goste do ambiente.
A New Beginning#293.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#294.src: ...I need another passport. Same as the rest.
A New Beginning#294.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#295.src: Naturally. You and your trend for collecting strays... Really you should just start a family by this point.
A New Beginning#295.dst: Naturalmente. Você e essa mania de recolher desgarrados... A essa altura, devia era começar uma família.
A New Beginning#295.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#296.src: You of all people should know that I can't just stand by and leave them to fend for themselves.
A New Beginning#296.dst: Você, mais que ninguém, devia saber que não posso ficar parada e deixá-los se virar sozinhos.
A New Beginning#296.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#297.src: Of course. As I always do.
A New Beginning#297.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#298.src: Ha! "Always." If I were a gambling man I'd never bet on your odds.
A New Beginning#298.dst: Ha! "Sempre." Se eu apostasse, nunca apostaria nas suas chances.
A New Beginning#298.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#299.src: I need to get moving. There's always something that needs me to crunch the numbers... and today's events have only added to the pile.
A New Beginning#299.dst: Preciso ir. Sempre tem algo que exige que eu faça as contas... e os eventos de hoje só aumentaram a pilha.
A New Beginning#299.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#300.src: I certainly wouldn't want to delay you, Sovereign. I hope you manage to sort out all these problems.
A New Beginning#300.dst: Não quero atrasá-lo, Soberano. Espero que consiga resolver todos esses problemas.
A New Beginning#300.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#301.src: Oh, we will. It's only a matter of time. Take care, Syndra. Keep it constant.
A New Beginning#301.dst: Ah, vamos. É só questão de tempo. Cuide-se, Syndra. Mantenha-se constante.
A New Beginning#301.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#302.src: Sigh. You may as well come down now. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#302.dst: Ai, ai. Podem descer agora. Zeph, {u}.
A New Beginning#302.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#304.src: That was... risky. You're lucky he didn't look up.
A New Beginning#304.dst: Foi arriscado. Sorte que ele não olhou para cima.
A New Beginning#304.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#305.src: S-sure, but- b-but what were you d-doing meeting up w-with him?!
A New Beginning#305.dst: C-claro, mas- m-mas o que você fazia se e-encontrando c-com ele?!
A New Beginning#305.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#306.src: Its... complicated - we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#306.dst: É... complicado - temos uma espécie de acordo. O que importa é que está tudo resolvido. Já que está aqui, {u}, pegue isto. Seu passaporte.
A New Beginning#306.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#307.src: It's... complicated - we have something of an agreement. What matters is that everything is taken care of. Since you're here, {u}, take this. Your passport.
A New Beginning#307.dst: É... complicado - temos uma espécie de acordo. O que importa é que está tudo resolvido. Já que está aqui, {u}, pegue isto. Seu passaporte.
A New Beginning#307.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#308.src: He's... h-he's with the c-crown, though. H-how can you t-trust him?
A New Beginning#308.dst: Ele é... e-ele é da C-Coroa, ora. C-como pode c-confiar nele?
A New Beginning#308.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#309.src: I had hoped to keep this a secret for a reason... but what's done is done. Just... don't do anything rash, would you?
A New Beginning#309.dst: Eu queria manter isso em segredo por um motivo... mas o que está feito, está feito. Só... não façam besteira, tá?
A New Beginning#309.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#310.src: {u}, your passport will let you enter the city. I'd suggest you take some time to visit and look around, to familiarize yourself with the place.
A New Beginning#310.dst: {u}, seu passaporte vai deixar você entrar na cidade. Sugiro que tire um tempo para visitar e olhar em volta, para conhecer o lugar.
A New Beginning#310.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#311.src: And when you have time... I'd like to follow up on our discussion we had earlier. I think it's time we start taking steps forward.
A New Beginning#311.dst: E quando tiver tempo... quero retomar nossa conversa de antes. Acho que é hora de começarmos a dar passos adiante.
A New Beginning#311.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#312.src: I'll be returning to our home. Zeph, you can come with me if you'd like.
A New Beginning#312.dst: Vou voltar para casa. Zeph, pode vir comigo se quiser.
A New Beginning#312.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#314.src: Ugh. What do you want? I'm clearly busy.
A New Beginning#314.dst: Argh. O que quer? Estou ocupada, não vê?
A New Beginning#314.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#316.src: No, just... leave me alone, okay? I don't want to talk to you.
A New Beginning#316.dst: Não, só... me deixa em paz, tá? Não quero falar com você.
A New Beginning#316.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#317.src: Ah! You ca-caught- caught me off guard. How's your time in Auburn bee-been?
A New Beginning#317.dst: Ah! Você me pe-pegou- pegou de surpresa. Como tem si-sido Auburn para você?
A New Beginning#317.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#318.src: Yup! I've s-s-stayed here the longest so I've ma-managed to gather quite the assortment of useful stuff. Rex w-w-would call it junk but...
A New Beginning#318.dst: Sim! Sou quem e-e-está aqui há mais tempo, então ju-juntei uma boa variedade de coisas úteis. A Rex c-c-chamaria de tralha, mas...
A New Beginning#318.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#319.src: An old friend a-actually helped me make this training dum-dummy.
A New Beginning#319.dst: Um velho amigo me a-ajudou a fazer este boneco de trei-treino.
A New Beginning#319.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#320.src: Gotta stay on t-top of my training! Especially with you here.
A New Beginning#320.dst: Tenho que manter o t-treino em dia! Ainda mais com você aqui.
A New Beginning#320.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#321.src: Besides, I wa-wa-want I want to be able to help when it matters.
A New Beginning#321.dst: Além disso, eu que-que-quero eu quero ajudar quando importar.
A New Beginning#321.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#322.src: We should t-train together some day.
A New Beginning#322.dst: A gente devia t-treinar junto um dia.
A New Beginning#322.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#324.src: Did you... need help with anything?
A New Beginning#324.dst: Você... precisava de ajuda com algo?
A New Beginning#324.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#325.src: Mhm! Me, Zeph, Rex, and Mora all, um, have rooms here. Oh, and Syndra, too. And Kaio lives nearby too...
A New Beginning#325.dst: Aham! Eu, o Zeph, a Rex e o Mora, hã, temos quartos aqui. Ah, e a Syndra também. E o Kaio mora perto...
A New Beginning#325.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#326.src: I've... been meaning to decorate some more. You know... make it more, um, homely.
A New Beginning#326.dst: Eu... ando querendo decorar mais. Sabe... deixar mais, hã, aconchegante.
A New Beginning#326.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#327.src: ...but life's been getting in the way, I suppose.
A New Beginning#327.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#328.src: Um! I- d-don't, ha, judge me for this, but... I'm, um, writing in my diary.
A New Beginning#328.dst: Hã! Eu- n-não, ha, me julgue, mas... estou, hã, escrevendo no meu diário.
A New Beginning#328.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#329.src: ...a-and before you ask! No!! You're, um, not allowed to read it.
A New Beginning#329.dst: ...e-e antes que pergunte! Não!! Você, hã, não pode ler.
A New Beginning#329.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#330.src: ...thank you. I'll, um, see you later.
A New Beginning#330.speaker: Sui

A New Beginning#331.src: Hmm... Delivering mail from river settlement to {p}... Kaio... Check... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#331.dst: Hmm... Entregar correio do povoado do rio a {p}... Kaio... Feito... Hmmm.
A New Beginning#331.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#332.src: Ah! {u}, do you require my assistance?
A New Beginning#332.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#333.src: Ah... You overheard me talking to myself, then. Hoh!
A New Beginning#333.dst: Ah... Então você me ouviu falando sozinho. Hoh!
A New Beginning#333.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#334.src: I am just writing and filing some reports I had forgotten about. We are trying to keep better track of our activities throughout the forest, you see.
A New Beginning#334.dst: Só estou escrevendo e arquivando uns relatórios que tinha esquecido. Queremos registrar melhor nossas atividades pela floresta, sabe?
A New Beginning#334.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#336.src: Hm... I guess not, thinking on it now. A few years ago, had you asked, I'd've probably said yes. But I don't got the strength in me for it anymore.
A New Beginning#336.dst: Hm... Acho que não, pensando agora. Uns anos atrás, se tivesse perguntado, eu diria que sim. Mas num tenho mais força pra isso.
A New Beginning#336.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#337.src: It's good your arrival has given Syndra and the younguns some hope, for once. We've been a bit, eh... lacking in it lately.
A New Beginning#337.dst: Que bom que sua chegada deu um pouco de esperança pra Syndra e pros jovens, pra variar. A gente anda meio, é... sem ela.
A New Beginning#337.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#338.src: I've got no such delusions, unfortunately. I reckon this path only ends in tragedy. But it's not my place to say so, so I don't.
A New Beginning#338.dst: Eu num tenho essas ilusões, infelizmente. Acho que esse caminho só acaba em tragédia. Mas num cabe a mim dizer, então não digo.
A New Beginning#338.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#339.src: Would be good to be proven wrong... but I don't think I will be. I've seen this sorta thing before.
A New Beginning#339.dst: Seria bom estar errado... mas acho que não vou estar. Já vi esse tipo de coisa antes.
A New Beginning#339.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#340.src: ...what? I got nothin' else to say.
A New Beginning#340.dst: ...quê? Num tenho mais o que dizer.
A New Beginning#340.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#341.src: Interesting that you're drawn to that grave in particular. S'our latest loss, that'n there.
A New Beginning#341.dst: Curioso você se interessar justo por aquele túmulo. É nossa perda mais recente, aquele ali.
A New Beginning#341.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#342.src: It's a damn shame. A tragedy each 'n every time, yet still happens often enough to feel routine. But that's life, I reckon.
A New Beginning#342.dst: É uma baita pena. Uma tragédia toda santa vez, e mesmo assim acontece tanto que parece rotina. Mas a vida é assim, acho.
A New Beginning#342.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#343.src: ...did you now? Funny thing to say about a dead man, considering I ain't ever seen you 'round these parts before.
A New Beginning#343.dst: ...é mesmo? Coisa engraçada de dizer de um morto, já que nunca te vi por estas bandas.
A New Beginning#343.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#344.src: Now, spill. 'Fore I go and tell Synny you ain't no good after all.
A New Beginning#344.dst: Desembucha. Antes que eu conte pra Synny que você num presta.
A New Beginning#344.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#345.src: Ah... Wynn. Caught Rex muttering something 'bout that once or twice before. Poor girl... it'd do her well to set it aside, for a time.
A New Beginning#345.dst: Ah... Wynn. Peguei a Rex resmungando algo disso uma ou duas vezes. Coitada... ia fazer bem pra ela deixar isso de lado, por um tempo.
A New Beginning#345.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#346.src: Didn't think much of it, but I suppose you're livin' proof, aren'tcha? Strange as can be...
A New Beginning#346.dst: Nunca dei muita bola, mas acho que você é a prova viva, né? Estranho que só...
A New Beginning#346.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#347.src: Say, is the memory wipin' a real thing? Got no damn clue where that theory started, but... well, if one thing's true, why not the rest?
A New Beginning#347.dst: Diz aí, isso de apagar a memória é real? Num sei de onde saiu essa teoria, mas... bom, se uma coisa é verdade, por que não o resto?
A New Beginning#347.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#348.src: Damn. Damn. That's rough. That's real rough, ain't it. And you're tellin' me that's where he ended up?
A New Beginning#348.dst: Droga. Droga. Que barra. Que barra pesada, hein. E você tá dizendo que foi lá que ele foi parar?
A New Beginning#348.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#349.src: Hrm... y'know, it's funny. Big guy like him, you wouldn't take him for a thief. Hard to keep hidden, eh? And yet...
A New Beginning#349.dst: Hum... sabe, é engraçado. Grandalhão assim, ninguém diria que era ladrão. Difícil de esconder, né? E mesmo assim...
A New Beginning#349.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#350.src: He'd managed to turn blending into a crowd into an art. No matter where he was, who he spoke to, how he was actin', he'd always seem like he fit right in.
A New Beginning#350.dst: Ele fez de se misturar na multidão uma arte. Não importava onde estava, com quem falava, como agia, sempre parecia que se encaixava.
A New Beginning#350.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#351.src: ...t'was a right stupid risk that did him in, in the end. I told him, I did- it ain't worth breaking into the Sovereign's place, especially not during festival times...
A New Beginning#351.dst: ...foi um risco besta que acabou com ele, no fim. Eu avisei, avisei sim- num vale a pena invadir a casa do Soberano, ainda mais em época de festival...
A New Beginning#351.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#352.src: But he was the kinda sort to dig in his heels. Said he'd be fine, said it'd be worth it, nabbin' all those documents. Something to help the cause... I hardly even remember now.
A New Beginning#352.dst: Mas ele era do tipo teimoso. Disse que ia ficar bem, que ia valer a pena, surrupiar aqueles documentos todos. Algo pra ajudar a causa... nem lembro mais direito.
A New Beginning#352.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#353.src: Can't save 'em all. Especially not from themselves. I've learned that many times over, over my years.
A New Beginning#353.dst: Num dá pra salvar todo mundo. Ainda mais deles mesmos. Aprendi isso muitas vezes, ao longo dos anos.
A New Beginning#353.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#354.src: So he got caught. Heard a cursed one got involved... was a whole damn mess. Sovereign really wasn't happy with Synny when he heard, let me tell you. Ain't seen her that shellshocked in years.
A New Beginning#354.dst: Aí pegaram ele. Ouvi que um amaldiçoado se meteu... foi uma baita confusão. O Soberano num ficou nada feliz com a Synny quando soube, vou te contar. Fazia anos que num via ela tão abalada.
A New Beginning#354.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#355.src: ...but you're sayin' he lived? How's that all work out?
A New Beginning#355.dst: ...mas tá dizendo que ele sobreviveu? Como é que pode?
A New Beginning#355.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#357.src: Well... tell me this, then. Was he happy, you think? Out there in the wider world? Did he live a good life?
A New Beginning#357.dst: Bom... então me diz uma coisa. Ele era feliz, você acha? Lá fora, no mundo? Teve uma vida boa?
A New Beginning#357.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#358.src: ...alright. Alrighty. Good. That- that's good, y'hear. I... I'm glad for that much.
A New Beginning#358.dst: ...tá. Tá bom. Bom. Isso- isso é bom, ouviu. Eu... fico feliz por isso, pelo menos.
A New Beginning#358.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#359.src: Thank you for... for tellin' me all that. S'not a tale that ends in happiness, but I reckon so long as he made the most of it... that's all you can really hope for.
A New Beginning#359.dst: Obrigado por... por me contar tudo isso. Num é uma história com final feliz, mas acho que, se ele aproveitou o máximo... é tudo que dá pra esperar.
A New Beginning#359.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#360.src: Y'may as well leave me be a while, now. Got some thinkin' to get through.
A New Beginning#360.dst: Melhor me deixar sozinho um pouco agora. Tenho umas coisas pra pensar.
A New Beginning#360.speaker: Kaio

A New Beginning#362.src: I'll let you get back to it.

A New Beginning#366.src: It's a headstone. Carved into the stone, you see a name and a year.
A New Beginning#366.dst: É uma lápide. Gravados na pedra, você vê um nome e um ano.

A New Beginning#369.src: He got sent to Wynn. We... m
A New Beginning#369.dst: Mandaram ele a Wynn. Nós... nos conhecemos lá.
A New Beginning#369.full: He got sent to Wynn. We... met there.

A Sandy Scandal#000.src: You look like a hardy one! {p} army, is it? Would you be willing to help {p} a bit?
A Sandy Scandal#000.dst: Você parece forte! Do exército de {p}, é? Estaria disposto a ajudar {p} um pouco?
A Sandy Scandal#000.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#001.src: We're looking into some witness reports to try to gain information on the bandits' plan.
A Sandy Scandal#001.dst: Estamos analisando depoimentos de testemunhas para descobrir o plano dos bandidos.
A Sandy Scandal#001.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#002.src: You read the report and visualize its words.
A Sandy Scandal#002.dst: Você lê o depoimento e imagina as cenas.

A Sandy Scandal#003.src: WITNESS REPORT I - TOLD BY ODIN GIBBS, SHOP OWNER - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.
A Sandy Scandal#003.dst: DEPOIMENTO I - POR ODIN GIBBS, DONO DA LOJA - GIBBS' MINING SUPPLY STORE CO.

A Sandy Scandal#004.src: Business was slow that day, until two rugged, oddly-dressed men stormed into my shop, with a lot of nerve.
A Sandy Scandal#004.dst: Era um dia fraco, até que dois sujeitos rudes e esquisitos invadiram minha loja, cheios de atrevimento.

A Sandy Scandal#005.src: Before I could close any deal with them, the man with a dagger started threatening me!
A Sandy Scandal#005.dst: Antes que eu fechasse negócio com eles, o homem da adaga começou a me ameaçar!

A Sandy Scandal#006.src: I tried to make peace with the crooks.

A Sandy Scandal#007.src: The bandit put the knife closer to me and started demanding the code to the TNT vault downstairs!
A Sandy Scandal#007.dst: O bandido aproximou a faca de mim e começou a exigir o código do cofre de TNT lá embaixo!

A Sandy Scandal#008.src: The bandits grew agitated and resorted to violence to obtain the combination.
A Sandy Scandal#008.dst: Os bandidos se agitaram e partiram para a violência para obter a combinação.

A Sandy Scandal#009.src: They swiped their knife at me, leaving a sizeable wound on my arm.
A Sandy Scandal#009.dst: Eles me atacaram com a faca, deixando um corte feio no meu braço.

A Sandy Scandal#010.src: I had no choice but to give up the combination, which was {~}.
A Sandy Scandal#010.dst: Não tive escolha a não ser entregar a combinação, que era {~}.

A Sandy Scandal#011.src: After I gave up the combination, they knocked me out!
A Sandy Scandal#011.dst: Depois que entreguei a combinação, eles me nocautearam!

A Sandy Scandal#012.src: I had no idea what the criminals did after that, I haven't been back to my shop since the incident.
A Sandy Scandal#012.dst: Não sei o que os criminosos fizeram depois, não voltei à minha loja desde o incidente.

A Sandy Scandal#013.src: The bandits must've taken the explosives! You should investigate.
A Sandy Scandal#013.dst: Os bandidos devem ter levado os explosivos! Você devia investigar.

A Sandy Scandal#014.src: Looks like the bandit's took almost all of the TNT from the shopkeeper's vault.
A Sandy Scandal#014.dst: Parece que os bandidos levaram quase toda a TNT do cofre do lojista.

A Sandy Scandal#015.src: They seem to have dropped their knife during all the looting...
A Sandy Scandal#015.dst: Parece que deixaram cair a faca durante o saque...

A Sandy Scandal#016.src: You should return to the {p} Bank Guard with your information.
A Sandy Scandal#016.dst: Volte ao guarda do banco de {p} com o que descobriu.

A Sandy Scandal#017.src: WITNESS REPORT II - TOLD BY SCROLL MERCHANT, SHOP OWNER - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP
A Sandy Scandal#017.dst: DEPOIMENTO II - POR MERCADOR DE PERGAMINHOS, DONO DA LOJA - ALMUJ SCROLL SHOP

A Sandy Scandal#018.src: I was having a fine time tending to my rooftop garden after a lengthy day of selling scrolls.
A Sandy Scandal#018.dst: Eu cuidava tranquilo do meu jardim no terraço depois de um longo dia vendendo pergaminhos.

A Sandy Scandal#019.src: While looking down on the street, I saw two unsavory men, one with TNT in hand, marching down the path.
A Sandy Scandal#019.dst: Olhando para a rua, vi dois homens mal-encarados, um com TNT na mão, descendo pelo caminho.

A Sandy Scandal#020.src: I was suspicious, so I tried to get their attention, but they ignored me.
A Sandy Scandal#020.dst: Desconfiei e tentei chamar a atenção deles, mas me ignoraram.

A Sandy Scandal#021.src: I tried to yell for the attention of a guard or official, but nobody could hear me.
A Sandy Scandal#021.dst: Tentei gritar para chamar algum guarda ou oficial, mas ninguém me ouvia.

A Sandy Scandal#022.src: I wasn't sure what to do at this point... I didn't try to confront them, that'd have been way too risky!
A Sandy Scandal#022.dst: Eu não sabia o que fazer naquela hora... Não tentei enfrentá-los, seria arriscado demais!

A Sandy Scandal#023.src: I have no idea where they went off to afterwards.
A Sandy Scandal#023.dst: Não faço ideia de para onde foram depois.

A Sandy Scandal#024.src: You should check out the house that the explosion came from!
A Sandy Scandal#024.dst: Você devia investigar a casa de onde veio a explosão!

A Sandy Scandal#025.src: Two weapons are missing from the wealthy estate owner's weapon rack!
A Sandy Scandal#025.dst: Faltam duas armas no suporte do rico dono da propriedade!

A Sandy Scandal#026.src: With such powerful weapons the bandits could easily break through the bank's defenses.
A Sandy Scandal#026.dst: Com armas tão poderosas, os bandidos romperiam fácil as defesas do banco.

A Sandy Scandal#027.src: The whole thing'll go up in a few seconds, and any evidence will be buried in the sand. Good luck getting out of here!
A Sandy Scandal#027.dst: Tudo vai pelos ares em poucos segundos, e qualquer prova vai ficar enterrada na areia. Boa sorte para sair daqui!
A Sandy Scandal#027.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#028.src: Looks like the bandits have started their heist! You should follow them into the bank and stop them.
A Sandy Scandal#028.dst: Parece que os bandidos começaram o assalto! Siga-os até o banco e detenha-os.

A Sandy Scandal#029.src: It's too late to stop us now! We're about to bust out of here with the grand prize - the contents of the emerald vault!
A Sandy Scandal#029.dst: Tarde demais para nos deter! Estamos prestes a dar o fora com o grande prêmio - o conteúdo do cofre de esmeraldas!
A Sandy Scandal#029.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#030.src: We think the bandits might have made the first move in their heist, we're mobilising a troop to-
A Sandy Scandal#030.dst: Achamos que os bandidos já deram o primeiro passo no assalto, estamos mobilizando uma tropa para-
A Sandy Scandal#030.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#031.src: Before anybody could hear me, a large explosion occurred inside of the house the bandits intruded.
A Sandy Scandal#031.dst: Antes que alguém me ouvisse, houve uma grande explosão dentro da casa que os bandidos invadiram.

A Sandy Scandal#032.src: Talk to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Sandy Scandal#032.dst: Fale com o guarda do banco de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Sandy Scandal#034.src: {p} bank tends to be a prime target for bandits, and there's been a string of incidents that have made us suspicious.
A Sandy Scandal#034.dst: O banco de {p} costuma ser alvo preferido dos bandidos, e uma série de incidentes nos deixou desconfiados.
A Sandy Scandal#034.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#036.src: If I give you some of the reports, will you help check them out for clues?
A Sandy Scandal#036.dst: Se eu te passar alguns depoimentos, você ajuda a procurar pistas?
A Sandy Scandal#036.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#037.src: Great! The store from the first witness report is straight down the stairs, just past this building right behind me.
A Sandy Scandal#037.dst: Ótimo! A loja do primeiro depoimento fica descendo a escada, logo depois deste prédio atrás de mim.
A Sandy Scandal#037.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#038.src: It's called "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", and the owner reported a robbery a few days ago.
A Sandy Scandal#038.dst: Chama-se "Gibbs' Mining Supply Store", e o dono relatou um roubo há alguns dias.
A Sandy Scandal#038.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#039.src: Good luck! Report back to me if you find any information.
A Sandy Scandal#039.dst: Boa sorte! Volte para me contar se achar algo.
A Sandy Scandal#039.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#040.src: Go to the witness report location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#040.dst: Vá ao local do depoimento em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#041.src: Hello gentlemen! What can I interest you in today? Some industrial torches? Pickaxes?
A Sandy Scandal#041.dst: Olá, senhores! O que posso oferecer hoje? Tochas industriais? Picaretas?
A Sandy Scandal#041.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#042.src: Shut yer’ trap, old man. We came for a different kind of business.
A Sandy Scandal#042.dst: Cala a boca, velho. Viemos por outro tipo de negócio.
A Sandy Scandal#042.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#043.src: Wha-? Look, fellows. Just step out of my store, and nobody gets hurt. I don't want any trouble.
A Sandy Scandal#043.dst: Quê-? Olhem, amigos. Saiam da minha loja e ninguém se machuca. Não quero confusão.
A Sandy Scandal#043.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#044.src: Listen up old man, tell us the code to the TNT vault in the basement, or I decorate my necklace with your fingers!
A Sandy Scandal#044.dst: Escuta aqui, velho, diz o código do cofre de TNT no porão, ou faço um colar com seus dedos!
A Sandy Scandal#044.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#045.src: Certainly not! That TNT is for licensed mining companies only, not your average amateur miner.
A Sandy Scandal#045.dst: De jeito nenhum! Essa TNT é só para mineradoras licenciadas, não para qualquer minerador amador.
A Sandy Scandal#045.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#046.src: Well then! I guess you'll still be able to grasp a pick with four fingers, eh?
A Sandy Scandal#046.dst: Pois bem! Acho que com quatro dedos você ainda segura uma picareta, hein?
A Sandy Scandal#046.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#047.src: Gaaah! Alright, alright! No more violence, please!
A Sandy Scandal#047.dst: Aaah! Tá, tá! Chega de violência, por favor!
A Sandy Scandal#047.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#048.src: The code is {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... please don't hurt me!
A Sandy Scandal#048.dst: O código é {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... não me machuquem!
A Sandy Scandal#048.speaker: Shopkeeper Gibbs

A Sandy Scandal#049.src: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... thanks! We won't be needing you anymore... now go to sleep!
A Sandy Scandal#049.dst: {~}-{~}-{~}-{~}... valeu! Não precisamos mais de você... agora, dorme!
A Sandy Scandal#049.speaker: Bandit

A Sandy Scandal#050.src: Open the vault in the basement [Code: {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#054.src: Ah, you're back! Did you find anything interesting in the report?
A Sandy Scandal#054.dst: Ah, você voltou! Achou algo interessante no depoimento?
A Sandy Scandal#054.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#055.src: Missing TNT in the shop's vault? Looks like the shopkeeper was telling the truth.
A Sandy Scandal#055.dst: TNT sumida do cofre da loja? Parece que o lojista dizia a verdade.
A Sandy Scandal#055.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#056.src: We need to catch these criminals quickly if they have access to that amount of TNT - they could blow a hole right into the bank's vault!
A Sandy Scandal#056.dst: Precisamos pegar esses criminosos rápido se eles têm tanta TNT - podem abrir um buraco direto no cofre do banco!
A Sandy Scandal#056.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#057.src: You should check out another witness report, from after the attack on the shopkeeper.
A Sandy Scandal#057.dst: Você devia ver outro depoimento, de depois do ataque ao lojista.
A Sandy Scandal#057.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#058.src: It was taken from the rooftop garden of the Scroll Merchant's residence, you should take a look.
A Sandy Scandal#058.dst: Foi colhido no jardim do terraço da casa do Mercador de Pergaminhos, dê uma olhada.
A Sandy Scandal#058.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#059.src: Be quick! We don't have much time if we want to stop these bandits.
A Sandy Scandal#059.dst: Rápido! Não temos muito tempo se quisermos deter esses bandidos.
A Sandy Scandal#059.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#062.src: Ey', what do you two blighters think you're doing with those dangerous explosives in the city?
A Sandy Scandal#062.dst: Ei, o que vocês dois patifes acham que estão fazendo com esses explosivos perigosos na cidade?
A Sandy Scandal#062.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#063.src: Guards! Guards! Robber! Come quick! Urgently!
A Sandy Scandal#063.dst: Guardas! Guardas! Ladrão! Rápido! É urgente!
A Sandy Scandal#063.speaker: Scroll Merchant

A Sandy Scandal#065.src: Find the source of the detonation at [{~}, {~}, {~}].
A Sandy Scandal#065.dst: Encontre a origem da detonação em [{~}, {~}, {~}].

A Sandy Scandal#068.src: Were you able to uncover any new information regarding the status of the criminals?
A Sandy Scandal#068.dst: Conseguiu descobrir algo novo sobre a situação dos criminosos?
A Sandy Scandal#068.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#069.src: Ah... that's troubling. The criminals plundered two very powerful weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#069.dst: Ah... isso é preocupante. Os criminosos roubaram duas armas muito poderosas.
A Sandy Scandal#069.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#070.src: It won't be easy facing those criminals if they decide to raid the bank with those weapons.
A Sandy Scandal#070.dst: Não vai ser fácil enfrentar esses criminosos se decidirem invadir o banco com essas armas.
A Sandy Scandal#070.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#071.src: I'm not certain how to proceed from here, we didn't receive any more witness reports, and-
A Sandy Scandal#071.dst: Não sei bem como seguir daqui, não recebemos mais depoimentos, e-
A Sandy Scandal#071.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#072.src: Boss, I just received urgent reports of a robbery underway in the left residential area of {p}!
