A Sandy Scandal#072.dst: Chefe, chegaram relatos urgentes de um roubo em curso na área residencial esquerda de {p}!
A Sandy Scandal#072.speaker: Almuj Sentry

A Sandy Scandal#073.src: Oh my… you! Soldier! Quick! The robbery is taking place across the bridge, next to the first house you visited today! It may be the bandits we're looking for.
A Sandy Scandal#073.dst: Nossa… você! Soldado! Rápido! O roubo é do outro lado da ponte, ao lado da primeira casa que você visitou hoje! Podem ser os bandidos que buscamos.
A Sandy Scandal#073.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#074.src: There will be somebody waiting for you outside of the house once you get to the residential area!
A Sandy Scandal#074.dst: Vai ter alguém te esperando do lado de fora da casa quando chegar à área residencial!
A Sandy Scandal#074.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#075.src: If you still can't find it, I've written the coordinates in your content book. Now quickly, get to the house!
A Sandy Scandal#075.dst: Se ainda não achar, anotei as coordenadas no seu livro de conteúdo. Agora rápido, vá até a casa!
A Sandy Scandal#075.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#076.src: Quickly! Go to the house at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#076.dst: Rápido! Vá até a casa em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#077.src: Hello? Are you with the guards? Good! Hurry! Some bandits just ransacked my house, and left with lots of emeralds!
A Sandy Scandal#077.dst: Olá? Você é da guarda? Ótimo! Rápido! Uns bandidos acabaram de saquear minha casa e levaram um monte de esmeraldas!
A Sandy Scandal#077.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#078.src: Follow me to my house, hopefully you can find the bandits! They stole lots of my precious gems!
A Sandy Scandal#078.dst: Venha à minha casa, tomara que ache os bandidos! Roubaram muitas das minhas gemas preciosas!
A Sandy Scandal#078.speaker: Almuj Citizen

A Sandy Scandal#079.src: Look for signs of the bandits' whereabouts.
A Sandy Scandal#079.dst: Procure sinais do paradeiro dos bandidos.

A Sandy Scandal#081.src: Ready, boys? We've got the TNT, weapons, and the fastest horses those emeralds could buy. Now we just-
A Sandy Scandal#081.dst: Prontos, rapazes? Temos a TNT, as armas e os cavalos mais rápidos que as esmeraldas pagam. Agora é só-
A Sandy Scandal#081.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#082.src: Ahah. I had a feeling we had a guard on our tail.
A Sandy Scandal#082.dst: Ahá. Eu sabia que tinha um guarda na nossa cola.
A Sandy Scandal#082.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#083.src: No point wasting these brand-new weapons on you... since we're blowing up this hideout anyway!
A Sandy Scandal#083.dst: Nem vale gastar estas armas novinhas em você... já que vamos explodir este esconderijo mesmo!
A Sandy Scandal#083.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#086.src: Find where the bandits blasted a hole to get into the bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#086.dst: Encontre onde os bandidos abriram um buraco para entrar no banco em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#088.src: Follow the criminals into the other room.
A Sandy Scandal#088.dst: Siga os criminosos até a outra sala.

A Sandy Scandal#089.src: Look here, the soldier decided they wanted to follow us. Dumb move.
A Sandy Scandal#089.dst: Olha só, o soldado resolveu nos seguir. Péssima ideia.
A Sandy Scandal#089.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#090.src: I guess we can kill two birds with one stone: escaping the bank, and killing this pest.
A Sandy Scandal#090.dst: Dá para matar dois coelhos com uma cajadada só: fugir do banco e acabar com essa praga.
A Sandy Scandal#090.speaker: Bandit Leader

A Sandy Scandal#093.src: Report back to the {p} Bank Guard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Sandy Scandal#093.dst: Volte ao guarda do banco de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Sandy Scandal#094.src: Soldier! Where did you disappear to? Did you hear those explosions, below the bank?
A Sandy Scandal#094.dst: Soldado! Onde você se meteu? Ouviu aquelas explosões embaixo do banco?
A Sandy Scandal#094.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#096.src: You've already stopped them? And reclaimed the stolen weapons and explosives..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.dst: Você já os deteve? E recuperou as armas e os explosivos roubados..?
A Sandy Scandal#096.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#097.src: Wow. Excellent work, soldier. {p} is in your debt. Please accept these from our vault, as a token of our thanks.
A Sandy Scandal#097.dst: Uau. Excelente trabalho, soldado. {p} está em dívida com você. Aceite isto do nosso cofre como sinal de gratidão.
A Sandy Scandal#097.speaker: Almuj Bank Guard

A Sandy Scandal#098.src: I then realized that they had no innocent itinerary, they were heading straight for my wealthy neighbor's house!
A Sandy Scandal#098.dst: Então percebi que o trajeto deles não tinha nada de inocente: iam direto para a casa do meu vizinho rico!

A Sandy Scandal#099.src: The bandits came sprinting out of my wealthy neighbor's house with some of his most prized possessions: two weapons from his collection.
A Sandy Scandal#099.dst: Os bandidos saíram correndo da casa do meu vizinho rico com alguns de seus bens mais valiosos: duas armas da coleção dele.

Acquiring Credentials#000.src: Oh, an egg! I'll pay you {~} emeralds for it, of course!
Acquiring Credentials#000.dst: Ah, um ovo! Pago {~} esmeraldas por ele, claro!
Acquiring Credentials#000.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#001.dst: Consiga um passaporte de Gavel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Acquiring Credentials#002.src: I'm sorry sir, but I can't just give you a new passport... You'd need approval from-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.dst: Lamento, senhor, mas não posso lhe dar outro passaporte... Precisa da aprovação de-...
Acquiring Credentials#002.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#003.src: But sir, my passport was stolen! I have a flight to {p} in under {~} minutes. I really need one, quick...
Acquiring Credentials#003.dst: Mas, senhor, roubaram meu passaporte! Meu voo para {p} sai em menos de {~} minutos. Preciso de um já...
Acquiring Credentials#003.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#004.src: I've already told you where you need to go to get a new one. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#004.dst: Já lhe disse aonde ir para conseguir um novo. Próximo da fila, por favor!
Acquiring Credentials#004.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#005.src: Hmmm... {u}, is it? Unfortunately, humans are required to get their passports in Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.dst: Hmmm... {u}, não é? Infelizmente, humanos devem tirar o passaporte em Wynn.
Acquiring Credentials#005.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#006.src: I'm afraid I can't help you. Next in line, please!
Acquiring Credentials#006.dst: Receio não poder ajudar. Próximo da fila, por favor!
Acquiring Credentials#006.speaker: Officer

Acquiring Credentials#007.src: Hey, you! Yes, you! Come outside, would you? I think we can help each other.
Acquiring Credentials#007.dst: Ei, você! Sim, você! Pode vir aqui fora? Acho que podemos nos ajudar.
Acquiring Credentials#007.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#008.src: So, I overheard your conversation with the Officer... You're also looking for a passport, right?
Acquiring Credentials#008.dst: Então, ouvi sua conversa com o oficial... Você também quer um passaporte, né?
Acquiring Credentials#008.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#009.src: Well...so, I've heard rumours of a secret Black Market that hides in the airbase.
Acquiring Credentials#009.dst: Bom... então, ouvi boatos de um Mercado Negro secreto escondido na base aérea.
Acquiring Credentials#009.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#010.src: Let's explore the airbase, then! We need to look for clues, lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#010.dst: Vamos explorar a base aérea, então! Temos que achar pistas, vá na frente.
Acquiring Credentials#010.speaker: Cinfras Citizen

Acquiring Credentials#011.src: Apparently they trade illegal products... There has to be a way of buying passports, I'm sure of it!
Acquiring Credentials#011.dst: Dizem que negociam produtos ilegais... Tem que ter um jeito de comprar passaportes, tenho certeza!
Acquiring Credentials#011.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#012.src: If we work together, we might be able to find a way in. What do you think?
Acquiring Credentials#012.dst: Se trabalharmos juntos, talvez achemos um jeito de entrar. O que acha?
Acquiring Credentials#012.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#013.src: Explore the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#013.dst: Explore a base aérea em busca de pistas sobre o Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#014.src: Oh, you brought us to the Inn! Hmmm, the Barman's been working here for a long time...
Acquiring Credentials#014.dst: Ah, você nos trouxe à pousada! Hmmm, o barman trabalha aqui há muito tempo...
Acquiring Credentials#014.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#015.src: Maybe he knows something about the Black Market! I'll try and ask, y'know...all, uh...sneaky-like.
Acquiring Credentials#015.dst: Talvez ele saiba algo do Mercado Negro! Vou tentar perguntar, sabe... assim, hã... na surdina.
Acquiring Credentials#015.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#016.src: I can't believe this place! They only have some rancid wheat stored here, what am I supposed to do with that? I'll take a carrot any day over... wheat.
Acquiring Credentials#016.dst: Não acredito neste lugar! Só tem trigo rançoso guardado aqui, o que vou fazer com isso? Prefiro mil vezes uma cenoura a... trigo.

Acquiring Credentials#017.src: All those other airship men carry around those vile face fruits, but I have to say, I've always had a soft spot for potatoes.
Acquiring Credentials#017.dst: Todos esses outros aeronautas andam com aquelas frutas com cara nojentas, mas devo dizer que sempre tive um fraco por batatas.
Acquiring Credentials#017.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#018.src: I wish my airship was black, I can't say I'm a fan of that white palette...
Acquiring Credentials#018.dst: Queria uma aeronave preta, não sou muito fã dessa paleta branca...

Acquiring Credentials#020.src: You know, maybe white isn't so bad after all.
Acquiring Credentials#020.dst: Sabe, talvez branco não seja tão ruim, afinal.
Acquiring Credentials#020.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#021.src: It turns out, white's actually quite a nice colour.
Acquiring Credentials#021.dst: Pelo visto, branco é até uma cor bem bonita.
Acquiring Credentials#021.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#022.src: ... Oh, fine, wheat's not bad. I'll take some, I guess.
Acquiring Credentials#022.dst: ... Ah, tá, trigo não é ruim. Vou levar um pouco, acho.
Acquiring Credentials#022.speaker: Airship Commander

Acquiring Credentials#024.src: Though, really, the face doesn't mean it has to be evil, does it? It could be a nice face, after all.
Acquiring Credentials#024.dst: Mas, pensando bem, ter cara não quer dizer que seja malvada, né? Pode ser uma cara simpática, afinal.

Acquiring Credentials#025.src: Excuse me, sir... You, uh...wouldn't happen to know any really cheap stores around here, would you?
Acquiring Credentials#025.dst: Com licença, senhor... O senhor, hã... não conhece alguma loja bem barata por aqui, conhece?
Acquiring Credentials#025.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#026.src: The table's been set for the great feast, have stout or beer, what will it be?
Acquiring Credentials#026.dst: A mesa está posta para o grande banquete, preta ou loira, o que vai ser?
Acquiring Credentials#026.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#027.src: Is that a secret code...? Beer?
Acquiring Credentials#027.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#028.src: Did that work? Is he gonna let us in?
Acquiring Credentials#028.dst: Funcionou? Ele vai nos deixar entrar?
Acquiring Credentials#028.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#029.src: I guess it wouldn't be that easy to find a way in... Where do you think we can go with that lead, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.dst: Acho que não ia ser tão fácil entrar... Para onde acha que essa pista nos leva, {u}?
Acquiring Credentials#029.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#030.src: Let's just keep exploring. Lead the way.
Acquiring Credentials#030.dst: Vamos continuar explorando. Vá na frente.
Acquiring Credentials#030.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#031.src: Keep exploring the Airbase looking for clues about the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#031.dst: Continue explorando a base aérea em busca de pistas sobre o Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#033.src: Hey, uh...do these people look suspicious to you, too?
Acquiring Credentials#033.dst: Ei, hã... essa gente também te parece suspeita?
Acquiring Credentials#033.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#034.src: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#034.dst: Os comandantes de aeronave amam o que odeiam.
Acquiring Credentials#034.speaker: Waiter

Acquiring Credentials#035.src: I think we're getting onto something! Let's keep going.
Acquiring Credentials#035.dst: Acho que estamos chegando a algum lugar! Vamos continuar.
Acquiring Credentials#035.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#036.src: Follow the clue: The airship commanders love what they hate.
Acquiring Credentials#036.dst: Siga a pista: Os comandantes de aeronave amam o que odeiam.

Acquiring Credentials#037.src: Hmmm... These crates are full of items. Maybe we could give some of them to the commanders?
Acquiring Credentials#037.dst: Hmmm... Essas caixas estão cheias de itens. Será que podíamos dar alguns aos comandantes?
Acquiring Credentials#037.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#038.src: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#038.dst: Rasgado uma vez, quebrado para sempre.
Acquiring Credentials#038.speaker: Commander

Acquiring Credentials#039.src: Oh, let's keep going! Where can we go with that lead?
Acquiring Credentials#039.dst: Ah, vamos continuar! Para onde essa pista nos leva?
Acquiring Credentials#039.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#040.src: Follow the clue: Once torn, forever broken beyond repair.
Acquiring Credentials#040.dst: Siga a pista: Rasgado uma vez, quebrado para sempre.

Acquiring Credentials#041.src: Who's that on top of that platform?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.dst: Quem é aquele no alto da plataforma?!
Acquiring Credentials#041.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#042.src: The two of you have come real far for this, huh?
Acquiring Credentials#042.dst: Vocês dois vieram de bem longe por isso, hein?
Acquiring Credentials#042.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#043.src: Well, I can give you the answer to the stout and beer question! But you won't enter the Market just with that.
Acquiring Credentials#043.dst: Bom, posso dar a resposta da pergunta da preta e da loira! Mas só com isso vocês não entram no Mercado.
Acquiring Credentials#043.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#044.src: You see, to enter the Market you'll need something to sell! And it won't be something you can exactly buy around here, if you get what I mean.
Acquiring Credentials#044.dst: Sabe, para entrar no Mercado vocês vão precisar de algo para vender! E não vai ser algo que dê para comprar por aqui, se é que me entendem.
Acquiring Credentials#044.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#046.src: Exactly! Luckily for you, I'm in a good mood. There's an airship docked close by. We'll be able to take it and I can help you get an item.
Acquiring Credentials#046.dst: Exato! Para sorte de vocês, estou de bom humor. Tem uma aeronave atracada aqui perto. Podemos pegá-la e eu ajudo vocês a conseguir um item.
Acquiring Credentials#046.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#047.src: Uh... What do you think, {u}? I really need that passport, and well...you could get something out of this too, right?
Acquiring Credentials#047.dst: Hã... O que acha, {u}? Preciso muito desse passaporte, e bom... você também pode tirar algo disso, né?
Acquiring Credentials#047.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#048.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, soldier!
Acquiring Credentials#048.dst: Me proteja enquanto pego o ovo, soldado!
Acquiring Credentials#048.speaker: Mechanic

similar.text: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!

Acquiring Credentials#050.src: Great! Follow me, it's not far.
Acquiring Credentials#050.dst: Ótimo! Me sigam, não é longe.
Acquiring Credentials#050.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#052.src: Wait! There are guards protecting the airship. Don't let them see you!
Acquiring Credentials#052.dst: Esperem! Há guardas protegendo a aeronave. Não deixem que vejam vocês!
Acquiring Credentials#052.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#053.src: They're near the edge... Push them off.
Acquiring Credentials#053.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#054.src: Uhh... I'm sure they're fine, I'm sure that fall wasn't too big...
Acquiring Credentials#054.dst: Hã... Com certeza estão bem, a queda nem foi tão alta...
Acquiring Credentials#054.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#055.src: Well, that's your only way inside! There are more guards up ahead. Take care of them without being seen, and we'll be in the clear!
Acquiring Credentials#055.dst: Bom, é o único jeito de entrar! Tem mais guardas adiante. Cuide deles sem ser visto e estaremos livres!
Acquiring Credentials#055.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#056.src: Well done! Let's get on the airship.
Acquiring Credentials#056.dst: Muito bem! Vamos subir na aeronave.
Acquiring Credentials#056.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#057.src: Did you just... Push them all...?
Acquiring Credentials#057.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#058.src: Buckle up! We're heading to the {p}, there we'll be able to collect some dragonling eggs for you to sell at the Black Market!
Acquiring Credentials#058.dst: Apertem os cintos! Vamos para {p}, onde vamos pegar ovos de dragãozinho para vocês venderem no Mercado Negro!
Acquiring Credentials#058.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#059.src: Travel with the Mechanic and Doan to the {p} to get the Dragonling Egg.
Acquiring Credentials#059.dst: Viaje com o Mecânico e Doan para {p} para pegar o ovo de dragãozinho.

Acquiring Credentials#060.src: The island we're heading to is home to a Dragonling nest! They use it to lay their eggs, as it's quite a difficult place to access.
Acquiring Credentials#060.dst: A ilha para onde vamos abriga um ninho de dragõezinhos! Eles botam ovos lá, já que é um lugar bem difícil de alcançar.
Acquiring Credentials#060.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#061.src: And those'll be worth a lot in the Black Market, right...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.dst: E eles vão valer muito no Mercado Negro, né...?
Acquiring Credentials#061.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#062.src: They sure will! Dragonling eggs are rare, and this island can only be accessed by airship... They're worth a fortune back at Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.dst: Com certeza! Ovos de dragãozinho são raros, e só se chega a esta ilha de aeronave... Valem uma fortuna lá em Letvus.
Acquiring Credentials#062.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#063.src: Oh, there it is! I can see the island from here, buckle up. We've got some eggs to steal!
Acquiring Credentials#063.dst: Ah, lá está! Já vejo a ilha daqui, apertem os cintos. Temos ovos para roubar!
Acquiring Credentials#063.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#064.src: What's that?! Oh... It looks like we've got company...
Acquiring Credentials#064.dst: O que é aquilo?! Ah... Parece que temos companhia...
Acquiring Credentials#064.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#065.src: Drat, the skyraiders are here! We can't let them get away with those eggs...
Acquiring Credentials#065.dst: Droga, os Skyraiders vieram! Não podemos deixar que fujam com os ovos...
Acquiring Credentials#065.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#066.src: Well, if that's the case, then there's only one thing to do! Come on, follow me!
Acquiring Credentials#066.dst: Bom, se é assim, só resta uma coisa a fazer! Vamos, me sigam!
Acquiring Credentials#066.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#067.src: We can't get to the nest with so many pirates on the way, kill them!
Acquiring Credentials#067.dst: Não dá para chegar ao ninho com tantos piratas no caminho, matem-nos!
Acquiring Credentials#067.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#068.src: Alright, follow me! Let's go harvest that egg!
Acquiring Credentials#068.dst: Certo, me sigam! Vamos pegar aquele ovo!
Acquiring Credentials#068.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#069.src: Protect me while I harvest the egg, human!
Acquiring Credentials#069.dst: Me proteja enquanto pego o ovo, humano!
Acquiring Credentials#069.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#070.src: We're halfway there, just keep defending me!
Acquiring Credentials#070.dst: Estamos na metade, continue me defendendo!
Acquiring Credentials#070.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#071.src: There we go! Let's get back to the airship, run!
Acquiring Credentials#071.dst: Pronto! Vamos voltar para a aeronave, corram!
Acquiring Credentials#071.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#072.src: Don't let them get away! Fire the cannons!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.dst: Não deixem que escapem! Disparem os canhões!!
Acquiring Credentials#072.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#073.src: Soldier, don't let them hit us! Attack the cannonballs using your weapon before they hit our airship to deflect them!
Acquiring Credentials#073.dst: Soldado, não deixe nos acertarem! Ataque as balas de canhão com sua arma para desviá-las antes que atinjam a aeronave!
Acquiring Credentials#073.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#074.src: We can't take more cannon shots... We're wasting our time, let's get going! We got bigger fish to fry!
Acquiring Credentials#074.dst: Não aguentamos mais tiros... Estamos perdendo tempo, vamos embora! Temos peixes maiores para pescar!
Acquiring Credentials#074.speaker: Skyraider

Acquiring Credentials#075.src: That was close... Well then, let's head back to the airbase!
Acquiring Credentials#075.dst: Essa foi por pouco... Bom, vamos voltar para a base aérea!
Acquiring Credentials#075.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#076.src: Go back to the bar at the Blackbird Inn with Doan.
Acquiring Credentials#076.dst: Volte com Doan ao bar da Blackbird Inn.

Acquiring Credentials#077.src: The two of you have certainly proven yourselves today!
Acquiring Credentials#077.dst: Vocês dois certamente mostraram seu valor hoje!
Acquiring Credentials#077.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#078.src: So, I'll give you the password to enter the Black Market.
Acquiring Credentials#078.dst: Então, vou dar a senha para entrar no Mercado Negro.
Acquiring Credentials#078.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#079.src: Go back to the Barman at the Inn and tell him 'I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.dst: Voltem ao barman da pousada e digam 'Não tenho sede, sempre levo uma garrafa.'
Acquiring Credentials#079.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#080.src: That might just give you the chance you need to get in. Good luck!
Acquiring Credentials#080.dst: Isso pode dar a chance que vocês precisam para entrar. Boa sorte!
Acquiring Credentials#080.speaker: Mechanic

Acquiring Credentials#081.src: Thank you for your help, sir... Let's go back to the bar, then.
Acquiring Credentials#081.dst: Obrigado pela ajuda, senhor... Vamos voltar ao bar, então.
Acquiring Credentials#081.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#082.src: Here we are again. Let's talk to the Barman.
Acquiring Credentials#082.dst: De volta aqui. Vamos falar com o barman.
Acquiring Credentials#082.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#083.src: Um, sir? I'm not thirsty, I always carry a bottle.
Acquiring Credentials#083.dst: Hã, senhor? Não tenho sede, sempre levo uma garrafa.
Acquiring Credentials#083.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#084.src: ...Well, hey there... Would you like to buy some... potions?
Acquiring Credentials#084.dst: ...Ora, olá... Gostaria de comprar umas... poções?

Acquiring Credentials#085.src: Well, hello there! You like you could use some of my fine wares, yes!
Acquiring Credentials#085.dst: Ora, olá! Parece que você precisa das minhas ótimas mercadorias, sim!

Acquiring Credentials#086.src: A dragonling egg? I'd pay {~} emeralds for it.
Acquiring Credentials#086.dst: Ovo de dragãozinho? Eu pagaria {~} esmeraldas.
Acquiring Credentials#086.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#087.src: So that's our initial bid. Now we need to ask for a higher bid, remember? We can't always talk to the same merchant or they'll lose interest...
Acquiring Credentials#087.dst: Essa é a oferta inicial. Agora pedimos uma maior, lembra? Não dá para falar sempre com o mesmo mercador, senão ele perde o interesse...

Acquiring Credentials#088.src: And we can't talk to more than {~} people for a raise or they might get angry.
Acquiring Credentials#088.dst: E não podemos pedir aumento a mais de {~} pessoas, senão podem ficar bravas.

Acquiring Credentials#089.src: Well! We really don't see many dragonling eggs around here, not at all!! I'll give you {~} emeralds for it, how does that sound?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.dst: Ora! Não vemos muitos ovos de dragãozinho por aqui, não mesmo!! Dou {~} esmeraldas por ele, que tal?!
Acquiring Credentials#089.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#090.src: Fine! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds. But if this egg isn't mine now? Don't bother coming back.
Acquiring Credentials#090.dst: Tá bom! Subo para {~} esmeraldas. Mas se este ovo não for meu agora? Nem se dê ao trabalho de voltar.
Acquiring Credentials#090.speaker: Black Market Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#091.src: Remember what the passport seller said? We shouldn't always talk to the same merchant... I think this one won't like another price raise. We should talk to the others.
Acquiring Credentials#091.dst: Lembra o que o vendedor de passaportes disse? Não dá para falar sempre com o mesmo mercador... Acho que este não vai gostar de outro aumento. Vamos falar com os outros.

Acquiring Credentials#092.src: An egg, eh... I'd pay you... {~} emeralds, for it.
Acquiring Credentials#092.dst: Um ovo, é... Eu pagaria... {~} esmeraldas, por ele.

Acquiring Credentials#093.src: Another price hike?! I'm not interested anymore. Scram.
Acquiring Credentials#093.dst: Outro aumento?! Não tenho mais interesse. Some daqui.

Acquiring Credentials#094.src: Is that a dragonling egg I spot? For a rare item such as that, I would of course be willing to pay {~} emeralds for it!
Acquiring Credentials#094.dst: Aquilo é um ovo de dragãozinho? Por um item tão raro, eu certamente pagaria {~} esmeraldas por ele!
Acquiring Credentials#094.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#096.src: He appears to be rummaging through his documents.
Acquiring Credentials#096.dst: Ele parece estar remexendo seus documentos.

Acquiring Credentials#097.src: We have to get to {~} emeralds in {~} bid increases. Let's try again!
Acquiring Credentials#097.dst: Precisamos de {~} esmeraldas em {~} aumentos. Tentemos de novo!

Acquiring Credentials#098.src: You should try to increase the price with another merchant before going back to your previous one.
Acquiring Credentials#098.dst: Tente aumentar o preço com outro mercador antes de voltar ao anterior.

Acquiring Credentials#099.src: Oh, you're bold, I'll give you that! Asking for another price increase?! Fine!! I'll raise my price to {~} emeralds!
Acquiring Credentials#099.dst: Ah, você é ousado, isso eu admito! Pedindo outro aumento?! Tá bom!! Subo minha oferta para {~} esmeraldas!

Acquiring Credentials#100.src: I'll raise that price to... {~} emeralds.

Acquiring Credentials#102.src: ...might not be my business to ask, but what's a human got business at a villager airship customs office for?
Acquiring Credentials#102.dst: ...talvez não seja da minha conta, mas o que um humano faz numa alfândega de aeronaves de aldeões?

Acquiring Credentials#103.src: Talk only to the Black Market member in the end of the hallway and do not talk to anyone else.
Acquiring Credentials#103.dst: Falem só com o membro do Mercado Negro no fim do corredor e com mais ninguém.
Acquiring Credentials#103.speaker: Barman

Acquiring Credentials#105.src: Enter the Black Market and talk to the Member at the end of the hallway.
Acquiring Credentials#105.dst: Entre no Mercado Negro e fale com o membro no fim do corredor.

Acquiring Credentials#106.src: I've heard you've stolen some eggs from the Skyraiders. That's a bold move!
Acquiring Credentials#106.dst: Soube que vocês roubaram uns ovos dos Skyraiders. Que ousadia!
Acquiring Credentials#106.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#108.src: Two passports? I'd say that's around {~} emeralds. You can get that selling this egg on the market.
Acquiring Credentials#108.dst: Dois passaportes? Eu diria umas {~} esmeraldas. Dá para conseguir isso vendendo este ovo no mercado.
Acquiring Credentials#108.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#109.src: Let me fill you in how the market works. You'll get a low starting price for your egg, and then you'll have to go around the merchants asking for a higher bid.
Acquiring Credentials#109.dst: Vou te explicar como o mercado funciona. Seu ovo vai ter um preço inicial baixo, e você vai ter que passar pelos mercadores pedindo uma oferta maior.
Acquiring Credentials#109.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#110.src: Be careful, though, as you can only ask for {~} price increases.
Acquiring Credentials#110.dst: Mas cuidado, você só pode pedir {~} aumentos de preço.
Acquiring Credentials#110.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#111.src: You can try talking to different merchants, and see how much each increases the price of the egg.
Acquiring Credentials#111.dst: Pode falar com mercadores diferentes e ver quanto cada um aumenta o preço do ovo.
Acquiring Credentials#111.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#112.src: Good luck, and do try not to get killed.
Acquiring Credentials#112.dst: Boa sorte, e tente não morrer.
Acquiring Credentials#112.speaker: Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#113.src: Talk to the Merchants and try to get {~} emeralds to buy a passport.
Acquiring Credentials#113.dst: Fale com os mercadores e tente conseguir {~} esmeraldas para comprar um passaporte.

Acquiring Credentials#114.src: That's what we need, {u}. Sold! The egg is yours.
Acquiring Credentials#114.dst: É disso que precisamos, {u}. Vendido! O ovo é seu.
Acquiring Credentials#114.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#115.src: Here, you can have your emeralds.
Acquiring Credentials#115.speaker: Merchant

Acquiring Credentials#117.src: Talk to the Black Market Member again.
Acquiring Credentials#117.dst: Fale de novo com o membro do Mercado Negro.

Acquiring Credentials#118.src: So do you have the emeralds?
Acquiring Credentials#118.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#119.src: Hmm... This will do it. Here, your passports.
Acquiring Credentials#119.dst: Hmm... Isto basta. Tomem, seus passaportes.
Acquiring Credentials#119.speaker: Black Market Member

Acquiring Credentials#120.src: Uhh.. {u}, I think you dropped your passport. Let me get it for yo-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.dst: Hã.. {u}, você deixou cair seu passaporte. Deixa que eu pego pra vo-...
Acquiring Credentials#120.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#121.src: Wait... That's MY passport?! It was in my pocket all along...
Acquiring Credentials#121.dst: Espera... É o MEU passaporte?! Estava no bolso o tempo todo...
Acquiring Credentials#121.speaker: Doan

Acquiring Credentials#122.src: Well, uhhh... I guess you can have some of these emeralds, then...
Acquiring Credentials#122.dst: Bom, hããã... Acho que pode ficar com algumas esmeraldas, então...
Acquiring Credentials#122.speaker: Doan

Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.src: For the safety of the citizens, these doors shall remain shut until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.dst: Pela segurança dos cidadãos, estas portas ficarão fechadas até que o criminoso seja capturado.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#000.speaker: Elf Guard

similar.text: [+{~} Rusted Rake]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.src: This is utterly inane. A full lockdown, over a petty theft... Are we not to help one another? To thieve is unnecessary.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.dst: Isso é um absurdo. Um bloqueio total por um furto à toa... Não devemos ajudar uns aos outros? Roubar é desnecessário.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#002.speaker: Vaenr

Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.src: The plant has been disturbed- Looks like it was knocked over.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#003.dst: A planta foi mexida- Parece que foi derrubada.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.src: It's missing a few leaves- Many of them are scattered around the area.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#004.dst: Faltam algumas folhas- Muitas estão espalhadas pela área.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.src: There seem to be some footprints leading away... It would probably be best to ask about the plant.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#005.dst: Parece haver pegadas se afastando... Provavelmente é melhor perguntar sobre a planta.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.src: I pray to the Light that you are able to help before the situation degrades further.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#006.dst: Rogo à Luz que você consiga ajudar antes que a situação piore.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.src: This book describes a potion of enhanced vision.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#007.dst: Este livro descreve uma poção de visão aprimorada.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#008.src: ...why are so many of the pages ripped out?

Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.src: See me as I truly am- My name is Korben, and I mustn't be delayed further!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.dst: Veja-me como realmente sou- Meu nome é Korben, e não posso me atrasar mais!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#009.speaker: Criminal

Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.src: Maybe there's another way to the window...
Aldorei's Secret Part I#010.dst: Talvez haja outro caminho até a janela...

Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.src: You should probably investigate the collapsed bridge to see where Korben went.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#011.dst: Você devia investigar a ponte desabada para ver aonde Korben foi.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.src: You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall open the doors for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#012.dst: Você pode ir e vir da cidade de {p} quando quiser. Abriremos as portas para você.

similar.text: This being the case... You may come and go as you wish to {p} Town. We shall re-open the doors.

Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.src: Hey! Please come talk to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die"- well it's true, or so I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.dst: Já ouviu o ditado "Elfos nunca morrem"? Pois é verdade, ou assim eu pensava.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#014.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.src: Talk to the Elf Guard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part I#015.dst: Fale com o guarda elfo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.src: Halt, traveler! Entry to {p} Town is forbidden at present.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.dst: Alto, viajante! Entrar na cidade de {p} está proibido agora.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#016.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.src: There is a dangerous criminal on the loose in this valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.dst: Há um criminoso perigoso à solta neste vale.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#017.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.src: These doors shall remain closed until the criminal is captured.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.dst: Estas portas ficarão fechadas até o criminoso ser capturado.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#018.speaker: Elf Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.src: See if anyone in {p} Valley knows what happened
Aldorei's Secret Part I#019.dst: Veja se alguém no vale de {p} sabe o que aconteceu

Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.src: An outsider in our midst? Exciting to see. I have wished to share our magic with new people for a long while.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.dst: Um forasteiro entre nós? Que empolgante. Há muito tempo desejo compartilhar nossa magia com gente nova.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#020.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.src: However, I am...well, rather hungry. And I must tend to my garden here for the time being.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.dst: Porém, estou... bem, com bastante fome. E por enquanto preciso cuidar do meu jardim aqui.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#021.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.src: Have you heard the saying “You scratch my ears, I scratch yours”? People must help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.dst: Conhece o ditado "Uma orelha coça a outra"? As pessoas devem se ajudar.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#022.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.src: If you would be so kind as to bring me a loaf of fresh bread you may take my enchanted bucket.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.dst: Se tiver a bondade de me trazer um pão fresco, pode ficar com meu balde encantado.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#023.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.src: I saw you toil to bake this yourself. Frankly, that is above and beyond what I expected, so here is your exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.dst: Vi você se esforçar para assar isto sozinho. Francamente, foi além do que eu esperava, então aqui está sua troca.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#024.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.src: If you require help in the future with anything, do not be afraid to ask. If you put such effort for me, I shall give you the same.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.dst: Se precisar de ajuda com qualquer coisa no futuro, não hesite em pedir. Se você se empenha assim por mim, farei o mesmo por você.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#025.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.src: Find a use for Damys' Bucket
Aldorei's Secret Part I#026.dst: Encontre um uso para o balde de Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.src: The thieving is not the reason, from what I have heard. It is that the grove was jealously hidden due to the potency of the plants there.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.dst: Pelo que ouvi, o roubo não é o motivo. O bosque era escondido com zelo pela potência das plantas de lá.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#027.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.src: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... The Light only knows what else. It is impossible to reach without unusual means- And that is cause for grave concern.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.dst: Tattytale, Iridesca, Subtraxerim... Só a Luz sabe o que mais. É impossível chegar lá sem meios incomuns- E isso é motivo de grave preocupação.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#028.speaker: Sylvar

Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.src: Find a way to grow the plant by the waterfall
Aldorei's Secret Part I#029.dst: Encontre um jeito de fazer a planta crescer perto da cachoeira

Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.src: Halt! This area is strictly off limits, especially for an outsider. Turn back now!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.dst: Alto! Esta área é estritamente proibida, ainda mais a forasteiros. Volte já!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#031.speaker: Guard

Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.src: Aha, the outsider returns. Is there something troubling you?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.dst: Ahá, o forasteiro voltou. Há algo que te aflige?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#033.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.src: ...mmm. Unfortunate, that. I cannot help with this.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.dst: ...hmm. Que pena. Nisso não posso ajudar.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#034.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.src: It is not a matter of secrecy or morals- I simply do not know what that leaf is from or what it may be capable of.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.dst: Não é questão de sigilo nem de moral- Eu só não sei de onde vem essa folha nem do que ela é capaz.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#035.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.src: I am no botanist- Simply a gardener. The mistake is understandable, if regrettable.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.dst: Não sou botânico- Só jardineiro. Um engano compreensível, ainda que lamentável.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#036.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.src: However, I was taught under a much more storied botanist who may have the answers you seek.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.dst: Mas aprendi com uma botânica bem mais renomada, que talvez tenha as respostas que busca.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#037.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.src: Her name is Fiona- Her home is across the valley from here. Take the bridge across. She often stays inside studying.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.dst: Ela se chama Fiona- Mora do outro lado do vale. Atravesse a ponte. Costuma ficar em casa estudando.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#038.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.src: She has forgotten more than I will ever hope to know about plants. If she cannot help you, I fear none can.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.dst: Ela esqueceu mais sobre plantas do que eu jamais saberei. Se ela não puder ajudar, ninguém poderá.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#039.speaker: Damys

Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.src: Go to the botanist's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part I#040.dst: Vá até a casa da botânica em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.src: This is outrageous! To think one of our own would stoop to such thievery and destruction!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.dst: Que ultraje! Pensar que um dos nossos se rebaixaria a tal roubo e destruição!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#041.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.src: Outsider, this is not the time to be asking me anything. My home has been ransacked!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.dst: Forasteiro, não é hora de me perguntar nada. Minha casa foi saqueada!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#042.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.src: Mm? Damys sent you... You have leaves of Iridesca? Hm... Then perhaps we may be able to help one another.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.dst: Hm? Damys te enviou... Você tem folhas de Iridesca? Hm... Então talvez possamos ajudar um ao outro.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#043.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.src: They tore through my shelves and furniture searching, and scanned the pages as fervently once they found it.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.dst: Revirou estantes e móveis à procura, e folheou as páginas com fervor quando o achou.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#044.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.src: Afterwards, they threw the book into the back garden, and forced a carnivorous plant to grow and consume my notes!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.dst: Depois, jogou o livro no jardim dos fundos e fez uma planta carnívora crescer e devorar minhas anotações!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#045.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.src: I assume when the desired information was found, they went into my garden, threw the book into the carnivorous plant and stormed off towards the lab.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.dst: Imagino que, ao achar o que queria, foi ao meu jardim, jogou o livro na planta carnívora e partiu furioso rumo ao laboratório.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#046.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.src: I have researched the Iridesca bloom, and many other plants, for a long time. All my knowledge is stored in that book!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.dst: Estudo a flor de Iridesca, e muitas outras plantas, há muito tempo. Todo o meu conhecimento está naquele livro!
Aldorei's Secret Part I#047.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.src: Retrieve it for me, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.dst: Recupere-o e dividirei meu saber com você.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#048.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.src: Kill the carnivorous plant and loot the book
Aldorei's Secret Part I#049.dst: Mate a planta carnívora e recupere o livro

Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.src: ...disgusting. I will have to hang the pages to dry later, but first, our exchange.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.dst: ...nojento. Depois penduro as páginas para secar, mas primeiro, nossa troca.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#050.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.src: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, no...where is Iridesca, again...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.dst: Hmm... Herbstzeitlose... Death Whistle, não... cadê a Iridesca...?
Aldorei's Secret Part I#051.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.src: Aha, there it is. The pages were sticking together. Iridesca leaves are potent in various ways and are very versatile in their use.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.dst: Ahá, aqui está. As páginas estavam grudadas. As folhas de Iridesca são potentes de várias formas e muito versáteis no uso.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#052.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.src: They have an incredibly broad range of usage, from soothing joint pain or curing sickness to emetic effect and lethal poison, depending on what it is brewed with.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.dst: Têm usos incrivelmente variados, de aliviar dores nas juntas ou curar doenças a efeito emético e veneno letal, conforme o preparo.
Aldorei's Secret Part I#053.speaker: Fiona

Aldorei's Secret Part I#054.src: Mm? The book thief also possesses Iridesca...? This... This is very troubling. There are few notes aside from mine on how to heal Iridesca poisoning.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#109.dst: Vou esperar aqui em cima. Volte se descobrir alguma informação valiosa.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.dst: Peça informações aos elfos da cidade de {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.dst: Ouvi falar de você e do que aconteceu no vale.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#270.dst: Que absurdo, quem deixou essa rata ruiva entrar!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#270.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.src: Who are you calling a rat!? Pulling the ginger card too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.dst: Rata é a senhora!? E ainda zomba do meu cabelo!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#272.src: Can somebody please get the Sol Embassy Guards for us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#272.dst: Alguém pode chamar os guardas da Embaixada de Sol?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#272.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.src: Wait a second... human, what are you doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.dst: Espere aí... humano, o que faz aqui?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#274.src: Erm- I must've taken a wrong
Aldorei's Secret Part II#274.dst: Hã- Devo ter pegado o caminho errado.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.src: We saw you arrive with this elf, us elders aren't that gullible.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.dst: Vimos você chegar com este elfo, nós anciões não somos ingênuos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.src: ... I really thought you'd have my back out there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.dst: ... Achei mesmo que você ia me dar cobertura.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.src: What are you REALLY doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.dst: O que faz aqui DE VERDADE?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.src: So you admit that your invitation to {p} is being used to threaten us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.dst: Então admite que usa seu convite a {p} para nos ameaçar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.src: I knew letting foreigners into our town would come back to bite us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.dst: Sabia que deixar estrangeiros entrar ia se voltar contra nós.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.dst: Guardas- prendam essas pestes e levem-nas às masmorras!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.src: And you admit you're a part of this elf's posse?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.dst: E admite que é cúmplice deste elfo?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.dst: Guardas- prendam essas pestes e levem-nas às masmorras.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.src: You said you had proof of something, tell me- what have you found?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.dst: Disse que tinha provas de algo, diga- o que encontrou?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#289.dst: O segredo de {p}: vocês são imortais!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#289.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.src: We found the old cemetery under the city and aren't afraid to expose you to the world!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.dst: Achamos o cemitério antigo sob a cidade e não temos medo de expor vocês ao mundo!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.src: My parents both suffered and I only have you to blame for it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.dst: Meus pais sofreram e a culpa é toda de vocês.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#293.src: That's enough! To the dungeons with you now!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#293.dst: Chega! Às masmorras com vocês, já!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#293.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#294.src: This is looking bad, you need to say something!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#294.dst: A coisa está feia, diga alguma coisa!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.src: I'm sure you must realize by now we are the elders for a reason?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.dst: Já deve ter notado que somos os anciões por um motivo, não?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.src: Us elves are ten times more powerful than any human by nature.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.dst: Elfos são, por natureza, dez vezes mais fortes que um humano.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.src: Just because we tend to solve things peacefully doesn't mean we can't use brute force.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.dst: Resolvermos tudo em paz não quer dizer que não saibamos usar a força bruta.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.src: No! {u}, I am not letting this go! I will get justice for my parents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.dst: Não! {u}, não vou deixar isso passar! Farei justiça pelos meus pais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.src: How come one of the pedestal
Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.dst: Por que um dos pedestais está vazio?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.src: Pfft- it's merely a design flaw.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.dst: Pff- é só uma falha de projeto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.src: Don't try to trick us with your mind games.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.dst: Não tente nos enganar com seus jogos mentais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.src: Just let us go, your secret
Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.dst: Deixem a gente ir, não contaremos seu segredo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.src: Escape the town hall with Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.src: You know... I didn't really think that would work, and I was right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.dst: Sabe... eu não achei que aquilo daria certo, e eu tinha razão.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.src: But I think I figured it out...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#311.dst: Um dos elfos falou em {~} anciões.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.src: Exactly! You've got a keen eye for this kinda thing.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.dst: Isso! Você tem bom olho para essas coisas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.src: The question is if she lied, or if something else happened.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.dst: A questão é se ela mentiu ou se aconteceu outra coisa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.src: One of the seats were empty but most importantly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.dst: Um dos assentos estava vazio, mas o mais importante...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.dst: Olhei as estantes atrás deles e vi papéis assinados com outro nome.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.dst: Então a questão é... o que houve com ele?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.src: No- but I noticed something that didn't add up with our previous information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.dst: Não- mas notei algo que não batia com o que sabíamos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.src: One of the seats were empty and one of the elves mentioned six elders, did she not?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.dst: Um dos assentos estava vazio e uma elfa falou em seis anciões, não foi?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.src: I'm guessing the Elders got into a big disagreement and decided to rid of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.dst: Acho que os anciões brigaram feio e decidiram se livrar dele.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.src: So I doubt they have any records of that occurring here...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.dst: Então duvido que haja registros disso aqui...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.src: That seemed to put Birch in a bad mood. You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.dst: Parece que isso irritou o Birch. Tente de novo!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.src: He told us where to find you
Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.dst: Ele nos disse onde te encontrar.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.src: You seem to be getting close! You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.dst: Parece que está chegando perto! Tente de novo!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.src: Our best bet is to find somebody that may have seen what happened here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.dst: O melhor é achar alguém que possa ter visto o que houve aqui.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.src: Y'know I'm pretty good friends with the {p} Scouts.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.dst: Sabe, sou bem amigo dos batedores de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.src: They are really observant of everything that goes on in and around the canyons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.dst: Eles notam tudo o que acontece dentro e em volta dos cânions.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.src: Meet me outside the {p} {p}, speak with me if you'd like to travel there together.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.dst: Me encontre fora de {p} {p}, fale comigo se quiser ir junto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.src: Meet up with Olon outside the {p} in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.dst: Encontre Olon fora de {p}, em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.src: Let's go then! Glad you want to travel with me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.dst: Então vamos! Que bom que quer ir comigo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.src: Here we are! The capital of Gavel, home of a lot of things I'm sure.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.dst: Chegamos! A capital de Gavel, lar de muitas coisas, com certeza.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.src: Alright- so we have to come up with a plan on what to do next, I have a few suggestions myself.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.dst: Certo- precisamos bolar um plano para o próximo passo, eu tenho algumas sugestões.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.src: I've done some work for the {p} staff in the past and happen to know a few of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.dst: Já trabalhei para o pessoal de {p} e por acaso conheço alguns deles.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.src: We are actually quite good friends, what do you think?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.dst: Na verdade, somos bons amigos, o que acha?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.src: Sounds like a good plan to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.src: Head inside and look for someone who doesn't seem busy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.dst: Entre e procure alguém que não pareça ocupado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.src: So you want us to sneak in?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.dst: Quer que a gente se infiltre?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.src: Do you even know where we need to go?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.dst: Você ao menos sabe aonde temos de ir?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.src: Thought so... good thing I'm here then!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.dst: Imaginei... ainda bem que estou aqui!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.dst: Como eu disse, ando ajudando a cuidar dos jardins lá dentro.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.dst: Fiquei sabendo de umas coisas aqui e ali, claro! Minha conclusão é...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.dst: No topo do salão da guilda há uma sala com velhos documentos militares.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.dst: Quase não é mais usada, então subir não será fácil... me encontre sob a ponte.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.dst: Encontre o amigo de Olon dentro de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.dst: Quanto tempo! Estou bem, a família também!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.dst: Que bom! Escuta- estamos com pressa hoje, sabe onde guardam os velhos documentos militares?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.dst: É sobre aquela sua teoria? Aliás- trabalhei lá há pouco tempo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.dst: Tem um elevador subindo a escada aqui do lado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.dst: Volte depois para conversar! Sinto falta dos nossos papos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: Perfeito! Vamos subir nesse elevador já.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.dst: Encontre Olon sob a ponte em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.src: The archive should be at the top of one of the big towers of the {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.dst: O arquivo deve ficar no topo de uma das grandes torres de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.src: I had a brilliant idea of blessing you with some of my magic that you can hopefully use to get in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.dst: Tive a brilhante ideia de te abençoar com um pouco da minha magia, que espero te ajude a entrar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: Quero ir ver meu velho amigo, espero te ver em breve.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.dst: Vê a poça de magia branca aqui do lado?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.dst: É só pular nela quando estiver pronto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.dst: Use a poça de magia em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para começar a ir até o arquivo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: Volte à cidade de {p} pelo mercador malabarista em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou a pé até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.dst: Achou? Ótimo, é bem o que eu pensava.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.dst: Certo- o plano é este. Vou ficar e procurar um mapa do lugar citado, eles quase sempre marcam os relatórios direitinho.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.dst: Me encontre na cidade de {p}, na saída leste. Vamos evitar os anciões por enquanto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.dst: Se quiser voltar à cidade de {p}, ouvi dizer que há um tal mercador "malabarista" em {p} que te leva de graça.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.dst: Você também pode ir a pé, imagino.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#371.dst: Encontre Olon em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] na cidade de {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.dst: Esta estrada leva a {p}, talvez a gente tenha que procurar um pouco.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.dst: O cânion se move sozinho. Certo, vamos lá.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.dst: Não vim impedir vocês. Na verdade, quero ajudar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.dst: Há muita coisa errada nesta cidade, nesta sociedade. Os julgamentos que fizemos...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.dst: Nós elfos não somos perfeitos. Gostamos de dizer isso- e muitos de nós acreditam.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.dst: Sempre quis ser a mudança em {p}, mas é difícil convencer quem está preso a seus costumes tortos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.dst: Por favor, tragam o ancião Birch de volta- por mim. Sigam a estrada da montanha à direita até uma caverna com cogumelos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.dst: Enquanto isso, tenho perguntas para os anciões- boa sorte aos dois.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: Find your way through the canyon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.dst: Vocês têm um minuto para explicar o que fazem aqui e quem são antes que eu derrube as montanhas em cima de vocês.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: Um elfo e um humano- dentro da minha casa!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.dst: Podem dizer a ELES que não saio de casa desde meu banimento. Não disse uma palavra, nem pensei em fazer nada.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: Não estamos com os anciões. Sou de {p}! Viemos pela verdade.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: Eles... me querem... de volta? É por isso que vieram?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.dst: Não temos nada a ver com os anciões! Vim por motivos pessoais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.dst: Isto é algum teste dos anciões.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.dst: Provem! Não acredito que me esqueceriam tão rápido.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.dst: E daí? Isso não prova nada.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.dst: O que... o que ele disse de mim?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.src: He couldn't say much with th
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.dst: Ele não podia falar muito com os outros por perto.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.dst: Claro que disse, ele sempre ficou do meu lado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.dst: Sabem de uma coisa- vou com vocês.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.dst: Mas não vou contar nada. Só vou por causa do Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#409.src: He said he misses you and wa
Aldorei's Secret Part II#409.dst: Ele disse que sente sua falta e quer que você volte.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.dst: Alder nunca diria isso... ainda mais a gente como vocês.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.dst: Embora- eu sinta muita falta dele...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.dst: Que pena- não vejo como isso prova que não estão com os anciões.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.dst: Vão ter que se esforçar mais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.dst: Se os anciões mandaram vocês, já deviam saber a resposta.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: Are you two a bit slow or what? We are not killing anyone!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: São meio lentos ou o quê? Não estamos matando ninguém!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.src: If anything, the {p} elves brought it upon themselves by leaving our city.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.dst: Se algo, os elfos de {p} procuraram isso ao deixar nossa cidade.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.src: Let's just say the town is magical. That's all you need to know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.dst: Digamos que a cidade é mágica. É tudo o que precisam saber.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.src: Really... it seems I can't escape the past.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.dst: Ora... parece que não fujo do passado.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: I don't know what it is... but I want you to tell me more...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: Não sei o que é... mas quero que me contem mais...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: Maybe it's time- time to confront the elders again. We must go.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.dst: Talvez seja hora- hora de enfrentar os anciões de novo. Vamos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.src: Of course things happened- things happen everywhere!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.dst: Claro que aconteceram coisas- acontecem em todo lugar!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.src: Elves are magical, that's why the city is magical.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.dst: Elfos são mágicos, por isso a cidade é mágica.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#431.src: I'm not going to tell you anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#431.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.src: {p} doesn't care about {p} elves, why would they kill them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.dst: {p} não liga para os elfos de {p}, por que os mataria?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.src: We have come very close to u
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.dst: Estamos bem perto de descobrir seu segredo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.src: Well, why are you here then?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.src: If you are so close, what do you need me for?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.dst: Se estão tão perto, para que precisam de mim?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.src: Even though I have been banished, I would never want something like that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.dst: Mesmo banido, eu jamais desejaria algo assim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.src: Go on ahead. This is not something I expected to happen...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.dst: Vão na frente. Eu não esperava que isso acontecesse...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.src: Return to the Elders with Elder Birch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.dst: Volte aos anciões com o ancião Birch em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.src: You've got guts coming back here after everyth-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.dst: Que coragem voltar aqui depois de tud-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.src: Actually- we have someone that you might be interested in meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.dst: Na verdade- trouxemos alguém que talvez queiram rever.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#447.src: What is the meaning of this?!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#447.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.src: It's been so long, I didn't think you would come back.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.dst: Faz tanto tempo, não achei que você voltaria.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.src: Alder- I am sorry but the only reason I have returned is to set things right once and for all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.dst: Alder- sinto muito, mas só voltei para acertar as coisas de uma vez por todas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.src: These two individuals have the right to know what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.dst: Estes dois têm o direito de saber o que está havendo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.src: Are you out of your MIND! We voted on this all those years ago!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.dst: Ficou MALUCO? Votamos isso há tantos anos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.src: If you tell them ANYTHING about the tree I will make sure your eternal life ends right here and now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.dst: Se contar QUALQUER coisa sobre a árvore, garanto que sua vida eterna acaba aqui e agora.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.src: Oak- that is ENOUGH! Can't you see- this human is fighting the war we begun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.dst: Oak- CHEGA! Não vê- este humano luta na guerra que nós começamos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.src: They've earned it- they should know. Salvation of our light, our redemption!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.dst: Eles merecem- devem saber. Salvação da nossa luz, nossa redenção!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.src: I agree with Elder Birch, sir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.src: {u}, Olon- the war you are fighting...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.dst: {u}, Olon- a guerra que vocês travam...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.src: We- we are the ones to blame. Our kind, our people...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.dst: Nós- a culpa é nossa. Nossa raça, nosso povo...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.src: The elves are the reason the world is in calamity. All because of one, senseless, selfish mistake.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.dst: Os elfos são a razão da calamidade do mundo. Tudo por um erro insensato e egoísta.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.src: The worst fate that this world has seen, a fate beyond comprehension.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.dst: O pior destino que este mundo já viu, um destino incompreensível.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.src: Your leading question, about our immortality. The answer is simple- but there is more to it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.dst: Sua grande pergunta, sobre nossa imortalidade. A resposta é simples- mas há mais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.src: We... we revealed the first gate- giving way for the darkness...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.dst: Nós... abrimos o primeiro portão- dando passagem à escuridão...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.src: I'd rather if we show you. Meet me under the Cherry Blossom tree.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.dst: Prefiro mostrar. Me encontrem sob a cerejeira em flor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.src: I- I will join you as well.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.src: Head down to the Cherry Blossom tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.dst: Desça até a cerejeira em flor em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.src: This place- here is where it all began.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.dst: Este lugar- foi aqui que tudo começou.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.src: The center of the Elven society, under the tree that protects our civilization.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.dst: O centro da sociedade élfica, sob a árvore que protege nossa civilização.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.src: And, brings upon us our immortality...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.dst: E que nos concede a imortalidade...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.src: The roots expand deep inside this cavern that we've used for storage over the years.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.dst: As raízes se estendem fundo nesta caverna que usamos de depósito há anos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.src: At least two Elders are required to open the passage. We will open the way for you two now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.dst: São precisos ao menos dois anciões para abrir a passagem. Vamos abri-la para vocês agora.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.speaker: Elder Birch
