Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.src: Be careful, nobody was meant to return there so certain defense mechanisms were put in place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.dst: Cuidado, ninguém devia voltar lá, então instalamos certos mecanismos de defesa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.src: Also, the information you will learn can harm all elves, unfortunately some things must be kept a secret.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.dst: Além disso, o que vão saber pode ferir todos os elfos; infelizmente, certas coisas devem ser secretas.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.src: I've had a very bad feeling that we won't like what we see...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.dst: Tenho um mau pressentimento sobre o que vamos ver...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.src: Well... It's too late to back down now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.dst: Bem... Agora é tarde para recuar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.src: Do you feel the magical energy, it's almost like I can touch it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.dst: Sente a energia mágica? É como se eu pudesse tocá-la.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.src: Is the water filled with logs?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.dst: A água está cheia de troncos?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.src: Have you noticed this... plant in the middle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.src: It seems like this place is so alive, I mean just look at all of this coming from the logs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.dst: Este lugar parece tão vivo, olha só tudo isso saindo dos troncos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.src: If you are here to stop us, we won't hesitate to hurt you!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.dst: Se vieram nos impedir, não hesitaremos em machucá-los!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.src: On the contrary. I... realize, that this is something we can no longer keep quiet about.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.dst: Pelo contrário. Eu... percebi que não podemos mais ficar calados sobre isso.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.src: When you brought back Birch... it brought back memories, and I must admit. It made me realize I had lost myself along the way.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.dst: Quando trouxeram o Birch... as lembranças voltaram, e confesso. Percebi que me perdi pelo caminho.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.src: We were ashamed of our actions- all of us. Scared for our people. If they knew the truth... there would be riots, wars, innocents would die!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.dst: Tínhamos vergonha do que fizemos- todos nós. Medo pelo nosso povo. Se soubessem a verdade... haveria revoltas, guerras, inocentes morreriam!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.src: But because we locked up {p} from the outside, we grew a... god complex, so to speak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.dst: Mas, por isolarmos {p} do exterior, criamos um... complexo de deus, por assim dizer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.src: We lost track of why we locked ourselves in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.src: You will find the answers to your questions once you lay grasp of the wood.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.dst: Vocês terão as respostas assim que tocarem a madeira.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.src: I assume you two already noticed the intense magical energy coming from here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.dst: Imagino que já notaram a intensa energia mágica que vem daqui.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.src: This is the source of our immortality.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.dst: Esta é a fonte da nossa imortalidade.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.src: The remnants of the original Guardian of the Forest.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.dst: Os restos do Guardião da Floresta original.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.src: I have summoned you two for an important meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.dst: Convoquei vocês dois para uma reunião importante.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.src: What did you see this time?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.src: It was unclear... The only thing I'm certain of is that he contacted me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.dst: Estava confuso... Só tenho certeza de que ele falou comigo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.src: I think... I think he wants us to witness him. This is finally our chance to grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.dst: Acho... acho que ele quer que o contemplemos. É enfim nossa chance de alcançar a Luz.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.src: And I know how we do that!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.dst: E eu sei como fazer isso!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.src: You must have realized by now that he is a direct contact to the other side. I think... I think it's time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.dst: Já devem ter notado que ele é um contato direto com o outro lado. Acho... acho que chegou a hora.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#507.src: ... cutting down the Guardian of the Forest!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#507.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.src: Believe me- I hear how ludicrous this all sounds.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.dst: Acreditem- sei como tudo isso soa absurdo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.src: But think, why would I have visions of witnessing him moments after visions of the Guardian?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.dst: Mas pensem, por que eu teria visões de contemplá-lo logo após visões do Guardião?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.src: We would be the first of our kind to witness him before death!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.dst: Seríamos os primeiros da raça a contemplá-lo antes de morrer!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.src: I believe that's what he wants!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.dst: Creio que é isso que ele quer!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.src: Today is the day we meet our God!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.src: We will take down the Guardian of the Forest to open a gateway!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.dst: Derrubaremos o Guardião da Floresta para abrir um portal!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.src: Today we establish history and a new chapter for all elves!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.dst: Hoje fazemos história e um novo capítulo para os elfos!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.src: We do not have the time. Move along, young one.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.dst: Não temos tempo. Siga seu caminho, jovem.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.src: Wait! I don't think... this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.dst: Espere! Não acho que... seja boa ideia.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.src: But... I really don't think you should go ahead and hurt the Gua-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.dst: Mas... não acho mesmo que devam ferir o Guar-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.src: As the Elders of this town we've already decided on this. You are welcome to join us for this moment, young elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.dst: Como anciões desta cidade, já decidimos. Você pode nos acompanhar neste momento, jovem elfa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.src: But if you as much as try to stop us, you will be banished.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.dst: Mas, se ousar tentar nos impedir, será banida.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.src: Talk to the Elders about the vision.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.dst: Fale com os anciões sobre a visão.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.src: This secret can never leave {p}. If it does- people will riot and wars will break out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.dst: Este segredo nunca pode sair de {p}. Se sair- haverá revoltas e guerras.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.src: Elves who had nothing to do with their decision will die.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.dst: Morrerão elfos que nada tiveram a ver com a decisão.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.src: This is far greater than any of us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.dst: Isto é maior que qualquer um de nós.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.src: I understand you may have questions.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.src: Elder Prometheus died of old age, almost everyone from that time is dead. He elected us six to keep the secret safe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.dst: O ancião Prometheus morreu de velhice, como quase todos daquela época. Escolheu nós seis para guardar o segredo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.src: Apparently the immortality hadn't set in just yet- magic takes time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.dst: Parece que a imortalidade ainda não fizera efeito- magia leva tempo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.src: I don't think he really understood the extent of what he had done. We slowly began connecting the dots.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.dst: Acho que ele não entendeu o alcance do que fez. Aos poucos, ligamos os pontos.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.src: Everything seemed to lead back to the portals opening- the war in Wynn and the attack on Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.dst: Tudo levava à abertura dos portais- a guerra em Wynn e o ataque a Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.src: The magical wood from the Guardian of the Forest must radiate magic that grants us our life.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.dst: A madeira mágica do Guardião da Floresta deve irradiar a magia que nos dá a vida.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.src: This is why we locked up {p}, letting people live immortal lives would have dire consequences.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.dst: Por isso isolamos {p}, deixar as pessoas viverem para sempre teria consequências graves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.src: We tried to at least make up for some of the damage we had done...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.dst: Tentamos ao menos compensar parte do estrago que fizemos...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.src: The portal being opened here caused a chain reaction that opened every portal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.dst: Abrir o portal aqui causou uma reação em cadeia que abriu todos os portais.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.src: This is unfortunately what cursed the world and made it possible for the corruption to leak into Wynn and beings of darkness to breach Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.dst: Infelizmente, foi isso que amaldiçoou o mundo e permitiu que a Corrupção vazasse em Wynn e que seres das trevas invadissem Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.src: This used to be an open cave that we decided to hide the rest of the Guardian in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.dst: Era uma caverna aberta, onde decidimos esconder o resto do Guardião.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.src: It seems like the immense magic transformed this place to look like this...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.dst: Parece que a imensa magia transformou este lugar no que vemos...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.src: We can't put innocent lives at risk- don't you agree?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.dst: Não podemos arriscar vidas inocentes- concordam?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.src: We will make our leave, you can jump after us to return to {p} Town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.dst: Vamos nos retirar, pulem atrás de nós para voltar à cidade de {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.src: I didn't even hear you come in. I was too sucked up in this interesting book "Live Life Love Life".
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.dst: Nem ouvi você entrar. Estava vidrado neste livro interessante, "Live Life Love Life".
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.src: I've been reading all day to get myself in a different head space.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.dst: Passei o dia lendo para mudar o foco da cabeça.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#558.src: Ah, who am I kidding- this book SUCKS!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#558.dst: Ah, a quem engano- este livro é PÉSSIMO!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#558.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.src: Come back tomorrow, please. I have about five more books to get through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.dst: Volte amanhã, por favor. Ainda tenho uns cinco livros para ler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.src: I got inspired from my journey through the world of motivational writing yesterday.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.dst: Me inspirei ontem na minha viagem pelo mundo da autoajuda.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.src: The best thing in the world is to help people around you, is that not right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.dst: A melhor coisa do mundo é ajudar quem está à sua volta, não é?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.src: This way I'll keep myself busy while still being of assistance.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.dst: Assim fico ocupado e ainda ajudo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.src: Well, I'm doing better. Thank you for asking.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.dst: Bem, estou melhor. Obrigado por perguntar.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.src: My shame is slowly turning into hatred for those old elders, maybe that's progress.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.dst: Minha vergonha está virando ódio daqueles velhos anciões, talvez seja um avanço.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.src: Please come back tomorrow, I have a gift for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.dst: Volte amanhã, por favor, tenho um presente para você.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.src: I know I couldn't have done anything, I just find it so stupid.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.dst: Sei que não poderia ter feito nada, só acho tudo tão idiota.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.src: Stupid that the so called, "all mighty, selfless elves" did something like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.dst: Idiota que os tais "elfos todo-poderosos e altruístas" fizessem algo assim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.src: You are earlier than I expected.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.dst: Chegou antes do que eu esperava.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.src: I was planning to cook you a nice meal to as a thank you for getting me through these past two days and for helping me earlier.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.dst: Eu ia te preparar uma boa refeição para agradecer por me ajudar a passar por estes dois dias e pela ajuda de antes.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.src: I decided to pick up a couple of new hobbies to get my mind working, cooking being one of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.dst: Decidi arrumar uns hobbies novos para ocupar a mente, e cozinhar é um deles.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.src: You have truly done more than I ever could have imagined. I'm proud to call you my friend.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.dst: Você fez muito mais do que eu jamais imaginei. Tenho orgulho de te chamar de amigo.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.src: I may or may not have forgot a couple of ingredients for my stew!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.dst: Talvez eu tenha esquecido uns ingredientes do meu ensopado!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.src: Can you go around the forest seeing if you can find [{~} Leafy Stalks] and [{~} Mycanoid Spores] please.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.dst: Pode procurar pela floresta [{~} Leafy Stalks] e [{~} Mycanoid Spores], por favor?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.src: I think I'm finally getting over my guilt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.dst: Acho que finalmente estou superando a culpa.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.src: I realized that I never really took time to grieve my parents' death and I guess I was so occupied finding an answer to my big conspiracy that {p} killed them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.dst: Percebi que nunca tirei um tempo para chorar a morte dos meus pais, acho que estava ocupado demais buscando provas da minha grande teoria de que {p} os matou.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.src: Then finding out all that information... It just all came crashing down on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.dst: Aí descobrir tudo aquilo... Tudo desabou em cima de mim.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.src: I'm grateful that you've managed to pull me out of that dark space, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.dst: Sou grato por você ter me tirado daquele lugar sombrio, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#582.dst: Volte amanhã de novo, por favor.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#582.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.src: I stayed up all night working on this new project of mine.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.dst: Passei a noite em claro neste meu novo projeto.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.src: I picked up the wonderful art of painting and decided to make something for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.dst: Peguei gosto pela maravilhosa arte da pintura e decidi fazer algo para você.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.src: I've also gone the entire day feeling good, for once.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.dst: E, pela primeira vez, passei o dia todo me sentindo bem.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.src: I feel like I'm back on track. So it's time for me to start stressing over another conspiracy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.dst: Sinto que voltei aos trilhos. Então é hora de começar a me estressar com outra conspiração.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.src: I'm actually on my way to the {p} library to do some light reading, hoping to stumble upon another mystery.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.dst: Aliás, estou indo à biblioteca de {p} ler algo leve, na esperança de topar com outro mistério.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.src: I hope you are careful on wherever journey leads you. If you ever need me, just drop by.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.dst: Tome cuidado aonde quer que a jornada te leve. Se precisar de mim, é só passar aqui.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the Valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.dst: Ouvi falar de você e do que aconteceu no Vale.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.src: Perfect! {u}, let's take that elevator upstairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.dst: Perfeito! {u}, vamos subir nesse elevador já.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.src: Wait! I don't think.. this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.dst: Espere! Não acho que.. isso seja boa ideia.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.src: You can come back to Mona later.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.dst: Você pode voltar à Mona mais tarde.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.dst: A Mona não gostou da sua atitude.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#597.dst: Os pais do meu amigo morreram.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#598.src: Uhm. Actually I'm busy, I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#598.dst: Hum. Estou ocupada, tenho muito a fazer hoje.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.src: Perhaps Mona didn't like your attitude.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.dst: Talvez Mona não curtiu sua atitude.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.src: Farewell, make sure to let everybody know that I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.dst: Adeus, e conte a todo mundo que sou o mais esperto!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.src: In that case- I assume majority of elves were buried in the lesser ones.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.dst: Então- imagino que a maioria dos elfos foi enterrada nas piores.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#604.src: The documents should be in here somewhere.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#604.dst: Os documentos devem estar por aqui.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#605.src: You flip through various documents before you find something that seems of interest...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#605.dst: Você folheia vários documentos até achar algo que parece interessante...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#606.src: - {~}:{~} {p} Elves returned with freshly picked flowers. Canyon is stable.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#606.dst: - {~}:{~} Elfos de {p} voltaram com flores colhidas. Cânion estável.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.src: - {~}:{~} Small piece of rubble fell near {p} Wall. Nothing to be concerned of.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.dst: - {~}:{~} Pedaço de entulho caiu perto da Muralha de {p}. Nada preocupante.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#608.src: - {~}:{~} Mysterious group of elves spotted heading into the canyon through the eastern exit.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#608.dst: - {~}:{~} Grupo misterioso de elfos visto indo ao cânion pela saída leste.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.src: - {~}:{~} Spotted elves again. Seems like... the six elders?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.dst: - {~}:{~} Elfos vistos de novo. Parecem... os seis anciões?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.src: - {~}:{~} They just entered one cave system we previously deemed as a dangerous area.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.dst: - {~}:{~} Entraram numa rede de cavernas que consideramos área perigosa.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.src: - {~}:{~} Only five elders returned. They left one behind. I will mark the spot with an orange flag for further investigation.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.dst: - {~}:{~} Só cinco anciões voltaram. Deixaram um. Vou marcar o local com uma bandeira laranja para investigar depois.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.src: Olon talked about the eastern exit next to the bank.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.dst: Olon falou da saída leste perto do banco.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.src: Venture into the canyon of the lost and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.dst: Adentre o Canyon of the Lost e ache a entrada do ancião selado em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#614.src: A sound can be heard from the main path...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#614.dst: Ouve-se um som vindo do caminho principal...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.src: You've already interacted with this crystal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.dst: Você já interagiu com este cristal.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.src: Birch did not like that answer. You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.dst: O Birch não gostou da resposta. Tente de novo!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#618.src: You seem to be getting nowhere. You might need to trace back!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#618.dst: Parece que não está avançando. Talvez precise voltar atrás!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#619.src: Alder was the only one who s
Aldorei's Secret Part II#619.dst: Alder foi o único que disse algo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.src: The Elders ignored the young elf's worries and went ahead.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.dst: Os anciões ignoraram o temor da jovem elfa e seguiram.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#622.src: The thought of reaching their god was stronger than any logic.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#622.dst: A ideia de alcançar seu deus falava mais alto que a razão.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.src: It turned out that the visions the elder had weren't encouragement- but a warning.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.dst: As visões do ancião não eram um incentivo- mas um aviso.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.src: The portal revealed itself, but no one could approach its center.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.dst: O portal se revelou, mas ninguém conseguia chegar ao centro.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.src: The elves were successful, but none of them could grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.dst: Os elfos conseguiram, mas nenhum deles alcançou a Luz.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#626.src: Little did they realize, that this was the start of the end. The act that set off everything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#626.dst: Mal sabiam que aquele era o começo do fim. O ato que desencadeou tudo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#627.src: The opening of the Light Portal caused a chain reaction throughout the world.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#627.dst: A abertura do Portal da Luz causou uma reação em cadeia pelo mundo.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#628.src: The Realm of War Portal opened in Wynn.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#628.dst: O Portal do Reino da Guerra abriu em Wynn.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#629.src: The Realm of Darkness Portal was also opened.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#629.dst: O Portal do Reino da Escuridão também se abriu.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#630.src: The portals that had lied dormant for so many years... this was the beginning of a new era.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#630.dst: Os portais adormecidos por tantos anos... era o início de uma nova era.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#631.src: An era of an endless war- all created because of a selfish wish.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#631.dst: Uma era de guerra sem fim- toda nascida de um desejo egoísta.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#632.src: You make your way back to {p}...

Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.src: What do you think about all of this?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.dst: O que acha de tudo isso?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#635.speaker: Olon

All Roads to Peace#000.dst: Fale com o capitão Goruca em [-{~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#001.src: Hm. It's been long enough, we should've heard back from the diplomacy squad by now...
All Roads to Peace#001.dst: Hm. Já faz tempo, o esquadrão diplomático já devia ter dado notícias...
All Roads to Peace#001.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#002.src: Ah, hello there, Wynn soldier. You should stick around! We were just launching a counterattack against the orc citadel.
All Roads to Peace#002.dst: Ah, olá, soldado de Wynn. Fique por aqui! Íamos lançar um contra-ataque à cidadela orc.
All Roads to Peace#002.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#003.src: Since you've helped with curbing the orcs elsewhere, you can join in the festivities- Oh, that's them coming over the hills!
All Roads to Peace#003.dst: Já que ajudou a conter os orcs em outros lugares, pode entrar na festa- Ah, lá vêm eles pelas colinas!
All Roads to Peace#003.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#004.src: I don't know, but they just decimated our golems with it. How are we supposed to deal with that chieftain without our protection?
All Roads to Peace#004.dst: Não sei, mas destruíram nossos golens com aquilo. Como enfrentar o cacique deles sem proteção?
All Roads to Peace#004.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#005.src: Let's just get to the medical tent and go from there. The captain will need to hear about this.
All Roads to Peace#005.dst: Vamos para a tenda médica e vemos daí. O capitão precisa saber disso.
All Roads to Peace#005.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#006.src: ...why do you always have to embarrass me in front of the humans, you idiots...
All Roads to Peace#006.dst: ...por que sempre me fazem passar vergonha diante dos humanos, seus idiotas...
All Roads to Peace#006.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#007.src: Follow the captain to the medical tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#007.dst: Siga o capitão até a tenda médica em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#008.src: You lot are useless, you are! We had you sent off with thirty golems! THIRTY! And you come back with nothing to show? Do you have any idea how much that cost us?!
All Roads to Peace#008.dst: Vocês são uns inúteis, isso sim! Mandamos vocês com trinta golens! TRINTA! E voltam sem nada? Têm ideia de quanto isso nos custou?!
All Roads to Peace#008.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#009.src: ...fine. I suppose you have a point. And that means it's a good thing we have a human here to pick up all your slack.
All Roads to Peace#009.dst: ...tá. Acho que tem razão. Ainda bem que temos um humano aqui para cobrir a moleza de vocês.
All Roads to Peace#009.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#010.src: There have been many attacks here at town, and we've been struggling to fend them off. Thanks to the incompetence of our troops, we haven't been able to-
All Roads to Peace#010.dst: Houve muitos ataques aqui na cidade, e está difícil repeli-los. Graças à incompetência das tropas, não conseguimos-
All Roads to Peace#010.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#011.src: ORC CATAPULT!! ORC CATAPULT!! Listen to the words I am telling you! ORC! CATAPULT!
All Roads to Peace#011.dst: CATAPULTA ORC!! CATAPULTA ORC!! Ouça o que estou dizendo! CATAPULTA! ORC!
All Roads to Peace#011.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#012.src: ...we haven't been able to get the orc chieftain to listen to reason and sign a new ceasefire yet. If this keeps up, we'll be overwhelmed. The brutes only seem to listen to force...
All Roads to Peace#012.dst: ...ainda não fizemos o cacique orc ouvir a razão e assinar um novo cessar-fogo. Assim, seremos esmagados. Esses brutos só parecem ouvir a força...
All Roads to Peace#012.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#013.src: The fortress is off to the northeast, it's visible from town. Don't come back without a ceasefire- Or the chieftain's head, if peace is out of the question!
All Roads to Peace#013.dst: A fortaleza fica a nordeste, dá para ver da cidade. Não volte sem um cessar-fogo- Ou a cabeça do cacique, se a paz for impossível!
All Roads to Peace#013.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#015.src: Hmh! Human! Just like say, Serepe. Villager fail, then send human to kill.
All Roads to Peace#015.dst: Hmh! Humano! Igual dizer, Serepe. Aldeão falhar, mandar humano matar.
All Roads to Peace#015.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#016.src: Idiot big-noses! Human strong, but only one. Need more to break Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#016.dst: Narigudo idiota! Humano forte, mas só um. Precisar mais contra Centerworld!
All Roads to Peace#016.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#018.src: Idiot. Idiot human. Will die in open. Come.
All Roads to Peace#018.dst: Idiota. Humano idiota. Morrer ao relento. Vem.

All Roads to Peace#019.src: RRRGHH! Armor heavy! How human carry much weight, but so weak without?!
All Roads to Peace#019.dst: RRRGHH! Armadura pesada! Como humano carregar tanto, mas tão fraco sem?!

All Roads to Peace#020.src: Need medicine for...urgh. Blood... Where yarrow root...
All Roads to Peace#020.dst: Remédio pra... urgh. Sangue... Onde raiz mil-folhas...

All Roads to Peace#021.src: Name Zuett. Your name, Idiot. But only because taught wrong. So will help idiot. Take medicine.
All Roads to Peace#021.dst: Nome Zuett. Seu nome, Idiota. Mas só porque ensinado errado. Então ajudar idiota. Toma remédio.

All Roads to Peace#022.src: Hmh! Better than silly magic potion. Earth heals best...
All Roads to Peace#022.dst: Hmh! Melhor que poção mágica boba. Terra curar melhor...
All Roads to Peace#022.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#023.src: Hmh. Mhm, mhm. Yes, idiot villagers come by, lots of metal villager too. Say want peace- just want kill. Evil war machines.
All Roads to Peace#023.dst: Hmh. Hum. Sim, aldeão idiota vir, muito aldeão de metal também. Dizer querer paz- só querer matar. Máquinas de guerra más.
All Roads to Peace#023.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#024.src: Human really want peace? Then listen to Zuett. Killing not the way. Orcs strong, but not killers. Villager say, but villager wrong.
All Roads to Peace#024.dst: Humano querer paz mesmo? Então ouvir Zuett. Matar não ser caminho. Orcs fortes, mas não matadores. Aldeão dizer, mas aldeão errado.
All Roads to Peace#024.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#025.src: We... Orcs... Not listen to just force. Orcs see strength, not idiot-killing. Human been idiot-killing. Time to stop.
All Roads to Peace#025.dst: Nós... Orcs... Não ouvir só força. Orcs ver força, não matança idiota. Humano fazer matança idiota. Hora parar.
All Roads to Peace#025.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#026.src: Whole war stupid. War killing us. Not all Orcs meant to fight. Human need learn first.
All Roads to Peace#026.dst: Guerra toda burra. Guerra matar nós. Nem todo orc ser pra luta. Humano aprender antes.
All Roads to Peace#026.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#027.src: Need talk with Arrai-Veretel. But first, need trust. To start trust, listen to Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#027.dst: Falar com Arrai-Veretel. Mas antes, ter confiança. Pra ter confiança, ouvir Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#027.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#028.src: Will give guards peace offer. [Elite Boar Meat]. Go hunt. Look bushes up north.
All Roads to Peace#028.dst: Dar oferta de paz pra guarda. [Elite Boar Meat]. Ir caçar. Olhar mato no norte.
All Roads to Peace#028.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#029.src: If want walk away like coward, do now. If human trust me...meet by fort after get meat.
All Roads to Peace#029.dst: Se querer fugir feito covarde, ir agora. Se confiar... ver no forte com carne.
All Roads to Peace#029.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#030.src: Travel to the hunting grounds at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#030.dst: Vá ao campo de caça em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#031.src: Speak to Zuett with the Elite Boar Meat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#031.dst: Fale com Zuett com a Elite Boar Meat em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#032.src: Hmh. Hunt like child, but succeed anyway. Human should rely less on magic. Human serious, though.
All Roads to Peace#032.dst: Hmh. Caçar feito criança, mas conseguir. Humano devia usar menos magia. Mas humano falar sério.
All Roads to Peace#032.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#033.src: Good. Human really want peace. Help stop stupid war... Even though human and villager start anyway...
All Roads to Peace#033.dst: Bom. Humano querer paz mesmo. Ajudar parar guerra burra... Mesmo humano e aldeão começar...
All Roads to Peace#033.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#034.src: Follow. We go Centerworld. Guards still angry, but can say good for you. Stay quiet- Zuett do talk.
All Roads to Peace#034.dst: Seguir. Ir Centerworld. Guardas ainda bravos, mas poder falar bem de você. Calar- Zuett falar.
All Roads to Peace#034.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#035.src: Zuett! What you do? Thought drag away human to kill for good! Why bringing back now?
All Roads to Peace#035.dst: Zuett! Que fazer? Achar levar humano pra matar de vez! Por que trazer de volta?
All Roads to Peace#035.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#036.src: Zuett bleeding heart. Strong in compassion. Saw hurt, thought help. Stupid, but can respect.
All Roads to Peace#036.dst: Zuett coração mole. Forte em compaixão. Ver ferido, querer ajudar. Burro, mas respeitar.
All Roads to Peace#036.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#037.src: Listen to Zuett! Human want peace. Came for peace, but was taught peace come from idiot-killing by villager.
All Roads to Peace#037.dst: Ouvir Zuett! Humano querer paz. Vir por paz, mas aldeão ensinar paz vir de matança idiota.
All Roads to Peace#037.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#038.src: Grrrh! All human say! What special about this human?
All Roads to Peace#038.dst: Grrrh! Todo humano dizer! Que ter de especial esse?
All Roads to Peace#038.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#039.src: Human listen to Zuett. Hunt spineback boar, bring meat. See? If human not care, human not listen. Not hunt.
All Roads to Peace#039.dst: Humano ouvir Zuett. Caçar javali espinhento, trazer carne. Ver? Se humano não ligar, não ouvir. Não caçar.
All Roads to Peace#039.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#040.src: But strong not mean trust! Strength of body only one thing.
All Roads to Peace#040.dst: Mas forte não ser confiança! Força do corpo só uma coisa.
All Roads to Peace#040.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#041.src: RESSINTER HURT! RESSINTER HURT BAD! NEED HELP!! HELP NOW!!
All Roads to Peace#041.dst: RESSINTER FERIDO! FERIDO FEIO! PRECISAR AJUDA!! JÁ!!

All Roads to Peace#042.src: Onluk! Tell what happen! Ressinter...healer hurt?
All Roads to Peace#042.dst: Onluk! Que houve? Ressinter... curandeiro ferido?
All Roads to Peace#042.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#043.src: KREIMU! Get Kreimu! Mudspring camp! She good healer!
All Roads to Peace#043.dst: KREIMU! Chamar Kreimu! Mudspring! Boa curandeira!
All Roads to Peace#043.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#044.src: Will go! Fast runner! Ressinter no die today! Serepe, deal with human!
All Roads to Peace#044.dst: Eu ir! Correr rápido! Ressinter não morrer hoje! Serepe, ver humano!
All Roads to Peace#044.speaker: Guard Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#045.src: Gwuh?! Zuett! Lying bad! Human idiot no hea-
All Roads to Peace#045.dst: Gwuh?! Zuett! Mentir feio! Idiota não cur-
All Roads to Peace#045.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#046.src: RESSINTER DYING! NO CARE IF LIE! ANY HEALER BETTER THAN NO HEALER!
All Roads to Peace#046.dst: RESSINTER MORRENDO! NÃO LIGAR SE MENTIR! QUALQUER CURANDEIRO SERVIR!
All Roads to Peace#046.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#047.src: HEY! ONLUK IDIOT! NO LET HUMAN IN!
All Roads to Peace#047.dst: EI! ONLUK IDIOTA! NÃO DEIXAR ENTRAR!
All Roads to Peace#047.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#049.src: Follow Onluk to the Medicine Tent through the fortress
All Roads to Peace#049.dst: Siga Onluk pela fortaleza até a Tenda de Remédios

All Roads to Peace#050.src: Cannon backfire! Caught in blast! Cut up all over, bleeding bad! Healer already brought medicine tent!
All Roads to Peace#050.dst: Canhão explodir! Pego na explosão! Cortado todo, sangrar muito! Curandeiro já levado pra tenda!
All Roads to Peace#050.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#051.src: Hhhgh. Bad injury... Human. Heal Ressinter, fast!
All Roads to Peace#051.dst: Hhhgh. Ferida feia... Humano. Curar Ressinter, já!
All Roads to Peace#051.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#052.src: Make balm to keep healer alive! Even if only keep alive for Kreimu to heal, keep Ressinter alive!
All Roads to Peace#052.dst: Fazer bálsamo pra manter curandeiro vivo! Mesmo só até Kreimu curar, manter Ressinter vivo!
All Roads to Peace#052.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#053.src: Mix herbs. Use medicine book. And stay in tent!
All Roads to Peace#053.dst: Misturar ervas. Usar livro. E ficar na tenda!
All Roads to Peace#053.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#054.src: Save the injured orc, or keep it alive until rescue arrives
All Roads to Peace#054.dst: Salve o orc ferido ou mantenha-o vivo até o socorro chegar

All Roads to Peace#055.src: This is the medicine book Zuett talked about...but almost all of the words are in Orcish! There are pictures of each plant, and readable names, but...
All Roads to Peace#055.dst: Este é o livro de remédios de que Zuett falou... mas quase tudo está em orc! Há desenhos de cada planta e nomes legíveis, mas...

All Roads to Peace#058.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#058.dst: Gwuh, sim! Parar de gritar! Eu- Urgh!
All Roads to Peace#058.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#059.src: Here in time. Ressinter still alive...why other balm on cuts?
All Roads to Peace#059.dst: A tempo. Ressinter vivo... por que outro bálsamo nos cortes?
All Roads to Peace#059.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#060.src: Wait, why human here? Ressinter hurt because human?
All Roads to Peace#060.dst: Espera, por que humano aqui? Humano ferir Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#060.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#062.src: Human try heal Ressinter. Thought better healer than Zuett. Try hard to keep Ressinter alive.
All Roads to Peace#062.dst: Humano tentar curar Ressinter. Achar ser melhor que Zuett. Esforçar muito pra manter vivo.
All Roads to Peace#062.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#063.src: ... ... ...Nunexetor. You sensible. Is true? Human try heal Ressinter?
All Roads to Peace#063.dst: ... ... ...Nunexetor. Você sensato. Verdade? Humano tentar curar?
All Roads to Peace#063.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#064.src: Yes. The human made herb balms and tried to heal Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#064.dst: Sim. O humano fez bálsamos e tentou curar Ressinter.
All Roads to Peace#064.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#065.src: So Zuett not lie. Human care about orc?
All Roads to Peace#065.dst: Zuett não mentir. Humano ligar pra orc?
All Roads to Peace#065.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#066.src: See? Human try. Maybe not heal Ressinter full, but try save life of someone call enemy by idiot Villager.
All Roads to Peace#066.dst: Ver? Humano tentar. Talvez não curar tudo, mas tentar salvar vida de quem aldeão idiota chamar inimigo.
All Roads to Peace#066.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#067.src: Human learn Villagers lie. Trying learn about us. War only because Villagers trick! Not because human bad!
All Roads to Peace#067.dst: Humano aprender aldeão mentir. Tentar conhecer nós. Guerra só por truque de aldeão! Não por humano mau!
All Roads to Peace#067.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#068.src: ...hmh! Can respect. Strong in mind if able to learn.
All Roads to Peace#068.dst: ...hmh! Poder respeitar. Mente forte se capaz aprender.
All Roads to Peace#068.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#070.src: Will stay for while in case Ressinter need medicine more.
All Roads to Peace#070.dst: Ficar um pouco caso Ressinter precisar mais remédio.
All Roads to Peace#070.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#071.src: Sorry to put human up to task sudden, but now more orc trust you.
All Roads to Peace#071.dst: Desculpa tarefa de repente, mas agora mais orc confiar em você.
All Roads to Peace#071.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#072.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#072.dst: Orc confiar... talvez falar com Arrai-Veretel agora. Seguir.
All Roads to Peace#072.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#074.src: No! Lomoster okay! Ressinter not okay- Wait. Ressinter sort of okay! Need rest still!
All Roads to Peace#074.dst: Não! Lomoster bem! Ressinter mal- Espera. Ressinter meio bem! Precisar descanso!
All Roads to Peace#074.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#075.src: But Lomoster at cannon when explode!
All Roads to Peace#075.dst: Mas Lomoster no canhão quando explodir!
All Roads to Peace#075.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#076.src: Lomoster wear armor. Armor took hurt, Lomoster okay!
All Roads to Peace#076.dst: Lomoster com armadura. Armadura apanhar, Lomoster bem!
All Roads to Peace#076.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#078.src: Human heal Ressinter. See? Human good healer!
All Roads to Peace#078.dst: Humano curar Ressinter. Ver? Bom curandeiro!
All Roads to Peace#078.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#079.src: I don't believe it. How did-
All Roads to Peace#079.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#080.src: Gwuh, yes! Stop shouting! I- Whuh...
All Roads to Peace#080.dst: Gwuh, sim! Parar de gritar! Eu- Uah...
All Roads to Peace#080.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#082.src: Wait, Ressinter okay? How did- HUMAN?! WHY HUMAN IN CAMP?!
All Roads to Peace#082.dst: Espera, Ressinter bem? Como- HUMANO?! POR QUE HUMANO AQUI?!
All Roads to Peace#082.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#083.src: Human heal Ressinter! Not know how, but human save Ressinter life!
All Roads to Peace#083.dst: Humano curar Ressinter! Não saber como, mas salvar vida dele!
All Roads to Peace#083.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#084.src: Told Bitteliso. Human learning! Save life of orc, even though idiot Villager say kill.
All Roads to Peace#084.dst: Dizer pra Bitteliso. Humano aprender! Salvar orc, mesmo aldeão idiota dizer matar.
All Roads to Peace#084.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#085.src: ...how. How. HOW! How human so good at healing?! Why human help?
All Roads to Peace#085.dst: ...como. Como. COMO! Como tão bom curar?! Por que ajudar?
All Roads to Peace#085.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#086.src: Can trust human. Human try unlearn bad villager teach.
All Roads to Peace#086.dst: Poder confiar. Humano tentar desaprender lição de aldeão.
All Roads to Peace#086.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#087.src: ...fine. Good human, not stupid human. Bitteliso sorry for beating. Here.
All Roads to Peace#087.dst: ...tá. Humano bom, não humano burro. Bitteliso desculpa pela surra. Toma.
All Roads to Peace#087.speaker: Bitteliso

All Roads to Peace#088.src: Shouldn't we get back to what we were doing?
All Roads to Peace#088.dst: Não devíamos voltar ao que fazíamos?
All Roads to Peace#088.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#089.src: ...will stay in case Ressinter need help.
All Roads to Peace#089.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#090.src: Ressinter not old man! No need sitter!
All Roads to Peace#090.dst: Ressinter não velho! Não precisar babá!
All Roads to Peace#090.speaker: Ressinter

All Roads to Peace#091.src: Not know that human actually good at heal! Very good! Healer, not hunter. More orc trust you now.
All Roads to Peace#091.dst: Não saber humano bom em curar! Muito bom! Curandeiro, não caçador. Mais orc confiar em você.
All Roads to Peace#091.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#092.src: Since orc trust...maybe can talk to Arrai-Veretel now. Follow!
All Roads to Peace#092.dst: Orc confiar... talvez falar com Arrai-Veretel agora. Seguir!
All Roads to Peace#092.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#093.src: Follow Zuett through the Orcish Fortress

All Roads to Peace#094.src: No enter! Much camp see human heal, but still no trust human!
All Roads to Peace#094.dst: Não entrar! Muito orc ver humano curar, mas ainda não confiar!
All Roads to Peace#094.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#095.src: Ureietun! Human save Ressinter life! Why no trust?
All Roads to Peace#095.dst: Ureietun! Humano salvar Ressinter! Por que desconfiar?
All Roads to Peace#095.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#096.src: Human being led by you. Human led by villager too! Teach good thing, yes, but what if human just copying?
All Roads to Peace#096.dst: Humano guiado por você. Guiado por aldeão também! Ensinar coisa boa, sim, mas e se humano só copiar?
All Roads to Peace#096.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#097.src: Human can earn trust alone! Zuett, stay in Arrai-room.
All Roads to Peace#097.dst: Humano ganhar confiança só! Zuett, ficar na sala Arrai.
All Roads to Peace#097.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#099.src: RRRRRGH! STUPID ZUETT! WAR HAPPEN FOR REASON! GO AWAY!
All Roads to Peace#099.dst: RRRRRGH! ZUETT BURRO! GUERRA TER MOTIVO! SAI!
All Roads to Peace#099.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#100.src: Can trust human not kill. Human can walk around Centerworld. But human no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#100.dst: Poder confiar humano não matar. Humano andar em Centerworld. Mas não ver Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#100.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#101.src: Ask various orcs if they need any help at the Orcish Fortress at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
All Roads to Peace#101.dst: Pergunte a vários orcs se precisam de ajuda na Fortaleza Orc em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

All Roads to Peace#102.src: Hm! Human, hunter, healer, halfwit soldier. Many things! Human also runner?
All Roads to Peace#102.dst: Hm! Humano caçador, curandeiro, soldado tonto. Muita coisa! Também corredor?
All Roads to Peace#102.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#103.src: Peloros from Holehold. Camp home to messengers and runners. Have thing to deliver to Fruludir in green tower.
All Roads to Peace#103.dst: Peloros de Holehold. Campo de mensageiros e corredores. Ter coisa pra entregar a Fruludir na torre verde.
All Roads to Peace#103.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#105.src: Then human run fast to green tower- deliver in {~} seconds! Or else come back. Not urgent delivery, so delay fine.
All Roads to Peace#105.dst: Então humano correr pra torre verde- entregar em {~} segundos! Senão, voltar. Não urgente, atraso tudo bem.
All Roads to Peace#105.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#106.src: Will know human delivered in time. How? Human will see if run fast!
All Roads to Peace#106.dst: Saber se humano entregar a tempo. Como? Humano ver se correr rápido!
All Roads to Peace#106.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#108.src: RGH! Can understand just fine, just not speak as good! No mock us!
All Roads to Peace#108.dst: RGH! Entender bem, só não falar tão bem! Não zombar!
All Roads to Peace#108.speaker: Peleros

All Roads to Peace#109.src: Hm! Human have Peloros box. Peloros give human run training. Give here.
All Roads to Peace#109.dst: Hm! Humano ter caixa de Peloros. Peloros dar treino de corrida. Me dar.
All Roads to Peace#109.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#110.src: More than Zuett with human? Good sign. Maybe fighting stop soon.
All Roads to Peace#110.dst: Mais que Zuett com humano? Bom sinal. Talvez luta parar logo.
All Roads to Peace#110.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#111.src: Patience, human. Box full of signal flare. Will light one to show Peloros human got here in time.
All Roads to Peace#111.dst: Paciência, humano. Caixa cheia de sinalizador. Acender um pra Peloros ver humano chegar a tempo.
All Roads to Peace#111.speaker: Fruludir

All Roads to Peace#112.src: Saw the firework. Human did well, finishing single morning exercise!
All Roads to Peace#112.dst: Ver fogos. Humano ir bem, terminar exercício de manhã!
All Roads to Peace#112.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#113.src: Orc do much training to stay strong. Orc runners must be fast and not tire to become Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#113.dst: Orc treinar muito pra ficar forte. Corredor orc ser rápido e não cansar pra virar Marathon!
All Roads to Peace#113.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#114.src: Here. Human take. Train harder. Maybe visit Holehold- also place for relax, not just run. Stamina good for all.
All Roads to Peace#114.dst: Toma. Humano pegar. Treinar mais. Talvez ir a Holehold- lugar pra relaxar, não só correr. Fôlego bom pra todos.
All Roads to Peace#114.speaker: Peloros

All Roads to Peace#115.src: Oh. Human who help Ressinter. You are strange. Not like other human at all.
All Roads to Peace#115.dst: Ah. Humano que ajudar Ressinter. Você estranho. Nada como outro humano.
All Roads to Peace#115.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#116.src: This? This food storage. Mostly for meats and roots. Though, large ritual happening soon.
All Roads to Peace#116.dst: Isso? Depósito de comida. Mais pra carne e raiz. Mas grande ritual logo.
All Roads to Peace#116.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#117.src: Festival with Earthpit. Will be coming soon- so stocking up food for that.
All Roads to Peace#117.dst: Festival com Earthpit. Chegar logo- então guardar comida pra isso.
All Roads to Peace#117.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#118.src: ...human look like want help. You...really are strange. I suppose...if you want help with food, could do some fishing.
All Roads to Peace#118.dst: ...humano parecer querer ajudar. Você... é estranho mesmo. Acho... se quiser ajudar com comida, poder pescar.
All Roads to Peace#118.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#119.src: Won't ask human to do everything- just [{~} Carp Meat] enough to help. Though, could bring more if wanted.
All Roads to Peace#119.dst: Não pedir humano fazer tudo- só [{~} Carp Meat] já ajudar. Mas poder trazer mais se querer.
All Roads to Peace#119.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#120.src: If want bring more than {~}, will accept more than {~}.
All Roads to Peace#120.dst: Se querer trazer mais de {~}, aceitar mais de {~}.
All Roads to Peace#120.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#121.src: Mhm, mhm. You are strange human, but not bad human. This enough meat.
All Roads to Peace#121.dst: Hum, hum. Você humano estranho, mas não humano mau. Carne suficiente.
All Roads to Peace#121.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#122.src: Festival will still be long time away, but here. Since human help, you get reward. Only fair.
All Roads to Peace#122.dst: Festival ainda demorar, mas toma. Humano ajudar, ganhar prêmio. Só justo.
All Roads to Peace#122.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#123.src: Oh, you brought more fish than asked. Twice as much as asked!
All Roads to Peace#123.dst: Ah, você trazer mais peixe que pedido. O dobro do pedido!
All Roads to Peace#123.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#124.src: You are good human. Strange, but not bad. Willing to put in extra effort.
All Roads to Peace#124.dst: Você humano bom. Estranho, mas não mau. Disposto a esforço extra.
All Roads to Peace#124.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#125.src: Here- will also share some meat that won't be for festival. Other rewards too.
All Roads to Peace#125.dst: Toma- também dividir carne que não ser pro festival. Outros prêmios também.
All Roads to Peace#125.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#126.src: ...that is...much fish. You heard me when I said five, right?
All Roads to Peace#126.dst: ...isso é... muito peixe. Você ouviu eu dizer cinco, né?
All Roads to Peace#126.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#127.src: Four times as much as fair share. Why human like this?
All Roads to Peace#127.dst: Quatro vezes a parte justa. Por que humano assim?
All Roads to Peace#127.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#128.src: Humans are supposed to be selfish. Listen to villager and kill orc. But you are not like that at all.
All Roads to Peace#128.dst: Humanos deviam ser egoístas. Ouvir aldeão e matar orc. Mas você nada assim.
All Roads to Peace#128.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#129.src: Then here- Will share extra meat. Not for festival, but still good. Other thing too. Thank you very much, human.
All Roads to Peace#129.dst: Então toma- Dividir carne extra. Não pro festival, mas boa. Outra coisa também. Muito obrigado, humano.
All Roads to Peace#129.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#131.src: Said five. You have thirty. I...how and why.
All Roads to Peace#131.dst: Pedi cinco. Tem trinta. Eu... como e por quê.
All Roads to Peace#131.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#132.src: You just did work of six orc. You are...overachieving human. But that is not bad thing!
All Roads to Peace#132.dst: Você fez trabalho de seis orcs. Você é... humano exagerado. Mas não é coisa ruim!
All Roads to Peace#132.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#133.src: Here, then. This meat not for festival, but you deserve hearty meal for all effort!
All Roads to Peace#133.dst: Então toma. Carne não pro festival, mas merecer refeição farta por tanto esforço!
All Roads to Peace#133.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#134.src: That much fish actually meet quota! Thank you so much, strange, kind human!
All Roads to Peace#134.dst: Tanto peixe bater a meta! Muito obrigado, humano estranho e gentil!
All Roads to Peace#134.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#135.src: Human OFFERING help- Hmh! Very good human! Task simple. Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#135.dst: Humano OFERECER ajuda- Hmh! Muito bom! Tarefa fácil. Sudeste do forte, após crista, velho campo de Teiren.
All Roads to Peace#135.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#136.src: Used to live, but left because Freelancer jump down from mountain. Forgot important thing there!
All Roads to Peace#136.dst: Morar lá, mas sair porque Freelancer pular da montanha. Esquecer coisa importante lá!
All Roads to Peace#136.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#137.src: Need stay here, make sure stupid Peloros no run into firepit. Has done before. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#137.dst: Ficar aqui, ver Peloros burro não correr pra fogueira. Já fez antes. Então, você ir pegar!
All Roads to Peace#137.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#138.src: Oi, oi! Y'oughta gimme 'at back right now, li'l lady!
All Roads to Peace#138.dst: Ei, ei! Cê vai me devolvê isso já, mocinha!
All Roads to Peace#138.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#139.src: Absolutely NOT, you craven wind spirit! This belongs to me now!
All Roads to Peace#139.dst: De jeito NENHUM, espírito do vento covarde! Isto agora é meu!
All Roads to Peace#139.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#140.src: Nonsense! This camp was built by those who respected the earth and its bounties. Now that its inhabitants have left, nature is free to reclaim it, as is right!
All Roads to Peace#140.dst: Bobagem! Este acampamento foi erguido por quem respeitava a terra e suas dádivas. Agora que partiram, a natureza pode retomá-lo, como é justo!
All Roads to Peace#140.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#141.src: Aw yeah? Issat it? You're a peach, gal, but I'll clip those petals, you don't give it up right now!
All Roads to Peace#141.dst: Ah, é? É isso? Cê é um doce, gata, mas vou podar essas pétalas se não soltar isso já!
All Roads to Peace#141.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#142.src: What a brutish lout you are, threatening an embodiment of nature! I won't give this up without a fight!
All Roads to Peace#142.dst: Que brutamontes grosseiro, ameaçar uma encarnação da natureza! Não vou entregar isto sem luta!
All Roads to Peace#142.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#143.src: ...hm? And who might you be? What brings a human to this disused place?
All Roads to Peace#143.dst: ...hm? E quem é você? O que traz um humano a este lugar abandonado?
All Roads to Peace#143.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#144.src: Oh no, you want this too?! I have claimed it for my own! Leave me be, go! Get out of here!
All Roads to Peace#144.dst: Ah, não, você também quer isto?! Eu o reivindiquei! Deixe-me em paz, vá! Fora daqui!
All Roads to Peace#144.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#145.src: Shouldn'ta crossed me, doll! Remember who spreads your pollen next time, huh?! Now to just take this back up the mountain...
All Roads to Peace#145.dst: Num devia ter me enfrentado, boneca! Da próxima, lembra quem espalha teu pólen, hein?! Agora é só levar isto pra montanha...
All Roads to Peace#145.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#146.src: OI! Who's THIS joker now? You lookin' ta empty your wallet for me or something?
All Roads to Peace#146.dst: EI! Quem é ESSE palhaço? Tá querendo esvaziar a carteira pra mim, é?
All Roads to Peace#146.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#147.src: What, you want this thing too?! It's mine, y'hear? MINE! You can't have it!
All Roads to Peace#147.dst: Quê, cê também quer isso?! É meu, ouviu? MEU! Não vai levar!
All Roads to Peace#147.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#148.src: Human! Was right to send out. Peloros fall over chair and almost burn! Did find thing? Very distinctive, only thing left at camp.
All Roads to Peace#148.dst: Humano! Certo mandar. Peloros cair da cadeira e quase queimar! Achar coisa? Bem diferente, única coisa no acampamento.
All Roads to Peace#148.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#149.src: Hmhm!! Yes! This what looking for! Very good human! Human deserve reward for be good human!
All Roads to Peace#149.dst: Hmhm!! Sim! Isso que procurar! Humano muito bom! Humano merecer prêmio por ser bom!
All Roads to Peace#149.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#150.src: Oh? Human not know what thing is? Want know?
All Roads to Peace#150.dst: Ah? Humano não saber o que ser? Querer saber?
All Roads to Peace#150.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#151.src: Silly! If human not know what thing is, no tell! Can learn for self.
All Roads to Peace#151.dst: Bobo! Se humano não saber o que ser, não contar! Aprender sozinho.
All Roads to Peace#151.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#153.dst: Grrh... Jixy burro. Língua humana burra!
All Roads to Peace#153.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#154.src: Hrrh! Human! You language dumb! Name smart, flow like water in Orc language, look like dungpile on paper in human language!
All Roads to Peace#154.dst: Hrrh! Humano! Sua língua burra! Nome esperto, fluir feito água em orc, parecer monte de esterco no papel em língua humana!
All Roads to Peace#154.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#155.src: Say name! Look at spell, say name! Try!! TRY!!!
All Roads to Peace#155.dst: Diz nome! Olha letra, diz nome! Tenta!! TENTA!!!
All Roads to Peace#155.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#156.src: GRRRH! Confusing name! Not confusing in orcish! Human say all wrong!
All Roads to Peace#156.dst: GRRRH! Nome confuso! Não confuso em orc! Humano dizer tudo errado!
All Roads to Peace#156.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#157.src: Hmh. That right, human. Willing to try at least. See how bad name look?
All Roads to Peace#157.dst: Hmh. Isso, humano. Ao menos tentar. Ver como nome fica feio?
All Roads to Peace#157.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#158.src: Said "shoon-bur." Not even LOOK like that in human letter!
All Roads to Peace#158.dst: Dizer "chun-bur". Nem PARECER isso em letra humana!
All Roads to Peace#158.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#159.src: Here. Needed show anger at stupid language, not show anger at human.
All Roads to Peace#159.dst: Toma. Precisar mostrar raiva da língua burra, não raiva de humano.
All Roads to Peace#159.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#160.src: Stupid stupid STUPID! Not at all say like spell! See stupid language now?!
All Roads to Peace#160.dst: Burra burra BURRA! Nada igual escrever! Ver língua burra agora?!
All Roads to Peace#160.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#161.src: GAAAH!! No, no, no, no!!! Why need learn human language?!
All Roads to Peace#161.dst: GAAAH!! Não, não, não!!! Por que aprender língua humana?!
All Roads to Peace#161.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#162.src: NAME NOT JOE! WHAT KIND NAME JOE?! JOE STUPID NAME!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#162.dst: NOME NÃO JOE! QUE NOME SER JOE?! JOE NOME BURRO!!! AAAAHH!!
All Roads to Peace#162.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#167.src: Rock stuck. Trying to lift- for train strength! No one able to lift rock.
All Roads to Peace#167.dst: Pedra presa. Tentar erguer- treinar força! Ninguém erguer pedra.
All Roads to Peace#167.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#168.src: Yunelsu try throw rock into river! Have thrown other rock, not this one.
All Roads to Peace#168.dst: Yunelsu tentar jogar pedra no rio! Jogar outras, não essa.
All Roads to Peace#168.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#169.src: Hmm...human magic strong, but rock still not moving.
All Roads to Peace#169.dst: Hmm...magia humana forte, mas pedra não mexer.
All Roads to Peace#169.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#170.src: Work together! Cast magic at rock, I try lift again! Ready!
All Roads to Peace#170.dst: Juntos! Lançar magia na pedra, eu tentar erguer! Pronto!
All Roads to Peace#170.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#172.src: Hrrgh... Hrrf. Must be...old earth rock.
All Roads to Peace#172.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#173.src: Been here very long time. Stuck here, rock where earth wants rock to be.
All Roads to Peace#173.dst: Aqui faz muito tempo. Presa, pedra onde terra querer pedra.
All Roads to Peace#173.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#174.src: Yunelsu find other rock then. Sometimes rock break, though.
All Roads to Peace#174.dst: Yunelsu achar outra pedra então. Mas às vezes pedra quebrar.
All Roads to Peace#174.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#175.src: See? Many broken rock. Hear can be good for armor though. You take.
All Roads to Peace#175.dst: Ver? Muita pedra quebrada. Ouvir ser boa pra armadura. Você pegar.
All Roads to Peace#175.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#176.src: Oh! You! Saw Zuett dragging you to camp. And saw other thing.
All Roads to Peace#176.dst: Ah! Você! Ver Zuett arrastar você pro campo. E ver outra coisa.
All Roads to Peace#176.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#177.src: And you helped Ressinter! Will apologize later. Was my fault. Human seen Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#177.dst: E você ajudar Ressinter! Desculpar depois. Culpa minha. Humano ver Freelancers?
All Roads to Peace#177.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#178.src: Freelancers think everything belong to them. Loiter around fortress a lot, try to jump in sometimes.
All Roads to Peace#178.dst: Freelancers achar tudo deles. Rondar muito fortaleza, às vezes tentar pular dentro.
All Roads to Peace#178.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#179.src: Was trying to shoot flying one down, but cannon broke, and cannonball explode.
All Roads to Peace#179.dst: Tentar derrubar um voando, mas canhão quebrar e bala explodir.
All Roads to Peace#179.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#180.src: Now Ressinter okay, but still need repair cannon. Human feel like helping, will need [{~} Iron Ingots] to repair.
All Roads to Peace#180.dst: Ressinter bem, mas canhão precisar conserto. Se humano querer ajudar, trazer [{~} Iron Ingots].
All Roads to Peace#180.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#181.src: Long walk, but there iron in valley east of villager quarry. There also other villager there, with weapons. Not sure why.
All Roads to Peace#181.dst: Longe, mas ter ferro no vale a leste da pedreira aldeã. Lá também outro aldeão, com arma. Não saber por quê.
All Roads to Peace#181.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#182.src: Human being weirdly helpful. That good though! Make Lomoster job of shooting enemy easier.
All Roads to Peace#182.dst: Humano ajudar de jeito estranho. Mas bom! Facilitar trabalho de Lomoster atirar inimigo.
All Roads to Peace#182.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#183.src: Here. Freelancer like steal metal and other thing too, have found a lot from shooting. Human can have.
All Roads to Peace#183.dst: Toma. Freelancer gostar roubar metal e outra coisa, achar muito ao atirar. Humano ficar.
All Roads to Peace#183.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#184.src: Not good for repair cannon, but probably good for make other thing.
All Roads to Peace#184.dst: Não servir pra canhão, mas talvez servir pra fazer outra coisa.
All Roads to Peace#184.speaker: Lomoster

All Roads to Peace#185.src: Her name, my name, sound same. Don't sound same in Orcish! But in YOUR language, sound same!
All Roads to Peace#185.dst: Nome dela, nome meu, soar igual. Em orc não soar igual! Mas em SUA língua, igual!
All Roads to Peace#185.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#186.src: Grrmbl... Dumb Kreimu... Human have stalks?
All Roads to Peace#186.dst: Grrmbl... Kreimu burra... Humano ter talos?
All Roads to Peace#186.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#187.src: Good. Can take these, then- Alraune girl have sometimes. Tasty, but not good medicine.
All Roads to Peace#187.dst: Bom. Poder pegar então- menina Alraune ter às vezes. Gostoso, mas não remédio bom.
All Roads to Peace#187.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#188.src: Durbeo might like, actually. Durbeo orc in food storage tower behind me. Maybe he want help too?
All Roads to Peace#188.dst: Durbeo talvez gostar. Durbeo orc na torre de comida atrás de mim. Talvez querer ajuda também?
All Roads to Peace#188.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#189.src: Oh, that human who healed Ressinter. Yes, I've heard of you already. News travels fast here.
All Roads to Peace#189.dst: Ah, o humano que curou Ressinter. Sim, já ouvi falar de você. Notícia corre rápido aqui.
All Roads to Peace#189.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#190.src: You have a weird face. Uh, a weird look on your face, I mean. What, not used to a more eloquent orc?
All Roads to Peace#190.dst: Você está com uma cara estranha. Digo, expressão estranha. Quê, não acostumado a um orc eloquente?
All Roads to Peace#190.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#191.src: I'm studying languages, is why. I haven't got everything known yet, so if you feel like helping, I could use it.
All Roads to Peace#191.dst: Estudo línguas, por isso. Ainda não sei tudo, então se quiser ajudar, seria bom.
All Roads to Peace#191.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#192.src: I used to have a very smart hobbit friend who lived nearby. They've left, but I want you to check their hobbit hole to see if they left behind any language books.
All Roads to Peace#192.dst: Eu tinha um amigo hobbit muito esperto que morava perto. Ele se foi, mas quero que olhe a toca dele para ver se deixou livros de línguas.
All Roads to Peace#192.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#193.src: It should be close to the blue tower on the hill. That should be easy, right?
All Roads to Peace#193.dst: Deve ficar perto da torre azul na colina. Isso deve ser fácil, né?
All Roads to Peace#193.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#194.src: Oh, good, they did leave a book behind. This even completes the collection I have. I have the first, second, fourth, fifth, and sixth volumes of this.
All Roads to Peace#194.dst: Ah, bom, ele deixou mesmo um livro. Isto completa minha coleção. Tenho o primeiro, segundo, quarto, quinto e sexto volumes.
All Roads to Peace#194.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#195.src: Hopefully I can learn something new here. I still don't understand what all these weird "figures of speech" are supposed to mean...
All Roads to Peace#195.dst: Espero aprender algo novo aqui. Ainda não entendo o que essas "expressões idiomáticas" estranhas querem dizer...
All Roads to Peace#195.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#196.src: What does busting your hump mean? Or two shakes of a lamb tail? Well, anyway. You probably know, so me trying to guess is boring.
All Roads to Peace#196.dst: O que é "dar o sangue"? Ou "num piscar de olhos"? Bem, enfim. Você deve saber, então eu adivinhar é chato.
All Roads to Peace#196.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#197.src: Here, then. That friend of mine wrote everything he came across down in some diaries, and he gave me them to keep, but I can't read them.
All Roads to Peace#197.dst: Tome, então. Esse meu amigo anotava tudo o que via em uns diários, e me deu para guardar, mas não consigo lê-los.
All Roads to Peace#197.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#198.src: The pages are too flimsy- I'll rip them if I turn them. It's a good thing the book you gave me is bound with strong leather, but I still need to be careful not to ruin it...
All Roads to Peace#198.dst: As páginas são frágeis demais- rasgo se virar. Ainda bem que o livro que me deu tem capa de couro forte, mas ainda preciso cuidar para não estragá-lo...
All Roads to Peace#198.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#199.src: Well, maybe if you read what these have written in them you can learn some things yourself.
All Roads to Peace#199.dst: Bem, talvez, se você ler o que está escrito neles, aprenda algumas coisas também.
All Roads to Peace#199.speaker: Jixy

All Roads to Peace#200.src: Huh. You again. That weird human who helped Ressinter. Something wrong?
All Roads to Peace#200.dst: Hã. Você de novo. O humano estranho que ajudou Ressinter. Algo errado?
All Roads to Peace#200.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#201.src: Hm. Looking to help out still? What is it with you looking to be helpful? Have to say I'm not used to this. But, I can think of something.
All Roads to Peace#201.dst: Hm. Ainda quer ajudar? Qual é a sua com isso de querer ajudar? Não estou acostumado. Mas posso pensar em algo.
All Roads to Peace#201.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#202.src: HEY! Any of you feel like playing a game?
All Roads to Peace#202.dst: EI! Alguém aí quer brincar de algo?
All Roads to Peace#202.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#203.src: Ugh, yeah! We're so BORED in here!
All Roads to Peace#203.dst: Ah, sim! Estamos tão ENTEDIADOS aqui!

All Roads to Peace#204.src: Well, sure, but...even if you say this one isn't so scary, I know I don't wanna tell them my real name!
All Roads to Peace#204.dst: Bom, tá, mas... mesmo que você diga que esse não assusta tanto, não quero contar meu nome de verdade!

All Roads to Peace#205.src: Didn't we just eat a bunch of fruit though? We can use those as fake names!
All Roads to Peace#205.dst: A gente não comeu um monte de fruta? Dá pra usar como nomes falsos!

All Roads to Peace#206.src: Okay then. Well, call me Mango then, weird human!
All Roads to Peace#206.dst: Tá bom. Então me chame de Mango, humano estranho!
All Roads to Peace#206.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#207.src: I just ate a bunch of blueberries, so I guess I'm Blueberry for now?
All Roads to Peace#207.dst: Comi um monte de mirtilo, então acho que sou Blueberry agora?
All Roads to Peace#207.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#208.src: Hey, I wouldn't mind being called Grapes by anyone, really!
All Roads to Peace#208.dst: Ei, eu não ligo de me chamarem de Grapes!
All Roads to Peace#208.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#209.src: Then I'm Peaches! So we're just doing a little hide and seek game?
All Roads to Peace#209.dst: Então sou Peaches! Vamos só brincar de esconde-esconde?
All Roads to Peace#209.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#210.src: Yes. Just hide around the fort someplace. If the human doesn't find you, you win.
All Roads to Peace#210.dst: Sim. Escondam-se em algum canto do forte. Se o humano não achar, vocês ganham.
All Roads to Peace#210.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#211.src: Well, that's kinda boring, so I'm gonna go find a really tough to reach spot!
All Roads to Peace#211.dst: Bom, isso é meio chato, então vou achar um lugar bem difícil de alcançar!
All Roads to Peace#211.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#213.src: Well, there you go. I'll tell you how many you have left to find if you talk with me.
All Roads to Peace#213.dst: Bem, aí está. Se falar comigo, digo quantos faltam encontrar.
All Roads to Peace#213.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#214.src: ...wow. You're good. I thought you might be able to see me up here, but I didn't think you'd be able to reach me!
All Roads to Peace#214.dst: ...uau. Você é bom. Achei que me veria aqui em cima, mas não que conseguiria me alcançar!
All Roads to Peace#214.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#215.src: I don't really care about the fact you're human. As long as I get my entertainment I'm happy. Which kinda isn't so great, cause there isn't a lot here to tinker with.
All Roads to Peace#215.dst: Não ligo muito de você ser humano. Desde que eu me divirta, estou feliz. O que não é grande coisa, pois aqui tem pouco com que mexer.
All Roads to Peace#215.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#216.src: Tinkernook is so much better about having machines and metals and things to experiment and build than here is.
All Roads to Peace#216.dst: Tinkernook é muito melhor em máquinas, metais e coisas para experimentar e construir do que aqui.
All Roads to Peace#216.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#217.src: Anyways, you win, I lose, so I better get back to stick-in-the-mud Nunexetor. See ya!
All Roads to Peace#217.dst: Enfim, você ganha, eu perco, então é melhor voltar pro chato do Nunexetor. Tchau!
All Roads to Peace#217.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#218.src: NYACK! For such a big human you really know how to sneak up on someone!!
All Roads to Peace#218.dst: NYACK! Pra um humano tão grande, você sabe mesmo chegar de fininho!!
All Roads to Peace#218.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#219.src: Gah, I thought I was a goner for a second there... If Nunny says you're okay then I'll trust him, but that doesn't make you less intimidating!
All Roads to Peace#219.dst: Ai, achei que estava perdido por um segundo... Se o Nunny diz que você é legal, confio nele, mas isso não te deixa menos assustador!
All Roads to Peace#219.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#220.src: And, I guess out in the open like this, the other orcs wouldn't let you bully us, so...
All Roads to Peace#220.dst: E acho que, aqui à vista, os outros orcs não deixariam você nos maltratar, então...
All Roads to Peace#220.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#221.src: Suppose you're alright, maybe. But even still, you found me, so I lose. Unless you can't find everyone else!
All Roads to Peace#221.dst: Acho que você é legal, talvez. Mesmo assim, me achou, então perdi. A menos que não ache os outros!
All Roads to Peace#221.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#222.src: I bet you'll NEVER find Mango, hahaah! She always takes these games SUPER seriously!
All Roads to Peace#222.dst: Aposto que NUNCA vai achar a Mango, hahaah! Ela leva esses jogos SUPER a sério!
All Roads to Peace#222.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#223.src: Aw darn it. I guess it's pretty easy to see me up here.
All Roads to Peace#223.dst: Ah, droga. Acho que é bem fácil me ver aqui em cima.
All Roads to Peace#223.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#224.src: I mean, I knew that, but I thought you wouldn't think to climb the tower!
All Roads to Peace#224.dst: Bom, eu sabia, mas achei que não pensaria em subir na torre!
All Roads to Peace#224.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#225.src: Well, anyway...you really went and tried to heal Ressinter? That's pretty admirable!
All Roads to Peace#225.dst: Enfim... você tentou mesmo curar Ressinter? Isso é bem admirável!
All Roads to Peace#225.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#226.src: Aaaand then a human went and killed her, because I guess they got told to do so! At least you seem halfway decent.
All Roads to Peace#226.dst: Eeee aí um humano foi lá e matou ela, acho que porque mandaram! Pelo menos você parece meio decente.
All Roads to Peace#226.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#227.src: Anyway, back to the quiet ol' grouch with me!
All Roads to Peace#227.dst: Enfim, de volta ao velho rabugento calado!
All Roads to Peace#227.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#228.src: Ack! Thought you wouldn't notice me behind the stairs!
All Roads to Peace#228.dst: Ai! Achei que não me veria atrás da escada!
All Roads to Peace#228.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#229.src: Ugh, you...you human types are scary up close. Is Nunexetor really sure you're not a bad guy?
All Roads to Peace#229.dst: Ai, vocês... humanos assustam de perto. O Nunexetor tem certeza de que você não é do mal?
All Roads to Peace#229.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#230.src: I mean, look at your armor! You, you look like you could splat me against the wall in a snap!
