All Roads to Peace#230.dst: Quer dizer, olha essa armadura! Parece que você me esmagaria na parede num estalo!
All Roads to Peace#230.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#231.src: ...I feel like I just gave you an idea and I'm not sticking around to find out! You win!
All Roads to Peace#231.dst: ...acho que acabei de te dar uma ideia e não vou ficar pra ver! Você ganhou!
All Roads to Peace#231.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#232.src: Looks like the human wins. Guess I know how you managed to find that spineback boar.
All Roads to Peace#232.dst: Parece que o humano ganhou. Já sei como conseguiu achar aquele javali espinhento.
All Roads to Peace#232.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#233.src: There's no way you REALLY hunted one of those things. Those even give the orc hunters trouble!
All Roads to Peace#233.dst: Não tem como você ter caçado MESMO um daqueles. Até os caçadores orcs sofrem!
All Roads to Peace#233.speaker: Blueberry

All Roads to Peace#234.src: Are you kidding me? Humans are terrifying, Blueberry! They've hunted way stronger stuff than some stupid pig!
All Roads to Peace#234.dst: Tá brincando? Humanos são aterrorizantes, Blueberry! Já caçaram coisa bem mais forte que um porco bobo!
All Roads to Peace#234.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#235.src: But, the game was fun, right?
All Roads to Peace#235.dst: Mas a brincadeira foi legal, né?
All Roads to Peace#235.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#236.src: That's all I wanted from you. Can go back to whatever it was you were doing now.
All Roads to Peace#236.dst: Era só isso que eu queria. Podem voltar ao que estavam fazendo.
All Roads to Peace#236.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#237.src: Yes, finally! I don't have to spend time wondering if the human's gonna try and poke my eyes out!
All Roads to Peace#237.dst: Sim, enfim! Não preciso mais pensar se o humano vai tentar arrancar meus olhos!
All Roads to Peace#237.speaker: Peaches

All Roads to Peace#238.src: Oh, quit being such a scaredy-baby. This one's nice!
All Roads to Peace#238.dst: Ah, deixa de ser medroso. Esse aí é legal!
All Roads to Peace#238.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#239.src: Good game, I guess! Back to being bored again.
All Roads to Peace#239.dst: Boa partida, acho! De volta ao tédio.
All Roads to Peace#239.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#242.src: What? You aren't even wearing those kinds of shoes.
All Roads to Peace#242.dst: Quê? Você nem está usando esse tipo de sapato.
All Roads to Peace#242.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#243.src: Anyways, to the winner goes the spoils. Here, for entertaining them for a bit.
All Roads to Peace#243.dst: Enfim, ao vencedor, os despojos. Tome, por distraí-los um pouco.
All Roads to Peace#243.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#244.src: They have me watch the goblins but I'm no good at having fun with them, so thanks I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#244.dst: Me fazem vigiar os goblins, mas não sei diverti-los, então obrigado, acho.
All Roads to Peace#244.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#245.src: Ah, the weird human. Why you looking to be helpful?
All Roads to Peace#245.dst: Ah, humano estranho. Por que querer ajudar?
All Roads to Peace#245.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#246.src: The cave outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it. Go in, and there will be blue flowers.
All Roads to Peace#246.dst: Caverna fora da ponte aldeã, com lago e arco do lado. Entrar, e ter flores azuis.
All Roads to Peace#246.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#247.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Don't know why you helping, but won't turn down help either.
All Roads to Peace#247.dst: Trazer [{~} Terramarine Buds] pra fazer mais tinta. Não saber por que ajudar, mas não recusar ajuda.
All Roads to Peace#247.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#248.src: The weird human again? You all covered in blue powder. You found the flowers then!
All Roads to Peace#248.dst: Humano estranho de novo? Você todo coberto de pó azul. Achar flores então!
All Roads to Peace#248.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#249.src: Here. Will get that for you. The buds are enough for what need, but you can keep the dust.
All Roads to Peace#249.dst: Toma. Eu ficar com isso. Botões bastar pro que precisar, mas você ficar com pó.
All Roads to Peace#249.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#250.src: Little more, too. But, again- why you looking to be helpful? Don't understand. Humans kill orcs a lot.
All Roads to Peace#250.dst: Um pouco mais, também. Mas, de novo- por que querer ajudar? Não entender. Humanos matar muito orc.
All Roads to Peace#250.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#251.src: You that weird human helping instead killing, right? Nunexetor and little goblins talking about you.
All Roads to Peace#251.dst: Você humano estranho que ajudar em vez de matar, né? Nunexetor e goblins falar de você.
All Roads to Peace#251.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#252.src: Trying to make weapons and tools better. Training, but running out of grindstones. Etemitoro- that is me, my name... That how say it?
All Roads to Peace#252.dst: Tentar melhorar arma e ferramenta. Treinar, mas acabar pedra de afiar. Etemitoro- esse eu, meu nome... Assim dizer?
All Roads to Peace#252.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#253.src: Weird human language. Anyway, know where good grindstone is- top of mountain east of fortress.
All Roads to Peace#253.dst: Língua humana estranha. Enfim, saber de boa pedra de afiar- topo do monte a leste do forte.
All Roads to Peace#253.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#254.src: There shortcut running through top by Ledant cave. Maybe dangerous, but not too much. Follow dead bushes on road and can get to top quickly.
All Roads to Peace#254.dst: Ter atalho pelo topo junto da caverna Ledant. Talvez perigoso, mas não muito. Seguir arbustos mortos na estrada e chegar rápido ao topo.
All Roads to Peace#254.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#255.src: May have something useful if bring me [Leaden Stone] for grind metal.
All Roads to Peace#255.dst: Talvez ter algo útil se trazer [Leaden Stone] pra afiar metal.
All Roads to Peace#255.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#256.src: Look- human want help? Then get Etemitoro- that is me, my name... Get-
All Roads to Peace#256.dst: Olha- quer ajudar? Então trazer Etemitoro- esse eu, meu nome... Trazer-
All Roads to Peace#256.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#257.src: Oh! You have [Leaden Stone]! Was focusing on work, didn't notice.
All Roads to Peace#257.dst: Ah! Ter [Leaden Stone]! Focado no trabalho, não ver.
All Roads to Peace#257.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#258.src: Here. Human like green gem for money, right? Not good for smithing though.
All Roads to Peace#258.dst: Toma. Humano gostar pedra verde por dinheiro, né? Mas não boa pra forjar.
All Roads to Peace#258.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#259.src: Hm, healer human. Could swear, saw you walking around plains some time ago. What here for? Ressinter hurt again?
All Roads to Peace#259.dst: Hm, humano curandeiro. Jurar ver você andando na planície tempo atrás. Que fazer aqui? Ressinter ferido de novo?
All Roads to Peace#259.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#260.src: No? Well, am curious now. You try heal Ressinter...luck, maybe? Or did human really know what herbs do?
All Roads to Peace#260.dst: Não? Bem, agora curioso. Você curar Ressinter... sorte, talvez? Ou humano saber mesmo o que erva fazer?
All Roads to Peace#260.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#261.src: Want review. Want see human medicine knowledge. Will ask questions, human give answer. Simple. Ready?
All Roads to Peace#261.dst: Querer revisar. Ver saber de remédio do humano. Fazer pergunta, humano responder. Simples. Pronto?
All Roads to Peace#261.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#263.src: Good! So, first question. Ginkgo Leaf. What Gingko Leaf good for?
All Roads to Peace#263.dst: Bom! Primeira pergunta. Folha de ginkgo. Pra que servir ginkgo?
All Roads to Peace#263.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#264.src: Yes! Good. Gingko leaf help brain. Make feel better when stress, but make blood runny. Can be good for sometimes, but can be dangerous.
All Roads to Peace#264.dst: Sim! Bom. Ginkgo ajudar cérebro. Aliviar estresse, mas deixar sangue ralo. Às vezes bom, mas poder ser perigoso.
All Roads to Peace#264.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#265.src: So, second question. Sweetgale. What Sweetgale good for?
All Roads to Peace#265.dst: Segunda pergunta. Murta-do-brejo. Pra que servir murta?
All Roads to Peace#265.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#267.src: Nope. Sweetgale not for helping with that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#267.dst: Não. Murta não servir pra isso. Hm, talvez curar Ressinter por sorte... Tentar de novo se querer.
All Roads to Peace#267.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#270.src: Here third question. Elderberry. Elderberry good for two thing. What Elderberry good for?
All Roads to Peace#270.dst: Terceira pergunta. Sabugueiro. Sabugueiro bom pra duas coisas. Pra que servir sabugueiro?
All Roads to Peace#270.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#271.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#271.dst: Não, sabugueiro não servir pra isso. Hm, talvez curar Ressinter por sorte... Tentar de novo se querer.
All Roads to Peace#271.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#272.src: It soothes pain and treats c
All Roads to Peace#272.dst: Alivia a dor e trata males tipo resfriado.

All Roads to Peace#273.src: Yes! Though, Elderberry also good for third thing. Can make good drink! Get drunk if ferment Elderberry, but that not medicine.
All Roads to Peace#273.dst: Sim! Mas sabugueiro bom pra terceira coisa. Fazer bebida boa! Ficar bêbado se fermentar, mas isso não remédio.
All Roads to Peace#273.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#274.src: Last question for human. Feverfew. What Feverfew NOT help with?
All Roads to Peace#274.dst: Última pergunta. Matricária. Com o que matricária NÃO ajudar?
All Roads to Peace#274.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#276.src: Feverfew very good for heal that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#276.dst: Matricária muito boa pra isso. Hm, talvez curar Ressinter por sorte... Tentar de novo se querer.
All Roads to Peace#276.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#281.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#281.dst: Isso...certo! Não correto, mas certo! Você...haha, só ajudar Ressinter por sorte, né? Humano não curandeiro de verdade.
All Roads to Peace#281.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#282.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#282.dst: Mas humano ter humor! E humano esforçar pra ajudar. Mais que maioria dos humanos. Toma- tentar curar mais, em vez de ser soldado.
All Roads to Peace#282.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#283.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#283.dst: Mundo precisar mais gente que ajuda outros. Humano querer tentar significar muita coisa boa.
All Roads to Peace#283.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#284.src: It aids in sleep and soothes
All Roads to Peace#284.dst: Ajuda a dormir e alivia inflamações.

All Roads to Peace#285.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#285.dst: Não. Ginkgo ruim pra isso. Hm, talvez curar Ressinter por sorte... Tentar de novo se querer.
All Roads to Peace#285.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#287.dst: Na verdade, me dê um momento.

All Roads to Peace#288.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#288.dst: Tá. Levar tempo. Ficar aqui um pouco pra ver se outro curandeiro bem.
All Roads to Peace#288.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#289.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#289.dst: Humano curandeiro! Oi! Essa torre Onluk. Torre Onluk dois! Humano ajudar, bem-vindo.
All Roads to Peace#289.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#290.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#290.dst: Torre um chamar torre um porque Onluk fazer torre um! Aqui não lugar normal de Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#290.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#291.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#291.dst: Normal na torre do morrinho, depois da ponte. Mas fazer torre sozinho, torre bamba.
All Roads to Peace#291.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#292.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#292.dst: Humano útil. Trazer madeira forte pra arrumar torre? {p} ter madeira forte. Floresta também, mas mais mágica que forte.
All Roads to Peace#292.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#293.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#293.dst: Aha! Humano ter salgueiro! Onluk arrumar torre já!
All Roads to Peace#293.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#294.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#294.dst: Consertar torre Onluk um! Vir ver depois!
All Roads to Peace#294.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#295.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#295.dst: TORRE UM CONSERTADA! Hrahaaah! Sim! Humano muito útil!
All Roads to Peace#295.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#296.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#296.dst: Ir ver! Subir torre, atirar besta em Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#296.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#297.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#297.dst: Ver? Torre Onluk um muito melhor que torre Onluk dois! Aconchego aqui, e ver torre de Fruludir também!
All Roads to Peace#297.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#298.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#298.dst: Humano muito útil. Curandeiro e lenhador! Consertador de torre- Bem, humano não consertar. Ajudante de consertador!
All Roads to Peace#298.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#299.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#299.dst: Toma, por ajudar torre Onluk um!
All Roads to Peace#299.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#300.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#300.dst: Fale com Ureietun em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para entrar na cabana da cacica

All Roads to Peace#302.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#302.dst: Humano querer falar Arrai-Veretel. Na cabana. Vem.
All Roads to Peace#302.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#303.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#303.dst: Arrai-Veretel! Humano ajudar orc na fortaleza. Querer falar.
All Roads to Peace#303.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#304.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#304.dst: Agora com humano. Não ajudar mais- escolha ser de Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#304.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#305.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#305.dst: Hmh. Zuett falar de você. Você humano que tentar parar guerra?
All Roads to Peace#305.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#307.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#307.dst: VOCÊ! Humano que matar Rai-Poxper! Humano que atacar outro forte!
All Roads to Peace#307.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#308.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#308.dst: Precisar falar com Zuett de novo. Você seguir. E calar. Entender?
All Roads to Peace#308.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#309.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
All Roads to Peace#309.dst: Siga Arrai-Veretel até a sala de reuniões em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#310.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#310.dst: ZUETT! Dizer humano querer paz. Saber quem humano ser?!
All Roads to Peace#310.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#311.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#311.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#314.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#314.dst: Humano TAMBÉM atacar outro forte! Muito orc morto por esse humano!
All Roads to Peace#314.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#316.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#316.dst: Humano atacar! Rai-Poxper cobrar preço justo por quebrar trégua, mas não guerra ainda. Pegar machado mágico de cidade aldeã quando magia ir mal.
All Roads to Peace#316.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#317.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#317.dst: Aldeão e humano atacar primeiro, mas culpar orc por cobrar preço justo! E humano matar Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#317.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#318.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#318.dst: Depois mesmo humano vir, matar orc no banho, invadir forte, matar muito orc de Centerworld! Aldeão começar, orc acabar, aldeão não respeitar fim!
All Roads to Peace#318.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#319.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#319.dst: Sim, humano enganado por aldeão. Mas humano ainda atacar orc. Ainda matar muito orc! Agora humano querer paz?
All Roads to Peace#319.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#320.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#320.dst: Que humano fazer? Caçar javali? Ajudar curandeiro? Fazer bico pra orc? Isso não pagar vida perdida.
All Roads to Peace#320.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#321.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: ...Arrai-Veretel certa. Bem que humano fazer não pagar isso. Mas humano ainda tentar. Se um humano tentar parar, mais humano poder tentar.
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: Talvez. Talvez mais orc morrer em vez disso. Zuett, não poder dizer o que acontecer. Ilusão, e eu querer que acontecer também!
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#323.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: Mas com wynnês pela metade, orc não falar bem. VOCÊ tentar aprender língua com idiota matando você! Tudo soar burro, e maioria sem tempo!
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#324.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: Mas humano ouvir Zuett, mesmo sem soar esperto. Arrai-Veretel não respeitar humano. Justo, mas ainda causar problema.
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#325.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: Grrh. TÁ! Zuett querer tanto paz? Humano querer tanto paz? Humano derramar muito sangue orc. Única saída da guerra é atravessar. Lutar.
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#326.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: Sem truque. Sem reforço. Nada além de luta entre humano e eu. Se humano lutar na arena ritual e vencer, ouvir.
All Roads to Peace#326.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#327.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#327.dst: Tentar ameaçar com máquina de cadáver de ferro! Então, ter luta. Preparar ritual e juntar público. Prepare-se, humano.
All Roads to Peace#327.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#328.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#328.dst: Derrote Arrai-Veretel em combate na arena abaixo da sala de reuniões orc.

All Roads to Peace#329.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: Que a própria terra nos ouça... Embora não falemos mais como outrora...
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#330.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: Nós, humildes moradores da terra que ela nos deu, oferecemos esta luta em sua honra.
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#331.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: Que ela fique saciada, cresça forte e nos honre por esta oferenda.
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#334.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: HMH! Humano duro. Tá- Lutar sério agora!
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#335.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: Pelos mortos antes de mim, não perder!
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#338.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: Não, não! Arrai-Veretel ferida feio! Humano tentar matar ela!!
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#339.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#339.dst: ESTOU BEM! Burro, idiota! Não interromper luta ritual!
All Roads to Peace#339.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#340.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#340.dst: Humano vencer. Odiar dizer, mas vencer. Nem tentar me matar.
All Roads to Peace#340.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#341.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#341.dst: Dar tempo. Luta dura- Precisar acalmar. Esperar na sala de reuniões. Discutir...termos.
All Roads to Peace#341.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#342.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#342.dst: Parecer insulto parar guerra que não começar. Mas prometer. Humano forte. Ainda não pagar tanta morte...
All Roads to Peace#342.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#343.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#343.dst: Mas humano tentando. Tentando muito. Admitir, não saber que humano matar tantos ao ver... Ainda assim. Se guerra acabar, mortes também acabar.
All Roads to Peace#343.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#344.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#344.dst: Parar de atacar cidades. Orcs ainda se defender! Não dar barriga pra lança. Ainda não confiar aldeão- só dar cessar-fogo.
All Roads to Peace#344.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#345.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
All Roads to Peace#345.dst: Avisar- muito orc guardar rancor, na planície. Muito orc talvez ainda atacar. Se sim, humano pode se defender. Mas humano evitar luta lá.
All Roads to Peace#345.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#346.src: ...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
All Roads to Peace#346.dst: ...se aldeão continuar atacar, defender como antes. Humano, garantir aldeão saber disso.
All Roads to Peace#346.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#347.src: Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
All Roads to Peace#347.dst: Hum. Aldeão mais burro que humano. Aldeão fazer muita coisa terrível. Mas guerra sem fim não ajudar.
All Roads to Peace#347.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#348.src: So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
All Roads to Peace#348.dst: Zuett não ingênuo. Certas coisas...não poder...ser...perdoadas. Aldeão andar no limite.
All Roads to Peace#348.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#349.src: Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
All Roads to Peace#349.dst: Humano ver terra apodrecer no norte. Ter que ver, se tomar forte em lugar podre. Floresta ser coisa viva. Agora morrer. Morta no nordeste.
All Roads to Peace#349.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#350.src: Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
All Roads to Peace#350.dst: Começar só poucas décadas antes de aldeão ir pro outro lado do mar! Aldeão sempre fugir de problema.
All Roads to Peace#350.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#351.src: And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
All Roads to Peace#351.dst: E aldeão criar próprio problema. Só poder ser aldeão ferir terra, e fazer ela morrer, lento e certo. Muito orc morar lá.
All Roads to Peace#351.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#352.src: Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
All Roads to Peace#352.dst: Mesmo depois de aldeão chegar, tentar expulsar orc, muito orc morar lá... aí terra começar morrer. Não vir pro sul- e nós no sul!
All Roads to Peace#352.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#353.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#353.dst: Mas... isso fugir do assunto. Chega de guerra. Dar isso pra aldeão que precisar.
All Roads to Peace#353.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#354.dst: Mostre o Acordo de Cessar-fogo ao capitão Goruca.

All Roads to Peace#355.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#355.dst: Humano! Você voltou! Demorou um bocado, hein. Pensando bem, não devia me surpreender. Esses orcs são duros.
All Roads to Peace#355.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#356.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#356.dst: O que é isto? Você conseguiu mesmo que os brutos assinassem um cessar-fogo?! Eu esperava um troféu sangrento, não uma assinatura!
All Roads to Peace#356.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: Ainda assim, isso é ótimo! Os termos são mais rígidos do que eu queria, mas, desde que nos deixem em paz, tudo serve.
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#358.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: Hm? Os orcs falavam da Decadência no norte? Não sei o que isso importa. Ninguém sabe o que a causa.
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#359.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#359.dst: Digo, ouviu os boatos vindos de {p}? Dizem que bruxas amaldiçoam a terra, há! Bem, isso não vem ao caso.
All Roads to Peace#359.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#360.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: Tome- sua recompensa. Eu ia te dar a máscara para você se infiltrar como um deles, mas eu... bem, esqueci até você já ter partido.
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#361.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#361.dst: Mas EU a reforcei com magia, virou um equipamento potente! Deve te servir bem. Agradecemos seu serviço, humano!
All Roads to Peace#361.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#362.src: ...A CATAPULT! Since when did orcs have the knowhow to make a CATAPULT?!
All Roads to Peace#362.dst: ...UMA CATAPULTA! Desde quando orcs sabem fazer uma CATAPULTA?!
All Roads to Peace#362.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Nonono, you don't understand- a CATAPULT?! Seriously, I can't get over this! Orc catapult! What's the world coming to?!
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: Nãonão, você não entende- uma CATAPULTA?! Sério, não consigo superar! Catapulta orc! Aonde o mundo vai parar?!
All Roads to Peace#363.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#364.src: Obviously it seems we need some backup, soldier. Would you mind coming along to the medical tent with me?
All Roads to Peace#364.dst: Parece óbvio que precisamos de reforço, soldado. Pode vir comigo até a tenda médica?
All Roads to Peace#364.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#365.src: ORC CATAPULT! I'm telling you, Captain! They crushed our guard golems with huge honking boulders! What are we supposed to do against that?!
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: CATAPULTA ORC! Juro, capitão! Esmagaram nossos golens de guarda com pedregulhos enormes! O que fazer contra isso?!
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#366.src: He's right, captain. After the golems were crushed, the orcs spilled out from the fortress. If we didn't retreat we would've been killed, with just the four of us.
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: Ele tem razão, capitão. Depois que os golens foram esmagados, os orcs saíram da fortaleza. Se não recuássemos, teríamos morrido, só nós quatro.
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Soldier

All Roads to Peace#367.src: Human! Let me give you the lowdown. Since you helped us reclaim the outpost up north, the orcs have gotten much more aggressive.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: Humano! Vou te pôr a par. Desde que você nos ajudou a retomar o posto avançado ao norte, os orcs ficaram bem mais agressivos.
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#368.src: And that's where you come in, soldier. We need you to go to the orc fortress and break through their line of defenses. Maybe if we show them we can equal their force, they'll listen, right?
All Roads to Peace#368.dst: E é aí que você entra, soldado. Precisamos que vá à fortaleza orc e rompa a linha de defesa deles. Se mostrarmos que somos tão fortes quanto eles, vão ouvir, né?
All Roads to Peace#368.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#369.src: One against four... Human not beat even one. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#369.dst: Um contra quatro... Humano não vence nem um. Ismikku! Hulve!
All Roads to Peace#369.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#370.src: Mmh. Get up. Human! Get up! See human breathing, you awake!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: Hmm. Levanta. Humano! Levanta! Humano respirar, acordado!

All Roads to Peace#371.src: Anyway. Why you here? Why now? Give me good reason. Because kill orcs for "peace"?
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: Enfim. Por que aqui? Por que agora? Dar bom motivo. Porque matar orc pela "paz"?
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#372.src: [!] An Elite Boar has been spotted. The hunt begins!
All Roads to Peace#372.dst: [!] Um Elite Boar foi avistado. Que comece a caçada!

All Roads to Peace#373.src: [!] The Elite Boar can be identified by the particles above it's head.
All Roads to Peace#373.dst: [!] Dá para reconhecer o Elite Boar pelas partículas sobre a cabeça.

All Roads to Peace#374.src: [!] The boars will try to hide in the bushes around the hunting grounds.
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: [!] Os javalis vão tentar se esconder nos arbustos da área de caça.

All Roads to Peace#375.src: [!] Pay attention to what bush the Elite Boar is hiding in and give that bush a rustle with right-click to get the boars out of their hiding spots.
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: [!] Repare em qual arbusto o Elite Boar se esconde e sacuda-o com clique direito para tirar os javalis do esconderijo.

All Roads to Peace#376.src: ...hm. ... ... ...can respect human strength. Can hunt spineback, mean strong.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: ...hm. ... ... ...poder respeitar força humana. Caçar espinhudo, ser forte.
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Guard Serepe

All Roads to Peace#377.src: !! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: !! Ressinter único curandeiro! Zuett querer ser, Creinu querer ser, mas não!
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Guard Serepe

similar.text: {u}!! Ressinter only healer! Zuett want be healer, Creinu want be healer, but not!

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Hm... HM!! Human, uh, human good healer! Heal own injury with medicine! Human will help!
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: Hm... HM!! Humano, é, humano bom curandeiro! Curou ferida com remédio! Humano ajudar!
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#379.src: The book depicts a tall, vine-like plant with red buds.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: O livro mostra uma trepadeira alta de botões vermelhos.

All Roads to Peace#380.src: The illustration shows a body with splotchy red patches, and seems to depict pulped buds being applied to them.
All Roads to Peace#380.dst: A ilustração mostra um corpo com manchas vermelhas e parece retratar botões amassados sendo aplicados nelas.

All Roads to Peace#381.src: There's a picture of fire on the skin...? Is it trying to say that sweetgale helps heal inflammation?
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: Há um desenho de fogo na pele...? Será que quer dizer que a murta-do-brejo ajuda a curar inflamação?

All Roads to Peace#382.src: Another diagram shows grubs on the body, and seems to show that applying the pulped buds kills the bugs? That's what the big red X over the grub implies...
All Roads to Peace#382.dst: Outro diagrama mostra larvas no corpo e parece indicar que aplicar os botões amassados mata os bichos? É o que o grande X vermelho sobre a larva sugere...

All Roads to Peace#384.src: The book depicts large groups of flowers in various colors, but primarily yellow.
All Roads to Peace#384.dst: O livro mostra grandes grupos de flores de várias cores, mas sobretudo amarelas.

All Roads to Peace#385.src: Seems like yarrow can do a lot- there's a lot of disparate illustrations. One depicts a sneezing orc with two yarrow plants pointing at it, and the sneezing stopping.
All Roads to Peace#385.dst: Parece que a mil-folhas serve para muito: há várias ilustrações diferentes. Uma mostra um orc espirrando com duas mil-folhas apontadas para ele, e o espirro parando.

All Roads to Peace#386.src: A similar illustration shows an orc that appears to be having stomach cramps, if its hands being crossed over its stomach is any indication, with two yarrow plants pointed at it.
All Roads to Peace#386.dst: Uma ilustração parecida mostra um orc que parece ter cólicas, a julgar pelas mãos cruzadas sobre a barriga, com duas mil-folhas apontadas para ele.

All Roads to Peace#387.src: The third one shows an orc seemingly cut up, with red droplets coming off it. Again, two yarrow plants are pointed at it, and the next picture shows the cuts and droplets gone.
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: A terceira mostra um orc todo cortado, pingando gotas vermelhas. De novo, duas mil-folhas apontam para ele, e o desenho seguinte mostra os cortes e as gotas sumindo.

All Roads to Peace#389.src: The book depicts small, dainty flowers with white petals.
All Roads to Peace#389.dst: O livro mostra florzinhas delicadas de pétalas brancas.

All Roads to Peace#390.src: There's a detailed picture of the plant, with arrows pointing to multiple different illustrated orcs each showing different things.
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: Há um desenho detalhado da planta, com setas apontando para vários orcs ilustrados, cada um mostrando algo diferente.

All Roads to Peace#391.src: One orc is shown to be agitated, and then subsequently sleeping. Another is...shown with red patches on the skin, and fire next to it, which is replaced with water droplets in the next drawing. The red patches are gone.
All Roads to Peace#391.dst: Um orc aparece agitado e, em seguida, dormindo. Outro aparece... com manchas vermelhas na pele e fogo ao lado, que no desenho seguinte vira gotas d'água. As manchas sumiram.

All Roads to Peace#392.src: The last one shows various cuts and gashes on a third orc that's emitting red droplets, and then smaller cuts without any red drops on the next depiction...
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: O último mostra cortes e talhos num terceiro orc que solta gotas vermelhas, e depois cortes menores, sem gotas vermelhas, no desenho seguinte...

All Roads to Peace#393.src: ...but the next page is showing an orc with X's over its eyes, and arrows from multiple chamomile plants pointing to it. Does that mean too much chamomile is bad?
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: ...mas a página seguinte mostra um orc com X nos olhos e setas de várias camomilas apontando para ele. Será que camomila demais faz mal?

All Roads to Peace#395.src: The book depicts a shrub-like plant with white petals and buds.
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: O livro mostra um arbusto com pétalas e botões brancos.

All Roads to Peace#396.src: It looks like this is good for healing a lot of things. The pictures show a sweating, feverish orc, one clutching its stomach, a female one clutching her stomach, and what can be assumed to be an orc with...a toothache?
All Roads to Peace#396.dst: Parece que isto serve para curar muita coisa. Os desenhos mostram um orc suado e febril, um segurando a barriga, uma orc segurando a barriga, e o que parece um orc com... dor de dente?

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Seems to imply that feverfew is good for dealing with all of those kinds of maladies.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: Parece sugerir que o tanaceto é bom para todos esses tipos de males.

All Roads to Peace#399.src: The bleeding seems to have slowed down a little bit, but the medicine orc is still badly injured. The balm must not have been effective. You'll have to make another one.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: O sangramento parece ter diminuído um pouco, mas o orc dos remédios continua muito ferido. O bálsamo não deve ter funcionado. Você vai ter que fazer outro.

All Roads to Peace#400.src: Not know much about medicine yet. Medicine give to you, last one- Was made before. Know this though.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: Não saber muito de remédio ainda. Remédio que dar a você, o último- Feito antes. Mas saber isto.

All Roads to Peace#401.src: Ressinter bleeding bad. Find herb good for bleeding. Won't need more than two herb of type, too.
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: Ressinter sangrar muito. Achar erva boa para sangue. Não precisar mais que duas de cada tipo.

All Roads to Peace#402.src: The book depicts broad, yellow-green leaves.
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: O livro mostra folhas largas verde-amarelas.

All Roads to Peace#403.src: There's an image of an orc with red droplets coming off it, and an arrow with a picture of a gingko leaf pointing at it- the arrow is crossed out. That could mean multiple things.
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: Há uma imagem de um orc pingando gotas vermelhas, e uma seta com o desenho de uma folha de gingko apontando para ele; a seta está riscada. Isso pode significar várias coisas.

All Roads to Peace#404.src: The next page shows a gingko leaf pointed at an illustration of a brain, and a similar arrow points from a frowning orc to a smiling one.
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: A página seguinte mostra uma folha de gingko apontada para um cérebro, e uma seta parecida vai de um orc carrancudo a um sorridente.

All Roads to Peace#405.src: So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: Então é bom para o humor e a saúde mental... e tem algo a ver com sangramento, mas não dá para saber se ajuda ou atrapalha.

All Roads to Peace#407.src: The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: O livro mostra hastes floridas vermelho-laranja, quase como taboas.

All Roads to Peace#408.src: There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: Há uma ilustração grande de um orc coberto de manchas roxas, e ao lado outra parecida, com manchas laranja no lugar.

All Roads to Peace#409.src: That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: Isso sugere que a pirola moída vai ali... provavelmente são hematomas.

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: Manchas laranja parecidas aparecem aplicadas sobre o que é claramente um corte, e a ilustração seguinte mostra o mesmo corte menor.

All Roads to Peace#411.src: Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: Depois há ilustrações do que parecem... veias? Há muita escrita orc ao lado, então você não consegue entender nada do que aquilo quer dizer.

All Roads to Peace#413.src: The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: O livro mostra um arbusto baixo cheio de bagas rubras em hastes finas.

All Roads to Peace#414.src: There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: Há várias ilustrações do que parecem orcs doentes: espirros e tosse desenhados.

All Roads to Peace#415.src: One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: Uma ilustração mostra o que parece um orc com muita dor, e setas indo do sabugueiro até essas figuras.

All Roads to Peace#416.src: Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: Seu melhor palpite é que o sabugueiro serve para curar doenças leves e talvez aliviar a dor.

All Roads to Peace#418.src: The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
All Roads to Peace#418.dst: O bálsamo também não parece ter funcionado desta vez. Ele continua sangrando muito. Talvez você possa só... cobrir todos os cortes e torcer? Ou talvez não seja boa ideia.

All Roads to Peace#419.src: Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
All Roads to Peace#419.dst: Ainda nenhum efeito notável. A respiração do orc está mais fraca...

All Roads to Peace#420.src: ... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
All Roads to Peace#420.dst: ... Concordo. Mas devemos voltar às nossas tarefas.
All Roads to Peace#420.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#421.src: If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
All Roads to Peace#421.dst: Se ela teme que você só esteja cumprindo ordens, talvez Ureietun mude de ideia se você for ajudar alguns orcs por conta própria.

All Roads to Peace#422.src: There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
All Roads to Peace#422.dst: Há muitos orcs por aqui. Perguntar se precisam de ajuda deve ser bem simples.

All Roads to Peace#423.src: Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#423.dst: Humano burro? Dizer não ver Arrai-Veretel!

All Roads to Peace#424.src: Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
All Roads to Peace#424.dst: Então é isso: Fruludir recebeu o pacote. Hora de voltar até Peloros.

All Roads to Peace#425.src: Peloros train hard. Peloros work hard. Peloros work everyone hard, do everything hard.
All Roads to Peace#425.dst: Peloros treinar duro. Peloros trabalhar duro. Fazer todos trabalhar duro, tudo duro.

All Roads to Peace#426.src: Heard that Peloros thinking of making more race spot.
All Roads to Peace#426.dst: Ouvir que Peloros pensar fazer mais lugar de corrida.

All Roads to Peace#427.src: Maybe if war stop, then all orc can try run. Maybe human try run too.
All Roads to Peace#427.dst: Se guerra parar, todo orc poder correr. Talvez humano correr também.

All Roads to Peace#428.src: NO! Wrong! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
All Roads to Peace#428.dst: NÃO! Errado! Dizer errado, tudo errado! Mais burro que normal!
All Roads to Peace#428.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#429.src: Want human try again! Feel pain of good name in stupid language! SAY NAME!
All Roads to Peace#429.dst: Humano tentar de novo! Sentir dor de nome bom em língua burra! DIZER NOME!

All Roads to Peace#430.src: Supposed to learn human language for peace. Show orc good because big-nose grub say bad.
All Roads to Peace#430.dst: Dever aprender língua humana pela paz. Mostrar orc bom porque verme narigudo dizer ruim.

All Roads to Peace#431.src: Idiot villager get human before orc, so human greet orc with weapon and death!
All Roads to Peace#431.dst: Aldeão idiota pegar humano antes do orc, e humano saudar orc com arma e morte!

All Roads to Peace#432.src: Now learn language but only in half, and name all stupid!
All Roads to Peace#432.dst: Agora aprender língua só pela metade, e nome todo burro!

All Roads to Peace#433.src: His breathing is steady...better let him sleep.

All Roads to Peace#434.src: Just need [{~} Carp Meat] from human. Could bring more if wanted, but will not force you.
All Roads to Peace#434.dst: Só precisar [{~} Carp Meat] do humano. Poder trazer mais se quiser, mas não forçar.

All Roads to Peace#435.src: All must work together to survive on earth. All have places, all have paths.
All Roads to Peace#435.dst: Todos dever trabalhar juntos na terra. Todos ter lugar, todos ter caminho.
All Roads to Peace#435.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#436.src: Many just take and not give. Villager, bugs, other human... You are different.
All Roads to Peace#436.dst: Muitos só pegar e não dar. Aldeão, inseto, outro humano... Você ser diferente.
All Roads to Peace#436.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#437.src: Still not understand why helping so much. It good, but was not expecting from human.
All Roads to Peace#437.dst: Ainda não entender por que ajudar tanto. Ser bom, mas não esperar de humano.

All Roads to Peace#438.src: Can say, happy to be wrong about this.
All Roads to Peace#438.dst: Poder dizer: feliz de errar nisso.
All Roads to Peace#438.speaker: Durbeo

All Roads to Peace#439.src: Well, it seems like just trying to lift it won't work. Maybe casting some spells at it will dislodge it? Try casting multiple spells in a row.
All Roads to Peace#439.dst: Bom, parece que só tentar levantá-la não vai dar certo. Talvez lançar alguns feitiços a solte? Tente lançar vários feitiços seguidos.

All Roads to Peace#440.src: Human! Try move rock, use magic!
All Roads to Peace#440.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#441.src: Human can't find iron? There some in valley east of villager quarry, around villager with weapons.
All Roads to Peace#441.dst: Humano não achar ferro? Ter no vale a leste da pedreira dos aldeões, perto de aldeão armado.

All Roads to Peace#442.src: Maybe someplace closer. If so, not know where. Need [{~} Iron Ingots] total though.
All Roads to Peace#442.dst: Talvez lugar mais perto, mas não saber onde. Precisar [{~} Iron Ingots] no total.

All Roads to Peace#443.src: Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language...pfeh. Whatever language. Not orc language.
All Roads to Peace#443.dst: Grrmb. Kreimu burra. Língua Wynn burra... língua de Gavel... pff. Qualquer língua. Não língua orc.
All Roads to Peace#443.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#444.src: Not just that- Learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
All Roads to Peace#444.dst: Não só isso- Aprender a ser orc-remédio. Ela também! Curandeira, boticária, herbalista, tanto faz. Igual demais!
All Roads to Peace#444.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#445.src: Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help with Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu...ingredient for medicine.
All Roads to Peace#445.dst: Brava com isso. Atrapalhar treino também. Humano querer ajudar como ajudou Ressinter? Pegar para Creinu- Crei...nu...não Kreimu...ingrediente de remédio.
All Roads to Peace#445.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#446.src: [{~} Leafy Stalk]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
All Roads to Peace#446.dst: [{~} Leafy Stalk]. Precisar aprender a fazer muito remédio com pouca erva. Fácil?
All Roads to Peace#446.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#447.src: [{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#447.dst: [{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] bastar para melhorar torre? Salgueiro forte! Poder pegar?
All Roads to Peace#447.speaker: Onluk

similar.text: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?

All Roads to Peace#448.src: Human welcome in Onluk tower two, but Onluk tower one better. Not safe to be on without fix tower though.
All Roads to Peace#448.dst: Humano bem-vindo na torre dois de Onluk, mas torre um melhor. Só não seguro subir sem consertar.

All Roads to Peace#449.src: If want go on Onluk tower one, bring [{~} Willow Planks] so Onluk can fix!
All Roads to Peace#449.dst: Querer subir na torre um? Trazer [{~} Willow Planks] para Onluk consertar!

All Roads to Peace#450.src: If bring up lots of arrow, maybe can shoot Freelancer. Like to run through sky. Cause problem for everyone, and Freelancer never actually die, just dissipate.
All Roads to Peace#450.dst: Se trazer muita flecha, talvez atirar em Freelancer. Gostar de correr pelo céu. Causar problema a todos, e Freelancer nunca morrer de verdade, só dissipar.

All Roads to Peace#451.src: Fun time sometimes! Though sometimes Freelancer shoot back. That how Onluk tower one broke.
All Roads to Peace#451.dst: Divertido às vezes! Mas Freelancer às vezes revidar. Assim torre um de Onluk quebrou.

All Roads to Peace#452.src: Must be some reason. Not sure if tired of fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
All Roads to Peace#452.dst: Dever ter motivo. Não saber se cansado de lutar ou outro motivo, mas se humano querer ajudar, ajuda ser bem-vinda.
All Roads to Peace#452.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#453.src: Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of the other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
All Roads to Peace#453.dst: Tinta azul acabando. Ter muito das outras cores, mas precisar azul. Saber onde conseguir, também.
All Roads to Peace#453.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#454.src: Can't find the cave? Is outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it.
All Roads to Peace#454.dst: Não achar caverna? Ficar fora da ponte dos aldeões, com lago e arco perto.

All Roads to Peace#455.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Bright blue flowers, very dusty.
All Roads to Peace#455.dst: Pegar [{~} Terramarine Buds] para fazer tinta. Flor azul-viva, muito empoeirada.

All Roads to Peace#456.src: You unlearn villager stupidity, maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
All Roads to Peace#456.dst: Você desaprender burrice de aldeão, talvez? No meio de desaprender? Talvez sinal da terra que coisas vão sarar. Talvez não. Vamos ver.
All Roads to Peace#456.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#457.src: Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp make bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
All Roads to Peace#457.dst: Uhum. Bom! Polpa de murta espantar inseto. Também acalmar pele irritada. Bom para picada de inseto.
All Roads to Peace#457.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#458.src: Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
All Roads to Peace#458.dst: Peça de arma quebrada não boa sozinha, mas afiada. Usar para fazer outra arma! Reusar bom para terra- não desperdiçar!
All Roads to Peace#458.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#459.src: What in the... HEY! Why's one of those big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
All Roads to Peace#459.dst: Mas o que... EI! Por que um desses humanos grandes e assustadores está aqui?! Nunny, você disse que a gente ia brincar!

All Roads to Peace#460.src: We are. This human isn't actually so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
All Roads to Peace#460.dst: E vamos. Este humano não é tão ruim assim. Que tal se apresentarem?
All Roads to Peace#460.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#461.src: Silly little goblins. Who goes and names themself after fruits?
All Roads to Peace#461.dst: Goblinzinhos bobos. Quem é que se dá nome de fruta?

All Roads to Peace#462.src: Guess goblins are just sort of fickle like that. But again, you just have to find all four of them.
All Roads to Peace#462.dst: Acho que os goblins são volúveis assim mesmo. Mas, de novo, você só precisa achar os quatro.

All Roads to Peace#463.src: None of them will have left the fortress, so it shouldn't take too long.
All Roads to Peace#463.dst: Nenhum deles vai ter saído da fortaleza, então não deve demorar muito.

All Roads to Peace#464.src: I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu over at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
All Roads to Peace#464.dst: Dizem que quase todo humano é valentão. Por isso Veltu, do acampamento Trunkstump, nos endurecia.
All Roads to Peace#464.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#465.src: I lost, so I don't care about the game anymore. I saw Blueberry over by that one orc who keeps trying to lift that rock.
All Roads to Peace#465.dst: Eu perdi, então não ligo mais pro jogo. Vi o Blueberry perto daquele orc que fica tentando levantar aquela pedra.

All Roads to Peace#466.src: Ack! I saw Grapes on the hanging flag! Don't hurt me!
All Roads to Peace#466.dst: Ai! Vi o Grapes na bandeira pendurada! Não me bata!

All Roads to Peace#467.src: Y'know, I probably shouldn't tell you this, but I could actually see Mango over in the other tower! She probably figured it was tough to get to.
All Roads to Peace#467.dst: Sabe, eu não devia te contar isso, mas dá para ver a Mango lá na outra torre! Ela deve ter achado que era difícil chegar lá.

All Roads to Peace#468.src: Uh... I wonder where Peaches went? I know he loves playing in the creeks at Waterway, so... Oh. I shouldn't spoil their spot.
All Roads to Peace#468.dst: Hã... Onde será que o Peaches foi? Ele adora brincar nos riachos de Waterway, então... Ops. Não devia entregar o esconderijo.

All Roads to Peace#469.src: Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I thought.
All Roads to Peace#469.dst: É, acho que não foi tão chato quanto eu pensei.
All Roads to Peace#469.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#471.src: Not much else to say. Was fun, I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#471.dst: Nada mais a dizer. Foi divertido, acho.

All Roads to Peace#472.src: Hey! Human! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
All Roads to Peace#472.dst: Ei! Humano! Humano caçar javali espinhudo e curar curandeiro!
All Roads to Peace#472.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#473.src: Not stupid human who go around kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
All Roads to Peace#473.dst: Não humano burro que sair matando orc! Humano bom! Poder confiar. Então pedir coisa pequena.
All Roads to Peace#473.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#474.src: Oh, human forget. Teiren tell again! Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#474.dst: Ah, humano esquecer. Teiren repetir! Sudeste do forte, após crista, velho campo.

All Roads to Peace#475.src: Forgot important thing there. Need make sure Peloros no run into firepit. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#475.dst: Esquecer coisa importante lá. Precisar Peloros não cair na fogueira. Então, você buscar!

All Roads to Peace#476.src: Lady, everything the wind touches is OURS! Not ta mention we're so close to the mountains we live on! This camp's our property, and that thing you got's part of the camp!
All Roads to Peace#476.dst: Moça, tudo que o vento toca é NOSSO! Sem falar que a gente vive nas montanhas logo ali! O acampamento é nosso, e essa coisa aí que cê pegou faz parte dele!
All Roads to Peace#476.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#477.src: One so brazen as yourself could never share in the bounties of nature! Now begone, and leave me be!
All Roads to Peace#477.dst: Alguém tão atrevido jamais terá parte nas dádivas da natureza! Agora some daqui e me deixe em paz!
All Roads to Peace#477.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#478.src: Will say, got thing from Earthpit. Was brought by Holehold gofer during party.
All Roads to Peace#478.dst: Dizer: coisa vir de Earthpit. Trazida por moleque de Holehold durante festa.

All Roads to Peace#479.src: Special thing! Kept for long time. Important, so was bad to forget.
All Roads to Peace#479.dst: Coisa especial! Guardar muito tempo. Importante, ruim esquecer.

All Roads to Peace#480.src: Will maybe invite human to next party!
All Roads to Peace#480.dst: Talvez chamar humano na próxima festa!

All Roads to Peace#481.src: Earth say what earth should be. Only need to listen to her.
All Roads to Peace#481.dst: Terra dizer o que terra deve ser. Só precisar ouvir ela.

All Roads to Peace#482.src: Earth say rock should stay here, then rock stays here. Simple.
All Roads to Peace#482.dst: Terra dizer pedra ficar aqui, então pedra fica aqui. Simples.

All Roads to Peace#483.src: Hurts, seeing earth rot in north. Big-nose grubs should feel her pain too- they make earth sick!
All Roads to Peace#483.dst: Doer ver terra apodrecer no norte. Verme narigudo dever sentir dor dela- deixam terra doente!

All Roads to Peace#484.src: How can Zuett say human trying end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#484.dst: Como Zuett dizer humano querer paz, se humano RECOMEÇAR GUERRA?!
All Roads to Peace#484.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#485.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then, human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#485.dst: É. ESSE. O. PONTO!! Aldeão fazer humano lutar por eles! Trégua dizer aldeão não atacar orc. Então humano vir do mar. Tentar paz- ser atacado!
All Roads to Peace#485.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#486.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#486.dst: Ver humano atacar. Aldeão fazer humano atacar, mentir para enganar. Orc se defender. Então três orcs Rai morrer em Earthpit, Cliffhearth, acampamento Trunkstump.
All Roads to Peace#486.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#487.src: Orc take human fort built in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#487.dst: Orc tomar forte humano em floresta de terra morrendo. Não saber se humano planejar outro ataque! Mas não matar humano. Prender humano.
All Roads to Peace#487.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#488.src: War only killing us! If tried talk to human instead of go to sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#488.dst: Guerra só matar nós! Se falar com humano em vez de afiar lança e revidar, talvez humano aprender mais rápido que agora.
All Roads to Peace#488.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#489.src: Listen. Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#489.dst: Escuta. Zuett. Eu querer fim da guerra também. Mas dever entender risco. Não decidir à toa. Aldeão faltar com palavra- ver escrito, achar jeito de fugir do escrito.
All Roads to Peace#489.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#490.src: ...that right. Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#490.dst: ...isso certo. Preparar, humano. Arrai-Veretel orc mais forte. Forte em tudo. Mente, corpo, poder, espírito.
All Roads to Peace#490.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#491.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel. Arena is down stairs.
All Roads to Peace#491.dst: Zuett ainda achar humano tentar ser bom. Achar poder ajudar guerra burra acabar. Pôr juízo em Arrai-Veretel. Arena lá embaixo.
All Roads to Peace#491.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#492.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not respect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#492.dst: Antes de luta... Dever fazer ritual. Desafio precisar respeito. Não respeitar você, humano, mas mostrar respeito mesmo assim.
All Roads to Peace#492.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#493.src: Hmh. Human probably trying end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#493.dst: Hmh. Humano talvez querer acabar guerra desde início. Só lado errado. Concordar, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#493.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#494.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#494.dst: Dar chance de humano aprender e aldeão mostrar respeito. Se não atacar, estar aberto a mais negociação.
All Roads to Peace#494.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#495.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager keep doing stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#495.dst: Paz primeiro passo para sarar. ...a não ser que aldeão fazer burrice. Aí talvez lutar mesmo.
All Roads to Peace#495.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#496.src: That's the cease-fire agreement! You need to hand this to Captain Goruca- He should be waiting in {p} still.
All Roads to Peace#496.dst: É o acordo de cessar-fogo! Entregue isto ao capitão Goruca- Ele deve estar esperando em {p} ainda.

All Roads to Peace#497.src: Maybe see human again soon. Hopefully in good spirit and on good faith.
All Roads to Peace#497.dst: Talvez ver humano de novo logo. Tomara com bom ânimo e de boa-fé.

All Roads to Peace#498.src: Go on. Give to whatever villager need to see it. Let them learn.
All Roads to Peace#498.dst: Vai. Dar para aldeão que precisar ver. Deixar eles aprender.

All Roads to Peace#499.src: ...Think new thoughts. Difficult ones, from now on.
All Roads to Peace#499.dst: ...Pensar coisa nova. Difícil, daqui em diante.

All Roads to Peace#500.src: Keep thinking too. Not just copy what see. Figure for self what good and bad.
All Roads to Peace#500.dst: Continuar pensando. Não só copiar o que ver. Descobrir sozinho bom e ruim.

All Roads to Peace#501.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they've rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#501.dst: Depois de atacarem nosso posto com tanta selvageria e de rejeitarem nossas missões diplomáticas, eu não esperava isto.
All Roads to Peace#501.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#502.src: You know, that one guy was going off about that orc catapult or whatever the entire time you were gone. He's shut up now, but criminy!
All Roads to Peace#502.dst: Sabe, aquele cara ficou reclamando da catapulta orc ou sei lá o quê o tempo todo que você esteve fora. Agora calou a boca, mas caramba!

All Roads to Peace#503.src: The cuts are closing underneath the balm, and his breathing is becoming more steady. Did you do it...?
All Roads to Peace#503.dst: Os cortes estão fechando sob o bálsamo, e a respiração dele está mais estável. Você conseguiu...?

An Iron Heart Part I#000.src: ...I am... What^s my...name...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Re...remember!! WHAT IS MY NAME? My life?
An Iron Heart Part I#001.dst: Lem...lembre!! QUAL MEU NOME? Minha vida?

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!! No...no oives!
An Iron Heart Part I#002.dst: LEMBRE!! Não...sem ordens! Sem dLEMBRE!! Não...sem o iretLEMBRE!! Não...sem oizes!

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: My name!! My life! I won't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PLEASE!
An Iron Heart Part I#003.dst: Meu nome!! Minha vida! Não vou feri-los! A dor me faz lemb...quem é?! SAIA! POR FAVOR!

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: NO MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE VOICES THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#004.dst: CHEGA DE FRIO! CHEGA DE VOZES QUE NÃO SÃO MINHAS! MEU NOME É [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NÃOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#004.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
An Iron Heart Part I#005.dst: Desmoro...nando...este não é quem eu eu eu era... Meu... Meu... Meu meu meu nome é. Era. É. Era. É. É...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! Sou Madeleine... Eu... E-E-EEEEEEEEE-

An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: Ei, você aí! Não esperava um soldado humano por aqui, mas você chegou na hora certa. Eu bem que precisava de ajuda.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#008.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.dst: Você conhece os Golens guardiões, certo? São fabricados aqui em Gavel, e eu comprei um há pouco.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.dst: Os goblins vivem tentando saquear minhas plantações, sabe- Eu precisava de algo para mantê-los longe, e um golem seria perfeito.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.dst: Mas, logo depois que o ativei, a coisa me atacou! Quase morri- Ele se jogava contra pedras e paredes...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: Claro que me venderam um modelo com defeito... Aquele golem é um perigo para tudo ao redor. Acha que consegue contê-lo?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: Ele deixou um rastro de sucata, como vê. Por favor, siga o rastro e impeça que ele cause mais estragos!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#013.dst: Encontre o Golem guardião defeituoso na montanha em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#019.src: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.dst: Sem diretrizes!! Quem fez isso?! Eu não...p-parem de dar ORDENS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#021.src: Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: Contenha o Golem guardião defeituoso e volte a Duvale em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.dst: Conseguiu conter o golem? Pelo menos você parece estar inteiro.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#024.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.dst: Ai...essa doeu. Não me surpreende que tenha precisado destruí-lo, mas foi um investimento grande jogado fora.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#025.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.dst: Mesmo assim, fico pensando...parecia que ele falava quando o liguei- Espera, você também ouviu?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#026.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.dst: Hm. Pensando bem, há uns boatos feios sobre a fábrica... Talvez tenham algum fundamento.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#027.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.dst: Ele disse um nome? Madeleine? Não me diz nada, mas isso é...bem preocupante. Nunca falei de uma Madeleine para ele.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#028.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.dst: Isso merece ir à polícia, sério. Acho que vou ter que escrever para {p}- a fábrica fica perto de lá.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#029.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.dst: Até lá, tome. Considere isto sua recompensa pela ajuda, bravo humano. Boa sorte por aí.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#030.src: ...I am... What's my...name...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part II#000.src: Have you found any leads since I sent you to my contact, Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#000.dst: Achou alguma pista desde que te mandei ao meu contato, Daxe?

An Iron Heart Part II#001.src: Duvale mentioned rumors about an illegal factory in the swamp... If Daxe's criminal past had to do with this, maybe the [Mechanical Reactor] will cause him to react. Duvale mentioned he had spares, should they be needed.
An Iron Heart Part II#001.dst: Duvale falou de boatos sobre uma fábrica ilegal no pântano... Se o passado criminoso de Daxe tem a ver com isso, talvez o [Reator mecânico] o faça reagir. Duvale disse que tinha peças extras, se precisar.

An Iron Heart Part II#002.src: The guard golem left...but the reactor has stopped working.
An Iron Heart Part II#002.dst: O golem guardião foi embora...mas o reator parou.

An Iron Heart Part II#003.src: Go on, search my house. Or are you just here to waste my time?
An Iron Heart Part II#003.dst: Vai, revista minha casa. Ou só veio me fazer perder tempo?

An Iron Heart Part II#005.src: So what is it? Have you made your decision?

An Iron Heart Part II#006.dst: Fale com o detetive Hart em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#007.src: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.dst: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. Todos sumidos...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#008.src: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.dst: Etan é o último. Você por acaso sabe algo dessas pessoas, soldado?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#009.src: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.dst: Cidadãos estão sumindo num ritmo alarmante. Perdemos {~} pessoas em só {~} semanas. E nenhum rastro delas em lugar nenhum.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#010.src: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.dst: Quem diria, com tantos golens guardiões que ganhamos há pouco! {p} devia estar mais segura do que nunca.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#011.src: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.dst: Claro que tenho minhas suspeitas, há boatos por aí sobre...negócios escusos.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#012.src: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.dst: Não sei em quem confiar nessas circunstâncias, então, se você puder ajudar na investigação, eu ficaria muito grato.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#013.src: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.dst: O “Grande” Daxe tem um passado criminoso. Sabe coisas que a polícia não sabe, mas não fala comigo por causa do meu cargo.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#014.src: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.dst: Pode tentar tirar alguma informação dele? A cabana dele fica a oeste daqui. Ao lado do acampamento da garota elfa.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#015.src: Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#015.dst: Siga a estrada oeste e fale com Daxe na casa dele em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#016.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.dst: Ora, um humano quer entrar sem convite na casa do grande Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#017.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.dst: Azar o seu, não gosto de visitas. Deixei meu passado criminoso para trás.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#018.src: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.dst: Então vá. Não tenho nada para te contar.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#020.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.dst: Azar o seu, não gosto de visitas. Deixei meu passado criminoso para trás...hm?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#021.src: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.dst: Que aparelho é esse aí? Então você já sabe disso...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#022.src: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.dst: Hm! Se já sabe, para que quer a informação?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#024.src: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.dst: MADELEINE! Cadê...espera! O que houve, onde estou? DE QUEM É ESTA VOZ?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#025.src: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.dst: Espera, o que está acontecendo?! O que fez com meu golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#026.src: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.dst: Eles... minha filha... CALA A BOCA! SILÊNCIO! Quem me dá ordens- SEM ORDENS! Frio! FRIO!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#027.dst: Espera, sua filha?! M-Madeleine...? Eu...c-como...o quê...?
An Iron Heart Part II#027.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#028.src: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#028.dst: Você...você não é...aço morto? Lembra seu nome...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#028.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#029.src: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.dst: PAREM DE ME DAR ORDENS!! EU...EU SOU THEODORE! NÃO SOU SERVO! Eu...cadê minha vida...? Cadê...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.speaker: Guard Golem?
