Apotheosis (Quest)#454.dst: Sim, sim... chegaremos lá. {u}, antes de partir para mais uma missão perigosa, é melhor falar com todos aqui. Aliviar algumas preocupações, sim?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#455.dst: ...e você está bem? Nenhum ferimento- nada?
Apotheosis (Quest)#455.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#456.src: Ughhhhh... yeah, bro, I'm fine! Quit hovering!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.dst: Aaaff... tô bem, mano! Para de ficar em cima!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#457.src: Well, sorry for being worried under these circumstances! The SKY is broken, Yuman, so let me hover at least a little, okay?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.dst: Bom, desculpa por me preocupar nessas circunstâncias! O CÉU quebrou, Yuman, então me deixa ficar em cima um pouquinho, tá?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#458.src: Well, a...at least the soldiers have b- ba- backed off a little... so, that's s- something.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.dst: Bem, p...pelo menos os soldados r- re- recuaram um pouco... então já é a- alguma coisa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#459.src: Sigh... yeah, that is something. I'm almost out of electrical charges...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.dst: Suspiro... é, já é alguma coisa. Estou quase sem cargas elétricas...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#462.src: S...so does that mean you... y- you stopped her?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.dst: E...então você... v- você a deteve?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#465.src: ...I hear a "but" added on to the end. Where are Rex and Sui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.dst: ...ouço um "mas" no fim. Cadê a Rex e a Sui?
Apotheosis (Quest)#465.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#469.src: B...but she's... sh- she's okay, now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#469.dst: M...mas ela... e- ela está bem, agora...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#469.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#470.src: ...man. Man. That... that really sucks, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#470.dst: ...cara. Cara. Isso... isso é péssimo, né?
Apotheosis (Quest)#470.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#471.src: Her... h- her bow... she's n- ne- never gonna be able to... use it ag- again...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.dst: O... o- o arco dela... ela n- nu- nunca mais vai... usá-lo de n- novo...
Apotheosis (Quest)#471.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#472.src: I didn't even consider that... man. So, then... Sui's with her still?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.dst: Nem pensei nisso... cara. Então... a Sui ainda está com ela?
Apotheosis (Quest)#472.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#473.src: She's... in good hands, at least. Multiple Sovereigns, turning to our side... it's a little hard to believe.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.dst: Ela está... em boas mãos, ao menos. Vários Soberanos passando para o nosso lado... é meio difícil de acreditar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#473.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#474.src: But this is good. If they've turned against the Queen... it'll make things easier for us once this is all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.dst: Mas isso é bom. Se eles se voltaram contra a Rainha... vai facilitar as coisas quando tudo isso acabar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#474.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#475.src: Guess so... WAIT! So Zhiraok broke Soosu out of prison?! Was that-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.dst: Acho que sim... ESPERA! O Zhiraok tirou a Soosu da prisão?! Foi-
Apotheosis (Quest)#475.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#476.src: -wh- what we saw? It was a- a flash of s- so- something, going into and out of the p...palace! Just before the sk...sky broke.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.dst: -o- o que vimos? Foi um- um clarão de a- al- algo entrando e saindo do p...palácio! Logo antes do c...céu quebrar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#476.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#477.src: It must've been! That explains some things! Hey, no wonder the soldiers were so confused!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.dst: Só pode ter sido! Explica umas coisas! Ei, não admira os soldados estarem tão perdidos!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#477.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#479.src: ...{u}. The Queen isn't d...dead, is she?
Apotheosis (Quest)#479.dst: ...{u}. A Rainha não está m...morta, está?
Apotheosis (Quest)#479.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#480.src: Then... y...you're going after her. Right?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.dst: Então... v...você vai atrás dela. Certo?
Apotheosis (Quest)#480.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#481.src: Zeph... you're not thinking of going in there too, are you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.dst: Zeph... você não está pensando em ir lá também, está?
Apotheosis (Quest)#481.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#484.src: I- I have to... Rex won't be in any sh- shape to fight, a- and- and it's my turn to do my p...part anyway!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.dst: E- eu preciso... A Rex não vai estar em c- condições de lutar, e- e- e é minha vez de fazer minha p...parte!
Apotheosis (Quest)#484.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#485.src: ... Fine. But you have to come back, princess! We've got plans, remember? I still have to show you where I grew up, and-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.dst: ... Tá. Mas você tem que voltar, princesa! Temos planos, lembra? Ainda tenho que te mostrar onde cresci, e-
Apotheosis (Quest)#485.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#486.src: -and sh...show me your favourite food stand from when you were gr...growing up, I- I know. I'll be b- back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.dst: -e me m...mostrar sua barraca de comida favorita de quando era c...criança, e- eu sei. Eu v- volto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#486.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#487.src: Okay, lovebirds, that's my signal to get out of here. There's schedules I have to organize...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.dst: Tá, pombinhos, é minha deixa para sair daqui. Tenho horários para organizar...
Apotheosis (Quest)#487.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#488.src: ...but yeah. Zeph, {u}, I expect to see you two again. Understood?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.dst: ...mas é sério. Zeph, {u}, espero ver vocês dois de novo. Entendido?
Apotheosis (Quest)#488.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#490.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you're back.
Apotheosis (Quest)#490.dst: {u}, que bom ver você de volta.
Apotheosis (Quest)#490.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#491.src: I heard from Zeph that you and the girls decided to challenge Her Majesty.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.dst: Zeph me contou que você e as meninas decidiram desafiar Sua Majestade.
Apotheosis (Quest)#491.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#492.src: How... how did it go? I can't help notice the lack of companions by your side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.dst: Como... como foi? Não pude deixar de notar que você está sem companhia.
Apotheosis (Quest)#492.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#493.src: Sui has grown into quite the powerful cursed one, huh?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.dst: A Sui virou uma Amaldiçoada bem poderosa, hein?
Apotheosis (Quest)#493.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#494.src: Did I hear that right... Soosu?
Apotheosis (Quest)#494.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#495.src: That... is an unexpected turn of events. However, you may accept their change of heart but for the rest of us...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.dst: Isso... é uma reviravolta inesperada. Você pode aceitar a mudança de lado deles, mas para o resto de nós...
Apotheosis (Quest)#495.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#496.src: They are an extension of her Majesty. All the pain and suffering they have caused is because of them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.dst: Eles são uma extensão de Sua Majestade. Toda a dor e o sofrimento que causaram vêm deles.
Apotheosis (Quest)#496.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#498.src: We have been thinking about how to handle the aftermath; in case we were successful. The larger populous knows of us as only terrorists. They would never accept us to rebuild Fruma.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.dst: Temos pensado em como lidar com o depois, caso déssemos certo. A maior parte do povo só nos conhece como terroristas. Nunca nos aceitariam para reconstruir Fruma.
Apotheosis (Quest)#498.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#499.src: But. With the Sovereigns on our side, the people might, they just might, hear them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.dst: Mas. Com os Soberanos do nosso lado, talvez, só talvez, o povo os ouça.
Apotheosis (Quest)#499.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#500.src: Ugh. You're right. This is the best option we got.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.dst: Argh. Tem razão. É a melhor opção que temos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#500.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#501.src: We will need to arrange a meeting with them to discuss moving forwards. I expect it to be tense, even hostile. But, but we can do this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.dst: Teremos que marcar uma reunião com eles para falar do futuro. Imagino que será tensa, até hostil. Mas, mas conseguimos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#501.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#502.src: I'll get Fuhue to draft up our plan, then.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.dst: Então vou pedir ao Fuhue que redija o plano.
Apotheosis (Quest)#502.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#504.src: Went without a scratch, of course.
Apotheosis (Quest)#504.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#505.src: Well, we did have a lot of issues... I wasn't worried but I'm glad Zeph and Cileon returned with us.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.dst: Bom, tivemos muitos problemas... Não me preocupei, mas que bom que Zeph e Cileon voltaram com a gente.
Apotheosis (Quest)#505.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#506.src: Fuhue's talismans were doing a lot of the heavy lifting in their absence.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.dst: Sem eles, os talismãs do Fuhue fizeram o trabalho pesado.
Apotheosis (Quest)#506.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#507.src: The Canopy will be helping with the aftermath. I don't care for becoming a public figure after this is over, though.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.dst: O Dossel vai ajudar com o depois. Mas não faço questão de virar figura pública quando isso acabar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#507.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#508.src: The trees are calling my name and the {p} is definitely not the place for me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.dst: As árvores me chamam, e {p} com certeza não é lugar para mim.
Apotheosis (Quest)#508.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#509.src: Besides, could you ever see such a hunk like me become a politician... Pshh, at least I can't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.dst: Além disso, dá para imaginar um gato como eu virando político... Pff, eu não consigo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#509.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#512.src: Foxes and I cleared them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#512.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#513.src: I want to return to the forest.
Apotheosis (Quest)#513.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#514.src: Need to hunt, run and stay away from... cities.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.dst: Preciso caçar, correr e ficar longe de... cidades.
Apotheosis (Quest)#514.speaker: Cileon

Apotheosis (Quest)#517.src: My talismans did the trick. Managed to keep up a temporary barrier for some time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.dst: Meus talismãs funcionaram. Consegui manter uma barreira temporária por um tempo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#517.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#518.src: Unfortunately, they only last for some time and my schedule has not allowed me to create more. It was a miscalculation on my side.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.dst: Infelizmente, eles só duram um tempo e minha agenda não me permitiu criar mais. Foi um erro de cálculo meu.
Apotheosis (Quest)#518.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#519.src: I have completely, utterly failed as the Deer's captain. I totally underestimated how many barrier talismans we needed!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.dst: Falhei total e completamente como capitão dos Cervos. Subestimei totalmente quantos talismãs de barreira precisávamos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#519.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#520.src: The Canopy will remain. Master has asked me to document everything that has transpired in the past couple of weeks. It will take me at least one week and three days to compile it all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.dst: O Dossel continuará. O Mestre me pediu para documentar tudo o que houve nas últimas semanas. Levarei ao menos uma semana e três dias para compilar tudo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#520.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#521.src: Besides, without the Queen a new government will have to be established. I am planning to be of assistance, there as well.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.dst: Além disso, sem a Rainha, um novo governo terá de ser formado. Pretendo ajudar nisso também.
Apotheosis (Quest)#521.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#524.src: When we got- got back we had almost been c-completely overtaken.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.dst: Quando vol- voltamos, quase tinham nos d-dominado de vez.
Apotheosis (Quest)#524.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#525.src: I'd like t-to -to believe I helped but... to be honest Rurie did most of the w-work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.dst: Queria a-a-achar que ajudei, mas... sinceramente, a Rurie fez quase todo o t-trabalho.
Apotheosis (Quest)#525.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#526.src: I felt guilty that I- I left you guys.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.dst: Me senti culpado por- por deixar vocês.
Apotheosis (Quest)#526.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#527.src: But I will n-not back down for this final showdown!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.dst: Mas não v-vou recuar neste confronto final!
Apotheosis (Quest)#527.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#529.src: It's, it's weird. After everything we've g-gone through, after everyone we- we- we lost. I have hope for the future.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.dst: É, é estranho. Depois de tudo que p-passamos, de todos que- que- que perdemos. Tenho esperança no futuro.
Apotheosis (Quest)#529.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#530.src: I promised myself when... when I was captured that if I- I made it out, I would not let my life fly by. I will l-live for Syndra and Mora. I will k-keep Syndra's legacy going.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.dst: Prometi a mim mesmo quando... quando fui capturado que, se e- eu saísse, não deixaria a vida passar. Vou v-viver por Syndra e Mora. Vou m-manter vivo o legado de Syndra.
Apotheosis (Quest)#530.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#531.src: And I made a p-promise to Yuman. I w-want to explore the world with- with him.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.dst: E fiz uma p-promessa ao Yuman. Q-quero explorar o mundo com- com ele.
Apotheosis (Quest)#531.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#532.src: I don't think I- I will n-never be ready but, I want to do all that I c-can.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.dst: Acho que e- eu n-nunca vou estar pronto, mas quero fazer tudo o que p-puder.
Apotheosis (Quest)#532.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#533.src: I won't be a hinderance to you. I k-know you and Sui are strong but... I'm not h-helpless.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.dst: Não vou te atrapalhar. E-eu sei que você e a Sui são fortes, mas... não sou i-indefeso.
Apotheosis (Quest)#533.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#534.src: I'll follow you whenever you're r-ready, friend.
Apotheosis (Quest)#534.dst: Vou te seguir quando estiver p-pronto, amigo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#534.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#536.src: Things were looking veeery hairy for a bit. Luckily, Rurie brought back up just in time.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.dst: A coisa ficou beeem feia por um tempo. Por sorte, a Rurie trouxe reforços bem na hora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#536.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#537.src: Those Canopy people can be quite scary, I must say.
Apotheosis (Quest)#537.dst: O pessoal do Dossel dá um certo medo, viu.
Apotheosis (Quest)#537.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#538.src: I know that chaos is sure to ensue with Her Majesty gone but, I don't think I'm the best at... cleaning up a province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.dst: Sei que vai ter caos com Sua Majestade fora, mas não acho que eu seja o melhor para... arrumar uma província.
Apotheosis (Quest)#538.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#539.src: I would honestly love to see the world. Traveling the world with someone you like sounds... nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.dst: Sinceramente, eu adoraria ver o mundo. Viajar por aí com alguém de quem você gosta parece... bom.
Apotheosis (Quest)#539.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#540.src: I also miss the Steel Feather. I don't know what will happen to that place, or what has happened for that matter, but that place will always be my home.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.dst: Também sinto falta da Pluma de Aço. Não sei o que vai ser daquele lugar, ou o que já foi, mas aquele lugar sempre vai ser minha casa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#540.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#543.src: I'm just glad we managed to sort the situation.
Apotheosis (Quest)#543.dst: Só fico feliz que resolvemos a situação.
Apotheosis (Quest)#543.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#544.src: My electric charges almost ran out and I would have been useless without them.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.dst: Minhas cargas elétricas quase acabaram, e sem elas eu seria inútil.
Apotheosis (Quest)#544.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#545.src: Honestly, I'm ready to deal with the fall out of this revolution.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.dst: Sinceramente, estou pronto para lidar com o rescaldo da revolução.
Apotheosis (Quest)#545.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#546.src: I want to make a difference. I want to make sure the new Fruma is a good place. It will for sure take some time. But, I'm ready to spend the rest of my life bettering the province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.dst: Quero fazer a diferença. Quero garantir que a nova Fruma seja um bom lugar. Vai levar um tempo, com certeza. Mas estou pronto para passar o resto da vida melhorando a província.
Apotheosis (Quest)#546.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#547.src: I better be seeing you later.
Apotheosis (Quest)#547.dst: É bom eu te ver depois.
Apotheosis (Quest)#547.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#549.src: I intend to make up for my past mistakes. I don't think I told you this before but, the wall that separates the {p} from the Roughworks was designed by me during my university stay.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.dst: Pretendo compensar meus erros passados. Acho que não te contei, mas o muro que separa {p} de Roughworks foi projetado por mim nos tempos de universidade.
Apotheosis (Quest)#549.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#550.src: I thought- I thought I was protecting the people of the Roughworks from the dangers of the {p}. But in reality, all I did was separate the people.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.dst: Eu achava- achava que protegia o povo de Roughworks dos perigos de {p}. Mas, na verdade, só separei as pessoas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#550.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#551.src: Fruma needs all the help it can get once this is all over. Everyone will need to cooperate to save the province from destroying itself without a ruler.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.dst: Fruma vai precisar de toda ajuda possível quando isso acabar. Todos terão que cooperar para salvar a província de se destruir sem um governante.
Apotheosis (Quest)#551.speaker: Quill

Apotheosis (Quest)#554.src: I might hand the responsibilities for liberating Fruma to the young ones.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.dst: Talvez eu deixe a libertação de Fruma com os mais jovens.
Apotheosis (Quest)#554.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#555.src: I've lived long enough and honestly, retirement sounds rather nice.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.dst: Já vivi bastante e, sinceramente, me aposentar parece bem agradável.
Apotheosis (Quest)#555.speaker: Azael

Apotheosis (Quest)#561.src: She, um... she is. S-Sovereign Zhiraok, he, um, took her to a medic. And... went to try to get control of the army.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.dst: Ela, hã... está. O S-Soberano Zhiraok, ele, hã, a levou a um médico. E... foi tentar retomar o controle do exército.
Apotheosis (Quest)#561.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#562.src: ...I don't want to think about him. Or- or Soosu. I don't... like that everything's just- j-just okay now. Because of a common enemy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.dst: ...não quero pensar nele. Nem- nem na Soosu. Não... gosto que tudo esteja- e-esteja bem agora. Por causa de um inimigo comum.
Apotheosis (Quest)#562.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#563.src: So... later. I'll think about it later. After we're d-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.dst: Então... depois. Penso nisso depois. Quando tivermos t-
Apotheosis (Quest)#563.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#564.src: Sui!!! I- I- I heard about what you g...guys did!! You st- st- stopped the Queen!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.dst: Sui!!! E- e- eu soube o que v...vocês fizeram!! Vocês d- de- detiveram a Rainha!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#564.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#565.dst: ...é. A Rex e {u} detiveram. Eu... não.
Apotheosis (Quest)#565.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#566.src: What? Sui, you he- held back the lake's water from fl- fl- flooding the {p}!! If it wasnt for y...you, then-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.dst: Quê? Sui, você se- segurou a água do lago para não i- i- inundar {p}!! Se não fosse v...você, então-
Apotheosis (Quest)#566.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#567.src: It doesn't MATTER! While I was stuck h-holding back the flood, I- I couldn't help fight!! Again - AGAIN!!! - someone got hurt because I COULDN'T BE THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.dst: NÃO IMPORTA! Enquanto eu estava presa s-segurando a enchente, e- eu não pude lutar!! De novo - DE NOVO!!! - alguém se feriu porque EU NÃO PUDE ESTAR LÁ!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#567.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#568.src: Rex. She... she died, Zeph, I felt it. For a minute, I was holding her- her cold, LIFELESS BODY in my hands, and- a-and it was like I was there again. With... M-Mora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.dst: A Rex. Ela... ela morreu, Zeph, eu senti. Por um minuto, eu segurava o- o corpo frio, SEM VIDA dela nas mãos, e- e-e era como estar lá de novo. Com... o M-Mora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#568.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#569.src: ...I failed again. I told myself, if I was STRONGER, if I was BETTER, it WOULDN'T HAPPEN AGAIN!! And it DID!!! Even if she got better, even if she's not dead, it's still MY FAULT!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.dst: ...falhei de novo. Eu disse que, se fosse MAIS FORTE, se fosse MELHOR, NÃO ACONTECERIA DE NOVO!! E ACONTECEU!!! Mesmo que ela melhore, mesmo que não tenha morrido, a CULPA É MINHA!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#569.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#571.src: A- and if you were able to s...save Rex, but the dam broke... and all th- those people died instead... would that have been b- be- better?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.dst: E- e se você tivesse s...salvado a Rex, mas a represa rompesse... e t- todas aquelas pessoas morressem... teria sido m- me- melhor?
Apotheosis (Quest)#571.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#573.src: I've b...been thinking about it, ever since {u} t- told me... if- if I had been th- there, a- and not here, could I have st...stopped it...? A- an extra pair of eyes...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.dst: Venho p...pensando nisso desde que {u} m- me contou... se- se eu estivesse l- lá, e- e não aqui, eu teria i...impedido...? M- mais um par de olhos...
Apotheosis (Quest)#573.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#574.src: B- but I was here, instead, a- a- and because of that, I was able to m...make sure Yuman survived! If it were th- the other way around... I'd feel the same!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.dst: M- mas eu estava aqui, e- e- e por isso consegui g...garantir que o Yuman sobrevivesse! Se fosse a- ao contrário... eu sentiria o mesmo!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#574.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#576.src: She's still out there. Through that rift. We're going to kill her, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.dst: Ela ainda está lá fora. Atrás daquela fenda. Vamos matá-la, Zeph.
Apotheosis (Quest)#576.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#577.src: ...right now? Sui, are you s...sure? Controlling that much water, it mu- must have drained your mana... can you st...still fight?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.dst: ...agora? Sui, tem c...certeza? Controlar tanta água de- deve ter esgotado sua mana... ainda c...consegue lutar?
Apotheosis (Quest)#577.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#578.src: ...yes. I... it doesn't feel like I've used any magic at all. I, um, don't feel tired at all.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.dst: ...sim. Eu... parece que nem usei magia. Eu, hã, não estou nada cansada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#578.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#579.src: Ever since the {p}, the ocean's... grown. Or... no, that's wrong - it was always this big, I just... couldn't see it before.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.dst: Desde {p}, o oceano... cresceu. Ou... não, está errado - sempre foi deste tamanho, eu só... não o via antes.
Apotheosis (Quest)#579.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#580.src: It's... mana, but it's not mine. It's... all the strands, the threads, tied up in everything. And I can, um, use as much as I want.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.dst: É... mana, mas não é minha. São... todos os fios, as linhas, amarrados em tudo. E eu posso, hã, usar quanto quiser.
Apotheosis (Quest)#580.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#581.src: ...okay. So y- you- you're going now...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#581.dst: ...tá. Então v- vo- você vai agora...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#581.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#583.src: Th- then let me join you! Things are c...calmer here, now, so- so they should be fine w- with- without me!
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.dst: E- então me deixem ir junto! Aqui está mais c...calmo agora, então- então eles vão ficar bem s- sem- sem mim!
Apotheosis (Quest)#583.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#584.src: ...okay, Zeph. We could use the help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#584.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#586.src: I- I did it! I finally, finally, FINALLY did it!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.dst: E- eu consegui! Enfim, enfim, ENFIM consegui!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#586.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#588.src: The Resonance Weaver - I had theories before, workable theories, but I wasn't sure. But I am now!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.dst: O Tecelão de Ressonância - eu tinha teorias, teorias viáveis, mas não tinha certeza. Agora tenho!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#588.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#589.src: It was in the glyphs! They don't just call upon the five elements, they ARE the five elements! Like Soosu's writings about matter - building blocks of reality!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.dst: Estava nos glifos! Eles não só invocam os cinco elementos, eles SÃO os cinco elementos! Como os escritos da Soosu sobre a matéria - os tijolos da realidade!
Apotheosis (Quest)#589.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#590.src: The Weaver pulls on these strands - the physical makeup of our reality - and uses them to... well... do mostly anything.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.dst: O Tecelão puxa esses fios - a composição física da nossa realidade - e os usa para... bem... fazer quase qualquer coisa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#590.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#591.src: I used it before to make that... corruption visible. But with enough experimenting, you could do more than just visualizing it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.dst: Usei antes para tornar aquela... corrupção visível. Mas com testes o bastante, daria para fazer mais do que só visualizá-la.
Apotheosis (Quest)#591.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#592.src: Thread it into something else, or change the course of its flow, or... or even bind it to something physical!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.dst: Tecê-la em outra coisa, mudar o curso do fluxo, ou... ou até prendê-la a algo físico!
Apotheosis (Quest)#592.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#593.src: ...I didn't see her transform. What did it look like?
Apotheosis (Quest)#593.dst: ...não a vi se transformar. Como era?
Apotheosis (Quest)#593.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#594.src: S...so, what, that's how she b- became... human?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.dst: E...então, foi assim que ela v- virou... humana?
Apotheosis (Quest)#594.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#595.src: ...I don't really care. Yusanu, can it help with our... um, our rift problem?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.dst: ...pouco me importa. Yusanu, ele ajuda com o nosso... hã, problema da fenda?
Apotheosis (Quest)#595.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#596.src: Uh... maybe. To- to be clear, the Weaver is still... hard to use. If we had people more familiar with the glyphs... it could be very powerful. But we don't.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.dst: Hã... talvez. Pa- para ser claro, o Tecelão ainda é... difícil de usar. Se tivéssemos gente que conhecesse os glifos... seria muito poderoso. Mas não temos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#596.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#597.src: In theory... it should be able to close the rifts. Would just- ha, need to weave reality shut again. But... I don't know how.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.dst: Em teoria... deveria conseguir fechar as fendas. Só seria- ha, preciso tecer a realidade de volta. Mas... não sei como.
Apotheosis (Quest)#597.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#598.src: Um... S-Sovereign Soosu might know. She and- a-and Zhiraok are... no longer against us. F-for now, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.dst: Hã... a S-Soberana Soosu talvez saiba. Ela e- e-e o Zhiraok... não estão mais contra nós. P-por ora, ao menos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#598.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#599.src: ...got it. I'll see what I can do..
Apotheosis (Quest)#599.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#600.src: You're... heading in to deal with the source, aren't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#600.dst: Vocês... vão entrar para lidar com a origem, não é?
Apotheosis (Quest)#600.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#602.src: Then... good luck. Don't die. Be careful. We'll hold the fort while you're gone, until everything stabilizes, at least.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.dst: Então... boa sorte. Não morram. Cuidado. Seguramos as pontas enquanto estiverem fora, até tudo se estabilizar, pelo menos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#602.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#603.src: ...yeah. We should get going. See you when it's all over.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.dst: ...é. Devemos ir. Até quando tudo acabar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#603.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#604.src: Head to the Royal Palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#606.src: It's fine. My mana has never been stronger. You don't have to worry about me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.dst: Tudo bem. Minha mana nunca esteve tão forte. Não precisa se preocupar comigo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#606.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#608.src: Awful, empty, sad, enraged... Does that paint you a clear picture? But I can't afford that. Not, now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.dst: Péssima, vazia, triste, furiosa... Dá para ter uma ideia? Mas não posso me dar a esse luxo. Não, agora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#608.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#609.src: I... I still haven't given it much thought.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.dst: Eu... ainda não pensei muito nisso.
Apotheosis (Quest)#609.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#610.src: I'll think about it if- when we kill her for good.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.dst: Vou pensar nisso se- quando a matarmos de vez.
Apotheosis (Quest)#610.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#613.src: To be honest. If it weren't for your information about worlds beyond ours, I would never have figured it out. Besides, Sui taught me a lot about magic which helped...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.dst: Para ser sincero. Se não fossem suas informações sobre mundos além do nosso, eu nunca teria descoberto. Além disso, a Sui me ensinou muito sobre magia, o que ajudou...
Apotheosis (Quest)#613.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#614.src: At the end of the day, Soosu has taught me to... think outside of the box and I have gotten quite used to how she builds her inventions.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.dst: No fim das contas, a Soosu me ensinou a... pensar fora da caixa, e me acostumei bastante a como ela monta as invenções.
Apotheosis (Quest)#614.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#615.src: I haven't been able to test my theory on the use but I'm {~} certain it will work.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.dst: Não pude testar minha teoria de uso, mas tenho {~} de certeza de que vai funcionar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#615.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#616.src: I have a lot I want to do. I feel like a world of opportunity has opened for me. I want to travel the world, explore the other provinces and share research.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.dst: Tenho muito que quero fazer. Sinto que um mundo de oportunidades se abriu. Quero viajar pelo mundo, explorar as outras províncias e compartilhar pesquisas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#616.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#617.src: But more importantly, I heard from Quill that Soosu is alive. I think- I think she should join me on my travels. Once the aftermath has calmed down a bit.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.dst: Mas, mais importante, soube pelo Quill que a Soosu está viva. Acho- acho que ela devia vir comigo nas viagens. Quando o rescaldo se acalmar um pouco.
Apotheosis (Quest)#617.speaker: Yusanu

Apotheosis (Quest)#620.src: I've.. done what I can. Reached as many people as I could, with the time I had. The rest...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.dst: Eu.. fiz o que pude. Alcancei quantas pessoas consegui, no tempo que tive. O resto...
Apotheosis (Quest)#620.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#621.src: The gendarme won't listen to me... their commander's disappeared somewhere, and they won't tell me anything about it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.dst: Os gendarmes não me escutam... o comandante deles sumiu, e não me dizem nada a respeito.
Apotheosis (Quest)#621.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#622.src: ...I thought she understood me. I still think she did, but... it doesn't make up for this. Any of this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.dst: ...achei que ela me entendia. Ainda acho que sim, mas... isso não compensa isto. Nada disto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#622.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#623.src: The cracks are finally showing... I always knew they were there, I just. Told myself they weren't the end of the world. Ha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.dst: As rachaduras enfim aparecem... Sempre soube que estavam ali, só. Me dizia que não eram o fim do mundo. Ha.
Apotheosis (Quest)#623.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#624.src: ...it's strange. For all that I thought she understood me... maybe she never really did. How much of what she said was real? How much of it wasn't?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.dst: ...é estranho. Por mais que eu achasse que ela me entendia... talvez nunca tenha entendido. Quanto do que ela disse era real? Quanto não era?
Apotheosis (Quest)#624.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#625.src: The cracks had been showing for a while, I just... chose to push them aside. I didn't think I would make it out of this, so... why push back on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.dst: As rachaduras já apareciam há um tempo, eu só... escolhi ignorá-las. Não achei que sairia desta, então... por que resistir?
Apotheosis (Quest)#625.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#626.src: ...I still think her plan would have worked to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.dst: ...ainda acho que o plano dela teria evitado o fim do mundo. Ela tinha o método e os meios...
Apotheosis (Quest)#626.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#627.src: But it was never her priority. She was always focused on... this. Keeping Fruma perfect, and under her control.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.dst: Mas nunca foi a prioridade dela. Ela sempre esteve focada em... isto. Manter Fruma perfeita, e sob seu controle.
Apotheosis (Quest)#627.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#628.src: ...does any of this matter? I guess not. We've found ourselves here, either way. Nothing to do but... keep moving forward.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.dst: ...alguma coisa disso importa? Acho que não. Viemos parar aqui, de todo jeito. Não resta nada senão... seguir em frente.
Apotheosis (Quest)#628.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#629.src: YOU!!! {u}, what is HE doing here?! After he- he- he KILLED Rex, so why is he HERE?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.dst: VOCÊ!!! {u}, o que ELE faz aqui?! Ele- ele- ele MATOU a Rex, por que está AQUI?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#629.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#630.src: I should... I should kill you. You- you'd DESERVE it, for everything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.dst: Eu devia... eu devia matar você. Você- você MERECERIA, por tudo!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#630.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#632.src: ...maybe. Maybe I do. But I can't just leave my mistakes for other people to deal with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.dst: ...talvez. Talvez eu mereça. Mas não posso deixar meus erros para os outros resolverem.
Apotheosis (Quest)#632.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#633.src: I'm here to help with the Queen. I have to see it through, or... or I've made these mistakes for nothing.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.dst: Estou aqui para ajudar com a Rainha. Preciso ir até o fim, ou... ou terei cometido esses erros à toa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#633.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#634.src: ...right. Of course you want to help, what else would you do? Sigh. Everyone who hurts me, always... out of reach.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.dst: ...certo. Claro que quer ajudar, o que mais faria? Suspiro. Todos que me ferem, sempre... fora de alcance.
Apotheosis (Quest)#634.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#635.src: Fine. Fine. Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.dst: Tá. Tá. Até isto acabar... eu vou... ignorar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#635.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#636.src: I can't wait for this nightmare to be over...
Apotheosis (Quest)#636.dst: Não vejo a hora deste pesadelo acabar...
Apotheosis (Quest)#636.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#638.src: I don't want to hear it. I don't care what you have to say for yourself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.dst: Não quero ouvir. Não me importa o que tem a dizer em sua defesa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#638.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#641.src: {u}. I'm here, aren't I? Sigh... Look at it all. What a mess. The sky itself is cracked and broken!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.dst: {u}. Estou aqui, não estou? Suspiro... Olhe só. Que bagunça. O próprio céu está rachado e quebrado!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#641.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#642.src: Everything she said... it was true. She had a plan to stop the end of the world. She had the method and the means...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.dst: Tudo o que ela disse... era verdade. Ela tinha um plano para evitar o fim do mundo. Tinha o método e os meios...
Apotheosis (Quest)#642.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#643.src: But she was always focused on this, wasn't she? Fruma was her priority. Keeping it perfect and under her control...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.dst: Mas ela sempre esteve focada nisto, não é? Fruma era a prioridade dela. Mantê-la perfeita e sob seu controle...
Apotheosis (Quest)#643.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#644.src: Maybe I should have seen it. Maybe I did. But it doesn't matter, does it? We've found ourselves here and now either way.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.dst: Talvez eu devesse ter visto. Talvez tenha visto. Mas não importa, não é? Viemos parar aqui e agora de todo jeito.
Apotheosis (Quest)#644.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#648.src: ...I would, wouldn't I? But there are bigger things to worry about right now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.dst: ...mereceria, não é? Mas há coisas maiores com que se preocupar agora.
Apotheosis (Quest)#648.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#649.src: You're going after the Queen, right? I want to help.
Apotheosis (Quest)#649.dst: Vocês vão atrás da Rainha, certo? Quero ajudar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#649.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#650.src: Help. You want to... fine. Fine!! Of course you get to just... turn around and be good now. Of course...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.dst: Ajudar. Você quer... tá. Tá!! Claro que você pode só... dar meia-volta e ser bom agora. Claro...
Apotheosis (Quest)#650.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#651.src: It's fine. It's fine! Until this is done... I'll... ignore it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.dst: Tudo bem. Tudo bem! Até isto acabar... eu vou... ignorar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#651.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#653.src: ...I just want to make things right.
Apotheosis (Quest)#653.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#654.src: Well... you CAN'T!! Her arm is gone, FOREVER, and it's YOUR fault. She would have been DEAD, if it weren't for- f-for Zhiraok!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.dst: Bom... NÃO DÁ!! O braço dela se foi, PARA SEMPRE, e a culpa é SUA. Ela estaria MORTA, se não fosse- f-fosse o Zhiraok!
Apotheosis (Quest)#654.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#655.src: So... so I don't care. If you're going to help with the Queen... fine. But I don't want to see you ever again after we're done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.dst: Então... então não me importa. Se vai ajudar com a Rainha... tá. Mas não quero te ver nunca mais depois que acabarmos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#655.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#658.src: I've been thinking. About all of it. After everything that's happened, everything she's done - everything I've done - it wouldn't be right to turn away.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.dst: Andei pensando. Em tudo. Depois de tudo o que houve, tudo o que ela fez - tudo o que eu fiz - não seria certo dar as costas.
Apotheosis (Quest)#658.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#659.src: It's all broken, breaking... and maybe it always was. And this is just the truth finally being visible.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.dst: Está tudo quebrado, quebrando... e talvez sempre esteve. E isto é só a verdade enfim aparecendo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#659.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#660.src: ...I just wanted to do something about it all. About the realms... but also about Fruma. But... I was never going to make any real change, was I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.dst: ...eu só queria fazer algo a respeito de tudo. Dos reinos... mas também de Fruma. Mas... eu nunca ia fazer mudança real nenhuma, ia?
Apotheosis (Quest)#660.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#661.src: I'll help you take her down. It's only right. After that... I don't know.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.dst: Vou ajudar vocês a derrubá-la. É o certo. Depois disso... não sei.
Apotheosis (Quest)#661.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#665.src: W-well? What do you have to say for yourself?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#665.dst: E-e então? O que tem a dizer em sua defesa?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#665.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#670.src: ...I can't. I... I can't do it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#670.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#671.src: After everything... after EVERYTHING, I get a CHANCE to- to- to get back at s-someone who's hurt me, and- and- a-and I CAN'T DO IT?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.dst: Depois de tudo... depois de TUDO, tenho a CHANCE de- de- de me vingar de a-alguém que me feriu, e- e- e-e NÃO CONSIGO?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#671.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#672.src: ...whatever. WHATEVER!! Let's just go deal with the STUPID Queen!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.dst: ...que seja. QUE SEJA!! Vamos logo cuidar da Rainha IDIOTA!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#672.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#681.src: How is- is this going to go?
Apotheosis (Quest)#681.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#683.src: And so, the cards fall. The shards collapse as decisions are made and paths are chosen. What a destructive end it has turned out to be.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.dst: E assim caem as cartas. Os fragmentos desabam enquanto decisões são tomadas e caminhos, escolhidos. Que fim destrutivo acabou sendo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#683.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#684.src: In retrospect, it seems an inevitability... each decision branching out from the last. What was the weight that sent it over the edge? The tournament? The selection?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.dst: Em retrospecto, parece inevitável... cada decisão brotando da anterior. Que peso a levou ao limite? O torneio? A seleção?
Apotheosis (Quest)#684.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#685.src: Would you have been the better choice? No. Having seen now what I have, I am only more certain. But perhaps it could have saved us all this mess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.dst: Você teria sido a melhor escolha? Não. Depois do que vi, tenho ainda mais certeza. Mas talvez isso nos poupasse de toda esta confusão.
Apotheosis (Quest)#685.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#686.src: Oh, Anathema... what a mess you've left in your wake...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.dst: Ah, Anathema... que bagunça você deixou para trás...
Apotheosis (Quest)#686.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#687.src: You will face no resistance from me. I do not have a death wish.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.dst: Vocês não terão resistência da minha parte. Não desejo morrer.
Apotheosis (Quest)#687.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#688.src: So go on, fellow Scion. Put an end to this.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.dst: Vá em frente, Descendente. Acabe com isto.
Apotheosis (Quest)#688.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#690.src: Sovereign, then? Deny it all you like, but you chose to take on that role.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.dst: Soberano, então? Negue o quanto quiser, mas você escolheu esse papel.
Apotheosis (Quest)#690.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#691.src: As with each of us, that mark remains. It cannot be so easily discarded. It cannot be forgotten.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.dst: Como em cada um de nós, essa marca permanece. Não se descarta tão fácil. Não se esquece.
Apotheosis (Quest)#691.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#692.src: Her power gifted, drawn through the mark... and she has given much away in pursuit of this freedom, hasn't she...
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.dst: O poder dela, concedido, extraído pela marca... e ela abriu mão de muito em busca dessa liberdade, não é...
Apotheosis (Quest)#692.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#693.src: How much of it remains now, I wonder? Enough to guarantee her victory? Or, perhaps... little enough to grant you a chance of success...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.dst: Quanto resta agora, me pergunto? O bastante para garantir a vitória dela? Ou, talvez... pouco o bastante para lhes dar uma chance...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#693.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#694.src: Hm! I cannot say for certain. Of all things, this variable yet eludes me. The shards are inconclusive - equally favourable and not.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.dst: Hm! Não posso dizer ao certo. De tudo, só essa variável ainda me escapa. Os fragmentos são inconclusivos - favoráveis e não.
Apotheosis (Quest)#694.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#695.src: But you... an unexpected variable, though not unwelcome. A naturally-born manaweaver! I thought I'd never see the day.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.dst: Mas você... uma variável inesperada, mas bem-vinda. Uma tecelã de mana nata! Pensei que nunca veria o dia.
Apotheosis (Quest)#695.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#697.src: ...naturally, you do not know the gift you possess. That knowledge was lost with the old world, after all. Will you grow into that power? Or will you allow it to consume you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.dst: ...naturalmente, você não conhece o dom que possui. Esse saber se perdeu com o velho mundo, afinal. Vai crescer até esse poder? Ou vai deixar que ele a consuma?
Apotheosis (Quest)#697.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#699.src: And you. Do you remember what I asked you? If not Her, then who?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.dst: E você. Lembra o que lhe perguntei? Se não Ela, então quem?
Apotheosis (Quest)#699.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#701.src: From here, there are no easy paths - your decisions have buried all of those. For Fruma, for the world... each step towards a better future will be a bitter, hard-fought victory.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.dst: Daqui não há caminhos fáceis - suas decisões enterraram todos. Por Fruma, pelo mundo... cada passo rumo a um futuro melhor será uma vitória amarga e suada.
Apotheosis (Quest)#701.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#702.src: But perhaps it will prove worthwhile, after all! You've surprised me once already - who's to say you won't do it again? An uncertain future... what an exciting prospect.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.dst: Mas talvez valha a pena, afinal! Você já me surpreendeu uma vez - quem diz que não fará de novo? Um futuro incerto... que perspectiva empolgante.
Apotheosis (Quest)#702.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#703.src: I hope to see you all once more, somewhere down this winding road of ours.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.dst: Espero rever todos vocês em algum ponto desta nossa estrada sinuosa.
Apotheosis (Quest)#703.speaker: Sovereign Two

Apotheosis (Quest)#706.src: I'm... I don't know. Saying goodbye, I guess.
Apotheosis (Quest)#706.dst: Estou... não sei. Me despedindo, acho.
Apotheosis (Quest)#706.speaker: Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#708.src: I should... get going. I'll, uh... see you around.
Apotheosis (Quest)#708.dst: Eu devia... ir andando. Eu, hã... a gente se vê.
Apotheosis (Quest)#708.speaker: Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#709.src: A strained tension lingers in the air as you enter {p}. In the absence of its citizens, the city square feels... empty, off.
Apotheosis (Quest)#709.dst: Uma tensão pesada paira no ar quando você entra em {p}. Sem seus cidadãos, a praça da cidade parece... vazia, estranha.

Apotheosis (Quest)#710.src: The city streets are crawling with guards and soldiers, all searching for something... or, someone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#710.dst: As ruas da cidade estão infestadas de guardas e soldados, todos procurando algo... ou alguém.

Apotheosis (Quest)#711.src: You need to find your friends, before the guards find them first.
Apotheosis (Quest)#711.dst: Você precisa achar seus amigos antes que os guardas os achem.

Apotheosis (Quest)#712.src: Well, I don't imagine you'll have the chance. NOW - SHINING STAR'S SPOTLIGHT!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#712.dst: Bem, acho que você não terá a chance. AGORA - HOLOFOTE DA ESTRELA RADIANTE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#712.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#713.src: ...it's too late to turn back now. After everything...
Apotheosis (Quest)#713.dst: ...é tarde demais para voltar atrás. Depois de tudo...
Apotheosis (Quest)#713.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#714.src: She holds the means to save the world. So, no matter what she does...
Apotheosis (Quest)#714.dst: Ela tem os meios de salvar o mundo. Então, faça ela o que fizer...
Apotheosis (Quest)#714.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#715.src: ...she's the only option. And if you stand against her, then you stand against the world.
Apotheosis (Quest)#715.dst: ...ela é a única opção. E se você ficar contra ela, fica contra o mundo.
Apotheosis (Quest)#715.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#716.src: One final satisfaction! Before all comes crashing down. I will enjoy it, the sounds of bones cracking, of flesh burning, of...-!
Apotheosis (Quest)#716.dst: Uma última satisfação! Antes que tudo desabe. Vou saboreá-la, o som de ossos estalando, de carne queimando, de...-!
Apotheosis (Quest)#716.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#717.src: This... this will be difficult to bury. But not impossible. Never impossible. Given... enough... time...
Apotheosis (Quest)#717.dst: Isto... isto será difícil de enterrar. Mas não impossível. Nunca impossível. Com... bastante... tempo...
Apotheosis (Quest)#717.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#719.src: She's... dying. There's nothing you can do for her.
Apotheosis (Quest)#719.dst: Ela está... morrendo. Você não pode fazer nada.

Apotheosis (Quest)#720.src: CRACK! The stone beneath your feet shakes and cracks and crumbles as the dam's foundation begins to collapse.
Apotheosis (Quest)#720.dst: CRACK! A pedra sob seus pés treme, racha e se desfaz enquanto a fundação da represa começa a ruir.

Apotheosis (Quest)#721.src: And the dam splits in two.

Apotheosis (Quest)#722.src: The crashing of otherworldly thunder in the distance, the creaking and cracking of the dam's foundations breaking apart...
Apotheosis (Quest)#722.dst: O estrondo de um trovão sobrenatural ao longe, o ranger e estalar das fundações da represa se partindo...

Apotheosis (Quest)#723.src: All of it - all of the noise, the chaos... it all stills, for a moment. Drowned out by the overwhelming, oppressive silence between the two of you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#723.dst: Tudo isso - todo o barulho, o caos... tudo para, por um momento. Abafado pelo silêncio esmagador e opressivo entre vocês dois.

Apotheosis (Quest)#724.src: There is nothing to say. There is nothing you can say, in this moment.
Apotheosis (Quest)#724.dst: Não há nada a dizer. Não há nada que você possa dizer, neste momento.

Apotheosis (Quest)#725.src: You will not kill him. You will not offer him this easy way out. The choice is his.
Apotheosis (Quest)#725.dst: Você não vai matá-lo. Não vai lhe dar essa saída fácil. A escolha é dele.

Apotheosis (Quest)#726.src: ...before either of you can do anything, the silence s h a t t e r s. The noise, the chaos, the destruction - all of it rushes back in to fill the space it once held.
Apotheosis (Quest)#726.dst: ...antes que um de vocês faça algo, o silêncio s e   r o m p e. O barulho, o caos, a destruição - tudo volta de uma vez a preencher o espaço que ocupava.

Apotheosis (Quest)#727.src: ...it's fine. He'll be fine. I... know what to do...
Apotheosis (Quest)#727.dst: ...calma. Ele ficará bem. Eu... sei o que fazer...
Apotheosis (Quest)#727.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#729.src: Off in the distance, you hear shouts, screams. The clashing of steel rings out. The citadel is in chaos.
Apotheosis (Quest)#729.dst: Ao longe, você ouve gritos, berros. O choque do aço ressoa. A cidadela está um caos.

Apotheosis (Quest)#730.src: The sky above is cracked and broken. A tear in the world itself, a hole punched through reality over the Queen's royal palace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#730.dst: O céu acima está rachado e partido. Um rasgo no próprio mundo, um buraco aberto na realidade sobre o palácio real da Rainha.

Apotheosis (Quest)#731.src: You need to regroup with your allies. But you also need to save your strength. Fight through the citadel, and avoid areas crawling with soldiers.
Apotheosis (Quest)#731.dst: Você precisa se reunir aos aliados. Mas também poupar forças. Abra caminho pela cidadela e evite áreas cheias de soldados.

Apotheosis (Quest)#732.src: This road is heavily guarded. Best to avoid it for now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#732.dst: Esta estrada está bem vigiada. Melhor evitá-la agora.

Apotheosis (Quest)#733.src: You tell the captains about your fight at the dam. About the Queen's threat to flood the {p}, how you and Rex and Sui stopped it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#733.dst: Você conta aos capitães da luta na represa. Da ameaça da Rainha de inundar {p}, e como você, Rex e Sui a impediram.

Apotheosis (Quest)#734.src: You tell them about the Queen's transformation into her monstrous true form. About the rifts that opened up around her as her shell broke apart.
Apotheosis (Quest)#734.dst: Você conta da transformação da Rainha em sua monstruosa forma real. Das fendas que se abriram em volta dela quando a casca se partiu.

Apotheosis (Quest)#735.src: You point to the palace. You tell them that is where she fled to. That is where she is now.
Apotheosis (Quest)#735.dst: Você aponta para o palácio. Diz que foi para lá que ela fugiu. Que é lá que ela está agora.

Apotheosis (Quest)#736.src: You tell them about fighting Tasim. And then the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#736.dst: Você conta da luta com Tasim. E depois com a Rainha.

Apotheosis (Quest)#737.src: You tell them about the aftermath - the Queen's transformation, the rifts opening.
Apotheosis (Quest)#737.dst: Você conta o que veio depois - a transformação da Rainha, as fendas se abrindo.

Apotheosis (Quest)#738.src: You tell them about how the dam broke, about how Sui singlehandedly kept the water from flooding the {p}.
Apotheosis (Quest)#738.dst: Você conta como a represa se rompeu, como Sui sozinha impediu a água de inundar {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#739.src: You... tell them about Rex. About how she saved you, about how she lost her arm, about how she... died.
Apotheosis (Quest)#739.dst: Você... conta sobre Rex. Como ela te salvou, como perdeu o braço, como ela... morreu.

Apotheosis (Quest)#740.src: Fractured shards of porcelain stone. Seeping red chaos flowing from the cracks in the shell.
Apotheosis (Quest)#740.dst: Cacos partidos de pedra de porcelana. Um caos vermelho escorrendo pelas rachaduras da casca.

Apotheosis (Quest)#741.src: Hahahaha... HAHAHAHAHAHAAAA!!!! You?! YOU truly believe you can kill ME?!?! No... no no no no NO, YOU WILL NOT!!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#741.dst: Hahahaha... HAHAHAHAHAHAAAA!!!! Você?! VOCÊ acha que pode ME matar?!?! Não... não não não não NÃO, NÃO VAI!!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#741.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#742.src: I will draw more... and more, and more and more AND MORE POWER!!! I WILL TAKE ALL IT CAN OFFER ME, AND MORE!!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#742.dst: Vou extrair mais... e mais, e mais e mais E MAIS PODER!!! VOU TOMAR TUDO O QUE ELE PUDER ME DAR, E MAIS!!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#742.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#743.src: The COSMOS bends to my will!! The STARS, the INDESCRIBABLY COUNTLESS STARS!!! THE STARS AND THE INKY VOID BETWEEN, THEY WILL STRIKE YOU DOWN!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#743.dst: O COSMOS cede à minha vontade!! As ESTRELAS, as INDESCRITÍVEIS E INCONTÁVEIS ESTRELAS!!! AS ESTRELAS E O NEGRO VAZIO ENTRE ELAS TE ABATERÃO!!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#743.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#745.src: This... this feeling... is this how it feels, to float amongst the shining stars? A rush - of feeling, of emotion, of power - it is all... so... so...
Apotheosis (Quest)#745.dst: Esta... esta sensação... é assim flutuar entre as estrelas brilhantes? Um ímpeto - de sensação, de emoção, de poder - é tudo... tão... tão...
Apotheosis (Quest)#745.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#746.src: Have I done it? Have I reached the pinnacle? All I have ever strived for, to be above, to be greater still... it is here. I have seen it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#746.dst: Eu consegui? Alcancei o ápice? Tudo pelo que sempre lutei, estar acima, ser ainda maior... está aqui. Eu vi.
Apotheosis (Quest)#746.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#747.src: Hahahahaha!!! AHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!!!! OH, THE JOY! THE INCOMPARABLE JOY!!! NONE COULD EVER DARE TO STAND AGAINST ME NOW!!! I HAVE BECOME-
Apotheosis (Quest)#747.dst: Hahahahaha!!! AHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!!!! OH, A ALEGRIA! A ALEGRIA INCOMPARÁVEL!!! NINGUÉM OUSARIA ME ENFRENTAR AGORA!!! EU ME TORNEI-
Apotheosis (Quest)#747.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#748.src: Oh, yeah?! Then I guess we'll just have to get through you and her!
Apotheosis (Quest)#748.dst: Ah, é?! Então vamos ter que passar por você e por ela!
Apotheosis (Quest)#748.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#749.src: ...don't throw your life away for this. I don't want to have to kill you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#749.dst: ...não jogue sua vida fora por isso. Não quero ter que te matar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#749.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#750.src: And let you kill thousands?! Yeah, right.
Apotheosis (Quest)#750.dst: Deixar vocês matarem milhares?! Tá, sei.
Apotheosis (Quest)#750.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#751.src: Sigh. Don't say I didn't warn you. You've made your stand - now let me make mine!
Apotheosis (Quest)#751.dst: Suspiro. Não diga que não avisei. Você escolheu seu lado - agora é minha vez!
Apotheosis (Quest)#751.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#752.src: Oh, get over yourself. You've made these mistakes, and that's it, now you're done? Really?
Apotheosis (Quest)#752.dst: Ah, para com isso. Você cometeu esses erros, e pronto, acabou? Sério?
Apotheosis (Quest)#752.speaker: Player

Apotheosis (Quest)#753.src: You've labeled yourself the villain, and for what? So you can avoid dealing with the consequences?
Apotheosis (Quest)#753.dst: Você se rotulou de vilão, e para quê? Para não ter que encarar as consequências?
Apotheosis (Quest)#753.speaker: Player

Apotheosis (Quest)#754.src: ...before either of you can say anything else, the strained moment between the two of you s h a t t e r s.
Apotheosis (Quest)#754.dst: ...antes que um de vocês diga mais algo, o momento tenso entre vocês dois s e   r o m p e.

Apotheosis (Quest)#755.src: ...it's fine. He'll be fine. I know what to do.
Apotheosis (Quest)#755.dst: ...calma. Ele ficará bem. Eu sei o que fazer.
Apotheosis (Quest)#755.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#756.src: He doesn't seem sure how to react. Conflicting emotions cross his face...but it settles on a familiar determination as he holds his hand out towards the charm.
Apotheosis (Quest)#756.dst: Ele não sabe bem como reagir. Emoções conflitantes cruzam seu rosto... mas se firmam numa determinação familiar ao estender a mão para o amuleto.

Apotheosis (Quest)#757.src: It's... buzzing with magic. If you focus, you can just barely make out the different sources. An energizing glow, a feeling of soil and steel, and a raging, swirling ocean.
Apotheosis (Quest)#757.dst: Está... vibrando de magia. Se você se concentrar, mal consegue distinguir as fontes. Um brilho revigorante, uma sensação de terra e aço, e um oceano furioso e revolto.

Apotheosis (Quest)#758.src: You tighten your grip on the weapon in your hand. You concentrate on the points of contact, the feel of it pressing against your skin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#758.dst: Você aperta a arma em sua mão. Concentra-se nos pontos de contato, na sensação dela contra a pele.

Apotheosis (Quest)#759.src: Through the weapon, you feel the singing hum of magic in the air around you. A sensation like warmth, like rain, like soil, like wind, like static... it is familiar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#759.dst: Pela arma, você sente o zumbido cantante da magia no ar à sua volta. Uma sensação como calor, como chuva, como terra, como vento, como estática... é familiar.

Apotheosis (Quest)#760.src: Your focus draws inwards, pulling the hum with it. Towards the center of your body, your self, your soul. Flowing within, a rushing river - of magic, of mana, familiar. You know it well.
Apotheosis (Quest)#760.dst: Seu foco se volta para dentro, levando o zumbido. Para o centro do seu corpo, do seu ser, da sua alma. Lá dentro, um rio caudaloso - de magia, de mana, familiar. Você o conhece bem.

Apotheosis (Quest)#761.src: Points of contact - your grip on your weapon, and the charm in your other hand. You push the mana outwards, divert the river's course, and watch it flow out into the charm.
Apotheosis (Quest)#761.dst: Pontos de contato - sua mão na arma e o amuleto na outra. Você empurra a mana para fora, desvia o curso do rio e a vê fluir para o amuleto.

Apotheosis (Quest)#762.src: And just like that, the hum fades, and the river returns to its natural course. The revival charm is charged.
Apotheosis (Quest)#762.dst: E, simples assim, o zumbido some e o rio volta ao curso natural. O amuleto de ressurreição está carregado.

Apotheosis (Quest)#763.src: Holding it, the sensation is unlike anything you have ever felt before. Energizing glow, soil and steel, raging ocean, and... you. A catalyst. A hum in the air.
Apotheosis (Quest)#763.dst: Ao segurá-lo, a sensação não se parece com nada que já sentiu. Brilho revigorante, terra e aço, oceano furioso, e... você. Um catalisador. Um zumbido no ar.

Apotheosis (Quest)#764.src: But I'm... still here, aren't I? So... I guess I have to keep going, after all...
Apotheosis (Quest)#764.dst: Mas eu... ainda estou aqui, né? Então... acho que tenho que seguir, afinal...
Apotheosis (Quest)#764.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#765.src: Then... we need to clean up this mess, don't we...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#765.dst: Então... precisamos limpar essa bagunça, não é...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#765.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#766.src: ...I'll meet you by the palace. I just... need some time to think.
Apotheosis (Quest)#766.dst: ...nos vemos no palácio. Só... preciso de um tempo pra pensar.
Apotheosis (Quest)#766.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#767.src: You tell them about Zhiraok and Soosu arriving on the scene, about Soosu fixing up the dam.
Apotheosis (Quest)#767.dst: Você conta da chegada de Zhiraok e Soosu, e de como Soosu consertou a represa.

Apotheosis (Quest)#768.src: You tell them about Zhiraok, using his revival charm to save her. About the cost of doing so.
Apotheosis (Quest)#768.dst: Você conta de Zhiraok, que usou o amuleto de ressurreição para salvá-la. E do preço disso.

Apotheosis (Quest)#769.src: We stopped her. But she destroyed the dam in the process. Luckily, Sui, with the help of Soosu, managed to stop the water from reaching Auburn. However, Her Majesty escaped into her realm.
Apotheosis (Quest)#769.dst: Nós a detivemos. Mas ela destruiu a represa no processo. Por sorte, Sui, com a ajuda de Soosu, impediu a água de chegar a Auburn. Mas Sua Majestade fugiu para o reino dela.
Apotheosis (Quest)#769.speaker: Player

Arachnids' Ascent#000.src: Best route to the den's through that road with the burn marks. 'sends ya straight to the cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#000.dst: Melhor rota pro covil é pela estrada com marcas de queimado. Te leva direto pro capitão!

Arachnids' Ascent#001.src: So, you've taken out their queen! Well done, soldier. I'll have to let the nearby village know.
Arachnids' Ascent#001.dst: Então você matou a rainha delas! Muito bem, soldado. Vou avisar a vila aqui perto.

Arachnids' Ascent#002.src: Hm... ah, {u}! There you are. I was just about to send someone to fetch you.
Arachnids' Ascent#002.dst: Hm... ah, {u}! Aí está você. Eu ia mandar alguém te buscar.
Arachnids' Ascent#002.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#003.src: Our preparations are complete, and it's time for the assault on the spider den! With you here, we'll just need to wait for-...
Arachnids' Ascent#003.dst: Os preparativos estão prontos, e é hora do ataque ao covil das aranhas! Com você aqui, só falta esperar por-...
Arachnids' Ascent#003.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#004.src: If {u} is here, I take it that means today's the day we strike at the spiders?
Arachnids' Ascent#004.dst: Se {u} está aqui, quer dizer que hoje atacamos as aranhas?
Arachnids' Ascent#004.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#005.src: 'course, the roots ain't an option. Lucky this ol' corrupted spring chose to pop up out here, eh? Scientific mystery, it is- but none o' that's our concern.
Arachnids' Ascent#005.dst: Claro, as raízes não são opção. Sorte que essa velha fonte corrompida brotou aqui, né? Mistério científico, isso sim- mas nada disso é da nossa conta.

Arachnids' Ascent#007.src: Ah, good! You can see the pickle we're in, hmm? We've tried everything to get these poor souls out, but the damnned web is like glue!
Arachnids' Ascent#007.dst: Ah, ótimo! Veem a enrascada em que estamos, hein? Tentamos de tudo pra soltar essas pobres almas, mas a maldita teia é como cola!
Arachnids' Ascent#007.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#008.src: Cob filled you in on my reasoning, yes? We need to get through these webs somehow... and, well, this seemed simpler than the other option.
Arachnids' Ascent#008.dst: Cob explicou meu raciocínio, né? Precisamos passar por essas teias de algum jeito... e, bem, isso parecia mais simples que a outra opção.

Arachnids' Ascent#010.src: So what do we do now? You mentioned another option- what was that about? What about it made it difficult?
Arachnids' Ascent#010.dst: E agora, o que fazemos? Você falou de outra opção- qual era? O que a tornava difícil?
Arachnids' Ascent#010.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#011.src: Then what's the catch? You would have tried this first if it were that simple.
Arachnids' Ascent#011.dst: Então qual é o porém? Você teria tentado isso antes se fosse tão simples.
Arachnids' Ascent#011.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#012.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have been met with extreme hostility.
Arachnids' Ascent#012.dst: A montanha está infestada de aranhas, mais ainda que {p}. Nossas poucas tentativas de explorá-la enfrentaram hostilidade extrema.

Arachnids' Ascent#013.src: You've been rocketed by the great web.
Arachnids' Ascent#013.dst: Você foi lançado pela grande teia.

Arachnids' Ascent#014.src: Well, here we are! ...The heat's gotten more intense up here. Come on, let's find what we're looking for, before I over-
Arachnids' Ascent#014.dst: Bem, chegamos! ...O calor ficou mais forte aqui em cima. Vamos achar o que procuramos antes que eu desma-
Arachnids' Ascent#014.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#018.src: You've returned! I trust you found something that can help us get through these webs?
Arachnids' Ascent#018.dst: Vocês voltaram! Imagino que acharam algo que nos ajude a passar por essas teias?
Arachnids' Ascent#018.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#019.src: Talk to Admiral Aegis in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#019.dst: Fale com o almirante Aegis no quartel de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#020.src: Follow me- we have a conversation to have in my office. It's on the top floor of the barracks.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.dst: Me siga- temos que conversar na minha sala. Fica no último andar do quartel.
Arachnids' Ascent#020.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#021.src: ...ahem. Now that we're here, we can discuss the matter of {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#021.dst: ...ahem. Agora que estamos aqui, podemos tratar de {p}.
Arachnids' Ascent#021.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#022.src: Admiral- we're here! Sorry we're late, we were sparring in the training room and lost track of time...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.dst: Almirante- chegamos! Desculpe o atraso, estávamos treinando na sala de treino e perdemos a hora...
Arachnids' Ascent#022.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#023.src: Indeed it is. Now, you three are to be the force which will fight through their den and clear out as many of those spiders as you can. For that, you'll need support.
Arachnids' Ascent#023.dst: Exato. Vocês três serão a força que vai atravessar o covil e eliminar o máximo de aranhas possível. Para isso, precisarão de apoio.
Arachnids' Ascent#023.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#024.src: We've sent out several soldiers ahead of time to make preparations on site. You'll want to first speak to Private Cob on the {p}, who will have supplies for you.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.dst: Enviamos vários soldados na frente para preparar o local. Primeiro falem com o soldado Cob em {p}, que terá suprimentos para vocês.
Arachnids' Ascent#024.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#025.src: I expect this mission will hold some danger, but I trust the three of you will be able to deal with anything you come across. Good luck, soldiers!
Arachnids' Ascent#025.dst: Esta missão deve ter seus perigos, mas confio que vocês três darão conta do que encontrarem. Boa sorte, soldados!
Arachnids' Ascent#025.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Arachnids' Ascent#026.src: Yes, sir. We'll do our best.
Arachnids' Ascent#026.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#027.src: These spiders won't stand a chance! Let's get going.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.dst: Essas aranhas não têm chance! Vamos nessa.
Arachnids' Ascent#027.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#028.src: Speak to Private Cob in the Savannah at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to receive supplies.
Arachnids' Ascent#028.dst: Fale com o soldado Cob na savana em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para receber suprimentos.

Arachnids' Ascent#029.src: 'ey there, chaps! You lot must be the spider killin' force, eh?
Arachnids' Ascent#029.dst: Opa, rapaziada! Cês devem ser a tropa mata-aranha, né?
Arachnids' Ascent#029.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#030.src: That's us! The Admiral told us you had supplies to give us?
Arachnids' Ascent#030.dst: Somos! O almirante disse que você tem suprimentos pra nós?
Arachnids' Ascent#030.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#031.src: That I do! Now, 'fore I send ya off, there's been sum news from the Cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#031.dst: Tenho sim! Mas antes de mandar cês embora, tem novidade do capitão!
Arachnids' Ascent#031.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#032.src: Buncha terrorised citizens been found right next to the bloomin' den! Trapped in a sticky old web, they were.
Arachnids' Ascent#032.dst: Acharam um monte de cidadão apavorado bem do lado do bendito covil! Presos numa teia grudenta, tavam.
Arachnids' Ascent#032.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#033.src: Priority number one is gettin' them out, before takin' on the den. But nothin' can get through the web!
Arachnids' Ascent#033.dst: Prioridade número um é tirar eles de lá antes de atacar o covil. Mas nada passa pela teia!
Arachnids' Ascent#033.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#034.src: No fire, no magic... nothin' has broken through. The cap'n decided- 'ey, why not try some lava? 's hotter than fire, anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#034.dst: Nem fogo, nem magia... nada rompeu. Aí o capitão decidiu- ei, por que não tentar lava? É mais quente que fogo, né?
Arachnids' Ascent#034.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#035.src: Point is. Along with all your supplies 'n whatnot, ya've gotta bring along some lava for the cap'n. Magically contained, o' course!
Arachnids' Ascent#035.dst: Enfim. Junto com os suprimentos e tal, cês têm que levar lava pro capitão. Contida com magia, claro!
Arachnids' Ascent#035.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#036.src: Sure, that sounds easy enough. A bit of extra work, but we were heading in that direction anyway.
Arachnids' Ascent#036.dst: Claro, parece bem fácil. Um pouco de trabalho extra, mas íamos pra lá mesmo.
Arachnids' Ascent#036.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#037.src: That's the spirit! If ya want the best route to the den, follow that road with the burn marks. It'll send ya straight to the cap'n!
Arachnids' Ascent#037.dst: Esse é o espírito! O melhor caminho pro covil é seguir a estrada com marcas de queimado. Vai levar cês direto pro capitão!
Arachnids' Ascent#037.speaker: Private Cob

Arachnids' Ascent#038.src: Bring the supplies to Captain Enduyn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#038.dst: Leve os suprimentos ao capitão Enduyn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#039.src: At ease, soldiers! You're the three Aegis told me to look out for, aren't you? Have you spoken to Cob yet?
Arachnids' Ascent#039.dst: Descansar, soldados! Vocês são os três que Aegis mandou eu esperar, não são? Já falaram com Cob?
Arachnids' Ascent#039.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#040.src: We have, and we've brought supplies. As well as... lava, I think?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.dst: Falamos, e trouxemos suprimentos. E também... lava, acho?
Arachnids' Ascent#040.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#041.src: Now, let's see here... If I cast a spell on it like this, then...
Arachnids' Ascent#041.dst: Vejamos... Se eu lançar um feitiço nela assim, então...
Arachnids' Ascent#041.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#042.src: Right. You may have noticed on your way here, but the nest is at the base of {p}, a dormant volcano.
Arachnids' Ascent#042.dst: Certo. Talvez tenham notado no caminho, mas o ninho fica no sopé de {p}, um vulcão adormecido.
Arachnids' Ascent#042.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#043.src: Legends speak of incredible magic granted by the mountain- that of protection, incinerating any who dare go against it.
Arachnids' Ascent#043.dst: As lendas falam de uma magia incrível dada pela montanha- de proteção, incinerando quem ousar desafiá-la.
Arachnids' Ascent#043.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#044.src: These are only stories, of course. It's very unlikely the mountain actually could grant such magic. However... there may be some truth in the legend.
Arachnids' Ascent#044.dst: São só histórias, claro. É bem improvável que a montanha conceda tal magia. Mas... pode haver alguma verdade na lenda.
Arachnids' Ascent#044.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#045.src: The mountain is infested with spiders, even more so than {p}. Our few attempts at scouting it out have shown they're incredibly hostile towards intruders.
Arachnids' Ascent#045.dst: A montanha está infestada de aranhas, mais ainda que {p}. Nossas poucas tentativas de explorá-la mostraram que são muito hostis com intrusos.
Arachnids' Ascent#045.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#046.src: As though they're protecting something, I assume?
Arachnids' Ascent#046.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#047.src: Indeed. So, here's the plan... If you enter the mountain, the spiders will quickly try to move inside to stop you. I'll need one of you to stay here with me to fight them off.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.dst: Exato. O plano é este... Se entrarem na montanha, as aranhas vão logo tentar entrar pra impedir. Preciso que um de vocês fique aqui comigo pra enfrentá-las.
Arachnids' Ascent#047.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#048.src: So two of us take on the volcano, and two stay behind. Got it! {u}, you should be part of the Mount Wynn group. But then, Tasim, which of us should go with them?
Arachnids' Ascent#048.dst: Então dois enfrentam o vulcão e dois ficam. Entendido! {u}, você devia ir no grupo do Mount Wynn. Mas aí, Tasim, qual de nós deve ir junto?
Arachnids' Ascent#048.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#049.src: Why don't we let {u} decide? Which of us do you want to join you in the volcano?
Arachnids' Ascent#049.dst: Por que não deixamos {u} decidir? Qual de nós você quer levar ao vulcão?
Arachnids' Ascent#049.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#050.src: Alright! We'll handle the volcano then. Captain, Tasim, don't die out here!
Arachnids' Ascent#050.dst: Beleza! Então cuidamos do vulcão. Capitão, Tasim, não morram aqui!
Arachnids' Ascent#050.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#051.src: Alright. We'll fight through the spiders in the mountain, then. Captain, Aledar, good luck!
Arachnids' Ascent#051.dst: Certo. Então vamos enfrentar as aranhas da montanha. Capitão, Aledar, boa sorte!
Arachnids' Ascent#051.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#052.src: I need some more time to dec

Arachnids' Ascent#053.src: Then take more time. But don't take too long- we don't want the spiders to realize we're planning something.
Arachnids' Ascent#053.dst: Então pense mais. Mas não demore- não queremos que as aranhas notem que tramamos algo.
Arachnids' Ascent#053.speaker: Captain Enduyn

Arachnids' Ascent#054.src: Decide who to bring with you into Mount Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#054.dst: Decida quem levar com você ao Mount Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#055.src: So, who do you want to join you to fight through Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#055.dst: Então, quem você quer ao seu lado no Mount Wynn?
Arachnids' Ascent#055.speaker: Tasim

Arachnids' Ascent#056.src: Enter Mount Wynn and reach the summit through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Arachnids' Ascent#056.dst: Entre no Mount Wynn e chegue ao cume pela caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Arachnids' Ascent#057.src: ...Wow, it's hot in here! That makes sense, I guess, given what we're here for. Let's reach the top as quickly as we can.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.dst: ...Nossa, que calor aqui dentro! Faz sentido, pelo que viemos buscar. Vamos chegar ao topo o mais rápido possível.
Arachnids' Ascent#057.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#058.src: W-woah! You felt that too, right? What's going-
Arachnids' Ascent#058.dst: U-uau! Também sentiu isso, né? O que houv-
Arachnids' Ascent#058.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#059.src: We've got to run for it! Come on, jump!
Arachnids' Ascent#059.speaker: Aledar

Arachnids' Ascent#060.src: That... that was a close one. Phew! Can't believe we made it out in one piece. I think we're near the top, too.
Arachnids' Ascent#060.dst: Essa... essa foi por pouco. Ufa! Nem acredito que saímos inteiros. E acho que estamos perto do topo.
