Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: Sim, o outro motivo de eu ter saído foi a brutalidade. Não lido bem com sangue e não estava preparada para tanto sangue.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: Quase sempre, ser soldado é monótono. Monótono de entorpecer. Mas as poucas vezes em que não foi me fizeram desejar mais que tudo estar entediada.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.dst: Nem sei se a violência era errada; só não consigo participar dela.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: Uma vida desagradável em casa. Nada me prendia lá. O exército parecia minha melhor saída.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#409.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.dst: Acho que faria a mesma escolha de novo, mesmo sabendo como acabaria. Eu não aguentaria ficar lá muito mais tempo.
Celebrations in Smoke#409.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#410.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#410.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: Não. O resíduo cheira muito mais forte que qualquer bebida que eu conheça.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: Se achou isso aqui, tente perguntar pelo festival se mais alguém reconhece.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#414.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.dst: Bem, posso dizer que com certeza não é chá verde. Além disso, não sei.
Celebrations in Smoke#414.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: Hum... nenhum de nós viu alguém entrar com algo que cheire assim.
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: Ou já estava em {p}, ou quem trouxe chegou antes até de nós.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#417.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.dst: Uma garrafa quebrada? Parece as que usamos nas nossas Garrafas de Névoa, mas o cheiro é totalmente diferente.
Celebrations in Smoke#417.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#418.dst: Uau, que demais! Aposto que essas pontas machucariam muito um metamorfo...
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: Se eu conheço? Não, mas queria!
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: Esse cheiro... receio não reconhecer. Com certeza não cheira a coisa boa!
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#421.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.dst: Não reconheço. Mas poderia guardar isso? O cheiro parece estar incomodando umas raposas.
Celebrations in Smoke#421.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#423.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#423.dst: Me parece vagamente familiar, mas infelizmente não sei de onde.
Celebrations in Smoke#423.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.dst: Seja o que for, com certeza não fui eu que trouxe.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#429.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.dst: Mas não tem nada de marcante, fora esse odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#429.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#430.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.dst: Não. E estamos no meio de uma conversa, por favor não interrompa.
Celebrations in Smoke#430.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#431.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.dst: Essa garrafa? De jeito nenhum, esse cheiro é demais para este corpo velho.
Celebrations in Smoke#431.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#433.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.dst: Mas me pagaram bem para não contar!
Celebrations in Smoke#433.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#434.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#434.dst: Só conto se alguém me impressionar de verdade.
Celebrations in Smoke#434.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#436.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#436.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#437.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.dst: Sem ressentimentos; ninguém espera me vencer em corrida de raposas.
Celebrations in Smoke#437.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#438.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.dst: Claro, se quiser tentar de novo, fique à vontade. Só não se surpreenda com o mesmo resultado.
Celebrations in Smoke#438.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#440.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#440.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#441.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#441.dst: Nem sei como isso é possível, parecia que você escolhia ao acaso!
Celebrations in Smoke#441.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#442.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#442.dst: Bem, o que é justo é justo. Foi um belo show; vou te contar o que sei.
Celebrations in Smoke#442.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#443.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.dst: Nem é grande coisa, não sei por que me pagaram para não contar.
Celebrations in Smoke#443.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#444.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.dst: Enquanto eu estudava as raposas antes das corridas, peguei uns membros do clã Kalkalrah trazendo garrafas como essas.
Celebrations in Smoke#444.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#445.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#445.dst: Achei que fossem só chá verde, mas claramente não são!
Celebrations in Smoke#445.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#446.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#446.dst: Não sei bem onde estão agora, mas acho que os vi subir pela tirolesa até o segundo andar de {p}?
Celebrations in Smoke#446.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#447.src: And if you'd teach me your racing technique at some point, I'd really appreciate it!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.dst: E se um dia você me ensinar sua técnica de corrida, eu ia adorar!
Celebrations in Smoke#447.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#448.src: Be careful what accusations you throw around.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.dst: Cuidado com as acusações que sai fazendo.
Celebrations in Smoke#448.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#449.src: Not everyone has their guard down around this festival for those who stick their noses where they don't belong.
Celebrations in Smoke#449.dst: Nem todos baixam a guarda neste festival para quem mete o nariz onde não é chamado.
Celebrations in Smoke#449.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#450.src: Give me that, let me look at what you were showing them more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.dst: Me dá isso, deixa eu ver de perto o que você mostrava a eles.
Celebrations in Smoke#450.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#451.src: Ahhh, yes, you know something about that group, don't you?
Celebrations in Smoke#451.dst: Ahhh, sim, você sabe algo sobre aquele grupo, não sabe?
Celebrations in Smoke#451.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#452.src: You don't need to tell me, I know as much as you do and more.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.dst: Não precisa me contar, sei tanto quanto você e mais.
Celebrations in Smoke#452.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#453.src: It's been many years since I was able to freely move about the city, my old age imprisoning me in my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.dst: Faz muitos anos que não consigo andar livremente pela cidade; a velhice me prende em casa.
Celebrations in Smoke#453.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#454.src: But I can still sit and watch the scurrying people below. I can see what they all do when they think nobody is watching.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.dst: Mas ainda posso sentar e observar a gente correndo lá embaixo. Vejo o que fazem quando acham que ninguém está olhando.
Celebrations in Smoke#454.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#455.src: It's a sort of power. A way to keep myself grounded, hanging here in the canopy.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.dst: É um tipo de poder. Um jeito de manter os pés no chão, pendurada aqui no alto.
Celebrations in Smoke#455.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#456.src: I watched you scramble to extinguish the fire and I watched what that group did after the flame was lit.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.dst: Vi você correr para apagar o fogo e vi o que aquele grupo fez depois que a chama acendeu.
Celebrations in Smoke#456.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#457.src: I watched as those three outsiders were corralled into custody.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.dst: Vi aqueles três forasteiros serem encurralados e detidos.
Celebrations in Smoke#457.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#458.src: However, I cannot hear the details. I do not know the specifics.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.dst: Porém, não ouço os detalhes. Não sei os pormenores.
Celebrations in Smoke#458.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#459.src: Tell me what your suspects have done and what you have found. Then, I will give you what you seek.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.dst: Diga o que seus suspeitos fizeram e o que você encontrou. Então, te darei o que procura.
Celebrations in Smoke#459.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#460.src: A bunch of lying outsiders then. To be expected, it's a pity you can't say they all did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.dst: Um bando de forasteiros mentirosos. Era de se esperar; pena não poder culpar todos.
Celebrations in Smoke#460.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#461.src: As for that clique, I suspect they're secretly security for the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.dst: Quanto à panelinha, suspeito que sejam a segurança secreta do festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#461.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#462.src: I didn't see who lit the flame, but moments after it was lit, one of them threw a bottle just like the one you're holding at it.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.dst: Não vi quem acendeu a chama, mas logo depois um deles jogou nela uma garrafa igual à que você está segurando.
Celebrations in Smoke#462.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#463.src: It must have been filled with fuel, because after it hit the flame grew much larger.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.dst: Devia estar cheia de combustível, porque depois do impacto o fogo cresceu muito.
Celebrations in Smoke#463.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#464.src: Probably for the best, you never know what vermin you can roast if you're not afraid to burn the bush.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.dst: Talvez tenha sido melhor; nunca se sabe que pragas dá para assar sem ter medo de queimar o mato.
Celebrations in Smoke#464.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#465.src: If you will entertain an old woman, then I have no use for you. Quit blocking my view.
Celebrations in Smoke#465.dst: Se só veio entreter uma velha, não me serve. Pare de tapar minha vista.
Celebrations in Smoke#465.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#466.src: My investigator has returned. Now, tell me what you know.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.dst: Meu investigador voltou. Agora, diga o que sabe.
Celebrations in Smoke#466.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#467.src: You look like you have something on your mind, what is it?
Celebrations in Smoke#467.dst: Parece que algo te preocupa. O que é?
Celebrations in Smoke#467.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#468.src: Ah, I see your investigations have borne fruit.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.dst: Ah, vejo que suas investigações deram frutos.
Celebrations in Smoke#468.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#469.src: Yes. As you have seen, people tend to let their guard down at the festival in a way they normally wouldn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.dst: Sim. Como você viu, no festival as pessoas costumam baixar a guarda como normalmente não fariam.
Celebrations in Smoke#469.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#470.src: They are a necessity to ensure any unexpected guests are swiftly taken care of.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.dst: Eles são necessários para cuidar rapidamente de qualquer convidado inesperado.
Celebrations in Smoke#470.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#471.src: I suspect you're probably right. And yet, that is irrelevant.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.dst: Talvez você tenha razão. Mesmo assim, isso é irrelevante.
Celebrations in Smoke#471.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#472.src: You will tell me they are reckless and a danger to others. I don't disagree, but I encourage you to look at the wider picture.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.dst: Você vai me dizer que são imprudentes e um perigo para os outros. Não discordo, mas sugiro que olhe o quadro geral.
Celebrations in Smoke#472.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#473.src: If we let up our vigilance for even a moment, we have already lost our war. Our clans and families will be infiltrated within the day.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.dst: Se baixarmos a guarda um só instante, já perdemos a guerra. Nossos clãs e famílias serão infiltrados no mesmo dia.
Celebrations in Smoke#473.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#474.src: Their recklessness prevents this. In a case where the smallest failure would be catastrophe, recklessness becomes necessity.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.dst: A imprudência deles evita isso. Quando a menor falha seria uma catástrofe, a imprudência vira necessidade.
Celebrations in Smoke#474.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#475.src: Imagine they had not acted rashly in throwing a bottle of fuel onto the already lit flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.dst: Imagine se não tivessem agido sem pensar, jogando o combustível no fogo já aceso.
Celebrations in Smoke#475.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#476.src: They did not create the flame, someone else must have been hoping to gain from it.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.dst: Eles não acenderam a chama; alguém mais devia querer tirar proveito dela.
Celebrations in Smoke#476.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#477.src: Their actions, while dangerous, prevented any fiends from exploiting the opportunity. We took it out of their control.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.dst: Os atos deles, embora perigosos, impediram que qualquer criatura vil aproveitasse a chance. Tiramos dela a chance.
Celebrations in Smoke#477.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#478.src: Whatever risk their actions created was worth the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.dst: Qualquer risco que criaram valeu o preço.
Celebrations in Smoke#478.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#479.src: Apologies for rambling, I assure you though that safety is our top concern. Whatever the price.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.dst: Perdoe a divagação, mas garanto que a segurança é nossa maior preocupação. Custe o que custar.
Celebrations in Smoke#479.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#480.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or look into the suspects a bit more.
Celebrations in Smoke#480.dst: Volte ao organizador do festival em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou investigue um pouco mais os suspeitos.

Celebrations in Smoke#481.src: You think you know who the changeling is?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.dst: Acha que sabe quem é o metamorfo?
Celebrations in Smoke#481.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#482.src: You've dug into them all and have found something? Excellent.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.dst: Investigou todos e encontrou algo? Excelente.
Celebrations in Smoke#482.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#483.src: So, who do you think tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#483.dst: Então, quem acha que tentou queimar o homem de vime?
Celebrations in Smoke#483.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#484.src: Suspect {~}? Very well. I will take care of things from here.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.dst: Suspeito {~}? Muito bem. Daqui em diante, eu cuido disso.
Celebrations in Smoke#484.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#485.src: Again, thank you so much for your help. I cannot emphasize enough how much you assisting in this matter for us allowed the festival to be a success.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.dst: Mais uma vez, muito obrigado pela ajuda. Nunca vou conseguir enfatizar o bastante o quanto sua ajuda permitiu que o festival fosse um sucesso.
Celebrations in Smoke#485.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#486.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival, and make sure to watch the wickerman burn! I'll save a special seat for you near the front as a sign of our appreciation.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.dst: Aproveite o resto do festival, e não deixe de ver o homem de vime queimar! Vou guardar um lugar especial lá na frente para você, como agradecimento.
Celebrations in Smoke#486.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#487.src: I understand your reticence to pick one. We don't have anything close to the information required to make a proper judgment.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.dst: Entendo sua relutância em escolher um. Não temos nem de longe a informação necessária para um julgamento adequado.
Celebrations in Smoke#487.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#488.src: But you cannot allow that to stop you. We do not have the luxury to close our eyes and pretend it didn't happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.dst: Mas não pode deixar isso te impedir. Não temos o luxo de fechar os olhos e fingir que nada aconteceu.
Celebrations in Smoke#488.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#489.src: Please, from the inevitably incomplete investigation you conducted, tell me who you think lit that flame.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.dst: Por favor, pela sua investigação, inevitavelmente incompleta, diga quem acha que acendeu a chama.
Celebrations in Smoke#489.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#490.src: Very well then. I am disappointed, but understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.dst: Muito bem, então. Estou decepcionado, mas entendo.
Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: I will take care of things from this point forward.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.dst: Daqui em diante, eu cuido de tudo.
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: In thanks for saving the wickerman, there will be a seat saved for you when you are ready to watch it burn.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.dst: Em agradecimento por salvar o homem de vime, guardaremos um lugar para quando quiser vê-lo queimar.
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Enjoy the rest of the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: Keep looking then. Return here once you've made a decision.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.dst: Então continue procurando. Volte quando se decidir.
Celebrations in Smoke#494.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#495.dst: Assista à queima do homem de vime em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#496.dst: Assista à queima do homem de vime.

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: You children of the {p} gather round
Celebrations in Smoke#497.dst: Ó filhos de {p}, venham se reunir
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: To gaze upon this relic from years past,
Celebrations in Smoke#498.dst: para mirar esta relíquia de outrora,
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: This effigy, of ancient foes we fought—
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#500.src: In memory, we will again ignite!
Celebrations in Smoke#500.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#501.src: An ancient beast, rebuilt with plank and straw,
Celebrations in Smoke#501.dst: Fera ancestral, refeita em tábua e palha,
Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#502.src: What once was flesh, reconstitute as wood;
Celebrations in Smoke#502.dst: o que foi carne, agora é madeira;
Celebrations in Smoke#502.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#503.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#503.dst: todo monstro, velho ou novo, há de findar—
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#504.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#504.dst: Todo vil há de arder! Assar, tostar, derreter!
Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#505.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#505.dst: Fora a substância, o que resta persiste...
Celebrations in Smoke#505.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#506.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#506.dst: ...como cadáver negro, sem ameaça a existir!
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.dst: Ah, oi, nunca tive a chance de te agradecer.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.dst: Não sei bem o que houve depois que saiu.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.dst: O organizador do festival voltou e levou Burick/Cerisa com ele.
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#510.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.dst: Não sei o que houve, mas, hã, acho que não foi coisa boa.
Celebrations in Smoke#510.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.dst: Então, valeu de novo. Na hora, eu não estava com cabeça para demonstrar.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.dst: Vou ver quanto tempo aguento por aqui, mas o pessoal local já está me olhando torto.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.dst: Talvez eu entre mais fundo na floresta, para ver se encontro algo.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#515.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#515.dst: Ou entrar para o exército? Acho que não levo jeito e nem sei se me aceitariam, mas talvez valha tentar.
Celebrations in Smoke#515.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#516.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.dst: Senão, só me resta viver do que eu encontrar. E, hã, não boto muita fé nisso.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.dst: Estou! Sempre bate, hã, um nervoso. Mas bem menos que antes.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.dst: Foi como se tirassem o machado do meu pescoço, graças a você.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.dst: Ainda há muita incerteza, mas já não me sinto como um coelho se debatendo numa gaiola.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.dst: Minha cabeça ainda estava longe, então não, desculpe.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#521.dst: Mas ela saiu bem rápido, devia estar com pressa de chegar a algum lugar
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#523.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#523.dst: Olá. Tente não chegar muito perto.
Celebrations in Smoke#523.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.dst: Desculpe a frieza; sua ajuda foi bem-vinda.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.dst: Mas não tenho como saber se você é quem diz ser.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#528.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.dst: Desde nosso encontro no festival, ando mais escondido que o normal.
Celebrations in Smoke#528.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#529.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.dst: Minha vida não mudou muito do que costuma ser.
Celebrations in Smoke#529.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#530.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.dst: Ir ao festival foi um erro terrível.
Celebrations in Smoke#530.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#531.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.dst: Deixei minha própria humanidade me dominar; {p} raramente perdoa esse erro.
Celebrations in Smoke#531.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#532.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#532.dst: Não vou repetir o erro. A solidão machuca, mas a confiança mata.
Celebrations in Smoke#532.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#533.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.dst: Da última vez, ainda estava em {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#533.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#534.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.dst: Arris não parece ter jeito para a vida de catador; se não achar outro jeito de viver fora de um clã, não passa desta semana.
Celebrations in Smoke#534.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#535.dst: É uma pena, mas é a realidade.
Celebrations in Smoke#535.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#536.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.dst: Sim, enquanto todos viam o homem de vime queimar, ela vasculhou todas as barracas, bolsas e casas vazias que pôde.
Celebrations in Smoke#536.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#537.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.dst: Saí antes de ela terminar, mas hoje de manhã vi alguém saindo de {p} rumo ao sul, carregando várias bolsas grandes.
Celebrations in Smoke#537.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#538.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.dst: Aonde quer que vá, está pronta para uma longa jornada.
Celebrations in Smoke#538.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#540.src: Now that you have a mask, you can enjoy the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#540.dst: Agora que tem máscara, pode aproveitar o festival.

Celebrations in Smoke#541.src: Do you want to wear the deer mask?
Celebrations in Smoke#541.dst: Quer usar a máscara de cervo?

Celebrations in Smoke#542.src: You unravel your fortune. It says:

Celebrations in Smoke#543.src: 'You will live a long and prosperous life and will die surrouded by your clan.'
Celebrations in Smoke#543.dst: 'Terá vida longa e próspera e morrerá junto ao seu clã.'
Celebrations in Smoke#543.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#544.src: 'Respect your parents, in your time of greatest need they will come for you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#544.dst: 'Respeite seus pais: na hora de maior necessidade, eles virão por você.'
Celebrations in Smoke#544.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#545.dst:
Organizador do festival
O que é isso?!
Celebrations in Smoke#545.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#546.src:
Festival Attendee
Not right now, but-
Celebrations in Smoke#546.dst:
Participante do festival
Agora não, mas-
Celebrations in Smoke#546.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#547.src: What would you like to ask the suspect?
Celebrations in Smoke#547.dst: O que quer perguntar ao suspeito?

Celebrations in Smoke#548.src: You've updated your notes with this new information.
Celebrations in Smoke#548.dst: Você atualizou suas anotações com a nova informação.

Celebrations in Smoke#549.dst: Você já está seguindo o Suspeito {~}.

Celebrations in Smoke#550.src: You're now following the clues related to Suspect {~}.
Celebrations in Smoke#550.dst: Agora você está seguindo as pistas do Suspeito {~}.

Celebrations in Smoke#553.src: What would you like to ask Burick?
Celebrations in Smoke#553.dst: O que quer perguntar a Burick?

Celebrations in Smoke#554.src: What would you like to ask Arris?
Celebrations in Smoke#554.dst: O que quer perguntar a Arris?

Celebrations in Smoke#555.src: What would you like to ask Cerisa?
Celebrations in Smoke#555.dst: O que quer perguntar a Cerisa?

Celebrations in Smoke#559.src: Isn't that personally dangerous, for you?
Celebrations in Smoke#559.dst: Isso não é perigoso para você?
Celebrations in Smoke#559.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#561.src: Why don't you have a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#561.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#562.src: How did you get into the festival without a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#562.dst: Como entrou no festival sem medalhão?
Celebrations in Smoke#562.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#564.src: Why would the clans trust you without a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#564.dst: Por que os clãs confiariam em você sem medalhão?
Celebrations in Smoke#564.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#565.src: What do you do as a member of Kalkalrah clan?
Celebrations in Smoke#565.dst: O que você faz no clã Kalkalrah?
Celebrations in Smoke#565.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#568.src: So what if I think you did do it?
Celebrations in Smoke#568.dst: E se eu achar que foi você?
Celebrations in Smoke#568.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#570.src: Did you see who tried to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#570.dst: Viu quem tentou queimar o homem de vime?
Celebrations in Smoke#570.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#571.src: Why did you try to burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#571.dst: Por que tentou queimar o homem de vime?
Celebrations in Smoke#571.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#572.src: Where do you get your green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#572.dst: Onde você consegue o chá verde?
Celebrations in Smoke#572.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#573.src: Your entire business is selling the products of one clan to everyone else?
Celebrations in Smoke#573.dst: Seu negócio todo é vender os produtos de um clã para todos os outros?
Celebrations in Smoke#573.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#574.src: So you won't lie to me at all?
Celebrations in Smoke#574.dst: Então não vai mentir pra mim?
Celebrations in Smoke#574.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#575.src: Why are you so insistent on not wanting to be found to have tried to burn the wickerman? Do you fear the consequences that much?
Celebrations in Smoke#575.dst: Por que insiste tanto em que não descubram que você tentou queimar o homem de vime? Teme tanto assim as consequências?
Celebrations in Smoke#575.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#578.src: Ask the tea enthusiast a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#578.dst: Perguntar algo ao fã de chá?

Celebrations in Smoke#579.src: Search for a camp east of {p} that Burick might have been spotted at
Celebrations in Smoke#579.dst: Procure um acampamento a leste de {p} onde Burick pode ter sido visto

Celebrations in Smoke#580.src: The Kalkalrah clan doesn't sell it normally?
Celebrations in Smoke#580.dst: O clã Kalkalrah não costuma vender?
Celebrations in Smoke#580.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#581.src: No, It's starting to look like there isn't one.
Celebrations in Smoke#581.dst: Não, está começando a parecer que não existe.
Celebrations in Smoke#581.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#582.src: This is where the fire was started, it looks like all that's left is embers.
Celebrations in Smoke#582.dst: Foi aqui que o fogo começou; parece que só restam brasas.

Celebrations in Smoke#584.src: A bottle? You might want to see if the food stall recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#584.dst: Uma garrafa? Veja se a barraca de comida a reconhece.

Celebrations in Smoke#585.src: Ask the clan member a question?

Celebrations in Smoke#586.src: Exiled? They never mentioned anything like that when I interrogated them.
Celebrations in Smoke#586.dst: Exílio? Arris não mencionou nada disso no interrogatório.
Celebrations in Smoke#586.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#587.src: How much do you think I can trust them?
Celebrations in Smoke#587.dst: Quanto acha que posso confiar em Arris?
Celebrations in Smoke#587.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#590.src: Was this the first time something like that happened?
Celebrations in Smoke#590.dst: Foi a primeira vez que algo assim aconteceu?
Celebrations in Smoke#590.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#591.src: Why did you come to the festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#591.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#593.src: Sure, let me go get one.
Celebrations in Smoke#593.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#596.src: This looks like the place that festival attendee mentioned.
Celebrations in Smoke#596.dst: Parece o lugar que o participante do festival mencionou.

Celebrations in Smoke#597.src: The green tea covering the ground seems to indicate the clan member is telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#597.dst: O chá verde cobrindo o chão indica que o membro do clã diz a verdade.

Celebrations in Smoke#598.src: Maybe you could look a bit more closely though?
Celebrations in Smoke#598.dst: Mas talvez valha olhar mais de perto?

Celebrations in Smoke#599.src: On the wall is a crude sketch of the surrounding area.
Celebrations in Smoke#599.dst: Na parede há um esboço tosco dos arredores.

Celebrations in Smoke#600.src: The embers below this cooking pot are still smoldering, it's been used recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#600.dst: As brasas sob esta panela ainda fumegam; foi usada há pouco.

Celebrations in Smoke#601.src: You cheer your fox on! It, already under pressure, is overwhelmed.
Celebrations in Smoke#601.dst: Você torce pela sua raposa! Já sob pressão, ela fica sobrecarregada.

Celebrations in Smoke#602.src: Your voice has recovered and you can cheer again.
Celebrations in Smoke#602.dst: Sua voz se recuperou e você pode torcer de novo.

Celebrations in Smoke#603.src: You cheer your fox on! It can't hear you over the excitement of the race.
Celebrations in Smoke#603.dst: Você torce pela sua raposa! Ela não te ouve com a empolgação da corrida.

Celebrations in Smoke#604.src: You cheer your fox on! It receives an extra boost of encouragement!
Celebrations in Smoke#604.dst: Você torce pela sua raposa! Ela recebe um empurrão extra de ânimo!

Celebrations in Smoke#605.src: You just cheered your fox on! You need a few moments to recover your voice to cheer again.
Celebrations in Smoke#605.dst: Você acabou de torcer pela sua raposa! Precisa de alguns instantes para recuperar a voz e torcer de novo.

Celebrations in Smoke#606.src: You cheer your fox on! It beams with your approval.
Celebrations in Smoke#606.dst: Você torce pela sua raposa! Ela se enche de alegria com sua aprovação.

Celebrations in Smoke#608.src: The box is stuck tightly in the mud. You might have to pull again, harder.
Celebrations in Smoke#608.dst: A caixa está bem presa na lama. Talvez você tenha que puxar de novo, com mais força.

Celebrations in Smoke#609.src: You'll have to confront her to learn more.
Celebrations in Smoke#609.dst: Você terá que confrontá-la para saber mais.

Celebrations in Smoke#611.src: Are you aware of how easy it is to sneak in?
Celebrations in Smoke#611.dst: Sabe como é fácil entrar sem ser visto?
Celebrations in Smoke#611.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#612.src: ... You're not sure someone else hasn't already noticed.
Celebrations in Smoke#612.dst: ... Você não tem certeza se mais alguém já percebeu.
Celebrations in Smoke#612.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#614.src: Ask the racing expert a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#614.dst: Perguntar algo ao especialista em corridas?

Celebrations in Smoke#615.src: Challenge the racing expert in the fox race?
Celebrations in Smoke#615.dst: Desafiar o especialista em corridas na corrida de raposas?

Celebrations in Smoke#616.src: Ask the group of clan members a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#616.dst: Perguntar algo ao grupo de membros do clã?

Celebrations in Smoke#617.src: I was told you all snuck into the festival with bottles like this.
Celebrations in Smoke#617.dst: Me disseram que vocês todos entraram escondidos no festival com garrafas como esta.
Celebrations in Smoke#617.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#618.src: You hear a frail voice calling you from the east.
Celebrations in Smoke#618.dst: Você ouve uma voz fraca chamando do leste.
Celebrations in Smoke#618.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#619.src: Ask the elderly woman a question?
Celebrations in Smoke#619.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#620.src: Share your information with the elderly woman?
Celebrations in Smoke#620.dst: Compartilhar suas informações com a senhora idosa?
Celebrations in Smoke#620.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#621.src: Then return to me once you do know. I'll be waiting.
Celebrations in Smoke#621.dst: Então volte quando souber. Estarei esperando.
Celebrations in Smoke#621.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#622.src: I found this box of soldier's gear. It was set down exactly where you snuck in the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#622.dst: Encontrei esta caixa de equipamento de soldado. Estava exatamente onde você entrou escondida no festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#622.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#624.src: This seems counterproductive to your goal of getting me to trust you.
Celebrations in Smoke#624.dst: Isso parece ir contra o seu objetivo de me fazer confiar em você.
Celebrations in Smoke#624.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#625.src: I could report you to the military right now.
Celebrations in Smoke#625.dst: Eu poderia denunciar você ao exército agora mesmo.
Celebrations in Smoke#625.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#626.src: Is there anything you're not telling me?
Celebrations in Smoke#626.dst: Tem algo que você não está me contando?
Celebrations in Smoke#626.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#627.src: Why did you join the military?
Celebrations in Smoke#627.dst: Por que você entrou para o exército?
Celebrations in Smoke#627.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#628.src: You have enough confessions that the festival organizer should be happy now. You can return to them or continue investigating for more info.
Celebrations in Smoke#628.dst: Você tem confissões suficientes para deixar o organizador do festival satisfeito. Pode voltar a ele ou continuar investigando para obter mais informações.

Celebrations in Smoke#629.src: Why are you attending the festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#629.dst: Por que você veio ao festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#629.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#631.src: How did you get that massive box of green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#631.dst: Como conseguiu essa caixa enorme de chá verde?
Celebrations in Smoke#631.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#632.src: I'm not sure I feel comfortable sharing that with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#632.dst: Não sei se me sinto à vontade para contar isso a você.
Celebrations in Smoke#632.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#634.src: Is there hidden security at this festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#634.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#635.src: They caused the small fire that almost burnt down the wickerman!
Celebrations in Smoke#635.dst: Eles causaram o pequeno incêndio que quase queimou o homem de vime!
Celebrations in Smoke#635.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#636.src: Return to the festival organizer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Celebrations in Smoke#636.dst: Volte ao organizador do festival em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Celebrations in Smoke#637.src: You already have found Suspect {~}'s lie!
Celebrations in Smoke#637.dst: Você já descobriu a mentira do Suspeito {~}!

Celebrations in Smoke#638.src: Really, I don't think any of them did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#638.dst: Sério, acho que nenhum deles fez isso.
Celebrations in Smoke#638.speaker: Player

Celebrations in Smoke#639.src: Do you want to watch the wickerman burn and end the festival?
Celebrations in Smoke#639.dst: Quer ver o homem de vime queimar e encerrar o festival?

Celebrations in Smoke#640.src: Maybe if you look around, you can find a way to sneak in?
Celebrations in Smoke#640.dst: Talvez, olhando em volta, ache um jeito de entrar?

Celebrations in Smoke#641.src: No. And I would appreciate it if you would avoid prying in my personal affairs.
Celebrations in Smoke#641.dst: Não. E agradeceria se não se metesse nos meus assuntos pessoais.
Celebrations in Smoke#641.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#642.src: I disagree. You'll have to find a way to live with that disagreement.
Celebrations in Smoke#642.dst: Discordo. Você vai ter que aprender a conviver com essa discordância.
Celebrations in Smoke#642.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#643.src: The barrel was destroyed! Try again?
Celebrations in Smoke#643.dst: O barril quebrou! Tentar de novo?

Clearing the Camps#000.src: The orc chiefs seem to hide in the camps with green flags - search the plains, and return once they're subdued!
Clearing the Camps#000.dst: Os chefes orcs se escondem nos acampamentos de bandeira verde - vasculhe as planícies e volte ao subjugá-los!

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these 'Orcs' and 'Goblins' are threatening their towns and cities.
Clearing the Camps#001.dst: Soube dos pedidos que recebemos dos aldeões? Dizem que esses 'orcs' e 'goblins' estão ameaçando suas vilas e cidades.
Clearing the Camps#001.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Primitive, brutal things, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
Clearing the Camps#002.dst: Criaturas primitivas e brutais, pouco melhores que os zumbis a que estamos acostumados, diz o exército de {p}.
Clearing the Camps#002.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#003.src: Our scouts have identified three 'chief' orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko, and Veltu. Though, strangely, Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
Clearing the Camps#003.dst: Nossos batedores identificaram três orcs 'chefes' na área- Elisu, Ceifko e Veltu. Mas, estranhamente, Veltu vive cercado de goblins...
Clearing the Camps#003.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#004.src: Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags - search the plains, and return once they're dealt with!
Clearing the Camps#004.dst: Enfim, precisam de nós aqui defendendo {p}. Você dá conta dos chefes? Eles parecem se esconder nos acampamentos de bandeira verde - vasculhe as planícies e volte quando acabar!
Clearing the Camps#004.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#005.src: That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead or alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
Clearing the Camps#005.dst: Isso foi... mais brutal do que eu queria, mas serve... Os aldeões não ligam se estão vivos ou mortos, contanto que se resolva. Aqui está sua parte da recompensa.
Clearing the Camps#005.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#006.src: You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah... livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
Clearing the Camps#006.dst: Lá fora você viu que as criaturas de Gavel não são como as de Wynn, né? São um pouco, ah... mais animadas que o normal. Melhor se acostumar.
Clearing the Camps#006.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#007.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Clearing the Camps#007.dst: Fale com o capitão Kymer nos arredores de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Clearing the Camps#008.src: Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
Clearing the Camps#008.dst: Ahá, outro soldado de {p}, é? Bem, seja bem-vindo.
Clearing the Camps#008.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#009.src: So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
Clearing the Camps#009.dst: Achamos que, se entre eles quem manda é a força, derrotar os líderes deve assustá-los até se renderem.
Clearing the Camps#009.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#010.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
Clearing the Camps#010.dst: Encontre e mate os chefes orcs Elisu, Veltu e Ceifko nos acampamentos ao redor de {p}- procure as bandeiras verdes

Clearing the Camps#011.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
Clearing the Camps#011.dst: Volte ao capitão Kymer quando tiver as três cabeças.

Clearing the Camps#012.src: Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
Clearing the Camps#012.dst: Ah, o soldado de antes! Vejo que voltou. Conseguiu derrotar aqueles- ...credo. Isso são as cabeças deles?
Clearing the Camps#012.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#013.src: This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
Clearing the Camps#013.dst: Um ataque cirúrgico assim deve evitar uma guerra aberta com os orcs. Não queremos uma guerra em larga escala em cada província, rá!
Clearing the Camps#013.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#014.src: The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
Clearing the Camps#014.dst: O próximo povoado grande é {p}, no pântano ao norte, mas dizem que os ogros do pântano são bem mais duros que os das planícies. Eu ficaria por aqui treinando primeiro.
Clearing the Camps#014.speaker: Captain Kymer

Cluck Cluck#000.src: Have you taken care of Cluckles yet? If you can't find him, I hid him in my basement.
Cluck Cluck#000.dst: Já deu um jeito no Cluckles? Se não o encontrar, escondi ele no meu porão.
Cluck Cluck#000.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#001.src: You need to be Farming Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
Cluck Cluck#001.dst: Requer Agricultura Nv. {~} para iniciar esta minimissão.

Cluck Cluck#002.src: You need to be Mining Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
Cluck Cluck#002.dst: Requer Mineração Nv. {~} para iniciar esta minimissão.

Cluck Cluck#003.src: You need to be Fishing Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.
Cluck Cluck#003.dst: Requer Pesca Nv. {~} para iniciar esta minimissão.

Cluck Cluck#004.src: Sometimes I wish animals could respawn... hey! What are you doing here? Go away!
Cluck Cluck#004.dst: Às vezes queria que os animais renascessem... ei! O que faz aqui? Vá embora!
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#006.dst: Ei, você não é uma galinha! Espera, você é humano! Pode me ajudar! Talvez seja quem ajudou meu irmão Yahya, mas vai saber, pra mim os humanos são todos iguais.
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#007.dst: Amo minhas galinhas, mas tem um galo que eu não consigo controlar...
Cluck Cluck#007.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#008.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#008.dst: Ele se chama Cluckles, um homem chamado Bob me deu ele antes de ir para a guerra, mas como Bob nunca voltou, Cluckles ficou bravo...
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#009.dst: Ele é perigoso demais para ficar na minha linda ilha, então o deixo no porão...
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#010.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#010.dst: Quero cuidar dele, mas minha esposa diz que é perigoso demais. Onde está minha esposa? Ah, acho que ela está por aí comendo grãos.
Cluck Cluck#010.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#011.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#011.dst: Enfim, preciso que você desça lá e... Dê um jeito nele para mim. Eu agradeceria muito.
Cluck Cluck#011.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#012.src: Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
Cluck Cluck#012.dst: Leve [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] para Nohno.

Cluck Cluck#013.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#013.dst: O que é isso?! A pena dele? O que fez com o Cluckles?! Queria que desse um jeito nele, não que o matasse!
Cluck Cluck#013.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#014.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#014.dst: Seu monstro! Saia daqui agora, e guarde essa pena para lembrar do seu crime hediondo!
Cluck Cluck#014.speaker: Nohno

Collect White Lilies#001.src: Request from Jayba: Someone, please! I planned on giving my partner a bouquet of lilies for our anniversary, but I simply forgot!
Collect White Lilies#001.dst: Pedido de Jayba: Alguém, por favor! Eu ia dar um buquê de lírios ao meu amor no nosso aniversário, mas simplesmente esqueci!

Collect White Lilies#002.src: With the festival coming up, they're all sold out! I'd rather not muddy my clothes to get some; especially with the nasty rumors regarding enemies of the state.
Collect White Lilies#002.dst: Com o festival chegando, estão todos esgotados! Prefiro não sujar a roupa de lama para pegá-los, ainda mais com esses boatos feios sobre inimigos do Estado.

Collect White Lilies#003.src: {~} White Lilies should do the trick. These lone flowers can be found in grassy areas, usually near blossom trees. Do keep an eye out, they're quite small.
Collect White Lilies#003.dst: {~} lírios brancos devem bastar. Essas flores solitárias ficam em áreas de grama, geralmente perto de árvores floridas. Fique de olho, são bem pequenas.

Collect White Lilies#004.src: If you stick to the roads, you should be able to come across a few. Careful to not get disturbed whilst picking them though! You may want to clear the area beforehand, especially with all the Moorbadgers around...
Collect White Lilies#004.dst: Se seguir as estradas, deve encontrar alguns. Mas cuidado para não te atrapalharem enquanto colhe! Talvez convenha limpar a área antes, ainda mais com tantos texugos da charneca por aí...

Collect White Lilies#005.src: Unfortunately, all lilies close to town have been picked already. Do bring back the flowers to this post once you're done. Thank you!
Collect White Lilies#005.dst: Infelizmente, todos os lírios perto da cidade já foram colhidos. Traga as flores a este quadro quando terminar. Obrigado!

Collect White Lilies#006.src: Bring [{~} White Lilies] near Blossom trees in the {p} to the Slaying Post at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Collect White Lilies#006.dst: Leve [{~} Lírio branco] de perto das árvores floridas de {p} ao Quadro de caça em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Collect White Lilies#007.src: As you pick up this lonely flower, you feel light on your feet!
Collect White Lilies#007.dst: Ao colher esta flor solitária, você sente os pés leves!

Collect White Lilies#008.src: The board mentioned the flowers are really small and sparse. Make sure to look around patches of blossom trees...
Collect White Lilies#008.dst: O quadro dizia que as flores são bem pequenas e raras. Procure bem perto dos grupos de árvores floridas...

Collect White Lilies#009.src: You've gathered enough White Lilies. You should return to the Slaying Post to collect your reward.
Collect White Lilies#009.dst: Você colheu lírios brancos suficientes. Volte ao Quadro de caça para receber sua recompensa.

Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Cook Assistant#000.dst: Fale com o Cozinheiro em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#001.dst: O Rei me mandou assar bolos para todos os recrutas novos!
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#002.dst: Só que um Grook levou meu último bolo, e acabaram meus ingredientes!
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#004.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#004.dst: É o Grook! Vá atrás dele e recupere meu bolo!
Cook Assistant#004.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#006.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Cook Assistant#006.dst: O Grook fugiu! Volte ao Cozinheiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para decidir o que fazer.

Cook Assistant#007.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#007.dst: O que está fazendo? Vá atrás do Grook...
Cook Assistant#007.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#009.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#009.dst: Bem, acho que você vai ter que me ajudar a achar os ingredientes e assar outro...
Cook Assistant#009.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Cook Assistant#011.dst: Descubra para onde o Grook voou em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Cook Assistant#012.dst: Descubra para onde o Grook voou em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.
Cook Assistant#013.dst: Volte ao cozinheiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use um pergaminho para chegar mais rápido.

Cook Assistant#014.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Use a Scroll to get there faster
Cook Assistant#014.dst: Volte ao cozinheiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Um pergaminho é mais rápido

Cook Assistant#016.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#016.dst: Não sei como agradecer! Tome estas esmeraldas e armadura pelo trabalho.
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#017.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#017.dst: Explore por aí para ficar mais forte. Ouvi dizer que talvez haja trabalho em {p}.
Cook Assistant#017.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#018.src: I can't believe what is happening to me...
Cook Assistant#018.dst: Não acredito no que está havendo...

Cook Assistant#020.src: Wait! That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#020.dst: Espera! É o Grook! Vá atrás dele e recupere meu bolo!

Corrupted Betrayal#000.src: {u}, good to see you again! Been a while, huh?
Corrupted Betrayal#000.dst: {u}, que bom te ver de novo! Faz tempo, hein?

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: We've got a major problem with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#001.dst: Temos um problemão com esta fortaleza velha. Ela não para de cuspir esses malditos slimes, e tão perto de {p}, isso está dando confusão.
Corrupted Betrayal#001.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: You lean in close to read the riddle inscribed on the ancient stone...
Corrupted Betrayal#002.dst: Você se aproxima para ler o enigma gravado na pedra antiga...

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: You seem to have fallen into an ancient ruin of some sort. Maybe the incantation is somewhere inside...
Corrupted Betrayal#004.dst: Parece que você caiu numa espécie de ruína antiga. Talvez o encantamento esteja aqui dentro...

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: The King sought the help of a shaman, Slykaar. Shamans use the life of sacrifices to inflict damage. Dark magic.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.dst: O Rei buscou a ajuda de um xamã, Slykaar. Xamãs usam a vida de sacrifícios para causar dano. Magia sombria.

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Slykaar defended {p}. At an immense cost. Slykaar loved the attention and power. He controlled the city.
Corrupted Betrayal#006.dst: Slykaar defendeu {p}. A um custo imenso. Slykaar adorava a atenção e o poder. Ele controlava a cidade.

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: {p} had suffered from the hordes and from the endless sacrifices of Slykaar for years.
Corrupted Betrayal#007.dst: {p} sofreu por anos com as hordas e com os infindáveis sacrifícios de Slykaar.

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: Then... Bob appeared. The people of {p} instantly dropped their horrible shaman for the pure hero.
Corrupted Betrayal#008.dst: Então... Bob apareceu. O povo de {p} trocou na hora seu xamã horrível pelo herói puro.

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Slykaar, bitter and humiliated, sunk underground to restart his demonic experiments for an army.
Corrupted Betrayal#009.dst: Slykaar, amargo e humilhado, foi ao subsolo criar um exército com experimentos demoníacos.

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: It appears the mutant contained the key for that door.
Corrupted Betrayal#010.dst: Parece que o mutante carregava a chave daquela porta.

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: It's an old, dusty journal. It seems to be left open to a page. You begin to read it out of curiosity...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.dst: É um diário velho e empoeirado, deixado aberto numa página. Por curiosidade, você começa a ler...

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: ...{p} is beginning to grow suspicious of me...some guy named Robert came into town...
Corrupted Betrayal#012.dst: ...{p} começa a desconfiar de mim...um tal de Robert chegou à cidade...

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: ...I know they will banish me...he is too good...too nice...
Corrupted Betrayal#013.dst: ...sei que me banirão...ele é bom demais...gentil demais...

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: ...I must open a portal...make a dimension to become more powerful...
Corrupted Betrayal#014.dst: ...devo abrir um portal...criar uma dimensão para ter mais poder...

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: ...the books...I have prepared well for this...

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: ...I will carve a hidden room...behind a visible wall...to create my world...my revenge...
Corrupted Betrayal#016.dst: ...criarei uma sala oculta...atrás de um muro visível...meu mundo...minha vingança...

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: Go have fun while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.dst: Vá se divertir enquanto pode. Você nem tem muita vida pela frente, mesmo.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: You should head back to Lanu...

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of the cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#019.dst: Ah, voltou. Achou algo interessante? Eu fiquei aqui rebatendo um ou outro slime que saía da caverna.
Corrupted Betrayal#019.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: In {~} AP, {p} was on its knees. Hordes of undead were crippling the army and castle.
Corrupted Betrayal#020.dst: Em {~} AP, {p} estava de joelhos. Hordas de mortos-vivos arrasavam tropas e castelo.

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#022.dst: Ei, soldado! É, você! Tem um tempinho para dar uma mão?
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: Os soldados passam meia guarda picando esses bichos em gosma. O ideal seria invadir a caverna e cortar o mal pela raiz, mas...
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: Este lugar tem história. Coisa feia. Prefiro não entrar às cegas, então estou procurando pistas do que pode haver lá dentro.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#025.dst: Não achei muita coisa... só estes versos, gravados naquela parede ali. Vai, dá uma olhada e me diz o que acha.
Corrupted Betrayal#025.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: Bobagem, se quer saber. Devem ser crianças de {p} fazendo arte. Mas não achamos mais nada, então... se tiver um tempo, topa ir ver para mim?
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: O primeiro verso claramente fala do Great Bridge, mas não faço ideia do que o resto quer dizer. Vá até lá, dê uma olhada e me diga se achar algo interessante.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#028.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#028.dst: Já achou algo interessante sobre o enigma? Quer ouvir de novo?
Corrupted Betrayal#028.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#029.dst: Junto à ponte corrompida, uma ruína ao chão..
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: Vive uma ovelha maldita, cor de limão...
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: Leve-a pela trilha, até o slime do grotão...
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: Sacrifique sua alma, em sangue e podridão.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: Beleza. Me avise quando tiver alguma coisa, então.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: Use o enigma do mago para descobrir aonde ele leva

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: Se for para o Great Bridge, tenha cuidado nas planícies perto da entrada da selva.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: Recebi relatos de uma estranha ovelha maldita abrigada numa das ruínas mais fortificadas da região.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: Pelo que sei, o mato da selva a prende nas ruínas, mas se fosse cortado ela poderia escapar...
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: You find a tattered journal on the ground in front of this slimy cave. You skim through some of the pages...
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: Você acha um diário rasgado no chão, diante desta caverna gosmenta. Folheia algumas páginas...

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: ...this cave...for some reason it seems to erupt with fresh slime masses every minute...
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: ...esta caverna...por algum motivo parece expelir novas massas de slime a cada minuto...

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: ...the bottom...has a weird pit...maybe used to sacrifice something...
Corrupted Betrayal#040.dst: ...no fundo...há um poço estranho...talvez para sacrificar algo...

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: ...maybe...if you bring a mob there...by letting it follow you...you can do something...dark ...
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: ...talvez...se levar um mob até lá...deixando que te siga...dê para fazer algo...sombrio ...

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: Explore o templo em busca de um jeito de quebrar a barreira.

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: Vá à residência de Slykaar em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para descobrir o que está escondido lá.

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.dst: Por ordem da cidade de {p}, estou aqui para impedir que cidadãos entrem nesta casa.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: Pela experiência, todos que entraram nesta casa sumiram da existência...
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#046.dst: Eu não entraria, a menos que você saiba o que está fazendo.
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: Bem, imagino que saiba quem eu sou.

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.dst: Bem-vindo ao meu domínio. Sou Slykaar, herói de {p}.

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.dst: Bem, eu era. Banido pelas mesmas pessoas que pediram minha ajuda. Patético.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#050.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#050.dst: Não podiam ceder uns camponeses pela segurança? Fracos.
Corrupted Betrayal#050.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#052.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#052.dst: Pratiquei meu xamanismo por anos no subsolo para criar a mistura perfeita de monstro.
Corrupted Betrayal#052.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#053.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#053.dst: A maioria virou slimes horrendos. Agressivos e fortes, mas, ai, só slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#053.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#054.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#054.dst: Então achei este lugar. Terra sombria. Deus sombrio. Fonte de poder.
Corrupted Betrayal#054.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#055.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#055.dst: Vocês, magos medíocres, não fazem ideia do que este mundo guarda.
Corrupted Betrayal#055.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#056.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#056.dst: Todos almejam ser o herói dos heróis, “Bob”, mas eis a verdade. Ele está perdido. Você também.
Corrupted Betrayal#056.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#057.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#057.dst: Ninguém na província de Wynn aceita fazer os sacrifícios que faço por poder.
Corrupted Betrayal#057.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#058.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#058.dst: Se quer poder, precisa dar algo. Sacrifique poucos para salvar muitos.
Corrupted Betrayal#058.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#059.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#059.dst: Em {~}, aceitaram me dar uns camponeses, quando as hordas cruzaram a ponte.
Corrupted Betrayal#059.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#060.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#060.dst: O rei adorava jogar vidas fora para salvar a dele. Mas aí o herói de Wynn chegou todo pimpão anos depois.
Corrupted Betrayal#060.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#061.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#061.dst: Me baniram como fruta podre. Seu herói, seu protetor. E daí se umas centenas de zés-ninguém morreram por isso?
Corrupted Betrayal#061.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#062.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#062.dst: Um aspirante a Bob, pelo visto. Cópia pálida.
Corrupted Betrayal#062.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#063.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#063.dst: Então. Sinta-se à vontade para me visitar lá embaixo, traga todo o poder do exército de {p}. Não vai bastar.
Corrupted Betrayal#063.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#064.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#064.dst: Estou pronto. Logo {p} estará em ruínas. E terei minha vingança.
Corrupted Betrayal#064.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#065.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.
Corrupted Betrayal#065.dst: Conte a Lanu o que você descobriu.

Corrupted Betrayal#066.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#066.dst: Você... viu Slykaar? Em outra dimensão?!
Corrupted Betrayal#066.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#067.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#067.dst: Isso é ruim. Se consegue se materializar fora da caverna, mesmo que só na mente... está ficando mais forte. Explica os slimes, os ataques a {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#067.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#068.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#068.dst: Ele é um xamã poderosíssimo, {u}. Precisa ser detido, mas {p} levaria uma eternidade para mobilizar tropas contra ele.
Corrupted Betrayal#068.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#069.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends to watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#069.dst: Se puder, entre lá e... acabe com ele. Mas se equipe antes, e arrume amigos para te dar cobertura.
Corrupted Betrayal#069.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#070.src: {u}, how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#070.dst: {u}, como vai? Deu de cara com outra alucinação do xamã?
Corrupted Betrayal#070.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#071.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#071.dst: Enfim, boa sorte na caverna. Se decidir entrar, tome cuidado.
Corrupted Betrayal#071.speaker: Lanu

Cowfusion#001.src: Looks like Ranol's cows are being held in this pen... maybe there's a way to unlock the door around?
Cowfusion#001.dst: As vacas de Ranol parecem presas neste curral... será que há um jeito de abrir a porta por aqui?

Cowfusion#003.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#003.dst: Um Humano, é? Lá no fim do cânion? Ocê é dos duros.
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#004.dst: Quem sabe eu te arrumo um serviço, se ocê tá procurando? Alguém tá vindo e afanando minhas vacas!
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#005.dst: E eu sei bem quem é - aquele maldito cientista de vacas que mora no laboratório ao norte daqui.
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#006.dst: Enfim, topa o serviço? Num posso deixar ele roubar elas pra sempre!
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#007.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#007.dst: O laboratório dele na caverna fica logo ao norte. Num é difícil achar. Lá, faz ele devolver minhas vacas!
Cowfusion#007.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#008.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#008.dst: Mas tem um problema. A porta de lá vive fechada, então ocê vai ter que achar outro jeito de entrar.
Cowfusion#008.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#010.src: Maybe there's a way to open the door somewhere around..?
Cowfusion#010.dst: Será que há um jeito de abrir a porta por aqui..?

Cowfusion#011.src: Find a way into the Laboratory
Cowfusion#011.dst: Encontre um jeito de entrar no Laboratório

Cowfusion#012.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows
Cowfusion#012.dst: Procure as vacas desaparecidas no Laboratório

Cowfusion#013.src: Find a way to free the Cows.
Cowfusion#013.dst: Encontre um jeito de libertar as vacas.

Cowfusion#016.src: [!] You can no longer jump or cast spells.
Cowfusion#016.dst: [!] Não pode mais pular nem usar feitiços.

Cowfusion#017.src: Something feels wrong... you should head back to Ranol...
Cowfusion#017.dst: Algo parece errado... você deveria voltar a Ranol...

Cowfusion#019.src: What's this 'ere? Ibele, that you? My girl, I knew you'd come back to me!
Cowfusion#019.dst: Que é isso? Ibele, é ocê? Minha menina, sabia que ia voltar pra mim!
Cowfusion#019.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#020.src: And to think I was going to hire some city-dwellin' 'uman to get you for me? Ha!
Cowfusion#020.dst: E pensar que eu ia contratar um 'umano da cidade pra te buscar? Rá!
Cowfusion#020.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#021.src: Right then, back into the pen you go. Hup!
Cowfusion#021.dst: Muito bem, de volta pro curral. Upa!
Cowfusion#021.speaker: Ranol
