Echoes of Change#143.dst: Oh! Ótimo! Deu, hã, tudo certo, espero? Mora e Yuman se entenderam?
Echoes of Change#143.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#144.src: If they got the schedules, it was probably fine. So, {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#144.dst: Se conseguiram as escalas, deve ter dado certo. Então, {u}, veio nos ajudar também?
Echoes of Change#144.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#145.src: Hehe, I guess that's what happens when you show off all those skills of yours!
Echoes of Change#145.dst: Hehe, acho que é isso que acontece quando você exibe essas suas habilidades!
Echoes of Change#145.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#146.src: Yep! Oh, speaking of... {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#146.dst: É! Ah, falando nisso... {u}, veio nos ajudar também?
Echoes of Change#146.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#147.src: We've been putting together those explosives Syndra requested. I think we've decided on an easily produced model.
Echoes of Change#147.dst: Estamos montando os explosivos que a Syndra pediu. Acho que escolhemos um modelo fácil de produzir.
Echoes of Change#147.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#148.src: By, um, "we," he mostly means him. I can, ha, barely understand what he's going on about.
Echoes of Change#148.dst: Com, hã, "estamos", ele quer dizer mais ele. Eu, ha, mal entendo o que ele diz.
Echoes of Change#148.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#149.src: Hey, don't sell yourself short! You've been helpful! I would've never thought to utilize water in the design if it weren't for your suggestion.
Echoes of Change#149.dst: Ei, não se subestime! Você ajudou muito! Eu nunca teria pensado em usar água no projeto se não fosse sua sugestão.
Echoes of Change#149.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#150.src: Oh... thank you. {u}, we were playing around with the idea of hiding magical water inside the, um, explosive... but I, ah, don't know how to hold its power when I can't... see it.
Echoes of Change#150.dst: Oh... obrigada. {u}, pensamos em esconder água mágica dentro do, hã, explosivo... mas eu, ah, não sei como conter o poder dela se não consigo... vê-la.
Echoes of Change#150.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#152.src: Magic or not, using water in the design will make the explosion look more dangerous and powerful than it actually is! It's genius!
Echoes of Change#152.dst: Mágica ou não, usar água no projeto vai fazer a explosão parecer mais perigosa e potente do que realmente é! É genial!
Echoes of Change#152.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#153.src: Now, we just need to put it together...
Echoes of Change#153.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#154.src: Eheh. Maybe? I need to run some tests while it's being assembled, and Sui needs to stand guard in case it's about to actually explode.
Echoes of Change#154.dst: Hehe. Talvez? Preciso fazer uns testes enquanto montamos, e a Sui precisa vigiar caso esteja prestes a explodir de verdade.
Echoes of Change#154.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#155.src: If things go awry, I'll, um, surround it in a ball of water.
Echoes of Change#155.dst: Se der algo errado, eu, hã, envolvo ele numa bola de água.
Echoes of Change#155.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#156.src: Yep! Okay, no more questions, we've got to get to it! Click the explosive parts whenever you're ready.
Echoes of Change#156.dst: Isso! Beleza, chega de perguntas, temos que começar! Clique nas peças do explosivo quando quiser.
Echoes of Change#156.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#157.src: Help assemble the explosives inside the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#157.dst: Ajude a montar os explosivos dentro da oficina em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#158.src: (Coal Block): Can only be placed on the outer tiles.
Echoes of Change#158.dst: (Bloco de carvão): só pode ir nas casas externas.
Echoes of Change#158.speaker: Casing

Echoes of Change#159.src: (Dark Gray Concrete Powder): Can only be placed on the inner tiles.
Echoes of Change#159.dst: (Pó de concreto cinza-escuro): só pode ir nas casas internas.
Echoes of Change#159.speaker: Gunpowder

Echoes of Change#160.src: (White Wool Block): Must touch the orange chemical.
Echoes of Change#160.dst: (Bloco de lã branca): deve tocar o químico laranja.
Echoes of Change#160.speaker: Fuse

Echoes of Change#162.src: (Bone): Can remove any block from the board.
Echoes of Change#162.speaker: Wrench

Echoes of Change#163.src: Collect all pieces by finishing {~} puzzles!
Echoes of Change#163.dst: Resolva {~} quebra-cabeças e pegue as peças!
Echoes of Change#163.speaker: Bomb Piece

Echoes of Change#165.src: I think Sui and I will perform a few more tests... maybe a test run or two... but the construction went okay, so I should be able to produce some more.
Echoes of Change#165.dst: Acho que a Sui e eu vamos fazer mais alguns testes... talvez um ou dois ensaios... mas a montagem deu certo, então devo conseguir produzir mais.
Echoes of Change#165.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#166.src: And, eheh, hopefully not blow up my workshop...
Echoes of Change#166.dst: E, hehe, sem explodir a oficina, tomara...
Echoes of Change#166.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#167.src: Oh, no... {u}, are you sure you, um, can't stick around, a bit longer? Just, in case?
Echoes of Change#167.dst: Oh, não... {u}, tem certeza que, hã, não pode ficar mais um pouco? Só por precaução?
Echoes of Change#167.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#168.src: Nope, there's still stuff to do! On that subject - {u}, Rex was looking for you earlier.
Echoes of Change#168.dst: Não, ainda tem coisa pra fazer! Aliás - {u}, a Rex tava te procurando mais cedo.
Echoes of Change#168.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#169.src: Meet up with Zeph and Rex for the next assignment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#169.dst: Encontre Zeph e Rex para a próxima tarefa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#170.src: {u}, finally! There you are! I was getting restless.
Echoes of Change#170.dst: {u}, até que enfim! Aí está você! Já tava impaciente.
Echoes of Change#170.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#171.src: I w- was quite comfortable... actually.
Echoes of Change#171.dst: E- eu tava bem à vontade... na verdade.
Echoes of Change#171.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#172.src: Oh, are the nerves getting to you Zeph?
Echoes of Change#172.dst: Ah, os nervos estão te pegando, Zeph?
Echoes of Change#172.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#174.src: I- I know... But it f- fe- feels like everyone else is doing okay, while I- I'm not even doing an- any- anything, and I'm a- al- already panicking.
Echoes of Change#174.dst: E- eu sei... Mas p- pa- parece que todo mundo está bem, enquanto e- eu nem estou fazendo n- na- nada, e já e- es- estou em pânico.
Echoes of Change#174.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#175.src: Hey, everyone else is also feeling nervous, Zeph. Some of us are just... better at hiding it than others.
Echoes of Change#175.dst: Ei, todo mundo também está nervoso, Zeph. Alguns só... disfarçam melhor que outros.
Echoes of Change#175.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#177.src: Re- really? For some reason, that m- ma- makes me feel a lot better... uh, n- no offense!
Echoes of Change#177.dst: S- sério? Por algum motivo, isso m- me- me faz sentir muito melhor... hã, s- sem ofensa!
Echoes of Change#177.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#178.src: We're all nervous, Zeph. It's a risky plan. But we know what we're doing. We have to trust we'll succeed.
Echoes of Change#178.dst: Estamos todos nervosos, Zeph. O plano é arriscado. Mas sabemos o que fazemos. Temos que confiar.
Echoes of Change#178.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#179.src: Ha ha, v- ver- very funny, {u}. I- I- I'm trying. I am! It's just... hard not to be an- anxious.
Echoes of Change#179.dst: Haha, m- mu- muito engraçado, {u}. T- t- tô tentando. Tô mesmo! Só é difícil não ficar an- ansioso.
Echoes of Change#179.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#180.src: You're fine, Zeph. I'd be surprised if you weren't anxious, honestly. Given what we're planning on doing...
Echoes of Change#180.dst: Você está bem, Zeph. Sinceramente, eu estranharia se não estivesse ansioso. Com o que planejamos...
Echoes of Change#180.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#181.src: I g- guess... It's all just st- st- starting to sink in.
Echoes of Change#181.dst: A- acho... É que a ficha está c- ca- caindo agora.
Echoes of Change#181.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#182.src: Look, the more you think about it, the worse it'll get. Accept the feeling for what it is, then put it aside for now.
Echoes of Change#182.dst: Olha, quanto mais você pensa, pior fica. Aceite o que sente e deixe isso de lado por enquanto.
Echoes of Change#182.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#183.src: We've got work to do, and... we really can't afford to screw it up.
Echoes of Change#183.dst: Temos trabalho a fazer e... não podemos nos dar ao luxo de errar.
Echoes of Change#183.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#184.dst: V- vou dar o meu melhor.
Echoes of Change#184.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#185.src: That's all I ask. Anyway, {u}, Zeph and I looked over the schedules with Syndra earlier. We've marked a couple of spots we want to check out.
Echoes of Change#185.dst: É só o que peço. Enfim, {u}, Zeph e eu vimos as escalas com a Syndra mais cedo. Marcamos uns pontos que queremos conferir.
Echoes of Change#185.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#186.src: So- s- so let's go see them in person! Uh, Rex, I c- ca- can carry the arrows and electric ch- charges for you.
Echoes of Change#186.dst: E- e- então vamos vê-los pessoalmente! Hã, Rex, e- eu p- po- posso levar as flechas e as cargas elétricas.
Echoes of Change#186.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#188.src: ...and those are the faces I usually see around, so-
Echoes of Change#188.dst: ...e essas são as caras que costumo ver por aí, então-
Echoes of Change#188.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#189.src: Ah- Rex, Zeph, and {u}! Rather auspicious timing.
Echoes of Change#189.dst: Ah- Rex, Zeph e {u}! Que momento oportuno.
Echoes of Change#189.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#190.src: Oh, hey! Have you seen the guard schedules yet?
Echoes of Change#190.dst: Oh, oi! Já viram as escalas da guarda?
Echoes of Change#190.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#191.src: We have, yep. Quill and I were just talking about some of the escape routes I had in mind.
Echoes of Change#191.dst: Já vimos, sim. Quill e eu falávamos de umas rotas de fuga que pensei.
Echoes of Change#191.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#192.src: Are you heading out for your assignment then?
Echoes of Change#192.dst: Então estão indo fazer sua tarefa?
Echoes of Change#192.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#193.src: We were j- just about to head to {p} for ours, too. P- per- perhaps we could go there together?
Echoes of Change#193.dst: A gente ia a- agora mesmo a {p} fazer a nossa. T- tal- talvez a gente possa ir junto?
Echoes of Change#193.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#194.src: Hmm... yes, I suppose we could- though, I'll want {u}'s opinion on our ideas as well. Once you finish with Rex and Zeph, would you care to join us?
Echoes of Change#194.dst: Hmm... sim, acho que sim- mas também quero a opinião de {u} sobre nossas ideias. Quando acabar com Rex e Zeph, nos acompanha?
Echoes of Change#194.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#195.src: Then let's get going. No time to waste.
Echoes of Change#195.dst: Então vamos. Sem tempo a perder.
Echoes of Change#195.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#196.src: Find Zeph and Rex in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#196.dst: Encontre Zeph e Rex em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#197.src: Rex, please don't pick the highest rooftops.
Echoes of Change#197.dst: Rex, por favor, nada dos telhados mais altos.
Echoes of Change#197.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#198.src: You better not pick out the highest roof tops. I'm not sure I can get up that far.
Echoes of Change#198.dst: É bom você não escolher os telhados mais altos. Não sei se consigo subir tanto.
Echoes of Change#198.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#199.src: I'm just not sure I'd be able to climb up to them.
Echoes of Change#199.dst: Só não sei se conseguiria subir até eles.
Echoes of Change#199.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#200.src: Well, Yuman seems to do it just fine! But okay, I'll pick out something more accessible for you.
Echoes of Change#200.dst: Bom, o Yuman parece se virar bem! Mas tá, vou escolher algo mais acessível pra você.
Echoes of Change#200.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#202.src: Hm... {u}, I don't suppose you would happen to have seen Jiro?
Echoes of Change#202.dst: Hm... {u}, por acaso você não viu o Jiro?
Echoes of Change#202.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#203.src: Syndra told me he had gone looking for me, but I haven't seen him all day!
Echoes of Change#203.dst: A Syndra disse que ele foi me procurar, mas não o vi o dia todo!
Echoes of Change#203.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#204.src: Well, I suppose I can always find him after we're done here. No need to delay this any longer.
Echoes of Change#204.dst: Bem, acho que posso encontrá-lo quando terminarmos aqui. Não há por que adiar mais.
Echoes of Change#204.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#205.src: Just one more day... a- a- and then it'll be done. I can m- make it that far.
Echoes of Change#205.dst: Só mais um dia... e- e- e aí acaba. Eu a- aguento até lá.
Echoes of Change#205.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#206.src: T- took you a bit, huh?
Echoes of Change#206.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#207.src: Great, you're here! Slowpoke. I thought Zeph's races in the {p} would've prepared you for this!
Echoes of Change#207.dst: Ótimo, você chegou! Lesma. Achei que as corridas do Zeph por {p} tinham te preparado pra isso!
Echoes of Change#207.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#208.src: Quill and Yulie? They've started on their assignment already. Quill said to tell you to just join up with them once you're done here.
Echoes of Change#208.dst: Quill e Yulie? Já começaram a tarefa deles. O Quill pediu pra você se juntar a eles quando terminar aqui.
Echoes of Change#208.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#210.src: Ha! Or m- ma- maybe you're too slow!
Echoes of Change#210.dst: Ha! Ou v- vo- você que é devagar!
Echoes of Change#210.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#211.src: We should get started, before we draw any attention towards ourselves... I've got the map here. Zeph and I have marked out two locations.
Echoes of Change#211.dst: Devíamos começar, antes de chamar atenção... Tenho o mapa aqui. Zeph e eu marcamos dois lugares.
Echoes of Change#211.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#212.src: We're ch- checking both, since we wanted to sp- split Rex and Yulie on two different v- vantage points.
Echoes of Change#212.dst: Vamos c- conferir os dois, pra se- separar Rex e Yulie em dois p- pontos de observação.
Echoes of Change#212.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#213.src: I'll p- point them out for you! Ready?
Echoes of Change#213.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#216.src: Always a second with you... fine, just let us know when you are ready.
Echoes of Change#216.dst: Sempre um segundo com você... tá, avisa quando der.
Echoes of Change#216.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#217.dst: O primeiro fica l- lá em cima...
Echoes of Change#217.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#218.src: And there's the s- sec- second one!
Echoes of Change#218.dst: E ali está o s- se- segundo!
Echoes of Change#218.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#219.src: Okay. Let's g- get to work!
Echoes of Change#219.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#220.src: Here, Zeph, hand me those arrows. Keep the charges though, I think your point would be better for Yulie.
Echoes of Change#220.dst: Aqui, Zeph, me passa essas flechas. Mas fica com as cargas, acho que seu ponto é melhor pro Yulie.
Echoes of Change#220.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#221.src: Sure... w- wait, why do we need {u} for this?
Echoes of Change#221.dst: Claro... p- peraí, pra que precisamos de {u}?
Echoes of Change#221.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#222.src: To check our work, I guess? They can help assess the vantage points. Maybe they'll spot some potential issues we missed.
Echoes of Change#222.dst: Pra conferir nosso trabalho, acho? Pode ajudar a avaliar os pontos. Talvez note algum problema que deixamos passar.
Echoes of Change#222.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#224.src: Just make your way up however you can!
Echoes of Change#224.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#225.src: Get to the top of the two buildings at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#225.dst: Chegue ao topo dos dois prédios em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#226.src: Yeah, hey. Not much fer conversation today, 'm afraid.
Echoes of Change#226.dst: É, oi. Hoje não tô pra papo, foi mal.
Echoes of Change#226.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#227.src: This job's gonna be the death a' me eventually. If it's not slippin off the ledge, 's gonna be breakin' my damn back.
Echoes of Change#227.dst: Esse serviço ainda vai me matar. Se não for escorregar da beirada, vai ser quebrar a droga das costas.
Echoes of Change#227.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#228.src: Beggars can't be choosers though, huh? Literally, in my case...
Echoes of Change#228.dst: Mas quem pede não escolhe, né? No meu caso, literalmente...
Echoes of Change#228.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#231.src: Ha! Well, o- of course I am! I can't let y- you start beating me... I ha- have an image to maintain!
Echoes of Change#231.dst: Ha! Bem, c- claro que cheguei! Não posso deixar v- você me vencer... t- tenho uma imagem a zelar!
Echoes of Change#231.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#232.src: B- but you didn't! Maybe next time... wh- what are we at now? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#232.dst: M- mas não ganhou! Quem sabe da próxima... c- qual o placar? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#232.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#233.src: Ha... so, th- this is the spot.
Echoes of Change#233.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#234.src: This should c- co- cover Rex's blind spots well enough...
Echoes of Change#234.dst: Isso deve c- co- cobrir bem os pontos cegos da Rex...
Echoes of Change#234.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#235.src: What do you th- think? Does it look okay?
Echoes of Change#235.dst: O que você a- acha? Parece bom?
Echoes of Change#235.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#236.src: Perfect! So are we g- good then?
Echoes of Change#236.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#237.src: Well... I- I guess it is a little high up for Y- Yulie... but I think it's fine.
Echoes of Change#237.dst: Bem... a- acho que é meio alto pro Y- Yulie... mas tudo bem.
Echoes of Change#237.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#238.src: Let me p- put down the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#238.dst: Vou d- deixar o equipamento aqui...
Echoes of Change#238.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#239.src: Hey... if you h- hurry, you can make it to the other spot be- before Rex does!
Echoes of Change#239.dst: Ei... se você se a- apressar, chega no outro ponto a- antes da Rex!
Echoes of Change#239.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#240.src: She's n-never been the most agile...
Echoes of Change#240.dst: Ela n- nunca foi das mais ágeis...
Echoes of Change#240.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#241.src: Uh, d- don't tell her I said that!!!
Echoes of Change#241.dst: N- não conta pra ela que eu disse!!!
Echoes of Change#241.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#243.src: I saw you beat R- Rex earlier! Not like that's hard, th- though!
Echoes of Change#243.dst: Vi você vencer a R- Rex agora há pouco! Não que seja d- difícil!
Echoes of Change#243.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#244.src: But since we're done here... it's t- time for you to assist Quill and Yulie, Superhero.
Echoes of Change#244.dst: Mas já que terminamos aqui... é h- hora de ajudar o Quill e o Yulie, Super-herói.
Echoes of Change#244.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#245.src: ...heh. I- I should go get some more pr- practice in, though... before tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#245.dst: ...heh. E- eu devia ir t- treinar mais um pouco... antes de amanhã.
Echoes of Change#245.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#246.src: Quill and Yulie are out- outside Sovereign Soosu's mansion, by the way.
Echoes of Change#246.dst: Aliás, Quill e Yulie estão f- fo- fora da mansão da Soberana Soosu.
Echoes of Change#246.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#247.src: I'll be there in a second!
Echoes of Change#247.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#248.src: Phew... well, seems like you got here before me.
Echoes of Change#248.dst: Ufa... bem, parece que você chegou antes de mim.
Echoes of Change#248.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#249.src: Oh. Thanks. But you've seen me do better!
Echoes of Change#249.dst: Oh. Valeu. Mas você já me viu fazer melhor!
Echoes of Change#249.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#250.dst: Pff. Tá, que seja. E daí?
Echoes of Change#250.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#251.src: Hm... would you agree this spot overlooks the whole square?
Echoes of Change#251.dst: Hm... você diria que este ponto tem vista da praça toda?
Echoes of Change#251.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#252.src: From what I've heard, the festival always takes place right here. And this looks like it gives us a pretty good coverage of the area...
Echoes of Change#252.dst: Pelo que ouvi, o festival sempre acontece bem aqui. E daqui parece que temos uma boa cobertura da área...
Echoes of Change#252.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#254.src: Just... okay? You're sure? If you have any concerns, speak up.
Echoes of Change#254.dst: Só... bom? Tem certeza? Se tiver alguma dúvida, fala.
Echoes of Change#254.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#255.src: ...no? You're just gonna go mute? Okay. Sure.
Echoes of Change#255.dst: ...não? Não vai dizer nada? Tá. Beleza.
Echoes of Change#255.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#256.src: Really? Well, if you say so.
Echoes of Change#256.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#257.src: I guess that means our work here is done!
Echoes of Change#257.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#258.src: Just gotta leave the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#258.dst: Só falta deixar o equipamento aqui...
Echoes of Change#258.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#259.src: Alright! That's my part done, but you've still got to assess Zeph's location.
Echoes of Change#259.dst: Beleza! Minha parte está feita, mas você ainda precisa avaliar o ponto do Zeph.
Echoes of Change#259.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#260.src: I'll head down and wait for him to be done. I'll see you back at the Steel Feather, I guess.
Echoes of Change#260.dst: Vou descer e esperar ele terminar. A gente se vê na Pluma de Aço, acho.
Echoes of Change#260.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#261.src: Good luck with Quill and Yulie. That's the last bit of preparation we have to do, right?
Echoes of Change#261.dst: Boa sorte com o Quill e o Yulie. É a última preparação que falta, né?
Echoes of Change#261.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#263.src: Alright! That's my part done... and I saw you over with Zeph earlier, too.
Echoes of Change#263.dst: Beleza! Minha parte está feita... e vi você com o Zeph mais cedo também.
Echoes of Change#263.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#264.src: So I think that means we're done. I'll go get Zeph and head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#264.dst: Então acho que terminamos. Vou buscar o Zeph e voltar para a Pluma de Aço.
Echoes of Change#264.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#265.src: I need to get some practice in before tomorrow... I know the plan shouldn't involve any fighting, but... in case things go wrong, I need to be sure I can hit my shots when it counts.
Echoes of Change#265.dst: Preciso treinar antes de amanhã... Sei que o plano não deve envolver luta, mas... se algo der errado, tenho que acertar meus tiros quando importar.
Echoes of Change#265.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#266.src: I think I saw Quill and Yulie out by Sovereign Soosu's mansion. So, go find them! Don't keep them waiting!
Echoes of Change#266.dst: Acho que vi o Quill e o Yulie perto da mansão da Soberana Soosu. Então vai lá! Não deixe eles esperando!
Echoes of Change#266.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#268.src: Ah, {u}! I take it you have finished up with Rex and Zeph?
Echoes of Change#268.dst: Ah, {u}! Imagino que já terminou com Rex e Zeph?
Echoes of Change#268.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#269.src: We've been trying to get an idea of the general feel of the coming festival.
Echoes of Change#269.dst: Estávamos tentando sentir o clima do festival que vem aí.
Echoes of Change#269.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#270.src: As with every year, people usually just see it as a day off of work. That's all it really is for them.
Echoes of Change#270.dst: Como todo ano, o povo costuma ver como um dia de folga. É só isso pra eles, na verdade.
Echoes of Change#270.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#271.src: Rather different from what you had experienced in the {p}, yes? The people there see their festival as a way to celebrate their culture.
Echoes of Change#271.dst: Bem diferente do que você viveu em {p}, não? Lá o povo vê o festival como um jeito de celebrar sua cultura.
Echoes of Change#271.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#272.src: Hm... that's hard to imagine. Though, in a way, I guess the Roughworks festival also celebrates our culture... just, only the part of it about working hard.
Echoes of Change#272.dst: Hm... difícil de imaginar. Mas, de certa forma, o festival de Roughworks também celebra nossa cultura... só a parte de trabalhar duro.
Echoes of Change#272.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#273.src: Indeed... indeed. Well, as we are all here, let us begin the task. According to the map, we have three possible escape routes to scout out.
Echoes of Change#273.dst: De fato... de fato. Bem, como estamos todos aqui, vamos começar. Segundo o mapa, temos três possíveis rotas de fuga para explorar.
Echoes of Change#273.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#274.src: And they're the ones most likely to be optimal, with the information from the guard schedules... alright. Let's head to the first location then.
Echoes of Change#274.dst: E são as mais propensas a ser ideais, segundo as escalas da guarda... certo. Vamos ao primeiro local, então.
Echoes of Change#274.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#276.src: First on the list... our tunnel.
Echoes of Change#276.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#277.src: The reason it's been so safe for us all this time is 'cause the place is always empty.
Echoes of Change#277.dst: O motivo de ter sido tão seguro esse tempo todo é que o lugar está sempre vazio.
Echoes of Change#277.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#278.src: It's still a developing area in the city, so people rarely come here.
Echoes of Change#278.dst: Ainda é uma área em obras da cidade, então quase ninguém vem aqui.
Echoes of Change#278.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#279.src: And according to our guard schedules... it should remain unguarded during the festival, as well.
Echoes of Change#279.dst: E segundo as escalas da guarda... também deve ficar sem vigilância durante o festival.
Echoes of Change#279.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#280.src: {u}, why don't you have a look around?
Echoes of Change#280.dst: {u}, por que não dá uma olhada?
Echoes of Change#280.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#281.src: Assess the first escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#281.dst: Avalie a primeira rota de fuga em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#286.src: Why are you even here? Don't you have work to do? Tomorrow is a VERY special day.
Echoes of Change#286.dst: Por que você está aqui? Não tem trabalho? Amanhã é um dia MUITO especial.
Echoes of Change#286.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#288.src: Well LUCKY you!!!!!! But SOME of us have work to do!!!!! What do you want?!
Echoes of Change#288.dst: QUE SORTE a sua!!!!!! Mas ALGUNS de nós trabalham!!!!! O que você quer?!
Echoes of Change#288.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#290.src: Thoughts? You interrupted my work to ask about my THOUGHTS?
Echoes of Change#290.dst: O que acho? Você parou meu trabalho pra saber o que eu ACHO?
Echoes of Change#290.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#291.src: I mean... if you really want to know. It's great! A day of NO work. You know what that means!
Echoes of Change#291.dst: Quer dizer... se quer mesmo saber. É ótimo! Um dia SEM trabalho. Sabe o que isso significa!
Echoes of Change#291.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#292.src: I get to dust off my Roughworks Vodka and not worry for {~} hours! Great days ahead, I tell ya!
Echoes of Change#292.dst: Vou tirar o pó da minha Vodca de Roughworks e esquecer tudo por {~} horas! Vêm aí dias ótimos!
Echoes of Change#292.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#293.src: Have a look around, {u}. Perhaps you'll find something which compromises this option.
Echoes of Change#293.dst: Dê uma olhada, {u}. Talvez encontre algo que comprometa esta opção.
Echoes of Change#293.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#295.src: Hm... seems fine, all things considered. Let's get to the next option. It's on the other side of the city.
Echoes of Change#295.dst: Hm... parece bom, considerando tudo. Vamos à próxima opção. Fica do outro lado da cidade.
Echoes of Change#295.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#296.src: Head to the second escape point at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#296.dst: Vá ao segundo ponto de fuga em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#297.src: Hm... the map tells me it should be around here somewhere, but... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#297.dst: Hm... o mapa diz que deve ser por aqui, mas... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#297.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#298.src: Right, this one. The plan was to escape using the underground river.
Echoes of Change#298.dst: Isso, este. O plano era fugir pelo rio subterrâneo.
Echoes of Change#298.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#299.src: This path should lead us to it, I think.
Echoes of Change#299.dst: Acho que este caminho leva até ele.
Echoes of Change#299.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#301.src: It... might require us to, ah, dive through a small underwater section.
Echoes of Change#301.dst: Talvez... tenhamos que, ah, mergulhar num trecho curto debaixo d'água.
Echoes of Change#301.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#303.src: Look, it's perfectly safe! Mostly. I've tried it before, it works!
Echoes of Change#303.dst: Olha, é totalmente seguro! Quase. Já testei, funciona!
Echoes of Change#303.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#304.src: Oh, dear. Do I want to know why?
Echoes of Change#304.dst: Ai, ai. Eu quero saber por quê?
Echoes of Change#304.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#305.src: Work stuff... an investigation led me to it. A thief had used it to escape the city- it's not important.
Echoes of Change#305.dst: Coisas do trabalho... uma investigação me levou lá. Um ladrão usou pra fugir da cidade- não importa.
Echoes of Change#305.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#306.src: I see. Let's mark this one as our lowest priority. Only to be used in case of emergencies.
Echoes of Change#306.dst: Entendo. Vamos marcar esta como a de menor prioridade. Só para emergências.
Echoes of Change#306.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#307.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#307.dst: Mas vale dar uma olhada mesmo assim. {u}, talvez você encontre algo.
Echoes of Change#307.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#308.src: Assess the second escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#308.dst: Avalie a segunda rota de fuga em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#309.src: Bless you, child. I hope her Majesty brings you health.
Echoes of Change#309.dst: Bênçãos a você, criança. Que Sua Majestade te dê saúde.
Echoes of Change#309.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#310.src: Her Majesty sure is powerful. And tomorrow... it's her big day.
Echoes of Change#310.dst: Sua Majestade é mesmo poderosa. E amanhã... é o grande dia dela.
Echoes of Change#310.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#311.src: And I get to see her! Bless us all.
Echoes of Change#311.dst: E eu vou vê-la! Bênçãos a todos nós.
Echoes of Change#311.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#312.dst: O que te traz aqui, criança?
Echoes of Change#312.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#315.src: Do you like how I have decorated my palace. And my most priced possession... my own personal symbol of her Majesty of Fruma!
Echoes of Change#315.dst: Gosta de como decorei meu palácio? E meu bem mais precioso... meu próprio símbolo de Sua Majestade de Fruma!
Echoes of Change#315.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#316.src: She is great, don't you agree? And all that she has done for us, her children.
Echoes of Change#316.dst: Ela é grandiosa, não acha? E tudo o que fez por nós, seus filhos.
Echoes of Change#316.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#317.src: Unfortunately I am a bad subject, a very very bad subject! I couldn't work due to my illness... And... I lost my original home - the much worse version.
Echoes of Change#317.dst: Infelizmente sou um súdito ruim, muito muito ruim! Não podia trabalhar por causa da doença... E... perdi minha casa original - a versão muito pior.
Echoes of Change#317.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#318.src: This home is much more homely.
Echoes of Change#318.dst: Esta casa é bem mais aconchegante.
Echoes of Change#318.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#319.src: Her orders made you lose you
Echoes of Change#319.dst: Por ordem dela você perdeu s

Echoes of Change#321.src: That was my own fault for being lazy and worthless. But now! Now I've devoted myself to her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#321.dst: Foi culpa minha, por ser preguiçoso e inútil. Mas agora! Agora me dediquei a Sua Majestade.
Echoes of Change#321.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#322.src: She is the reason I'm alive and well! She even cured my mental illness. I feel much better now.
Echoes of Change#322.dst: Ela é o motivo de eu estar vivo e bem! Até curou minha doença mental. Me sinto bem melhor agora.
Echoes of Change#322.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#323.src: It's absolutely splendid! A whole day of getting to celebrate her majesty... Nothing could beat that.
Echoes of Change#323.dst: É absolutamente esplêndido! Um dia inteiro para celebrar Sua Majestade... Nada supera isso.
Echoes of Change#323.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#324.src: Every festival brings me closer to her. I even feel like I will soon join her in the capital!
Echoes of Change#324.dst: Cada festival me aproxima dela. Sinto até que logo vou me juntar a ela na capital!
Echoes of Change#324.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#325.src: Join her as her right hand by the throne!
Echoes of Change#325.dst: Ser o braço direito dela, ao lado do trono!
Echoes of Change#325.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#328.src: Hah... Since when did you tu - turn - turn into two people!
Echoes of Change#328.dst: Hah... Desde quando você vi - vir - virou duas pessoas!
Echoes of Change#328.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#329.src: Well yeees... Of course it is! *hic*
Echoes of Change#329.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#330.src: Do - d- do you like it? Smells quite freshhhh.
Echoes of Change#330.dst: Vo - v- você gosta? Cheira bem fresquiiinho.
Echoes of Change#330.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#331.src: Oh I feel like I ne- need to... hurl... *burp*
Echoes of Change#331.dst: Ai, acho que vou... v- vomitar... *arroto*
Echoes of Change#331.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#333.src: Oh! That one... Ya know, I don't even know what year it is anymore.
Echoes of Change#333.dst: Ah! Esse... Sabe, nem sei mais em que ano estamos.
Echoes of Change#333.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#334.src: None of of it matters anymore. This is my life n-now!
Echoes of Change#334.dst: Nada disso disso importa. Esta é minha vida a-agora!
Echoes of Change#334.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#335.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#335.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#336.src: Alright... to the final spot, then. The gate to the {p}.
Echoes of Change#336.dst: Certo... para o último lugar, então. O portão para {p}.
Echoes of Change#336.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#337.src: Head to the third escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#337.dst: Vá à terceira rota de fuga em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#338.src: Sigh... our last stop. That wall, always looming over me...
Echoes of Change#338.dst: Ai... última parada. Aquele muro sempre pairando sobre mim...
Echoes of Change#338.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#340.src: Yes, yes. I'm alright. {u}... is something on your mind?
Echoes of Change#340.dst: Sim, sim. Estou bem. {u}... algo te preocupa?
Echoes of Change#340.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#341.src: Ah... yes. I understand your meaning.
Echoes of Change#341.dst: Ah... sim. Entendo o que quer dizer.
Echoes of Change#341.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#342.src: But... we do not have the space to house all of these people. No matter how much I wish we could.
Echoes of Change#342.dst: Mas... não temos espaço para abrigar toda essa gente. Por mais que eu quisesse.
Echoes of Change#342.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#343.src: Some of these people also refuse to accept our help. They're too deeply rooted in the Roughworks' work culture.
Echoes of Change#343.dst: Alguns também recusam nossa ajuda. Estão enraizados demais na cultura de trabalho de Roughworks.
Echoes of Change#343.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#344.src: I was one of them, once. My brothers and I, we used to live around there. After... well, we didn't have anywhere else to go.
Echoes of Change#344.dst: Eu já fui um deles. Meus irmãos e eu morávamos por ali. Depois... bem, não tínhamos outro lugar pra ir.
Echoes of Change#344.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#345.src: When Quill offered to take us off the street, I... almost declined the offer. I didn't need his pity, I thought. I was supporting our family just fine.
Echoes of Change#345.dst: Quando o Quill se ofereceu pra nos tirar da rua, eu... quase recusei. Não precisava da pena dele, pensei. Eu sustentava nossa família muito bem.
Echoes of Change#345.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#346.src: ...but I remembered our parents. How our mother worked three jobs just to keep our house. How even those jobs weren't enough, and eventually... she fell ill.
Echoes of Change#346.dst: ...mas lembrei dos nossos pais. De como nossa mãe tinha três empregos só pra manter a casa. De como nem isso bastava, e no fim... ela adoeceu.
Echoes of Change#346.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#348.src: I realized... that was where I was heading. Working myself to death, and- and for what? Then they'd be left on their own anyway.
Echoes of Change#348.dst: Percebi... que era pra lá que eu ia. Me matando de trabalhar, e- e pra quê? Eles ficariam sozinhos de qualquer jeito.
Echoes of Change#348.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#349.src: For what it is worth, I am deeply glad you chose to come with me, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#349.dst: Se serve de algo, fico muito feliz que tenha escolhido vir comigo, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#349.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#350.src: ...yeah. It's hard accepting help when you're in that position, is all. It's easier to turn to substances to keep working, to survive...
Echoes of Change#350.dst: ...é. É difícil aceitar ajuda nessa situação, só isso. É mais fácil apelar pra substâncias pra seguir trabalhando, pra sobreviver...
Echoes of Change#350.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#351.src: But that's what we're doing all this for, isn't it? To build a better Fruma.
Echoes of Change#351.dst: Mas é por isso que fazemos tudo isso, né? Pra construir uma Fruma melhor.
Echoes of Change#351.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#352.src: ...hm. I believe someone is about to pass through the gate.
Echoes of Change#352.dst: ...hm. Acho que alguém vai passar pelo portão.
Echoes of Change#352.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#353.src: What? More guards for the festival? Or-
Echoes of Change#353.dst: O quê? Mais guardas pro festival? Ou-
Echoes of Change#353.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#354.src: I'm not certain, Yulie. But we should avoid being spotted.
Echoes of Change#354.dst: Não tenho certeza, Yulie. Mas devemos evitar ser vistos.
Echoes of Change#354.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#356.src: You're the newest addition to our set, then. Good punctuality- You've made a good first impression.
Echoes of Change#356.dst: Então você é o mais novo do nosso grupo. Boa pontualidade- Você causou uma boa primeira impressão.
Echoes of Change#356.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#357.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I was... told I would be meeting Sovereign Soosu here?
Echoes of Change#357.dst: Soberano Zhiraok. Me... disseram que eu encontraria a Soberana Soosu aqui?
Echoes of Change#357.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#358.src: Attention to formalities is good too, but no need to stand on ceremony right now, alright? Soosu, we'll meet in a short while.
Echoes of Change#358.dst: Atenção às formalidades também é bom, mas não precisa de tanta cerimônia agora, tá? A Soosu, vamos ver daqui a pouco.
Echoes of Change#358.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#359.src: But as for you- Tasim, correct? This'll be your first time visiting {p}? It's the province's central hub for technological development. Needs work, but what do you think?
Echoes of Change#359.dst: Mas quanto a você- Tasim, certo? É sua primeira vez em {p}? É o centro de desenvolvimento tecnológico da província. Precisa de melhorias, mas o que acha?
Echoes of Change#359.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#360.src: It is, yes...ah, to both your questions. I don't think I've ever seen anything this... densely packed! It definitely leaves an impression.
Echoes of Change#360.dst: É, sim... ah, às duas perguntas. Acho que nunca vi nada tão... apinhado! Com certeza impressiona.
Echoes of Change#360.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#361.src: I, ah... appreciate the help getting adjusted to all this. I'm still getting used to... holding this authority, I guess. I'm not sure I'm comfortable having the soldiers defer to me yet.
Echoes of Change#361.dst: Eu, ah... agradeço a ajuda para me adaptar a tudo isso. Ainda me acostumo a... ter essa autoridade, acho. Não me sinto à vontade com os soldados me obedecendo.
Echoes of Change#361.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#362.src: I was in the same position as you once too. {~} years seems long, especially to me, but compared to the rest? I'm barely on the board. You'll get used to it, so don't worry.
Echoes of Change#362.dst: Eu também já estive na sua posição. {~} anos parece muito, ainda mais pra mim, mas comparado aos outros? Mal entrei no jogo. Você vai se acostumar, não se preocupe.
Echoes of Change#362.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#363.src: On that tangent... How's your recovery been? I remember how taxing ascension was for me... But you look like you're taking to it naturally.
Echoes of Change#363.dst: Falando nisso... Como vai a recuperação? Lembro como a ascensão foi desgastante pra mim... Mas você parece lidar com isso com naturalidade.
Echoes of Change#363.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#364.src: I'm... getting there. The blessing's a little strange, but it's not unlike what I was already able to do. I just need to practice using it.
Echoes of Change#364.dst: Estou... chegando lá. A bênção é meio estranha, mas não é tão diferente do que eu já conseguia fazer. Só preciso praticar.
Echoes of Change#364.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#365.src: Golden! I know how tough being the newest can be, so don't be afraid to ask me if you need help solving for your own problems.
Echoes of Change#365.dst: Ótimo! Sei como é difícil ser o novato, então não tenha medo de me pedir ajuda para resolver seus próprios problemas.
Echoes of Change#365.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#366.src: Speaking of... How's that project you were scouted for? Her Majesty and the Spymaster haven't shown their work to the rest of the class yet.
Echoes of Change#366.dst: Falando nisso... Como vai o projeto pelo qual te recrutaram? Sua Majestade e a Mestra dos Espiões ainda não mostraram o trabalho ao resto da turma.
Echoes of Change#366.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#367.src: I've been filled in on the details already, but Her Majesty wants me to fully recover before we start.
Echoes of Change#367.dst: Já me passaram os detalhes, mas Sua Majestade quer que eu me recupere totalmente antes de começarmos.
Echoes of Change#367.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#368.src: I can tell you more later. You said you'd be able to bring me to Sovereign Soosu?
Echoes of Change#368.dst: Posso te contar mais depois. Você disse que poderia me levar até a Soberana Soosu?
Echoes of Change#368.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#369.src: I'll put a pin in that, then. I think she'll be reaching the end of her sequence on whatever she was working on by now... Follow me, her mansion's this way.
Echoes of Change#369.dst: Fica para depois, então. Acho que ela já deve estar terminando a sequência do que estava fazendo... Me siga, a mansão dela é por aqui.
Echoes of Change#369.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#370.src: Talk to Yulie and Quill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#370.dst: Fale com Yulie e Quill em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#372.src: Indeed... we already had two Sovereigns to concern ourselves with. And now, a third.
Echoes of Change#372.dst: De fato... já tínhamos dois Soberanos com que nos preocupar. E agora, um terceiro.
Echoes of Change#372.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#373.src: He's not one of the Sovereigns I know about... is he new?
Echoes of Change#373.dst: Ele não é um dos Soberanos que conheço... é novo?
Echoes of Change#373.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#374.src: Perhaps... but this could be a problem. We know nothing about this new Sovereign...
Echoes of Change#374.dst: Talvez... mas isso pode ser um problema. Não sabemos nada sobre esse novo Soberano...
Echoes of Change#374.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#375.dst: Você- o quê?! De onde? Auburn?
Echoes of Change#375.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#376.src: Hm... no, Syndra would have mentioned him if he were from the {p}.
Echoes of Change#376.dst: Hm... não, a Syndra teria falado dele se fosse de {p}.
Echoes of Change#376.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#378.src: You have Sovereign friends...? Why? How?
Echoes of Change#378.dst: Tem amigos Soberanos...? Por quê? Como?
Echoes of Change#378.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#379.src: There could be any number of explanations... but it does not matter.
Echoes of Change#379.dst: Pode haver inúmeras explicações... mas isso não importa.
Echoes of Change#379.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#380.src: If you know him, we need information. What can you tell us?
Echoes of Change#380.dst: Se o conhece, precisamos saber mais. O que pode nos dizer?
Echoes of Change#380.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#381.src: Really. Because from my perspective, working directly under the Crown doesn't sound like something a good person would do!
Echoes of Change#381.dst: Sério. Porque, do meu ponto de vista, trabalhar direto para a Coroa não parece coisa de gente boa!
Echoes of Change#381.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#383.src: That could certainly be a concern... though, we were not expecting to fight any Sovereigns, regardless.
Echoes of Change#383.dst: Isso pode mesmo ser uma preocupação... embora não esperássemos lutar contra nenhum Soberano, de todo modo.
Echoes of Change#383.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#384.src: Ah... so you knew him before his ascension, then.
Echoes of Change#384.dst: Ah... então você o conhecia antes da ascensão.
Echoes of Change#384.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#385.src: This could be a good thing for us. If he only recently ascended, he's likely to lack experience with the Queen's blessing.
Echoes of Change#385.dst: Isso pode ser bom pra nós. Se ele ascendeu há pouco, deve ter pouca experiência com a bênção da Rainha.
Echoes of Change#385.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#386.src: We need to report back to Syndra about this... this changes things.
Echoes of Change#386.dst: Precisamos informar a Syndra sobre isso... isso muda as coisas.
Echoes of Change#386.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#387.src: Come on, let's head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#387.dst: Vamos, de volta à Pluma de Aço.
Echoes of Change#387.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#389.src: If it comes down to it... and you are forced to face him. Would you be ready to kill your former friend, if necessary?
Echoes of Change#389.dst: Se chegar a esse ponto... e você tiver que enfrentá-lo. Teria coragem de matar seu antigo amigo, se necessário?
Echoes of Change#389.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#390.src: ...think on it, for now. If we are lucky, you won't need the answer.
Echoes of Change#390.dst: ...pense nisso, por enquanto. Com sorte, não vai precisar da resposta.
Echoes of Change#390.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#391.src: Return to The Steel Feather and find discuss the final steps at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#391.dst: Volte à Pluma de Aço e discuta os últimos passos em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#392.src: Everyone! Gather around, we return with... news. Both good and bad.
Echoes of Change#392.dst: Pessoal! Venham cá, voltamos com... notícias. Boas e ruins.
Echoes of Change#392.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#393.src: Welcome back. I hesitate to ask, but what are the news?
Echoes of Change#393.dst: Bem-vindos. Até hesito, mas quais são as notícias?
Echoes of Change#393.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#394.src: We can begin with the good news. We have properly assessed each of our escape routes, and ordered them from most to least preferable..
Echoes of Change#394.dst: Podemos começar pelas boas. Avaliamos bem cada rota de fuga e as ordenamos da mais à menos preferível..
Echoes of Change#394.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#395.src: That's good. With that, we should have completed all the necessary preparations for the festival... then what are the bad news?
Echoes of Change#395.dst: Ótimo. Com isso, concluímos todos os preparativos para o festival... então, quais são as más notícias?
Echoes of Change#395.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#396.src: We've learned of a third Sovereign who will be present at the festival. A new one, by the name of Tasim.
Echoes of Change#396.dst: Soubemos de um terceiro Soberano que estará no festival. Um novo, chamado Tasim.
Echoes of Change#396.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#397.src: Oh, great. As if having both Sovereigns Zhiraok and Soosu to deal with wasn't bad enough... and now there's another one?
Echoes of Change#397.dst: Ah, ótimo. Como se lidar com os Soberanos Zhiraok e Soosu já não fosse ruim o bastante... e agora tem outro?
Echoes of Change#397.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#398.src: This doesn't change anything. We'll proceed as planned.
Echoes of Change#398.dst: Isso não muda nada. Seguiremos como planejado.
Echoes of Change#398.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#399.src: Er... with all due respect, we'd stand no chance facing three Sovereigns wielding the Queen's blessing. I doubt we could even defeat one!
Echoes of Change#399.dst: Hã... com todo o respeito, não teríamos chance contra três Soberanos com a bênção da Rainha. Duvido que vencêssemos até um!
Echoes of Change#399.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#400.src: We have all the necessary steps prepared. We know what we need to do. The plan doesn't involve facing the Sovereigns at all - the only target is Her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#400.dst: Temos todos os passos preparados. Sabemos o que fazer. O plano não envolve enfrentar os Soberanos - o único alvo é Sua Majestade.
Echoes of Change#400.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#401.src: Syndra... I agree with the young ones. It's incredibly risky, and the risk factor has only increased. Perhaps we... wait for next year?
Echoes of Change#401.dst: Syndra... concordo com os jovens. É arriscadíssimo, e o risco só aumentou. Talvez... devêssemos esperar o próximo ano?
Echoes of Change#401.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#402.src: Yes, the outlook of this fight is not great. Yes, the odds are against us. As I have said previously, I will be the face of the operation.
Echoes of Change#402.dst: Sim, o panorama desta luta não é bom. Sim, as chances estão contra nós. Como já disse, eu serei o rosto da operação.
Echoes of Change#402.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#403.src: I will deal the final blow, and I alone will draw the wrath of the crown and the people. The rest of you will work from the shadows. No one will even know you're involved.
Echoes of Change#403.dst: Eu darei o golpe final, e só eu atrairei a ira da Coroa e do povo. O resto de vocês vai agir nas sombras. Ninguém sequer vai saber do envolvimento de vocês.
Echoes of Change#403.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#404.src: Syndra, old friend... are you certain your judgment isn't... clouded? I understand your troubled history, I do... but is it worth burning yourself to ash? What would Eli-
Echoes of Change#404.dst: Syndra, velha amiga... tem certeza de que seu julgamento não está... nublado? Entendo seu passado difícil, entendo... mas vale a pena virar cinzas? O que a Eli-
Echoes of Change#404.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#405.src: Enough, Quill. My judgment is clear. I do not believe an additional Sovereign changes anything. Now, are you all still ready to proceed?
Echoes of Change#405.dst: Chega, Quill. Meu julgamento está claro. Não acho que mais um Soberano mude nada. Agora, vocês ainda estão prontos para seguir?
Echoes of Change#405.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#406.src: ... Well, the explosives are already made and ready... so I guess we might as well use 'em.
Echoes of Change#406.dst: ... Bom, os explosivos já estão feitos e prontos... então é melhor usar.
Echoes of Change#406.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#407.src: After seeing the state of our citizens today... we've waited long enough. I'm ready to take action.
Echoes of Change#407.dst: Depois de ver hoje o estado dos nossos cidadãos... já esperamos demais. Estou pronto para agir.
Echoes of Change#407.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#408.src: So long as Zeph joins, I'm in.
Echoes of Change#408.dst: Se o Zeph topar, eu topo.
Echoes of Change#408.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#409.src: Wh- what? Why w- wo- would my choice matter to you...? Uh, an- anyway, I already pr- pro- promised to help Syndra, no m- matter what.
Echoes of Change#409.dst: O- o quê? Por que m- mi- minha escolha importa pra você...? Hã, e- enfim, já pr- pro- prometi ajudar a Syndra, a- aconteça o que for.
Echoes of Change#409.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#410.src: Sigh. Fine, I'm outvoted. But I don't like this.
Echoes of Change#410.dst: Suspiro. Tá, perdi na votação. Mas não gosto disso.
Echoes of Change#410.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#412.src: I am fighting. But I will not allow you to take the fall for it entirely by yourself.
Echoes of Change#412.dst: Eu vou lutar. Mas não vou deixar você levar a culpa sozinha.
Echoes of Change#412.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#413.src: You don't need to protect me, Mora. This is my decision, and-
Echoes of Change#413.dst: Você não precisa me proteger, Mora. A decisão é minha, e-
Echoes of Change#413.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#414.src: And my decision, Syndra, is to follow you into battle.
Echoes of Change#414.dst: E a minha decisão, Syndra, é seguir você na batalha.
Echoes of Change#414.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#416.src: That will be all I ask from most of you. Try to rest and relax before tomorrow's festival. I'll do a final briefing before we head out in the morning.
Echoes of Change#416.dst: É tudo o que peço da maioria de vocês. Tentem descansar antes do festival de amanhã. Farei uma última reunião antes de sairmos pela manhã.
Echoes of Change#416.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#417.src: {u}, I have one final request to make of you. I'd like to duel you again... this time, I'll give it my all, and I expect the same of you.
Echoes of Change#417.dst: {u}, tenho um último pedido. Quero duelar com você de novo... desta vez vou dar tudo de mim, e espero o mesmo de você.
Echoes of Change#417.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#418.src: Meet me by the north-eastern tracks.
Echoes of Change#418.dst: Me encontre nos trilhos a nordeste.
Echoes of Change#418.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#419.src: My water magic has gotten a lot better. I will help, no matter what!
Echoes of Change#419.dst: Minha magia de água melhorou muito. Vou ajudar, custe o que custar!
Echoes of Change#419.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#421.src: U-uh, yeah. I was just a-about to go there myself.
Echoes of Change#421.dst: H-hã, bora. Eu já i-ia pra lá mesmo.
Echoes of Change#421.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#422.src: I- I can't rest now. I n-need to practice.
Echoes of Change#422.dst: N- não dá pra descansar. P-preciso praticar.
Echoes of Change#422.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#423.src: All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
Echoes of Change#423.dst: Apesar de tudo, estou animado para ver como meus explosivos vão se sair.
Echoes of Change#423.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#425.src: I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
Echoes of Change#425.dst: Tomara que o invento do Yus não falhe...
Echoes of Change#425.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#426.src: I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
Echoes of Change#426.dst: Tenho um mau pressentimento sobre amanhã. Tomara que a Syndra saiba o que faz.
Echoes of Change#426.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#427.src: Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
Echoes of Change#427.dst: A resistência sempre tem um preço. Só espero que não seja alto demais.
Echoes of Change#427.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#428.src: Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#428.dst: Encontre Syndra para o duelo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#429.src: We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
Echoes of Change#429.dst: Não sabemos o que amanhã nos reserva. Talvez dê tudo certo sem problemas - e eu realmente espero que seja assim.
Echoes of Change#429.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#430.src: However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
Echoes of Change#430.dst: Porém... precisamos estar prontos para tudo. Por isso quero te desafiar.
Echoes of Change#430.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#431.src: Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
Echoes of Change#431.dst: De todos aqui, você e eu somos os mais próximos do nível de um Soberano. Se nós dois aguentarmos este duelo... talvez tenhamos uma chance.
Echoes of Change#431.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#432.src: As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
Echoes of Change#432.dst: Como eu disse, não vou me conter. Espero o mesmo de você.
Echoes of Change#432.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#433.src: ... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
Echoes of Change#433.dst: ... Ainda não te contei a parte mais importante do meu plano, contei?
Echoes of Change#433.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#434.src: I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
Echoes of Change#434.dst: Eu disse que darei o golpe final em Sua Majestade. Para isso... vou usar minha bênção do alto e matá-la num só golpe.
Echoes of Change#434.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#435.src: I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
Echoes of Change#435.dst: Vou contar aos outros amanhã de manhã... Mas entende por que preciso deste duelo? Eu... preciso ter certeza de que consigo.
Echoes of Change#435.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#436.src: Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
Echoes of Change#436.dst: Certo. Quando quiser, fale comigo de novo e começamos.
Echoes of Change#436.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#439.src: Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Echoes of Change#439.dst: Certo. Que vença o melhor soldado!
Echoes of Change#439.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#441.src: Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
Echoes of Change#441.dst: Sinceramente, não esperava te vencer. Você conseguiu aprimorar suas habilidades e treinar sua magia muito mais do que eu jamais poderia.
Echoes of Change#441.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#442.src: So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
Echoes of Change#442.dst: Tantos anos... e a solução estava bem na minha frente. Mas eu não sabia onde procurar!
Echoes of Change#442.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#443.src: ...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
Echoes of Change#443.dst: ...agora não importa. Já chegamos até aqui. Vamos ter que nos virar com o que temos.
Echoes of Change#443.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#444.src: Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
Echoes of Change#444.dst: Escute... há outro motivo para eu ter pedido isso. Tenho... uma verdade difícil para contar, e preciso que guarde para você.
Echoes of Change#444.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#445.src: There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
Echoes of Change#445.dst: Há uma boa chance de eu errar o primeiro golpe. Se isso acontecer... não vou sair viva daquele confronto.
Echoes of Change#445.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#446.src: A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such overwhelming strength?
Echoes of Change#446.dst: Uma batalha com Sua Majestade não é luta nenhuma. Como seria? Será que uma só pessoa faria um arranhão numa força tão esmagadora?
Echoes of Change#446.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#447.src: This pile of trash has a strong stench of alcohol and other... unpleasantries.
Echoes of Change#447.dst: Este monte de lixo fede a álcool e a outras... coisas desagradáveis.

Echoes of Change#448.src: This must be the underwater route Yulie was talking about...
Echoes of Change#448.dst: Esta deve ser a rota subaquática de que o Yulie falou...

Echoes of Change#449.src: Second Division - Stationed by the gate to the {p}. Low risk - will assist in case of commotion.
Echoes of Change#449.dst: Segunda Divisão - Posicionada junto ao portão para {p}. Risco baixo - ajudará em caso de tumulto.

Echoes of Change#450.src: - Tip! Hover over a piece and it will tell you its shape.
Echoes of Change#450.dst: - Dica! Passe o cursor sobre uma peça para ver seu formato.

Echoes of Change#451.src: ... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
Echoes of Change#451.dst: ... Então farei isso sozinha. Se alguém tiver que levar a culpa, *serei* eu.
Echoes of Change#451.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#452.src: Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
Echoes of Change#452.dst: Porque não há outra escolha! Porque se eu for forçada a suportar mais um ano sem ela ao meu lado, então... então... então acho que minha chama finalmente se apagaria.
Echoes of Change#452.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#453.src: I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
Echoes of Change#453.dst: Acho que é melhor eu te contar. Uma raiva sem contexto deve parecer estranha para quem vê de fora.
Echoes of Change#453.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#454.src: I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
Echoes of Change#454.dst: Eu já fui do exército, como sabe. Mas não era uma mera soldado, não... Cheguei perto do círculo íntimo de Sua Majestade. Uma de suas Asas.
Echoes of Change#454.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#455.src: You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
Echoes of Change#455.dst: Sabe, foi no ano depois da morte do Soberano Selium. O posto de Soberano de {p} tinha ficado vago. Se as coisas tivessem sido diferentes, será que eu...?
Echoes of Change#455.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#456.src: Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
Echoes of Change#456.dst: Talvez por isso ela tenha feito aquilo. Sempre me mandava em missões difíceis, mas...
Echoes of Change#456.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#457.src: This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
Echoes of Change#457.dst: Dessa vez, me mandaram lidar com vários amaldiçoados em Roughworks. Capturar se possível, mas... bem, nem sempre vinham por bem.
Echoes of Change#457.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#458.src: I'd done this before, of course. So I wouldn't have thought much of it, except... except, one of the names I received... I recognized it. Of course I recognized it.
Echoes of Change#458.dst: Eu já tinha feito isso antes, claro. Então não teria dado importância, só que... só que um dos nomes que recebi... eu o reconheci. Claro que reconheci.
Echoes of Change#458.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#461.src: I refused! Of course I did - I was asked to kill the love of my life!!
Echoes of Change#461.dst: Recusei! Claro que sim - me pediram para matar o amor da minha vida!!
Echoes of Change#461.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#462.src: She wasn't even cursed. And here and now, we understand the truth of that label... but back then, it was a shock! A normal, working citizen...
Echoes of Change#462.dst: Ela nem era amaldiçoada. Hoje sabemos a verdade sobre esse rótulo... mas na época, foi um choque! Uma cidadã comum, trabalhadora...
Echoes of Change#462.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#463.src: I was brought back to the citadel. As I stood before Her Majesty, she told me it was a test. A TEST!! A test of my loyalty to the crown.
Echoes of Change#463.dst: Me levaram de volta à cidadela. Diante de Sua Majestade, ela me disse que era um teste. Um TESTE!! Um teste da minha lealdade à Coroa.
Echoes of Change#463.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#464.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to the {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#464.dst: Desonrada, perdi minha patente e meu status. Fui descartada, mandada para {p}, proibida de sair de lá.
Echoes of Change#464.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#465.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#465.dst: Desonrada, perdi minha patente e meu status. Fui descartada, mandada para {p}, proibida de sair de lá.
Echoes of Change#465.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#466.src: Of course he knew! Offered condolences and helped get me back up once he became Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#466.dst: Claro que ele sabia! Me deu os pêsames e me ajudou a me reerguer quando virou Soberano.
Echoes of Change#466.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#467.src: He gave me an assignment. To infiltrate the local resistance groups, and keep an eye on them. If I did that... I could restore my honour.
Echoes of Change#467.dst: Ele me deu uma missão. Infiltrar os grupos de resistência locais e ficar de olho neles. Se eu fizesse isso... poderia recuperar minha honra.
Echoes of Change#467.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#468.src: Ironically, it's thanks to him that we're here right now. But I can't ever forgive him for standing by and letting the crown keep me trapped there.
Echoes of Change#468.dst: Ironicamente, é graças a ele que estamos aqui agora. Mas nunca vou perdoá-lo por ficar só olhando enquanto a Coroa me mantinha presa lá.
Echoes of Change#468.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#469.src: ... But he isn't important. Not really. It's who he serves.
Echoes of Change#469.dst: ... Mas ele não importa. Não de fato. Importa a quem serve.
Echoes of Change#469.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#470.src: Her Majesty... I need her to die. I need to do it myself. Only then, can I finally be at peace...
Echoes of Change#470.dst: Sua Majestade... preciso que ela morra. E pelas minhas mãos. Só então poderei enfim ter paz...
Echoes of Change#470.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#471.src: {u}. If I don't survive... I need you to do something for me.
Echoes of Change#471.dst: {u}. Se eu não sobreviver... preciso que faça algo por mim.
Echoes of Change#471.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#472.src: Keep my children safe. They're all I have left.
Echoes of Change#472.dst: Proteja minhas crianças. São tudo o que me resta.
Echoes of Change#472.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#473.src: ... Try and get some rest. We have a massive challenge ahead of us tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#473.dst: ... Tente descansar um pouco. Temos um desafio enorme pela frente amanhã.
Echoes of Change#473.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#475.src: I did. When I first got into contact with Quill, I asked him to find her.
Echoes of Change#475.dst: Procurei. Quando contatei o Quill, pedi que ele a encontrasse.
Echoes of Change#475.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#476.src: And... he did. But... she didn't recognize him. She didn't... remember me.
Echoes of Change#476.dst: E... ele encontrou. Mas... ela não o reconheceu. Não... se lembrava de mim.
Echoes of Change#476.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#477.src: Ha... knowing she was still alive past that wall, but that I could never see here again, and that she didn't even... remember me...?
Echoes of Change#477.dst: Ha... saber que ela seguia viva além daquele muro, mas que eu nunca mais poderia vê-la, e que ela nem... se lembrava de mim...?
Echoes of Change#477.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#478.src: I tried sending her letters, with Quill's help. I don't know if any of them ever reached her.
Echoes of Change#478.dst: Tentei mandar cartas para ela, com a ajuda do Quill. Não sei se alguma chegou.
Echoes of Change#478.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#479.src: It doesn't matter now. It's been... {~} years. Nearly half of my whole life. So long as she's safe... that's all that matters.
Echoes of Change#479.dst: Agora não importa. Já se passaram... {~} anos. Quase metade da minha vida. Contanto que ela esteja a salvo... é só o que importa.
Echoes of Change#479.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#480.src: And if we succeed tomorrow... then...
Echoes of Change#480.dst: E se tivermos sucesso amanhã... então...
Echoes of Change#480.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#481.src: Then... maybe we can finally be at peace. Together.
Echoes of Change#481.dst: Então... talvez finalmente possamos ter paz. Juntas.
Echoes of Change#481.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#482.src: It was... during a larger assignment. I'd risen through the ranks of the military at a rapid pace, becoming a Wing only three years after joining.
Echoes of Change#482.dst: Foi... durante uma missão maior. Subi muito rápido nas fileiras do exército e virei Asa apenas três anos depois de entrar.
Echoes of Change#482.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#483.src: In {~} IA, Her Majesty was looking into more long-term solutions for managing the {p}. She requested a team of Wings most suited to the task, and I was selected for it.
Echoes of Change#483.dst: Em {~} IA, Sua Majestade buscava soluções mais duradouras para administrar {p}. Pediu uma equipe das Asas mais aptas para a tarefa, e fui escolhida.
Echoes of Change#483.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#484.src: We worked to establish a more centralized management structure... I ended up taking charge, and was later promoted to Captain.
Echoes of Change#484.dst: Trabalhamos para criar uma estrutura de gestão mais centralizada... Acabei assumindo o comando e depois fui promovida a Capitã.
Echoes of Change#484.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#485.src: But one of my first ideas was to go undercover and work at the factories, for a time. I believed I would be able to get a better insight into the situation that way.
Echoes of Change#485.dst: Mas uma das minhas primeiras ideias foi me infiltrar e trabalhar nas fábricas por um tempo. Achei que assim entenderia melhor a situação.
Echoes of Change#485.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#487.src: I wasn't supposed to get attached. It was just a job, and I'd be visiting many factories...
Echoes of Change#487.dst: Eu não devia me apegar. Era só um trabalho, e eu visitaria muitas fábricas...
Echoes of Change#487.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#488.src: But I did. And it was the best mistake of my life.
Echoes of Change#488.dst: Mas me apeguei. E foi o melhor erro da minha vida.
Echoes of Change#488.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#489.src: Even after I moved on, and throughout the whole three years of that assignment, I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#489.dst: Mesmo depois de seguir adiante, e durante os três anos daquela missão, continuei me encontrando com ela.
Echoes of Change#489.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#490.src: ...even after the assignment ended, and I was recalled to the Citadel... even after I was inducted into the Gendarme... I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#490.dst: ...mesmo depois que a missão acabou e fui chamada de volta à Cidadela... mesmo depois de entrar na Gendarmaria... continuei me encontrando com ela.
Echoes of Change#490.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#491.src: I... never told her what I really was. I thought it would be safer, for both of us... ha. And how did that turn out...?
Echoes of Change#491.dst: Eu... nunca contei a ela o que eu realmente era. Achei que seria mais seguro para nós duas... ha. E no que deu isso...?
Echoes of Change#491.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#495.src: Syndra's about to give her final speech before the festival. Come on, let's get going.
Echoes of Change#495.dst: A Syndra vai fazer o discurso final antes do festival. Vamos, anda.
Echoes of Change#495.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#496.src: Listen to Syndra's last speech before the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#496.dst: Ouça o último discurso de Syndra antes do festival em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#498.src: Today is the day we set our plan into motion. In a few hours, the festival will begin... and that's when we'll strike!
Echoes of Change#498.dst: Hoje é o dia em que pomos o plano em ação. Em algumas horas o festival começa... e é aí que atacaremos!
Echoes of Change#498.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#499.src: I'll now be handing out assignments. They're different from yesterday's pairings, as they're focused on what we need *during* the festival.
Echoes of Change#499.dst: Agora vou distribuir as tarefas. São diferentes das duplas de ontem, pois focam no que precisamos *durante* o festival.
Echoes of Change#499.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#500.src: Zeph and Yuman, you're in charge of placing and detonating the explosives. Yusanu will show you where they are.
Echoes of Change#500.dst: Zeph e Yuman, vocês cuidam de posicionar e detonar os explosivos. Yusanu vai mostrar onde estão.
Echoes of Change#500.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#501.src: Rex and Yulie, you're aerial support. Take your positions on the buildings we scouted out yesterday. Provide support for everyone else as needed.
Echoes of Change#501.dst: Rex e Yulie, vocês são o apoio aéreo. Assumam suas posições nos prédios que exploramos ontem. Deem apoio aos outros conforme necessário.
Echoes of Change#501.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#502.src: Sui, Yusanu, and {u}. I want you three to stay put on a roof nearby. Once the Queen is dead, chaos is going to break out.
Echoes of Change#502.dst: Sui, Yusanu e {u}. Quero que vocês três fiquem num telhado próximo. Quando a Rainha morrer, vai ser o caos.
Echoes of Change#502.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#503.src: I need you three to help calm down the people, and to help fight off any soldiers that oppose us.
Echoes of Change#503.dst: Preciso que vocês três ajudem a acalmar o povo e a repelir os soldados que se opuserem a nós.
Echoes of Change#503.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#504.src: Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Echoes of Change#504.dst: Quill vai ficar aqui com o resto da Pluma de Aço e se preparar para as consequências.
Echoes of Change#504.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#505.src: I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
Echoes of Change#505.dst: Receio que eu não sirva para lutar. Só atrasaria vocês no campo de batalha.
Echoes of Change#505.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#506.src: Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Echoes of Change#506.dst: Mora vai ficar escondido na multidão e vai me ajudar se necessário.
Echoes of Change#506.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#507.src: Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
Echoes of Change#507.dst: Por fim... estarei num prédio acima de Sua Majestade. Quando chegar a hora, vou abatê-la!
Echoes of Change#507.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#508.src: I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
Echoes of Change#508.dst: Espero que estejam prontos para fazer história. Não será fácil... mas acredito que conseguiremos.
Echoes of Change#508.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#509.src: I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
Echoes of Change#509.dst: Não posso garantir a segurança de todos. É provável que civis se firam, e alguns de nós também... ou... pior.
Echoes of Change#509.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#510.src: Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
Echoes of Change#510.dst: Resistência e revolução têm um preço. Precisamos aceitar isso. Mas eu... rezo para que não chegue a isso.
Echoes of Change#510.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#511.src: Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
Echoes of Change#511.dst: Alguns de vocês estão com medo, nervosos. E com razão. Isto é perigoso e arriscado... mas saibam que tenho muito, muito orgulho de cada um de vocês aqui hoje.
Echoes of Change#511.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#512.src: We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
Echoes of Change#512.dst: Vamos mudar Fruma para melhor! Vamos derrubar o governo tirano da Coroa e libertar o povo!!
Echoes of Change#512.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#513.src: Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
Echoes of Change#513.dst: Muito bem! Mãos à obra! Encontrem suas equipes e se reúnam nas posições designadas no festival.
Echoes of Change#513.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#515.src: Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
Echoes of Change#515.dst: Encontre seu grupo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e converse antes de ir ao festival.
