Echoes of Change#517.src: Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
Echoes of Change#517.dst: Sim. E uma bateria extra também.
Echoes of Change#517.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#518.src: Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
Echoes of Change#518.dst: Perfeito. Deixei cargas pra você em cada ponto, aí em {p} escolhemos nossas posições.
Echoes of Change#518.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#522.src: Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Echoes of Change#522.dst: Rex, nunca vi atiradora melhor. Você não vai errar.
Echoes of Change#522.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#523.src: Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
Echoes of Change#523.dst: Obrigada, Yulie. Desejo muita sorte a você lá.
Echoes of Change#523.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#526.src: Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Echoes of Change#526.dst: A Syndra m- marcou bons pontos pra gente, né?
Echoes of Change#526.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#527.src: She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
Echoes of Change#527.dst: Marcou. Vou garantir que fiquemos longe do perigo! Conheço bem aqueles becos.
Echoes of Change#527.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#528.src: Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
Echoes of Change#528.dst: Obrigado... Mas eu n- não preciso de babá! Vou f- ficar bem.
Echoes of Change#528.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#529.src: I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
Echoes of Change#529.dst: Sei que você sabe se cuidar. Mas é sério, Zeph. Não tô de brincadeira.
Echoes of Change#529.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#530.src: I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
Echoes of Change#530.dst: Preciso que você fique seguro. Não podemos ser pegos aqui.
Echoes of Change#530.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#531.src: I've never s- seen you this serious before...
Echoes of Change#531.dst: Nunca te v- vi tão sério...
Echoes of Change#531.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#532.src: I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
Echoes of Change#532.dst: Só estou nervoso. Nunca fiz nada assim.
Echoes of Change#532.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#533.src: Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
Echoes of Change#533.dst: Ainda bem que eu j- já fiz, p- pr- princesa.
Echoes of Change#533.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#534.src: Hi... are you two, um, ready?
Echoes of Change#534.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#535.src: I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
Echoes of Change#535.dst: Eu... ha, não tenho certeza! É... muita coisa, né?
Echoes of Change#535.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#536.src: I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
Echoes of Change#536.dst: Ando preocupada com esse novo Soberano... Tasim. {u}, sei que você... o conhece.
Echoes of Change#536.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#537.src: It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
Echoes of Change#537.dst: É... é como a Rex disse outro dia. Os Soberanos não são nossos amigos. Se ele se juntou à Coroa, então... não sei se dá pra confiar que fará a coisa certa.
Echoes of Change#537.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#538.src: We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
Echoes of Change#538.dst: Não dá pra só... ficar preocupados com o que pode rolar. Temos que, hã, manter o foco.
Echoes of Change#538.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#539.src: Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Echoes of Change#539.dst: A Syndra confia em nós! Temos que ter fé no plano dela.
Echoes of Change#539.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#540.src: Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
Echoes of Change#540.dst: É... você tem razão. Vamos às nossas posições, então.
Echoes of Change#540.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#541.src: The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
Echoes of Change#541.dst: O mapa diz que devemos ficar no alto de um prédio...
Echoes of Change#541.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#542.src: Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#542.dst: Vá até sua posição designada no festival em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#543.src: So... this is our spot, then?
Echoes of Change#543.dst: Então... este é o nosso lugar?
Echoes of Change#543.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#544.src: I think so, if I read the map correctly...
Echoes of Change#544.dst: Acho que sim, se li o mapa direito...
Echoes of Change#544.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#545.src: ... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
Echoes of Change#545.dst: ... É estranho. Só, hã, esperando. Como... como se a gente não estivesse, hã, fazendo nada pra, pra ajudar.
Echoes of Change#545.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#546.src: A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
Echoes of Change#546.dst: Um pouco... é. Mas como a Syndra disse, vão precisar de nós depois. Mesmo que até lá não façamos muita coisa...
Echoes of Change#546.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#548.src: What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
Echoes of Change#548.dst: O que foi? Algo chamou sua atenção?
Echoes of Change#548.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#549.src: Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
Echoes of Change#549.dst: Ah, hã... é que- hoje é o dia do festival, né? A cidade está igualzinha a quando, hã, chegamos. Nada de festa? Nem barracas, nem atrações?
Echoes of Change#549.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#550.src: Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
Echoes of Change#550.dst: Oh! Hahaha, vocês têm atrações em Auburn?
Echoes of Change#550.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#551.src: Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
Echoes of Change#551.dst: Hã... sim! Não é esse... o propósito do festival?
Echoes of Change#551.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#552.src: Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
Echoes of Change#552.dst: Pra vocês, talvez. Aqui... bem, ninguém tem tempo pra isso. O propósito, pra maioria, é ter um dia de folga do trabalho.
Echoes of Change#552.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#553.src: Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
Echoes of Change#553.dst: Oh! Isso é... bom, eu acho. Mas um pouco triste que seja, ha, por isso que as pessoas se animam...?
Echoes of Change#553.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#554.src: Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
Echoes of Change#554.dst: É, um pouco. Mas Roughworks é assim.
Echoes of Change#554.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#558.src: Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
Echoes of Change#558.dst: Trabalhar para a Coroa é complicado? Ajudar a oprimir o povo de Fruma é complicado?!
Echoes of Change#558.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#559.src: Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#559.dst: Sim! Eu explicaria, mas não temos tempo agora- {u}, você precisa me ouvir-
Echoes of Change#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#560.src: Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
Echoes of Change#560.dst: Suspiro. Não precisava fazer isso. Ninguém está... me obrigando a nada, eu só-
Echoes of Change#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#561.src: So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
Echoes of Change#561.dst: Então escolheu servir à Coroa? Por quê?!
Echoes of Change#561.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#562.src: I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#562.dst: Eu... tenho meus motivos, acredite. Olha, não há tempo para explicar agora- {u}, você precisa me ouvir-
Echoes of Change#562.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#563.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#563.dst: Sui, o que você está fazendo?! Só vai chamar mais atenção pra nós.
Echoes of Change#563.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#566.src: If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#566.dst: Se me deixassem terminar... Vim avisar vocês. O grupo de vocês foi descoberto- não sei exatamente como, mas sabemos o que planejam fazer hoje.
Echoes of Change#566.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#567.dst: O quê?! Não, isso- isso não-
Echoes of Change#567.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#568.src: It is. You need to call it off, or else-
Echoes of Change#568.dst: Foi, sim. Vocês precisam cancelar, ou então-
Echoes of Change#568.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#569.src: ... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#569.dst: ... Porque, no fim das contas, ainda somos amigos. Não quero que você se machuque.
Echoes of Change#569.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#570.src: If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#570.dst: Se você não tivesse sumido... bem, agora não importa. Estamos sem tempo. Se você estiver a salvo depois disso, então... vou dar um jeito de te procurar.
Echoes of Change#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#572.src: There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
Echoes of Change#572.dst: Tem... algo maior que Fruma em jogo.
Echoes of Change#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#573.src: It doesn't matter. Not now, at least-
Echoes of Change#573.dst: Não importa. Não agora, pelo menos-
Echoes of Change#573.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#574.src: Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
Echoes of Change#574.dst: Claro que importa! Tem gente de verdade sofrendo nas mãos da Coroa, e você acha que não importa?!
Echoes of Change#574.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#575.src: That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to-
Echoes of Change#575.dst: Não foi isso que eu disse. Eu... não temos tempo pra isso. {u}, você tem que-
Echoes of Change#575.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#576.src: I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
Echoes of Change#576.dst: Pedi que não fizesse. Não preciso ser salvo.
Echoes of Change#576.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#577.src: You being here, it's... making things harder than they need to be.
Echoes of Change#577.dst: Você estar aqui está... complicando as coisas mais do que precisa.
Echoes of Change#577.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#578.src: Harder for you?! You're the one siding with the crown, man!
Echoes of Change#578.dst: Mais difícil pra VOCÊ?! Você está do lado da Coroa, cara!
Echoes of Change#578.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#579.src: I... I don't have time for this right now. {u}, you have to-
Echoes of Change#579.dst: Eu... eu não tenho tempo pra isso agora. {u}, você tem que-
Echoes of Change#579.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#580.src: I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- how, exactly, I don't know, but... the Crown knows what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#580.dst: Vim avisar vocês. O grupo de vocês foi descoberto- como, exatamente, não sei, mas... a Coroa sabe o que planejam fazer hoje.
Echoes of Change#580.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#581.dst: O quê?! Não, isso isso não
Echoes of Change#581.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#582.src: It is. Choose to believe me, or not, but-
Echoes of Change#582.dst: Foi, sim. Acredite ou não, mas-
Echoes of Change#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#583.src: We're still friends, aren't we? I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#583.dst: Ainda somos amigos, não somos? Não quero que você se machuque.
Echoes of Change#583.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#584.src: If only you hadn't come after me, then... well, it doesn't matter now. You're here anyway. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#584.dst: Se você não tivesse vindo atrás de mim... bem, agora não importa. Você está aqui mesmo assim. Se estiver a salvo depois disso... vou dar um jeito de te procurar.
Echoes of Change#584.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#585.src: Just... please, don't proceed with your plan. Find a way to stop it. I just don't want to see anyone get hurt.
Echoes of Change#585.dst: Só... por favor, não sigam com o plano. Deem um jeito de impedir. Só não quero ver ninguém se machucar.
Echoes of Change#585.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#586.src: I need to go, even finding an excuse to step away for this long was difficult. Stay safe.
Echoes of Change#586.dst: Preciso ir, até achar uma desculpa pra sumir tanto tempo foi difícil. Cuidem-se.
Echoes of Change#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#588.src: What- what do we do? We need to, to get a message out! Where's Syndra, we have to-
Echoes of Change#588.dst: O que- o que a gente faz? Temos que, que avisar os outros! Cadê a Syndra, temos que-
Echoes of Change#588.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#589.src: Oh, no... I- I don't think we can. The... the festival's starting.
Echoes of Change#589.dst: Ah, não... A- acho que não dá. O... o festival está começando.
Echoes of Change#589.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#591.src: Citizens of the {p}, I extend my heartfelt gratitude for your remarkable attendance this year.
Echoes of Change#591.dst: Cidadãos de {p}, expresso minha sincera gratidão pela notável presença de vocês este ano.
Echoes of Change#591.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#592.src: Together, we shall celebrate yet another year of success and prosperity!
Echoes of Change#592.dst: Juntos, celebraremos mais um ano de sucesso e prosperidade!
Echoes of Change#592.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#593.src: Your unwavering dedication and industrious spirit are deeply valued, and I hold a profound appreciation for your contributions to the strength and glory of our province.
Echoes of Change#593.dst: Sua dedicação inabalável e seu espírito laborioso são muito valorizados, e aprecio profundamente suas contribuições para a força e a glória da nossa província.
Echoes of Change#593.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#594.src: Production quotas for this year have been successfully achieved, and I am most pleased by this accomplishment.
Echoes of Change#594.dst: As cotas de produção deste ano foram cumpridas com sucesso, e essa conquista muito me agrada.
Echoes of Change#594.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#595.src: However, as Fruma continues to evolve and flourish, it is imperative that we strive for greater heights.
Echoes of Change#595.dst: Porém, à medida que Fruma continua a evoluir e florescer, é imperativo buscarmos patamares mais altos.
Echoes of Change#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#596.src: As such, we shall be raising production quotas for the coming year.
Echoes of Change#596.dst: Por isso, vamos aumentar as cotas de produção para o próximo ano.
Echoes of Change#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#597.src: I have every confidence that you will continue to dedicate yourselves to the growth of Fruma.
Echoes of Change#597.dst: Tenho plena confiança de que vocês continuarão se dedicando ao crescimento de Fruma.
Echoes of Change#597.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#598.src: Let us now turn our attention to the year ahead, and to the improvements to the district's infrastructure that your Sovereign has prepared for your benefit.
Echoes of Change#598.dst: Voltemos agora a atenção para o ano que vem e para as melhorias na infraestrutura do distrito que seu Soberano preparou em seu benefício.
Echoes of Change#598.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#599.src: Sovereign Soosu has been hard at work these past months, and has developed an innovative technology designed to deliver cleaner and fresher water to our people.
Echoes of Change#599.dst: A Soberana Soosu trabalhou duro nestes últimos meses e desenvolveu uma tecnologia inovadora para levar água mais limpa e fresca ao nosso povo.
Echoes of Change#599.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#601.src: ... I th- th- think it's time. Let's do this.
Echoes of Change#601.dst: ... A- a- acho que é a hora. Vamos lá.
Echoes of Change#601.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#603.src: What was that?! Soldiers, investigate the commotion!
Echoes of Change#603.dst: O que foi isso?! Soldados, investiguem o tumulto!
Echoes of Change#603.speaker: Timasca Captain

Echoes of Change#604.src: Hm? Worry not for the commotion, it is already being taken care of. Now, as I was saying...
Echoes of Change#604.dst: Hm? Não se preocupem com o tumulto, já está sendo resolvido. Agora, como eu dizia...
Echoes of Change#604.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#606.src: It's now or never... For Fruma!!!
Echoes of Change#606.dst: É agora ou nunca... Por Fruma!!!
Echoes of Change#606.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#612.src: Oh, but it is. Witness, citizens, the depravity and foolhardiness of those who turn against the crown!
Echoes of Change#612.dst: Ah, mas é. Contemplem, cidadãos, a depravação e a insensatez dos que se voltam contra a Coroa!
Echoes of Change#612.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#613.src: Terrorists seeking to threaten the safety of our people, of our province! Aiding and abetting the Cursed, daring to make an attempt on my life, as your Queen!
Echoes of Change#613.dst: Terroristas que ameaçam a segurança do nosso povo, da nossa província! Cúmplices dos Amaldiçoados, ousando atentar contra a vida de sua Rainha!
Echoes of Change#613.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#614.src: We are fortunate that news of their plot reached the crown, and that our Sovereign Soosu could devise a construct to deceive them, to draw them out into the open.
Echoes of Change#614.dst: Por sorte, a notícia da conspiração chegou à Coroa, e nossa Soberana Soosu pôde criar um constructo para enganá-los e trazê-los à luz.
Echoes of Change#614.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#615.src: Sovereigns, soldiers, to arms! Hunt down any terrorists or supporters you can find!
Echoes of Change#615.dst: Soberanos, soldados, às armas! Cacem todo terrorista ou apoiador que encontrarem!
Echoes of Change#615.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#616.src: I should have expected you'd have some tricks left.
Echoes of Change#616.dst: Eu devia imaginar que você ainda tinha truques.
Echoes of Change#616.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#617.src: Oh, Syndra... you couldn't just stay put and leave things to rest, could you? To discard your safety, security... all for this?
Echoes of Change#617.dst: Ah, Syndra... não podia ficar quieta e deixar tudo em paz, né? Jogar fora sua segurança, sua tranquilidade... tudo por isso?
Echoes of Change#617.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#618.src: I once saw great potential in you. Your strategic mind, your dedication... a pity you had to throw it all away.
Echoes of Change#618.dst: Um dia vi um grande potencial em você. Sua mente estratégica, sua dedicação... pena que tenha jogado tudo fora.
Echoes of Change#618.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#619.src: Did you really believe it would be that easy to kill me? A single empowered strike? Have you forgotten who gave you that blessing in the first place?!
Echoes of Change#619.dst: Achou mesmo que seria tão fácil me matar? Um único golpe potencializado? Esqueceu quem te deu essa bênção, para começo de conversa?!
Echoes of Change#619.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#620.src: What a shame, that your rage and desperation blinded you to the truth. You never stood a chance.
Echoes of Change#620.dst: Que pena que sua raiva e seu desespero te cegaram para a verdade. Você nunca teve chance.
Echoes of Change#620.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#621.src: No... no, no, no... what do we do?!
Echoes of Change#621.dst: Não... não, não, não... o que a gente faz?!
Echoes of Change#621.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#622.src: Damn it... we need to stick to the plan. Take the escape routes and regroup.
Echoes of Change#622.dst: Droga... temos que seguir o plano. Pegar as rotas de fuga e nos reagrupar.
Echoes of Change#622.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#623.src: What?! We can't just leave her behind! We, we have to help her! She's... I can't lose her.
Echoes of Change#623.dst: O quê?! Não podemos deixá-la! Temos, temos que ajudá-la! Ela é... não posso perdê-la.
Echoes of Change#623.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#624.src: I know, I know! But... she knew this might happen. She told us to save ourselves first if anything goes wrong.
Echoes of Change#624.dst: Eu sei, eu sei! Mas... ela sabia que isso podia acontecer. Disse pra nos salvarmos primeiro se algo desse errado.
Echoes of Change#624.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#625.src: Besides, we... what could we even do? If Syndra can't kill her, what could we possibly do? Can't you feel it? This... this pressure?
Echoes of Change#625.dst: Além disso, nós... o que poderíamos fazer? Se a Syndra não consegue matá-la, o que nós faríamos? Não sente? Essa... essa pressão?
Echoes of Change#625.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#626.src: Is... is that coming from her? I, I felt something similar, during the Auburn festival...
Echoes of Change#626.dst: Isso... isso vem dela? Eu, eu senti algo parecido no festival de Auburn...
Echoes of Change#626.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#627.src: She's furious... we need to get out of here. Quickly, let's head for the underground river escape route!
Echoes of Change#627.dst: Ela está furiosa... temos que sair daqui. Rápido, vamos para a rota do rio subterrâneo!
Echoes of Change#627.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#628.src: Escape using the underground river at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#629.src: How is this possible? Why are there, ha, guards stationed here?!
Echoes of Change#629.dst: Como é possível? Por que tem, ha, guardas aqui?!
Echoes of Change#629.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#630.src: I- I don't know! They must have done some last minute schedule changes, or... or...
Echoes of Change#630.dst: E- eu não sei! Devem ter mudado as escalas de última hora, ou... ou...
Echoes of Change#630.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#631.src: Oh. Or they knew our whole plan. Ha... hahaha, we never stood a chance!
Echoes of Change#631.dst: Oh. Ou sabiam do plano inteiro. Ha... hahaha, nunca tivemos chance!
Echoes of Change#631.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#632.src: What are we going to do now? Yusanu, where's the next closest escape route?
Echoes of Change#632.dst: E agora, o que fazemos? Yusanu, qual é a rota de fuga mais próxima?
Echoes of Change#632.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#633.src: WE HAVE VOICES OVER BY THE CAMP SITE!! Requesting backup!
Echoes of Change#633.dst: TEM VOZES PERTO DO ACAMPAMENTO!! Pedindo reforços!
Echoes of Change#633.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#634.src: Ugh, there's more voices to the west! That mean the only route left is... is... oh, no.
Echoes of Change#634.dst: Ugh, tem mais vozes a oeste! Então a única rota que sobra é... é... ah, não.
Echoes of Change#634.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#637.src: What?! That'll just take us even further into danger!
Echoes of Change#637.dst: O quê?! Isso só vai nos levar mais fundo no perigo!
Echoes of Change#637.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#638.src: Yeah, I know! But it's our only option left! We'll... we'll figure it out. Come on!
Echoes of Change#638.dst: É, eu sei! Mas é a única opção que sobrou! A gente... a gente dá um jeito. Vamos!
Echoes of Change#638.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#640.dst: Cuidado! Não deixe que te vejam!
Echoes of Change#640.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#641.src: Hey! We need to get out, now!
Echoes of Change#641.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#642.src: There's... barely any guards around. Zeph and Yuman must've really succeeded...
Echoes of Change#642.dst: Quase não tem... guardas por aqui. Zeph e Yuman devem ter conseguido mesmo...
Echoes of Change#642.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#643.src: ...hold it. Something's wrong. They would never leave the gate unguarded...
Echoes of Change#643.dst: ...espera. Tem algo errado. Eles nunca deixariam o portão sem vigilância...
Echoes of Change#643.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#645.src: You're right. We wouldn't be that obtuse. But you were.
Echoes of Change#645.dst: Tem razão. Não seríamos tão obtusos. Mas vocês foram.

Echoes of Change#648.src: I'll hand it to you, those were some unexpected variables you introduced for this plan of yours, but you should know how good I am at crunching the numbers.
Echoes of Change#648.dst: Admito, vocês introduziram umas variáveis inesperadas nesse plano, mas deviam saber como sou bom em fazer as contas.
Echoes of Change#648.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#649.src: More to the point... YOU. Cursed. You just keep summing to your list of crimes! There's the Torann massacre, we can add every other soldier to the tally... And...the death of a Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#649.dst: Mais direto ao ponto... VOCÊ. Amaldiçoado. Não para de somar à sua lista de crimes! Tem o massacre de Torann, podemos pôr cada soldado na conta... E... a morte de um Soberano.
Echoes of Change#649.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#650.src: Let me ask. Do you know how it feels to die? Disposed of like yesterday's garbage? Do you know how exponentially more excruciating it is to feel IN REVERSE?!
Echoes of Change#650.dst: Deixe-me perguntar. Sabe como é morrer? Ser descartado como o lixo de ontem? Sabe o quanto é exponencialmente mais excruciante sentir isso AO CONTRÁRIO?!
Echoes of Change#650.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#651.src: If dealing with you quickly wasn't magnitudes of order more important, I'd give you a lesson on the topic. Consider yourself lucky, cursed!
Echoes of Change#651.dst: Se acabar logo com você não fosse magnitudes de ordem mais importante, eu te daria uma aula. Considere-se com sorte, amaldiçoado!
Echoes of Change#651.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#652.src: What... what's going to happen with Syndra?
Echoes of Change#652.dst: O que... o que vai acontecer com a Syndra?
Echoes of Change#652.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#653.src: ...an attempt on Her Majesty's life carries high consequences. Almost positive she'll be divided out...but that isn't my problem to solve.
Echoes of Change#653.dst: ...atentar contra Sua Majestade tem consequências graves. Quase certo que ela será eliminada da equação... mas não é problema meu.
Echoes of Change#653.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#654.src: Weren't you... weren't you friends?! And you're just, going to let-
Echoes of Change#654.dst: Vocês não eram... não eram amigos?! E você vai simplesmente deixar-
Echoes of Change#654.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#655.src: NOT ONE MORE FACTORING WORD! How much do you think I enjoy this?! Do you think I want to hunt her down like a forgotten variable?!
Echoes of Change#655.dst: NEM MAIS UMA FATORADA PALAVRA! Acha que eu gosto disso?! Acha que quero caçá-la como uma variável esquecida?!
Echoes of Change#655.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#656.src: She chose to terminate our sequence! She threw that all away, used me for some irrational solution! She has as much value as any of you zeroes now!
Echoes of Change#656.dst: Ela escolheu encerrar nossa sequência! Jogou tudo fora, me usou numa solução irracional! Agora ela vale tanto quanto vocês, seus zeros!
Echoes of Change#656.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#657.src: So why don't we accelerate this? Without that traitor misusing her blessing... Your number's up!!
Echoes of Change#657.dst: Por que não aceleramos? Sem aquela traidora desperdiçando a bênção... Seus dias estão contados!!
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#659.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#660.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#660.dst: Ele... morreu. De novo. Vencemos ele... de novo.
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#661.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#661.dst: De novo?! Então ele falava sério sobre você já tê-lo matado?
Echoes of Change#661.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#662.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#662.dst: ... Tá. Tá, então... provavelmente não foi de vez. Ótimo! Isso é... ótimo.
Echoes of Change#662.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#664.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#664.dst: Eu... eu não tenho mais, hã, mana pra lutar... e-então devíamos ir, antes que-
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#665.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#665.dst: Hã... é- é, devíamos... ir andando.
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#667.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#667.dst: C- como...? Da outra vez ele, ele demorou mais...
Echoes of Change#667.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#668.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#668.dst: Nngh... Você...calculou mal! Eu avisei! Você sabe como sou bom em fazer contas! Eu me preparei...hhhff...para essa possibilidade!
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#669.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#669.dst: Foi um risco calculado. Sobrecarregar o velho amuleto Nasin podia quebrá-lo. Mas, em vez disso... minha solução esperada chegou!
Echoes of Change#669.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#670.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#670.dst: Uma ressurreição quase instantânea! E ouvi sua parceira- Sem poder agora. Quase peguei vocês no primeiro round. Lutem quanto quiserem- vai dar zero, assassino!
Echoes of Change#670.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#671.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#671.dst: ...Soosu. Obrigado por me levar a sério. Não queria você envolvida pelo perigo, mas com nós dois... Resolvemos este problema num instante. Siga meu exem-
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#672.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#672.dst: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! Você... O que foi...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#673.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#673.dst: Soosu!! E-Esses são os insurgentes! Os assassinos!! Você não pode- O que eles- O QUE ELES TÊM CONTRA VOCÊ?! Soosu, eu juro, você pode sair dess-
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#674.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#674.dst: É, é... eu sei. Mas acho que cansei de tentar.
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#675.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#675.dst: ...Soosu...você não pode- Sei que pode ser melhor, você pode- Eu-
Echoes of Change#675.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#676.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#676.dst: Logo tudo vai acabar, Z. Por favor... não me faça te matar de novo.
Echoes of Change#676.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#679.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#679.dst: Por que- por que está nos ajudando?
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#680.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#680.dst: Só... vá, Yus. Está perdendo tempo.
Echoes of Change#680.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#681.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#681.dst: Mas... fui eu quem roubou seu projeto. Por que você...
Echoes of Change#681.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#682.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#682.dst: Sim, Yus, eu sei! Que importa por que estou ajudando vocês? Só... só pegue e vá. Antes que percebam que você está aqui.
Echoes of Change#682.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#683.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#683.dst: Ugh, por que você é tão-! Tá! Você - quando olho pra você, é como me ver, antes... antes de virar isto.
Echoes of Change#683.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#684.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#684.dst: Agora, vá! Corra! Fuja! Só vá embora!
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#685.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#685.dst: Se... Se eu te deixar aqui. Você, você-
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#686.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu. I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#686.dst: Vou ficar bem, Yusanu. Cansei de lutar. Cansei do meu dever. Estou farta desta vida.
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#688.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#688.dst: Vou ficar bem, Yusanu, cansei de lutar. Cansei do meu dever. Estou farta desta vida.
Echoes of Change#688.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#690.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#690.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#692.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#692.dst: Muito bem, Syndra, a Leoa. Nada a dizer? O gato comeu sua língua?
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#693.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#693.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#694.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#694.dst: Não, imagino que você sempre preferiu a linguagem da violência...
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#695.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#695.dst: Vai notar que a área foi esvaziada. Entende o que isso significa para você, não?
Echoes of Change#695.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#696.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#696.dst: O mesmo de sempre. Eu te mato, ou morro tentando.
Echoes of Change#696.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#697.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#697.dst: Yuman... P- p- precisamos de uma rota de fuga que f- fun- funcione!
Echoes of Change#697.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#698.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#698.dst: Ugh, tem muito mais guardas do que esperávamos! Vamos ter que dar um jeito de despistar todos...
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#700.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#700.dst: N- n- não aguento isso... não a- aju- ajudar a Syndra!
Echoes of Change#700.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#701.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#701.dst: Ei, cara, tenha fé. Ela vai achar um jeito de sair de lá! Mas agora temos que cuidar da gente, beleza?
Echoes of Change#701.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#702.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#702.dst: É... v- valeu, Yuman. Vamos c- con- continuar.
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#704.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#704.dst: Contemplem, cidadãos... o rosto do grupo insurgente.
Echoes of Change#704.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#705.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#705.dst: Os dois amaldiçoados que nos atacaram foram capturados. Porém, ainda há quem deseje nosso mal. Por favor, fiquem em alerta máximo!
Echoes of Change#705.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#706.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#706.dst: Se notarem qualquer comportamento suspeito, avisem o exército local. Juntos, prevaleceremos como nação.
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#707.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#707.dst: Mas não se preocupem. Nem um ataque tão agressivo do inimigo teve chance contra nosso poder. Garantirei a segurança de todos!
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#708.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#708.dst: Agora. Como punição por tentar me assassinar... vou executar Syndra, líder dos terroristas amaldiçoados, aqui mesmo!
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#709.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#709.dst: Seu cúmplice será preso e interrogado em busca de informações sobre os insurgentes restantes.
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#712.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#712.dst: Não me arrependo de nada que fiz. Sei que Fruma vai mudar para melhor. Talvez não hoje, nem amanhã! Mas a mudança virá.
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#713.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#713.dst: Lamento que tenha chegado a isso, Syndra... Não sinto alegria com sua morte. Me pergunto o que houve com aquela mulher que tinha um potencial sem limites.
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#714.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#714.dst: Vou encontrar suas crianças, Syndra. Esse seu chilique acaba aqui, com você.
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#715.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#715.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#716.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#716.dst: Eu te conheço, Soosu. Por favor, me diga o que há! Não é um problema sem solução! Não me faça perder dois dos meus-
Echoes of Change#716.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#717.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#717.dst: Soberano Zhiraok. Não posso deixar de notar a óbvia falta de terroristas capturados, em meio à cena de uma batalha.
Echoes of Change#717.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#718.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#718.dst: Vossa Majestade!! Os insurgentes devem ter chantageado a Soberana Soosu, ela-
Echoes of Change#718.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#719.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#719.dst: Silêncio. Você já me falhou duas vezes. Eles te venceram em combate duas vezes, Soberano.
Echoes of Change#719.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#720.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#720.dst: Eu- Os amaldiçoados são mais astutos do que eu cal-
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#721.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#721.dst: Estou decepcionada com seu desempenho. Você está expressamente proibido de continuar perseguindo e rastreando essas... crianças podres.
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#722.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#722.dst: ...Eu. ... ...Assumo sozinho a responsabilidade por este fracasso, Majestade. Ma-
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#723.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#723.dst: Concentre-se em manter as operações de {p} na ausência de sua Soberana, sim? Você já tem bastante experiência nisso, tenho certeza.
Echoes of Change#723.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#724.dst: A...a ausência- Não- A senhora está subtrain-
Echoes of Change#724.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#725.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#725.dst: Agora, pare de ficar parado e faça algo! Reúna os soldados, cace os restos daquele grupo terrorista que ainda se escondem!
Echoes of Change#725.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#728.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#728.dst: Quanto a você... acha que seus joguinhos vão te poupar da minha ira? Atacar um colega Soberano, deixar esses alvos escaparem...
Echoes of Change#728.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#729.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#729.dst: Blá, blá, que seja. Acabe logo com isso. Me mate de uma vez, se valho tão pouco pra você.
Echoes of Change#729.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#730.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#730.dst: E te conceder uma morte tranquila? Depois de eu te dar tudo, e você se virar e me trair?!
Echoes of Change#730.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#731.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#731.dst: Não, Soosu. Você não merece tal clemência de mim.
Echoes of Change#731.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#732.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#732.dst: ...cada fatorada pessoa aqui embaixo está acusada de conspiração. Sua Majestade exige a captura deles, por todos os meios.
Echoes of Change#732.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#733.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#733.dst: Façam isso. Agora. Um deles tem que saber o que fizeram com a Soo- ... Vou interrogar cada um deles. Pessoalmente.
Echoes of Change#733.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#734.src: This shelf is filled with recent reports on military activity...
Echoes of Change#734.dst: Esta estante está cheia de relatórios sobre atividade militar...

Echoes of Change#735.src: Nothing seems to mention guard schedules, though.
Echoes of Change#735.dst: Mas nada parece mencionar as escalas da guarda.

Echoes of Change#736.src: First Division - Stationed at the main entrance to the city.
Echoes of Change#736.dst: Primeira Divisão - Posicionada na entrada principal da cidade.

Echoes of Change#737.src: You continue to write down the rest of the guard divisions' positions...
Echoes of Change#737.dst: Você continua anotando as posições das outras divisões da guarda...

Echoes of Change#738.src: Right-Click a block to pick it up.
Echoes of Change#738.dst: {c1}Clique direito{c2} em um bloco para pegá-lo.

Echoes of Change#739.src: Place the block on empty tiles.

Echoes of Change#740.src: Fill the board to complete one puzzle!
Echoes of Change#740.dst: {c1}Preencha{c2} o tabuleiro para completar um quebra-cabeça!

Echoes of Change#742.src: - Every square has to contain a piece of the bomb.
Echoes of Change#742.dst: - Cada casa deve conter uma peça da bomba.

Echoes of Change#743.src: - Create three bomb pieces and later combine them into one.
Echoes of Change#743.dst: - Crie {c2}três{/} peças de bomba e depois combine-as em uma.

Echoes of Change#744.dst: {#} Este bloco não pode ser removido!

Echoes of Change#745.src: Ah! Worked better than I anticipated, no rogue explosions.
Echoes of Change#745.dst: Ah! Melhor que o esperado, nenhuma explosão descontrolada.

Echoes of Change#746.src: Um. You- you expected it to go off?!
Echoes of Change#746.dst: Hã. Você- você esperava que explodisse?!

Echoes of Change#747.src: There's electric charge casings and a quiver of arrows...
Echoes of Change#747.dst: Há invólucros de carga elétrica e uma aljava de flechas...

Echoes of Change#748.src: It's good to have multiple routes leading to the escape point, in case one gets blocked.
Echoes of Change#748.dst: É bom ter várias rotas até o ponto de fuga, caso uma fique bloqueada.

Echoes of Change#749.src: There seem to be multiple roads leading into the escape point. That's a good sign.
Echoes of Change#749.dst: Parece haver várias ruas levando ao ponto de fuga. Bom sinal.

Echoes of Change#750.src: Long live Her Majesty, the Queen of Fruma. May Her presence bless us for many more years to come.
Echoes of Change#750.dst: Vida longa a Sua Majestade, a Rainha de Fruma. Que Sua presença nos abençoe por muitos anos mais.

Echoes of Change#751.src: Return to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#751.dst: Volte à Pluma de Aço pelo túnel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#755.src: Rrrngh...huff...you...aren't getting away from me...huff...again. Our sequence...isn't terminated yet!
Echoes of Change#755.dst: Rrrngh...huff...você...não vai fugir de mim...huff...de novo. Nossa sequência...ainda não terminou!

Elemental Exercise#000.src: Hm... So if I attack this one, I'll deal more {#} Air and less {#} Earth...
Elemental Exercise#000.dst: Hm... Se eu atacar este, causo mais dano de {#} Ar e menos de {#} Terra...
Elemental Exercise#000.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#001.src: Oh, {u}. Don't mind me, I'm just trying to wrap my head around this all.
Elemental Exercise#001.dst: Oh, {u}. Não liga pra mim, só estou tentando entender tudo isso.
Elemental Exercise#001.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#002.src: Hm. Come looking for more training, have you? I'm afraid the next training session isn't for some time.
Elemental Exercise#002.dst: Hm. Veio atrás de mais treino, foi? Receio que a próxima sessão de treino demore um pouco.
Elemental Exercise#002.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#003.src: If you'd like some more advice for combat, though, you could always speak to the soldiers down in the training room.
Elemental Exercise#003.dst: Mas, se quiser mais conselhos de combate, pode sempre falar com os soldados lá embaixo, na sala de treino.
Elemental Exercise#003.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#004.src: They're honing their skills, and they'll gladly share some tips if you ask them.
Elemental Exercise#004.dst: Eles estão treinando e dão dicas com prazer se você pedir.

Elemental Exercise#005.src: Did you know you can stash your items in your bank? You can even get them back at any other bank, any time!
Elemental Exercise#005.dst: Sabia que dá pra guardar itens no banco? E dá pra pegá-los em qualquer outro banco, a qualquer hora!

Elemental Exercise#006.src: Now, I'm not sure how that works, but it's best to not ask any questions.
Elemental Exercise#006.dst: Agora, não sei bem como isso funciona, mas é melhor não fazer perguntas.

Elemental Exercise#007.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to the elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#007.dst: Eu tenho uma. Se nossos inimigos são sensíveis aos elementos desse jeito, isso também vale pra nós?
Elemental Exercise#007.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#008.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound to the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#008.dst: Ah, sim. Boa observação. De fato, vocês também estão sujeitos às regras dos elementos. As defesas e fraquezas elementais do seu equipamento afetam vocês do mesmo jeito.
Elemental Exercise#008.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#009.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does not use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#009.dst: Porém, vocês têm outra ferramenta à disposição: seus feitiços! Feitiços diferentes causam dano de elementos diferentes, mesmo que sua arma não use esse elemento por padrão.
Elemental Exercise#009.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#010.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal {#} Earth damage even if my weapon only uses {#} Water , right?
Elemental Exercise#010.dst: ...Ah! Então meu Bash ainda causa dano de {#} Terra mesmo se minha arma só usa {#} Água , né?
Elemental Exercise#010.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#011.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a safe environment.
Elemental Exercise#011.dst: Correto! Agora, vejamos... Temos vocês dois aqui. Que tal um duelo amistoso? Uma chance de testar suas habilidades de combate num ambiente seguro.
Elemental Exercise#011.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#012.src: The leader has been slain! Take out the stragglers, soldiers! The battle has been won!
Elemental Exercise#012.dst: O líder caiu! Acabem com os retardatários, soldados! A batalha está ganha!
Elemental Exercise#012.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#013.src: We've been seeing more attacks from {p} recently... good grief, when will that Graken do his job and sort it out?
Elemental Exercise#013.dst: Temos visto mais ataques vindos de {p}... minha nossa, quando o Graken vai fazer o trabalho dele e resolver isso?
Elemental Exercise#013.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#014.src: Hmph. Well, regardless, the two of you fought well! The training seems to have paid off.
Elemental Exercise#014.dst: Hunf. Bom, de todo modo, vocês dois lutaram bem! O treino parece ter valido a pena.
Elemental Exercise#014.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#015.src: Thank you, sir! That summoner was a tough foe, but it was nothing we couldn't handle... right, {u}?
Elemental Exercise#015.dst: Obrigado, senhor! Aquele invocador era duro, mas nada que não pudéssemos encarar... né, {u}?
Elemental Exercise#015.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#016.src: Hm... Let us return to the barracks. I'll have to speak to the Admiral when he returns, and I'd like for the two of you to be present.
Elemental Exercise#016.dst: Hm... Vamos voltar ao quartel. Terei que falar com o Almirante quando ele voltar, e quero que vocês dois estejam presentes.
Elemental Exercise#016.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#017.src: He wants us to be there for a meeting with the Admiral...? Huh. What do you think that could be about?
Elemental Exercise#017.dst: Ele quer que a gente esteja numa reunião com o Almirante...? Hum. Do que você acha que se trata?
Elemental Exercise#017.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#018.src: ... Hopefully it's not anything bad. He did seem to approve of our combat prowess, but-... Nevermind. We should get going.
Elemental Exercise#018.dst: ... Tomara que não seja nada ruim. Ele pareceu aprovar nossas habilidades de combate, mas-... Deixa pra lá. Vamos indo.
Elemental Exercise#018.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#019.src: Ahem. Before you return to your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#019.dst: Hum, hum. Antes de voltarem aos seus afazeres, tenho algo para vocês dois. O pagamento pelo trabalho de hoje e um equipamento especial. Façam bom uso.
Elemental Exercise#019.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#020.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#020.dst: Fale com o capitão Ragon no quartel de {p}, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#021.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... {u}, yes?
Elemental Exercise#021.dst: Ah! Você deve ser um dos novos recrutas que o Almirante me pediu para esperar! Como era... {u}, certo?
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#022.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#022.dst: Você fez bem em chegar a esta cidade tão rápido, o que deve ter exigido muita luta contra os mortos-vivos.
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#023.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#023.dst: Bem, o sargento Van me contou da sua ajuda no ataque ao nosso forte tomado- bom trabalho, muito bem feito...
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#024.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#024.dst: Mas o fato é que falta experiência a você. Você sabe lutar, sim, mas sabe lutar bem?
Elemental Exercise#024.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#025.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#025.dst: Sorte sua que é aí que eu entro. Você chegou bem na hora do treino de hoje! Venha, me siga.
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#026.dst: Siga o capitão Ragon até a sala de treinamento em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#027.src: ...Oh! {u}, hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#027.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#028.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#028.dst: Ahem. Bem, à frente de vocês estão cinco bonecos de treino especiais, cada um imbuído de magia elemental. Vocês conhecem os elementos, certo? São cinco no total.
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#029.src: I am! The elements are... {#} Fire, {#} Air, {#} Earth, {#} Thunder, and... {#} Water?
Elemental Exercise#029.dst: Conheço! Os elementos são... {#} Fogo, {#} Ar, {#} Terra, {#} Trovão e... {#} Água?
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#030.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- {#} Fire beats {#} Air, {#} Air beats {#} Earth, and so on.
Elemental Exercise#030.dst: Isso mesmo. E, em geral, um vence o outro nessa ordem- {#} Fogo vence {#} Ar, {#} Ar vence {#} Terra, e assim por diante.
Elemental Exercise#030.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#031.dst: As fraquezas elementais variam por inimigo, mas essa ordem vale na maioria dos casos.
Elemental Exercise#031.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#032.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#032.dst: Os inimigos sofrem mais dano dos elementos a que são fracos e menos dos que resistem. Essa mudança no seu dano é sempre um valor fixo e varia de inimigo para inimigo.
Elemental Exercise#032.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#033.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#033.dst: Bem. Para o treino, vocês receberão uma arma elemental para testar nesses bonecos. Reparem como cada defesa e fraqueza elemental afeta o dano causado. Falem comigo quando acharem que entenderam.
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#034.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#034.dst: Teste as armas de treino elementais nos bonecos e depois fale com o capitão Ragon em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#035.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#035.dst: E então? Repararam no efeito das defesas e fraquezas elementais no seu dano?
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#036.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#036.dst: Excelente. Vou recolher as armas de treino de vocês dois. Alguma pergunta?
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#037.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#037.dst: Uma última observação antes de deixarmos os elementos- nem sempre sua arma será tão eficaz contra um inimigo quanto gostaria.
Elemental Exercise#037.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#038.src: That sounds good to me! {u}, we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#038.dst: Por mim, tudo bem! {u}, já faz tempo que viajamos juntos... Confesso que estava curioso para ver como você luta. Vamos ver quem leva a melhor?
Elemental Exercise#038.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#040.dst: Certo. Espero aqui até você estar pronto!
Elemental Exercise#040.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#042.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#042.dst: Vá em frente, então. Fale comigo quando quiser continuar.
Elemental Exercise#042.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#043.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.
Elemental Exercise#043.dst: Volte até Tasim em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para o duelo.

Elemental Exercise#044.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#044.dst: Aí está você! Pronto para o nosso duelo?
Elemental Exercise#044.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#045.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#045.dst: Certo! Vamos ver quem de nós luta melhor!
Elemental Exercise#045.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#047.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.
Elemental Exercise#047.dst: Enfrente Tasim em um duelo amistoso.

Elemental Exercise#048.dst: Fale com o capitão Ragon em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, {u}. We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#049.dst: Ufa! Que boa luta. Você mandou bem, {u}. Temos que repetir- e talvez chamar o Aledar!
Elemental Exercise#049.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#050.src: Woo! You fought well, {u}, but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#050.dst: Uhu! Lutou bem, {u}, mas parece que eu ainda sou melhor! Espera só o Aledar saber...
Elemental Exercise#050.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#051.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#051.dst: Sim, sim, bom trabalho, os dois. Agora-
Elemental Exercise#051.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#052.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#052.dst: Capitão! Capitão Ragon! Tem- tem forças corrompidas! Avançando de {p}!
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#053.dst: Hum. E o almirante está fora... Muito bem. Mobilizem as tropas! Vamos enfrentá-los no portão norte!
Elemental Exercise#053.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#055.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead.
Elemental Exercise#055.dst: Capitão- nós também lutamos. Deixe a gente ajudar a enfrentar esses mortos-vivos!
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#056.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#056.dst: Hm... A meu ver, é uma ótima chance de vocês ganharem experiência real! Muito bem. Preparem-se e venham ao portão norte de {p} quando estiverem prontos.
Elemental Exercise#056.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#057.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#057.dst: Que emocionante! Mas... ainda tô meio nervoso.
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#058.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the Captain.
Elemental Exercise#058.dst: ... Vamos ficar bem. Vem, vamos seguir o capitão.
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#059.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.
Elemental Exercise#059.dst: Siga o capitão Ragon até o portão norte de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para enfrentar as forças de mortos-vivos.

Elemental Exercise#060.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#060.dst: Aí estão! Prontos para a luta?
Elemental Exercise#060.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#061.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#061.dst: Também tô pronto. Esses corrompidos não têm chance contra nós!
Elemental Exercise#061.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#062.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#062.dst: Sim, sim, muito bem. Agora, não deve demorar até-
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#064.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#064.dst: Hm... Atenção ao líder. Se o derrotarmos, imagino que o resto das forças se disperse.
Elemental Exercise#064.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#065.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#065.dst: Inimigos fortes como este lançam feitiços um após o outro, numa ordem específica. Esses combos de feitiços podem ser perigosos, então prestem atenção neles.
Elemental Exercise#065.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#066.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#066.dst: Vamos lutar ao seu redor, então gritem se precisarem de ajuda. Certo, soldados, vamos defender nossa cidade!
Elemental Exercise#066.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#068.src: I need to get ready first.

Elemental Exercise#069.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#069.dst: Entendo. Temos tempo até as forças corrompidas chegarem, então vá se preparar. Mas não demore muito.
Elemental Exercise#069.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#070.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.
Elemental Exercise#070.dst: Derrote o Capitão corrompido e as forças que ameaçam {p}.

Elemental Exercise#071.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#071.dst: Volte ao quartel de {p} e fale com o capitão Ragon em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#072.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#072.dst: Ah, aí estão vocês. Venham cá.
Elemental Exercise#072.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#074.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#074.dst: Sim, eu não ficaria fora por muito tempo. Fui à cidade desértica de {p}, para uma reunião com um tal almirante Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#074.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#075.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#075.dst: Mas divago. Soube que vocês dois foram essenciais na defesa da nossa cidade! Excelente trabalho.
Elemental Exercise#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#076.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#076.dst: Os preparativos do ataque ao covil de aranhas de {p} estão quase prontos. Quero vocês dois nessa missão.
Elemental Exercise#076.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#077.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#077.dst: Senhor- tem certeza? Quer dizer, adoraríamos ir, mas com certeza há muitos outros mais dignos dessa tarefa.
Elemental Exercise#077.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#078.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#078.dst: Bobagem! O capitão Ragon avaliou suas habilidades e as considerou suficientes. E eu confio no julgamento do capitão.
Elemental Exercise#078.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#079.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#079.dst: Agora preciso ir. Vejo vocês dois quando chegar a hora da missão.
Elemental Exercise#079.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#080.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#080.dst: Uma grande missão para acabar com as aranhas, hein... Sabe, mesmo um pouco preocupado, acho que estou animado.
Elemental Exercise#080.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#081.src: Come on, let's get going towards the north gate.
Elemental Exercise#081.dst: Vem, vamos seguir para o portão norte.
Elemental Exercise#081.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#082.src: Oh, {u}! Are you here for some training? Aledar and I thought we'd get some practice in before... you know.
Elemental Exercise#082.dst: Ah, {u}! Veio treinar um pouco? Eu e o Aledar pensamos em praticar antes de... você sabe.
Elemental Exercise#082.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#083.src: It's going... about as well as you would expect.
Elemental Exercise#083.dst: Está indo... mais ou menos como você imagina.
Elemental Exercise#083.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#084.src: Hey! It's going great, thank you very much! When we go fight those spiders, I'll be well prepared!
Elemental Exercise#084.dst: Ei! Está indo muito bem, muito obrigado! Quando formos enfrentar aquelas aranhas, vou estar bem preparado!
Elemental Exercise#084.speaker: Aledar

Elemental Exercise#085.src: ...Sure. Well, {u}, there's plenty of dummies around if you want to train up as well. Including the one fighting a dummy of the same element as his weapon...
Elemental Exercise#085.dst: ...Claro. Bem, {u}, tem bonecos de sobra por aqui se você também quiser treinar. Incluindo aquele que está lutando contra um boneco do mesmo elemento da arma dele...
Elemental Exercise#085.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#086.src: I'll have you know, I...- alright, that's fair.
Elemental Exercise#086.dst: Fique sabendo que eu...- tá, justo.
Elemental Exercise#086.speaker: Aledar

Elemental Exercise#087.src: Oh, {u}! Good to see you- I'm just here getting some training in before we take on those spiders.
Elemental Exercise#087.dst: Ah, {u}! Que bom te ver- só estou treinando um pouco antes de encararmos aquelas aranhas.
Elemental Exercise#087.speaker: Aledar

Elemental Exercise#088.src: And Tasim's here for moral support!
Elemental Exercise#088.dst: E o Tasim está aqui pelo apoio moral!
Elemental Exercise#088.speaker: Aledar

Elemental Exercise#089.src: That's what I do best. Also, I can tell you when your form's off. Which is... fairly often. Including right now!
Elemental Exercise#089.dst: É o que eu faço de melhor. E também posso avisar quando sua postura sai do lugar. O que acontece... com bastante frequência. Inclusive agora!
Elemental Exercise#089.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#090.src: ...When did you get better than me at this?
Elemental Exercise#090.dst: ...Quando foi que você ficou melhor que eu nisso?
Elemental Exercise#090.speaker: Aledar

Ensemble of Hope#000.src: Meet up with your friends in room number {~} in hotel {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#000.dst: Encontre seus amigos no quarto número {~} do hotel {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#003.src: {u}'s here? Good, that means we can-
Ensemble of Hope#003.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#007.src: Ugh. ZEPH! Get out of there already!
Ensemble of Hope#007.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#008.src: C...coming! Jeez, Rex, g...give a man his p- pr- privacy...
Ensemble of Hope#008.dst: J...já vou! Rex, d...deixa eu ter p- pr- privacidade...
Ensemble of Hope#008.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#010.src: Rex. I'm f...fine. St- stop asking me that.
Ensemble of Hope#010.dst: Rex. Tô b...bem. P- para de perguntar isso.
Ensemble of Hope#010.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#011.src: Okay! Okay. Gods forbid I worry about you for even a second...
Ensemble of Hope#011.dst: Tá! Tá. Deuses me livrem de me preocupar um segundo sequer...
Ensemble of Hope#011.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#012.src: Rex. You had something to tell us.
Ensemble of Hope#012.dst: Rex. Você tinha algo pra contar.
Ensemble of Hope#012.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#013.src: Right, okay, I'll get to it. These past few days, I have been plotting. I have something... serviceable, I think.
Ensemble of Hope#013.dst: Certo, tá, já vou. Nesses últimos dias, andei tramando. Acho que tenho algo... aproveitável.
Ensemble of Hope#013.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#014.src: So, to start with, let's lay out our goal - the destruction of the Crown, the Queen and her Sovereigns included.
Ensemble of Hope#014.dst: Então, para começar, vamos definir nosso objetivo - destruir a Coroa, incluindo a Rainha e seus Soberanos.
Ensemble of Hope#014.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#015.src: We won't be able to do it ourselves - we're only four people. And we definitely won't be able to do it if their eyes are on us the whole time!
Ensemble of Hope#015.dst: Não vamos conseguir sozinhos - somos só quatro. E com certeza não vamos conseguir se ficarem de olho na gente o tempo todo!
Ensemble of Hope#015.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#016.src: Sui and {u}, you two worked with the Canopy while you were in the {p}. Do you think they have the people and resources to help us?
Ensemble of Hope#016.dst: Sui e {u}, vocês dois trabalharam com o Dossel quando estavam em {p}. Acham que eles têm gente e recursos para nos ajudar?
Ensemble of Hope#016.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#017.src: They do. They've... been fighting openly against the crown for years and haven't been caught. So... they know what they're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#017.dst: Têm. Eles... lutam abertamente contra a Coroa há anos e nunca foram pegos. Então... sabem o que fazem.
Ensemble of Hope#017.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#018.src: Good, we'll want to get in contact then. And Yusanu is with them, anyway... it'll be good to see him again.
Ensemble of Hope#018.dst: Ótimo, então vamos querer contatá-los. E o Yusanu está com eles, aliás... vai ser bom revê-lo.
Ensemble of Hope#018.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#020.src: But, uh, moving on. Zeph, you went out earlier and gathered some information on the {p}, right?
Ensemble of Hope#020.dst: Mas, hã, seguindo. Zeph, você saiu mais cedo e juntou informações sobre {p}, né?
Ensemble of Hope#020.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#021.src: Y- yeah! P...people around here seem v- v- very excited for th...the festival. The C- Cr- Crown is gonna be b...busy with preparations for a wh...while.
Ensemble of Hope#021.dst: S- sim! O p...pessoal daqui parece m- m- muito animado com o...o festival. A C- Co- Coroa vai ficar o...ocupada com os preparativos por um t...tempo.
Ensemble of Hope#021.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#022.src: B- but, uh, Rex, y...you wanted me to- to ch...check out the Dam E- Elevator, right?
Ensemble of Hope#022.dst: M- mas, hã, Rex, v...você queria que eu v...visse o e- elevador da represa, né?
Ensemble of Hope#022.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#023.src: I did, yep. What's the guards situation like? Heavily guarded, lightly guarded... somewhere in between?
Ensemble of Hope#023.dst: Queria, sim. Como está a guarda? Muito vigiado, pouco vigiado... meio-termo?
Ensemble of Hope#023.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#024.src: S...somewhere in be- between, I think. Cl...closer to lightly guarded. I don't th- think they're ex- exp- expecting an... a- an attack.
Ensemble of Hope#024.dst: M...meio-termo, a- acho. M...mais pra pouco vigiado. Não a- acho que eles e- esp- esperem um... u- um ataque.
Ensemble of Hope#024.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#025.src: Perfect. Perfect, perfect, perfect... so! How do we all feel about committing some light terrorism today?
Ensemble of Hope#025.dst: Perfeito. Perfeito, perfeito, perfeito... então! O que acham de cometer um terrorismozinho hoje?
Ensemble of Hope#025.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#026.src: Okay, curb the enthusiasm a little. Let me explain why, first.
Ensemble of Hope#026.dst: Tá, menos entusiasmo. Deixem eu explicar o porquê primeiro.
Ensemble of Hope#026.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#027.src: Ev- ever the optimist... R- Rex, why do you w...want to take the e- el-... the elevator?
Ensemble of Hope#027.dst: S- sempre otimista... R- Rex, por que você q...quer tomar o e- el-... o elevador?
Ensemble of Hope#027.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#028.src: Like we haven't done worse already... um, why the elevator, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.dst: Já fizemos coisa pior... hã, por que o elevador, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#029.src: We need to get the Crown's eyes off of us. They won't expect us to try to return to the {p} - why would we? The enemy is right here.
Ensemble of Hope#029.dst: Precisamos tirar os olhos da Coroa de nós. Eles não esperam que a gente tente voltar para {p} - para quê? O inimigo está aqui.
Ensemble of Hope#029.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#030.src: So what happens when we do? They'll start thinking. Why are we doing it? What do we have to gain?
Ensemble of Hope#030.dst: E o que acontece quando voltarmos? Vão começar a pensar. Por que fazemos isso? O que ganhamos?
Ensemble of Hope#030.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#031.src: They'll start to pay attention to that elevator. And, if we're lucky, less attention on what we're actually doing.
Ensemble of Hope#031.dst: Vão começar a prestar atenção naquele elevador. E, com sorte, menos no que realmente estamos fazendo.
Ensemble of Hope#031.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#032.src: ...and, well, maybe if we're fast, we could bring some friends up from Auburn to us. We could use all the help we can get.
Ensemble of Hope#032.dst: ...e, bom, se formos rápidos, talvez dê para trazer alguns amigos de Auburn para cá. Toda ajuda é bem-vinda.
Ensemble of Hope#032.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#033.src: Th...that- that sounds nice... it- it's been s...so long already...
Ensemble of Hope#033.dst: I...isso- isso seria bom... já- já faz t...tanto tempo...
Ensemble of Hope#033.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#035.src: Sui... do you think you and Zeph could handle getting the rest of the Leaves up here? Zeph'll need someone who knows how to find the Canopy, and I need {u} with me.
Ensemble of Hope#035.dst: Sui... você e o Zeph dão conta de trazer o resto das Folhas para cá? O Zeph vai precisar de alguém que saiba achar o Dossel, e eu preciso de {u} comigo.
Ensemble of Hope#035.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#038.src: Well, we'll all be going to take control of the elevator anyway. We can... talk more there.
Ensemble of Hope#038.dst: Bom, de qualquer jeito vamos todos tomar o elevador. Podemos... conversar mais lá.
Ensemble of Hope#038.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#039.src: {u}, after we've done that, I'll need you to take me to the Canopy. I want to familiarize myself with their leadership, and start working on an actual plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.dst: {u}, depois disso, preciso que você me leve até o Dossel. Quero conhecer os líderes deles e começar a trabalhar num plano de verdade.
Ensemble of Hope#039.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#040.src: Okay! I think that's everything. Let's all get ready, then head to that elevator on the southern side of the dam!
Ensemble of Hope#040.dst: Certo! Acho que é tudo. Vamos nos preparar e ir até aquele elevador no lado sul da represa!
Ensemble of Hope#040.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#043.src: Hi, {u}. Ready to fight more of the crown's soldiers?
Ensemble of Hope#043.dst: Oi, {u}. Pronto pra lutar com mais soldados da Coroa?
Ensemble of Hope#043.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#047.src: We... have Rex and Zeph back. We're going to reunite with the people we left behind in Auburn. We're going to meet back with the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#047.dst: Nós... temos a Rex e o Zeph de volta. Vamos reencontrar quem deixamos em Auburn. Vamos nos juntar de novo ao Dossel.
