Fantastic Voyage#105.dst: Voltando ao assunto! Consistência! A consistência é consistentemente a parte mais importante de qualquer bom pão.
Fantastic Voyage#105.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#106.src: Overusin' so-called 'refined' grains is a sure and done way to get runny slop that's not fit for the pigs.
Fantastic Voyage#106.dst: Abusar dos tais grãos 'refinados' é o jeito certo de acabar com uma lavagem mole que nem os porcos comem.
Fantastic Voyage#106.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#107.src: Come to think, you shouldn't feed pig refined grains anyway. It's hard on their digestion.
Fantastic Voyage#107.dst: Pensando bem, nem dê grãos refinados aos porcos. Faz mal pra digestão deles.
Fantastic Voyage#107.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#108.src: Of course! Digestion. A topic I’ll get to later!
Fantastic Voyage#108.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#109.src: Anyway, whole grains are where the money’s at! I’d swear it on these plants.
Fantastic Voyage#109.dst: Enfim, os grãos integrais é que são o negócio! Juro por estas plantas.
Fantastic Voyage#109.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#110.src: What you want is a thick-crusted, chewy loaf that you can savor! Not some frail morsel that collapses under its own weight. Why, the things I’ve seen...
Fantastic Voyage#110.dst: O que você quer é um pão de casca grossa e miolo elástico pra saborear! Não um bocado frágil que desaba com o próprio peso. Ora, as coisas que já vi...
Fantastic Voyage#110.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#111.src: In particular, have you seen some of the scraps sold at {p}? Ridiculous!
Fantastic Voyage#111.dst: Em especial, já viu as migalhas que vendem em {p}? Ridículo!
Fantastic Voyage#111.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#112.src: I'll let you in on a little secret. The Sky's Kitchen's great and all, but what passes for bread there is intolerable. No substance at all!
Fantastic Voyage#112.dst: Vou te contar um segredinho. A Sky's Kitchen é ótima e tudo, mas o que passa por pão ali é intolerável. Nenhuma substância!
Fantastic Voyage#112.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#113.src: What you'll want to do is get it straight from the fields, right from the soil! Well, not literally, but from the countryside! Leave breadmakin' to those who've been workin' with grain before they could even walk on two legs!
Fantastic Voyage#113.dst: O que você quer é pegar direto do campo, direto do solo! Bem, não literalmente, mas do interior! Deixe o pão com quem trabalha com grãos desde antes de andar sobre duas pernas!
Fantastic Voyage#113.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#114.src: Heck, I bet even I could do a better job than those snobby sauciers.
Fantastic Voyage#114.dst: Ora, aposto que até eu faria melhor que esses cozinheiros metidos.
Fantastic Voyage#114.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#115.src: Right. Digestion. The fiber in whole-grain bread is a real lifesaver.
Fantastic Voyage#115.dst: Isso. Digestão. A fibra do pão integral é uma salvação.
Fantastic Voyage#115.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#116.src: Did you know that whole-grain bread has four times the fiber of white bread? Now you do!
Fantastic Voyage#116.dst: Sabia que o pão integral tem quatro vezes a fibra do pão branco? Agora sabe!
Fantastic Voyage#116.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#117.src: Helps keep you full and fit. Want to avoid lookin’ like a loaf of white bread yourself? Fiber’s your man.
Fantastic Voyage#117.dst: Ajuda a manter você saciado e em forma. Quer evitar ficar parecendo um pão branco? A fibra é sua aliada.
Fantastic Voyage#117.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#118.src: Nothin’ beats a rich, fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf with a slab of flat-iron steak. Red meat and fiber make a real man, as my pappy once said.
Fantastic Voyage#118.dst: Nada supera um pão rico, moído e assado na hora, com uma fatia de bife. Carne vermelha e fibra fazem um homem de verdade, como dizia meu pai.
Fantastic Voyage#118.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#119.src: Oh, how time flies. Where was I? Right, white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#119.dst: Como o tempo voa. Onde eu estava? Isso, pão branco.
Fantastic Voyage#119.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#120.src: That stuff’s poison, I tell you! Not a lick of nutritional value!
Fantastic Voyage#120.dst: Aquilo é veneno, vou te contar! Nem um pingo de valor nutritivo!
Fantastic Voyage#120.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#121.src: It’s more milk and sugar than bread! Hardly somethin’ you’d want to eat, never mind something for which you’d pay extra!
Fantastic Voyage#121.dst: Tem mais leite e açúcar que pão! Mal dá vontade de comer, quanto mais pagar a mais por isso!
Fantastic Voyage#121.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#122.src: Those hawkers can pretend that it's an upper-crust good all they want, but we all know it's just a waste of dough.
Fantastic Voyage#122.dst: Esses ambulantes podem vender como coisa de gente fina, mas todo mundo sabe que é farinha do mesmo saco.
Fantastic Voyage#122.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#123.src: Heheh, I did it again! Sorry, sorry, I’ll get the train back on track. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#123.dst: Hehe, fiz de novo! Desculpe, vou pôr o trem de volta nos trilhos. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#123.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#124.src: Blendin' grains? Why jumble the flavors and textures? Just make two loaves of bread instead of one! Or several, if we're talkin' about more than two types of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#124.dst: Misturar grãos? Pra que embaralhar sabores e texturas? É só fazer dois pães em vez de um! Ou vários, se forem mais de dois tipos de grão.
Fantastic Voyage#124.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#125.src: Say, that reminds me! Bread’s probably the most versatile food. You can make it from just about any type of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#125.dst: Opa, isso me lembra! O pão deve ser o alimento mais versátil. Dá pra fazer com quase qualquer grão.
Fantastic Voyage#125.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#126.src: But just because you can doesn't mean that you should. Who could stomach somethin' like 'Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight'? WHO WOULD EVEN MAKE BREAD OUT OF OATS?!
Fantastic Voyage#126.dst: Mas poder não quer dizer dever. Quem aguenta algo como 'Delícia Fusão de Aveia e Farelo'? QUEM FARIA PÃO DE AVEIA?!
Fantastic Voyage#126.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#127.src: Just a waste of food, in my opinion. Sure, it may be like the hottest new culinary sensation now, but it’ll die out like any other idiotic fad in just days. I’m positive that nobody’s eatin’ it for the taste, that’s for sure. Like “Seven Colors of the Grainbow,” or “Hearty Hemp-tastic,” or...
Fantastic Voyage#127.dst: Puro desperdício de comida, na minha opinião. Claro, pode ser a sensação culinária do momento, mas vai sumir em dias como qualquer outra moda idiota. Tenho certeza absoluta de que ninguém come aquilo pelo sabor. Tipo "Sete Cores do Arco-Grãos", ou "Canhamástico Caprichado", ou...
Fantastic Voyage#127.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#128.src: ...and don't get me started on 'Pain au {p}'! But really, Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight is among the worst. Oh! That reminds me about a better use for oats.
Fantastic Voyage#128.dst: ...e nem me fale do 'Pain au {p}'! Mas sério, a Delícia Fusão de Aveia e Farelo está entre as piores. Ah! Isso me lembra um uso melhor para a aveia.
Fantastic Voyage#128.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#129.src: If you want to avoid bein’ three sheets to the wind after a busy night of Jofash Rum, then eat a hearty bowl of oatmeal.
Fantastic Voyage#129.dst: Se quer evitar ficar de pileque depois de uma noite agitada de rum de Jofash, coma uma boa tigela de mingau de aveia.
Fantastic Voyage#129.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#130.src: Sounds crazy, I know. But it actually works. Take it from me; I’ve tried it!
Fantastic Voyage#130.dst: Parece loucura, eu sei. Mas funciona mesmo. Pode acreditar, já testei!
Fantastic Voyage#130.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#131.src: While anythin’ made of grain helps, oats are particularly good at this.
Fantastic Voyage#131.dst: Qualquer coisa de grão ajuda, mas a aveia é especialmente boa nisso.
Fantastic Voyage#131.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#132.src: And I’d bet my bread that you’d rather eat oatmeal than Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight, whatever that’s supposed to be.
Fantastic Voyage#132.dst: E aposto meu pão que você prefere comer aveia a Delícia Fusão de Aveia e Farelo, seja lá o que for isso.
Fantastic Voyage#132.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#133.src: Though it seems like you just can't get a good loaf of bread nearby. Sure, there's sailin' biscuits, but that hardly qualifies!
Fantastic Voyage#133.dst: Mas parece que não dá pra achar um pão decente por aqui. Tá, tem os biscoitos de marinheiro, mas isso mal conta!
Fantastic Voyage#133.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#134.src: I can’t stomach the fancy stuff, so I just make my own. Not only is it cheaper, but it also tastes much better.
Fantastic Voyage#134.dst: Não engulo essas coisas chiques, então faço o meu. Além de mais barato, fica muito mais gostoso.
Fantastic Voyage#134.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#135.src: It isn’t too difficult. Besides the obvious, you’ll just need some salt and yeast. Grab something to write with, y’hear? Take some notes!
Fantastic Voyage#135.dst: Não é tão difícil. Além do óbvio, só precisa de sal e fermento. Pegue algo pra escrever, ouviu? Anote!
Fantastic Voyage#135.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#136.src: Ready? Right, let's get started! The less ingredients you use, the closer you'll get to makin' a real loaf! Not the wannabe poundcakes eaten by wannabe spendthrifts.
Fantastic Voyage#136.dst: Pronto? Então vamos! Quanto menos ingredientes, mais perto você chega de um pão de verdade! Não esses bolos de araque comidos por esbanjadores de araque.
Fantastic Voyage#136.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#137.src: There's a common misconception that you need sugar for yeast to start risin'. Not true!
Fantastic Voyage#137.dst: Tem um equívoco comum de que o fermento precisa de açúcar pra crescer. Mentira!
Fantastic Voyage#137.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#138.src: Give it some time, and bread without sugar will rise just as well. If you want somethin’ good, you need to put in the time and effort for it!
Fantastic Voyage#138.dst: Dê um tempo, e o pão sem açúcar cresce igualzinho. Se quer algo bom, tem que investir tempo e esforço!
Fantastic Voyage#138.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#139.src: Get it right, and you’ll have the perfect taste and texture for nothin’ more than a few hours of your time!
Fantastic Voyage#139.dst: Faça direito e terá o sabor e a textura perfeitos por apenas algumas horas do seu tempo!
Fantastic Voyage#139.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#140.src: Let me make it clear: you don’t want sugar in your bread. It’ll do a number on its taste and your teeth.
Fantastic Voyage#140.dst: Deixa eu ser claro: você não quer açúcar no pão. Ele acaba com o sabor e com seus dentes.
Fantastic Voyage#140.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#141.src: I’ll cover the taste first. The sugar fights with the raw, savory flavors of an otherwise respectable loaf of bread.
Fantastic Voyage#141.dst: Primeiro o sabor. O açúcar briga com os sabores crus e salgados de um pão que, fora isso, seria respeitável.
Fantastic Voyage#141.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#142.src: It also fights with your teeth. Bread’s quite sticky as it is, and the sugar doesn’t do it any favors.
Fantastic Voyage#142.dst: Também briga com seus dentes. O pão já é grudento por natureza, e o açúcar não ajuda em nada.
Fantastic Voyage#142.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#143.src: Why, I can still remember the time that I got a cavity. Cried my eyes out, I did.
Fantastic Voyage#143.dst: Ora, ainda lembro da vez que tive uma cárie. Chorei um rio, chorei sim.
Fantastic Voyage#143.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#144.src: Eventually, my pappy had enough, and he went for the ol’ string-on-a-doorknob trick. He got me good there, though it took him a few tries.
Fantastic Voyage#144.dst: No fim, meu pai perdeu a paciência e apelou pro velho truque do barbante na maçaneta. Me pegou de jeito, mas levou umas tentativas.
Fantastic Voyage#144.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#145.src: Ah, it seems like I got distracted. Back to the topic at hand.
Fantastic Voyage#145.dst: Ah, parece que me distraí. Voltando ao assunto.
Fantastic Voyage#145.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#146.src: You aren’t goin’ to get quite as much of an effect on your digestion than coarse-ground whole-grain bread. It keeps most of the fiber intact, after all.
Fantastic Voyage#146.dst: Você não vai ter tanto efeito na digestão quanto com o pão integral de moagem grossa. Afinal, ele mantém quase toda a fibra intacta.
Fantastic Voyage#146.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#147.src: You know how fruit juice contains next to no fiber because none of it goes into the juice? It’s the same deal with white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#147.dst: Sabe como suco de fruta quase não tem fibra porque nada dela vai pro suco? Com o pão branco é a mesma coisa.
Fantastic Voyage#147.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#148.src: Fruit juice was banned in my household. As my pappy liked to say, a real man only drinks hard spirits and the sweat runnin’ down his face! Though I wasn’t allowed to have the former, not yet at least! Heheh! So I drank milk instead.
Fantastic Voyage#148.dst: Suco de fruta era proibido lá em casa. Como meu pai gostava de dizer, homem de verdade só bebe destilado forte e o suor que escorre do rosto! Se bem que o primeiro eu não podia, pelo menos não ainda! Hehe! Então eu bebia leite.
Fantastic Voyage#148.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#149.src: Say, if you haven’t done so already, try bread dipped in milk! Go on! There’s nothin’ quite like it. Don’t accidentally drop the bread into the milk, of course.
Fantastic Voyage#149.dst: Aliás, se ainda não fez isso, prove pão molhado no leite! Vai! Não tem nada igual. Só não deixe o pão cair dentro do leite, claro.
Fantastic Voyage#149.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#150.src: You’ll end up with a bloated mess with the consistency of a sponge. And you should know by now that consistency is everythin’!
Fantastic Voyage#150.dst: Vai acabar com uma meleca inchada com consistência de esponja. E a essa altura você já devia saber que consistência é tudo!
Fantastic Voyage#150.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#151.src: While we’re on the subject of milk, do you know some folks can’t drink it? Oh, yes, they can try, but sooner or later their belly will protest.
Fantastic Voyage#151.dst: Já que estamos falando de leite, sabia que tem gente que não pode tomar? Ah, sim, podem tentar, mas cedo ou tarde a barriga reclama.
Fantastic Voyage#151.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#152.src: It’s the same deal with bread! Stick with whole-grain, nothin’ added. That way, you don’t have to worry about surprise milk appearances and whatnot.
Fantastic Voyage#152.dst: Com o pão é a mesma coisa! Fique no integral, sem nada a mais. Assim não precisa se preocupar com leite aparecendo de surpresa e tal.
Fantastic Voyage#152.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#153.src: You got that? Let me know when you’re ready for more. Say, you know what? I oughta talk a bit slower to help you digest what I’m sayin’. Oh! “Digest”! I did it again! Heheh...
Fantastic Voyage#153.dst: Entendeu? Me avise quando quiser mais. Sabe de uma coisa? Eu devia falar mais devagar pra você digerir o que estou dizendo. Ah! "Digerir"! Fiz de novo! Hehe...
Fantastic Voyage#153.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#154.src: Right, then, somethin’ that really peeves me is people who use bakin’ powder. What’s wrong with some good ol’ yeast?
Fantastic Voyage#154.dst: Bem, algo que me irrita muito é gente que usa fermento químico. Qual o problema do bom e velho fermento biológico?
Fantastic Voyage#154.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#155.src: Too little of it, and it’ll go plum flat in the oven. Just a little too much of it, and your bread’s going to be as bitter as wormwood!
Fantastic Voyage#155.dst: Pouco demais e o pão fica achatado no forno. Um tiquinho a mais e ele fica amargo feito losna!
Fantastic Voyage#155.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#156.src: The only way to get a size that’s just right is the long way! Wait until the yeast works its magic, and bake it right as it reaches its good size.
Fantastic Voyage#156.dst: O único jeito de acertar o tamanho é o jeito demorado! Espere o fermento fazer sua mágica e asse bem quando a massa chegar no ponto.
Fantastic Voyage#156.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#157.src: There’s also nothin’ quite like the smell of yeast as it causes the dough to rise! Works up quite the appetite, it does.
Fantastic Voyage#157.dst: E não tem nada como o cheiro do fermento fazendo a massa crescer! Abre um apetite danado, abre sim.
Fantastic Voyage#157.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#158.src: Some people put the cart before the horse and think that yeast works like bakin' powder. Try that, and you'll end up with some scorchin'-hot bricks in your oven.
Fantastic Voyage#158.dst: Tem gente que põe a carroça na frente dos bois e acha que fermento biológico funciona como o químico. Faça isso e vai acabar com tijolos pelando no forno.
Fantastic Voyage#158.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#159.src: No, you have to do it right, and doin’ it right means leavin’ some of the work to the yeast.
Fantastic Voyage#159.dst: Não, tem que fazer direito, e fazer direito é deixar parte do trabalho pro fermento.
Fantastic Voyage#159.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#160.src: Unless you like flat breads. I can’t see why anyone would, though. Bread’s supposed to be puffy and chewy, not some dough jerky!
Fantastic Voyage#160.dst: A não ser que goste de pão chato. Não entendo quem goste. Pão tem que ser fofo e elástico, não um charque de massa!
Fantastic Voyage#160.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#161.src: Though that may not be the case for some other pastries. For one, I've never once heard of a pie with a chewy crust.
Fantastic Voyage#161.dst: Se bem que talvez não seja assim com outras massas. Pra começar, nunca ouvi falar de torta com massa elástica.
Fantastic Voyage#161.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#162.src: Really, the beauty in bread lies with its simplicity! No complicated steps, no chances for the dough to rebel. Certainly not as fickle as somethin' like a cream puff.
Fantastic Voyage#162.dst: Sério, a beleza do pão está na simplicidade! Sem etapas complicadas, sem chance de a massa se rebelar. Bem menos temperamental que uma carolina.
Fantastic Voyage#162.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#163.src: If you treat the dough with respect, the bread will respect you in turn. It’s simple stuff, really! No finnickin’ around with stiff peaks, or needin’ half a dozen bowls to mix in, or getting a flaky dough just right, or...
Fantastic Voyage#163.dst: Se você trata a massa com respeito, o pão te respeita de volta. É coisa simples, sério! Nada de ficar mexendo pra dar ponto de neve, ou precisar de meia dúzia de tigelas, ou acertar uma massa folhada, ou...
Fantastic Voyage#163.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#164.src: ...and not to mention that just about everythin’ needs butter in some shape or form! Really, what’s with it? It’s not like the stuff grows on trees!
Fantastic Voyage#164.dst: ...sem falar que quase tudo precisa de manteiga de um jeito ou de outro! Sério, qual é a dela? Não é como se desse em árvore!
Fantastic Voyage#164.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#165.src: Makin’ the pastry shiny. Makin’ it taste rich. Makin’ the dough thick. There’s no end to it! Bread’s so much simpler to handle.
Fantastic Voyage#165.dst: Pra deixar o doce brilhante. Pra deixar o sabor rico. Pra engrossar a massa. Não acaba nunca! O pão é bem mais fácil de lidar.
Fantastic Voyage#165.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#166.src: Though some people insist upon putin' butter in the bread. Not just on it, but in it! There's more butter than bread at that point!
Fantastic Voyage#166.dst: Mas tem gente que insiste em pôr manteiga no pão. Não em cima, mas dentro! A essa altura tem mais manteiga que pão!
Fantastic Voyage#166.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#167.src: I don’t have anythin’ against butter itself, mind you. It’s great on toast! Just I think it oughta stay on the toast rather than in it.
Fantastic Voyage#167.dst: Veja bem, não tenho nada contra a manteiga em si. Na torrada é ótima! Só acho que ela devia ficar em cima da torrada, não dentro.
Fantastic Voyage#167.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#168.src: Not to mention that there’s a time, place, and occasion for it. If you put butter on everythin’, you’re goin’ to get sick of it real quickly. Eat it in moderation! Your tongue and your emerald pouch will thank you.
Fantastic Voyage#168.dst: Sem falar que tem hora, lugar e ocasião pra ela. Se você põe manteiga em tudo, vai enjoar rapidinho. Coma com moderação! Sua língua e sua bolsa de esmeraldas agradecem.
Fantastic Voyage#168.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#169.src: Of course, there’s always margarine, but why settle for somethin’ inferior? You shouldn’t settle for anythin’ less than the quality you’d expect from your bread!
Fantastic Voyage#169.dst: Claro, sempre tem a margarina, mas por que se contentar com algo inferior? Não aceite nada abaixo da qualidade que você espera do seu pão!
Fantastic Voyage#169.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#170.src: Though, now that I look at it, bread does get a reputation for bein’ a breakfast food. That’s ridiculous! It’s got a place in every meal of the day!
Fantastic Voyage#170.dst: Se bem que, olhando agora, o pão ganhou fama de comida de café da manhã. Que absurdo! Ele tem lugar em todas as refeições do dia!
Fantastic Voyage#170.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#171.src: Sandwiches? They’ve got bread in ‘em. Casseroles? Any respectable one has it as a shell. Breadsticks? It’s in the name for cryin’ out loud!
Fantastic Voyage#171.dst: Sanduíches? Têm pão. Gratinados? Qualquer um que se preze leva pão por baixo. Palitos de pão? Está no nome, pelo amor de Deus!
Fantastic Voyage#171.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#172.src: Done right, and it’s also great as a side. I already mentioned having a fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf of whole-grain with a slab of flat-iron steak, but really, a well-sliced loaf and some dippin’ butter can transform a family dinner into a banquet!
Fantastic Voyage#172.dst: Bem feito, também é um ótimo acompanhamento. Já falei do pão integral moído e assado na hora com uma fatia de bife, mas sério, um pão bem fatiado e um pouco de manteiga pra molhar transformam um jantar de família num banquete!
Fantastic Voyage#172.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#173.src: They’re almost as versatile as potatoes! Actually, even more so, I’d say!
Fantastic Voyage#173.dst: Eles são quase tão versáteis quanto batatas! Até mais, eu diria!
Fantastic Voyage#173.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#174.src: As my pappy liked to say, a real man’s got to earn his daily bread through his own toilin’. As you can see, I’ve taken his advice to heart!
Fantastic Voyage#174.dst: Como meu pai gostava de dizer, homem de verdade ganha o pão de cada dia com o próprio suor. Como pode ver, levei o conselho a sério!
Fantastic Voyage#174.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#175.src: ...I feel that I’m missin’ somethin’ important that I wanted to discuss. Hang on for a bit, would you?
Fantastic Voyage#175.dst: ...sinto que estou esquecendo algo importante que queria comentar. Espera um pouco, pode ser?
Fantastic Voyage#175.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#176.src: Ah, of course! I can’t believe that I forgot! I wanted to cover some thoughts about bread consistency.
Fantastic Voyage#176.dst: Ah, claro! Não acredito que esqueci! Queria falar umas coisas sobre a consistência do pão.
Fantastic Voyage#176.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#177.src: Namely, the two extremes: too chewy and not chewy enough. I already spoke on hardly chewy bread plenty, but there's such a thing as too much of a good thing.
Fantastic Voyage#177.dst: Mais precisamente, os dois extremos: elástico demais e elástico de menos. Já falei bastante do pão pouco elástico, mas tudo que é demais enjoa.
Fantastic Voyage#177.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#178.src: And in this case, bread chewiness is a good thing. You don’t want your bread to be too chewy, got it?
Fantastic Voyage#178.dst: E, neste caso, pão elástico é uma coisa boa. Você não quer que o pão fique elástico demais, entendeu?
Fantastic Voyage#178.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#179.src: Too chewy’s a step right towards bread that’s outright rubbery. Your teeth’ll bounce right off it!
Fantastic Voyage#179.dst: Elástico demais é meio caminho pra um pão borrachudo. Seus dentes vão quicar nele!
Fantastic Voyage#179.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#180.src: Sure, too much give in the dough’s awkward and sets you up for bitin’ your own tongue, but too firm of a loaf can lead to much of the same.
Fantastic Voyage#180.dst: Tá, massa mole demais é esquisita e te faz morder a própria língua, mas um pão firme demais dá quase no mesmo.
Fantastic Voyage#180.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#181.src: They always say never bite off more than you could chew, but you oughta be careful not to bite off any less than that, either!
Fantastic Voyage#181.dst: Sempre dizem pra não morder mais do que consegue mastigar, mas também tome cuidado pra não morder menos!
Fantastic Voyage#181.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#182.src: No, just right and chewy’s what you want. Don’t settle for anything more or less!
Fantastic Voyage#182.dst: Não, no ponto e elástico é o que você quer. Não aceite nem mais nem menos!
Fantastic Voyage#182.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#183.src: Hmm, come to think. You seem really interested in discussin’ bread with me!
Fantastic Voyage#183.dst: Hmm, pensando bem. Você parece muito interessado em falar de pão comigo!
Fantastic Voyage#183.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#184.src: Lean in for a second, would you? I’ve got somethin’ important to say.
Fantastic Voyage#184.dst: Chega mais perto um segundo, pode ser? Tenho algo importante a dizer.
Fantastic Voyage#184.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#185.src: Listening? Right! Ah, sorry, I didn’t mean to shout in your ear.
Fantastic Voyage#185.dst: Ouvindo? ÓTIMO! Ah, desculpe, não queria gritar no seu ouvido.
Fantastic Voyage#185.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#186.src: You’re just about the only person that I’ve been able to have an honest conversation about bread with.
Fantastic Voyage#186.dst: Você é praticamente a única pessoa com quem consegui ter uma conversa sincera sobre pão.
Fantastic Voyage#186.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#187.src: Usually, bread gets brushed off as some kind of dull fodder. Dismissed as too borin’ and too plain, I tell you! That’s what leads to unnecessary excess as people try to make it into something that it’s not.
Fantastic Voyage#187.dst: Normalmente o pão é tratado como ração sem graça. Descartado por ser chato e simples demais, vou te contar! É isso que leva a excessos desnecessários, quando as pessoas tentam fazer dele algo que ele não é.
Fantastic Voyage#187.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#188.src: But us? We’re different, we’re visionaries, and we know the truth about what really makes a good loaf!
Fantastic Voyage#188.dst: Mas nós? Somos diferentes, somos visionários, e sabemos a verdade sobre o que faz um bom pão!
Fantastic Voyage#188.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#189.src: Tell ‘em off, I say! They can’t follow the thoughts of bread enthusiasts like you and I otherwise!
Fantastic Voyage#189.dst: Bota eles no lugar, eu digo! Senão nunca vão entender fãs de pão como eu e você!
Fantastic Voyage#189.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#190.src: Ah! Right, never did I get to answerin’ your question. About my favorite type of bread, that is...
Fantastic Voyage#190.dst: Ah! Verdade, nunca cheguei a responder sua pergunta. Sobre meu pão favorito, digo...
Fantastic Voyage#190.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#192.src: Sure, it may be simple, but if you were payin’ any attention at all, you’d know for sure why that’s everythin’ that I’m lookin’ for.
Fantastic Voyage#192.dst: Tá, pode ser simples, mas se você prestou um pingo de atenção, sabe muito bem por que é tudo que eu procuro.
Fantastic Voyage#192.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#193.src: And that just about sums up the basics! Let me know if you want to hear anythin’ more.
Fantastic Voyage#193.dst: E isso resume o básico! Me avise se quiser ouvir mais.
Fantastic Voyage#193.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#194.src: Let’s continue! Have you ever seen a baker wearin’ a fancy hat? Have you ever wondered how that corresponds to how well they bake bread compared to somethin’ else?
Fantastic Voyage#194.dst: Vamos continuar! Já viu um padeiro usando um chapéu chique? Já se perguntou o que isso tem a ver com o quão bem ele assa pão comparado a outras coisas?
Fantastic Voyage#194.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#195.src: Hah! That crazy coot, you're chattin' with that feller?
Fantastic Voyage#195.dst: Há! Tá de papo com aquele velho maluco?
Fantastic Voyage#195.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#196.src: He's wack-o, y'know... Singing his songs all day, somethin's not right upstairs.
Fantastic Voyage#196.dst: Ele é pirado, sabe... Canta as músicas dele o dia todo, tem um parafuso solto.
Fantastic Voyage#196.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#197.src: You do you, buddy, but I'd steer clear.
Fantastic Voyage#197.dst: Faça como quiser, mas eu ficaria longe.
Fantastic Voyage#197.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#198.src: A parrot? You know where you are, right?
Fantastic Voyage#198.dst: Um papagaio? Sabe onde você está, né?
Fantastic Voyage#198.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#199.src: I see plenty parrots everyday, I don't keep track.
Fantastic Voyage#199.dst: Vejo papagaio todo dia, não fico contando.
Fantastic Voyage#199.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#200.src: I'll keep an eye or two out for one, though, sound peachy?
Fantastic Voyage#200.dst: Mas vou ficar de olho, beleza?
Fantastic Voyage#200.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#203.src: IT'S IN T-THE TREE, HERE! IT'S HERE!!!
Fantastic Voyage#203.dst: ESTÁ NA Á-ÁRVORE, AQUI! ESTÁ AQUI!!!
Fantastic Voyage#203.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#205.dst: Zarpe a bordo do navio de Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#206.src: You have the map! Thank you for the assistance!
Fantastic Voyage#206.dst: Você pegou o mapa! Muito obrigado pela ajuda!
Fantastic Voyage#206.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#207.src: Now let us set sail, and cover some distance!
Fantastic Voyage#207.dst: Agora vamos zarpar, que a maré já muda!
Fantastic Voyage#207.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#208.src: I'm sorry, new friend, to be of haste!
Fantastic Voyage#208.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#209.src: However I sense power in you, and we have no time to waste!
Fantastic Voyage#209.dst: Mas sinto poder em você, e não há tempo pra hesitação!
Fantastic Voyage#209.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#210.src: So off we go, to find an old friend, that would be ideal.
Fantastic Voyage#210.dst: Então vamos achar um velho amigo, seria o ideal.
Fantastic Voyage#210.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#211.src: I'll captain the ship up at the steering wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#211.dst: Eu levo o navio ao leme, como capitão leal.
Fantastic Voyage#211.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#212.src: Speak to Captain Relend aboard the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#212.dst: Fale com o capitão Relend a bordo do Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#213.src: Welcome aboard, I suppose I can consider you my first mate. Although, it appears we now have a problem on our plate.
Fantastic Voyage#213.dst: Bem-vindo a bordo, acho que posso te chamar de imediato. Mas parece que já temos um problema no prato.
Fantastic Voyage#213.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#214.src: You see those spikes all around my boat? Well, we're about to ram into them like a goat!
Fantastic Voyage#214.dst: Vê esses espetos em volta do meu barco? Vamos dar de cara neles como um bode num charco!
Fantastic Voyage#214.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#215.src: I'd steer around them, but it appears the wheel is all smashed. I need you to craft a new one before we both get splashed!
Fantastic Voyage#215.dst: Eu desviaria, mas o leme está em pedaços. Fabrique um novo antes que a gente vire bagaço!
Fantastic Voyage#215.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#216.src: There's a Crafting Table at the front near all the crates. Now hurry up, else the ocean floor awaits!
Fantastic Voyage#216.dst: Há uma bancada de trabalho na proa, perto das caixas. Corra, ou o fundo do mar nos espera sem falhas!
Fantastic Voyage#216.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#217.src: Bring a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to the Crafting Table
Fantastic Voyage#217.dst: Leve uma [tábua de madeira], uma [peça central] e um [barbante] à bancada de trabalho

Fantastic Voyage#218.src: Bring the [Steering Wheel] to Captain Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#219.src: Ah, thank you for helping me in my time of need. Let's maneuver through these spikes at a steady speed!
Fantastic Voyage#219.dst: Ah, obrigado por me ajudar na hora da precisão. Vamos passar por esses espetos com calma e atenção!
Fantastic Voyage#219.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#220.src: Although, at the last minute, there is something I have to confess. I have never captained a ship with any success.
Fantastic Voyage#220.dst: Mas, de última hora, tenho algo a confessar: nunca comandei um navio sem naufragar.
Fantastic Voyage#220.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#221.src: I think before we get into any real danger, we should turn around. Could you man the wheel and get us back to solid ground?
Fantastic Voyage#221.dst: Acho que antes de corrermos perigo de verdade, devemos voltar. Pode assumir o leme e nos levar à terra sem afundar?
Fantastic Voyage#221.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#222.src: Man the wheel of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#222.dst: Assuma o leme do Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#223.src: Now you're the captain, hope the sea's not making you nauseous. Steer this ship, but you'll have to be cautious!
Fantastic Voyage#223.dst: Agora o capitão é você; espero que não enjoe no mar. Conduza o navio, mas com cautela ao navegar!
Fantastic Voyage#223.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#224.src: Nice steering, although your maneuvers are a bit brash. Hey, watch out! I think we're about to-
Fantastic Voyage#224.dst: Bela pilotagem, mas suas manobras são meio afoitas. Ei, cuidado! Acho que vamos bat-
Fantastic Voyage#224.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#225.src: Find Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#225.dst: Encontre Relend dentro dos destroços do Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#226.src: As you can see, my ship has become a shipwreck! Now please help me, I am trapped in the lower deck!
Fantastic Voyage#226.dst: Como vê, meu navio virou um naufrágio! Agora me ajude, estou preso no porão, que presságio!
Fantastic Voyage#226.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#227.src: Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
Fantastic Voyage#227.dst: Trabalho incrível, você desceu ao porão num instante! Vai ter que cruzar esses destroços pra me libertar adiante!
Fantastic Voyage#227.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#228.src: Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
Fantastic Voyage#228.dst: Uau, você abriu caminho, afinal! Que tal usar aquela bala de canhão pra me soltar, genial?
Fantastic Voyage#228.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#229.src: Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#229.dst: Salve Relend dentro dos destroços do Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#230.src: Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
Fantastic Voyage#230.dst: Obrigado por me soltar, agora vamos sair desta confusão! Mas não sei como fazer isso, não tenho a menor noção.
Fantastic Voyage#230.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#231.src: When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
Fantastic Voyage#231.dst: Quando o navio bateu, afundou sob a areia! Mas a boa notícia é que voltamos à terra inteira!
Fantastic Voyage#231.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#232.src: We should probably get out of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
Fantastic Voyage#232.dst: Devíamos sair daqui, este lugar é bem apertado. Talvez você possa quebrar aquele ponto fraco ali do lado?
Fantastic Voyage#232.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#234.src: It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
Fantastic Voyage#234.dst: Parece que vamos ficar presos aqui por um tempo. Venha falar comigo pra sairmos desta ilha num momento!
Fantastic Voyage#234.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#235.src: Speak to Relend on the beach.

Fantastic Voyage#236.src: Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Fantastic Voyage#236.dst: Gateway Island... finalmente a alcançamos. Graças aos céus, sobrevivemos!
Fantastic Voyage#236.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#237.src: Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
Fantastic Voyage#237.dst: Bem, tanta aventura me deu fome de ensopado. Vamos precisar de ingredientes, o que houver na ilha está aprovado.
Fantastic Voyage#237.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#238.src: Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
Fantastic Voyage#238.dst: Carne é preciso arrumar, e já: pegue [{~} Raw Mutton] das ovelhas de lá.
Fantastic Voyage#238.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#239.src: And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
Fantastic Voyage#239.dst: E traga [{~} Edible Mushrooms] da caverna do poente; só não pegue dos que me mandam pra cova de repente!
Fantastic Voyage#239.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#240.src: I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
Fantastic Voyage#240.dst: Sinto que falta algo nesta mistura, ora essa. Que tal pegar [{~} Coconut] no alto daquela árvore, depressa?
Fantastic Voyage#240.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#241.src: And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
Fantastic Voyage#241.dst: E se trouxer [{~} Berries], vou ficar pra lá de feliz!
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your content book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take the map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.dst: Consulte seu livro de conteúdo se precisar relembrar. E pra não se perder, leve o mapa pra se guiar.
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#243.dst: Dê o ensopado estranho a Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavour. But any food we can get here I shall savour.
Fantastic Voyage#244.dst: Bem, este ensopado tem um gosto meio estranho. Mas qualquer comida aqui é um ganho.
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.dst: O que restou do meu navio não vai nos proteger muito bem. Precisamos achar abrigo, como você vê também.
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there, I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.dst: A leste, mal consigo ver uma barraca. Vá procurar meu amigo lá, minha vontade não se aplaca!
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.dst: A barraca estava vazia e em ruína? Tanta notícia ruim me desanima.
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: Me empresta seu mapa por um instante. Teremos que procurá-lo em outro lugar, mais adiante.
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can craft an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: Com engenho, sei que acharemos uma solução. Talvez um explosivo faça aquela rocha virar pó num clarão!
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: Pensemos em materiais que dá pra achar aqui. Nesta ilha há pouco, receio, ai de mim...
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: Primeiro vamos precisar de [{~} Gritty Sand]. Onde achar? Tente a praia nos fundos da ilha.
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: Depois vem [Sawdust], vai precisar de três. O melhor lugar pra procurar é a maior árvore, talvez.
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: Por fim, [{~} Black Powder], num lugar muito peculiar. Vai ter que ter coragem e ao topo do vulcão chegar.
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items to craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your content book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: Com esses itens você fabrica a bomba; já disse onde procurar. Se esquecer o que falta achar, o livro de conteúdo vá consultar.
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring [{~} Gritty Sand], [{~} Saw Dust], and [{~} Black Powder] to the Crafting Table
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: Leve [{~} Gritty Sand], [{~} Saw Dust] e [{~} Black Powder] à bancada de trabalho

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.dst: Incrível, o explosivo atravessou a pedra num clarão!
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.dst: Vamos avançar por esta misteriosa região.
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: Pra aventureiros como nós, que caverna pra explorar!
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: Foi aqui que meu velho amigo veio - posso jurar!
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: Há tempos, um aventureiro forte como você me pediu uma travessia. Que história, quanta magia!
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became the best of friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: Viramos melhores amigos em nossa jornada. Mas ele sumiu, e era o melhor, de lavada.
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: E enfim chegamos aonde ele esteve. Mal posso esperar pra revê-lo, que emoção!
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: Um portal místico! Foi aqui que meu amigo se perdeu!
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: Vamos entrar e achá-lo, custe o que for, juro eu!
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: Sempre disse que não era doido, ninguém ouvia. Velho amigo, te busco até o fim, noite e dia!
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.dst: Uma terra estranha, de perigo transbordante...
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: Deve ser onde ele sumiu, por sombrio que seja adiante.
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Wherever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: Onde quer que seja, de longe nos vigiam enquanto andamos.
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I do hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: Com tanto perigo, espero que meu bom amigo ainda esteja bem.
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: Minha nossa! Fique atento, que lá vem confusão também!
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.dst: Aagh... Novo amigo... você está aí?
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: Prometo que vou achá-lo, eu vou, sem nenhuma cicatriz!
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#283.src: Get on it then, no time for a nap! That thieving parrot has our map!
Fantastic Voyage#283.dst: Sem cochilo, vamos já! O papagaio ladrão levou nosso mapa pra lá!
Fantastic Voyage#283.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#284.src: Perhaps these citizens may help us out, ask them about the parrot's route!
Fantastic Voyage#284.dst: Talvez o povo daqui possa ajudar: pergunte por onde o papagaio foi voar!
Fantastic Voyage#284.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#285.src: He seems distracted, best to walk away while you can.
Fantastic Voyage#285.dst: Ele parece distraído, melhor sair enquanto pode.

Fantastic Voyage#286.src: He begins to list off a seemingly endless amount of examples.
Fantastic Voyage#286.dst: Ele começa a listar exemplos que parecem não ter fim.

Fantastic Voyage#287.src: It looks like he's nearly finished.
Fantastic Voyage#287.dst: Parece que ele já está acabando.

Fantastic Voyage#288.src: It seems like he's lost in reminiscence.

Fantastic Voyage#289.src: He doesn't seem to be stopping any time soon.
Fantastic Voyage#289.dst: Ele não parece que vai parar tão cedo.

Fantastic Voyage#290.src: It seems like he's waiting expectantly.

Fantastic Voyage#291.src: He's thoughtfully rubbing his jaw. Best to leave him be
Fantastic Voyage#291.dst: Ele esfrega o queixo, pensativo. Melhor deixá-lo em paz

Fantastic Voyage#293.src: It seems like he's deep in thought.

Fantastic Voyage#294.src: He proceeds to rattle off several grievances about pastry making.
Fantastic Voyage#294.dst: Ele começa a desfiar várias queixas sobre confeitaria.

Fantastic Voyage#296.src: You don't have the time for this.
Fantastic Voyage#296.dst: Você não tem tempo pra isso.

Fantastic Voyage#297.src: He seems pretty comfortable, best not to disturb him.
Fantastic Voyage#297.dst: Ele parece bem à vontade, melhor não incomodar.

Fantastic Voyage#298.src: Heh, have fun, mate. Lot'sa treasure out there, eh?
Fantastic Voyage#298.dst: Heh, divirta-se, parceiro. Tem tesouro à beça, né?
Fantastic Voyage#298.text: You know he's nuts, right mate? Y'not gonna find any treasure or anythin'.

Fantastic Voyage#299.src: Looks like the parrot dropped the map! You should get this back to Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#299.dst: Parece que o papagaio soltou o mapa! Devolva-o a Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#300.src: You have no use for this yet, you should speak with Relend up near the steering wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#300.dst: Isso ainda não tem utilidade; você devia falar com Relend lá em cima, perto do leme.

Fantastic Voyage#301.src: You'll need a [Wooden Board], a [Center Piece], and a [String] to craft a Steering Wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#301.dst: Um leme precisa de uma [tábua de madeira], uma [peça central] e um [barbante].

Fantastic Voyage#302.src: This will probably work... You should show Relend.
Fantastic Voyage#302.dst: Isto deve funcionar... Mostre a Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#303.src: You have nothing to load... You should continue through the wreckage.
Fantastic Voyage#303.dst: Você não tem nada pra carregar... Devia seguir pelos destroços.

Fantastic Voyage#304.src: Bring [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to the Cooking Pot
Fantastic Voyage#304.dst: Leve [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut] e [{~} Berries] à panela

Fantastic Voyage#305.src: You'll need [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut], and [{~} Berries] to make a stew.
Fantastic Voyage#305.dst: Você vai precisar de [{~} Raw Mutton], [{~} Edible Mushrooms], [{~} Coconut] e [{~} Berries] para fazer um ensopado.

Fantastic Voyage#306.src: Take a look at your content book if you forgot your project, this island has supplies we ought to collect!
Fantastic Voyage#306.dst: Consulte seu livro de conteúdo se esquecer a missão; esta ilha tem suprimentos pra nossa coleção!
Fantastic Voyage#306.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#309.src: This looks dangerous! You should go blow open that boulder now.
Fantastic Voyage#309.dst: Isto parece perigoso! Vá explodir aquela rocha agora mesmo.

Fantastic Voyage#310.src: I've been looking for my old friend all this time. Sailing with every young adventurer in their prime!
Fantastic Voyage#310.dst: Procurei meu velho amigo todo esse tempo a fio, navegando com cada jovem aventureiro de brio!

Fantastic Voyage#311.src: ...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
Fantastic Voyage#311.dst: ...Ah, vai sair com o Relend, é? Tem certeza?
Fantastic Voyage#311.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#312.src: This looks... edible. You should see what Relend thinks.
Fantastic Voyage#312.dst: Isto parece... comestível. Veja o que Relend acha.

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to learn more of this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#000.dst: Ah, um soldado do exército de {p}. Queremos saber mais deste túmulo congelado. Sua ajuda viria bem.
Fate of the Fallen#000.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: If you don't remember what I said, I remember you writing something in your book. Try looking there.
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: Se não lembra do que eu disse, lembro de você anotar algo no seu livro. Dê uma olhada lá.

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: You should head back to the mage with the wand.
Fate of the Fallen#003.dst: Você devia voltar ao mago do cajado.

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: This is the Temple of Time...
Fate of the Fallen#004.dst: Este é o Temple of Time...

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: Here you can visit the memories of this land...
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: Aqui se visitam as memórias desta terra...

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: The altar requires an item from the time you desire to access...
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: O altar requer um item da época que você deseja acessar...

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: You will access a memory as if you were present, but when you return it will be as if you were never there.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: Você acessará uma memória como se estivesse presente, mas ao voltar será como se nunca tivesse estado lá.

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: You should stick around to find out how to reverse the spell.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: Fique por perto para descobrir como reverter o feitiço.

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too far gone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: Gaaah... Conte...a todos. Vou congelar este lugar. Eu...já me f-fui. A terra precisa sarar...e meus poderes, ser c-contidos...congelados...
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#010.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: Se aprendi algo com aquele insuportável d- ...com Mael...mortes sem motivo fazem os espíritos ficarem. Eu...prefiro não dificultar mais a vida dele.
Fate of the Fallen#010.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#011.src: Wha... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true that this place has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: O qu... tantas revelações... a magia de gelo detém a Corrupção...? É verdade que este lugar viu menos ameaças corrompidas que outros lugares da província...
Fate of the Fallen#011.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... It was to protect everyone... but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: Pelos deuses... Entendemos tudo errado esse tempo todo... Era pra proteger a todos... mas, se estivesse tão são, certamente teria contado a alguém suas intenções!
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: I froze this land to allow it to heal.. People did not understand.. They came for me here, seeking revenge.
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: Congelei esta terra para ela sarar.. Ninguém entendeu.. Vieram atrás de mim aqui, em busca de vingança.

Fate of the Fallen#014.src: Of course, just like you.. They can not leave. Their souls are stuck here. For the spell must not be broken.
Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: Claro, como você.. Não podem sair. Suas almas estão presas aqui. Pois o feitiço não pode ser quebrado.

Fate of the Fallen#015.src: Even if you think you can cure me.. I can not allow you to try for if it were to fail my corrupted body would wreak havoc on the world!
Fate of the Fallen#015.dst: Mesmo que você ache que pode me curar.. Não posso deixar você tentar, pois se falhar meu corpo corrompido vai devastar o mundo!

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: It will be dangerous...perhaps your toughest fight yet...but it must be done. If you need time to prepare, do so. But you must end Theorick's pain.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: Será perigoso...talvez sua luta mais dura...mas precisa ser feito. Se precisar se preparar, prepare-se. Mas você deve acabar com a dor de Theorick.

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Don't you just love fishing? The little waves in the river, the wind and the rewarding feeling when you catch something, those are my favorite things about it.
Fate of the Fallen#017.dst: Você não adora pescar? As ondinhas no rio, o vento e a satisfação de pegar algo, é disso que eu mais gosto.

Fate of the Fallen#018.src: You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
Fate of the Fallen#018.dst: Você não pode voltar até cumprir seu objetivo...

Fate of the Fallen#019.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Fate of the Fallen#019.dst: Fale com o mago Telvu em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#020.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#020.dst: Conhece a história de Theorick e {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#020.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: Talvez não. Veja, {p} nem sempre foi congelado.
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#022.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#022.dst: No tempo de Theorick, isto era como as planícies de Wynn, quente e fértil.
Fate of the Fallen#022.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#023.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#023.dst: Por algum motivo, Theorick Twain usou seu imenso poder para congelar a terra antes de se exilar aqui.
Fate of the Fallen#023.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: Precisamos descobrir o porquê para reverter o feitiço. Presume-se que a fonte da magia esteja dentro do túmulo... mas não queremos entrar de mãos vazias.
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: Então...já ouviu falar de um lugar chamado {p}? Podemos usá-lo para voltar no tempo e saber mais sobre os atos de Theorick.
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#026.dst: Bem...de certo modo, ao menos. Essa magia tem leis. Primeiro, é preciso um item da época exata que queremos ver. Segundo, você pode ver o passado, não mudá-lo.
Fate of the Fallen#026.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: Um dos cajados de Theorick está exposto no banco de {p}. Deve servir para o que precisamos. Consegue pegá-lo de algum jeito?
Fate of the Fallen#027.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#028.dst: Encontre o cajado de Theorick no banco de {p}.

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: Ahá, que rapidez. Vejo que pegou o cajado. Precisou de lábia para os banqueiros o largarem.
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#030.dst: Agora, é uma longa caminhada até {p}. Mas nem precisa, pois posso te teletransportar até lá. Espero.
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: Chegando lá, entre no Temple of Time. Lá você saberá o que fazer. Cuidado com viagens no tempo, amigo... Não faço ideia do que vai encontrar.
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: Se algo der errado, fico aqui para te teletransportar de volta ao templo.
Fate of the Fallen#033.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: Enter the portal the mage made.
Fate of the Fallen#034.dst: Entre no portal que o mago criou.

Fate of the Fallen#035.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#035.dst: Entre no Gate of Time em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e volte no tempo.

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#038.dst: Uau, suas armas e armadura são tão avançadas!
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: Você é outro Twain? Só os Twain conhecem magia assim.
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: Ele está lutando na guerra, não devia estar fazendo o mesmo?
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#042.dst: Foi para o oeste. Houve uma emergência.
Fate of the Fallen#042.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: Lutamos contra a Corrupção há anos, parece que ela finalmente vai engolir {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#043.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#044.dst: Encontre Theorick na floresta a oeste de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: Podia jurar que ela tinha ido por aqui... Ah, e agora, mais imbecis? Esta floresta não é segura!
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#046.dst: Se precisa de ajuda, reclame com os guardas. Estou ocupado e não posso parar de salvar esta bendita província para gelar seu leite!!
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#047.dst: Tem cera nos ouvidos?! Eu disse-
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#048.dst: Urgh, aquilo te seguiu! Viu só?! SAIA DA FRENTE.
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#049.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#049.dst: Como se eu precisasse salvar DUAS pessoas! Agora suma daqui, tenho que achar a mulher que desapareceu!
Fate of the Fallen#049.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#050.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#050.dst: SOCOOORRO! Não dá pra fugir!!! Guardas! Alguém!!

Fate of the Fallen#051.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#051.dst: Hã! É a voz dela! Onde ela está?! Acabei de limpar esta área!
Fate of the Fallen#051.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: Ugh, ela está trazendo eles lá do oeste?! Você aí, se não quer acabar congelado, FIQUE ATRÁS DE MIM, JÁ!!
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#054.dst: Ufa... Agora você está fora de perigo. Mas, se não tivesse saído da cidade, nem teria corrido perigo NENHUM!
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: Nem precisa se desculpar, só volte para a cidade. Agora.
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: Da próxima vez que quiser colher flores na floresta ou seja lá o que fazia, lembre que tem uma vida para viver, hein?!
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#057.dst: Todo dia, mais corrompidos, mais mortes... Só há uma saída. Tenho que resolver isso eu mesmo. Cortar as raízes...e matar essa erva infernal.
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: Ainda aqui? Pois escute. Eu e alguns outros estamos planejando algo arriscado. Que se dane se perdermos a sanidade, preciso atravessar aquele portal.
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: Você parece bem equipado, então está convocado. Encontre-nos na nossa base, imediatamente. Siga o rio para o sul e verá uma casa do lado direito.
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: Vá até a base da operação ao sul de {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: Bem, isso eu admito. Pelo menos você obedece ordens rápido. Vamos para {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#062.dst: O último homem que entrou no portal e voltou virou Bak’al... Mas, se houver a menor chance de dar certo, a esta altura temos que arriscar.
Fate of the Fallen#062.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: Vamos andando. Não faremos pausas na viagem, então espero que esteja preparado.
Fate of the Fallen#063.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: Bem. O frio que comando pode conter a própria Corrupção. Duvido que algum de vocês possa dizer o mesmo. Entro sozinho.
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: Quando eu entrar... Aposto que os corrompidos vão cercar o portal atrás de mim. Sua tarefa? Matá-los. Não posso ter distrações lá dentro.
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: Você não sai deste posto até eu sair daquele portal. Entendido?
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: ...não, não, não não não NÃO!! DROGA!!
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#070.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#070.dst: Sabe o que houve?! Perdi!! Vou destruir a província se me transformar de vez! AFASTE-SE, JÁ! ESTÁ ME OUVINDO?! CORRA!!
Fate of the Fallen#070.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#071.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#071.dst: Eu... A-acalme-se, Theorick...não...não se perca nisso...ainda...há uma solução...um caminho...
Fate of the Fallen#071.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#072.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#072.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#073.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#073.dst: Vive...então...escute. Se eu virar...q-quando...quando eu virar...n-não, não dá...gaaah, vou destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#073.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#074.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#074.dst: Não vou durar, dá pra ver... Agora...me matar é impossível, seu fracote idio- Agh, SAIA DA MINHA MENTE!!
Fate of the Fallen#074.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#075.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#075.dst: Inúteis... Urgh, não...ainda merecem viver...e este feitiço...vai levar alguns. Por favor, conte a eles o porquê...
Fate of the Fallen#075.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#076.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#076.dst: C-continue. Se todos fossem fortes como você...teríamos chance. Com o tempo, quando eu enfraquecer, isto pode me acabar.
Fate of the Fallen#076.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#077.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#077.dst: Que se saiba...Theorick Twain não morreu. Não pode ser morto...tudo vai arder...até dias futuros. Aqui, neste lugar maldito. Encontre-me...e acabe com tudo.
Fate of the Fallen#077.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#078.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.
Fate of the Fallen#078.dst: Conte ao mago Telvu o que aconteceu.

Fate of the Fallen#079.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#079.dst: Você deve ter conseguido, ou ainda estaria na memória do passado. Sinto uma magia poderosa em você.
Fate of the Fallen#079.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#080.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#080.dst: Então conheceu Theorick? Sempre disseram que deixou de ser herói após o grande congelamento.
Fate of the Fallen#080.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#081.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#081.dst: Conseguiu descobrir pelo menos por que ele congelou este lugar?
Fate of the Fallen#081.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#082.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#082.dst: Todo esse tempo enterrado vivo, lutando contra a Corrupção. A ideia também te horroriza, a julgar pelo seu rosto. Matá-lo seria um ato de misericórdia.
Fate of the Fallen#082.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#083.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#083.dst: Tome. Use isto. Pode te proteger nos Túmulos de Gelo... Por favor, soldado. Seja o anjo da guarda de Theorick. Liberte-o deste tormento.
Fate of the Fallen#083.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#000.src: Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.
Finding the Light#000.dst: A maioria das páginas está cheia de versículos religiosos. No fim do livro, há um cartão separado do resto das páginas.

Finding the Light#001.src: I covered over the way down to that giant archive like you asked. It shouldn't be reachable now.
Finding the Light#001.dst: Tapei a descida àquele arquivo gigante, como pediu. Agora não deve dar pra chegar lá.

Finding the Light#002.src: It'd take something really heavy to crack open the foundation- Frankly, that gold church bell might do it if it's not maintained.
Finding the Light#002.dst: Só algo bem pesado racharia a fundação- Francamente, aquele sino dourado da igreja daria conta se não tiver manutenção.

Finding the Light#003.src: I left ladders and platforms as access to the bell tower- Make sure you keep it in good condition! I don't want to have to do that kind of work again.
Finding the Light#003.dst: Deixei escadas e plataformas para acessar o campanário- Garanta que fique em bom estado! Não quero ter que fazer esse trabalho de novo.

Finding the Light#004.src: What, are you thinking "oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?" IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#004.dst: O quê, está pensando "ah, vamos seguir a elfa engraçadinha e ver ela FRACASSAR, DE NOVO e DE NOVO!?" É ISSO?!

Finding the Light#005.src: This is enough, Lari. I waken. And thus, your task is complete, {u}. You have done as Orphion asked.
Finding the Light#005.dst: Já basta, Lari. Eu desperto. E, assim, sua tarefa está completa, {u}. Você fez o que Orphion pediu.

Finding the Light#006.src: What connection does a primordial force have with the moral leanings of mortals- or even immortals?
Finding the Light#006.dst: Que ligação uma força primordial tem com as inclinações morais dos mortais- ou mesmo dos imortais?

Finding the Light#007.src: For now, {u} must learn what you have learned, of the nature of realms. They must know what you know if they are to aid you fully.
Finding the Light#007.dst: Por ora, {u} deve aprender o que você aprendeu sobre a natureza dos reinos. Precisa saber o que sabe para te ajudar plenamente.

Finding the Light#008.src: Allow me to show you our reality, {u}. It is difficult to properly present its scale... So here is an approximation.
Finding the Light#008.dst: Deixe-me mostrar nossa realidade, {u}. É difícil apresentar sua escala de fato... Então eis uma aproximação.

Finding the Light#009.src: The balance shifts, and Orphion grows weary. Angered, desperate. He called to you as a last plea- and you have done admirably, for what he has asked of you.
Finding the Light#009.dst: O equilíbrio se altera, e Orphion se cansa. Irado, desesperado. Ele te chamou como último apelo- e você se saiu admiravelmente no que ele pediu.

Finding the Light#010.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#010.dst: Entre no portal, {u}. Mostrarei a você a Passagem da Luz... E te desejo sorte.

Finding the Light#011.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#011.dst: O que você fez talvez não tenha sido o certo, aos olhos de ninguém. Porém, foi necessário. Você se livrou de suas amarras, de certo modo.

Finding the Light#012.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#012.dst: Nova missão iniciada: Reino da Luz IV - Em busca da luz

Finding the Light#013.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#013.dst: Isso deve ter rachado a fundação! Veja se já consegue chegar ao arquivo mencionado no cartão.

Finding the Light#014.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#014.dst: A porta lá embaixo deve abrir, agora que você ativou os mecanismos.

Finding the Light#015.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#015.dst: Algumas das poucas páginas foram arrancadas. Até a primeira página faltando, parece descrever algo que aconteceu com o Guardião da Floresta.

Finding the Light#016.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#016.dst: O resto do livro está perfeito- Quem poderia ter feito isso se o arquivo estava trancado? Alguém entrou antes de você?

Finding the Light#017.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#017.dst: ...assim voltou, adormecido e sem despertar. A luz falou de um tempo em que o Guardião nos agraciará de novo com sua presença...

Finding the Light#018.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#018.dst: ...mas esse tempo está a séculos e exigirá grande esforço. O feitiço anexo é vital ao processo.

Finding the Light#019.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#019.dst: A luz também adverte- Se a escuridão avançar até as raízes do Guardião, ele jamais despertará... Mas parece que não teremos que nos preocupar com isso.

Finding the Light#020.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#020.dst: Há outra página solta aqui, com mais texto em alto gavelliano. Lari deve conseguir traduzir isto.

Finding the Light#021.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#021.dst: ...vai, então, faça. Pelo visto, até agora só preciso estar aqui como sua tradutora.
Finding the Light#021.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#023.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#023.dst: A voz da Luz disse para você segui-la. Não vai parar agora, vai?

Finding the Light#024.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
