Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: E-espera, senhora! Alguém me empurrou da fila! Eu juro!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.dst: SILÊNCIO! Não mandei você falar, lixo!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#086.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.dst: Volte pra fila! Quando acabar, você está fora, nojento!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: Roube a chave do escritório da diretora e vá para a sala de controle

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#089.src: Find a way to open the exit door
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#089.dst: Encontre um jeito de abrir a porta de saída

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.dst: Passe pela porta de saída em [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: Passe despercebido pelos guardas e encontre o caminho até a sala de registros

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.dst: Ah, graças à vaca sagrada! Um rosto amigo por aqui..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: Escuta, humano, você tem que me tirar daqui! Eles passaram o dia matando gente aqui dentro! Se não me ajudar, eu sou o próximo!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.dst: Olha, do lado da minha cela, naquela mesa! Tem uma chave! Pega e me entrega!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: Sim, perfeito, PERFEITO! É essa chave, me dá!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.dst: Nem sei dizer o quanto te devo, humano... Você não faz ideia de como sou grato..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.dst: Escuta, qual é seu nome, humano? {u}? Certo, meu nome é Kaetan. Pode ir na frente e sair daqui, eu te alcanço. Se conseguir sair deste desmanche, me encontre em {p}, quero te dar algo lá.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#100.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#100.dst: Hã...? Ah- EI! A mesa pegou fogo, alguém vem aqui me ajudar a apagar!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#100.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: Encontre e destrua sua ficha criminal

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: Quem é você? Posso ajudar, humano?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.dst: O QUÊ?? Taron, e-ele está vivo?? E você... evitou que morresse de fome na prisão...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: Eu... humano, nem sei como agradecer. Mesmo que ele não saia de lá, só saber que está vivo já é... por favor, sei que não é muito, mas aceite isto.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: Boa noite. Posso ajudar em algo?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.dst: M-meu filho? Vivo?!? Ah, pela santa vaquinha, isso é...! Cadê ele??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: ...na prisão, é? Bem... É bom saber que ele vai conseguir aguentar mais um pouco... Muito obrigado, humano. Tome, aceite isto!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: O único jeito de fugir é passar pela porta de saída. Você vai precisar acessar a sala de controle para abri-la...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#110.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#110.dst: Parece que a Prisão mente ao governo sobre quase tudo o que faz, e o governo parece acreditar, apesar de todos os boatos sobre este lugar.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.dst: Parece que o único jeito de sair daqui é pela porta de saída..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: Ei, ei, humaninho! É, tô falando com você..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: So, welcome to the {p}. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: Então, bem-vindo a {p}. Você fica aqui pro resto da vida, nariz-curto, então nem adianta reclamar.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: Dentro há um uniforme de preso.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: There's a dusty key inside, labeled "SUPPLY CLOSETS"
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: Uma chave empoeirada, com a etiqueta "ALMOXARIFADO"

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: Some water came out of the shower head.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: Saiu um pouco de água do chuveiro.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.src: Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.dst: Parece que um preso está sendo interrogado...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#122.src: It's blocked off, though the holes in the fence are wide enough for you to get something through...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#122.dst: Está bloqueado, mas os buracos na cerca são largos o bastante para passar algo por eles...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#123.src: This must be the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#123.dst: Deve ser a porta de saída..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.src: It appears to be completely locked.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#125.src: There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#125.dst: Tem algo na mesa. Parece... carne??

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.src: You bite back the urge to vomit... was this once a person???
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.dst: Você contém a ânsia de vômito... isto já foi uma pessoa???

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#127.src: The book is titled 'A GUIDE TO SOUL EXTRACTION'.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#127.dst: O livro se chama 'GUIA DE EXTRAÇÃO DE ALMAS'.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#128.src: It'd probably be best not to touch it..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#129.src: There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#129.dst: Há pedaços quebrados de um aparelho de tortura aqui..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.src: The blade is rusted and completely stained with dried blood..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.dst: A lâmina está enferrujada e toda manchada de sangue seco..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#132.src: There's some cheese inside of the crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#132.dst: Há um pouco de queijo na caixa.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.src: This must be the warden's office...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.dst: Deve ser o escritório da diretora..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.src: The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.dst: A diretora parece muito absorta na escrita..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.src: You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.dst: Você põe o queijo no chão, por onde o rato passou correndo...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#136.src: Looks like the rat dropped something when it ran away...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#136.dst: Parece que o rato derrubou algo ao fugir...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.src: You managed to fill your bucket with some water.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.dst: Você conseguiu encher o balde com água.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.src: You throw the water bucket onto the generator...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.dst: Você joga o balde de água no gerador...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#139.src: Looks like something popped out of the generator...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#139.dst: Parece que algo saltou do gerador...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#140.src: Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#140.dst: Parece que você limpou toda a sujeira! Volte ao guarda na entrada dos corredores e diga que terminou.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.src: You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.dst: O guarda escolta você de volta ao bloco de celas...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.src: The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.dst: Vocês dois chegam bem quando a chamada vai começar. Uns guardas empurram você para o lugar, junto aos outros presos...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.src: You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.dst: Os guardas escoltam você até o refeitório...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.src: You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.dst: Você é escoltado para fora do refeitório e de volta à cela...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.src: Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.dst: Parece que o dia acabou... Amanhã, sua prioridade deve ser bolar um plano de fuga. Encontrar um uniforme de guarda também pode ajudar..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.speaker: Grook

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.src: [{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.dst: [{~}/{~}] ??? Certo! Todos de pé! Fora das celas, JÁ! Hora da chamada!

similar.text: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.src: There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.dst: Há um kit de gazuas nesta caixa!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.src: There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.dst: Há algumas pilhas de moedas nesta caixa.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#149.src: There are some vegetables inside of this crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.src: This must be the exit door.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.dst: Deve ser a porta de saída.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#151.src: This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#151.dst: Esta deve ser a saída mais direta da prisão... Mas você vai precisar entrar na sala de controle para abri-la.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.src: It's the map of the prison's hallways.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.dst: É o mapa dos corredores da prisão.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.src: Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.dst: Parece que a diretora não fica aqui no seu horário de trabalho... Isso pode ser útil depois...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.src: This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.dst: Esta deve ser a sala de controle de que aqueles presos falavam ontem...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.src: This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.dst: Esta sala tem que ser seu passaporte para sair daqui. Só precisa achar um jeito de entrar...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.src: You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.dst: Você lembra vagamente do rato que correu por aqui ontem...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#158.src: You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#158.dst: Você veste o uniforme de guarda por baixo da sua roupa. Isso deve ajudar a evitar suspeitas na hora da fuga...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.src: Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.dst: Parece que isso é tudo o que dá para achar por enquanto. Volte ao guarda na entrada dos corredores e diga que terminou o trabalho.

similar.text: "Don't touch me."

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#161.src: Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#161.dst: Hora de avaliar a situação. Você precisa sair daqui, e talvez já tenha descoberto o bastante para isso.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.src: The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.dst: A diretora disse na chamada que há chaves reserva da sala de controle no escritório dela. Você terá que entrar no escritório no horário de trabalho para acessar a sala de controle.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.dst: Certo, agora o resto, ao trabalho! A chamada acabou por ho-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.src: -The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.dst: -Que diabos? Ai, ei! Saiam de cima, pestes inúteis!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.src: ...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.dst: ...Todos vocês... Fora... Da minha vista... JÁ.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.src: Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.dst: Sem o guarda aqui, dá para examinar melhor esta saída de ar...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.src: It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.dst: Parece bem velha, e as grades estão se soltando nas junções... não deve custar muito esforço só...?

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#168.src: Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#168.dst: Perfeito! Sem a grade, é fácil se espremer pela abertura do duto.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.src: These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.dst: Estes papéis na mesa parecem endereçados à diretora.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.src: The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.dst: Os papéis parecem pedir à diretora...? Uma cota de almas...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.src: The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.dst: A assinatura no fim traz apenas a letra D.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.src: There are some books stacked up in piles right here.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.dst: Há alguns livros empilhados bem aqui.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.src: The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.dst: Os temas vão da história da Decadência à magia espiritual e... extração de almas.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.src: It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.src: The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.dst: A chave encaixa perfeitamente na fechadura...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.src: There are some papers here about the prison's history..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.dst: Há papéis aqui sobre a história da prisão..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.src: The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.dst: Os papéis dizem que a prisão foi construída em {~} AP e era reservada aos piores criminosos de Gavel...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.src: It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.dst: É também a maior prisão de toda Gavel, e recebe uma enorme verba para manter seus presos encarcerados...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#180.src: It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#180.dst: São só instruções de uso de aparelhos eletromágicos.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.src: There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.dst: Há cabeças de machado enferrujadas aqui. Os gumes estão manchados de sangue seco...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.src: The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.dst: A tela parece mostrar um mapa de toda a prisão! Parece que, depois da porta de saída, você terá que passar escondido por boa parte da prisão para fugir.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.src: Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.dst: Perto dos fundos da prisão, há uma sala com quase todos os registros do lugar... Talvez você consiga destruir sua ficha criminal se chegar lá!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.src: There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.dst: Há uma alavanca neste painel de controle com as palavras "DESTRANCAR PORTA DE SAÍDA".

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.src: You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.dst: Dá para ouvir uma porta se abrindo ao longe... a porta de saída deve ter acabado de abrir!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.src: This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.dst: Esta tela parece mostrar informações sobre patrulhas e posições dos guardas na segunda metade da prisão...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#187.src: ...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#187.dst: ...A área toda vai estar cheia de guardas. Você vai ter que passar escondido por todos eles para fugir da prisão de vez.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.src: There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.dst: Há um metal de aparência extremamente escura neste armário. Não dá para saber para que serve...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.src: This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.dst: Este arquivo tem várias cartas entre o governo de Gavel e a Prisão.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.src: The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.dst: O governo não deve se importar o bastante com a vida de quem mora nas florestas do norte de Gavel para condenar a prisão por toda essa matança.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.src: These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.dst: Estes arquivos têm fichas criminais de muitos presos daqui...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.src: Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.dst: Quase todas essas fichas estão vazias, salvo umas poucas de quem cometeu pequenos furtos tempos atrás.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.src: This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.dst: Esta caixa tem algumas fichas criminais. A primeira tem seu nome... Pelo menos não precisou procurar muito.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.src: There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.dst: Deve haver algo por perto para destruí-la.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.src: You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.dst: Você joga sua ficha criminal no fogo. Já vai tarde.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.src: Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.dst: Sua ficha foi destruída, por enquanto. Enfim você pode deixar a prisão de vez.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.src: This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.dst: Este arquivo tem registros sobre a diretora...mas parecem incompletos.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.src: Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.dst: Quase nenhuma informação foi preenchida: sem idade, histórico profissional, família, nada. Ela parece uma não-pessoa completa.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.src: It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.dst: É como se ela tivesse surgido do nada só para ser a diretora desta prisão.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.src: There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.dst: Aí está você! Que bom que conseguiu fugir daquele lugar horrível!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.speaker: Kaetan

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.src: But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.dst: Mas sério, obrigado, {u}. Achei que ia morrer lá dentro! Não é muito, mas espero que ajude você a se reerguer depois de tudo aquilo.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.speaker: Kaetan

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.src: Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.dst: Enfim, tenho que ir. Mas se um dia eu puder ajudar em qualquer coisa, é só falar! Fico eternamente em dívida com você, humano.

From the Bottom#000.src: An'! The best part! The idiot came back with a crumpled wrist and this HORRIFIED look- Musta gotten on the Hive witch's bad side!
From the Bottom#000.dst: E! A melhor parte! O idiota voltou com o pulso esmagado e uma cara HORRORIZADA- Deve ter irritado a bruxa do Hive!
From the Bottom#000.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#001.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#001.dst: Ah, olá, humano! Com certeza já notou o bazar aqui embaixo. É o orgulho dos anões- o maior mercado de todas as cidades anãs!
From the Bottom#001.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#002.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#002.dst: Itens especiais que você não acha em nenhum outro lugar- Todo tipo de coisa estranha, maravilhosa e única. Eu mesmo procuro umas miudezas aqui.
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#003.dst: É quase tudo escambo, não como os mercadores lá de cima e seu metal brilhante. O que é... um azar pra mim, de certo modo.
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after right now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#004.dst: Sabe, sou historiador de profissão, mas o que quero mesmo agora é Troll Hair. Sabe, eu adoro o chei- ahn. É forte e firme para encadernar livros- espera aí!
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#005.dst: VOCÊ tem? Fenomenal! Nunca consigo pegar- nunca fui de lutar. Hum, tome! Deixe-me trocar isso por... isto!
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#006.dst: Um Decorative Bottlecap Set! Foi difícil achar, mas tenho dois conjuntos mesmo. Dê uma olhada! Vai aprender muito. Muito obrigado, aliás!
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: ...this is more useless to you than that troll hair. But, Nakoba did say the merchants barter. Maybe you can get something more useful for these.
From the Bottom#007.dst: ...isto te serve menos ainda que aquele pelo de troll. Mas Nakoba disse que os mercadores fazem escambo. Talvez troque por algo mais útil.

From the Bottom#008.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#008.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar uma [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#009.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#009.dst: Minerais à venda! Minerais à venda! Venham buscar metais raros! Temos Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, Sandstone legítima de {p}, Voidstone verdadeira de {p}!
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#010.dst: Você aí, humano! Se curte ferraria, veio ao lugar certo! ...desde que goste de bebidas anãs. Quero conjuntos de tampinhas em troca disto.
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#011.dst: Que cara é essa? É novo aqui ou o quê? Nunca viu um colecionador de tampinhas? Ou essa é a sua cara mesmo?
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#012.dst: O- Isso! Isso é! Eu! Como você! Está... Está em estado perfeito! Não falta nenhuma tampinha! Nem marca de abridor tem!!!
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#013.dst: Não tem como você ter conseguido isso pessoalmente! Não pode entender a importância do que tem nas mãos!! EU! PRECISO! DELAS!
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#014.dst: Tome! Meu metal mais raro! Pegue! Pegue e me dê essas tampinhas! Tenho que completar minha coleção!! Me dá! Me dá! Me dá me dá me dá me dá AGORA!
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#015.dst: ...hã. Aham. Me empolguei. Mas...essas tampinhas são do primeiríssimo Dogun Festival. Nem era em Courag na época em que foram feitas!
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jaspilite I gave you!
From the Bottom#016.dst: Adoraria falar mais delas, mas não posso me demorar numa venda, senão outros clientes vão embora. Mas você fez um bom negócio com aquele Jaspilite que te dei!
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what he's selling instead.
From the Bottom#017.dst: Pensando bem, um sujeito queria isso, mas não tinha nem uma tampinha de refrigerante comum! Acho que ele está bem perto. Talvez você se interesse pelo que ele vende.
From the Bottom#017.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#018.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#018.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar uns [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#019.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#019.dst: Hm...um comerciante humano? Bem, já ouvi falar de vocês, mas espero que não traga o de sempre.
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables and all. You all seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#020.dst: Sim, já vi vários do seu tipo neste bazar- Usando as forjas e bancadas de ferraria comunitárias. Vocês parecem ter metal aos montes...
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#021.dst: ...mas uns noventa e oito de cada cem lingotes que vi humanos usarem eram lixo! Só servem para treinar! Eu só busco os melhores metais, sabe.
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPILITE?! Oh, you must've gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#022.dst: ...então, claro, você tinha que me contrariar com MOLTEN JASPILITE?! Ah, deve ter pego com Dobile. Não te imaginava colecionador de tampinhas!
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: I've been pestering him for awhile about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is incredibly valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#023.dst: Venho enchendo ele faz tempo por causa do estoque. O metal da Unseen Blade é valiosíssimo, sabe. É frágil, sim...
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#024.dst: ...mas empunhá-lo é canalizar o poder do próprio Ockar the Unseen Blade! O capataz de guerra que acovardou cem demônios com uma mera adaga!
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#025.dst: Infiltrando-se atrás das linhas inimigas, enfrentando um calor escaldante! Sendo uma sombra e cortando rocha e magma sem pestanejar!!
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#026.dst: ...hã, sim. Enfim! Por isso, não posso te dar menos que minha mercadoria mais rara. Um Golemlus Power Core. Se Qira soubesse que tenho isto, eu estaria pior que morto.
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#027.dst: Ela guarda os segredos daquelas criaturas a sete chaves- e isto deve ser a chave desse mistério. Guarde bem isto, humano! Não é uma mera bateria Corkian.
From the Bottom#027.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#028.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#028.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar uma [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#029.src: Aight chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#029.dst: Fala, chefia, em que posso ajudar? Tenho todo tipo de máquina aqui. Alguma tem que te agradar, ouviu?
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#030.dst: Eu improvisei este espremedor! Bota um limão, dá uma, hehe, carga, e num piscar sai suco de limão!
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business! Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#031.dst: Ou que tal este lança-moedas? Gire a manivela e ele cospe qualquer coisa do tamanho de uma moeda que é uma beleza! Só, hã, não mire em janelas, a não ser que odeie mesmo a janela.
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#032.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round, I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#032.dst: ...quê? Ah, entendi. Acha que tem algo que interessa a MIM, e não o contrário, saquei. Bem, deixa eu ver isso um segundo.
From the Bottom#032.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#033.src: ...okay, I can't make heads or tails 'a this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-Legendary island!
From the Bottom#033.dst: ...tá, não entendo nem pé nem cabeça dessa coisa. O que disse que era mesmo? Não me diga que é uma bugiganga de Corkus, daquela ilha não tão Lendária!
From the Bottom#033.speaker: Lodog

similar.text: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!

From the Bottom#034.src: ...okay. I can't make heads or tails a' this thing. What'd you say it was again? Don't tell me this is some Corkus gadget from that not-so-{p}!
From the Bottom#034.dst: ...tá. Não entendo nem pé nem cabeça dessa coisa. O que disse que era mesmo? Não me diga que é uma bugiganga de Corkus daquela não-tão-{p}!
From the Bottom#034.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#035.src: ...a... A Golemlus Power Core...? This...hot DOG! Yahaaah, I'd heard about those wacko golem thingies ages ago, I always wanted to take 'em apart! Aw hell but this is an opportunity!
From the Bottom#035.dst: ...um... Um Golemlus Power Core...? Isso é... CARAMBA! Iahaaa, ouvi falar desses golens malucos faz tempo, sempre quis desmontar um! Puxa vida, que oportunidade!
From the Bottom#035.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#036.src: Gotta say, for something that came from that Hive it's a lot less purple and black and spidery-all-over than I expected. The complexity...this has gotta be the real deal, but...
From the Bottom#036.dst: Devo dizer, para algo que veio daquele Hive, tem bem menos roxo, preto e cara de aranha do que eu esperava. A complexidade... isto tem que ser legítimo, mas...
From the Bottom#036.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#037.src: Feels like someone else made this. That Qira lady doesn't seem like the handsy type, and this is somethin' like {~} mechanics, {~} magic. Just seems out of character.
From the Bottom#037.dst: Parece que outra pessoa fez isto. Essa tal de Qira não parece do tipo que põe a mão na massa, e isto é tipo {~} mecânica, {~} magia. Não combina com ela.
From the Bottom#037.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#038.src: Ah, but I'm gettin' away from myself. Tell ya what- prob'ly went through a lotta trouble ta get this, and that means you got guts. You got bravery. You got STONES, human!
From the Bottom#038.dst: Ah, mas tô me perdendo. Olha só- deve ter dado um trabalhão pra conseguir isto, e isso quer dizer que você tem coragem. Tem bravura. Tem PEITO, humano!
From the Bottom#038.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#039.src: So, how 'bout these Ice Drake Scales then? It fits a brave soul like you, it does! Take 'em with pride, there!
From the Bottom#039.dst: Então, que tal estas Ice Drake Scales? Combinam com uma alma corajosa como a sua! Leve com orgulho!
From the Bottom#039.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#040.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the Ice Drake Scales. Mastro is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#040.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar as Ice Drake Scales. Mastro está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#041.src: Ardent Magma Crystals for sale! Pure, {~}! Accept no substitutes, unless you're paying in emeralds, in which case kindly substitute...a lot of them!!
From the Bottom#041.dst: Ardent Magma Crystals à venda! Puros, {~}! Não aceite substitutos, a não ser que pague em esmeraldas, aí por favor substitua... por muitas!!
From the Bottom#041.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#043.src: Human! You have a keen eye for prices and values! I can tell by that glint in your eye- a real MAN's spirit! Even if you aren't a man, your spirit shines all the same as a man...!
From the Bottom#043.dst: Humano! Que olho afiado para preços e valores! Vejo por esse brilho no olhar- o espírito de um verdadeiro HOMEM! Mesmo que não seja homem, seu espírito brilha igual...!
From the Bottom#043.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#044.src: A SALES MAN! YES! Macho and brave! Chiseled and strong! Strong enough to carry {~} Liquid Emeralds to trade for this brilliant Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#044.dst: UM HOMEM DE VENDAS! SIM! Macho e valente! Talhado e forte! Forte para carregar {~} esmeraldas líquidas por este brilhante Ardent Magma Crystal!
From the Bottom#044.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#045.src: ...but hold on a moment. Hold on just one moment. Do I detect...a vein of ICE in that manly aura? A chill, pushing against that spirit of market machismo?
From the Bottom#045.dst: ...mas espere um momento. Espere só um momento. Detecto... um veio de GELO nessa aura viril? Um frio, contra esse espírito de machismo comercial?
From the Bottom#045.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#046.src: YES, I DO! Human, you have Ice Drake Scales! I needn't see them to be sure! I was right about you from the start- Such burning passion!!
From the Bottom#046.dst: SIM! Humano, você tem Ice Drake Scales! Nem preciso vê-las para saber! Eu estava certo sobre você desde o início- Que paixão ardente!!
From the Bottom#046.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#047.src: AND SUCH NAIVETE! Let me strengthen your MIND! Ice Drake Scales are indicative of a great challenge having been overcome! A truly macho trophy of accomplishment!
From the Bottom#047.dst: E QUANTA INGENUIDADE! Deixe-me fortalecer sua MENTE! Ice Drake Scales indicam um grande desafio superado! Um troféu de conquista verdadeiramente macho!
From the Bottom#047.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#048.src: To tame Ice Drakes required UNBREAKABLE will! To overcome the sheerest cold with MACHO HEAT! And to outshine demons of lava and flame with that same determination! Those scales represent such resilience!
From the Bottom#048.dst: Domar Ice Drakes exigia vontade INQUEBRANTÁVEL! Vencer o frio mais puro com CALOR MACHO! E ofuscar demônios de lava e chama com a mesma determinação! Essas escamas representam tal resiliência!
From the Bottom#048.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#049.src: And yet...I must wonder. Such a fiery spirit you have- THOSE SCALES HOLD YOU BACK! Your spirit cannot be contained in such a manner!
From the Bottom#049.dst: E ainda assim... me pergunto. Que espírito ardente você tem- ESSAS ESCAMAS TE PRENDEM! Seu espírito não pode ser contido assim!
From the Bottom#049.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#050.src: DISRESPECT YOURSELF NO LONGER! I DEMAND YOU HAND OVER THOSE SCALES! But you will not leave empty-handed, no no, friend!
From the Bottom#050.dst: CHEGA DE DESRESPEITAR A SI MESMO! EXIJO QUE ENTREGUE ESSAS ESCAMAS! Mas não vai sair de mãos vazias, não, não, amigo!
From the Bottom#050.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#051.src: You have ignited my passion as a salesman, so I shall present you one of my own greatest accomplishments! For a spirit so WHITE HOT, only an ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL is fitting!
From the Bottom#051.dst: Você acendeu minha paixão de vendedor, então lhe darei uma das minhas maiores conquistas! Para um espírito tão INCANDESCENTE, só um ARDENT MAGMA CRYSTAL está à altura!
From the Bottom#051.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#052.src: YES! Your soul shines brighter than the shimmer of EIGHT-HUNDRED-MILLION EMERALDS! Forever may your spirit BURN, human!
From the Bottom#052.dst: SIM! Sua alma brilha mais que o cintilar de OITOCENTOS MILHÕES DE ESMERALDAS! Que seu espírito ARDA sempre, humano!
From the Bottom#052.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#053.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy an [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#053.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar um [Ardent Magma Crystal]. Dohstaj está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#055.dst: ...ouvi Mastro gritando. Ele é... tão apaixonado.
From the Bottom#055.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#056.src: ...he's married to his work. Would I were his.
From the Bottom#056.dst: ...é casado com o trabalho. Quem dera ser eu.
From the Bottom#056.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#057.src: ...but business first. Wartime artifacts for sale.
From the Bottom#057.dst: ...negócios primeiro. Artigos de guerra à venda.
From the Bottom#057.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#058.src: ...priciest thing is a Dogun Flameshooter. Practically invaluable. You want it?
From the Bottom#058.dst: ...o mais caro é um Dogun Flameshooter. Praticamente inestimável. Quer?
From the Bottom#058.speaker: Dohstaj

From the Bottom#061.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy the [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#061.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar o [Dogun Flameshooter]. Syni está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#062.src: I can't stand this. I can't stand this! SHUT UP, MASTRO! NO ONE CARES ABOUT YOUR SWEATY SPIRIT OR WHATEVER!
From the Bottom#062.dst: Não aguento. Não aguento! CALA A BOCA, MASTRO! NINGUÉM LIGA PRO SEU ESPÍRITO SUADO OU SEJA LÁ O QUE FOR!
From the Bottom#062.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#063.src: MY MACHISMO CANNOT BE CONTAINED! Your aversion only inspires my salesman's spirit! Ardent Magma Crystals! Pure, {~} gold! {~} Liquid Emeralds, {~} off! STRONG bargains!
From the Bottom#063.dst: MEU MACHISMO NÃO SE CONTÉM! Sua aversão só aviva meu espírito de vendedor! Ardent Magma Crystals! Ouro puro, {~}! {~} esmeraldas líquidas, {~} a menos! Ofertas FORTES!
From the Bottom#063.speaker: Mastro

From the Bottom#064.src: AAAGH! Stupid, stupid, stupid Dohstaj! I just need him to fork over that stupid Flameshooter and then I can get away from this tripe but he just! Won't! DO IT!
From the Bottom#064.dst: AAAGH! Dohstaj idiota, idiota, idiota! Só preciso que ele solte aquele Flameshooter idiota pra eu sair dessa porcaria, mas ele simplesmente! Não! FAZ ISSO!
From the Bottom#064.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#065.src: No, look, human! Can't you see the kind of stress I'm under?! I don't care about your Flameshooter, I need to get my hands on Dohstaj's Flameshooter!
From the Bottom#065.dst: Não, olha, humano! Não vê o estresse em que estou?! Não ligo pro seu Flameshooter, preciso pôr as mãos no Flameshooter do Dohstaj!
From the Bottom#065.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#067.src: ...wait. Wait wait wait that's Dohstaj's Flameshooter how in the world did you get it what what WHAT! How did you snap him out of his...emotions?!
From the Bottom#067.dst: ...espera. Espera espera espera esse é o Flameshooter do Dohstaj como você conseguiu isso quê quê QUÊ! Como tirou ele das suas... emoções?!
From the Bottom#067.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#068.src: I've been trying to get hold of that for a week straight! I already have the perfect trade lined up! Please, hear me out!
From the Bottom#068.dst: Estou tentando conseguir isso há uma semana inteira! Já tenho a troca perfeita preparada! Por favor, me escute!
From the Bottom#068.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#069.src: I have here the Scepter of Draani Thunderwill I! Dohstaj only WISHES he could salvage something this juicy! The real, honest-to-goodness staff of the Wartime King!
From the Bottom#069.dst: Tenho aqui o Cetro de Draani Thunderwill I! O Dohstaj só SONHA em achar algo tão suculento! O verdadeiro e legítimo bastão do Rei da Guerra!
From the Bottom#069.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#070.src: A war relic for a war relic. It's only a fair trade! Just be real careful- a thief's been skulking in the yellow stall by the bank trying to steal it from me.
From the Bottom#070.dst: Uma relíquia de guerra por outra. É uma troca justa! Só tome muito cuidado- um ladrão anda rondando a barraca amarela perto do banco para roubá-lo de mim.
From the Bottom#070.speaker: Syni

From the Bottom#071.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon is behind the stone walls at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#071.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar [Draani Thunderwill's Scepter]. Yobon está atrás dos muros de pedra em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#072.src: ...so. I saw you talking with Syni.
From the Bottom#072.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#073.src: Pfft. Thief? I'm an honest man. Just following in old footsteps.
From the Bottom#073.dst: Pff. Ladrão? Sou um homem honesto. Só sigo velhos passos.
From the Bottom#073.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#074.src: I know you have the Scepter. I'd have thumped you and taken it if you were a Dwarf.
From the Bottom#074.dst: Sei que você tem o Cetro. Se fosse anão, eu já teria te dado uma surra e tomado.
From the Bottom#074.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#075.src: But how 'bout we work out a deal, instead? Take this tablet.
From the Bottom#075.dst: Mas que tal fazermos um acordo? Pegue esta tábua.
From the Bottom#075.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#076.src: It'll explain everything. Dwarven History...if you can read it. I can. Won't let loose my secrets for free though.
From the Bottom#076.dst: Vai explicar tudo. História anã...se souber ler. Eu sei. Mas não revelo meus segredos de graça.
From the Bottom#076.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#077.src: Hand over the Scepter, and I'll hand over the tablet.
From the Bottom#077.dst: Me dê o Cetro, e eu te dou a tábua.
From the Bottom#077.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#078.src: I won't translate it for you, but I'm sure there's some egghead who'll get back to you on what it means in...ten years or so.
From the Bottom#078.dst: Não vou traduzir para você, mas com certeza algum sabichão vai te dizer o que significa daqui a... uns dez anos.
From the Bottom#078.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#079.src: Good things come to those who wait for others to do the work for 'em, as they say.
From the Bottom#079.dst: Coisas boas vêm para quem espera os outros trabalharem por eles, como dizem.
From the Bottom#079.speaker: Yobon

From the Bottom#080.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy your [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}
From the Bottom#080.dst: Encontre em {p} alguém que queira comprar sua [Eons-Lost Dwarven History Tablet]. Nakoba está em {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#081.src: Well, you've been busy, I see! You've been working this bazaar like a champion!
From the Bottom#081.dst: Ora, vejo que andou ocupado! Você dominou este bazar como um campeão!
From the Bottom#081.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#082.src: I ought to tell my friends up at the topside shops- they really respect traders who know their way around a deal. You should be able to buy and use more items from the armories!
From the Bottom#082.dst: Devia contar aos meus amigos das lojas lá de cima- eles respeitam muito comerciantes que sabem negociar. Você deve conseguir comprar e usar mais itens dos arsenais!
From the Bottom#082.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#083.src: I...haven't had such luck unfortunately. I think you might've picked the place clean, eheh. Don't suppose you've got one last deal up your sleeve, huh?
From the Bottom#083.dst: Eu... infelizmente não tive tanta sorte. Acho que você limpou o lugar, hehe. Não teria um último negócio na manga, teria?
From the Bottom#083.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#084.src: Oh, really? Hah, I was just joking about that, but if you really do have an offer, go ahead and lay it on me!
From the Bottom#084.dst: Ah, é? Há, eu só estava brincando, mas se tem mesmo uma oferta, pode mandar!
From the Bottom#084.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#088.src: THAT'S ANCIENT HISTORY! FORMATIVE ANCIENT HISTORY!
From the Bottom#088.dst: É HISTÓRIA ANTIGA! HISTÓRIA ANTIGA FUNDADORA!
From the Bottom#088.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#089.src: I recognize those runes, they're ancient Dwarven glyphs! This is slab number three! We already have the first, second, and fourth tablets, my team and I- this would finish the collection!
From the Bottom#089.dst: Reconheço essas runas, são glifos anões antigos! Esta é a placa número três! Eu e minha equipe já temos a primeira, a segunda e a quarta- esta completaria a coleção!
From the Bottom#089.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#090.src: I! I! I! Take! TAKE EVERYTHING! EVERYTHING I HAVE! TAKE IT ALL, I NEED THAT! I NEED TO DISCOVER THOSE ANCIENT SECRETS!
From the Bottom#090.dst: Eu! Eu! Eu! Pegue! PEGUE TUDO! TUDO O QUE TENHO! PEGUE TUDO, PRECISO DISSO! PRECISO DESCOBRIR ESSES SEGREDOS ANTIGOS!
From the Bottom#090.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#091.src: AH! AHAHAHAHA! THE HISTORY! THE STORIES! THE EVERYTHING! IT'S BETTER THAN THE SMELL OF TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#091.dst: AH! AHAHAHAHA! A HISTÓRIA! AS HISTÓRIAS! O TUDO! É MELHOR QUE O CHEIRO DE TROLL HAIR! AHAHAHAAAHAHHAHAHAAAAAH!
From the Bottom#091.speaker: Nakoba

From the Mountains#000.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs om fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#000.dst: Mmf! Humfano! Mfa caffa egtá peganfo fofo! Afuda, o fofo não pafa!
From the Mountains#000.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#001.src: It's impossible to understand what language this man's speaking, but he's pointing to the house behind him. Is there something that can translate, maybe?
From the Mountains#001.dst: É impossível entender que língua esse homem fala, mas ele aponta para a casa atrás dele. Será que há algo que possa traduzir?

From the Mountains#002.src: Arnod keeps on pointing at his house. Maybe he needs something that's in there?
From the Mountains#002.dst: Arnod não para de apontar para a casa. Será que precisa de algo lá dentro?

From the Mountains#003.src: Arnod takes his dentures, and slides them back in his mouth.
From the Mountains#003.dst: Arnod pega a dentadura e a coloca de volta na boca.

From the Mountains#004.src: Go, human! Find someone who can help! I'm not going to wait for my house to be burnt to a crisp!
From the Mountains#004.dst: Vá, humano! Encontre alguém que possa ajudar! Não vou esperar minha casa virar carvão!

From the Mountains#005.src: Hm...where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#005.dst: Hm...onde vou arranjar ajuda agora- Hm? Você é um desses tipos humanos, não é? Você tem-
From the Mountains#005.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#006.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there... Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#006.dst: Ah, vejo quando chegarmos lá... Ah, o que estou fazendo aqui? É, acho que pareço diferente do que você costuma ver. Bem, sou um anão.
From the Mountains#006.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#007.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh...that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#007.dst: ...e onde há fumaça, há fogo. Isso está, hã... parecendo um pouco mais com a minha terra, e tenho quase certeza de que não deveria.
From the Mountains#007.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#008.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-lighting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#008.dst: Então essa é a casa, hm? Certo, vou ver o que posso fazer. Talvez não consiga apagar, mas se está reacendendo, então talvez...
From the Mountains#008.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#009.src: Hm...didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#009.dst: Hm...não achei que estariam tão longe, mas faria sentido se...
From the Mountains#009.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#010.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else are harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#010.dst: Há um problema de mercado negro em {p}. Coisas que não se acham em nenhum outro lugar são colhidas nas Heights por seu alto valor.
From the Mountains#010.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#011.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. We still have work to do.
From the Mountains#011.dst: Já consertei a carroça, está pronta. Pegou todos os Flerisi? Então venha até a carroça. Ainda temos trabalho.
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fires went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#012.dst: ...oh. Bem, não tinha notado que o fogo chegou TÃO longe antes. Isso é um problema, não é?
From the Mountains#012.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#013.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed off cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#013.dst: Explicando: nem todos os Flerisi são tão pequenos quanto estes. Eles se alimentam de brasas e fogo... E para causar tanto estrago, bem...
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well...I got a free cart for the ride home. There's a thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#014.dst: Vou perguntar à guarda local se acharam os traficantes. Se eles fugiram, bem... ganhei uma carroça de graça pra voltar pra casa. Tenho assuntos a tratar lá.
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#015.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#015.dst: Descubra o que está acontecendo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#016.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#016.dst: Pfor fafor afude! Nfão fei o fue fá afontefendo!
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#017.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#017.dst: Encontre dentro da casa o que Arnod quer.

From the Mountains#018.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#018.dst: ...bem, isso explica por que não ajudou. Mas, hã, o FOGO FURIOSO passou despercebido de algum jeito?!
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#019.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#019.dst: Não me importa quem seja, me traga ajuda!! Não importa se você faz ou chama alguém, mas alguém tem que dar um jeito nesse fogo maluco que reacende!
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#020.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#020.dst: Procure por {p} se precisar, mas vá logo! Minha casa vai virar cinzas se você não se apressar!
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#021.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.
From the Mountains#021.dst: Encontre alguém em {p} que possa ajudar com o fogo.

From the Mountains#022.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#022.dst: Hã? A casa de alguém está pegando fogo? Acho que isso é mais urgente do que o que eu ia pedir. Onde é?
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#023.dst: Ah, aquele vale perto do portão? Acho que sei onde é. Vamos juntos. Então, me conte o que aconteceu exatamente?
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said...what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#024.dst: Ah, então você é tipo um mercenário, e achou a casa desse homem pegando fogo. Ele disse... o quê? Que reacendeu sozinho? Bem, isso não faz sentido.
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#025.dst: Normalmente moro em {p}, depois dos cânions a leste. Adivinhe como é a terra, pelo nome.
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#026.dst: Sem entrar em detalhes, há... Alguns problemas com o jeito como é governado, e eu estava tentando angariar apoio em {p}.
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#027.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#027.dst: Foi, hã. Bem, já estou acostumado a ser motivo de piada em casa, mas não esperava ver o mesmo lá, só que com papel de parede de quartzo.
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#028.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#028.dst: Eu ia perguntar se você teria como ajudar, mas... bem, dá pra sentir o cheiro da fumaça daqui. Uma coisa de cada vez.
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#029.dst: É, esse fogo não é nada natural... Diabos, quase parece incêndio criminoso!
From the Mountains#029.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#030.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#030.dst: Aha! Aqui está o problema. É só um pequeno Fleris. Hum, explicando, eles normalmente vivem nas Heights.
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#031.dst: Bem carinhosos, ótimos se você aguenta o calor, mas se os tira dos montículos deles, eles se assustam.
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: One fleris could've kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout...there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#032.dst: Um fleris podia ficar incendiando a casa desse homem, mas com todo o resto do estrago... com certeza há mais de onde este veio.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#033.dst: Vamos falar com o aldeão lá fora. Talvez ele tenha visto para onde os outros foram, ou de onde vieram.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#034.dst: Senhor, descobri por que sua casa reacendia e resolvi isso, mas me diga, viu alguma coisa gosmenta se mexendo por aqui?
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#035.dst: Hum, não sei bem. Tentei apagar a casa tantas vezes que nem prestei atenção!
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#036.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#036.dst: Lembro de ver uma coisa tipo piche escorrendo das montanhas atrás da minha casa, mas só isso!
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#037.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#037.dst: Me parece concreto o bastante. Vamos ver o que está acontecendo no topo da serra. Consulte aquele seu livro se precisar de direções.
From the Mountains#037.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#038.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.
From the Mountains#038.dst: Vá à trilha em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e siga-a até o topo da montanha.

From the Mountains#039.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#039.dst: Hm, você escala bem rápido. Achei que chegaria antes. Bem, isso parece a área queimada lá no vale... Hm! Eu imaginei.
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#040.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#040.dst: Só consigo pensar em um motivo para haver tantos Flerisi por aqui... Se aquela carroça é reforçada, então...
From the Mountains#040.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#041.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#041.dst: Argh, eu sabia. Traficantes! E incompetentes, ainda por cima, já que não seguraram os bichos.
From the Mountains#041.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#042.dst: Os Flerisi são um deles. Nas Heights, são criados como bichos de estimação. São bem mansos, esquentam a casa e não dão muito trabalho...
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#043.dst: ...Mas se você os tira de um lugar quente, queimam tudo. E pensar- Tem gente que usa os bichos como armas. Não sabem deixar quieto...
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#044.dst: Vamos ter que pegar esses Flerisi. Tome, pegue esta rede. Enquanto você os captura, vou consertar a carroça para pô-los lá depois.
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#045.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#045.dst: Capture todos os Flerisi soltos e leve-os a Axelus.

From the Mountains#046.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#046.dst: Vou deixar os Flerisi num fogo menor para acalmá-los, e ver se consigo levá-los de volta às Heights quando isso acabar.
From the Mountains#046.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#047.dst: Por ora, quero ver se acho algo sobre quem eram esses traficantes. Vamos ver se deixaram algo na frente da carroça.
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#048.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#048.dst: Acho que este aqui está saindo do controle. E está bem ao lado daquela floresta grande. Pode dar problema se deixarmos este pra lá.
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#049.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#049.dst: Vamos ter que rastreá-lo e domá-lo. Venha, me siga. Vou cavar até o vale. Veja um anão trabalhando!
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#052.dst: Nada mal, hein? Enfim, não sei pra que serve aquele portão enorme, mas nosso amigo Fleris o tomou para uma fogueira.
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#053.dst: Pelo menos está mais contido do que eu pensava, naquela caverna, mas ainda temos que pegá-lo. Vá na frente. Estou com você.
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#054.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#054.dst: Mas o quê...?! Ele incendiou as criaturas desta caverna! Segure-as!
From the Mountains#054.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#055.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#055.dst: Vêm mais deles! Vá até o fim da caverna!
From the Mountains#055.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#057.dst: Se nós dois pararmos vai demorar demais, os traficantes podem voltar!
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#058.dst: Escute. Eu cuido dessas coisas, e você vai atrás do Fleris. Se for grande como achamos, a luta vai ficando mais fácil- Ele deve encolher quando você o atacar!
From the Mountains#058.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#059.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#059.dst: Certo, hora de uma boa pancadaria!
From the Mountains#059.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#061.dst: Ufa, você está bem! Chamuscado e coberto de fuligem, mas era de se esperar. E domou o Fleris também! Estou com a rede, deixe comigo.
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#062.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#062.dst: Bem, provavelmente foi um trabalho ingrato o que fizemos, mas muito trabalho é assim. Vamos sair daqui. Conversamos lá fora.
From the Mountains#062.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#063.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
From the Mountains#063.dst: Saia da caverna e fale com Axelus em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#064.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#064.dst: Bem, digo que o trabalho é ingrato, mas isso não vai me parar mesmo. Obrigado pela ajuda, humano- Sozinho, isso teria sido demais.
From the Mountains#064.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#065.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#065.dst: Ah, onde estão meus modos? Nem me apresentei esse tempo todo. Meu nome é Axelus. E o seu?
From the Mountains#065.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#066.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#066.dst: {u}, é? Vou tentar lembrar. Por ora, pegue esta armadura pelo incômodo. Boa viagem, {u}!
From the Mountains#066.speaker: Axelus

Frost Bite#000.src: I ignored the warning at first, since the bridge is the only path into the jungle...
Frost Bite#000.dst: No começo ignorei o aviso, já que a ponte é o único caminho para a selva...

Frost Bite#001.src: If you want to ignore the military's warning, I suppose you might benefit from buying some our stock first. Our potions are stronger than any sold in {p}, after all!
Frost Bite#001.dst: Se quer ignorar o aviso do exército, talvez lhe convenha comprar algo do nosso estoque antes. Afinal, nossas poções são mais fortes que qualquer uma vendida em {p}!

Frost Bite#002.src: From the look of your equipment... I'd say you might have a better chance of making it across than us.
Frost Bite#002.dst: Pelo seu equipamento... diria que você tem mais chance de atravessar do que nós.

Frost Bite#003.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up and take a look at the drill, would you?
Frost Bite#003.dst: Ei, guarda! Sabe algo de eletromagia? Suba e dê uma olhada na broca, pode ser?
Frost Bite#003.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#004.src: Now you've obtained the key, you can enter Theoricks mansion
Frost Bite#004.dst: Agora que tem a chave, pode entrar na mansão de Theorick

Frost Bite#005.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, I have a carriage for it.
Frost Bite#005.dst: Vamos juntos à mansão. Olhe, tenho uma carruagem para isso.

Frost Bite#006.src: This is unbeliveable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#006.dst: Inacreditável.. Ele era tão ganancioso- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#006.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#007.src: There must be some way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#007.dst: Deve haver um jeito de abri-la. Olhe em volta e veja o que encontra.
Frost Bite#007.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#008.src: Wow, even by todays standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#008.dst: Uau, até para os padrões de hoje, isto é uma fortuna. Imagine quanto valia há centenas de anos.
Frost Bite#008.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#009.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Frost Bite#009.dst: Encontre Eppo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. A entrada da caverna dele fica em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#012.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#012.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#013.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#013.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#014.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#014.dst: Pelo amor de Bob... Por que você não quebra?
Frost Bite#014.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#015.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#015.dst: Este gelo foi criado por Theorick, um Twain que defendeu esta área há muitos anos.
Frost Bite#015.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#016.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#016.dst: Quando a corrupção ficou demais... Ele congelou tudo, até as pessoas. Está vendo elas ali dentro?
Frost Bite#016.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#017.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#017.dst: Tentamos desesperadamente tirá-las, mas já usamos todo o equipamento que tínhamos, até esta broca Corkian.
Frost Bite#017.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#018.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#018.dst: Talvez devamos destruir mais... O perito em demolição, Rhudya, está no fundo da caverna.
Frost Bite#018.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#019.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#019.dst: É um tiro no escuro, mas vale tentar. Pode ir buscar enquanto eu libero este espaço?
Frost Bite#019.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#020.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#020.dst: Vá mais fundo na caverna e fale com Rhudya.

Frost Bite#021.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#021.dst: Opa! Isto é propriedade privada, sabia? Ah, o Eppo te mandou? Então tudo bem.
Frost Bite#021.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#022.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#022.dst: Então vai precisar deste TNT, só não deixe cair, opa!
Frost Bite#022.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#023.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#023.dst: É só atravessar esta caverna e você volta ao Eppo rapidinho!
Frost Bite#023.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#024.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.
Frost Bite#024.dst: Volte a Eppo com o TNT.

Frost Bite#025.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#025.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#026.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#026.dst: Para trás, vou acender o explosivo.
Frost Bite#026.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#028.dst: NADA? Nem um arranhão. Não entendo o gelo de Theorick.. Não é real.
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#029.dst: Não sei o que mais podemos fazer...
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#030.dst: EI. Eppo, aqui! Perto da caverna!
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#031.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#031.dst: O explosivo não funcionou? Achei esta mina velha na volta da caverna, ela leva a uma antiga caverna de lava.
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#032.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#032.dst: É um tiro no escuro, mas essa lava parece diferente. Por que não tentar?
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#033.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.
Frost Bite#033.dst: Vá até as fontes de lava pela mina.

Frost Bite#034.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.
Frost Bite#034.dst: Resolva o quebra-cabeça e leve a lava a Eppo.

Frost Bite#035.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#035.dst: Não entendo como dá pra carregar lava num balde.. Mas cá estamos.
Frost Bite#035.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#036.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#036.dst: A verdade é.. Não estamos tirando esses corpos à toa.
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#037.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#037.dst: Achamos que um deles trabalhava para Theorick e tem uma chave da mansão dele
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#038.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#038.dst: Nós de {p} achamos que Theorick tem muito a explicar. Queremos dividir a riqueza dele entre suas vítimas.
Frost Bite#038.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#039.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
