Frost Bite#039.dst: Pronto, mergulhei este bastão na lava mágica. É só segurar a vara e andar pelo gelo para derretê-lo.
Frost Bite#039.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#040.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#040.dst: Ache o cadáver com a chave, pode estar acima de você. Boa sorte!
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#041.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.
Frost Bite#041.dst: Derreta o gelo e encontre o cadáver do criado.

Frost Bite#042.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#042.dst: É esse mesmo? Pegou? Ótimo! Agora desça.
Frost Bite#042.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#043.dst: Vamos juntos à mansão. Venha, vamos no meu cavalo.
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#044.dst: No caminho, deixe-me explicar um pouco mais do que estamos fazendo. Vamos.
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#045.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#045.dst: Como eu disse antes, há um motivo para esta terra estar congelada, e não é natural.
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#046.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#046.dst: Muito antes de Bob, Wynn estava em ruínas por causa da guerra da corrupção.
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#047.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#047.dst: Naquela época existia um grupo de pessoas com dons naturais chamados Twains. Eles defendiam todos nós com magia elemental.
Frost Bite#047.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#048.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#048.dst: Theorick era um desses Twains. Ele dominava uma magia de gelo anormalmente poderosa. Usava-a para proteger as terras ao redor da mansão.
Frost Bite#048.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#049.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#049.dst: Theorick.. Não era como os outros Twains. Queria que os protegidos o pagassem e alimentassem como agradecimento.
Frost Bite#049.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#050.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#050.dst: Com os anos, Theorick ficou rico enquanto os que ele protegia viviam na pobreza e no medo - não só dos monstros, mas do próprio Theorick.
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#051.dst: Ele punia quem desobedecia seus toques de recolher e se irritava se alguém tentasse se mudar. O povo se sentia preso.
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#052.dst: No fim, como os outros Twains - Theorick caiu para a corrupção. Mas não antes de dar a última palavra.
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#053.dst: Ele congelou a terra inteira, matando quase tudo e todos que estavam lá fora. Centenas de vidas se perderam.
Frost Bite#053.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#054.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#054.dst: Acontece que o gelo desacelerou o avanço da corrupção pela terra até quase parar. Está assim desde então.
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#055.dst: Agora que podemos entrar na mansão, esperamos descobrir os segredos da magia de gelo dele para desfazê-la, e repartir a riqueza que ele tirou do povo. Ah, chegamos.
Frost Bite#055.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#057.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#057.dst: Este lugar parece congelado no tempo.. A grandeza.. Bem, ele só fez tirar e tirar de todos ao redor.
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#058.dst: Então, não sei por onde começar, mas imagino que ele tenha alguma proteção.
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#060.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.
Frost Bite#060.dst: Encontre as riquezas na mansão de Theorick.

Frost Bite#061.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#061.dst: Ai! Não esperava por isso. Isso só prova tudo o que eu disse dele. Punir quem o insulta.
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#062.dst: Enfim, devemos procurar algum tipo de entrada secreta.
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#063.dst: Theorick e suas armadilhas em casa, aquele velho paranoico gela-
Frost Bite#063.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#064.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#064.dst: Isso não tem graça nenhuma. Não vejo nada. Onde estamos, num beco sem saída?
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#065.dst: Bem, sabemos que insultos resultam em castigo. Talvez um elogio o deixe feliz?
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#066.dst: Ó Theorick, o mais forte dos Twains, você é mesmo um herói.
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#068.dst: Parece que enfim achamos os aposentos dele, olhe aquela porta de cofre.
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#069.src: Find your way into the vault.
Frost Bite#069.dst: Encontre um jeito de entrar no cofre.

Frost Bite#070.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#070.dst: Pegue um pouco para você também, não teríamos chegado aqui sem você.
Frost Bite#070.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#071.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#071.dst: Espere, olhe isto. Parece ser uma peça da armadura de Theorick.
Frost Bite#071.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#072.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#072.dst: Você conseguiu! Temos acesso ao cofre.
Frost Bite#072.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#073.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#073.dst: Surpreende que tenha cabido naquela cabeçona.
Frost Bite#073.speaker: Eppo

General's Orders#000.src: Speak to Private Tylas outside of Kitrios Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#000.dst: Fale com o soldado Tylas do lado de fora dos Kitrios Barracks em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

General's Orders#003.src: ...wh...? Oh...OH! Oh oh oh! Ahem! Yes, um! Absolutely sir! Right away sir! I don't think you're crazy at all sir!
General's Orders#003.dst: ...quê...? Ah...AH! Ah ah ah! Aham! Sim, hã! Claro, senhor! Já, senhor! Não acho o senhor louco, senhor!
General's Orders#003.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#004.src: ...oh. Wait, you're just one of those heavily armored human types. Cripes, I thought you were Lecade... Even nuts as he's gotten I'd get the thumbscrews if he caught me napping.
General's Orders#004.dst: ...ah. Espera, você é só um desses humanos de armadura pesada. Puxa, achei que fosse o Lecade... Mesmo doido como anda, ele me esfolava se me pegasse cochilando.
General's Orders#004.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#005.src: Hum...well, hey. You humans like doing work, right? I hear about it from folks in the army that you lot are pretty zealous about your favors.
General's Orders#005.dst: Hum...bem, ei. Vocês humanos gostam de trabalhar, né? O pessoal do exército diz que vocês são bem dedicados com favores.
General's Orders#005.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#006.src: Then I think today might be your lucky day, because General Lecade is running out of free hands to push asinine tasks onto. No one knows what in the world's gotten into him.
General's Orders#006.dst: Então hoje pode ser seu dia de sorte, porque o General Lecade está ficando sem mãos livres para empurrar tarefas absurdas. Ninguém sabe o que deu nele.
General's Orders#006.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#007.src: Between you and me, I'm using this time to work on sleep instead. I mean, honestly! He wants me to dance with the other privates to greet visitors! We don't even ALLOW visitors normally.
General's Orders#007.dst: Cá entre nós, estou usando esse tempo pra praticar o sono. Sério mesmo! Ele quer que eu dance com os outros soldados pra receber visitantes! Normalmente nem PERMITIMOS visitantes.
General's Orders#007.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#008.src: So if you want to eat up a few hours, talk with Lecade. Up the hill and into the barracks. I'm going to try and do my actual guard duty here instead of doing the funky Grook.
General's Orders#008.dst: Então se quiser gastar umas horas, fale com Lecade. Morro acima e dentro do quartel. Vou tentar fazer meu serviço de guarda de verdade em vez de dançar o Grook funky.
General's Orders#008.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#010.src: Hey, hey, hey! What is this person? Why is it in my administrator's? New work! New work! Get this person out of the administrator's!
General's Orders#010.dst: Ei, ei, ei! O que é esta pessoa? Por que está na minha do administrador? Obra nova! Obra nova! Tirar pessoa da do administrador!
General's Orders#010.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#011.src: Wait. Wait, you. Wait right there. Don't move until someone comes to get you. Order! I order it!
General's Orders#011.dst: Espera. Espera, você. Espera aí. Não mexer até alguém vir buscar. Ordem! Eu ordeno isso!
General's Orders#011.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#013.src: ...okay, person. No one wants to bring you from administrator's, so instead I will give you another orders! Listen, listen, listen!
General's Orders#013.dst: ...certo, pessoa. Ninguém quer levar você da do administrador, então em vez disso eu dou outras ordem! Ouvir, ouvir, ouvir!
General's Orders#013.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#014.src: You intended to firstly? Convenient! Here is my order then- Check the war tools. They need to be maintained for use!
General's Orders#014.dst: Pretendia primeiramente? Conveniente! Minha ordem então- Verificar ferramentas de guerra. Manter elas para uso!
General's Orders#014.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#015.src: Cannons and catpults, fortifications and barriers. A barracks needs to be armed to the tooth! I order it! Bad weapons are no weapons!
General's Orders#015.dst: Canhões e catapultas, fortificações e barreiras. Quartel deve estar armado até o dente! Eu ordeno isso! Arma ruim é nenhuma arma!
General's Orders#015.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#016.src: Armaments are to be stored outside fort walls at all times. To the left path leaving the walls. There will be Smithy stationed.
General's Orders#016.dst: Armamentos guardados fora das muralhas do forte a todo tempo. Trilha esquerda saindo das muralhas. Haverá Ferreiro posicionado.
General's Orders#016.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#017.src: Move along! I have many orders to make! Return when the task is concluded!
General's Orders#017.dst: Andar! Tenho muitas ordens a fazer! Voltar quando a tarefa for concluída!
General's Orders#017.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#018.src: Go check on the malfunctioning equipment at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
General's Orders#018.dst: Vá verificar o equipamento com defeito em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

General's Orders#020.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person is in my administrator's again! This means the armaments are maintained! That is right?
General's Orders#020.dst: Ei, ei, ei! Pessoa está na minha do administrador de novo! Significa armamentos mantidos! Isto é correto?
General's Orders#020.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#021.src: Convenient! Very convenient! Now I will give you another orders! I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#021.dst: Conveniente! Muito conveniente! Agora eu dou outras ordem! Devo ponderar um momento.
General's Orders#021.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#022.src: Here is my new work then- Find the coin. A soldier has dropped a lucky charm in the wastewater!
General's Orders#022.dst: Minha nova obra então- Achar a moeda. Um soldado derrubou um amuleto da sorte na água suja!
General's Orders#022.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#023.src: All is confused without fortune. Soldiers must not be confused, or else I cannot give orders! Generally orders must be given!
General's Orders#023.dst: Tudo é confuso sem sorte. Soldado não deve estar confuso, senão eu não posso dar ordens! Generalmente ordens devem ser dadas!
General's Orders#023.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#024.src: The coin has been pushed into the sewage. My orders are convenient, as there is accessibility! The aqua ducts have means of entrance.
General's Orders#024.dst: A moeda foi empurrada para o esgoto. Minhas ordens são convenientes, pois há acessibilidade! Os aqua dutos têm meios de entrada.
General's Orders#024.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#025.src: Outside, the cracked aqua ducts have Sergeant nearby. It shall mark accessibility for you. Return when the charm is gotten!
General's Orders#025.dst: Lá fora, os aqua dutos rachados têm Sargento perto. Ele marcará acessibilidade para você. Voltar quando amuleto for obtido!
General's Orders#025.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#026.src: Recover the Good-Luck Charm from the sewers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#026.dst: Recupere o amuleto da sorte nos esgotos em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

General's Orders#027.src: My, what an odd task to give to the chief advisor of the general...
General's Orders#027.dst: Nossa, que tarefa estranha pro conselheiro-chefe do general...
General's Orders#027.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#028.src: You see, human, I was told to dig an extension to the sewer with my own hands.
General's Orders#028.dst: Sabe, humano, me mandaram cavar uma extensão do esgoto com as próprias mãos.
General's Orders#028.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#029.src: And at that, it's supposed to just loop right around back in to the pipe.
General's Orders#029.dst: E ainda por cima, ela deve só dar a volta e voltar para o mesmo cano.
General's Orders#029.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#030.src: I think the General is starting to snap under the stress. If you need to return to the fort, just follow along.
General's Orders#030.dst: Acho que o General está começando a surtar com a pressão. Se precisar voltar ao forte, é só seguir em frente.
General's Orders#030.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#031.src: Return to General Lecade with the Good-Luck Charm.
General's Orders#031.dst: Volte ao General Lecade com o amuleto da sorte.

General's Orders#032.src: Hey, hey, hey! Administrator's has person once more! The charm has been gotten! That is right?
General's Orders#032.dst: Ei, ei, ei! A do administrador tem pessoa mais uma vez! O amuleto foi obtido! Isto é correto?
General's Orders#032.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#033.src: Yipy! Soldier will get returned the coin very soon! Person, the actions you take are convenient! I appreciate your help. I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#033.dst: Iupi! Soldado terá a moeda devolvida muito em breve! Pessoa, suas ações são convenientes! Agradeço sua ajuda. Devo ponderar um momento.
General's Orders#033.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#034.src: Here is my new work then- Show your love. You have made me smile wide through your tasks! The other soldier would appreciate you too!
General's Orders#034.dst: Minha nova obra então- Mostrar seu amor. Você me fez sorrir largo com suas tarefas! O outro soldado apreciaria você também!
General's Orders#034.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#035.src: Walk jauntily across the tight rope, and make the other soldier smile as well! Soldiers must be happy at life.
General's Orders#035.dst: Andar faceiro pela corda bamba, e fazer o outro soldado sorrir também! Soldados devem ser felizes na vida.
General's Orders#035.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#036.src: The tight rope is right from administrator's- stairs are nearby the passage. Return when the soldier is happy!
General's Orders#036.dst: A corda bamba é à direita da do administrador- escadas perto da passagem. Voltar quando soldado estiver feliz!
General's Orders#036.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#038.src: Well I'll be, the soldier's crossing the tightrope.
General's Orders#038.dst: Ora vejam, o soldado está cruzando a corda bamba.
General's Orders#038.speaker: Barkeeper

General's Orders#039.src: Convenient! So convenient! Many cheers for person!
General's Orders#039.dst: Conveniente! Tão conveniente! Vivas para pessoa!
General's Orders#039.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#040.src: I think they might actually make it across...
General's Orders#040.dst: Acho que vai conseguir atravessar mesmo...
General's Orders#040.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#041.src: Gah, what in blazes are you thinking, Lecade?! First this confounded contraption, then...grumble, grumble...
General's Orders#041.dst: Argh, que diabos está pensando, Lecade?! Primeiro essa geringonça maldita, depois...resmungo, resmungo...
General's Orders#041.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#042.src: Very, very, very happy! The tight rope has been walked! I saw the task!
General's Orders#042.dst: Muito, muito, muito feliz! A corda bamba foi andada! Eu vi a tarefa!
General's Orders#042.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#043.src: The soldier is very happy now! A smile is brighting the room! Yet the day still is dark. Why this is, I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#043.dst: O soldado está muito feliz agora! Um sorriso ilumina a sala! Mas o dia ainda é escuro. Por que isso é, devo ponderar um momento.
General's Orders#043.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#044.src: I have devised my plan! I have observed the hills are naked. That must why the soldiers become upset.
General's Orders#044.dst: Eu elaborei meu plano! Observei que as colinas estão nuas. Por isso soldados ficam chateados.
General's Orders#044.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#045.src: Here is my new work then- Dress the hill. It is bare and trashy. No good! Trashy hills mean our day is trashy.
General's Orders#045.dst: Minha nova obra então- Vestir a colina. Está pelada e lixosa. Não bom! Colina lixosa quer dizer dia lixoso.
General's Orders#045.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#046.src: Turn the hill purple! I order it! Purple is King's color! The fortress will feel a castle and we will feast for a hundred!
General's Orders#046.dst: Pintar a colina de roxo! Eu ordeno isso! Roxo é cor do Rei! A fortaleza sentirá castelo e faremos banquete para cem!
General's Orders#046.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#047.src: Previously, Springy were introduced. They will make easy accessibility! Person will find Springy past the tight rope.
General's Orders#047.dst: Previamente, Molinha foram introduzidas. Elas dão fácil acessibilidade! Pessoa acha Molinha depois da corda bamba.
General's Orders#047.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#048.src: Paint the mountain by using the trampolines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#048.dst: Pinte a montanha usando os trampolins em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

General's Orders#049.src: WOOO!! Finally! Someone to help- Hey, look over here!!
General's Orders#049.dst: UHUUU!! Finalmente! Alguém pra ajudar- Ei, olhe aqui!!
General's Orders#049.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#050.src: Gosh, what a stroke of luck! I finally beat the Bantisu monks to one of you lost fellas!
General's Orders#050.dst: Puxa, que sorte! Finalmente cheguei antes dos monges de Bantisu num de vocês, perdidos!
General's Orders#050.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#051.src: I'm here searching for soldiers lost in the canyon, you're the first person I've found!
General's Orders#051.dst: Procuro soldados perdidos no cânion, você é a primeira pessoa que encontro!
General's Orders#051.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#052.src: This propeller hat is great, by the way. At first it seemed sort of silly, but it works a treat, and it's real fun, too!
General's Orders#052.dst: Esse chapéu de hélice é ótimo, aliás. No começo parecia bobo, mas funciona que é uma beleza, e é bem divertido também!
General's Orders#052.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#053.src: That aside, just stand under me, and I'll lift you down! Come on now!
General's Orders#053.dst: Tirando isso, é só ficar embaixo de mim que eu te desço! Vamos lá!
General's Orders#053.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#055.src: There you go, fella! It's back to the skies for me! Best orders ever!! WOOO!!
General's Orders#055.dst: Pronto, amigão! Eu volto pros céus! Melhores ordens de todas!! UHUUU!!
General's Orders#055.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#056.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person has returned to Administrator's! The hill is King's color now! This is right?
General's Orders#056.dst: Ei, ei, ei! Pessoa voltou à do Administrador! A colina é cor do Rei agora! Isto é correto?
General's Orders#056.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#057.src: However, tasks must be serious. Person's next work is very important. Mister "Gren" needs of help.
General's Orders#057.dst: Porém, tarefas devem ser sérias. Próxima obra de pessoa é importante. Senhor "Gren" precisa ajuda.
General's Orders#057.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#058.src: "Gren" Lieutenant has worked on task for many days. He needs assistance, fast- Time is required of a machine!
General's Orders#058.dst: "Gren" Tenente trabalhou em tarefa muitos dias. Precisa assistência, rápido- Tempo é requerido de máquina!
General's Orders#058.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#059.src: Here is my new work then- Assist "Gren." It is important work. Science machines are complicating.
General's Orders#059.dst: Minha nova obra então- Assistir "Gren." É obra importante. Máquinas de ciência são complicantes.
General's Orders#059.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#060.src: Build the machine with time! "Gren" is left outside Administrator's. Assist Lieutenant!
General's Orders#060.dst: Construir a máquina com tempo! "Gren" está fora da do Administrador. Assistir Tenente!
General's Orders#060.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#061.dst: Fale com o tenente Gren em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

General's Orders#062.src: ...hm? Oh, the madman's roped you into this too?! I asked for a Corkian engineer, not- Urgh. Look, have you got any technical knowhow?
General's Orders#062.dst: ...hm? Ah, o maluco te arrastou pra isso também?! Pedi um engenheiro Corkian, não- Argh. Olha, você entende alguma coisa de técnica?
General's Orders#062.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#063.src: He wants me to construct him a time machine!! Why does he even need more time when there's plenty about?
General's Orders#063.dst: Ele quer que eu construa uma máquina do tempo!! Pra que ele precisa de mais tempo se tem de sobra?
General's Orders#063.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#064.src: Well, beggars can't be choosers. If you think you have any ideas on how to get it functioning, step inside and see what you can do.
General's Orders#064.dst: Bom, quem não tem cão caça com gato. Se tiver ideia de como fazer isso funcionar, entre e veja o que dá pra fazer.
General's Orders#064.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#065.src: ...wait. It's ticking. Does that mean- Wait, no! HUMAN! GET OUT OF THERE-
General's Orders#065.dst: ...espera. Está fazendo tique-taque. Isso é- Não! HUMANO! SAIA DAÍ-
General's Orders#065.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#067.src: Investigate the mysterious prison within the fort.
General's Orders#067.dst: Investigue a misteriosa prisão dentro do forte.

General's Orders#068.src: Who goes there?! What, come to try and finish the job, you beast?! ...wait...a human?! Whatever reason you're down here for, you need to listen!
General's Orders#068.dst: Quem está aí?! O quê, veio terminar o serviço, sua fera?! ...espera...um humano?! Seja qual for o motivo de estar aqui, me escute!

General's Orders#069.src: I am General Lecade of the Kitrios Barracks! While you're on my ground, you must follow my orders!
General's Orders#069.dst: Sou o general Lecade do Kitrios Barracks! Enquanto estiver no meu território, siga minhas ordens!
General's Orders#069.speaker: Lecade

similar.text: [+{~} Old Key]

General's Orders#071.src: Soldier, I order you to unlock this door! They tossed the key behind that desk; we'll be able to discuss this once I'm out.
General's Orders#071.dst: Soldado, ordeno que abra esta porta! Jogaram a chave atrás daquela mesa; conversamos quando eu sair.
General's Orders#071.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#072.src: Good. Thank you, soldier. There's a lot to explain. I'll tell you everything on the way.
General's Orders#072.dst: Ótimo. Obrigado, soldado. Há muito a explicar. Conto tudo no caminho.
General's Orders#072.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#073.src: For now, though, we should get out of this dilapidated prison. Let's go.
General's Orders#073.dst: Mas por ora, vamos sair desta prisão caindo aos pedaços. Vamos.
General's Orders#073.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#076.src: You...! You're... What is the meaning of this, why do you look like me?!
General's Orders#076.dst: Você...! Você é... O que significa isso, por que se parece comigo?!
General's Orders#076.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#077.src: Trashy liar! No escape! I order it! Generally orders must be done! Return to the room!
General's Orders#077.dst: Mentiroso lixoso! Sem fuga! Eu ordenar! Generalmente ordem ser feita! Voltar pra sala!
General's Orders#077.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#078.src: What nonsense...! I'll wrestle that costume off of you, you impostor!
General's Orders#078.dst: Que absurdo...! Vou arrancar essa fantasia de você, impostor!
General's Orders#078.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#079.src: Agh... As insane as you sound, you're a tough fight... Human, you need to finish this thing off!
General's Orders#079.dst: Agh... Por mais louco que pareça, você briga bem... Humano, acabe com essa coisa!
General's Orders#079.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#080.src: Person! I have new work for you- Knock down the fake soldier! Assist fast!
General's Orders#080.dst: Pessoa! Ter trabalho novo pra você- Derrubar soldado falso! Ajudar rápido!
General's Orders#080.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#081.src: What folly! A doppelganger calling ME a fake! How about you go ahead and prove yourself!
General's Orders#081.dst: Que loucura! Um sósia chamando a MIM de falso! Que tal você provar quem é!
General's Orders#081.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#082.src: Hey, hey, hey! Smart thoughts from fakeman! Our home- we called it Gravel!
General's Orders#082.dst: Ei, ei, ei! Pensamento esperto de falsomem! Nosso lar- chamamos de Gravel!
General's Orders#082.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#083.src: Gravel? I've never heard something more outlandish, it's called Gavel!
General's Orders#083.dst: Gravel? Nunca ouvi nada tão absurdo, o nome é Gavel!
General's Orders#083.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#084.src: Are the rumors about humans being brainless mercenaries REALLY true?!
General's Orders#084.dst: Os boatos de que humanos são mercenários sem miolo são MESMO reais?!
General's Orders#084.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#085.src: What!? Books have told me this home is hilly and crumbly!
General's Orders#085.dst: O quê!? Livros dizer que este lar é morroso e farelento!
General's Orders#085.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#086.src: Do you even know where we are...? How about this then, who's the private who guards the entrance?
General's Orders#086.dst: Você sabe ao menos onde estamos...? Então me diga, quem é o soldado que guarda a entrada?
General's Orders#086.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#087.src: Tiger! The soldier with dance is Tiger!
General's Orders#087.dst: Tiger! O soldado com dança é Tiger!
General's Orders#087.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#088.src: Tiger?! His name is Tylas!! A tiger is an exotic animal, not some drowsy private!
General's Orders#088.dst: Tiger?! Ele é o Tylas!! Tigre é bicho exótico, não um soldado raso sonolento!
General's Orders#088.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#089.src: No wonder he was asleep, it seems he was even too lazy to give you his name!
General's Orders#089.dst: Não admira que estivesse dormindo, teve preguiça até de te dizer o nome!
General's Orders#089.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#090.src: Weak worm!! Person has been convenient with work- Why do stupid things?!
General's Orders#090.dst: Verme fraco!! Pessoa ser conveniente na obra- Por que fazer burrada?!
General's Orders#090.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#091.src: AHA! I have pondered- say where Springy is held!
General's Orders#091.dst: AHÁ! Eu ponderar- dizer onde Molinha é guardado!
General's Orders#091.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#092.src: What in the... Springy- What in the world are you talking about?! We don't store springs in the fort!!
General's Orders#092.dst: Mas o que... Molinha- Do que diabos você está falando?! Não guardamos molas no forte!!
General's Orders#092.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#093.src: Weak fake soldier!! Springy is held to sleep! Springy is held on top of the pillar!!
General's Orders#093.dst: Soldado falso fraco!! Molinha guardado pra dormir! Molinha guardado sobre o pilar!!
General's Orders#093.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#094.src: Human!! What are you thinking?! He's speaking utter nonsense!!
General's Orders#094.dst: Humano!! No que está pensando?! Ele só fala besteira!!
General's Orders#094.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#095.src: What even is a springy?! He's speaking utter nonsense!
General's Orders#095.dst: O que é uma molinha?! Ele só fala besteira!
General's Orders#095.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#096.src: Enough of this! Soldier, you can't possibly believe that fraud, we have to team up on him!
General's Orders#096.dst: Chega disso! Soldado, não acredite nesse farsante, vamos enfrentá-lo juntos!
General's Orders#096.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#097.src: Fine then- If I'm alone on this, it's time for the classic Lecade Power Play!!
General's Orders#097.dst: Pois bem- Se estou sozinho nessa, é hora do clássico Golpe de Força Lecade!!
General's Orders#097.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#099.src: Inconvenient! Person is trashy! Terrible fake! I will not intend the victim on returning to home!
General's Orders#099.dst: Inconveniente! Pessoa é lixosa! Falso terrível! Eu não pretender a vítima em voltar pro lar!

General's Orders#101.src: I did fine work! I generally performed tasks to soldiers! There's nothing wrong!
General's Orders#101.dst: Eu fazer bom trabalho! Eu generalmente dar tarefas a soldados! Nada errado!

General's Orders#102.src: Too much! Too much! Too much! Escape! Need escape! Too strong!
General's Orders#102.dst: Demais! Demais! Demais! Fugir! Precisar fugir! Forte demais!

General's Orders#103.src: Damn! He's gone... I don't think I'll be able to catch him on foot at this rate.
General's Orders#103.dst: Droga! Ele sumiu... Acho que não vou conseguir alcançá-lo a pé desse jeito.
General's Orders#103.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#104.src: I can't believe you actually trusted him, but I couldn't hold a grudge about it. The thing's gone, anyways.
General's Orders#104.dst: Não acredito que você confiou nele, mas não vou guardar rancor. Aquela coisa sumiu, de todo jeito.
General's Orders#104.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#105.src: It wouldn't be right to leave you empty handed over it. Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#105.dst: Não seria certo te deixar de mãos vazias. Talvez você ache uso para a gosma estranha que ele deixou.
General's Orders#105.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#106.src: Well soldier, I'll be checking out what degree of havoc he's wreaked on this fort.
General's Orders#106.dst: Bem, soldado, vou ver o tamanho do estrago que ele fez neste forte.
General's Orders#106.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#107.src: I couldn't leave you unrewarded for your efforts though. You seem resourceful- Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#107.dst: Mas não posso te deixar sem recompensa pelo esforço. Você parece engenhoso- Talvez ache uso para a gosma estranha que ele deixou.
General's Orders#107.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#108.src: Some clay I see! I'll take that off of you. Not without compensation of course!
General's Orders#108.dst: Vejo um pouco de argila! Fico com isso. Com compensação, claro!
General's Orders#108.speaker: Private

General's Orders#109.src: Convenient, convenient, convenient! Our day is will be no longer trashy. Good tasks have been concluded!
General's Orders#109.dst: Conveniente, conveniente, conveniente! Nosso dia ser não mais lixoso. Boas tarefas foram concluídas!
General's Orders#109.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#110.src: Lecade is up the hill and into the barracks. If he asks, tell him I greeted you with a squat-kick dance or something.
General's Orders#110.dst: Lecade subiu a colina e entrou no quartel. Se ele perguntar, diga que te recebi com uma dança de chutes agachado ou algo assim.

General's Orders#111.src: I have to dig this hole with only my feet. It's quite odd I admit, but I have faith in our general!
General's Orders#111.dst: Tenho que cavar este buraco só com os pés. É estranho, admito, mas confio no nosso general!

General's Orders#112.src: Here for some whiskey? Or maybe you'd like a flower. Gahaha, just pullin' your leg.
General's Orders#112.dst: Veio atrás de um uísque? Ou quem sabe uma flor. Gahaha, só tô brincando com você.

General's Orders#113.src: That general up in the fort told me to replace my bar with some of these flowers, so I had to oblige.
General's Orders#113.dst: Aquele general lá do forte mandou eu trocar meu bar por essas flores, então tive que obedecer.

General's Orders#114.src: Don't have much spare water in house, so I guess I'll be using booze to water 'em.
General's Orders#114.dst: Não tenho muita água sobrando em casa, então acho que vou regar elas com cachaça.

General's Orders#115.src: My duty is to help extend the aqueduct, but the issue with that is we're just making it one giant loop! The general says it's for quick traversal, who's gonna crawl through a sewer for that?
General's Orders#115.dst: Meu dever é ajudar a estender o aqueduto, mas o problema é que estamos fazendo um laço gigante! O general diz que é pra se deslocar rápido, quem vai rastejar num esgoto pra isso?

General's Orders#116.src: Hey! Shhh. I'm trying to pose as a scarecrow, and if you're around those crows will know I'm real!
General's Orders#116.dst: Ei! Shhh. Estou fingindo ser espantalho, e com você aqui os corvos vão ver que sou de verdade!

General's Orders#117.src: First off, my task is to catch rats around the table, but the fort HAS no rats.
General's Orders#117.dst: Primeiro, minha tarefa é caçar rato em volta da mesa, mas o forte NÃO TEM rato.

General's Orders#118.src: Secondly, I'm to catch each of them, individually, with a handheld mousetrap. What folly is this?!
General's Orders#118.dst: Segundo, tenho que pegar um por um com uma ratoeira de mão. Que loucura é essa?!

General's Orders#119.src: Hey, do you know what a "Springy" is? The General asked me to install them down the south hallway there.
General's Orders#119.dst: Ei, você sabe o que é uma "Molinha"? O general pediu que eu instalasse umas lá no corredor sul.

General's Orders#120.src: I had no clue, so I just purchased some trampolines instead. It, uh, should be close enough, I hope?
General's Orders#120.dst: Não fazia ideia, então comprei uns trampolins. Deve ser, hã, parecido o bastante, espero?

General's Orders#121.src: So excited to start my new job here! I don't understand why diving in to a pond is a part of the inauguration though.
General's Orders#121.dst: Que empolgação começar meu novo trabalho aqui! Só não entendo por que pular num lago faz parte da cerimônia de posse.

General's Orders#122.src: The equipment looks to be in proper shape. You should report back to General Lecade.
General's Orders#122.dst: O equipamento parece estar em ordem. Volte e informe o general Lecade.

General's Orders#123.src: Now that you're finally out of those stinking sewers, you should get that grubby coin to General Lecade.
General's Orders#123.dst: Agora que finalmente saiu desse esgoto fedorento, leve essa moeda encardida ao general Lecade.

General's Orders#124.src: You should return to General Lecade now that you've made it across.
General's Orders#124.dst: Você chegou ao outro lado, então volte ao general Lecade.

General's Orders#125.src: This is just insane. My task was to make a doorway here, but this tower is just filled with some really dark material! Where is it supposed to lead!?
General's Orders#125.dst: Isso é loucura. Minha tarefa era abrir uma passagem aqui, mas esta torre está cheia de um material muito escuro! Aonde isso deveria levar!?

General's Orders#126.src: Well, you're charred and covered in soot, but the explosion revealed a stairway. This seems important to investigate.
General's Orders#126.dst: Bem, você está chamuscado e coberto de fuligem, mas a explosão revelou uma escadaria. Parece importante investigar.

General's Orders#128.dst: Quem é o verdadeiro general Lecade?

General's Orders#129.src: So Lecade had a doppelganger this entire time...
General's Orders#129.dst: Então Lecade teve um sósia esse tempo todo...

General's Orders#130.src: If I had to guess, I bet that morphing creature came from a shipment of gear from the southwest.
General's Orders#130.dst: Se eu tivesse que chutar, apostaria que essa criatura metamorfa veio num carregamento de equipamentos do sudoeste.

General's Orders#131.src: Sorry for not catching it for you two, I had to wash myself off from that explosion you caused.
General's Orders#131.dst: Desculpem não ter pegado ele pra vocês dois, tive que me lavar depois da explosão que você causou.

General's Orders#132.src: What's this about a general? Look, I'm just trying to scare away crows...
General's Orders#132.dst: Que história é essa de general? Olha, só tô tentando espantar corvos...

General's Orders#133.src: Well, we finally finished connecting up this aqueduct. Although, I guess I never really had to do this, since a shape-shifter gave me the order.
General's Orders#133.dst: Bem, finalmente terminamos de ligar esse aqueduto. Mas acho que nem precisava, já que quem deu a ordem foi um metamorfo.

General's Orders#134.src: The soldiers understood the situation, luckily. Can't believe it got that far. I'll make sure nothing like that ever happens again!
General's Orders#134.dst: Por sorte, os soldados entenderam a situação. Nem acredito que chegou a esse ponto. Vou garantir que nada assim aconteça de novo!

General's Orders#135.src: Thank goodness that shape-shifter has been dealt with. His ridiculous speech patterns were starting to rub off on the newer recruits...
General's Orders#135.dst: Ainda bem que deram um jeito no metamorfo. O jeito ridículo dele de falar já estava pegando nos recrutas novos...

General's Orders#136.src: The General being back to normal is nice and all, but I dug my feet in to the hole and now I'm stuck!
General's Orders#136.dst: É bom o general ter voltado ao normal, mas enfiei os pés no buraco e agora estou preso!

General's Orders#137.src: Well well, looks like the general's back to normal. Same time though...the flowers are actually growin' pretty well like this. Think I'll keep 'em.
General's Orders#137.dst: Ora, ora, parece que o general voltou ao normal. Mas...as flores estão crescendo bem assim. Acho que vou ficar com elas.

General's Orders#138.src: Er, I mean, keeping the trampolines.
General's Orders#138.dst: Hã, digo, ficar com os trampolins.

Grand Youth#000.src: There's this group of mages out in Dernel who know how to get the stuff. They're a bunch of tightwads and wouldn't give me any real healing water to sell.
Grand Youth#000.dst: Tem um grupo de magos em Dernel que sabe pegar essa coisa. São uns pães-duros, não me deram nada de água curativa de verdade pra vender.
Grand Youth#000.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#001.src: Sorry man, if you haven't got any business with me then I can't talk.
Grand Youth#001.dst: Foi mal, se não tem negócio comigo, não posso conversar.
Grand Youth#001.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#002.src: Aha, perfect! If this will not work, then...no, I must have faith.
Grand Youth#002.dst: Ahá, perfeito! Se isso não funcionar, então...não, devo ter fé.
Grand Youth#002.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#003.src: Thank you so much, for aiding our village. I know we are smaller than our brothers from Iboju, but you are always welcome here.
Grand Youth#003.dst: Muito obrigado por ajudar nossa aldeia. Sei que somos menores que nossos irmãos de Iboju, mas você sempre será bem-vindo aqui.
Grand Youth#003.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#005.src: Oh, what am I to do...? How am I to be our next elder if I cannot even help him... Oh? Ehm, hello, stranger.
Grand Youth#005.dst: Ah, o que eu faço...? Como serei o próximo ancião se nem posso ajudá-lo... Hein? Hã, olá, forasteiro.
Grand Youth#005.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#006.src: You most likely heard me. Our elder has fallen ill of some vile disease... I am to be our next elder, but I am not yet ready.
Grand Youth#006.dst: Você deve ter me ouvido. Nosso ancião caiu doente de um mal terrível... Serei o próximo ancião, mas não estou pronto.
Grand Youth#006.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#007.src: We have tried everything we can think of, but our healers and shamans have failed to cure him. We had some hope, however...
Grand Youth#007.dst: Tentamos de tudo, mas nossos curandeiros e xamãs não conseguiram curá-lo. Porém, tínhamos uma esperança...
Grand Youth#007.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#008.src: A man in your city, {p}, insists that he sells healing water that could cure him, but he is selling it for an exorbitant price that we cannot afford!
Grand Youth#008.dst: Um homem da sua cidade, {p}, jura que vende uma água curativa que o salvaria, mas cobra um preço absurdo que não podemos pagar!
Grand Youth#008.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#009.src: I do not know where else to turn. I must ask you for help. If you can purchase it, I am sure that we could find a way to repay you.
Grand Youth#009.dst: Não sei a quem mais recorrer. Preciso pedir sua ajuda. Se puder comprá-la, sem dúvida acharemos um jeito de te recompensar.
Grand Youth#009.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#010.src: I have written directions for you in your content book...please help our village.
Grand Youth#010.dst: Anotei o caminho no seu livro de conteúdo...por favor, ajude nossa aldeia.
Grand Youth#010.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#011.src: Visit the Salesman in {p} near the fountain.
Grand Youth#011.dst: Visite o Vendedor em {p}, perto da fonte.

Grand Youth#012.src: Oh, why hello there! Come for my patented healing water, have you? Any problem instantly cured! Sniffles beware!
Grand Youth#012.dst: Ora, olá! Veio pela minha água curativa patenteada, foi? Cura qualquer mal na hora! Cuidado, resfriados!
Grand Youth#012.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#013.src: You're quite lucky, I only have a couple of bottles left, so it won't go cheap, but this is the good stuff! Only [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#013.dst: Você tem sorte, só me restam dois frascos, então não sai barato, mas é da boa! Só [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]!
Grand Youth#013.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#014.src: What? Don't give me that look! This is the real stuff, very valuable and rare! What do ya take me for, some guy who'd sell lake water for a fortune?!
Grand Youth#014.dst: Quê? Não me olhe assim! É da verdadeira, muito valiosa e rara! Acha que sou o quê, um sujeito que vende água de lago a peso de ouro?!
Grand Youth#014.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#015.src: Agh, agh! Put away the weapon! Put it away! Jeez, buddy! Alright, I admit it, I'm a fraudster! But, I do know where you get the real stuff, I ain't lying about that much.
Grand Youth#015.dst: Ai, ai! Guarde a arma! Guarde isso! Credo, amigo! Tá bom, admito, sou um vigarista! Mas sei onde arrumar a de verdade, nisso não estou mentindo.
Grand Youth#015.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#016.src: I doubt you'll have any better luck with it, but go on, try your luck.
Grand Youth#016.dst: Duvido que você se dê melhor, mas vai lá, tente a sorte.
Grand Youth#016.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#017.src: Those tightwad mages are out in Dernel, on the lake with the big island. I doubt you'll convince them to give you any healing water, though.
Grand Youth#017.dst: Os magos pães-duros ficam em Dernel, no lago com a ilha grande. Mas duvido que você os convença a te dar água curativa.
Grand Youth#017.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#018.src: Talk to Isfurus in Dernel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Grand Youth#018.dst: Fale com Isfurus em Dernel, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Grand Youth#019.src: Hm, hm...if it really does that, then...oh, is someone there? Erisk?
Grand Youth#019.dst: Hm, hm...se fizer mesmo isso, então...ah, tem alguém aí? Erisk?
Grand Youth#019.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#020.src: Oh, a tourist. Heard about the healing water, I presume? Well, if you are here to make a quick buck, you can turn right back around from where you came.
Grand Youth#020.dst: Ah, um turista. Ouviu falar da água curativa, presumo? Bem, se veio ganhar dinheiro fácil, pode voltar por onde veio.
Grand Youth#020.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#021.src: Hm...ah. Iboju's sister settlement...I see. I will trust this is an honest venture, then. The tribesmen are honourable.
Grand Youth#021.dst: Hm...ah. O povoado irmão de Iboju...entendo. Confiarei que é uma missão honesta, então. Os da tribo são honrados.
Grand Youth#021.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#022.src: I will provide you a specially-prepared bottle to hold the water in. My colleague, Erisk, is within the fountain here. He can fill up the bottle for you.
Grand Youth#022.dst: Vou te dar um frasco especialmente preparado para a água. Meu colega, Erisk, está dentro desta fonte. Ele pode enchê-lo para você.
Grand Youth#022.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#023.src: There are a few animals in the fountain, however. They're wild and will most likely attack, but you look well-armoured. I doubt you'll have trouble.
Grand Youth#023.dst: Mas há alguns animais na fonte. São selvagens e devem atacar, mas você parece bem armado. Duvido que tenha problemas.
Grand Youth#023.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#024.src: The entrance to the heart of the fountain is right below us. Take a deep breath and dive right in.
Grand Youth#024.dst: A entrada para o coração da fonte fica logo abaixo de nós. Respire fundo e mergulhe.
Grand Youth#024.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#025.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#025.dst: O caminho está no seu livro de conteúdo, amigo. Consulte-o sempre que estiver em apuros.
Grand Youth#025.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#026.src: Get the bottles filled by Erisk in the heart of the fountain to give Isfurus.
Grand Youth#026.dst: Peça a Erisk, no coração da fonte, que encha os frascos para Isfurus.

Grand Youth#027.src: And who might you be? We certainly don't get many visitors down here.
Grand Youth#027.dst: E quem é você? Aqui embaixo não recebemos muitas visitas.
Grand Youth#027.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#028.src: Aha, Isfurus referred you. Yes, let me bottle this up for you, then. Once I do, make sure you don't drop them! Both the bottles and the water are valuable and difficult to replace.
Grand Youth#028.dst: Ahá, Isfurus te mandou. Sim, deixe-me engarrafar isso para você. Depois, cuidado para não deixá-los cair! Frascos e água são valiosos e difíceis de repor.
Grand Youth#028.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#029.src: But what a marvel this place is...water to cure all ailments, even aging! I even hear there is a similar fountain someplace in Gavel, can you believe?
Grand Youth#029.dst: Mas que maravilha é este lugar...água que cura todos os males, até a velhice! Ouvi dizer que há uma fonte parecida em Gavel, acredita?
Grand Youth#029.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#030.src: Oh, I nearly forgot. Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave! There is just one more step to the process he has to take care of.
Grand Youth#030.dst: Ah, quase esqueci. Não deixe de passar no Isfurus antes de ir! Falta um último passo do processo que ele tem que fazer.
Grand Youth#030.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#031.src: Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave!
Grand Youth#031.dst: Não deixe de passar no Isfurus antes de ir!
Grand Youth#031.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#032.dst: Fale com Isfurus a pedido de Erisk.

Grand Youth#033.src: Aha. You had no trouble, I assume? Hand the bottle here, I'll finish the seal and remove the impurities...
Grand Youth#033.dst: Ahá. Nenhum problema, imagino? Me dê o frasco, vou terminar o selo e tirar as impurezas...
Grand Youth#033.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#034.src: ...done. There is much potential here...ancient tribal markings repeat the word "youth" over and again. It could be used, or abused...
Grand Youth#034.dst: ...pronto. Há muito potencial aqui...marcas tribais antigas repetem a palavra "juventude" sem parar. Pode ser usada, ou abusada...
Grand Youth#034.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#035.src: Anyways, you have your water. Not to be rude, but I must ask that you leave me to my research now. You have your delivery to make anyway, correct?
Grand Youth#035.dst: Enfim, você tem sua água. Sem querer ser grosseiro, peço que me deixe com minha pesquisa agora. Você tem uma entrega a fazer, certo?
Grand Youth#035.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#036.src: Bring back the bottle of healing water to Monte.
Grand Youth#036.dst: Leve o frasco de água curativa de volta a Monte.

Grand Youth#037.src: You have returned, I see. Have you the healing water?
Grand Youth#037.dst: Você voltou, vejo. Trouxe a água curativa?
Grand Youth#037.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#038.src: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I know we surely will not be able to compensate you for the price of the water...
Grand Youth#038.dst: Do fundo do coração, obrigado. Sei que jamais poderemos te compensar pelo preço da água...
Grand Youth#038.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#039.src: ...but here. This is the summation of our village's riches. For aiding us, consider it yours.
Grand Youth#039.dst: ...mas tome. Isto é toda a riqueza da nossa aldeia. Por nos ajudar, considere-a sua.
Grand Youth#039.speaker: Monte

Green Gloop#000.src: You gotten me [{~} Soft Sand] yet? You can dig it up from all those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#000.dst: Já arrumou [{~} Soft Sand] pra mim? Dá pra cavar nesses montes de areia pelo deserto.

Green Gloop#001.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I've come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#001.dst: Mas os slimes ficaram mais fortes faz um mês. Não consigo mais pegar a gosma, quase morri algumas vezes!
Green Gloop#001.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#002.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he^ll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#002.dst: Preciso de [{~} Slimey Goo], vamos fazer um lotão de bebidas. Se ajudar, falo com meu amigo e ele deve te deixar entrar na loja.
Green Gloop#002.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#003.src: Ah, you've got the scooper! Head into the cave now - remember, I need [{~} Slimey Goo] to make the drink!
Green Gloop#003.dst: Ah, você tem o scooper! Entre na caverna agora - lembre, preciso de [{~} Slimey Goo] para a bebida!

Green Gloop#005.src: Oh, hey! You, adventurer over there! Would you mind helping me?
Green Gloop#005.dst: Ah, ei! Você, aventureiro aí! Pode me ajudar?
Green Gloop#005.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#006.src: You see, this cave behind me has been troubling me for the past while now.
Green Gloop#006.dst: Sabe, esta caverna atrás de mim anda me dando trabalho.
Green Gloop#006.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#007.src: There are special slimes that live in there, and they drop a certain goo that is quite a delicacy when brewed into a drink!
Green Gloop#007.dst: Lá dentro vivem uns slimes especiais que soltam uma gosma que, virada bebida, é uma iguaria!
Green Gloop#007.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#008.src: They are called Gooey Slimes, and should be at the very back. A friend of mine drinks the stuff like water, and he refuses to work without it.
Green Gloop#008.dst: Chamam-se Gooey Slimes e devem estar bem no fundo. Um amigo bebe isso como água e se recusa a trabalhar sem.
Green Gloop#008.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#009.src: You, however, seem much better equipped than I. Hopefully you can do it.
Green Gloop#009.dst: Mas você parece bem mais equipado que eu. Espero que consiga.
Green Gloop#009.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#010.src: If you decide to help me, you'll need to obtain a special device for retrieving it, as the slime will dry up quickly in the air.
Green Gloop#010.dst: Se decidir me ajudar, vai precisar de um aparelho especial para coletá-la, pois a gosma seca rápido no ar.
Green Gloop#010.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#011.src: A...less fickle glassblower, Yodbon, can make it for you. He should be living in a house in front of the {p} bank.
Green Gloop#011.dst: Um vidreiro...menos enjoado, Yodbon, pode fazer um. Ele mora numa casa em frente ao banco de {p}.
Green Gloop#011.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#012.src: Find Yodbon near the {p} Bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#012.dst: Encontre Yodbon perto do banco de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#013.src: Welcome to Yodbon's Glass Blowery, what can I do f-
Green Gloop#013.dst: Bem-vindo à Vidraria do Yodbon, em que posso aj-
Green Gloop#013.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#015.src: So many've been coming up to me recently, askin' for a bloody Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#015.dst: Um monte deles tem vindo pedir um maldito Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#015.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#016.src: Izzat brother o' mine stopped workin' again? I swear, he's addicted to that slop...
Green Gloop#016.dst: Meu irmão parou de trabalhar de novo? Juro, ele é viciado nessa lavagem...
Green Gloop#016.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#017.src: Anyways, for me to make you a scooper you'll need to get [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#017.dst: Enfim, pra eu fazer um scooper, você vai trazer [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#017.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#018.src: Come back to me once you've gotten ahold of it. You can dig it up from those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#018.dst: Volte quando tiver. Dá pra cavar nesses montes de areia pelo deserto.
Green Gloop#018.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#019.src: Bring [{~} Soft Sand] from enemies in the desert to Yodbon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#019.dst: Leve [{~} Soft Sand] dos inimigos do deserto a Yodbon em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#021.src: A'ight, fork 'em over and I'll make you the scooper.
Green Gloop#021.dst: Beleza, passa pra cá que eu faço o scooper.
Green Gloop#021.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#022.src: ..There you go. No idea why he wants that stuff though. Maybe it's an acquired taste...
Green Gloop#022.dst: ..Aqui está. Não sei por que ele quer essa coisa. Vai ver é gosto adquirido...
Green Gloop#022.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#023.dst: Boa sorte com o que for.
Green Gloop#023.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#024.src: Fetch [{~} Slimey Goo] for Eluzterp from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#024.dst: Pegue [{~} Slimey Goo] para Eluzterp na caverna em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#025.src: Oh, you're back! Good to see you were able to get through there. Have you got a full Slime Scooper?
Green Gloop#025.dst: Ah, você voltou! Que bom que conseguiu passar. Trouxe o Slime Scooper cheio?
Green Gloop#025.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#026.src: Hmm, yes, everything seems to be in order. Perfect!
Green Gloop#026.dst: Hmm, sim, tudo parece em ordem. Perfeito!
Green Gloop#026.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#027.src: Thank you very much. Finally, I'll be able to get him in gear again... Why are all Villagers so fickle like that?
Green Gloop#027.dst: Muito obrigado. Enfim vou poder botá-lo pra trabalhar... Por que os Aldeões são tão enjoados assim?
Green Gloop#027.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#028.src: Well, I suppose that's beside the point. I'll be sure to let him know you got him his most recent fix.
Green Gloop#028.dst: Bom, acho que isso não vem ao caso. Vou contar a ele que foi você quem arrumou a última dose.
Green Gloop#028.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#029.src: He hangs around in a little black stall in the bazaar, there's a basement to it. He should let you inside now.
Green Gloop#029.dst: Ele fica numa barraquinha preta no bazar, que tem um porão. Agora ele deve te deixar entrar.
Green Gloop#029.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#030.src: And, for your troubles, a little something from me as well.
Green Gloop#030.dst: E, pelo incômodo, um agradinho meu também.
Green Gloop#030.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#031.src: Ah, hello again. This latest batch of drinks apparently really revitalized him. He said he's looking to make some great craft.
Green Gloop#031.dst: Ah, olá de novo. Esse último lote de bebidas o revigorou mesmo. Diz que quer fazer uma grande obra.
Green Gloop#031.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#032.src: Those Villagers are a little bit crazy though... I have no idea what kind of material it is that he insists he needs for it.
Green Gloop#032.dst: Mas esses Aldeões são meio doidos... Não faço ideia de que material ele insiste que precisa.
Green Gloop#032.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#033.src: Oh, it's you again. Yes, my brother there just loves makin' his little trinkets. He oughta make somethin' useful out of his glass instead...
Green Gloop#033.dst: Ah, você de novo. Sim, meu irmão adora fazer seus badulaques. Devia fazer algo útil com o vidro...
Green Gloop#033.speaker: Yodbon

Haven Antiquity#000.src: Did you talk with the old creepy man in the mansion yet? I'm sure he knows something.
Haven Antiquity#000.dst: Já falou com o velho esquisito da mansão? Tenho certeza de que ele sabe de algo.

Haven Antiquity#001.src: I'd sit and tell you, but I feel you might get a better experience first hand....
Haven Antiquity#001.dst: Eu poderia te contar, mas acho que vai ser melhor viver isso em primeira mão....
Haven Antiquity#001.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#002.src: I can not cast the spell without the [{~} Umbral Essences] I asked for.
Haven Antiquity#002.dst: Não posso lançar o feitiço sem [{~} Umbral Essences] que pedi.
Haven Antiquity#002.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#005.src: If you die in the memory, you die in reality too.... Best of luck....
Haven Antiquity#005.dst: Se morrer na memória, morre na realidade também.... Boa sorte....

Haven Antiquity#006.src: Please go check out that egg. I am very worried about its behavior. Don't forget the [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#006.dst: Por favor, vá ver aquele ovo. Estou muito preocupado com ele. Não esqueça [{~} Monster Hides] como prova.

Haven Antiquity#007.src: Thank you for your work! I will be returning home. Perhaps we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#007.dst: Obrigada pelo trabalho! Vou voltar para casa. Quem sabe nos vemos de novo!

Haven Antiquity#008.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#008.dst: Fale com {p} nas docas de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#009.src: Hey there adventurer, can I speak with you for a second? I need you to do a spot of detective work for me.
Haven Antiquity#009.dst: Olá, aventureiro, posso falar com você um instante? Preciso que faça um trabalhinho de detetive pra mim.
Haven Antiquity#009.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#010.src: My grandfather once told me how beautiful this place was, and how to visit here if I wanted to relax.
Haven Antiquity#010.dst: Meu avô me contou como este lugar era lindo, e que eu viesse aqui se quisesse relaxar.
Haven Antiquity#010.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#011.src: But as you can see, this island is the least bit relaxing. It is a sorrowful place, corrupted and dark.
Haven Antiquity#011.dst: Mas como você vê, esta ilha não tem nada de relaxante. É um lugar triste, corrompido e sombrio.
Haven Antiquity#011.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#012.src: This can't be right. My grandfather was an honest man, he wouldn't have lied.
Haven Antiquity#012.dst: Não pode ser. Meu avô era um homem honesto, ele não teria mentido.
Haven Antiquity#012.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#013.src: I figure something must have happened. I really want to know how it got like this.
Haven Antiquity#013.dst: Algo deve ter acontecido. Quero muito saber como ficou assim.
Haven Antiquity#013.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#014.src: There's an old creepy man living up on that hill in a big mansion who seems just old enough to know what happened. It might be a good place to start.
Haven Antiquity#014.dst: Tem um velho esquisito morando numa mansão grande naquela colina, velho o bastante para saber o que houve. Pode ser um bom começo.
Haven Antiquity#014.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#015.src: Investigate Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#015.dst: Investigue o velho Siwel na mansão morta em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#016.src: What do you want? I'm busy. Brewing potions takes focus, you know....
Haven Antiquity#016.dst: O que quer? Estou ocupado. Preparar poções exige foco, sabe....
Haven Antiquity#016.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#017.src: Oh, you want to know about the island's history? Well you certainly came to the right man. I've lived here for a very long time.
Haven Antiquity#017.dst: Ah, quer saber da história da ilha? Pois veio ao homem certo. Moro aqui há muito tempo.
Haven Antiquity#017.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#018.src: There is a way for you to see for yourself what happened here. It's quite... an interesting tale, too.
Haven Antiquity#018.dst: Há um jeito de você ver com os próprios olhos o que houve aqui. É uma história... bem interessante.
Haven Antiquity#018.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#019.src: Using some of the more... frowned upon methods in the alchemists library I am able to send you into the 'memory' of a dead person that lived here at the time.
Haven Antiquity#019.dst: Com uns métodos... malvistos da biblioteca alquímica, posso te mandar para a 'memória' de um morto que viveu aqui na época.
Haven Antiquity#019.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#020.src: It will require a little work from you though, if you wish to proceed....
Haven Antiquity#020.dst: Mas vai exigir um pouco de trabalho seu, se quiser continuar....
Haven Antiquity#020.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#021.src: Bring me [{~} Umbral Essences] and I will be able to cast a spell on you which will allow you to pass into the 'memory' of the deceased.
Haven Antiquity#021.dst: Traga [{~} Umbral Essences] e poderei lançar em você um feitiço que te deixará entrar na 'memória' do falecido.
Haven Antiquity#021.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#022.src: Acquire [{~} Umbral Essences] for Old Siwel
Haven Antiquity#022.dst: Consiga [{~} Umbral Essences] para o velho Siwel

Haven Antiquity#023.src: Excellent. You acquired the ingredients. Just give me a second and I'll prepare you for your journey into the mind of the dead.
Haven Antiquity#023.dst: Excelente. Conseguiu os ingredientes. Um momento e vou te preparar para a jornada à mente dos mortos.
Haven Antiquity#023.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#024.src: There, look into my eyes. Yes, you're ready. Ah, there is a drawback though....
Haven Antiquity#024.dst: Pronto, olhe nos meus olhos. Sim, está pronto. Ah, mas há um porém....
Haven Antiquity#024.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#025.src: Once you are inside the memory, it will feel like you are actually there. You won't be able to return until you have succeeded in your task.
Haven Antiquity#025.dst: Dentro da memória, vai parecer que você está lá de verdade. Não poderá voltar até cumprir sua tarefa.
Haven Antiquity#025.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#026.src: To enter the memory, you need to find the dead man at the end of the crypt in the graveyard.
Haven Antiquity#026.dst: Para entrar na memória, encontre o morto no fim da cripta do cemitério.
Haven Antiquity#026.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#027.src: The dead roam those caves in heavy numbers, so watch your step.
Haven Antiquity#027.dst: Os mortos vagam em bando por essas cavernas, então cuidado.
Haven Antiquity#027.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#028.src: Oh and one more thing, If you die in the memory, you die in reality too....
Haven Antiquity#028.dst: Ah, e mais uma coisa: se morrer na memória, morre na realidade também....
Haven Antiquity#028.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#030.src: Locate the Crypt under the church at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and pass through a dead man's memory
Haven Antiquity#030.dst: Encontre a cripta sob a igreja em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e atravesse a memória de um morto

Haven Antiquity#031.src: Investigate Siwel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] on Alive Island
Haven Antiquity#031.dst: Investigue Siwel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] na Ilha dos Vivos

Haven Antiquity#032.src: Oh, hello there. Would you mind helping me with something for a second?
Haven Antiquity#032.dst: Ah, olá. Pode me ajudar com uma coisa rapidinho?
Haven Antiquity#032.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#033.src: Recently, some strange things have been happening to the miners around here. New diseases, unexplained disappearances, and things like that.
Haven Antiquity#033.dst: Ultimamente, coisas estranhas andam acontecendo com os mineiros daqui. Doenças novas, sumiços sem explicação e coisas assim.
Haven Antiquity#033.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#034.src: The villagers have been getting very worried. So, in an attempt to protect the island, I bought a strange egg and placed it in a cave close to town.
Haven Antiquity#034.dst: Os aldeões estão muito preocupados. Então, para proteger a ilha, comprei um ovo estranho e coloquei numa caverna perto da vila.
Haven Antiquity#034.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#035.src: The egg, however, isn't what I thought it was. It is producing monsters and giving off some sort of dark aura.
Haven Antiquity#035.dst: Mas o ovo não é o que eu pensava. Ele está gerando monstros e soltando uma espécie de aura sombria.
Haven Antiquity#035.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#036.src: I want you to go check out that egg. See if you can get rid of whatever it is producing. Bring me [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#036.dst: Quero que vá ver aquele ovo. Veja se consegue se livrar do que ele está gerando. Traga [{~} Monster Hides] como prova.
Haven Antiquity#036.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#037.src: Confront the cave under the mansion at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and retrieve [{~} Monster Hides] for Siwel from the monsters within
Haven Antiquity#037.dst: Enfrente a caverna sob a mansão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e consiga [{~} Monster Hides] dos monstros lá dentro para Siwel

Haven Antiquity#038.src: You're back! Were you able to stop that egg?
Haven Antiquity#038.dst: Você voltou! Conseguiu deter aquele ovo?
Haven Antiquity#038.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#039.src: No? Well, I guess we'll have to wait and see what it hatches into.
Haven Antiquity#039.dst: Não? Bem, acho que teremos que esperar para ver o que sai dele.
Haven Antiquity#039.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#040.src: I see you got some rather rare dark monster hide. Maybe I could use those in a potion for something, maybe to prolong life.
Haven Antiquity#040.dst: Vejo que trouxe um couro de monstro sombrio bem raro. Talvez eu use numa poção para algo, talvez prolongar a vida.
Haven Antiquity#040.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#041.src: Some of the villagers believe that it is unwise for myself to dabble in the dark arts, dealing with mysterious eggs and brewing potions of death.
Haven Antiquity#041.dst: Alguns aldeões acham imprudente eu mexer com artes sombrias, lidar com ovos misteriosos e preparar poções de morte.
Haven Antiquity#041.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#042.src: I'll outlive them all, you'll see!
Haven Antiquity#042.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#043.src: As for you, you have done what I asked. You may return to your personal affairs now.
Haven Antiquity#043.dst: Quanto a você, fez o que pedi. Pode voltar aos seus assuntos agora.
Haven Antiquity#043.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#044.src: Thank you for your work, though. Only time will tell what that egg will hatch into.
Haven Antiquity#044.dst: Mas obrigado pelo trabalho. Só o tempo dirá o que vai sair daquele ovo.
Haven Antiquity#044.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#045.src: Return to Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#045.dst: Volte ao velho Siwel na mansão morta em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#046.src: What? You... you made it back? Oh... Very well. Alchemy can be a... dangerous practice.
Haven Antiquity#046.dst: O quê? Você... você voltou? Ah... Muito bem. A alquimia pode ser... um ofício perigoso.
Haven Antiquity#046.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#047.src: Anyone who tried to find out the island's history came to me at some point, and I sent them on a one way street to a memory. But not you....
Haven Antiquity#047.dst: Todos que tentaram descobrir a história da ilha vieram a mim, e eu os mandei sem volta para uma memória. Mas não você....
Haven Antiquity#047.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#048.src: So now you know my dreadful secret, I am racked with guilt and cursed with eternal life.
Haven Antiquity#048.dst: Então agora sabe meu terrível segredo: a culpa me consome e a vida eterna me amaldiçoa.
Haven Antiquity#048.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#049.src: There is no need to fight me, I am suffering enough for what I... wrought on this island.
Haven Antiquity#049.dst: Não precisa lutar comigo, já sofro o bastante pelo que... causei nesta ilha.
Haven Antiquity#049.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#050.src: I could not destroy the egg. It hatched into a... monstrous beast that cursed this island until this very day.
Haven Antiquity#050.dst: Não consegui destruir o ovo. Dele nasceu uma... fera monstruosa que amaldiçoou esta ilha até hoje.
Haven Antiquity#050.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#051.src: A powerful warrior from... {p} slew the beast, yet the island did not rejuvenate....
Haven Antiquity#051.dst: Um guerreiro poderoso de... {p} matou a fera, mas a ilha não se recuperou....
Haven Antiquity#051.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#052.src: I leave the bones of the beast as a reminder of my failure, the destruction it brought still... lingers in the monsters it left behind.
Haven Antiquity#052.dst: Deixo os ossos da fera como lembrete do meu fracasso; a destruição que ela trouxe ainda... vive nos monstros que deixou.
Haven Antiquity#052.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#053.src: So adventurer, now you have the knowledge of what I have done. You may tell the others down in the village, as it is no longer a secret.
Haven Antiquity#053.dst: Pois bem, aventureiro, agora sabe o que fiz. Pode contar aos outros lá na vila, pois já não é segredo.
Haven Antiquity#053.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#054.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about the mystery
Haven Antiquity#054.dst: Fale com {p} nas docas em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] sobre o mistério

Haven Antiquity#055.src: So, did you find out what happened?
Haven Antiquity#055.dst: E aí, descobriu o que aconteceu?
Haven Antiquity#055.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#056.src: Siwel was the one who caused this sorrow? He does have a very dark presence about him, doesn't he?
Haven Antiquity#056.dst: Siwel foi quem causou essa tristeza? Ele tem mesmo uma presença bem sombria, não é?
Haven Antiquity#056.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#057.src: Thank you for your work! I know it must have been tough getting that out of him.
Haven Antiquity#057.dst: Obrigada pelo trabalho! Sei que deve ter sido difícil arrancar isso dele.
Haven Antiquity#057.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#058.src: Now that this mystery is solved I will be returning home. I hope we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#058.dst: Agora que o mistério foi resolvido, volto pra casa. Espero que nos vejamos de novo!
Haven Antiquity#058.speaker: Cinfras

Heart of Llevigar#000.src: Were you bein' literal when you said there was a bug in the system? I swear I hear something crawling around down here all of the sudden.
Heart of Llevigar#000.dst: Era sério quando disse que tinha um bicho no sistema? Juro que de repente estou ouvindo algo rastejando aqui embaixo.

Heart of Llevigar#001.src: Oh, that experience gave me gray hairs... I sincerely hope there won't ever be bugs in the system like that for the rest of my life.
Heart of Llevigar#001.dst: Ah, essa experiência me deu cabelos brancos... Espero mesmo que nunca mais apareçam bichos assim no sistema enquanto eu viver.

Heart of Llevigar#002.src: Gweh, a visitor?! Get out of here! The plant is shut down for maintenance- wait, are you the electromagic expert we're paying for?
Heart of Llevigar#002.dst: Gweh, visita?! Fora daqui! A usina está parada para manutenção- espera, você é o especialista em eletromagia que estamos pagando?
Heart of Llevigar#002.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#003.src: We didn't even need to get Corkian consultation on this! We had this system all figured out ourselves, but now nothing's working right!
Heart of Llevigar#003.dst: Nem precisamos de consultoria Corkian nisso! Montamos o sistema todo sozinhos, mas agora nada funciona direito!
Heart of Llevigar#003.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#004.dst: Nova missão iniciada: O coração de {p}

Heart of Llevigar#005.src: Come on now, hurry! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer already!
Heart of Llevigar#005.dst: Vamos, rápido! Tem uma entrada da usina em frente ao banco, vá lá e fale logo com o Engenheiro-chefe!

Heart of Llevigar#006.src: My grandfather and his engineers jury-rigged this whole system. A reset should fix all this, but as a security measure, I need to be here to oversee the reset.
Heart of Llevigar#006.dst: Meu avô e seus engenheiros improvisaram este sistema todo. Um reinício deve resolver, mas por segurança preciso estar aqui para supervisionar.
Heart of Llevigar#006.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#007.src: I have to stay put here, so get through the system and find the reset button for me. These holes in the walls are tunnels that'll lead you around the generator rooms!
Heart of Llevigar#007.dst: Tenho que ficar aqui, então atravesse o sistema e ache o botão de reinício pra mim. Esses buracos nas paredes são túneis pelas salas dos geradores!

Heart of Llevigar#008.src: Maybe you can find a way to reset the system. That ought to do it...
Heart of Llevigar#008.dst: Talvez você ache um jeito de reiniciar o sistema. Deve resolver...

Heart of Llevigar#009.src: ...what, are you asleep or something? Of course there was a bug, we just fixed it!
Heart of Llevigar#009.dst: ...o quê, você está dormindo? Claro que tinha um bug, acabamos de consertar!

Heart of Llevigar#010.src: D'you really care about getting his name right, or what? Anyways, the exit's through the water cooling system back the way you got here, it hooks up to the sewer exit.
Heart of Llevigar#010.dst: Você liga mesmo pro nome certo dele? Enfim, a saída é pelo sistema de refrigeração a água, por onde você veio; dá na saída do esgoto.

Heart of Llevigar#011.src: Glad you got here when you did though! Some phony came through saying he was the expert. Clearly, he was just here to take your contract money...
Heart of Llevigar#011.dst: Que bom que chegou a tempo! Um farsante apareceu dizendo que era o especialista. Claramente só queria pegar o dinheiro do seu contrato...
Heart of Llevigar#011.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#012.src: Find Zenam in the {p} power control center at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Heart of Llevigar#012.dst: Encontre Zenam no centro de controle de energia de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Heart of Llevigar#013.src: Aaah, no no no! This doesn't make any sense, what in the world is going on?! Nothing's working!
Heart of Llevigar#013.dst: Aaah, não não não! Isso não faz sentido, o que diabos está acontecendo?! Nada funciona!
Heart of Llevigar#013.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#014.src: You are, right? Right?! Cause we can't wait any longer! This system was supposed to be unbreakable, a flawless design!
Heart of Llevigar#014.dst: Você é, né? Né?! Porque não dá pra esperar mais! Este sistema era pra ser inquebrável, um projeto perfeito!
Heart of Llevigar#014.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#015.src: You're seeing all these sparks and hearing all this crackling? We have no idea what could possibly be going wrong with this! That's why you're needed here!
Heart of Llevigar#015.dst: Está vendo essas faíscas e ouvindo esses estalos? Não fazemos ideia do que pode estar dando errado! Por isso precisamos de você!
Heart of Llevigar#015.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#016.src: We don't have much time until full meltdown! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer!
Heart of Llevigar#016.dst: Falta pouco para o colapso total! Tem uma entrada da usina em frente ao banco, vá lá e fale com o Engenheiro-chefe!
Heart of Llevigar#016.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#017.src: Enter the sewers opposite of the bank of {p}.
Heart of Llevigar#017.dst: Entre no esgoto em frente ao banco de {p}.

Heart of Llevigar#018.src: Find the head engineer at the {p} power plant
Heart of Llevigar#018.dst: Encontre o engenheiro-chefe na usina de {p}

Heart of Llevigar#019.src: Whew, finally Zeman found a guy for the job. I told him weeks ago this was a two-person task...
Heart of Llevigar#019.dst: Ufa, enfim o Zeman achou alguém pro serviço. Falei semanas atrás que era tarefa pra dois...
Heart of Llevigar#019.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#021.src: Wait, it's Zenam? Eh, what does it matter? You knew who I was talkin' about. Lemme give you the lowdown real fast.
Heart of Llevigar#021.dst: Espera, é Zenam? Ah, que diferença faz? Você sabia de quem eu falava. Deixa eu te pôr a par bem rápido.
Heart of Llevigar#021.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#022.src: About a month ago, there was a big blackout, and the generator here started acting up. Power surges, appliances overloading...heck, some of our lights turned purple!
Heart of Llevigar#022.dst: Um mês atrás houve um apagão enorme e o gerador começou a dar pane. Picos de energia, aparelhos sobrecarregando...até umas luzes ficaram roxas!
Heart of Llevigar#022.speaker: Head Engineer
