Hollow Serenity#345.dst: Eileen... É uma estrela brilhante neste mundo. O sangue nobre e o talento natural a tornam algo realmente especial.
Hollow Serenity#345.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#346.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#346.dst: ...Perdoe-me, e-estou divagando de novo. Eu... preciso ir, a pesquisa chama. Adeus, meu amor. Grandes coisas vão acontecer, cedo ou tarde.
Hollow Serenity#346.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#348.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#348.dst: Vá até o antigo posto de pesquisa de Garvan em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#349.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.
Hollow Serenity#349.dst: Reúna o máximo de provas que puder no posto de pesquisa.

Hollow Serenity#351.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#351.dst: Shhhh... Isso só vai levar um instante.
Hollow Serenity#351.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#352.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#352.dst: O-o que é aquela coisa?? S-senhor Garvan, e-eu não entendo...
Hollow Serenity#352.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#353.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#353.dst: Quieta, minha filha. E-estou fazendo isso pelo s-seu bem... Vai me a-agradecer depois, quando... ele se a-adaptar.
Hollow Serenity#353.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#355.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#355.dst: Você... G-Garvan... O que faz aqui? E o que houve com a Eileen? Ela está doente há dias!
Hollow Serenity#355.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#356.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#356.dst: Mmmm... Eu... T-t-tenho uma espécie de... como dizer... uma confissão a fazer.
Hollow Serenity#356.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#357.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#357.dst: Não, não não não não. Fiz algo m-m-muito melhor. Ela tem algo agora. No cérebro... Não ligue pro e-estado lastimável dela. O parasita precisa de tempo pra se adaptar à carne dela.
Hollow Serenity#357.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#358.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#358.dst: E-eu descobri... a cura. Meu trabalho acabou, amor... Eileen vai sarar. A Decadência pode parar. É maravilho-
Hollow Serenity#358.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#359.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#359.dst: O QUE VOCÊ FEZ COM MINHA FILHA?? O QUE HÁ DE ERRADO COM VOCÊ??
Hollow Serenity#359.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#360.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#360.dst: Aaaahhhmmmm... É... Talvez eu tenha passado dos limites. Mas é para o melhor.
Hollow Serenity#360.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#361.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#361.dst: DOS LIMITES?? Isso é demais, Garvan! O que aconteceu com você?? Você age assim há tanto, tanto tempo! E-eu não aguento mais!
Hollow Serenity#361.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#362.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#362.dst: Você mudou, Garvan! E-eu nem te reconheço mais!! Pra mim... pra mim CHEGA! FORA! FIQUE LONGE DA MINHA FAMÍLIA!
Hollow Serenity#362.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#363.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#363.dst: Vocês de novo... O-o que querem de mim desta vez...? Vocês... já me destruíram.
Hollow Serenity#363.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#364.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#364.dst: Diga, Garvan... Onde está a herdeira?
Hollow Serenity#364.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#365.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#365.dst: Eu... não vou dizer. Perdi Eileen e meu amor por causa de vocês. Se eu tenho que perdê-la... vocês vão perdê-la também.
Hollow Serenity#365.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#366.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#366.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#368.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#368.dst: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. Acho que há um mal-entendido. Você não está em posição de nos desafiar.
Hollow Serenity#368.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#369.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#369.dst: Volte à mansão e procure pistas do paradeiro de Eileen em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#370.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.
Hollow Serenity#370.dst: Parece que você chegou. P-perdão... E-eu já não estou acostumado a falar. Faz bastante tempo.

Hollow Serenity#371.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?
Hollow Serenity#371.dst: ...Esqueça. N-não quero o seu perdão em particular. Aliás, p-por que você se importa? A floresta morreu, gerações vieram e foram... e mesmo assim... Você tinha que reabrir a cicatriz, não é?

Hollow Serenity#372.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#372.dst: Saudações... T-tenho c-certeza de que você já me conhece bem. F-fui eu o tempo todo. Que- bem, acho que foi uma reviravolta previsível...
Hollow Serenity#372.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#373.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#373.dst: ...M-mas... imagino que não saiba a história toda. Então... então então então então... Deixe-me explicar, humano... O fim amargo da nossa história.
Hollow Serenity#373.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#374.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#374.dst: E-ela... está com a mãe. Na mansão Faltach. É-é só isso. Só p-parem...
Hollow Serenity#374.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#376.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#376.dst: N-NÃO! VOLTEM AQUI! NÃO SE ATREVAM A FERI-LAS! EU MATO VOCÊS!! ESTÃO OUVINDO???
Hollow Serenity#376.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#378.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#378.dst: ...Como é? Não. NÃO VÃO TOCAR NELA! SAIAM DA MINHA FRENTE-
Hollow Serenity#378.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#379.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#379.dst: Não é a senhora quem faz exigências aqui... Vocês, revistem a casa e achem a criança.
Hollow Serenity#379.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#380.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#380.dst: Ali está ela. Hmm... parece que a injeção do parasita funcionou bem. Garvan não era tão inútil, afinal.
Hollow Serenity#380.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#381.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#381.dst: Hã? Assustada demais pra falar? Calma, Eileen Faltach. Não vamos te machucar... muito. Você é bem importante pra nós, sabe.
Hollow Serenity#381.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#382.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#382.dst: N-NÃO! FIQUEM LONGE DA MINHA FILHA!
Hollow Serenity#382.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#383.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#383.dst: A senhora não tem muita escolha, senhora Faltach. Não se mexa.
Hollow Serenity#383.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#384.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#384.dst: Tch... Tem gente que nunca vai entender o que fazemos pelo mundo. Obrigado por nos proteger dela, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#384.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#385.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#385.dst: Eu mesmo cuido da herdeira. Vocês podem voltar à nossa vila. Obrigado pela ajuda hoje.
Hollow Serenity#385.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#386.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#386.dst: I-isto vai bastar. Você tem um túmulo lindo, m-meu amor...
Hollow Serenity#386.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#387.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#387.dst: M-mas não seremos separados. V-vou deixar nosso verdadeiro eu aqui também.
Hollow Serenity#387.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#389.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#389.dst: E-este é nosso último ato de amor, K-Katarin... Esta pedra vai nos manter aqui. Eternos, felizes.
Hollow Serenity#389.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#390.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#390.dst: É-é como se nada tivesse a-acontecido, não é?
Hollow Serenity#390.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#392.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#392.dst: A-agora você entende. I-isso é... tudo culpa minha. Arruinei tudo. T-tudo o que toquei, destruí.
Hollow Serenity#392.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#393.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#393.dst: Não... Você sabe demais. M-mas não posso matar, não de novo. P-posso consertar as coisas. V-vou consertar isso. Vou consertar isso. Vou vou vou vou vou...
Hollow Serenity#393.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#394.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#394.dst: Vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou vou-
Hollow Serenity#394.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#396.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#396.dst: Vá até o quarto principal em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#397.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#397.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#398.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#398.dst: Minha nossa... É-é você! Senti sua falta, amor... e sinto m-muito... por tudo isso!
Hollow Serenity#398.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#399.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#399.dst: Percebo a-agora, graças ao esforço deste h-humano. O que fiz nos s-separou... Machuquei tanto você e nossa m-menininha...
Hollow Serenity#399.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#400.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#400.dst: S-sinto muito, Katarin! P-por favor, me perdoe! Vamos c-consertar tudo-
Hollow Serenity#400.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#404.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#404.dst: O quê... O que quer dizer?? Fale, meu amor! Não entendo.
Hollow Serenity#404.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#405.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#405.dst: ...Perdão...? Você... implora... que eu... te perdoe?
Hollow Serenity#405.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#406.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#406.dst: Foi tudo culpa minha, desde o início! Eu errei! P-podemos consertar isso...! Podemos fazer tudo voltar ao normal, e-exatamente como era antes!
Hollow Serenity#406.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#407.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#407.dst: Por favor, Katarin! S-só peço que me perdoe!
Hollow Serenity#407.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#408.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
Hollow Serenity#408.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#409.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#409.dst: ...Talvez eu possa... Perdoar isso. Mas também preciso de algo seu...
Hollow Serenity#409.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#410.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#410.dst: ...Onde está a gema? Eu... eu queria saber. E então... eu poderia... perdoar... isso.
Hollow Serenity#410.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#411.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#411.dst: A-ah! Só isso? Claro, meu amor, eu te conto!
Hollow Serenity#411.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#412.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#412.dst: O-o quê... O-O QUE É ISSOO?? N-NÃO C-CONSIGO RESPIRAR! P-POR FAVOR!!
Hollow Serenity#412.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#416.src: Head to the Manor's catacombs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#416.dst: Vá às catacumbas da mansão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#418.src: TELL ME WHERE IT IS, GARVAN! I KNOW YOU'RE STILL LISTENING!
Hollow Serenity#418.dst: ME DIGA ONDE ESTÁ, GARVAN! SEI QUE AINDA ESTÁ OUVINDO!
Hollow Serenity#418.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#419.src: Right, a human. You knew... that it was just beneath this rubble?
Hollow Serenity#419.dst: Certo, um humano. Você sabia... que estava sob os escombros?
Hollow Serenity#419.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#420.src: There it is... Thank you... Now this eternal hell will finally end. After so long...
Hollow Serenity#420.dst: Aí está... Obrigada... Enfim este inferno eterno vai acabar. Depois de tanto tempo.
Hollow Serenity#420.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#424.src: He's gone... All of this will finally be done...
Hollow Serenity#424.dst: Ele se foi... Tudo isso enfim vai acabar...
Hollow Serenity#424.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#425.src: Thank you, stranger. Thank you for... everything.
Hollow Serenity#425.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#426.src: ...What has become of my daughter, Eileen? Has she suffered any more? Or did she escape?
Hollow Serenity#426.dst: ...O que foi da minha filha, Eileen? Ela sofreu mais? Ou escapou?
Hollow Serenity#426.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#427.src: I must know. Is she okay?
Hollow Serenity#427.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#429.src: ...I see. That is... wonderful news. Thank you, human.
Hollow Serenity#429.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#431.src: ...The pain is receding... The heavens are calling... for the final time...
Hollow Serenity#431.dst: ...A dor está passando... Os céus chamam... pela última vez...
Hollow Serenity#431.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#432.src: Goodbye... Thank you human, from the bottom of my heart.
Hollow Serenity#432.dst: Adeus... Obrigada, humano, do fundo do coração.
Hollow Serenity#432.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#435.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO NO NOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#435.dst: NÃO NÃO NÃO NÃO NÃO NÃO NÃOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#435.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#436.src: TRAITOR!! I WILL MAKE YOU ALL SUFFFEEERRRR!!! (In High Gavellian)
Hollow Serenity#436.dst: TRAIDOR!! VOU FAZER TODOS SOFREEEREEEM!!! (Em alto gavelliano)
Hollow Serenity#436.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#437.src: Bury Garvan's body in Katarin's incomplete grave.
Hollow Serenity#437.dst: Enterre o corpo de Garvan no túmulo inacabado de Katarin.

Hollow Serenity#438.src: That was incorrect... It looks like you need to start over again.
Hollow Serenity#438.dst: Errado... Parece que você vai ter que recomeçar.

Hollow Serenity#439.src: You see a few books regarding the histories of {p} and {p}, but not much else noteworthy.
Hollow Serenity#439.dst: Você vê alguns livros sobre a história de {p} e {p}, mas nada além digno de nota.

Hollow Serenity#440.src: This bookshelf sure seems like an an interesting one! You find books of various kind.
Hollow Serenity#440.dst: Esta estante parece mesmo interessante! Você acha livros de todo tipo.

Hollow Serenity#441.src: There's one about the ancient tales of Gylia, another regarding Remikas' victory... and even a book about dreaming?
Hollow Serenity#441.dst: Um sobre as lendas antigas de Gylia, outro sobre a vitória de Remikas... e até um livro sobre sonhar?

Hollow Serenity#442.src: A bunch of notes are scribbled on all of them.
Hollow Serenity#442.dst: Há um monte de anotações rabiscadas em todos.

Hollow Serenity#443.src: How many bookshelves does this manor have!?

Hollow Serenity#446.src: I've been trying to expose this piece of Kanderstone to different types of magical energy to see if I could reverse the effects of this Decay upon it.
Hollow Serenity#446.dst: Tenho exposto este pedaço de Kanderstone a vários tipos de energia mágica para ver se reverto os efeitos da Decadência nele.

Hollow Serenity#447.src: If I can just find whatever energy the Decay is sapping from the forests, then in all probability... this Kanderstone will revert to Cobalt, the mineral that was found in this forest before it began its decline.
Hollow Serenity#447.dst: Se eu achar a energia que a Decadência está drenando das florestas, então com toda a probabilidade... este Kanderstone voltará a ser cobalto, o mineral que havia nesta floresta antes do declínio.

Hollow Serenity#448.src: ...What could it be, though? I've tried every sort of magic I can think of. Nothing is reversing the effects of the Decay.
Hollow Serenity#448.dst: ...Mas o que pode ser? Já tentei todo tipo de magia que conheço. Nada reverte os efeitos da Decadência.

Hollow Serenity#449.src: I'm certain of it. The Decay is caused by the removal of magical energy. I just can't pinpoint what exactly, though...
Hollow Serenity#449.dst: Tenho certeza. A Decadência é causada pela retirada de energia mágica. Só não consigo identificar qual...

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.src: You should put the mask on before you leave.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.dst: Você deveria pôr a máscara antes de sair.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.src: Oh, ho ho. A human? What brings you to Gylia Watch - want to let your hair down a bit, I bet!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.dst: Oh, ho ho. Um humano? O que te traz à Guarda de Gylia - relaxar um pouco, aposto!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.src: Of course you know who we are! The Gylia Watch was founded over {~} years ago in wake of the Villager victory in the war.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.dst: Claro que sabe quem somos! A Guarda de Gylia foi fundada há mais de {~} anos, após a vitória dos aldeões na guerra.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.src: The Gerten war! Only the most famous war in all of modern Gavel! The might of the Villagers crushed those blasted Gerts - not that they were particuarly hard to beat, heh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.dst: A Guerra Gerten! Só a guerra mais famosa de todo o Gavel moderno! A força dos aldeões esmagou aqueles malditos Gerts - não que fossem difíceis de vencer, hehe.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.src: Gerts are stupid brutes, you see. The only thing they ever think about is food.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.dst: Gerts são uns brutos burros, sabe. Só pensam em comida.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.src: Get too close to one and it'll chomp your fingers off, quick as you like. And then the rest of you as well!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.dst: Chegue perto de um e ele arranca seus dedos numa mordida, rapidinho. E depois o resto de você!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: O tratado de paz os mantém dentro das fronteiras, e todo mês recebemos de {p} suprimentos pra mandar a eles.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: Claro, temos que guardar um pouco pra nós - você viu como esses homens trabalham, merecem uma festinha!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: A Guarda vigia as fronteiras gerten dia e noite... bem, talvez não nas noites de pôquer!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: Although... we have heard a couple nasty rumours floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: Mas... ouvimos uns boatos feios por aí - fazendeiros sumindo de casa e coisas assim.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: Se não consigo te tentar com uma taça de vinho e uma partida de pôquer, quem sabe você vai checar isso pra nós?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: Eu mandaria os homens, mas... bem, ficaria chateado se um deles perdesse a festa!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.dst: Olha, vá falar com Jitak, um dos fazendeiros que fizeram queixa. A casa fica a oeste daqui, vou anotar as coordenadas.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: Se está procurando um terno ou algo assim, não posso ajudar. Agora é péssima hora.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: Ah, você veio pela Guarda? Ha, nem mandar humanos fazer o serviço deles eles acham indigno.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: Só ficam naquela torre jogando jogos de bebida e agindo como se fossem donos da região!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me. Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: Avisei que tem claramente um acampamento gert bem na frente da minha casa e me ignoraram. Agora olha, meus porcos sumiram!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: Well, that explains how the Gerts were able to get to the pigs. You should head back to Jitak.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: Bem, isso explica como os Gerts chegaram aos porcos. Você deveria voltar ao Jitak.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: Eu sabia que era erro comprar esta terra tão perto das fronteiras gerten. Veja, gerts não são os 'brutos' que dizem, mas...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: Bem, eles comem de tudo! Animais, peixes, monstros, aldeões, até humanos! Biologicamente, vivem com fome.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: A Guarda devia mantê-los atrás das fronteiras...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: Até comprei um golem pra vigiá-los - Saiu barato por causa de um incidente na fábrica de {p}.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: Mas os gerts estão dando um jeito de evitá-lo! Olha, se você vem da Guarda, pode me ajudar?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.dst: Vá ao acampamento gert a oeste daqui e descubra como fazem tudo isso!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.dst: Inspecione o acampamento avançado gerten em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.dst: Investigue a caverna no fundo do acampamento em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: Looks like the Gerten chiefs are having a meeting, you shouldn't get too close... maybe there's somewhere nearby you can eavesdrop from?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: Parece que os chefes gerten estão em reunião, não chegue perto demais... talvez haja um lugar ali perto pra ouvir escondido?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: -Bom trabalho todos! Orgulho dizer: fizemos estrada de caverna muito bem.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: Povo da vila de Gylia rouba coisa nossa pra festa deles, e deixa a gente sem nada!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.dst: Mas povo burro e gordo da vila não pegou a gente cavando estrada bem embaixo da casa de guarda.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.dst: Com caminho novo pra terra Gylia temos mais coisa que nunca!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: Humano! Você voltou... e não foi comido por um Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Um túnel?! Além das fronteiras gerten? Deve ser assim que entram e roubam meus animais.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: Olha, humano. A Guarda não vai fazer nada. Por favor... talvez você possa me ajudar.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: Se você se disfarçar de Gert, talvez consiga entrar escondido no acampamento principal e ver esse túnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.dst: Certo! Como você vê, todo Gert usa uma abóbora entalhada na cabeça - coisa da cultura deles.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.dst: Há uma plantação de abóboras aqui perto, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... quem sabe você pega uma lá?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~},-{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: Há uma plantação de abóboras aqui perto, em [-{~},-{~}]... quem sabe você pega uma lá?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.dst: Vá à plantação de abóboras gerten em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: Que bom, mandaram você pra ser meu almoço?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: The gert is looking at you hungrily... it might be best to leave the conversation?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: O gert olha para você com fome... talvez seja melhor sair da conversa?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: Ah. Então o que você é, um petisco?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: ... É piada? O que você é, algum tipo de petisco?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: Um hu.. mano? Ah, quer dizer gente nova! Aqui nas terras gerten? Nunca vi um de vocês por aqui.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: The gert has a strange look in his eyes and is inching towards you suspiciously...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.dst: O gert está com um olhar estranho e chega perto de você aos poucos, desconfiado...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: Fazendo? Guardo a plantação de cabaças laranjas, é claro!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.dst: É desta plantação que os gerts tiram sua máscara do dia!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: Não, gente nova. Aqui só gerts.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: Por isso me puseram aqui. Pra ninguém entrar.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.dst: Mas mas fico tão entediado... e quero muito comer...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.src: Request from the Customs Clerk: To whomever it may concern, there has recently been an increase in damaged goods from outside the Capital. When questioned, various artisans admit having been attacked by ferocious beasts.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#001.dst: Pedido do agente da alfândega: A quem possa interessar, houve um aumento recente de mercadorias danificadas vindas de fora da Capital. Questionados, vários artesãos admitem ter sido atacados por feras selvagens.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.src: Woolly Rhinos seem to match the description, and they are indeed creatures not to be tempered with. I am unsure what causes them such unrest. Perhaps they feel a change in the environment, but it matters not.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#002.dst: Os rinocerontes-lanudos batem com a descrição, e são mesmo criaturas com que não se deve mexer. Não sei o que os deixa tão agitados. Talvez sintam uma mudança no ambiente, mas isso não importa.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.src: What matters is that more and more goods are being damaged, causing delays in the monitoring of what goes in and out of the Capital. If someone could hunt at least {~} Woolly Rhinos, it would be of assistance to us all.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#003.dst: O que importa é que cada vez mais mercadorias são danificadas, atrasando o controle do que entra e sai da Capital. Se alguém caçasse ao menos {~} rinocerontes-lanudos, ajudaria a todos nós.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.src: There are reports of two of them having been spotted nearby House Thalas and House Nasin. I have set up a carriage next to this board if you wish to go there.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#004.dst: Há relatos de dois avistados perto da Casa Thalas e da Casa Nasin. Deixei uma carruagem ao lado deste quadro, se quiser ir até lá.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.src: Additionally, a friend of mine has also seen one to the north of {p}, quite close to the town itself. Please return to this post once you are done. As mentioned, they are very resilient. Be sure to brace yourself.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#005.dst: Além disso, um amigo meu viu um ao norte de {p}, bem perto da cidade. Volte a este quadro quando terminar. Como eu disse, são muito resistentes. Prepare-se bem.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.src: You've hunted enough of those beasts. You should return to the Slaying Post to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#006.dst: Você já caçou o bastante dessas feras. Volte ao quadro de caça para pegar sua recompensa.

Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.src: Return to the Slaying Post at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to collect your reward.
Hunt Woolly Rhinos#007.dst: Volte ao quadro de caça em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para pegar sua recompensa.

Ice Nations#000.src: Thank you again for bringing peace upon our islands.
Ice Nations#000.dst: Obrigado de novo por trazer paz às nossas ilhas.
Ice Nations#000.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#002.src: It's useless to come back to me if you do not have the treasure.
Ice Nations#002.dst: Não adianta voltar a mim sem o tesouro.

Ice Nations#003.src: ...You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#003.dst: ...Veja, nosso naufrágio não foi por causa natural. Fomos atacados...
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Ice Nations#006.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#007.dst: Meu povo e eu chegamos aqui há muitos anos. Infelizmente, nosso navio não resistiu...
Ice Nations#007.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#008.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#008.dst: Tentamos construir uma nação nestas ilhas, mas nos dividimos com os anos.
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#009.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#009.dst: Por isso, travamos uma guerra inútil com nossos vizinhos.
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#010.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#010.dst: Acho que devíamos tentar um tratado de paz, mas tenho medo de ser morto se sair da ilha...
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#011.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#011.dst: Pode nos ajudar? Fale com Hallfred sobre esse tratado. Ele mora em outra ilha de gelo aqui perto.
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#012.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#012.dst: Fale com Hallfred sobre o tratado de paz

Ice Nations#013.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#013.dst: Bem-vindo, viajante! O que te traz à nossa ilha?
Ice Nations#013.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#014.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#014.dst: Ah, vejo que Adigard agora manda estranhos por covardia! Com medo de ser morto?
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#015.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#015.dst: É a última vez que repito: assinaremos o tratado de paz no dia em que Adigard e sua nação nos devolverem... o tesouro.
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#016.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#016.dst: Aquele que guardaram e esconderam de nós após o naufrágio.
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#017.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#017.dst: Ouro puro, muito valioso e raro! Diga a ele que estou esperando. E nada daquela história boba de novo.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#018.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#018.dst: Volte a Adigard e conte a resposta de Hallfred

Ice Nations#019.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#019.dst: Eu devia ter imaginado. Hallfred sempre foi muito ganancioso...
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#020.dst: Tentamos fazê-lo entender que não temos o tesouro, sem muito sucesso.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#021.dst: Por quem? Mortos-vivos. Fantasmas e demônios num navio monstruoso. Nos pegaram de surpresa.
Ice Nations#021.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#022.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#022.dst: Acho que também roubaram nosso tesouro durante o ataque.
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#023.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#023.dst: Ajudaria nossa nação a se unir de novo? Encontre esse navio e leve o tesouro a Hallfred para enfim vivermos em paz.
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#024.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#024.dst: Navegue para o norte. Foi lá que nos atacaram há muitos anos. Deve ser fácil achar, aposto que estão ancorados lá, gloriosos... Obrigado.
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#025.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#025.dst: Encontre o navio fantasma e leve o [Ancient Treasure] a Hallfred

Ice Nations#026.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#026.dst: Incrível! Ele entregou mesmo o tesouro!
Ice Nations#026.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#027.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#027.dst: Acho que isso significa o fim da guerra entre nossas nações!
Ice Nations#027.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#028.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#028.dst: Que grande dia! Tome, aceite isto como prêmio por ajudar nossa nação.
Ice Nations#028.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#029.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#029.dst: Aposto que um dia você vai usar este capacete!
Ice Nations#029.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#030.src: Find the ghost ship by heading north of the {p} and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#030.dst: Encontre o navio fantasma indo ao norte de {p} e leve o [Ancient Treasure] a Hallfred em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Infested Plants#000.src: I'm going to go on ahead. Just follow the coordinates in your content book to find that cave!
Infested Plants#000.dst: Vou na frente. É só seguir as coordenadas do seu livro de conteúdo para achar a caverna!

Infested Plants#001.src: ...mm, cutting it a little close, but... oh! You're, uh, still here...! Right. Right- you have to go into that cave, remember?
Infested Plants#001.dst: ...hm, o tempo está curto, mas... ah! Você, hã, ainda está aqui...! Certo. Certo- tem que entrar naquela caverna, lembra?

Infested Plants#004.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#004.dst: Encontre Tasim na entrada de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#005.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#005.dst: Ah, {u}! Aí está você. Que bom te ver. Pronto para seguir rumo a {p}?
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: E-ei! Vocês dois! São soldados, né? Dá pra ver pelo estilo esquisito. Vocês deviam ajudar as pessoas! Então. Ajudem!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: Hã? Ah- sim, claro! Qual é seu nome? Com o que precisa de ajuda?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: Sou o Ope! Eu fui... hã... picado por uma aranha! Preciso de ajuda pra achar uma erva medicinal rara que me cure!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: Ela só cresce numa caverna infestada de bichos rastejantes. E é claro que não estou em condições de ir lá!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: Tudo bem! Estamos aqui para ajudar, afinal... Vamos pegar essa erva!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#011.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#011.dst: Siga Ope até a caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#012.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#012.dst: Hm... Vocês são dois. Ótimo! Um sobe naquela caverna e o outro me protege das aranhas rastejantes aqui embaixo!
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#013.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#013.dst: Certo! {u}, você entra na caverna e eu defendo o Ope aqui enquanto isso.
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#014.dst: Encontre o remédio na caverna das aranhas atrás de Ope em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.
Infested Plants#015.dst: Saia da caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] com a erva medicinal.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.dst: Aí está você! Parece que esperamos há horas.
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.dst: Na verdade... nem foi tanto tempo. Uns dez minutos, no máximo.
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.dst: Bem-... Enfim! Pegou a erva? É muito- hã, importante! Pra me curar. É.
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#021.dst: Isso é... frustrante. Ele pareceu suspeito desde o início, eu devia-... Bem. O que passou, passou. Vamos ver o prefeito.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in Alekin Village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#022.dst: Fale com o prefeito Alvin em Alekin Village em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#023.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#023.dst: Fale com o prefeito Alvin em {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#024.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#024.dst: Ah, viajantes... bem-vindos à nossa humilde cidade da floresta. Vieram para ficar ou só estão de passagem?
Infested Plants#024.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#025.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#025.dst: Talvez a segunda. Mas encontramos um tal de Ope, que nos mandou falar com o senhor.
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#026.dst: Tomem, aceitem umas esmeraldas como desculpas. Espero que ele não tenha manchado a imagem da nossa cidadezinha...
Infested Plants#026.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#027.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#027.dst: Ah... Obrigado. É muita gentileza sua. Vamos ficar um tempo antes de seguir para {p}.
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#028.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#028.dst: Ah, {u}! Aí está você. Que bom te ver. Eu diria para seguirmos rumo a {p}, mas...

Infested Plants#029.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#029.dst: Parece que vamos ter que passar pela {p} antes. Dizem que a floresta está cheia de aranhas... e os mortos-vivos são um perigo, como sempre... mas cá entre nós, devemos-

Infested Plants#030.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?
Infested Plants#030.dst: E-ei! Vocês dois! São soldados, né?

Infested Plants#032.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#032.dst: É, deu pra ver pelo estilo esquisito! Vocês deviam ajudar as pessoas, né? Então. Ajudem!

Infested Plants#033.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#033.dst: Claro- mas quem é você? Por que está sozinho aqui, não é perigoso? Os mortos-vivos não...

Infested Plants#034.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#034.dst: Sou o Ope! E os mortos-vivos... ah, não tem tantos por aqui. As aranhas não escolhem quem atacam.

Infested Plants#035.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#035.dst: Certo... tá. Faz sentido. Com o que precisava de ajuda?

Infested Plants#036.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#036.dst: Eu... hã... então, tem uma erva medicinal rara que cresce nesta floresta, sabe? E é importante. Mas o único lugar onde sei achar é uma caverna infestada de aranhas rastejantes.

Infested Plants#037.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#037.dst: E, sabe, eu- eu não sou soldado! Não posso entrar lá e pegar sozinho! Então eu esperava que vocês me ajudassem.

Infested Plants#038.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#038.dst: Bem... viemos a Wynn para ajudar, afinal. Então... vamos pegar essa erva!

Infested Plants#039.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#039.dst: Ótimo. Ótimo! Levo vocês até a caverna, e de lá vocês fazem o resto. Me sigam!

Infested Plants#040.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#040.dst: Bem, chegamos! A caverna é bem ali- é só subir nas pedras e pular dentro. É seguro! Hã, provavelmente.

Infested Plants#041.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#041.dst: ...ai. Tem um monte de aranhas até aqui em cima... ei, já que são dois- um pega a erva e o outro, hã... me protege das aranhas rastejantes?

Infested Plants#042.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#042.dst: Por mim, tudo bem. {u}, entre na caverna, e eu defendo o Ope aqui em cima.

Infested Plants#043.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#043.dst: É... ótimo! Ótimo, ótimo! Boa, hã, sorte lá em cima! Tente não levar muitas picadas das aranhas!

Infested Plants#044.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#044.dst: ...ah- aí está você!! Por que demorou tanto? Parece que esperamos há horas!

Infested Plants#045.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#045.dst: Hã-... hm. E-enfim! Pegou a erva? É muito importante, é.

Infested Plants#046.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#046.dst: Pensando bem... acho que você nunca disse para que precisava dela.

Infested Plants#047.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#047.dst: Ah, eu- ehe, é... eu... hã, n-não é da sua conta, na verdade.

Infested Plants#048.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#048.dst: E- eu agradeço o trabalho, soldados! Agora, o pagamento... vejamos, o que eu tenho...

Infested Plants#049.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#049.dst: Ah. Parece que estou sem esmeraldas. Bem- então, eu- eu dou um conselho! Tem muito pra achar nesta mata. Outras cavernas com coisas valiosas! Pode valer a pena!

Infested Plants#050.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#050.dst: Espera, o quê? Ei, você não vai mesmo-

Infested Plants#051.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#051.dst: Foi um prazer, soldados, mas eu- eu preciso mesmo ir! Coisas importantes! Estamos perto de {p}, passem lá! É só seguir a estrada principal pro leste!

Infested Plants#052.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#052.dst: Podem, hã, falar com o prefeito! Ele cobre minhas despesas!

Infested Plants#054.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#054.dst: Isso é... frustrante. Eu só queria saber... enfim. O que está feito, está feito. Vamos falar com o prefeito que ele mencionou.

Infested Plants#055.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#055.dst: Vou na frente. Te encontro em {p}, é só seguir a estrada principal para o leste.

Infested Plants#056.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#056.dst: Ah, recrutas... bem-vindos à nossa humilde cidade da floresta. Vieram para ficar ou só estão de passagem?

Infested Plants#057.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#057.dst: Só de passagem, vamos pra {p}. Mas... encontramos um tal de Ope, que nos mandou falar com o senhor.

Infested Plants#058.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#058.dst: Ah, o Ope... Imagino que o encontro com ele foi ruim? Peço desculpas por ele, ele é... difícil de lidar às vezes.

Infested Plants#059.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#059.dst: Ah... obrigado. É muita gentileza sua. Vamos ficar um tempo antes de seguir para {p}.

Infested Plants#060.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#060.dst: Então fiquem à vontade! Recebemos bem todo viajante aqui, não importa quanto tempo fique.

Infested Plants#061.src: I'm going to go rest up a little. I'll be ready for more adventures soon though, don't worry!
Infested Plants#061.dst: Vou descansar um pouco. Mas logo estarei pronto para mais aventuras, não se preocupe!
Infested Plants#061.speaker: Tasim

Jungle Fever#000.src: The only cure to this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#000.dst: A única cura para esta febre é beber esmeraldas líquidas! Sim, isso! *cof*
Jungle Fever#000.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#001.src: Break into *cough* the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#001.dst: Invada *cof* o depósito de esmeraldas, mas não pegue nada... e volte logo pra mim, se sair vivo, hehe...
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we don't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#002.dst: Vamos ter que mudar de estratégia, não vamos pedir permissão. É para me ajudar, afinal.
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: I needed to make sure you could easily break into a bank. So i came here by myself to see if you could do it.
Jungle Fever#003.dst: Eu precisava ter certeza de que você invadiria um banco fácil. Então vim aqui sozinho pra ver se conseguia.

Jungle Fever#004.src: You've proven your ability of stealth and strength by breaking into this storage, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#004.dst: Você provou sua furtividade e força invadindo este depósito, agora podemos começar pra valer.

Jungle Fever#005.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golems, who can kill anyone in one hit.
Jungle Fever#005.dst: É vigiado por montes de Golens guardiões treinados, que matam qualquer um num golpe.

similar.text: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.

Jungle Fever#006.src: ..I mean *cough*.. I was too sick so i came back here.. *cough*
Jungle Fever#006.dst: ..Digo *cof*.. Eu estava muito doente, então voltei.. *cof*

Jungle Fever#007.src: I feel so much better now, thank you for the cure!
Jungle Fever#007.dst: Estou bem melhor agora, obrigado pela cura!

Jungle Fever#008.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#008.dst: Fale com Worid na aldeia da selva em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#009.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#009.dst: Ah, que alegria te ver! *cof*, peguei uma febre terrível e preciso muito de ajuda! *cof*
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#011.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#011.dst: Pode pedir ao Banqueiro de {p} para me dar, sei lá, [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]?
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#012.dst: Se ele tiver a audácia de *cof* negar... você vai ter que usar a força bruta...
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#015.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#015.dst: Fale com o Banqueiro de {p} sobre a cura para Worid em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#016.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#016.dst: [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]? Ele é louco! Esmeraldas líquidas não curam ninguém de nada, só da pobreza!
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#017.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#017.dst: Não vou participar dessa tentativa patética de fraude!
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#018.dst: Entre no depósito de esmeraldas de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#019.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#019.dst: Ah, não! Como vou curar minha doença sem esmeraldas líquidas?... *cof*
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: Antes, preciso ver se você invade um banco fácil. Tente entrar no Depósito Secreto de {p}.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: Quando terminar, fale comigo de novo. E cuidado, pode haver guardas.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#024.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#024.dst: Quê? Você já está aqui. Achei que ia demorar demais, então fui eu mesmo.
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#025.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: Minha doença? CLARO. *cof* Que vergonha obrigar um doente a fazer seu trabalho.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#026.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#026.dst: Enfim, vejo que você se provou, agora podemos começar pra valer.
Jungle Fever#026.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#027.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#027.dst: Veja, {p} tem um cofre bem vigiado chamado "O Labirinto de Esmeraldas".
Jungle Fever#027.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#028.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#028.dst: É vigiado por montes de Golens guardiões treinados, que matam qualquer aventureiro.
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: O Banqueiro do cofre secreto deve estar morrendo de tédio e não vai ligar se você o achar.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#030.dst: Boa sorte com isso. Haha.. digo, *cof*.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#031.dst: Infiltre-se no Labirinto Secreto de Esmeraldas de {p}, no subsolo, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e encontre o Banqueiro na Sala das Esmeraldas

Jungle Fever#032.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#032.dst: Ah, hã! Alguém! Faz tanto tempo que não vejo ninguém!
Jungle Fever#032.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#033.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#033.dst: Esmeraldas líquidas? Claro, claro! Tenho um monte! Tome, pode levar.
Jungle Fever#033.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#036.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#036.dst: É muito dinheiro, muito obrigado, finalmente vou poder... *cof* me curar!
Jungle Fever#036.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#037.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#037.dst: Tome, esta parte é sua, você merece. Preciso usar quase todo o... *cof* dinheiro pra me curar, então te paguei com uma chave.
Jungle Fever#037.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#038.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#038.dst: Eu roubei- *cof* digo, peguei emprestada do líder da tribo. Parece que foi usada para trancar um grande mal.
Jungle Fever#038.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#039.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#039.dst: Já vai tard- *cof* Hã... sorte. Boa sorte, aventureiro!
Jungle Fever#039.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#001.src: {#}Cast your Arrow Bomb Spell by clicking  LEFT -  RIGHT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

King's Recruit#006.dst: Ei, {u}! Tudo bem aí dentro? Parece que batemos em algo.

King's Recruit#007.src: Hey, {u}! Are you alright in there? It looks like we've hit something.

King's Recruit#011.dst: Ah. Quer dizer que vamos ter que andar daqui até {p}?
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#012.dst: Infelizmente, sim. Por sorte, não é tão longe. É só seguir reto pela estrada.

King's Recruit#013.dst: Bem, o jeito é continuar! Tasim, {u}, aposto corrida até o portão!
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#015.dst: ... Ele já foi. Vamos ter que alcançá-lo. {u}, vá na frente.
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.dst: Siga o caminho até o portão da província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#018.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#018.dst: Imagino que você também não saiba muito sobre Wynn, né?
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#019.dst: Claro, o Rei de {p} anda recrutando soldados de Fruma, mas...
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#020.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#020.dst: Essa guerra deles deve estar bem feia se precisam de tanto apoio.
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#021.dst: Ah, lá está o Aledar! E o portão, pelo jeito.
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#022.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#022.dst: Aí estão vocês! Vão ter que ser mais rápidos se quiserem ter chance contra os mortos-vivos.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time.
King's Recruit#023.dst: Tá, tá, da próxima vez corremos.
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#024.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.dst: Tá, tá, da próxima vez corremos. Então, este é o portão na fronteira entre Wynn e Fruma?
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#025.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#025.dst: Parece que sim! Prontos para o começo das nossas novas vidas?
King's Recruit#025.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#026.src: Looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#026.dst: Parece que sim! Vocês dois estão prontos pra começar nossa nova vida?
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#027.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#027.dst: {u}, que tal fazer as honras? Vá em frente e abra esse portão.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.dst: Entre na província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#029.dst: Entre na província de Wynn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#030.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#030.dst: Bem, o que estamos esperando? Vamos explorar esta província.
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#031.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#031.dst: Siga pela província de Wynn até o castelo

King's Recruit#032.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#032.dst: Então esta é a Wynn de que tanto ouvimos falar... É linda.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#033.src: So this is the Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#033.dst: Então esta é a Wynn de que tanto ouvimos falar... É linda.
King's Recruit#033.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#034.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#034.dst: Acho que a guerra não chegou até aqui. É isto que vamos lutar para proteger.
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#035.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#035.dst: Ei, recrutas! Venham cá, tenho algo para dizer.
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#038.dst: Um soldado? O que faz tão longe assim?
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#039.dst: Há problemas mais à frente. Me mandaram aqui para interceptar novos recrutas.
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#040.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#040.dst: Se querem sobreviver aqui fora, vão precisar disto.
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#043.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#043.dst: Tomara que não precisemos usar isto ainda.
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#044.dst: Boa sorte aí fora, recrutas! Sigam este caminho e mais à frente haverá uma ponte.
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#045.src: Just follow this path straight forward, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#045.dst: Sigam este caminho em frente e mais adiante haverá uma ponte.
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#048.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#048.dst: Ah, essa deve ser a ponte de que o soldado falou. Mas ela parece bem...
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#049.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#049.dst: Vamos, o Rei de {p} nos espera!
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#053.dst: Era disso que eu tentava te avisar! Vamos sair desta ponte antes que o resto desabe...
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#054.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#054.dst: E como vamos chegar ao outro lado deste desfiladeiro agora? Argh. Mais uma coisa dando errado, igual a-...
King's Recruit#054.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#056.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#056.dst: Que... estranho. Eu pensava em algo de antes de Wynn, mas... sumiu. Não consigo lembrar.
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#057.dst: Hm. Também não lembro de nada de Fruma... {u}, e você?
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#058.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#058.dst: Nada. Não pode ser coincidência todos perdermos a memória juntos, né?
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we've all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#059.dst: Nada. Não pode ser coincidência todos perdermos a memória ao mesmo tempo, né?
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#060.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#060.dst: Não, mas... Podemos nos preocupar com isso depois. Agora, precisamos atravessar este desfiladeiro. Aledar, {u}, procurem um caminho por aí. Vou continuar olhando aqui.
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#084.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#086.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?

King's Recruit#122.dst: Derrote o Goliath e liberte o tenente.

King's Recruit#144.dst: Fale com o Rei de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

King's Recruit#145.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#145.dst: Bem-vindos à província de Wynn! Pela aparência maltrapilha, imagino que a viagem até aqui foi uma grande aventura.
King's Recruit#145.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#146.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#146.dst: Isto, recrutas, é o nobre forte de {p}, uma das grandes cidades daqui!
King's Recruit#146.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#147.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our vast province!
King's Recruit#147.dst: Isto, recrutas, é o nobre forte de {p}, uma das grandes cidades da província!
King's Recruit#147.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#148.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#148.dst: Como soldados de Wynn, vocês devem conter os monstros corrompidos que assolam a terra.
King's Recruit#148.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#149.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#149.dst: Mas talvez queiram ganhar alguma experiência antes. Muitas vidas se perdem tragicamente todo dia...
King's Recruit#149.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#150.src: Although, you might want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#150.dst: Mas talvez queiram ganhar alguma experiência antes. Muitas vidas se perdem tragicamente todo dia...
King's Recruit#150.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#151.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#151.dst: Levem este {c2}[Pergaminho de Teletransporte de {p}]{/} na jornada. Ao usá-lo, vocês voltam na hora para esta cidade, estejam onde estiverem.
King's Recruit#151.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#152.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#152.dst: Dito isso, devo me despedir, mais recrutas podem chegar a qualquer momento. Boa sorte, soldados de Wynn!
King's Recruit#152.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#153.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#153.dst: Então! Wynn, hein? Que emoção enfim estar aqui.
King's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim
