King's Recruit#154.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#154.dst: Mal posso esperar para ver como é de perto!
King's Recruit#154.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#155.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#155.dst: Ha, bem, acho que logo vou rumo a {p}, embora pareça haver algo chamado {p} no caminho...
King's Recruit#155.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#156.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there appears to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#156.dst: Ha, bem, acho que logo vou rumo a {p}, embora pareça haver algo chamado {p} no caminho...
King's Recruit#156.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#157.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#157.dst: Chega de conversa! Vamos lá fora ajudar as pessoas!
King's Recruit#157.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#158.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing more of him soon enough.
King's Recruit#158.dst: E lá se foi ele de novo... Bem, com certeza vamos vê-lo de novo logo.
King's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#159.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#159.dst: É lindo... Ah! Quase esqueci de te contar, {u}.
King's Recruit#159.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#160.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#160.dst: Todos recebemos um item útil no caminho, o Livro de Conteúdo. Ele mostra quase tudo o que dá para fazer no mundo: Missões, Cavernas e muito mais.
King's Recruit#160.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#161.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#161.dst: Ele também rastreia o conteúdo que quiser, criando sinalizadores para você seguir.
King's Recruit#161.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#162.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#162.dst: Que tal experimentar? Use seu livro de conteúdo e clique na missão destacada.
King's Recruit#162.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#163.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#163.dst: Isso aí! Vou na direção de {p}, no fim de {p}.
King's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#164.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.dst: Me encontre lá quando estiver um pouco mais forte. Bem, até mais, {u}.
King's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#165.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}. You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger.
King's Recruit#165.dst: Isso aí! Vou na direção de {p}, no fim de {p}. Me encontre lá quando estiver um pouco mais forte.
King's Recruit#165.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#167.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#167.dst: Estão esperando o quê, recrutas? Vão identificar seu elmo no  Identificador de Itens e depois equipem no espaço de elmo!

King's Recruit#168.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#168.dst: Ou podem ficar aqui parados o dia todo, por mim tudo bem.

King's Recruit#169.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#170.src: Good luck in there, recruits. You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#170.dst: Boa sorte aí dentro, recrutas. Vão precisar...
King's Recruit#170.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#171.src: We did it! Let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#172.src: Well? Let's go see what this province is really like.
King's Recruit#172.dst: E aí? Vamos ver como é esta província.
King's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#173.src: It's beautiful... It's pretty exciting to finally be here, don't you think?
King's Recruit#173.dst: É lindo... Que emoção finalmente estar aqui, não acha?
King's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#174.src: There's no use standing around here waiting for adventure to come to us! I'm getting out there and helping some people!
King's Recruit#174.dst: Não adianta ficar parado esperando a aventura vir até nós! Vou lá fora ajudar as pessoas!
King's Recruit#174.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#175.src: Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}. There's this handy item we were given, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world and lets you track them, creating beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#175.dst: Ah! Quase esqueci de te contar, {u}. Ganhamos um item útil, o livro de conteúdo. Ele mostra quase tudo o que dá pra fazer neste mundo e permite rastrear, criando sinalizadores para você seguir.
King's Recruit#175.speaker: Tasim

Kingdom of Sand#000.src: Ah! Good to see you. Of all the sites we've explored so far... this tomb is the most exciting.
Kingdom of Sand#000.dst: Ah! Que bom te ver. De todos os locais que exploramos... esta tumba é o mais empolgante.

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: ... Until now. I believe I've managed to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: ... Até agora. Acho que consegui rastrear o paradeiro dele até um grupo de bandidos próximo. Eles nem devem saber o que têm nas mãos.
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: Oi! Remember, yer need to nab that journal from the big mansion in {p}, if yer want to get in with us.
Kingdom of Sand#002.dst: Ei! Lembra, cê precisa surrupiar aquele diário da mansão grande em {p}, se quiser entrar pro bando.

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: Parece que é neste quarto que guardam o diário...

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: What yer waiting for, get in here!
Kingdom of Sand#005.dst: Tá esperando o quê? Entra aqui!

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: Seems like there's a meeting going on...
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: Parece que está rolando uma reunião...

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...
Kingdom of Sand#007.dst: Parece que vale a pena ver aquela carroça quebrada perto do rio...

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Seems like that note might give you a clue...
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: Parece que essa nota pode te dar uma pista...

Kingdom of Sand#010.src: The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.
Kingdom of Sand#010.dst: O cetro vibra com um poder imensurável, cheio de mil anos de história do Deserto.

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.
Kingdom of Sand#011.dst: Você deveria levar isto a Junes o quanto antes.

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: I should get it to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: Preciso levá-lo a {p} já. Obrigada, {u}. Tem minha eterna gratidão.
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you could learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: Pensa em explorar a tumba? Com certeza aprenderia muito sobre o Império... mas tome cuidado.
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and this lesser treasure I found nearby.
Kingdom of Sand#015.dst: Tenho pouco a oferecer pela ajuda, mas aceite estas esmeraldas e este pequeno tesouro que achei aqui perto.

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: Um soldado de {p}! Imagino que veio investigar a tumba no alto da colina?
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#018.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: Dizem que ela guarda os restos do príncipe Hashr, filho do antigo Imperador do Deserto, mas é perigosa demais para eu explorar sozinha.
Kingdom of Sand#018.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: Em vez disso, estudo uma lenda relacionada - o cetro do Imperador.
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: Era a fonte do poder dele, e talvez um dos artefatos mais importantes da história.
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: Quando o Imperador foi morto pelo filho, Hashr, dizem que o cetro se perdeu na furiosa tempestade de areia que veio depois.
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: Não estou pronta para enfrentá-los, mas... este artefato pertence a um museu, nas mãos de pesquisadores cuidadosos e respeitosos.
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: Eu ficaria em dívida se você tentasse recuperá-lo, pelo bem da história.
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: Tente entrar no esconderijo dos bandidos em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: Soldado corrupto ou não, num dá pra te deixar entrar.
Kingdom of Sand#026.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: A não ser que cê saiba a senha?
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: Imaginei. Agora some, já me fez perder tem-
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: Olha só isso... Até soldado acha que pode entrar aqui de boa.
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: Se divertindo pensando na senha? Foi mal estragar a festa, mas num tem senha!
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: Uns oficiais a mais na lista cairiam bem.
Kingdom of Sand#031.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#032.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#032.dst: Se cê tá do lado frouxo da lei, fala com a gente lá fora.
Kingdom of Sand#032.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: Parece que cê tá dentro. Olha, num tem senha porque a gente é pra ser os melhores ladrões da terra, né?
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: Então pra que palavras? Cê tem que dar pro guarda algo roubado, né não!
Kingdom of Sand#035.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: E por acaso temos a chance da sua vida pra você. {p} amoleceu, sabe, um prefeito novo tá botando ordem.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: Num dá pra ter governo fora do nosso controle. {p} sempre será a capital dos bandidos.
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#038.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#038.dst: Então que tal fazer ele provar do próprio veneno e pegar o diário que ele guarda? Aposto que tem podres dele lá.
Kingdom of Sand#038.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: E "a gente" é você. Cê vai se esgueirar na mansão e fugir dos guardas.
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#040.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#040.dst: Ele guarda o diário no quarto mais alto. Talvez precise distrair uns guardas. É a maior mansão de {p}, num tem erro.
Kingdom of Sand#040.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: Entre escondido no quarto mais alto da {p} Mansion em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: Arrá, lá está o ladrão que vi rondando a mansão! Peguem!
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: Cê sabe que podem te expulsar do exército por isso.
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: Heh, parece que cê é dos nossos. Sobe aí, vamos sair daqui.
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#045.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: Esse diário vale mais que qualquer joia, cê vai entrar com certeza.
Kingdom of Sand#045.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#046.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: Leve o diário da {p} Mansion ao guarda do cofre para entrar no esconderijo.

Kingdom of Sand#049.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#049.dst: Ora, que senha e tanto, "soldado". Acho que isso serve, pode passar.
Kingdom of Sand#049.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: Procure o cetro no esconderijo dos bandidos em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#051.dst: Muito bem, pessoal. Me deem os relatórios.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: Ouro aliviado de viajantes de Mesa semana passada passou de {~} barras.
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: Estamos expondo aquele maldito prefeito de {p} com um diário roubado. {p} volta ao controle dos Creden Tibus em uma semana.
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: Bem... alguém anda rondando a velha tumba. Uma arqueóloga, parece. Acho que ela tá atrás do cetro.
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: Ah... esse cetro vale demais pra perdermos. Uma visitinha pra convencer ela a... parar de procurar.
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: Isso aí, chefe. Ainda bem que ninguém vai pensar em procurar na carroça quebrada perto do rio, né?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: Cala a boca, idiota! O que eu acabei de dizer? Enfim, eu decido o que fazer com a arqueóloga. Dispensados!
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#062.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#062.dst: Podemos ser bandidos, mas não somos burros. Melhor deixar aquele cetro quieto.
Kingdom of Sand#062.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#064.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#064.dst: Volte à tumba e entregue o cetro a Junes em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#065.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#065.dst: Ah, {u}. Não resisti - eu precisava ver a tumba de perto.
Kingdom of Sand#065.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#066.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#066.dst: Você não imagina a vontade que tenho de entrar, mas duvido que sairia viva.
Kingdom of Sand#066.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#067.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#067.dst: Você... você achou o cetro? Ah! Isso é incrível! Não acredito!
Kingdom of Sand#067.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#068.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#068.dst: Este artefato testemunhou a ascensão e a queda do Império, há milhares de anos. E você estava... segurando ele, sem luvas...
Kingdom of Sand#068.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#069.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#069.dst: Dadas as circunstâncias, acho que posso deixar passar. Mas o que eu poderia aprender estudando-o...
Kingdom of Sand#069.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#070.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#070.dst: Há lendas sinistras sobre o que ela guarda. Traças, esqueletos... até o próprio príncipe Hashr. Vá bem equipado!
Kingdom of Sand#070.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#071.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#071.dst: Tenho pouco a oferecer pela ajuda, mas aceite estas esmeraldas e um osso fóssil que achei por aqui.
Kingdom of Sand#071.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#000.src: If you want some of my special brews, elixirs, and potions, go do business with my assistant.
Lava Springs#000.dst: Se quiser minhas poções, elixires e misturas especiais, vá negociar com meu assistente.
Lava Springs#000.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#003.src: This should be enough evidence. You should report back to Colonel Gailard.
Lava Springs#003.dst: Isso deve bastar de prova. Volte e informe o coronel Gailard.

Lava Springs#004.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here named {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#004.dst: Espera... Tive uma ideia... Certo, escuta aqui, soldado! Tem uma cidadezinha ao norte chamada {p}, tá? Lá tem um curandeiro que pode ajudar a gente.
Lava Springs#004.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#005.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of the town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#005.dst: Ele tá enfurnado num poço importante no centro da cidade. Mas cê precisa de uma senha pra entrar lá...
Lava Springs#005.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#006.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how stupid that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#006.dst: ...Fontes... de lava... corrompidas...? Cê sabe como isso soa idiota, né? Bem, eu acredito totalmente.
Lava Springs#006.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#007.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report back to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#007.dst: Agora, cê tem compromisso, né? Isso. Vá informar o coronel, soldado. E manda um oi pra ele por mim.
Lava Springs#007.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#008.src: You can feel your body heat adjusting as the potion courses through your body...
Lava Springs#008.dst: Você sente sua temperatura se ajustar enquanto a poção corre pelo corpo...

Lava Springs#009.src: Ye're a good ally, soldier! And a great help to the army, at that!
Lava Springs#009.dst: Bom aliado, soldado! E uma baita ajuda pro exército!
Lava Springs#009.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#010.dst: Ah, bom, bom! Aposto que cê é um soldado de {p}, né? Escuta aqui, soldado! Tenho uma tarefa em que cê pode ajudar.
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#011.dst: Tá vendo aquela fonte de lava ali? Ela brotou do nada! O alto escalão tá bem preocupado, viu?
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#012.dst: Eles andam falando que tem a ver com a Corrupção, e pode apostar que isso é encrenca. Encrenca FEIA.
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#013.dst: Olha, esta savana sempre teve um pouco de Corrupção à espreita, mas não a ponto de fazer isso! Aqui não vai ser seguro se a gente não fizer algo!
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#014.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#014.dst: Enfim, o alto comando não vai mandar apoio até saber que tem Corrupção de verdade, então temos que achar provas perto das fontes, entendeu?
Lava Springs#014.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#015.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#015.dst: Dê uma olhada pelas fontes, soldado! Me arranja alguma maldita prova por aqui! [{~} provas] devem bastar! Agora, mexa-se!
Lava Springs#015.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#016.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#016.dst: Procure três provas de corrupção ao redor da fonte de lava em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#017.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#018.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#018.dst: Certo, bom! Cê achou provas, deixa eu dar uma olhada!
Lava Springs#018.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#019.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#019.dst: Ih... Que ruim... muito, MUITO ruim...
Lava Springs#019.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#020.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#020.dst: Isto é corrupção física. Se tá chegando à superfície, pode apostar que uma dessas ervas tá se espalhando no subsolo, bem embaixo das fontes...
Lava Springs#020.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#021.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#021.dst: Se cê chegasse embaixo da fonte, provavelmente cortaria a maldita raiz que causa isso, mas... o calor ia fritar sua pele na certa...
Lava Springs#021.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#022.src: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
Lava Springs#022.dst: Não sei muito, mas tenho quase certeza de que a senha é Bob, ou algo assim. Em honra ao herói.
Lava Springs#022.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#023.src: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Lava Springs#023.dst: Certo, cê vai lá achar uma poção que proteja esse seu couro fraquinho do calor, entendeu? Toma, deixa eu anotar o local nesse seu livro.
Lava Springs#023.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#024.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#024.dst: Fale com Gregor do lado de fora do poço de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#025.src: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
Lava Springs#025.dst: Ei, ei ei ei! Meu bem, o que pensa que está fazendo? Não pode entrar aqui assim sem me dizer a senha!
Lava Springs#025.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#026.src: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
Lava Springs#026.dst: Hmm... Seu rosto... confiança... ele brilha de confiança... mas... você ainda não falou comigo desde que chegou...
Lava Springs#026.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#027.src: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
Lava Springs#027.dst: Será que... você sabe que a senha é ovos de pinguim, mas é tímido demais pra falar? É... é, só pode ser isso!
Lava Springs#027.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#028.src: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Lava Springs#028.dst: Você me convenceu, meu bem mudinho... Pode entrar no poço. Vai, agora!
Lava Springs#028.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#029.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#029.dst: Entre no poço de {p} e fale com o curandeiro em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#030.src: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
Lava Springs#030.dst: Bom dia, amigo. Como posso ajudar?
Lava Springs#030.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#031.src: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
Lava Springs#031.dst: Hm? O coronel te mandou? Pra quê?
Lava Springs#031.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#032.src: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
Lava Springs#032.dst: Certo, lava, entããão... Precisa de uma poção contra o calor, né?
Lava Springs#032.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#033.src: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
Lava Springs#033.dst: Bom, você tá com sorte, meio que... Tenho uma poção que resiste ao calor da lava, mas não deixa você nadar nela.
Lava Springs#033.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#034.src: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
Lava Springs#034.dst: Ah, então serve, você só precisa entrar num poço que atravessa a lava? Perfeito
Lava Springs#034.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#035.src: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
Lava Springs#035.dst: Aliás, se precisar de mais misturas especiais, meu assistente vende com prazer a um preço bem camarada.
Lava Springs#035.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#036.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#037.src: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
Lava Springs#037.dst: Relatório! Já pegou a poção, soldado? Ótimo, beba se ainda não bebeu!
Lava Springs#037.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#038.src: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
Lava Springs#038.dst: Isso, é o que eu gosto de ouvir! Agora, OLHA PRA ESQUERDA, SOLDADO! Tem um poço ali que cavamos pra tentar achar a origem dessa erva.
Lava Springs#038.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#039.src: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
Lava Springs#039.dst: Achamos uma caverna quente pra caramba embaixo da superfície! Se cê pular no poço, deve achar a origem da Corrupção e dar um fim nela.
Lava Springs#039.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#040.src: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
Lava Springs#040.dst: As raízes e espinhos da Corrupção são bem resistentes, mas nunca vimos nada como lava jorrando do chão.
Lava Springs#040.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#041.src: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
Lava Springs#041.dst: Bati um papo com o alto escalão mais cedo. Eles desconfiam que a Corrupção tem um coração bombeando toda essa lava!
Lava Springs#041.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#042.src: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Lava Springs#042.dst: Essa tem que ser nossa chance, né? Se cê destruir isso, deve conseguir parar a lava! Agora, mexa-se! Pro poço, soldado!
Lava Springs#042.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#043.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart
Lava Springs#043.dst: Beba a Poção de pele de obsidiana, depois entre na fonte de lava pelo poço de sondagem em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e procure um coração corrompido

Lava Springs#044.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart
Lava Springs#044.dst: Diga ao coronel Gailard em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] que você destruiu o coração

Lava Springs#045.src: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Lava Springs#045.dst: Hah! Sabia que cê ia trazer resultado! Cê é confiável pra diabo, soldado! Toma, pelo trabalho!
Lava Springs#045.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.dst: Ah, mais um desses aventureiros, hein? Vemos muitos por aqui... Entrando e saindo quando querem. Deve ser uma vida boa.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.dst: Mas, se tiver um tempinho, a cidade bem que precisa de vo-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.dst: Espera, já?! Só faz um dia desde a última! Que insaciáveis...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.dst: OS MORTOS-VIVOS SUPERARAM OS GOLENS! CADA UM POR SI!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.dst: Era disso que eu falava! Precisamos da sua ajuda! Vocês de Wynn são bons em matar zumbis, né?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.dst: Precisamos de ajuda! Defenda a cidade conosco!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.dst: A horda está recuando, mas um cidadão morreu! Reagrupem na praça e preparem as piras!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.dst: Fale com Burtur sobre o ataque em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.dst: Ufa. Ainda bem que era uma horda menor... Mesmo assim, que bom que você estava lá. Podia ter sido pior.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.dst: Mas vamos... Temos que queimar os corpos. Não dá pra deixar pela metade.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.dst: É meio sacrílego, mas necessário agora- senão eles continuam voltando, como do outro lado do cume, em Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.dst: Como não vivemos numa planície fedida e esburacada, temos que queimar os corpos pra que nenhum morto se volte contra nós.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.dst: Despeçam-se, todos. Vamos sentir falta de Irahe. Afastem-se da pira!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.dst: Alguns teóricos da conspiração acham que o problema é o Poço de Lazarus. É uma lenda urbana, um poço de água que revive os mortos.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.dst: Supondo que seja real, até faria sentido- Se começasse a vazar pro rio ou pros lençóis freáticos, teríamos o que está acontecendo agora.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.dst: Claro, ninguém sabe onde fica, são só boatos, mas dizem que há uma "Ordem" de guardiões do poço. Convenientemente mortos há tempos e enterrados no cemitério logo ao norte daqui.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.dst: Vou ficar na praça da cidade, caso os mortos-vivos ataquem de novo. Me chame se achar algo que te deixe em dúvida.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.dst: Já deu uma olhada naquele cemitério ao norte? Lembre-se, você procura pistas sobre essa "Ordem" do Poço de Lazarus.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.dst: Encontre o corpo do mago da Ordem no cemitério de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.dst: Encontre a capela mencionada pelo talismã, ou volte a Burtur para pedir ajuda.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.dst: Achou a capela? As coordenadas devem estar no seu livro de conteúdo, né?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.dst: Investigue a capela da Ordem a noroeste de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.dst: Resolva o enigma da cripta para 'trazer de novo a água da vida' às sepulturas.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Perhaps you could use this water to revive some of the graves around the crypt...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.dst: Talvez dê para usar esta água para reviver algumas tumbas ao redor da cripta...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.dst: Reviva as pessoas das tumbas com a Água de Lazarus e atenda aos pedidos delas.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.dst: Argh. E quem colocou VOCÊ pra me acordar? Cadê a Gwendolyn, minha criada? Incompetentes- ela devia ter sido enterrada comigo também!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.dst: Quê, quer entrar na cripta? Então prove que é melhor que os agentes funerários e faça algo direito! Os Ghastly Ghouls daqui não param de GRITAR!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.dst: Quero eles longe! Livre-se de, digamos, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Aí talvez eu te dê atenção, seu enxerido estranho de nariz pequeno!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.dst: Agh! Pare de chegar de fininho! Já matou os {~} Ghastly Ghouls que pedi?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.dst: Ah, minha pessoinha esquisita de nariz pequeno favorita! O cemitério fica tão lindo em silêncio- belo trabalho!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.dst: Por mais importante que eu seja, ainda precisa ver as outras sepulturas, mas já tem minha bênção para entrar.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.dst: Minha nossa! Ah, que bom esticar estes ossos velhos. Não é fácil ficar trancado num caixão, sabe.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.dst: Quer entrar na cripta? Acho que posso te dar uma mão... no sentido figurado, claro. Mas preciso ver se você é de confiança e tal...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#034.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.dst: Ah, é! Meu querido marido me deu a aliança mais linda, mas ela se perdeu quando bati as botas. Uma coisa sombria e grosseira- Quero ver alguém casar com AQUILO!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.dst: Pode trazer ela de volta? Morri perto da torre do velho lich, a leste. Faça isso e te dou minha bênção com prazer!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.dst: Pode trazer minha aliança de volta? Morri perto da torre do velho lich, a leste. Faça isso e te dou minha bênção com prazer!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.dst: Encontre a aliança de Sir Pigglesworth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.dst: Ah, você achou! Maravilha! Coloque ali naquele ossinho do dedo... Ah, fica ainda melhor na outra mão!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.dst: Eu devia te dar um soco por me acordar!! Não sabe que é FALTA DE EDUCAÇÃO reanimar o cadáver antigo de um assassino no meio da morte de beleza dele?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.dst: Saudações! Ainda bem, aquela tumba lúgubre era simplesmente horrível. Sem móveis, sem luz natural, nem uma demão de tinta! Tudo tão sem graça.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#042.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.dst: O que foi? Quer entrar na cripta? Ora, claro que posso ajudar, se você fizer uma coisinha de nada pra mim?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.dst: Pode alimentar minha gata? A Mrs. Fluffles deve estar tão sozinha depois de tantos anos. Minha velha casa fica logo ao sul, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], é só deixar comida pra ela? Obrigado!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.dst: Por favor, gentil aventureiro! Alimente a Mrs. Fluffles. Ela deve estar tão sozinha naquele casarão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Mrs. Fluffles doesn't look to be in the best of shape...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.dst: A Mrs. Fluffles não parece estar nada bem...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: Use the Lazarus Water on Mrs
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.dst: Usar Água de Lazarus na Mrs

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.dst: Então, a Mrs. Fluffles está bem sem mim? Ah, aposto que ela foi tão carinhosa, sempre tão mansinha!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.dst: Ah, muito obrigado! Eu tinha tanto medo de ela não ficar bem depois da minha morte... Que alívio!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#051.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.dst: Você tem minha bênção para entrar na cripta! Mas não deixe de ver as outras sepulturas também.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#052.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.dst: E-espera, Mrs. Fluffles... Ela estava...m-morta? Não... Não pode ser! Deixei comida pra vida toda!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.dst: Você! Você matou a Mrs. Fluffles, é a única explicação!! COMO PÔDE FAZER ALGO ASSIM?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.dst: Abra a porta da cripta em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.dst: Investigue a câmara interna da cripta em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.dst: ... o Poço de Lazar... traria os mortos de volta.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.dst: Cuidado, viajante, el... não voltam de fato à vid... eram antes.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#058.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.dst: ... Em grande necessidade, pode-se achar... em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.dst: Mas saiba... por cobiça ou ganho pró... resulta em... pior que a morte.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.dst: Encontre a entrada do Poço de Lazarus em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.dst: Siga o caminho até o Poço de Lazarus em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e entre no Poço.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.dst: Siga a caverna para encontrar o Poço de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.dst: Encontre um jeito de bloquear a coluna de água no Poço de Lazarus.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.dst: Diga a Burtur em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] que você bloqueou o Poço de Lazarus

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.dst: Ah, você voltou! Já estávamos um pouco preocupados. Conseguiu descobrir algo naquela capela?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.dst: Espera, você achou o Poço de Lazarus? E bloqueou o fluxo pro rio? Penas de Grook, vocês humanos são rápidos! Só se passaram umas horas!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.dst: Puxa, tenho que te recompensar por esse trabalhão! Sei que não somos os mais ricos, mas espero que aceite também esta... outra forma de pagamento!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.dst: ...perda, mas os puros de coração acharam... sem a maldição, e formaram esta Ordem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.dst: Por medo do mau uso... águas, com malícia ou não, nosso... será levado ao túmulo.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.dst: Só um além de nossa... dele, e eles têm... segredo, até... imortalidade.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.dst: O lich, Espera... guardião da Ordem. Nós ...uma influência externa não...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: Looks like there's some debris blocking the path, but perhaps you could blast it away with a spell up close?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.dst: Parece que há entulho bloqueando o caminho, mas talvez você possa explodi-lo com um feitiço de perto?

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Hey! Over there, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.dst: Ei! Aí, tudo bem? Venha falar comigo, posso explicar o que aconteceu.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.dst: Mas os daqui vêm todos do rio, e como ele passa bem no meio da cidade, bem... Dá pra ver o problema.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.src: It's...probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.dst: Provavelmente é só o Referick, que andou contando isso pra qualquer bêbado que ouvisse um tempo atrás, mas é nossa única chance. Pode dar uma procurada e me dizer sim ou não?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.src: It looks like the revived mage dropped some kind of talisman...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.dst: Parece que o mago revivido deixou cair um talismã...

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.src: Oh, you found something? Well, color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.dst: Ah, achou algo? Bem, quem diria que havia algum fundo de verdade nos delírios do Referick...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#078.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.src: 'Chapel of an ancient order'? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.dst: 'Capela de uma ordem antiga'? Tem uma capela logo a noroeste daqui. Eu diria para investigar! Preciso ficar aqui caso haja outro ataque, mas...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#079.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#080.src: Well, you'll just have to hope that putting Uggword to rest counts as his blessing to open the crypt.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#080.dst: Bem, só resta torcer para que dar descanso ao Uggword conte como a bênção dele para abrir a cripta.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#081.src: There's no sound from within the bloodstained grave... Looks like Uggword's getting his...beauty...death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#081.dst: Silêncio na tumba manchada de sangue... Parece que o Uggword está na sua... morte... de beleza.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#082.src: That's most of the ghouls killed. You should head back to Lord Plaatic.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#082.dst: Quase todos os ghouls mortos. Volte ao lorde Plaatic.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#083.src: Lord Plaatic's tomb is cold and empty.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#083.dst: Tumba de lorde Plaatic: fria e vazia.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs around as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.dst: A cripta, você diz? Posso dar minha bênção para entrar, mas vai precisar ver as outras tumbas também. Adeus!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#084.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#085.src: Sir Pigglesworth's tomb is silent and still. Seems he thought that "Til death do us part" was for quitters.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#085.dst: A tumba de Sir Pigglesworth está em silêncio. Pelo visto, "até que a morte nos separe" era para os fracos.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#086.src: Looks like this is the house Poclo was talking about... you should check inside.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#086.dst: Parece que esta é a casa de que Poclo falou... dê uma olhada dentro.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#087.dst: A tumba de Poclo está muda.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.src: It's an old book, rather ripped and torn...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.dst: É um livro velho, bem rasgado e gasto...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#088.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#089.src: This must be the entrance to the Lazarus Pit... Seems like it goes down rather far. Better jump in.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#089.dst: Esta deve ser a entrada do Poço de Lazarus... Parece bem fundo. Melhor pular.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#090.src: Is the water going... upwards? You should look around for a way to cut it off.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#090.dst: A água está indo... para cima? Procure um jeito de cortá-la.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#091.src: Looks like you managed to block off the Pit from the river... You should tell Burtur what you've done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#091.dst: Parece que você isolou o Poço do rio... Conte a Burtur o que fez.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#092.src: The bird looks pretty angry, you probably don't want to get in her way.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#092.dst: A ave parece bem brava, melhor não entrar no caminho dela.

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: Nova missão iniciada: Os julgamentos de bruxas de {p}

similar.text: New Quest Started: {p} Trouble

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of dark magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: Temos um inimigo entre nós em {p}! A magia sombria ilegal desta bruxa nos ameaça!
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued with spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: A casa da Sra. Amira está tomada pela Decadência! Temos que matar a bruxa para proteger nossa santidade!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Further...intruders...? You are not of the worms...the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: Mais...intrusos...? Você não é dos vermes...dos parasitas?
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scorches us. There is no place to go, no place we can burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: Não podemos fugir, pois o sol nos queima. Não há para onde ir, nenhum lugar onde cavar em que eles não esperem.
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive til this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: Você... Você... Você tem vida. Tem coração, e músculo, e carne... Para aguentar até o tormento acabar...
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: You're stuck! Maybe you can dig yourself out?
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: Ficou preso! Talvez dê para cavar e sair?
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: À

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: It seems like the creature was knocked out. Now is the time to catch it! The cage seems like a good place to keep it.
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: Parece que a criatura desmaiou. Hora de capturá-la! A jaula parece um bom lugar para guardá-la.
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: À

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: The creature is out of control!

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: It seemed like the creature calmed down... You should show the mayor to free Amira.
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: Parece que a criatura se acalmou... Mostre ao prefeito para libertar Amira.

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: ...Fine then. This...creature...bug...leech? This whatever-it-is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.dst: ...Certo. Esta...criatura...inseto...sanguessuga? Sei lá o quê... Aceito sua explicação.
Lexdale Witch Trials#011.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just...took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.dst: Ah, finalmente! Está tendo juízo! É quase como se algo tivesse...possuído você um dia e só saído agora!
Lexdale Witch Trials#012.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: As for the...THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.dst: Quanto à...COISA... Bem... Vou informar o governo de Gavel, com certeza.
Lexdale Witch Trials#013.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#014.dst: Siga a criatura antes que ela fuja!

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: Veja o que está acontecendo no centro de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: ESPEREM! Me SOLTEM logo! Eu já contei o que houve!
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: Sua magia sombria não vai nos enganar, Sra. Amira. Vá quieta- deixe-nos em paz!
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: CALA A BOCA! Não pode acusar as pessoas assim!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#021.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#021.dst: Me escuta um segundo! Não sou eu, algo infectou minha casa! Por isso estava tão escura!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#021.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#022.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.dst: Meu porão, uma coisa bizarra cavou até ele! Por onde passava, tudo murchava e apodrecia!
Lexdale Witch Trials#022.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.dst: A prova de que não fui eu está na minha casa! É ela que está podre e estéril! Você vai ver se OLHAR, seu sanguinário!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: Chega de insultos! Vamos adiar por enquanto- Se não houver prova da inocência da bruxa, ela será executada!
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: Explore o porão da casa podre e estéril.

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: Continue seguindo a criatura a partir do túnel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: Mais um forasteiro... Você deve ter visto os túneis. Eles corroem a pedra, secam as raízes, deixam a terra sem vida...
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: E aqui passamos fome, isolados. Meu povo está perdido, e a própria terra se retorce e se move.
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: A água, parada e cinzenta. Nada além daquelas pragas mágicas horríveis, e os próprios vermes para nos sustentar.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#036.dst: Derrote o cacique dos Moradores do Túnel.

Lexdale Witch Trials#037.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#037.dst: Espera... Esses tremores! SÃO ELES! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#037.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#038.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#038.dst: Cave para sair da terra. Depois vá atrás da criatura.

Lexdale Witch Trials#039.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#039.dst: Volte a {p} e tente mostrar a criatura ao prefeito em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#040.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#040.dst: Você voltou. Você- Espera, o que diabos é ISSO?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#040.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#041.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#041.dst: Isso! Isso era a coisa no meu porão!! Sabia que aquele humano ia achar! Obrigada!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#041.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#042.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#042.dst: Aquela coisa espalhava a decadência pela minha casa! NÃO são bruxas nem magia como você DECIDIU do nada um dia!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#042.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#044.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#044.dst: Desça do palanque, Sra. Amira. É inocente.
Lexdale Witch Trials#044.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#046.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#046.dst: ...hm. Isso... Mmh. Enfim. Humano, você provou ser confiável. Nossas portas estarão abertas para você.
Lexdale Witch Trials#046.speaker: The Mayor

Lost in the Jungle#000.src: However... He also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#000.dst: Porém... ele também trouxe uma estranha gema roxa. Nosso xamã viu como mau presságio, mas eu estava tão envolvido na festa que nem liguei.

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Hm, I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#001.dst: Hm, só agora vejo um rastro estranho no chão... é da cor da gema! Pode te levar até ele, por favor, siga!

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You should talk to Aryn now...

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: Oh... My father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with the ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#003.dst: Ah... Meu pai te mandou? Estou impressionado, guerreiro de Wynn. Luta com a ferocidade dos nossos!
Lost in the Jungle#003.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit, and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#004.dst: Mas isso não vem ao caso. Você diz que destruiu o espírito, e ela não parece mais maculada, então vou confiar em você.

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#006.dst: Com licença, viajante... Lamento muito pedir isso, mas preciso da sua ajuda.
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#007.dst: Veja, meu filho, Aryn. Há pouco ele passou por uma cerimônia tradicional de maioridade da nossa tribo.
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#008.dst: A tarefa dele era entrar na perigosa {p}, logo ao sul daqui, e enfrentar a mata por três dias. Voltou um homem de verdade, vitorioso.
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#009.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#009.dst: Coisas estranhas começaram a acontecer na aldeia. Aryn andava à noite, falando com alguém, mas não havia mais ninguém com ele.
Lost in the Jungle#009.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#010.dst: Ontem ao amanhecer, ele sumiu de vez. Fomos procurá-lo, mas nem nossos guerreiros mais fortes conseguiram entrar fundo na selva.
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#011.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#011.dst: Voltamos de mãos vazias, tendo perdido nosso mais novo membro. A aldeia está arrasada, e sinto que a culpa é minha.
Lost in the Jungle#011.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#012.dst: Mas vocês, guerreiros de Wynn... há grandes histórias dos seus feitos. Você consegue enfrentar a selva, não?
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#013.dst: Eu te imploro, por favor, encontre meu filho. Não sei bem onde ele está, mas sem dúvida foi levado bem para dentro...
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#015.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#015.dst: P-por favor, eu imploro, espírito, me solte! A tribo deve estar tão preocupada-
Lost in the Jungle#015.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#016.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#016.dst: NÃO RESISTA, GAROTO! SEU CORPO É MEU. FIQUEI PRESO NAQUELA PEDRA POR MILÊNIOS, E AGORA ESTOU LIVRE.
Lost in the Jungle#016.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#017.dst: Arrá, ouço alguém! Com certeza alguém da tribo vindo me salvar!
Lost in the Jungle#017.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#018.dst: Oh! Se for assim, o corpo deste guerreiro vai me servir bem melhor! Me dê seu poder, garoto! Preciso derrotá-lo antes de possuí-lo!
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#019.dst: Derrote o espírito que possui Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#020.dst: Veja se Aryn está a salvo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#021.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#021.dst: Haha, toma, espectro maligno! Jamais vai igualar o poder da nossa tribo-
Lost in the Jungle#021.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#022.dst: E-espera, você não é da nossa tribo! Quem é você, por que veio aqui?
Lost in the Jungle#022.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#023.dst: Eu...não posso dizer o mesmo. Aquele espírito me dominou por completo, ainda não consigo me mexer...
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#024.dst: Por ora, por favor, leve esta gema. Ela causou tudo isso, não quero perto de mim um amuleto de azar desses.
Lost in the Jungle#024.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#025.dst: Diga à tribo que vou voltar sozinho. Consegui uma vez, consigo de novo quando estiver preparado.
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#026.dst: Leve a Gema Misteriosa a Gracen em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#027.dst: Minha nossa... Aryn foi possuído por um espírito que vivia na gema?
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#028.dst: Que vergonha... Nosso xamã nunca errou antes, por que ignorei o aviso dele...
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#029.dst: Olhando agora, esta pedra é bem valiosa. Moída até virar pó, serve para os amuletos especiais que fazemos.
Lost in the Jungle#029.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#030.dst: Aqui, deixe-me moer isto para você. Pode ficar com os fragmentos para o que quiser usá-los no futuro.
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#031.dst: Nossa tribo, e principalmente eu... agradecemos seu serviço. De hoje em diante, você será considerado um dos nossos.
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#032.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#032.dst: Na verdade, se quiser, pode até entrar na minha casa aqui quando quiser.
Lost in the Jungle#032.speaker: Gracen

Lost Royalty#000.src: Have you gotten the king's son freed yet? The jungle mercenaries most likely have him held near that run-down old farm.
Lost Royalty#000.dst: Já libertou o filho do rei? Os mercenários da selva devem mantê-lo perto daquela fazenda velha e decadente.

Lost Royalty#001.src: Uh... Hi? Err, why did you free me? I'm trying to run away, I hate being the son of the king.
Lost Royalty#001.dst: Hã... Oi? Ahn, por que você me soltou? Estou tentando fugir, odeio ser o filho do rei.

Lost Royalty#002.src: He expects too much of me! I hate politics, and I want to be a great mercenary like Tisaun, to help protect people that can't protect themselves!
Lost Royalty#002.dst: Ele espera demais de mim! Odeio política, e quero ser um grande mercenário como Tisaun, para proteger quem não consegue se proteger!

Lost Royalty#003.src: It's not like my father ever listened to me when I told him. He wouldn't even let me out of the castle.
Lost Royalty#003.dst: Não que meu pai me ouvisse quando eu falava. Ele nem me deixava sair do castelo.

Lost Royalty#004.src: Could you please tell Yavlis that I want to be free? I would be grateful if you could.
Lost Royalty#004.dst: Pode dizer a Yavlis que quero ser livre? Eu ficaria muito grato.

Lost Royalty#005.src: I need my father to know that I want to leave.
Lost Royalty#005.dst: Preciso que meu pai saiba que quero ir embora.

Lost Royalty#007.src: Oh, hello there! I had hoped not to bother you, adventurer, but this is urgent.
Lost Royalty#007.dst: Ah, olá! Eu esperava não te incomodar, aventureiro, mas é urgente.
Lost Royalty#007.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#008.src: You see, the king is very... erm, distracted, and you are just the kind of willing, able-bodied person I need.
Lost Royalty#008.dst: Veja, o rei está muito... hã, distraído, e você é justamente a pessoa disposta e capaz de que preciso.
Lost Royalty#008.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#009.src: You see, the king's son has gone missing, and with him worrying so much, the problems of the city have festered unsolved.
Lost Royalty#009.dst: O filho do rei desapareceu, e com ele tão preocupado, os problemas da cidade apodrecem sem solução.
Lost Royalty#009.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#010.src: We believe he was kidnapped by the splinter cell mercenaries in the jungle... Unfortunate, too. They used to be quite honourable.
Lost Royalty#010.dst: Achamos que ele foi sequestrado pela facção dissidente de mercenários na selva... Uma pena, aliás. Eles eram bem honrados.
Lost Royalty#010.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#011.src: Well, anyway, they're usually spotted outside the run-down farm outside of town. Go there and see what they want in return for the young prince.
Lost Royalty#011.dst: Bem, enfim, eles costumam ser vistos perto da fazenda abandonada fora da cidade. Vá lá e veja o que querem em troca do jovem príncipe.
Lost Royalty#011.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#012.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}
Lost Royalty#012.dst: Fale com o líder mercenário no esconderijo deles fora de {p}

Lost Royalty#013.src: Excuse me?! What are you doing here, how did you find our secret hideout?
Lost Royalty#013.dst: Como é?! O que faz aqui, como achou nosso esconderijo secreto?
Lost Royalty#013.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#014.src: Oh, you're here for the boy? A mighty fine steal, that one! The boy won't be leaving this establishment for free. I'll need some nice loot for him.
Lost Royalty#014.dst: Ah, veio pelo garoto? Um belo roubo, esse! O garoto não sai deste estabelecimento de graça. Vou precisar de um bom saque por ele.
Lost Royalty#014.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#015.src: Ah, but what to have you fetch...oh, haha! This would be a perfect opportunity to obtain that... Alright, ears open!
Lost Royalty#015.dst: Ah, mas o que te mandar buscar...ah, haha! A chance perfeita de pegar aquilo... Certo, ouvidos atentos!
Lost Royalty#015.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#016.src: There's a certain talisman that we aren't able to get to in the temple not far from here. It has special abilities that allow my men to be strengthened, see.
Lost Royalty#016.dst: Há um certo talismã no templo aqui perto que não conseguimos alcançar. Ele tem poderes especiais que fortalecem meus homens, sabe.
Lost Royalty#016.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#017.src: The guardians there pack quite the punch, and there's some nasty mechanism in the way that we just can't crack.
Lost Royalty#017.dst: Os guardiões de lá batem forte, e tem um mecanismo terrível no caminho que não conseguimos desvendar.
Lost Royalty#017.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#018.src: The temple is found just across the waterway, in a crevice in the mountain. It used to be blocked until those WynnExcavation fellows tried digging there.
Lost Royalty#018.dst: O templo fica logo do outro lado do canal, numa fenda na montanha. Estava bloqueado até aqueles caras da WynnExcavation tentarem cavar lá.
Lost Royalty#018.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#019.src: You get that talisman in my hands, and the king's boy is yours. Now off you pip! I'm a very busy man.
Lost Royalty#019.dst: Ponha esse talismã nas minhas mãos e o filho do rei é seu. Agora, xô! Sou um homem muito ocupado.
Lost Royalty#019.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#020.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost Royalty#020.dst: Vá ao templo da selva e recupere o talismã em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Royalty#021.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.
Lost Royalty#021.dst: Leve o talismã de volta ao líder mercenário.

Lost Royalty#022.src: You've gotten the talisman! I can't believe you actually got through that puzzle!
Lost Royalty#022.dst: Você pegou o talismã! Não acredito que passou daquele quebra-cabeça!
Lost Royalty#022.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#023.src: At this point I would usually keep the kid and throw you out of here, but since you've done what I've asked in such a timely fashion, he's all yours.
