Lost Royalty#023.dst: Normalmente eu ficaria com o garoto e te expulsaria daqui, mas como fez o que pedi tão rápido, ele é todo seu.
Lost Royalty#023.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#024.src: When you get back to whoever asked you to do this, tell him to leave my men and I alone! We guildsmen lay down our lives every day, we don't need any more hostile onlookers!
Lost Royalty#024.dst: Quando voltar a quem te mandou, diga pra deixar a mim e meus homens em paz! Nós da guilda arriscamos a vida todo dia, não precisamos de mais olhares hostis!
Lost Royalty#024.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#025.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell
Lost Royalty#025.dst: Fale com o Príncipe de {p} na cela

Lost Royalty#026.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news

Lost Royalty#027.src: Ah, finally! You're back. Did they let you bring him back? Those mercenaries have an awful habit of failing to honour their deals.
Lost Royalty#027.dst: Ah, finalmente! Você voltou. Deixaram você trazê-lo? Esses mercenários têm o péssimo hábito de não honrar acordos.
Lost Royalty#027.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#028.src: Wait, the prince said what? He truly wants to be a mercenary? Oh my... then he must have escaped on his own.
Lost Royalty#028.dst: Espere, o príncipe disse o quê? Quer mesmo ser mercenário? Nossa... então ele fugiu por conta própria.
Lost Royalty#028.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#029.src: Alright then, if that's the path the king's son chooses to walk, then there's nothing we can do.
Lost Royalty#029.dst: Pois bem, se esse é o caminho que o filho do rei escolheu, não há nada que possamos fazer.
Lost Royalty#029.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#030.src: I can only hope that he chose to join them out of a will to protect the people, rather than simply brutishness or money.
Lost Royalty#030.dst: Só posso torcer para que ele tenha se juntado a eles pela vontade de proteger o povo, e não por brutalidade ou dinheiro.
Lost Royalty#030.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#031.src: Such a shame that old guild has stooped to such a level. Well, we must thank you for your help. You can have the emerald ransom we had intended to pay.
Lost Royalty#031.dst: Que pena que aquela velha guilda se rebaixou tanto. Bem, agradecemos sua ajuda. Pode ficar com as esmeraldas do resgate que íamos pagar.
Lost Royalty#031.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Soles#000.src: You can keep them for now but i will need them back if your mission is successful!
Lost Soles#000.dst: Fique com elas por ora, mas vou querer de volta se a missão der certo!

Lost Soles#001.src: Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#001.dst: Lembre-se, é essencial achar o código de {~} dígitos do porão.

Lost Soles#002.src: They hid the boots in the mansion, along with the case. The writer of this diary wrote down some hints as to how to get to them, maybe you can find out what they mean. Here, try this one:
Lost Soles#002.dst: Esconderam as botas na mansão, junto com o estojo. Quem escreveu este diário deixou pistas de como chegar até elas, talvez você descubra o que significam. Tome, tente esta:
Lost Soles#002.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#003.src: Whoever placed down that sign might have meant a secret way up to the second floor. It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#003.dst: Quem pôs aquela placa pode ter falado de um caminho secreto até o segundo andar. Faz um bom tempo que não dá pra subir, desde que a escada desabou. Fora a Leacen, mas ela é meio doida...
Lost Soles#003.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#004.src: Yeah, I've been trying for a while too. I thought I was on to somethin' a couple of times, too! Like in here. Not one of these books opens a hidden passage, can you believe it?
Lost Soles#004.dst: É, eu também tentei por um tempo. Achei que tinha descoberto algo umas vezes! Tipo aqui. Nenhum desses livros abre uma passagem secreta, dá pra acreditar?
Lost Soles#004.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#005.src: Plus, I lost my notebook, so I can't even write down my notes. I just put it on the pillow in the master bedroom for two seconds, and then it disappeared!
Lost Soles#005.dst: E ainda perdi meu caderno, então nem consigo anotar nada. Só deixei ele no travesseiro do quarto principal por dois segundos, e sumiu!
Lost Soles#005.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#006.src: So you have the container and the boots! I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#006.dst: Então você está com o estojo e as botas! Queria ter ido com você...

Lost Soles#007.src: Now that the boots are back in place, we only need to repair the mansion, and we can live normally again!
Lost Soles#007.dst: Agora que as botas voltaram pro lugar, só falta consertar a mansão e podemos viver normalmente de novo!

Lost Soles#008.src: Were you not paying attention earlier?

Lost Soles#009.src: Start by placing your mount in the enclosure. To keep your friend happy and growing you will need to provide it with some tasty food.
Lost Soles#009.dst: Comece colocando sua montaria no cercado. Para manter seu amigo feliz e crescendo, vai precisar dar uma comida gostosa a ele.

Lost Soles#011.src: To breed your mount, simply place two of them in the same row in the Feeder.
Lost Soles#011.dst: Para cruzar sua montaria, basta colocar duas na mesma fileira do comedouro.

Lost Soles#012.src: Talk to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], make sure to bring Abysso Galoshes with you.
Lost Soles#012.dst: Fale com Ferndor em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], e leve as Abysso Galoshes.

Lost Soles#013.src: Have you seen boots called Abysso Galoshes on your journey, a pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the Abysso Galoshes and help us!
Lost Soles#013.dst: Viu umas botas chamadas Abysso Galoshes na sua jornada? Um pirata as roubou de nós anos atrás! Posso te recompensar se trouxer as Abysso Galoshes e nos ajudar!
Lost Soles#013.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#014.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.
Lost Soles#014.dst: Traga as Abysso Galoshes, obtidas na missão Sob as profundezas.

Lost Soles#015.src: I see you have the infamous galoshes with you. But do you know even half of the story of them?
Lost Soles#015.dst: Vejo que está com as infames galochas. Mas conhece sequer metade da história delas?
Lost Soles#015.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#016.src: The boots were once owned by my ancestors, who decided to lock it away in this manor years ago.
Lost Soles#016.dst: As botas já foram dos meus antepassados, que decidiram trancá-las nesta mansão anos atrás.
Lost Soles#016.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#017.src: Nobody knows why they decided to hide the boots just after they got into my family's hands. I was told they were acquired from a strange man with pale grey skin.
Lost Soles#017.dst: Ninguém sabe por que esconderam as botas logo que chegaram às mãos da minha família. Me disseram que foram compradas de um homem estranho de pele cinza-clara.
Lost Soles#017.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#018.src: We think they hid the boots in some kind of basement in the manor. You can get to it by following the river to the waterfall, but you will need some kind of code to open it...
Lost Soles#018.dst: Achamos que esconderam as botas num tipo de porão da mansão. Dá pra chegar seguindo o rio até a cachoeira, mas vai precisar de algum código para abrir...
Lost Soles#018.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#019.src: I remember Grandon saying that he found a book which is apparently a diary from one of my ancestors. Ever since that filthy pirate raided our home and stole our treasures, weird things have been happening.
Lost Soles#019.dst: Lembro do Grandon dizer que achou um livro que parece ser o diário de um dos meus antepassados. Desde que aquele pirata imundo atacou nossa casa e roubou nossos tesouros, coisas estranhas vêm acontecendo.
Lost Soles#019.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#020.src: Grandon should already have finished reading it. If I allow you to enter my home, would you talk to him?
Lost Soles#020.dst: O Grandon já deve ter terminado de ler. Se eu deixar você entrar na minha casa, falaria com ele?
Lost Soles#020.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#021.src: There are strange things going on in this mansion and I hope that book reveals everything we need to know...
Lost Soles#021.dst: Coisas estranhas acontecem nesta mansão e espero que esse livro revele tudo o que precisamos saber...
Lost Soles#021.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#022.src: I almost forgot to give you your boots back, I am not sure if I want to have them near me. Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#022.dst: Quase esqueci de devolver suas botas, não sei se quero elas perto de mim. Lembre-se, é essencial achar o código de {~} dígitos do porão.
Lost Soles#022.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#023.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book
Lost Soles#023.dst: Vá à sala de jantar da mansão e pergunte a Grandon sobre o livro

Lost Soles#024.src: Ferndor sent you here, correct? That must mean you’re here to help find the hidden {~} digit code in the manor.
Lost Soles#024.dst: O Ferndor te mandou aqui, certo? Então você veio ajudar a achar o código oculto de {~} dígitos da mansão.
Lost Soles#024.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#025.src: The book is actually a diary written by our ancestors decades ago. It is actually very interesting, how they remodeled almost the whole house.
Lost Soles#025.dst: O livro é na verdade um diário escrito por nossos antepassados décadas atrás. É bem interessante como reformaram quase a casa toda.
Lost Soles#025.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#026.src: Ferndor probably told you about the boots, right? The diary has some information about them...ah, here, on this page.
Lost Soles#026.dst: O Ferndor deve ter falado das botas, né? O diário tem umas informações sobre elas...ah, aqui, nesta página.
Lost Soles#026.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#027.src: Here...our family bought them from "a dark and mysterious humanoid creature" a long time ago.
Lost Soles#027.dst: Aqui...nossa família as comprou há muito de "uma criatura humanoide sombria e misteriosa".
Lost Soles#027.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#028.src: The boots were apparently so valuable that the creature as part of the deal, said they put some kind of spell on them, but that was a lie.
Lost Soles#028.dst: Pelo visto, as botas eram tão valiosas que a criatura, como parte do acordo, disse ter posto um feitiço nelas, mas era mentira.
Lost Soles#028.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#029.src: It was found that the boots themselves were horrendously powerful, imbued with dark magic that will deteriorate and decay everything around it over time.
Lost Soles#029.dst: Descobriu-se que as próprias botas eram terrivelmente poderosas, imbuídas de magia sombria que deteriora e apodrece tudo ao redor com o tempo.
Lost Soles#029.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#030.src: They were given a special boot container with similar effects, but when the Galoshes are within the Container, they cancel each others' effects out.
Lost Soles#030.dst: Deram a eles um contêiner especial de botas com efeito parecido, mas quando as Galoshes estão no Contêiner, os efeitos se anulam.
Lost Soles#030.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#031.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way".
Lost Soles#031.dst: "O rosto sobre o salão tem o nariz que deve pesar mais para abrir o caminho".
Lost Soles#031.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#032.src: Hmm, all the hints appear in a chapter about this room, the dining hall. Any idea what this meant? It feels like it should be obvious, but I can't for the life of me figure this out.
Lost Soles#032.dst: Hmm, todas as pistas aparecem num capítulo sobre esta sala, o salão de jantar. Alguma ideia do que isso quer dizer? Parece óbvio, mas não consigo entender de jeito nenhum.
Lost Soles#032.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#033.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"
Lost Soles#033.dst: "O rosto sobre o salão tem o nariz que deve pesar mais para abrir o caminho"

Lost Soles#034.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings
Lost Soles#034.dst: Fale com Grandon e conte o que você descobriu

Lost Soles#035.src: A room hidden underneath the big head? Why didn't I think of that!? I always wondered how self-centered they had to be to put that in, but who knew it actually had a valid purpose!
Lost Soles#035.dst: Uma sala escondida embaixo da cabeçona? Como não pensei nisso!? Sempre me perguntei que ego era preciso para pôr aquilo ali, mas quem diria que tinha uma função!
Lost Soles#035.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#036.src: So, there was a sign telling you to look for stone in the corner? Hm...intriguing!
Lost Soles#036.dst: Então uma placa dizia para procurar pedra no canto? Hm... intrigante!
Lost Soles#036.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#037.src: Anyway, seems they guessed that we would have to search for a way to return the boots, and made preparations. Good thing, that.
Lost Soles#037.dst: Enfim, parece que previram que teríamos de achar um jeito de devolver as botas, e se prepararam. Ainda bem.
Lost Soles#037.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#038.src: As I said, the stairs are all broken. I mean, I certainly couldn't climb up those rotten scraps of wood. Suppose it might be best to look for that stone, hm?
Lost Soles#038.dst: Como eu disse, a escada está toda quebrada. Eu é que não subiria por aquela madeira podre. Talvez seja melhor procurar essa pedra, hm?
Lost Soles#038.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#039.src: But where could it be...oh? Is this a hint? I just noticed this on the next page.
Lost Soles#039.dst: Mas onde será que está... oh? Isto é uma pista? Acabei de ver na página seguinte.
Lost Soles#039.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#040.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret".
Lost Soles#040.dst: "O tapete de outra cor vai mostrar a pedra que revela o segredo da mesa".
Lost Soles#040.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#041.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"
Lost Soles#041.dst: "O tapete de outra cor vai mostrar a pedra que revela o segredo da mesa"

Lost Soles#042.src: Sheesh! Quite the engineers, these old fellows! Never would've imagined any of this in the house. Anyway, was there a message? What did it say?
Lost Soles#042.dst: Nossa! Que engenheiros, esses velhos! Nunca imaginaria nada disso na casa. Enfim, tinha alguma mensagem? O que dizia?
Lost Soles#042.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#043.src: The hole nobody wanted? He can only mean the little rat hole in the back part of this hall. Though, it's more just a hole anymore, all the rats are gone.
Lost Soles#043.dst: O buraco que ninguém queria? Só pode ser a toca de rato no fundo deste salão. Se bem que agora é só um buraco, os ratos sumiram.
Lost Soles#043.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#044.src: Well, details, details. We never checked it any more than just laying mouse traps, so I suppose there could be something in there given how complex these contraptions have been.
Lost Soles#044.dst: Bom, detalhes, detalhes. Nunca fizemos mais que pôr ratoeiras ali, então pode haver algo lá dentro, vendo como esses mecanismos são complexos.
Lost Soles#044.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#045.src: I would say, you look into the hole and then search on top of the blue flags!
Lost Soles#045.dst: Eu diria para olhar no buraco e depois procurar em cima das bandeiras azuis!
Lost Soles#045.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#046.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#046.dst: Mas se esse é o caminho ao segundo andar, o que o diário quer dizer com isto?
Lost Soles#046.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#047.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#047.dst: "Jogue algo atrás do mapa na parede para revelar uma parte do código"? Espere, deve ser o código do porão! Volte assim que fizer isso, tenho mais a contar!
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#048.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#048.dst: "Jogue algo atrás do mapa na parede para revelar uma parte do código"

Lost Soles#049.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#049.dst: Você achou uma parte do código!? Haha, excelente! Devo dizer, você avançou mais em minutos do que eu em anos! Vocês humanos são incríveis!
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#050.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#050.dst: Agora o diário diz que você deve ir ao segundo andar para achar os outros {~} dígitos do código.
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#051.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#051.dst: Lembre: para subir ao segundo andar, use o botão da toca de rato para abrir a passagem acima das bandeiras azuis no teto.
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#052.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#052.dst: Não diz onde estão, só que estão bem escondidos e que há mais pistas pela casa. Os outros {~} dígitos devem estar todos no segundo andar! Talvez Leacen tenha visto algo deles quando esteve lá em cima.
Lost Soles#052.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#053.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#053.dst: Quando tiver o código inteiro, vá ao porão. É só seguir o caminho e as placas fora da mansão.
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#054.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#054.dst: Abra a passagem secreta acima das bandeiras enfiando a mão no buraco que ninguém queria

Lost Soles#055.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor
Lost Soles#055.dst: Leve [{~} Boot Container] e [Abysso Galoshes] de volta para Ferndor

Lost Soles#056.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#056.dst: Droga, jurava que um desses livros abriria uma estante secreta... ah, oi, humaninho. Você também conseguiu subir a escada?
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#057.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#057.dst: Uau, uma passagem secreta! Não é tão legal quanto subir escalando, mas bom trabalho! Imagino que você esteja atrás das pistas do código?
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#058.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#058.dst: Seguinte, humaninho. Você ajuda a gente e eu te conto uma coisa que vai te interessar. Que tal?
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#059.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#059.dst: No andar de cima há quartos e uma escada em caracol que começa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Suba até o topo, que leva ao telhado da mansão. A placa fica em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], na beira do telhado, e diz "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#059.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#060.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#060.dst: A placa do segundo dígito é a da etapa {~}: jogue qualquer item no mapa perto de Grandon e verá que o segundo dígito é {~}.
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#061.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#061.dst: No segundo andar, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], há uma porta de ferro com um botão ao lado. Aperte o botão para abrir a porta e entre na salinha; você vai achar uma placa que diz "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". De volta à área fora da porta de ferro, há uma flor azul numa prateleira alta ao lado de um botão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. O botão abre uma escada até um quarto no canto da sala, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. A terceira placa fica na parede desse quarto, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], e diz "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#061.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#062.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#062.dst: No terceiro andar há uma escada que começa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e leva a uma passarela sobre um corredor. Pulando da passarela por um vão na grade do lado norte, você entra num buraquinho com uma placa que diz "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Desça de volta ao Quarto Principal em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e, como a pista sugere, jogue uma esmeralda no travesseiro. Isso abre uma salinha atrás de uma prateleira alta, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], que leva à última placa, que diz "{~} is the fourth". Se não for rápido o bastante para entrar, jogue a esmeralda no travesseiro de cima da prateleira.
Lost Soles#062.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#063.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#063.dst: Você achou o contêiner? Queria ter ido com você...
Lost Soles#063.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#064.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#064.dst: Pelo menos podemos parar a lenta ruína da mansão! Deixa eu pôr as botas no contêiner...
Lost Soles#064.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#065.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#065.dst: Foi fácil. Ainda não acredito que algo tão pequeno cause tanto problema.
Lost Soles#065.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#066.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#066.dst: Bom, não posso deixar você aí parado sem recompensa, né?
Lost Soles#066.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#067.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#067.dst: Tome, que tal umas esmeraldas e estas botas? São relíquias que a guilda Sodeta, antiga dona desta mansão, deu à minha família. Juro que não são malignas! Visite-nos quando quiser!
Lost Soles#067.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#068.src: I wonder where those boots have gone... It's been such a long time. Do you know about the [Abysso Galoshes]?
Lost Soles#068.dst: Para onde terão ido aquelas botas... Faz tanto tempo. Você sabe das [Abysso Galoshes]?
Lost Soles#068.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#069.src: A pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the [Abysso Galoshes] and help us!
Lost Soles#069.dst: Um pirata as roubou de nós anos atrás! Eu te recompenso se trouxer as [Abysso Galoshes] e nos ajudar!
Lost Soles#069.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#070.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost Soles#070.dst: Leve [{~} Boot Container] e [Abysso Galoshes] de volta para Ferndor em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Soles#071.src: It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#071.dst: Faz um bom tempo que não dá para subir, desde que a escada desabou. Tirando a Leacen, mas ela é meio doida...
Lost Soles#071.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#072.src: The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#072.dst: Os outros {~} dígitos devem estar todos no segundo andar! Talvez Leacen tenha visto algo deles quando esteve lá em cima.
Lost Soles#072.speaker: Grandon

Lost Tower#000.src: Hey, adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#000.dst: Ei, aventureiro! Pode me ajudar um instante? Estou com um probleminha nas mãos.
Lost Tower#000.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#001.src: A long time ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#001.dst: Muito tempo atrás, antes de {p} ser destruída, minha família tinha um livro curioso, com saberes sobre lugares e seres de grande poder.
Lost Tower#001.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#005.dst: Infelizmente, uma criatura o roubou durante o ataque que levou à destruição de {p}, e ninguém o viu desde então.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#006.dst: Se quiser ajudar, traga-me [{~} Book of the Bones]; acho que o livro agora está nas mãos de esqueletos, numa velha torre em {p}.
Lost Tower#006.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#007.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#007.dst: Veja se acha essa torre; algum esqueleto lá dentro deve estar com o livro.
Lost Tower#007.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#008.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lost Tower#008.dst: Encontre a torre perdida em {p}, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#009.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.
Lost Tower#009.dst: Encontre o livro na torre e leve-o de volta para Laen.

Lost Tower#010.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#011.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#011.dst: Ótimo! Vai ser bem interessante de ler, obrigado!
Lost Tower#011.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of much importance to you humans, being a villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#000.dst: Por favor, faça algo! Sei que {p} não importa muito pra vocês humanos, é só um povoado, mas... meu filho!
Maltic's Well#000.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#001.dst: Nova missão iniciada: O poço de {p}

similar.text: New Quest Started: {p} Trouble

Maltic's Well#002.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#002.dst: Não sei por que me chamam de bruxa. O pai deste zombou da minha cara, então vou transformar o filho num Grook!
Maltic's Well#002.speaker: Witch

similar.text: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

Maltic's Well#003.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The... the Beast-That-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!!
Maltic's Well#003.dst: ...pois se escolher a porta errada, irá parar diante de uma fera, a mais vil! A... a Fera-Que-Almoça-Guardas-de-{p}!!
Maltic's Well#003.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#004.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing this cowl, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#004.dst: Oh... achei que não ia colar. Sabe, eu nem sou tão boa em magia. Só gosto de usar este capuz, e tenho verrugas.
Maltic's Well#004.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#005.src: I cannot thank you enough for your help!
Maltic's Well#005.dst: Não tenho como agradecer sua ajuda!
Maltic's Well#005.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#006.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#007.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#007.dst: Socorro! Pedimos um guarda de {p} há dias, mas os humanos sempre esquecem esta aldeia.
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#008.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#008.dst: Semana passada, uma bruxa má se abrigou no velho poço. Isso nem seria problema...
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#009.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: Mas ela atraiu meu filho para o poço! Meu único filho! Ele nasceu em Wynn, é cidadão de Wynn!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#010.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#010.dst: Investigue o velho poço de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e leve [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] para Rynend

Maltic's Well#011.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#011.dst: Socorro! Alguém! A bruxa está sendo má!!
Maltic's Well#011.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#012.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#012.dst: Quando mandariam os famosos guardas de {p}, hein? Nunca vão me pegar!
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#013.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#013.dst: Me trate como bruxa e eu ajo como uma, droga! Vai ter que passar pelas minhas terríveis defesas mágicas pra me achar!
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#014.dst: Oh... droga. Nunca acertei esse feitiço. Bem, agora vai ter que adivinhar o caminho, hã, seu tolo! Volte já, pois, hã...
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#015.dst: Se o povo desta aldeia não fosse tão cruel comigo, eu não teria sido obrigada a morar aqui.
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#016.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#016.dst: Sei que é crime, mas o pai dele e os aldeões me caçam como se eu fosse um cão raivoso!
Maltic's Well#016.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#017.dst: Eu nem ia transformar o menino num Grook. Duvido que conseguisse fazer nascer uma pena nele. Olha só...
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.dst: Aiiii! O que está havendo comigooo?!
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#019.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#019.dst: ...minha nossa, funcionou???? Funcionou, fiz um feitiço uma vez na vida miserável!!
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#020.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#020.dst: E-Espere, isso não é nada bom, você vai... Não! Você não me tira daqui com vida!
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#021.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#021.dst: Obrigado por me salvar da bruxa... No começo ela era legal e fazia biscoitos, mas agora quero ir para casa.
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#022.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#022.dst: Meu filho! O que houve lá embaixo? Hã, não era uma bruxa?
Maltic's Well#022.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#023.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#023.dst: Absurdo! Ela usava chapéu e tinha verrugas! Acho que agora é tarde... Muito obrigado pela ajuda.
Maltic's Well#023.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#024.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#024.dst: Tenho pouco a oferecer de recompensa... Espero que minha gratidão baste!
Maltic's Well#024.speaker: Rynend

Master Piece#000.src: Look in your content book! I wrote the locations of the legendary creatures.
Master Piece#000.dst: Olhe no seu livro de conteúdo! Anotei onde estão as criaturas lendárias.

Master Piece#001.src: This is...just a normal cow. This is supposed to be legendary?
Master Piece#001.dst: Isto é... só uma vaca normal. Isto é para ser lendário?

Master Piece#002.src: ...Caissop seemed to be looking forward to this painting a lot...

Master Piece#003.src: ...well, if he's blind, maybe you can fudge the details to give him something better.
Master Piece#003.dst: ...bem, se ele é cego, talvez dê para enfeitar os detalhes e dar algo melhor.

Master Piece#006.src: That sounds like a villager to you.

Master Piece#007.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he'll buy it.
Master Piece#007.dst: Hora de voltar ao Caissop. Tomara que ele acredite.

Master Piece#008.src: This is just a normal sheep! Are none of these supposed creatures really legendary?
Master Piece#008.dst: É só uma ovelha normal! Nenhuma dessas criaturas é lendária de verdade?

Master Piece#009.src: You'll need to lie about something to make a mundane sheep seem special...
Master Piece#009.dst: Vai ter que mentir sobre algo para uma ovelha comum parecer especial...

Master Piece#010.src: It has large horns- no, say it's just one.
Master Piece#010.dst: Chifres grandes... não, diga que é um só.

Master Piece#011.src: Clean white wool, instead of black...
Master Piece#011.dst: Lã branca e limpa, em vez de preta...

Master Piece#012.src: A pure white sheep with one horn...?
Master Piece#012.dst: Uma ovelha branca com um só chifre...?

Master Piece#013.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully that's good enough for him.
Master Piece#013.dst: Hora de voltar ao Caissop. Tomara que isso baste para ele.

Master Piece#014.src: Snowy white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#014.dst: Branca como neve, um chifre... Uma Ovelha Unicórnio?!
Master Piece#014.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#015.src: ...OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#015.dst: ...OH, NÃO, NÃO. SIM! MAIS COR, MAIS TINTA! ACABOU O VERMELHO!

Master Piece#016.src: The creatures guarding these animals seem more legendary to you.
Master Piece#016.dst: As criaturas que guardam esses animais parecem mais lendárias.

Master Piece#017.src: No way you can describe a pig fantastically. You'll have to outright make something up...
Master Piece#017.dst: Não tem como descrever um porco de forma fantástica. Vai ter que inventar tudo...

Master Piece#018.src: Pink is fine, it's a rare color...
Master Piece#018.dst: Rosa serve, é uma cor rara...

Master Piece#019.src: ...what if you say it has wings?
Master Piece#019.dst: ...e se você disser que tem asas?

Master Piece#020.src: Will he believe a flying pig?

Master Piece#021.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he won't be able to tell something's amiss.
Master Piece#021.dst: Hora de voltar ao Caissop. Tomara que ele não perceba nada de errado.

Master Piece#022.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#022.dst: Fale com Caissop, o artista, na tenda dele em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#024.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#024.dst: Ah, desculpe, não te vi. Quer um autógrafo?
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#025.dst: Como não? Não sabe quem eu sou?! Parece que não tem gosto artístico... Eu sou Caissop, o artista lendário!
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#026.dst: Mas, já que não é um fã... Talvez possa me ajudar? Procuro um novo assistente.
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#027.dst: Excelente... Preciso de ajuda para achar três criaturas lendárias escondidas em cavernas do pântano.
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#028.dst: Eu sei onde estão, mas, infelizmente, sou... cego.
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#029.dst: Para trabalhar, preciso imaginá-las! Aí entra você. Preciso que as encontre e as descreva para mim!
Master Piece#029.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#030.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#030.dst: Vai dar as costas a um cego?! Preciso de uma descrição exata delas! Quando achar uma, volte e me descreva tudo nos mínimos detalhes!
Master Piece#030.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#031.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#031.dst: A primeira caverna fica num morro com flores altas de folhas finas. Cheiram a rosa, disso tenho certeza.
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#032.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#032.dst: Procure a primeira criatura mítica na caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#033.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#033.dst: Volte e descreva a Caissop a criatura marrom de focinho grande

Master Piece#034.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#035.dst: Marrom... narigudo... Uma Vaca Aldeã, você diz!?
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#038.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#038.dst: Haha! Isto é MARAVILHOSO! Só vou mostrar quando estiver pronto!
Master Piece#038.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#039.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#039.dst: Saboreie as ideias! Agora, vá até a segunda caverna...
Master Piece#039.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#040.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#040.dst: Fica junto a uma estrada, com flores baixas de cálice redondo. Cheiram a laranja!
Master Piece#040.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#041.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.dst: Corra! Termino este bicho enquanto você vai. OH, SIM. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#042.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#042.dst: Procure a segunda fera mítica na caverna em [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#043.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#043.dst: Volte e descreva a Caissop a criatura branca de chifre grande

Master Piece#044.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#044.dst: Chegou! Rápido! Não olhe para mim, descreva!
Master Piece#044.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#046.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.dst: ...OH SIM, A LÃ É REAL... MAIS PINCELADAS... OH SIM, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#047.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#047.dst: ... ISTO É ÚNICO, NOTÁVEL, SIM. SOBRENATURAL!
Master Piece#047.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#048.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#048.dst: A última! Flores com cheiro de vermelho, espinhos, rápido, mucho inspirado!
Master Piece#048.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#050.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#050.dst: VOU USAR MEU SANGUE! OH! SIM! ...INSPIRADO! NOTÁVEL! Hein? Por que ainda está aqui? Vá! Preciso da última descrição!
Master Piece#050.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#051.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#051.dst: Procure o terceiro e último animal mítico na caverna em [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#052.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#052.dst: Volte e descreva a Caissop a criatura rosa voadora

Master Piece#053.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#053.dst: Enfim voltou! Acabei de terminar o último. Vá! Descreva!
Master Piece#053.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#056.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#056.dst: ...OH SIM, ASAS! OLHOS DO CÉU! OH, SIM.
Master Piece#056.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#057.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#057.dst: Oh, perfeito. O toque final e, pronto! Você me inspirou tanto que fiz dois! Um para você e um para mim!
Master Piece#057.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#058.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#058.dst: Melhor guardar isso: aldeões ricos das cidades grandes pagam uma fortuna pela obra de Caissop!
Master Piece#058.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#059.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#059.dst: Obrigado pela ajuda, que adrenalina! Boa sorte na sua aventura por Gavel!
Master Piece#059.speaker: Caissop

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: So, how is it going? Did you find Nick in the slum?
Meaningful Holiday#000.dst: E aí, como vai? Achou o Nick no cortiço?

Meaningful Holiday#001.src: You should follow Nick and hop in the portal right there!
Meaningful Holiday#001.dst: Você devia seguir o Nick e pular naquele portal ali!

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I can't wait for the feast to be served. It's always magnificent.
Meaningful Holiday#002.dst: Mal posso esperar pelo banquete. É sempre magnífico.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: You want me to donate food? I'm just a guest here.
Meaningful Holiday#003.dst: Quer que eu doe comida? Sou só um convidado aqui.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: You want food for the poor? They should get jobs and help themselves!
Meaningful Holiday#004.dst: Quer comida para os pobres? Que arranjem emprego e se virem!

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Why should I help them if they don't help themselves?
Meaningful Holiday#005.dst: Por que eu ajudaria quem não se ajuda?

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: I can't give away free food! This is the biggest feast of the year!
Meaningful Holiday#006.dst: Não posso dar comida de graça! É o maior banquete do ano!

Meaningful Holiday#007.src: You should go and ask charities for that.
Meaningful Holiday#007.dst: Peça isso às instituições de caridade.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#008.dst: Se quer ajudar alguém este ano, nosso chefe Nick já está na linha de frente.
Meaningful Holiday#008.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#010.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.dst: Foi mal, mas tá tudo vendido, todo mundo se arrumando pro Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#010.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#011.dst: Talvez tenha algo no sótão, se achar alguma coisa, pode ficar. Sei como a coisa aperta.
Meaningful Holiday#011.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.
Meaningful Holiday#013.dst: Parece que tô sem comida. Mal dá pra eu mesmo comer.
Meaningful Holiday#013.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#014.dst: Ah, e pode dar este cobertor para a Margaret quando passar pelo túnel? É só seguir a estrada atrás de mim.
Meaningful Holiday#014.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#016.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#016.dst: Ah, por favor, não me mande embora. Não tenho para onde ir!
Meaningful Holiday#016.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#017.dst: Oi! Acabei de enfeitar esta árvore de Craftmas!
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: Roubar não é o espírito do Craftmas... Mas acho que dá para aproveitar.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: Meus irmãos e eu cuidamos do povo no Craftmas. Minha área é o deserto de {p}. Pode me chamar de Papai Noel das Dunas, he.
Meaningful Holiday#021.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: Olá, querido. Sou a Haily. Prazer em conhecer.
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: Este é o centro de caridade de {p}. Buscamos voluntários para ajudar os sem-teto este ano.
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: Ele é um homem muito especial. Vou anotar onde ele está no seu livro. Ah, lembre que é caridade, então espero que a gratidão baste como recompensa.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#026.dst: Vá falar com Nick, amigo de Haily, na área pobre.

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: Oh. Oh... Ai, ai. Tem mais gente aqui do que nunca.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: Hm, está só de passagem? Oh! Um voluntário!
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#029.dst: Você é o único este ano. As coisas mudaram mesmo. Antes tínhamos centenas de voluntários nesta época.
Meaningful Holiday#029.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#030.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#030.dst: O povo aqui passa fome. Não há outro jeito de dizer.
Meaningful Holiday#030.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#031.dst: Não sei como vamos alimentar todo mundo este ano.
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#032.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#032.dst: O dono da loja barata já foi sem-teto... Ele sabe o que eles passam.
Meaningful Holiday#032.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: Eu cuido das coisas aqui. Pode ir à loja barata? É bem perto. Qualquer comida é bem-vinda.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: Vá à loja barata e peça comida.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#039.dst: Hm... Esta maçã já viu dias melhores...
Meaningful Holiday#039.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#040.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#040.dst: Queria ter algo para dar este ano. Acho que o povo da cidade está num banquete.
Meaningful Holiday#040.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.
Meaningful Holiday#041.dst: Volte ao Nick e dê a má notícia.

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#044.dst: Não posso ficar chateado. Ele doa tanto no resto do ano.
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: Talvez tenhamos de pedir aos fazendeiros...
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: Conheço alguém em {p} de bom coração.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: Já brigamos antes, parece que ele não entendeu o que é doação.
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Há um atalho ao sul daqui, numa caverna. Passe por lá.
Meaningful Holiday#048.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: Leve o cobertor à mulher no túnel ao sul de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: Oh, um cobertor para mim? Que gentil... Do Nick, é? Ele é sempre tão bondoso... Obrigada também.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: Se quiser chegar rápido a {p}, siga por este túnel. Alguns sem-teto nada amigáveis vivem por aqui, então cuidado. É tão triste ver como estão.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: Siga pelo túnel e encontre o amigo de Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: Bem-vindo à fazenda! Quer comprar colheitas frescas?
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: Bom, parece que deu azar. Acabei de vender o resto desta colheita.
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: Foi tudo para aquele grande banquete de Craftmas em {p}. Queria ajudar, mas não tenho mais comida para vender.
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: Espere, aposto que o Nick te mandou, né? Olha, ele vem pela esquerda. Lembre a ele que isto não é caridade.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: Nenhuma comida? Estamos ficando sem opções...
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: Bem, nesta época só resta uma pessoa a quem apelar.
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#061.dst: Explore a área e procure o Papai Noel.

Meaningful Holiday#063.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#063.dst: Ele está descendo a escada, à direita.
Meaningful Holiday#063.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#064.dst: Entre na casa do Papai Noel e fale com ele.

Meaningful Holiday#066.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#066.dst: Cada membro do conselho cuida de uma área. A sua é {p}. Como cuida dela é sua responsabilidade.
Meaningful Holiday#066.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: Há cinco vezes mais sem-teto e famintos que ano passado!
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: Nick, sei que lá está difícil, mas-
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Difícil?! Está impossível! Cadê a boa vontade do povo? Tive um voluntário este ano! UM!
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: Sinto muito, Nick. Vá a {p} pedir lá, eles têm um banquete que alimentaria um exército!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: Hmmm... Ah, perdão. Calculei mal sua viagem até aqui. Bom te ver.
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: Imagino que ouviu o Papai Noel e eu. Vamos para {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Certo, está resolvido. Saia pela lareira atrás de mim, ela te leva direto a {p}. Boa sorte, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: Saia pelo portal atrás do Papai Noel.

Meaningful Holiday#076.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#076.dst: Uau. Esse povo vive no luxo. Será que sabem que no leste há gente passando fome?
Meaningful Holiday#076.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#078.dst: E, mais importante, tomara que dividam um pouco de comida.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: Nem estão em traje de gala.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#084.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#084.dst: Comida? Querem comida? Isto parece caridade para vocês?
Meaningful Holiday#084.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#085.dst: Claro que não! Devemos alimentar nossos convidados, não uns pobres coitados do deserto!
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: Agora saiam antes que eu chame os golens de segurança. E nem pensem em roubar da cozinha!
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: Roube a comida da cozinha e fale com Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#088.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#089.dst: Conseguiu?! Não esperava tanta generosidade, uma caixa inteira?
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#092.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#092.dst: Vá na frente. Tenho um plano. Calma, vou devolver toda esta comida.
Meaningful Holiday#092.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#095.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#095.dst: Sei que têm fome. Eu também.
Meaningful Holiday#095.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#096.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#096.dst: Mas o jantar não será servido hoje.
Meaningful Holiday#096.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#097.dst: Não haverá banquete de Craftmas este ano!
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#099.dst: A comida da mesa não dá para todos aqui!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#100.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#100.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: É assim que milhares vivem todo dia.
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: Com fome, sem saber quando haverá comida.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#103.dst: E enquanto estão aí de estômago vazio, agradeçam o que têm. Pensem em quem não tem nada.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: Centenas de homens, mulheres e crianças, como vocês, não vão comer nada hoje.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: Tudo porque este enorme banquete não bastava. {p} comprou toda a comida, barata ou cara.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: Vim lembrar o verdadeiro sentido deste dia. Pensar nos outros..
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: Vou devolver o jantar de vocês, mas enquanto comem... quero que lembrem de cada boca vazia que ele poderia alimentar.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: Dividam o que têm, agradeçam o que recebem.
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: Bem, parece que você conseguiu de novo, Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: Vim ver se podia ajudar. Mas parece que você já resolveu.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#111.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#111.dst: Bem, acho que só falta uma coisa para completar a cena.
Meaningful Holiday#111.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#112.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: Parece que meu discursinho trouxe os ricos de volta à terra.
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#115.dst: Deram metade do banquete. Acredita que ainda sobrou?
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#116.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#116.dst: Toda aquela comida, direto pro lixo.
Meaningful Holiday#116.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: Não fazem ideia do que têm, comparados a essa gente pobre.
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: Quer saber como conheço o Papai Noel? Ele é meu irmão.
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#119.dst: É gente como você que mantém vivo o verdadeiro sentido desta data. A cada ano fica mais difícil, com o sentido distorcido. Aqui, um presente meu. Obrigado.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Memory Paranoia#000.src: You can't quite make out the messy scribbles in the journal, but it looks very intense.
Memory Paranoia#000.dst: Você não consegue decifrar os rabiscos bagunçados do diário, mas parecem bem intensos.

Memory Paranoia#001.src: The check is made out to a charity for a rather large amount of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#001.dst: O cheque é para uma caridade, de uma quantia bem grande de esmeraldas.

similar.text: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.

Memory Paranoia#003.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment... could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#003.dst: Oh, um humano? Se me der licença um momento... posso falar com você sobre a mansão aqui?
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we're not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but... things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.dst: Mas... Com o tempo... Hã, não sabemos bem o que houve, só surgiram boatos ao longo dos anos, mas... a coisa mudou, digamos.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah... How shall I put this... One day they were all... discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.dst: Porque, aah... Como dizer... Um dia, foram todos... encontrados mortos. Assassinados. Uns pelos outros.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: Since, erm... Since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#006.dst: Como, hã... Como não sobrou ninguém vivo para avisar, só descobriram dias depois, quando um viajante de passagem reparou na mansão.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Yet, I am... scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there... Cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#007.dst: Mas eu... tenho medo deste lugar. São as ruínas da vida que eu deveria ter tido. Os espíritos dos mortos ainda estão lá... Malditos. Preciso que outro descubra minha herança.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: It's so kind of the Caritats to donate these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#008.dst: Que bondade dos Caritat doar esses suprimentos ao povo sofrido da floresta.

similar.text: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Mr. Caritat is always writing so intensely in that book... I do wonder what he could be saying.
Memory Paranoia#009.dst: O senhor Caritat escreve tão intensamente naquele livro... O que será que ele escreve?

Memory Paranoia#010.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us or something. He can't be as nice as he appears, no one is!
Memory Paranoia#010.dst: Aposto que ele escreve insultos sobre nós ou algo assim. Ninguém é tão bonzinho quanto parece!
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Maid

similar.text: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.

Memory Paranoia#011.src: Come on, Timmy. Mr. Caritat is crazily sweet. I doubt he'd be upset, even if you'd thrown it down there on purpose.
Memory Paranoia#011.dst: Ora, Timmy. O senhor Caritat é um doce. Duvido que ficasse bravo, mesmo se você jogasse aquilo lá de propósito.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: Mr. Caritat looks very engrossed in his writing... you best not disturb him.
Memory Paranoia#013.dst: O senhor Caritat parece absorto na escrita... melhor não incomodar.

Memory Paranoia#014.src: I've forgotten, where should I look for my Library Key?
Memory Paranoia#014.dst: Esqueci, onde devo procurar minha Library Key?

Memory Paranoia#015.src: The drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, you should check there.
Memory Paranoia#015.dst: Os canos de esgoto já devem ter levado a chave ao porão no canto sudeste da mansão, olhe lá.

similar.text: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.

Memory Paranoia#016.src: Page {~}: The Caritats are as nice as people say. They're some of the kindest people I've ever met, let alone work for.
Memory Paranoia#016.dst: Página {~}: Os Caritat são tão bons quanto dizem. Das pessoas mais bondosas que já conheci, ainda mais como patrões.

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Page {~}: That Timmy boy has been acting rather unusual lately... Uncharacteristically hostile. I wonder what's come over him.
Memory Paranoia#017.dst: Página {~}: O garoto Timmy anda estranho ultimamente... Hostil, o que não é do feitio dele. O que será que deu nele?

Memory Paranoia#018.src: Page {~}: I've been hearing strange noises at night. Scratching, and sometimes yelling... I do hope nothing bad is going on.
Memory Paranoia#018.dst: Página {~}: Tenho ouvido ruídos estranhos à noite. Arranhões e às vezes gritos... Espero que nada de ruim aconteça.

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Page {~}: I don't even know how this happened, but Timmy performed dark magic. He shot a fireball! The north wall of the library was wrecked!
Memory Paranoia#019.dst: Página {~}: Nem sei como foi, mas Timmy usou magia sombria. Lançou uma bola de fogo! A parede norte da biblioteca ficou destruída!

Memory Paranoia#020.src: It appears that all of the pages have been torn out...
Memory Paranoia#020.dst: Parece que todas as páginas foram arrancadas...

Memory Paranoia#021.src: Aw man, I can't believe I'm not allowed to sit with the adults. I'm nearly twelve!
Memory Paranoia#021.dst: Ah, não acredito que não posso sentar com os adultos. Tenho quase doze anos!

Memory Paranoia#022.src: They appear to be chatting about local politics.

Memory Paranoia#024.src: It's been depleted of its magic. How disappointing.

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Thank you very much, Father, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#025.dst: Muito obrigado, pai, e a todos aqui. Um brinde a mais anos de saúde-
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#026.src: My god... What is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#026.dst: Meu deus... O que há de errado aqui? Faça o que eu fizer, tente o que tentar...
Memory Paranoia#026.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#027.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you... Were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#027.dst: ...Timothy, vou te perguntar algo, e preciso que responda com sinceridade. Foi... Foi você o responsável por isto?
Memory Paranoia#027.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Never, never!! That study is off-limits to everyone, even your mother! If I had known back then, I'd... I'd have... urgh...
Memory Paranoia#028.dst: Nunca, nunca!! Aquele escritório é proibido a todos, até à sua mãe! Se eu soubesse na época, eu... eu teria... argh...

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Page {~}: DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH DEATH.
Memory Paranoia#029.dst: Pág. {~}: MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE MORTE.

Memory Paranoia#030.src: Page {~}: There is a dark power beyond our control within this mansion. There is no use trying to fight it.
Memory Paranoia#030.dst: Página {~}: Há um poder sombrio fora do nosso controle nesta mansão. Não adianta tentar combatê-lo.

Memory Paranoia#031.src: Page {~}: I felt like all of the skulls were watching me. I have had to turn them all towards the fireplace.
Memory Paranoia#031.dst: Página {~}: Senti que todas as caveiras me observavam. Tive de virá-las todas para a lareira.

Memory Paranoia#032.src: THAT WHICH STARTED THIS WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#032.dst: O QUE COMEÇOU ESTA GUERRA SE ERGUERÁ OUTRA VEZ. DO REINO DAS SOMBRAS, DO ENGANO E DA DOR.
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#033.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. SHALL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#033.dst: PRESO PARA SEMPRE DE ONDE VEIO. PELO PONTO FRACO ENTRE REINOS ELE. SE. ERGUERÁ. DE NOVO!
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Dear Anton, the chandelier fell in the main hall. Please fix it as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#034.dst: Caro Anton, o lustre do salão principal caiu. Por favor, conserte-o o quanto antes.

Memory Paranoia#035.src: FROM SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#035.dst: DO SOLO MALDITO QUE O SERVO DEITOU
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#036.src: All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both. Something happened here all those years ago... I want to know what.
Memory Paranoia#036.dst: Você só precisa entrar lá e achar respostas. Tenho certeza de que o passado não vai assombrar nós dois. Algo aconteceu aqui há tantos anos... Quero saber o quê.

Memory Paranoia#037.src: I don't think it's wise you enter the mansion ever again...
Memory Paranoia#037.dst: Não acho sensato você entrar naquela mansão de novo...

Memory Paranoia#039.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#039.dst: Nem sempre foi tão arruinada. Já foi imponente, um monumento à família Caritat, que a ergueu desde os alicerces.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#040.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#040.dst: Os Caritat não eram como os outros. Altruístas e prestativos como poucos. Para eles, sua riqueza era a riqueza de todos.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#041.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#041.dst: Sou o último descendente, Atisun Caritat. Fui o único sobrevivente do... incidente. Era só um bebê quando um passante me achou.
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#042.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#042.dst: Não acredito que minha família simplesmente enlouqueceu, mas não sei o que houve. Quero a verdade. Acho que esta mansão ainda guarda as respostas que procuro.
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#043.dst: Não se preocupe, como meus ancestrais, sou um homem generoso. Se me ajudar, vou te recompensar bem. Você só precisa entrar lá e achar respostas. O passado não vai assombrar nós dois.
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.
Memory Paranoia#045.dst: Descubra a história da família Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#046.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#046.dst: O cheque é para uma caridade, de muitas esmeraldas.
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#047.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#047.dst: Que bonito os Caritat doarem todos estes suprimentos ao povo sofrido da floresta.
Memory Paranoia#047.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#048.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#048.dst: Ele parece bem absorto na escrita.
Memory Paranoia#048.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#049.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#049.dst: Ouvi falar de coisas estranhas na casa. Dizem que a mansão pode ser assombrada!
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#050.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#050.dst: Fantasmas? Absurdo! Esta mansão não é assombrada, não acredite nesses boatos bobos!
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#051.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#051.dst: O senhor Caritat vive escrevendo naquele livro, sempre tão intenso. O que será que escreve?
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#052.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#052.dst: Nem para mim ele conta o que escreve.
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#053.dst: Deixei cair minha Library Key no ralo sem querer, acha que meu pai vai ficar bravo?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#054.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#054.dst: Não, o senhor Caritat perdoa fácil. Duvido que fique bravo, ainda mais se foi acidente.
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#055.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#055.dst: Mas ainda quero achar a chave, sabe onde devo procurar?
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#056.dst: Bem, a esta altura os canos de esgoto já devem ter levado a chave ao porão no canto sudeste da mansão, deve estar lá.
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.
Memory Paranoia#057.dst: Entre no porão e recupere a Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#059.src: Enter the hole in the wall.

Memory Paranoia#060.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#060.dst: Timmy, algo te incomoda? Você anda tão estranho ultimamente.
Memory Paranoia#060.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#061.dst: Você não me dá ordens, mortal! Você e toda a sua espécie inferior se curvarão à escuridão!
Memory Paranoia#061.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#062.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#062.dst: Não sei que jogo é esse, Timmy. Mas não vou mais tolerar isso, volte a si!
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Timmy
