Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. Prefiro morder o derrière de uma mula! Isto... nem um Gert tocaria!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Vejo que não melhorou na arte da culinária. Deixe-me em paz e volte quando souber o que é boa comida!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: Vejo que voltou, e não de mãos vazias. Por favor, mostre-me o que criou!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: Uma torta? Ora, deve ter tido a ajuda do Frank. Ele sempre teve um fraco por tortas!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: Vejo que suas compétences culinaires estão muito bem desenvolvidas!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Ainda não vou chamá-lo de mestre-cuca, mas você é très bien! Leve esta recompensa como parabéns!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#141.src: Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#141.dst: Aventureiro! Você ainda não falou com Brie, Kale ou Frank, fale com eles antes de escolher com quem trabalhar.
Recipe For Disaster#141.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#142.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
Recipe For Disaster#142.dst: E aí, mano. Sou o Frank. Muito prazer.
Recipe For Disaster#142.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#144.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
Recipe For Disaster#144.dst: Ainda aqui? Só... vá jogar conversa fora com outro, Ainda aqui? Só... vá jogar conversa fora com outropor favor.
Recipe For Disaster#144.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#145.src: You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
Recipe For Disaster#145.dst: Você falou com os três cozinheiros, deveria voltar ao Hamsey.

Recipe For Disaster#146.src: Which chef you would like to cook with?
Recipe For Disaster#146.dst: Com qual cozinheiro gostaria de cozinhar?

Recipe For Disaster#148.src: Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
Recipe For Disaster#148.dst: Não rolou sintonia comigo? Sem problema! Com certeza vai se sair bem com quem for.
Recipe For Disaster#148.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#149.src: Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
Recipe For Disaster#149.dst: Graças ao grook que não me escolheu. Céus, não preciso de outro amador me atrasando.
Recipe For Disaster#149.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#150.src: Collect [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#150.dst: Colete [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#151.src: Collect [{~} Voidroot] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#151.dst: Colete [{~} Voidroot] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#152.src: Collect [{~} Moonsalt] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#152.dst: Colete [{~} Moonsalt] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#153.src: Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#153.dst: Colete [{~} Snail Slime] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#154.src: Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#154.dst: Colete [{~} Cogumelo falante] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#155.src: Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#155.dst: Colete [{~} Farinha da alvorada] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#156.src: Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#156.dst: Colete [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consulte seu livro de receitas.

Recipe For Disaster#157.src: You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!
Recipe For Disaster#157.dst: Você não deveria entrar em salas privadas sem ser convidado!

Recipe For Disaster#158.src: How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
Recipe For Disaster#158.dst: Como vai a culinária?! Se perdeu seu livro de receitas, é só pedir outra cópia ao seu cozinheiro!

Recipe For Disaster#159.src: Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.dst: Siga-me até a cozinha, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#160.src: You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
Recipe For Disaster#160.dst: Você precisa de [{~} Sunrise Wheat] para refinar no moinho!
Recipe For Disaster#160.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#161.src: You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
Recipe For Disaster#161.dst: Você conseguiu colher Sunrise Wheat - deveria refiná-lo no moinho do padeiro.

Recipe For Disaster#162.src: Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
Recipe For Disaster#162.dst: Parece que você conseguiu escapar com o ovo... essa foi por pouco!

Recipe For Disaster#163.src: Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?

Recipe For Disaster#166.src: You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
Recipe For Disaster#166.dst: Sua viagem à ilha já está paga, é só pular no canhão da ilha bem do meu lado!
Recipe For Disaster#166.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#167.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
Recipe For Disaster#167.dst: Você reuniu todos os ingredientes, deveria voltar ao Frank.

Recipe For Disaster#168.src: You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
Recipe For Disaster#168.dst: Não pule nas ilhas sem falar com o vendedor de framboesas!

Recipe For Disaster#169.src: You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
Recipe For Disaster#169.dst: Você vê Hamsey começar a provar seu prato... será que está à altura dele?

Recipe For Disaster#171.src: Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#171.dst: De volta ao meu restaurante, aventureiro!
Recipe For Disaster#171.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#172.src: Good to see you again, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#172.dst: Bom te ver de novo, mano!
Recipe For Disaster#172.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#173.src: Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
Recipe For Disaster#173.dst: Ah. Voltou. Só fique fora do meu caminho, estou cozinhando de verdade.
Recipe For Disaster#173.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#174.src: Hey! Nice to see you again.
Recipe For Disaster#174.dst: Oi! Bom te ver de novo.
Recipe For Disaster#174.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#175.src: Welcome back, mon ami! Alas, running a restaurant is busy work, so I can't talk for long. Maybe take a seat in the restaurant?
Recipe For Disaster#175.dst: Bem-vindo, mon ami! Infelizmente, um restaurante dá muito trabalho, não posso conversar muito. Que tal sentar no salão?
Recipe For Disaster#175.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#176.src: Hey, again! I'd love to chat, but you should talk to the other chefs before making your decision!
Recipe For Disaster#176.dst: Oi de novo! Adoraria conversar, mas fale com os outros cozinheiros antes de decidir!
Recipe For Disaster#176.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#177.src: Please go and talk to the other chefs first before you decide to weigh me down with your "assistance".
Recipe For Disaster#177.dst: Por favor, vá falar com os outros cozinheiros antes de decidir me atrasar com sua "assistência".
Recipe For Disaster#177.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#178.src: Can't wait to work with you man, tell the big man we're working together and we can get started.
Recipe For Disaster#178.dst: Mal posso esperar pra cozinhar com você, cara, avisa o chefão que somos dupla e a gente começa.
Recipe For Disaster#178.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#179.src: I still can't believe you chose to "work" with me. Make yourself useful and go and tell the Chef. I certainly won't.
Recipe For Disaster#179.dst: Ainda não acredito que você escolheu "trabalhar" comigo. Seja útil e vá avisar o Chef. Eu é que não vou.
Recipe For Disaster#179.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#180.src: You should go tell Hamsey who you've chosen to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#180.dst: Vá dizer ao Hamsey com quem decidiu trabalhar!
Recipe For Disaster#180.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#181.src: It is time to cook, mon ami! Head over to your chef and ask them what to do.
Recipe For Disaster#181.dst: É hora de cozinhar, mon ami! Vá até seu cozinheiro e pergunte o que fazer.
Recipe For Disaster#181.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#182.src: No sweat, man, I probably wouldn't choose me either. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#182.dst: Relaxa, cara, eu também não me escolheria. Boa sorte!
Recipe For Disaster#182.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#184.src: Hey! How's the ingredient gathering going? Remember to check your recipe book if you're stuck!
Recipe For Disaster#184.dst: Oi! Como vai a coleta de ingredientes? Se travar, consulte seu livro de receitas!
Recipe For Disaster#184.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#185.src: Need another recipe book? No problem! I keep plenty of spares, you never know what might happen!
Recipe For Disaster#185.dst: Outro livro de receitas? Sem problema! Tenho várias cópias, nunca se sabe o que pode acontecer!
Recipe For Disaster#185.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#186.src: The announcer seems to lose his train of thought.
Recipe For Disaster#186.dst: O locutor parece perder o fio da meada.

Recipe For Disaster#187.src: Would you like to race Usnail Bolt?

Recipe For Disaster#188.src: You shouldn't leave the race before it's finished!
Recipe For Disaster#188.dst: Não saia da corrida antes de terminar!
Recipe For Disaster#188.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#189.src: You've clearly won the race, but everyone seems to be waiting for Usnail Bolt to finish as well...
Recipe For Disaster#189.dst: Você claramente venceu a corrida, mas todos parecem esperar Usnail Bolt terminar também...
Recipe For Disaster#189.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#190.src: Looks like this is that "Space Wizard"'s tower... you should start looking around for some Moonsalt.
Recipe For Disaster#190.dst: Parece que esta é a torre daquele "Mago Espacial"... comece a procurar Moonsalt.

Recipe For Disaster#191.src: A large warning on the display flashes a "LOW FUEL " warning at you.
Recipe For Disaster#191.dst: Um grande aviso de "COMBUSTÍVEL BAIXO" pisca na tela.

Recipe For Disaster#192.src: You need [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] to refine into "burnmilk fuel". Perhaps the Humyn nearby knows how to get some?
Recipe For Disaster#192.dst: Precisa de [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] para refinar em "queimaleite". Talvez o Humyno ali saiba onde achar?

Recipe For Disaster#193.src: Looks like this is the Moonsalt Cave... you should head deeper to find some salt.
Recipe For Disaster#193.dst: Parece que esta é a Caverna do Moonsalt... avance mais para achar sal.

Recipe For Disaster#194.src: You grab a large handful of the unrefined salt.
Recipe For Disaster#194.dst: Você pega um bom punhado do sal não refinado.

Recipe For Disaster#195.src: You've secured some Unrefined Moonsalt, time to head back to the village and your way home.
Recipe For Disaster#195.dst: Você conseguiu Unrefined Moonsalt, hora de voltar à aldeia e seguir para casa.

Recipe For Disaster#196.src: You've managed to refine the moonsalt into some kind of fuel, you should head over to the spaceship now.
Recipe For Disaster#196.dst: Você conseguiu refinar o moonsalt em algum tipo de combustível, agora vá até a nave espacial.

Recipe For Disaster#197.src: You fill the ship up with the burnmilk and press the button on the control panel that is helpefully labelled "TRAVEL SPACEZOOM".
Recipe For Disaster#197.dst: Você enche a nave de queimaleite e aperta o botão do painel, convenientemente rotulado "VIAJAR ESPAÇOZUM".

Recipe For Disaster#198.src: Looks like you're safely back in the {p}, and with some Moonsalt to boot!
Recipe For Disaster#198.dst: Parece que você voltou em segurança a {p}, e com Moonsalt de quebra!

Recipe For Disaster#199.src: The recipe book says voidroot only grows in complete darkness... better start looking around.
Recipe For Disaster#199.dst: Segundo o livro de receitas, voidroot só cresce no escuro total... melhor começar a procurar.

Recipe For Disaster#200.src: It's some kind of cargo that's fallen from above... there's a distinct smell of fresh cookies coming from inside.
Recipe For Disaster#200.dst: É algum tipo de carga que caiu lá de cima... de dentro sai um cheiro nítido de biscoitos frescos.

Recipe For Disaster#201.src: You reach out to touch the silky leaves of the plant and find your vision restored for {~} second...
Recipe For Disaster#201.dst: Você estende a mão para tocar as folhas sedosas da planta e recupera a visão por {~} segundo...

Recipe For Disaster#202.src: A label on the side reads Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ. You probably shouldn't get too close to it.
Recipe For Disaster#202.dst: Uma etiqueta na lateral diz Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ. Melhor não chegar muito perto.

Recipe For Disaster#203.src: Dusty grey texture? Desaturated green leaves? Ever-growing sense of all-encompasing dread? Matches the recipe book description perfectly!
Recipe For Disaster#203.dst: Textura cinza e poeirenta? Folhas verde-desbotado? Pavor crescente que tudo envolve? Bate direitinho com o livro de receitas!

Recipe For Disaster#204.src: It's some kind of purple orb, pulsating with a otherworldy light. Maybe best not to touch.
Recipe For Disaster#204.dst: É uma espécie de orbe roxo, pulsando com uma luz de outro mundo. Melhor não tocar.

Recipe For Disaster#205.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Brie.
Recipe For Disaster#205.dst: Você reuniu todos os ingredientes, deveria voltar à Brie.

Recipe For Disaster#208.src: Have you shown Hamsey our dish yet? I'm sure he's gonna love it!
Recipe For Disaster#208.dst: Já mostrou nosso prato ao Hamsey? Com certeza ele vai amar!
Recipe For Disaster#208.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#209.src: Can't say your bake looks very good. No match for Kale's mighty omelette!
Recipe For Disaster#209.dst: Sua fornada não impressiona. Perde feio pra poderosa omelete do Kale!
Recipe For Disaster#209.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#211.src: Meet me in my dining room and we'll taste your dish!
Recipe For Disaster#211.dst: Vá à minha sala de jantar e provaremos seu prato!
Recipe For Disaster#211.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#212.src: These eggs look almost... furry? It's probably best to leave them alone.
Recipe For Disaster#212.dst: Estes ovos parecem quase... peludos? Melhor deixá-los em paz.

Recipe For Disaster#213.src: It's a strange grey fruit that's cold and dry to the touch... not the voidroot you're looking for though.
Recipe For Disaster#213.dst: É uma estranha fruta cinza, fria e seca ao toque... mas não é o voidroot que você procura.

Reclaiming the House#000.src: I need more firepower if I'm going...to get...
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: Preciso de mais poder de fogo se vou... pra...

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Anyway, it's clear that I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: Enfim, está claro que vou precisar de mais poder de fogo se quiser ter chance de retomar aquele posto.
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's...kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: O- que choque! Ali no meio- eles só enjaularam os soldados em vez de matá-los? Isso é... meio que um alívio.

Reclaiming the House#003.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza there for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: Com certeza há orcs demais naquela praça para derrubarmos sozinhos...
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may not be an option...
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: Certo, agora só preciso descobrir como nós dois vamos entrar... Há sentinelas no perímetro, então pular por cima talvez não seja opção...
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: Oh, orc from mud bath. In, now!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: Oh, orc do banho de lama. Entrar!

Reclaiming the House#007.src: No enter for humans! This place belong to orcs!
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: Humanos não entrar! Lugar pertencer a orcs!

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Ah... Took mud bath. Orc enter, quick!
Reclaiming the House#009.dst: Ah... Banho de lama. Orc entrar, rápido!

Reclaiming the House#011.src: The Gavellian Army's sending reinforcements to our outpost, finally. Everything was getting too much to handle on our end.
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: O Exército de Gavel enfim está mandando reforços para o nosso posto. Estava tudo ficando demais pra gente dar conta.

Reclaiming the House#012.src: You Wynnic folks are way better suited than us for guard duty. Why don't you take over for me, huh?
Reclaiming the House#012.dst: Vocês de Wynn são bem melhores que a gente pra montar guarda. Por que não me rende, hein?

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: Junte-se a Elphaba numa missão no Temporary Camp em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: Ah, um soldado de Wynn aqui no fim do mundo? Sinceramente, é bem o que precisamos- sua ajuda viria bem, se puder?
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: Ótimo, obrigada. Mas deixe-me trancar o acampamento antes das instruções.
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: Meu nome é Elphaba. Trabalho com o exército de Gavel há bons anos.
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: Comando o Posto Avançado de {p}, logo à frente. É uma fortaleza estratégica, feita para vigiar a capital orc.
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: Foi seguro por muito tempo, mas, sobretudo ultimamente, os orcs ficaram muito mais ousados, mais agressivos.
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: Eles tomaram o posto- tivemos que recuar e montar este acampamento para vigiar o lugar de onde nós os vigiávamos!
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#020.dst: ...ah, não. Viu, é disso que eu falo! Os orcs estão vindo!
Reclaiming the House#020.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: Mate os mobs que atacam o acampamento.

Reclaiming the House#023.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: É o terceiro ataque em três dias! Quantos reforços eles têm?!
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: Argh! Os magos deles são fortes, cuidado!
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: Fale com Elphaba para saber mais sobre o próximo ataque.

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: Ufa, acho que eram todos... Venha cá, vou continuar de onde paramos.
Reclaiming the House#026.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: Não sei se eu teria conseguido sozinha. Sorte minha você ter aparecido na hora, soldado.
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: Você certamente sabe lutar, então agradeço a ajuda, mas temos que bolar um plano, rápido.
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: Há uma torre velha perto do posto- um antigo silo de armazenagem. Foi construída mais alta que o forte, então talvez dê pra espioná-los de lá.
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: É um risco, já que fica tão perto, mas não temos outras opções. Me encontre na torre a sudeste daqui pra avaliarmos a situação.
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: Vá até a torre de vigia em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para planejar o ataque.

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: Soldado! Estou bem atrás de você. Dá pra ver nosso posto- e a torre que mencionei.
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: Temos que achar um jeito de entrar. Muitos soldados foram pegos de surpresa no ataque orc.
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#034.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: Se houver sobreviventes lá dentro, resgatá-los deve ser prioridade.
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: Afinal, significa mais gente pra nós. Mas não podemos contar com isso...
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: Vamos, entre rápido antes que algum orc nos veja!
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: Entre na torre de vigia em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para planejar o ataque.

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: Certo, a vista daqui é bem clara. Vamos ver o que acontece lá dentro...
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: ...mas aquela jaula está presa por aquelas cordas. Se as cortarmos, os outros soldados poderão ajudar!
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: Talvez a gente possa observar as rondas das sentinelas e achar uma brecha-
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: Humanos em torre velha! Junhur atirar! Lugar ser nosso agora, fora!!
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: Ah, agora não! Eu sabia do risco, sem tempo pra sair... Segure-se!!
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: Torre velha cair! Junhur ser melhor canhoneiro!!
Reclaiming the House#043.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: Argh, soldado!! Você está bem, onde caiu?!
Reclaiming the House#044.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: Ah... Uau. Você mal parece arranhado, deve ter tido muita sorte.
Reclaiming the House#045.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#046.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#046.dst: Já eu, nem tanto... Fiquei bem machucada depois dessa. Pelo menos um de nós está inteiro...
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: Infelizmente, achar um jeito de entrar fica por sua conta. Daqui de baixo não dá pra ver as rondas deles.
Reclaiming the House#047.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#048.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#048.dst: Vou sobreviver, claro, mas por um tempo não vou conseguir andar nem me defender.
Reclaiming the House#048.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#049.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: Odeio te deixar sozinho assim, mas, se serve de consolo, você deve ser forte o bastante, ou sortudo o bastante, pra conseguir.
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: Explore o perímetro do posto. Tente achar um jeito de entrar, mas cuidado, tá?
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#051.dst: Explore os arredores do posto para achar outra entrada.

Reclaiming the House#052.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: Siga o rastro de lama deixado pelo orc. Ele leva à caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#053.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.
Reclaiming the House#053.dst: Entre no posto coberto de lama.

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: Corte as cordas para libertar os guardas da jaula.

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: Boa ideia o disfarce de lama, soldado! Eles nem desconfiaram, agora venha nos ajudar aqui!
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: Mate os Orcish Overtakers, a gente segura os outros longe de você!
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#059.src: Open the gate with a spell
Reclaiming the House#059.dst: Abra o portão com um feitiço

Reclaiming the House#060.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#060.dst: Os Overtakers caíram, os outros orcs estão perdidos! Abra a entrada do posto com um feitiço agora, temos tudo sob controle!
Reclaiming the House#060.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#062.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#062.dst: Ufa... Belo trabalho, soldado! O posto está de volta sob nosso controle!
Reclaiming the House#062.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#063.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#063.dst: Que bom ver mais mãos capazes de Wynn por aqui. Mas não peguei seu nome. Se importa?
Reclaiming the House#063.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#064.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#064.dst: {u}, é? Vou lembrar. Você mal precisou da minha ajuda, hehe... Queria não ter sido um fardo, mas pelo menos deu certo.
Reclaiming the House#064.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#065.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#065.dst: Tome- é um pouco do meu dinheiro, como presente de agradecimento.
Reclaiming the House#065.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#066.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#066.dst: Certo, pessoal, vamos deixar este lugar nos trinques! Temos que consertar tudo caso venha outro ataque!!
Reclaiming the House#066.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#067.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc.
Reclaiming the House#067.dst: Siga o rastro de lama deixado pelo orc.

Recover the Past#000.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the- you get the point.
Recover the Past#000.dst: Mas com este aparelho... podemos mudar isso! Restaurar o que foi perdido! Recuperar o- você entendeu.
Recover the Past#000.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#001.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need more to be certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#001.dst: Agora, preciso muito de cobaias... Você serviria, sim, mas preciso de mais para ter certeza de que isto funciona.
Recover the Past#001.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#002.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still here? Get going!
Recover the Past#002.dst: Enquanto isso, vou fazer ajustes aqui... Ainda não está perfeito. Ainda me faltam grandes partes da memória... Hm? Ainda está aqui? Vá logo!
Recover the Past#002.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#003.src: Huh? Oh! I- ah, nothing to see here! Just... just having a look at my ship! That's all.
Recover the Past#003.dst: Hã? Oh! Eu- ah, nada pra ver aqui! Só... só dando uma olhada no meu barco! Só isso.

Recover the Past#004.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in that tower of his? Huh, good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#004.dst: O Picard te mandou? O cara enfurnado naquela torre? Hm, bom saber que ele enfim terminou o trabalho. Mas o que ele quer comigo?
Recover the Past#004.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#005.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. And I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about-...
Recover the Past#005.dst: ... Olhar minhas memórias de Fruma, é? Sei não. Se sumiram, deve ser por um motivo. E eu- eu tô feliz aqui! Não preciso saber nada sobre-...
Recover the Past#005.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#006.src: Get me the part from that blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#006.dst: Me arranja a peça daquele ferreiro e eu vou com você até a torre do Picard. Não posso deixar meu xodó inacabado assim, né?
Recover the Past#006.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#007.src: Move the box out of the door to complete the puzzle!
Recover the Past#007.dst: Tire a caixa da porta para resolver o enigma!

Recover the Past#009.src: You take a package out of the wreckage.
Recover the Past#009.dst: Você tira um pacote dos destroços.

Recover the Past#010.src: You should return to Caid with the package before the blacksmith notices...
Recover the Past#010.dst: Volte ao Caid com o pacote antes que o ferreiro perceba...

Recover the Past#012.src: Sure thing. Say- Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#012.dst: Claro. Diz aí- Caid. Como você sempre consegue essas coisas? Tem peças caras nelas, e isso parece meio fora do seu orçamento.
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#013.src: Wait- what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't-
Recover the Past#013.dst: Espera- o quê? Caid, me diz que você não andou roubando dos guardas. Você sabe que eles não vão-
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#014.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and to decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#014.dst: Levem-no à prisão para mais interrogatórios, e para decidir o que será feito dele.
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#015.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there... I wonder what we'd see if we could-
Recover the Past#015.dst: Hm. Hm hm hm. A memória cortou ali... O que veríamos se pudéssemos-
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#016.src: Yes, so it would appear! But surely there's more beyond this point... perhaps, if I-
Recover the Past#016.dst: Sim, parece que sim! Mas com certeza há mais além deste ponto... talvez, se eu-

Recover the Past#017.src: But that's of no importance now. What is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will revolutionize the world!
Recover the Past#017.dst: Mas isso não importa agora. O importante é o que acabamos de ver! Memórias revividas em detalhes vívidos! Este aparelho vai revolucionar o mundo!
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#018.src: I saw him heading into the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#018.dst: Eu o vi entrando no templo há pouco. Talvez ele tenha mudado de ideia. Mostre o caminho até o Caid, vou logo atrás.
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#019.src: I wouldn't dream of doing anything else!
Recover the Past#019.dst: Nem sonharia em fazer outra coisa!

Recover the Past#020.src: But- consider, Reynauld. Maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#020.dst: Mas- pense, Reynauld. Talvez esquecer o passado tenha um motivo.

Recover the Past#022.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's-... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#022.dst: Recuperei umas peças de... hã, uma fábrica aqui perto. Espero que seja-... deve ser o que você precisa.
Recover the Past#022.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#023.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... I took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#023.dst: N-não. Ninguém me viu. Eu, hã... tomei precauções. Entrei à noite. Sabe como é.
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#024.src: I- hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#024.dst: Eu- hunf. Tá, tá bom, eu- eu ponho umas esmeraldas. Pra adoçar o acordo.
Recover the Past#024.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your secrets.
Recover the Past#026.dst: Seu cúmplice, o fornecedor, foi pego outro dia. Disseram-me que ele mal pensou antes de decidir entregar seus segredos.
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#027.src: Assistant! Assistant! Snap out of it!

Recover the Past#028.src: {u}!? What're you doing... here...? No, actually, better question- what is happening up here?
Recover the Past#028.dst: {u}!? O que faz... aqui...? Não, pergunta melhor- o que está acontecendo aqui em cima?

Recover the Past#030.src: Science! Highly experimental and important science! That is what is taking place up here- and who are you, interrupting-
Recover the Past#030.dst: Ciência! Ciência altamente experimental e importante! É o que acontece aqui em cima- e quem é você, interrompendo-

Recover the Past#031.src: Doctor. Stop. Talking. Tasim, why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#031.dst: Doutor. Pare. De. Falar. Tasim, o que faz aqui? Cadê o Caid?

Recover the Past#032.src: Right... the Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defences. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#032.dst: Certo... o almirante me mandou reforçar as defesas de {p}. Esperava te encontrar na ponte, mas só achei o Caid.
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#033.src: Urgh... that damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#033.dst: Argh... maldito ladrão! Eu sabia que não devia ter ido... Foi tudo um erro... Droga.
Recover the Past#033.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#034.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go. Tasim, {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#034.dst: Não há tempo a perder. Vamos. Tasim, {u}. Precisamos salvar {p}.
Recover the Past#034.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#035.src: ...hmph. Rather rude, the both of them. But fine, the circumstances warrant it, I suppose.
Recover the Past#035.dst: ...hunf. Bem grosseiros, os dois. Mas tudo bem, as circunstâncias justificam, suponho.

Recover the Past#036.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. I'll need to think through our next steps...
Recover the Past#036.dst: Esse Tasim, ele deve ser de Fruma também? Se é seu companheiro, deveria recrutá-lo para esse nosso pequeno experimento. Vou precisar pensar nos próximos passos...

Recover the Past#037.src: ... Well? What are you waiting for?! Go on, get out there! {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#037.dst: ... E então? O que está esperando?! Vamos, vá lá fora! {p} precisa de ajuda!

Recover the Past#038.src: I'm trying to think, but... I've never...
Recover the Past#038.dst: Estou tentando pensar, mas... eu nunca...
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#039.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming- we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#039.dst: Reynauld, não funciona! Não param de vir- temos... que fazer outra... coisa, ou não aguentamos!
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#040.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. The three of us alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#040.dst: Você tem razão. Vamos ter que recuar, pedir ajuda a {p}. Nós três sozinhos não vencemos isso!
Recover the Past#040.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#041.src: Caid! You made it! That was incredible- you're a hero!
Recover the Past#041.dst: Caid! Você conseguiu! Foi incrível- você é um herói!
Recover the Past#041.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#042.src: That's all well and good, but... what about your boat?
Recover the Past#042.dst: Tudo muito bom, mas... e o seu barco?
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#043.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough... considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case.
Recover the Past#043.dst: Bem, o Caid parece bem o bastante... dadas as circunstâncias. Vou levá-lo pra ser examinado, por via das dúvidas.
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#044.src: Do you remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#044.dst: Lembra? A gente mal tinha chegado a Wynn e... o Aledar estava com a gente, e quase morreu no primeiro dia! Espero que ele esteja tomando mais cuidado por aí...
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#045.src: ... Oh, {u}, you've returned, and with a brand new subject! I take it {p} is now safe and sound? Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb, and-
Recover the Past#045.dst: ... Oh, {u}, você voltou, e com uma cobaia novinha! Presumo que {p} esteja a salvo? Excelente, excelente. Por favor, aproxime-se do orbe, e-

Recover the Past#046.src: Hold on. I didn't get the chance to ask questions, when I walked in on this earlier. How safe is this procedure, exactly? Because from what I saw of Reynauld-
Recover the Past#046.dst: Espera. Não tive chance de perguntar quando entrei aqui mais cedo. Quão seguro é esse procedimento, exatamente? Porque pelo que vi do Reynauld-

Recover the Past#047.src: Now, now, settle down. Just because I didn't do any proper tests before this doesn't mean it isn't safe! I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#047.dst: Ora, ora, calma. Só porque não fiz testes adequados antes não quer dizer que não seja seguro! Fiz os cálculos! Todos batem!

Recover the Past#049.src: You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?!
Recover the Past#049.dst: Quer pôr mais magia nisso, sendo que já está instável?!
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#050.src: ... Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but alright.
Recover the Past#050.dst: ... Tá bom. Podemos olhar minhas memórias. Não sei se concordo totalmente... mas tudo bem.
Recover the Past#050.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#051.dst: Oh. Você- você é um amaldiçoado.
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#052.src: My... magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#052.dst: Minha... magia mal consegue se manter... mas há mais para ver! Aumentando a potência...
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#053.src: ... It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#053.dst: ... Era a coisa certa a fazer. Eu não podia ficar parado quando podia fazer algo para ajudar.
Recover the Past#053.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#054.src: You feel a faint tug as something tries to pull you out of the memory.
Recover the Past#054.dst: Você sente um leve puxão, como se algo tentasse tirá-lo da memória.

Recover the Past#055.src: But there's more to see. You can't leave just yet.
Recover the Past#055.dst: Mas há mais para ver. Você ainda não pode sair.

Recover the Past#056.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to-
Recover the Past#056.dst: O- o quê? O que vocês vão fazer com-
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#057.src: What are you going to do now
Recover the Past#057.dst: O que você vai fazer agora
Recover the Past#057.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#058.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents... would be useful.
Recover the Past#058.dst: Você é um novo recruta, enviado à Província de Wynn para lutar na guerra deles. Você se alistou porque achou que seus... talentos... únicos seriam úteis.
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#059.src: Wonderful. Take this one away. It looks like we'll be able to fit two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#059.dst: Maravilhoso. Levem este. Parece que cabem mais dois no lote de hoje.
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#060.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! We have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#060.dst: ... Tá bom, tá bom. Nos deu mais informações. Mas não faça de novo! Temos muito o que conversar.
Recover the Past#060.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#061.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm-... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#061.dst: ... Hunf. Admito, eu-... não sei bem o que fazer com essa informação.
Recover the Past#061.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#062.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us- what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#062.dst: E o Inquisidor... Não sei o que pensar. Todos nós- o que achávamos que sabíamos quando chegamos a Wynn... Nada disso era verdade.
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#063.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you-... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#063.dst: Eu- preciso de espaço pra pensar. Pra... refletir. Pode-... por favor, não conte isso ao Aledar.
Recover the Past#063.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#064.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll even run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#064.dst: Quando ficar mais forte, você também devia ir pra lá. Talvez até a gente se esbarre, uma hora.
Recover the Past#064.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#065.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever- but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#065.dst: Acho que é um adeus por enquanto. Não pra sempre- só por enquanto. A gente se vê, {u}.
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#068.src: Well. Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant- not quite the response I was looking for... a shame, too- I truly believe we were on to something.
Recover the Past#068.dst: Bem. Passante-que-virou-assis- quer saber, vou te chamar de assistente- não foi bem a reação que eu esperava... uma pena- eu realmente acho que estávamos no caminho certo.

Recover the Past#069.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#069.dst: Hunf. Talvez só precise de mais potência... Se eu aumentar a mana que consigo pôr no feitiço, então-

Recover the Past#070.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#070.dst: Enquanto isso, sem nossa cobaia, teremos de nos virar com outra. Há um batedor, Reynauld, de serviço hoje, também originário de Fruma, assim como você.

Recover the Past#072.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#072.dst: É intrigante, sem dúvida... se pudéssemos ver mais longe. Mãos à obra- precisamos saber mais!

Recover the Past#073.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#073.dst: Use as teclas de movimento para ver a jogada e Pular para confirmar.

Recover the Past#074.dst: Fale com o Dr. Picard em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#075.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#075.dst: Sucesso! Sucesso, sucesso, SUCESSO! Sou um gênio, o mais esperto que há!
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#076.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#076.dst: Você aí, transeunte qualquer! Testemunhou uma maravilha mágica! Acabei de restaurar com sucesso minhas memórias de anos atrás!
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#077.dst: Você parece ser de Fruma, certo? Então sabe tão bem quanto eu que suas memórias da vida de antes sumiram. Puf. Foram-se!
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#078.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#078.dst: Escute aqui! Tenho uma proposta. Você quer suas memórias de volta, certo? Traga-me cobaias suficientes, e eu mostro o que você perdeu!
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#079.dst: Vejamos, vejamos... Precisamos de pessoas originárias de Fruma. Há algumas por aqui.
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#080.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#080.dst: Pode começar pelo aspirante a marinheiro, Caid. Ele fica logo depois de {p}- siga o caminho até chegar ao rio.
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#081.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#081.dst: Encontre o marinheiro Caid perto do barco dele em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#082.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#082.dst: E então? Eu te dei uma tarefa, o que ainda está fazendo aqui? Vá encontrar o marinheiro Caid. Ele fica logo depois de {p}- siga o caminho até o rio.
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#083.src: Huh? Oh! I- ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#083.dst: Hã? Oh! Eu- ah, nada pra ver aqui! Só... só olhando meu bom e velho barco!
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#084.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#084.dst: ... É, tá bom. Vou com você ver essa memória. Só me faz um favor antes, beleza?
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#085.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#085.dst: Eu sou meio construtor. Pensei em tentar fazer um barco, e aqui está! Bem bom, né?
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#087.src: Looks like a heap of scrap!

Recover the Past#088.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#088.dst: É disso que eu tô falando, toma essa, Reynauld! Eu sabia que alguém ia gostar!
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#090.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#090.dst: Ei! Heh, bem, você não está errado. Montei quase tudo com tralha que achei por aí. Mesmo assim, é bem impressionante pra um monte de sucata, não acha?
Recover the Past#090.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#091.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#091.dst: Você tem que prometer que não vai contar pro Reynauld, mas... Algumas das peças mais exóticas vieram do alojamento dos guardas. Nada demais! Só umas coisinhas tiradas por cima...
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#092.dst: Só preciso de mais uma peça pra terminar e, bem, sabe... Um carregamento acabou de chegar no ferreiro... Entende aonde quero chegar?
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#093.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#093.dst: Roube a caixa da casa do ferreiro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#094.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#094.dst: Já pegou a caixa? Está no ferreiro, pertinho daqui em {p}. Só não deixe te verem!
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#095.dst: Leve o pacote ao Caid em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#096.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#096.dst: ... Você voltou! Como foi? Aqui, eu pego a mercadoria.
Recover the Past#096.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#097.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#097.dst: O ferreiro não viu nada, né? Tô meio preocupado que o Reynauld esteja na minha cola...
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#098.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#098.dst: Ah, tanto faz! Enfim, hora de terminar esse meu velho barco!
Recover the Past#098.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#099.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#100.dst: Isso mesmo! Todo barco que se preze tem que ter um sino. Não seria o mesmo sem.
Recover the Past#100.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#102.src: What's with the attitude? Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#102.dst: Que atitude é essa? Todo barco que se preze tem sino, sabia? Acha que o Seaskipper andaria sem um? Nem morto!
Recover the Past#102.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#103.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#103.dst: Enfim... você cumpriu sua parte do acordo, então não tenho escolha a não ser cumprir a minha!
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#104.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding out in this head of mine.
Recover the Past#104.dst: Mostre o caminho até a torre do Picard! Vamos ver o que se esconde nesta cabeça.
Recover the Past#104.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#105.dst: Mostre o caminho até a torre do Picard! Vamos ver o que há nessa cabeçona.
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#106.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#106.dst: Leve Caid ao Dr. Picard na torre dele em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#108.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#108.dst: Aha! Vocês voltaram! Bom, bom, vai ser um bom teste dos meus ajustes...
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#109.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#109.dst: ... Certo. E é a esse doutor que vamos confiar minhas memórias?
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#110.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#110.dst: Ora, ora, não subestime meu gênio. Vai ficar tudo bem! Provavelmente. Eu diria noventa e cinco, bem, noventa por cento. Agora, suba aqui.
Recover the Past#110.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#111.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#111.dst: Tá bom... Confio que sabe o que está fazendo, doutor...
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#112.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#112.dst: E agora, só preciso... Ativar o feitiço aqui, acionar a alavanca ali, e...
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#114.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#114.dst: Certo, vamos ver o que temos aqui... Edwin, pode olhar aquela outra caixa ali?
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#115.dst: Bem... Digamos que o último pacote de suprimentos dos guardas está um pouco mais leve do que deveria.
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#116.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#116.dst: Edwin, relaxa. Só tiro um pouquinho por cima dos suprimentos deles. Não vão notar um ou dois pacotes faltando de trinta.
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#117.dst: Além disso, não tenho medo deles. Estão aqui pra nos proteger, não estão? Acho que vão me liberar com uma advertência, como em todas as outras vezes.
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#118.dst: Se... se você diz. Acho que tem razão. Eles nem precisam de todos esses suprimentos. E a gente faz bem melhor uso deles!
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#119.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo-
Recover the Past#119.dst: Exato! Que bom que concorda. Então, achou algo bo-
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#120.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#122.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa-
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#123.dst: Chega de você. Vocês dois, encontrem o cúmplice.
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#126.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#126.dst: Caid, você está preso por repetidos roubos de propriedade imperial.
Recover the Past#126.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#127.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#127.dst: Seu histórico mostra várias advertências por atos anteriores. Esta era sua última chance, e você a desperdiçou completamente.
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#128.dst: Ei! Alô? Passante-que-virou-assistente! Saia desse transe, precisamos conversar.
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#130.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu-
Recover the Past#130.dst: Sim, parece que sim... Mas talvez, se eu aumentar a potência, então... Sim! Sou um gêni-
Recover the Past#130.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#131.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#131.dst: Só isso que eu sou?! Um ladrãozinho... Só sirvo pra isso?
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#134.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#134.dst: Ah! Passante-que-virou-assis- quer saber, vou te chamar de assistente. Enfim saiu do transe, pelo visto.
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#135.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#135.dst: ... Mas devo dizer. Estou meio perdido na cronologia dos fatos. Caid foi preso- então como veio parar aqui em Wynn, como soldado?
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#136.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#136.dst: Precisamos de mais cobaias se quisermos descobrir a verdade! Há um batedor, Reynauld, de serviço hoje, também originário de Fruma, assim como você.
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#137.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#137.dst: Sim, hm. Ele fica perto da ponte para {p}. Conto com você para convencê-lo a entrar no nosso experimento. Em nome da ciência!
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#138.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#138.dst: Encontre o batedor Reynauld perto da ponte para {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#139.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#139.dst: Hm... Onde fica essa barreira? Esta magia não basta para rompê-la? Talvez se eu aumentar a potência, então...
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#140.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#140.dst: Ah! Assistente! O que faz aqui? Já falou com o batedor Reynauld? Ele fica perto da ponte para {p}.
Recover the Past#140.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#141.dst: Só... me deixe em paz. Tá?
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#142.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#142.dst: Ah, olá. Qual é o problema? Parece que quer algo de mim.
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#143.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#143.dst: Hm? O doutor estranho quer me ver? Para restaurar minhas memórias? Não confio muito no homem... mas estou curioso para ver se vai funcionar mesmo.
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#144.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#144.dst: Infelizmente, porém, devo recusar. Não posso deixar meu posto sem vigia. E se surgir um ataque corrompido? {p} ficaria sem defesa.
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#146.dst: Hm, bem. Se for só por um tempinho, pode dar certo. Desde que você prometa ajudar se houver um ataque.
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#147.dst: Então está decidido. Vou com você ver o doutor. Mas antes precisamos de alguém para vigiar. Tem alguém em mente?
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#149.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do, I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#149.dst: Caid? Aquele... vigarista. Ele anda roubando suprimentos, eu sei. Só não consigo provar. Mas, se você acha que ele serve, vai dar certo.
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#150.src: Yes, fine, I understand you've taken issue with my methodology. But it works! This has worked thrice now!
Recover the Past#150.dst: Sim, tá bom, entendo que você implique com meu método. Mas funciona! Já funcionou três vezes!

Recover the Past#151.src: Sigh... all of that, and we still weren't able to see what comes next! I swear, I was able to see more when I looked at my own memories! It's ridicu-
Recover the Past#151.dst: Ai... tudo isso, e ainda não vimos o que vem depois! Juro, eu vi mais quando olhei minhas próprias memórias! É ridícu-

Recover the Past#153.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#153.dst: Talvez o Caid tenha mudado de ideia. Mostre o caminho até ele, vou logo atrás.
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#154.dst: Convença Caid a vigiar a ponte em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#155.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#155.dst: Ah, você de novo. O que quer?
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#156.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#156.dst: Somos nós, e queremos te pedir algo. Nosso amigo em comum aqui está tentando me recrutar para algum tipo de experimento.
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#157.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#157.dst: Só que minha participação deixaria {p} sem defesa. Então queremos saber se você estaria disposto a vigiar as coisas enquanto eu estiver ocupado.
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#158.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#158.dst: Sério? Está me pedindo pra guardar {p}?
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#159.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third-
Recover the Past#159.dst: Não me entenda mal, eu preferiria não deixar a segurança de {p} nas mãos de um ladrã... de alguém como você. Você não era minha primeira opção, nem segunda, nem terceira-
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#162.dst: Topa? Bem, foi mais fácil do que eu esperava. Lembre-se: se vir qualquer sinal de ataque iminente, corra à torre daquele doutor e nos avise na hora. Deixe a luta para os profissionais.
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#163.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#163.dst: Nem sonharia com outra coisa! Mas pense, Reynauld, que talvez o passado seja esquecido por um motivo.
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#164.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#164.dst: Bem, acho que isso resolve. Vamos logo ao doutor. Não quero deixar a segurança de {p} nos dedos leves daquele homem mais tempo do que o necessário.
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#165.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#165.dst: Obrigado pela ajuda, Tasim e {u}. E ao Caid também...

Recover the Past#166.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#166.dst: Leve Reynauld ao Dr. Picard na torre dele em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#167.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#167.dst: Vamos logo ao doutor, não quero deixar a segurança de {p} nos dedos leves daquele homem mais tempo do que o necessário.
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#169.dst: Ah, assistente! Bem-vindo de volta, e trouxe nossa próxima cobaia! Maravilha!
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#171.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#171.dst: Ora, ora, dê um passo à frente. Não seja tímido! É só vir aqui! Olhe direto para o orbe e concentre-se em lembrar.
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#173.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#173.dst: Sim, sim! Não se preocupe, o aparelho foi bem testado no Caid. Rapidinho, só preciso ativar isto... lançar um feitiço aqui... e...
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#175.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour-
Recover the Past#175.dst: H-hã? Ei, quem está aí? Por que está batendo a esta hora-
Recover the Past#175.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#177.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#177.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#178.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#178.dst: N-não, claro que não- Hã. Teria sido bom se, sabe, você me avisasse que vinha!
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#179.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#179.dst: Sabe que não é assim que funciona. Agora, cadê a mercadoria?
Recover the Past#179.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#180.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#180.dst: Certo... sempre direto ao assunto com você. Nunca um ah, como foi sua semana? Sempre só-...
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#181.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#182.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#182.dst: ... Hm. De uma das fábricas, você diz? E tem certeza de que ninguém te viu? Se me pegassem falando com um criminoso conhecido, você sabe as consequências para nós dois.
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#184.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#184.dst: E-então... é o bastante? Trouxe o que você pediu.
Recover the Past#184.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#185.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#185.dst: Bem... isso é, sim. Mas, Caid, você sabe o risco que corro toda vez que venho aqui falar com você. Vou precisar de mais que o mínimo para garantir sua segurança.
Recover the Past#185.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#186.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#186.dst: Excelente. Um prazer fazer negócios, como sempre. Volto em algumas semanas.
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#187.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#187.dst: Ah, Reynauld. Bom te ver. Entre, entre.
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#188.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#188.dst: Posso saber o motivo desta reunião, senhor?
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#189.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#189.dst: Ah, nada de mais. Só queria conversar rapidinho sobre o seu desempenho.
Recover the Past#189.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#190.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#190.dst: Você entende que aqueles de nós que servem a Sua Majestade em posições tão respeitadas têm um certo... rigoroso código de honra a seguir, certo?
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#191.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#191.dst: Senão, como teríamos certeza de que nossas fileiras estão livres de delitos? Devemos dar exemplo ao povo da nossa grande província.
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#192.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#192.dst: Agora, o que acha que aconteceria se um dos nossos por acaso... dobrasse, ou quebrasse, esse código de honra? Que precedente isso abriria?
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#194.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#194.dst: Não é com prazer que lhe informo que você, Reynauld, será destituído da sua patente e preso sob acusação de desonra e conspiração contra Sua Majestade.
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#195.src: There is no place for your sort in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#195.dst: Não há lugar para sua laia nas nossas fileiras, Reynauld. Pena ter chegado a isso.
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#196.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#196.dst: Não há lugar para você nas nossas fileiras, Reynauld. Uma pena ter chegado a isso.
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#197.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#197.dst: Assistente! Acorde! Há mais a discutir.
Recover the Past#197.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#199.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#199.dst: Maravilhoso! Assistente, ótimo trabalho até agora! Estamos mais perto que nunca do mistério de Fruma!
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#201.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#201.dst: {u}!? Não achei que fosse esbarrar em você tão longe!
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#202.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#202.dst: Cumprimentos ficam pra depois. Tasim? Por que está aqui? Cadê o Caid?
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#203.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#203.dst: Ele disse que um ataque a {p} se formava e que você estava aqui, aí saiu correndo.
Recover the Past#203.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#204.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#204.dst: Esse Tasim, ele deve ser de Fruma também? Se é seu companheiro, deveria recrutá-lo para esse nosso pequeno experimento. Pela ciência, claro! Agora, ora, vá. {p} precisa de ajuda!
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#205.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#205.dst: Corra para defender {p} da incursão em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#206.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#206.dst: Assistente! O que ainda está fazendo aqui? Seus amigos parecem precisar da sua ajuda!
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#207.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#207.dst: Além disso, talvez seja a chance de recrutar aquele Tasim para o experimento! Hm, sim, ele certamente seria um espécime interessante de examinar!
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#208.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#208.dst: Vão vir atrás desta ponte a qualquer momento. Precisamos estar prontos.
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#211.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#211.dst: Boa resposta, soldado. Vamos derrubá-los, não importa quantos mandem contra nós!
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Reynauld
