Recover the Past#212.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#212.dst: Faça o que precisar antes, mas rápido. O inimigo pode chegar a qualquer momento.
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#214.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#214.dst: Tasim, você vai na frente, eu dou cobertura atrás.
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#215.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#216.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#216.dst: Não deve demorar muito agora... Se o Aledar estivesse aqui, seria como nos velhos tempos. Não acha?
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#217.dst: Alvo à vista! Forças corrompidas se aproximando!
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#219.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#219.dst: Droga. O líder parece ter um escudo! Como derrubamos isso?
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#220.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#220.dst: Os espinhos devem ser o ponto fraco!
Recover the Past#220.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#221.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#221.dst: Você tem razão! Tasim, {u}. Se mantiverem o inimigo longe de mim, consigo mirar bem nos espinhos. É nossa única chance de derrubar essa coisa.
Recover the Past#221.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#222.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#222.dst: ... Ah. Pelo visto vai ser mais difícil do que o esperado. Mas vamos dar o nosso melhor!
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#223.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#223.dst: Só... mais um pouco... para a direita...
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#224.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#225.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#225.dst: Reynauld! E agora? Assim não dá para vencer...
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#226.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#226.dst: Tasim, {u}, continuem segurando eles. Vou pensar em algo, qualquer coisa...
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#227.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#227.dst: Não podemos desistir agora, não com {p} ainda em perigo!
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#230.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#230.dst: Caid, o que faz aqui!? É perigoso demais, deixe isso com os profissionais!
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#231.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#231.dst: Chega, chega de deixar meu futuro escapar entre os dedos!
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#232.dst: Caid, não! Você... não pode, vai-
Recover the Past#232.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#235.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#235.dst: Agora, Reynauld! Atire! Pelo amor de Deus, atire! Está distraído!
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#236.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#236.dst: Es-está caindo! É a nossa chance!
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#237.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#241.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#241.dst: Sempre posso construir outra, não é?
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#242.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#242.dst: Ha. Mas desta vez sem usar as minhas coisas.
Recover the Past#242.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#243.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#243.dst: Imagino que queira levar o Tasim para o seu experimento. Depois de tudo o que fez hoje, mal posso me opor. Mas, Tasim...
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#244.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#244.dst: Pense bem antes de olhar para aquele cristal. Para alguns, o passado é cheio de coisas que prefeririam esquecer.
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#245.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... I guess that's something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#245.dst: Recuperar memórias de Fruma, é... Acho que isso me interessa. Tenho uma sensação estranha desde que percebemos que as perdemos.
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#246.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#246.dst: Bom, enfim. Por favor, me leve até o doutor. Estou curioso para ver do que se trata.
Recover the Past#246.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#247.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#247.dst: Leve Tasim até o Dr. Picard na torre dele em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#249.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#249.dst: ... Ah, {u}, de volta com mais uma cobaia! Excelente, excelente. Por favor, chegue perto do orbe.
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#250.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that-
Recover the Past#250.dst: Doutor, tem certeza de que é seguro? O Reynauld me avisou que-
Recover the Past#250.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#251.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#251.dst: Ah, sim, sim. Já testamos com duas cobaias, não foi, {u}? Além disso, fiz os cálculos! Todos dão certo!
Recover the Past#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#252.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#252.dst: Há só uma instabilidade minúscula. Hmpf. Talvez só precise de mais energia... Se eu aumentar a mana que consigo pôr no feitiço, então-
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#253.dst: Não quer saber como era sua vida antes? Mesmo que não seja o que quer ver, não é melhor saber?
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#254.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#254.dst: Excelente, que bom ouvir isso! Agora. Ativando em três... dois... um... já!
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#255.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#255.dst: Todos a postos! Prendam esse insurgente!
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#257.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#257.dst: Grr... Ele não pode ter ido longe. Todos vocês, vasculhem a cidade! Cada canto! Não deixem que ele fuja!
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#258.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I-...
Recover the Past#258.dst: Eu- ah, isso é ruim... O que posso-...
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#259.src: ... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#259.dst: ... Droga. Que droga. Não vou deixar o homem sangrar até morrer, mesmo que-...
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#260.src: ... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.
Recover the Past#260.dst: ... Você não devia ter se metido nisso, sabia?

Recover the Past#261.src: Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
Recover the Past#261.dst: Além disso, já usamos o feitiço em duas cobaias, e deu tudo perfeitamente certo com as duas... hã, quase tudo. Há só uma levíssima instabilidade.

Recover the Past#262.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#262.dst: ...Droga. Que droga. Não vou deixar o homem sangrar até morrer, mesmo que-...
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#263.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#263.dst: Calma, você vai ficar bem... Eu sei o que fazer, mesmo que não devesse...
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#264.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get-
Recover the Past#264.dst: A-ah! O-onde estou? Quem é você? Preciso-

Recover the Past#265.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#265.dst: Ele está aqui dentro! E tem um cúmplice! Prendam os dois!
Recover the Past#265.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#266.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#266.dst: E daí? Era pra deixar você sangrar até morrer em casa? Não seja ridículo.
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#267.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#267.dst: Sim! Devia! Porque agora não só fui preso por crimes contra a Coroa, como você foi exposto como um dos amaldiçoados. Não teria acontecido se você só tivesse... ficado de fora.
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#268.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#268.dst: Bom, de muito nos adiantou. Você sabe que ninguém sai daqui, né? Quando te levam, nunca mais se ouve falar de você! É aí que estamos.
Recover the Past#268.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#270.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#270.dst: Tasim. Chegou a sua vez. Me siga.
Recover the Past#270.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#271.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#271.dst: Boa sorte lá fora, Tasim. Vai precisar.
Recover the Past#271.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#272.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#272.dst: Nos vemos do outro lado, Aledar.
Recover the Past#272.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#273.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#273.dst: Aham. Estamos prontos para o processo. Preparem o Ajustador.
Recover the Past#273.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#274.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#274.dst: Silêncio. Antes de começar, uma coisa bem clara. Não precisamos da sua laia em Fruma. Não queremos a sua laia em Fruma.
Recover the Past#274.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#275.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#275.dst: O que faremos hoje com você é uma gentileza, uma misericórdia. Se dependesse do mundo, você estaria muito pior. Lembre-se disso no que segue.
Recover the Past#275.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#277.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#277.dst: Fruma é só um cisco na sua história. Um fato gravado em pedra, com detalhes perdidos num passado hipotético. Tem carinho por ela, mas não lembra de nada.
Recover the Past#277.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#278.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#278.dst: Você vai lutar na guerra deles. Vai viver por ela, vai morrer por ela. Será de Wynn para sempre, e Fruma ficará feliz em se livrar de você.
Recover the Past#278.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#280.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#280.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#281.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#281.dst: Vou perguntar mais uma vez. Sua diretriz foi entendida?
Recover the Past#281.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#286.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#286.dst: Assistente! Acorde! Você foi fundo demais, a memória está te sugando!
Recover the Past#286.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#287.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#287.dst: Minha nossa- aí está você! Entende como isso foi perigoso?!
Recover the Past#287.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#288.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#288.dst: O que acha que me acontece se um assistente meu ficar preso nas memórias para sempre! Nada de bom!
Recover the Past#288.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#289.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#289.dst: O orbe de restaurificação de memória funcionou como eu esperava para um só uso... mas, minha nossa, que coisa angustiante de ver.
Recover the Past#289.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#290.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#290.dst: É lógico que Caid e Reynauld também passaram por isso... e minha magia não conseguiu atravessar aquele muro...
Recover the Past#290.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#291.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#291.dst: É isso que fazem com os criminosos lá em Fruma? Mandam eles lutar na guerra de Wynn?
Recover the Past#291.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#292.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#292.dst: ... Vou ter que pensar no quanto quero mergulhar em memórias. Seja como for! Bem no começo de tudo, prometi que veríamos as suas memórias.
Recover the Past#292.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#293.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#293.dst: A oferta continua de pé, se quiser aceitar. É só chegar perto do orbe, como os outros fizeram.
Recover the Past#293.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#294.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#294.dst: E então? A oferta continua de pé, se quiser aceitar. Basta chegar perto do orbe, como os outros fizeram.
Recover the Past#294.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#295.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#295.dst: H-hã?! O orbe! Meu lindo orbe de restaurificação! Está arruinado!
Recover the Past#295.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#296.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#296.dst: ... Ah, que seja. Tenho as plantas guardadas por aqui. Sempre posso fazer outro... mas mesmo assim.
Recover the Past#296.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#297.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#297.dst: Ah! Ah, é mesmo! Desculpe, esqueci completamente de ver como você estava! Tudo bem?
Recover the Past#297.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#298.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#298.dst: Nenhuma das outras cobaias teve uma reação tão forte... estranho. É quase como se acessássemos memórias que não existiam.
Recover the Past#298.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#299.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#299.dst: ... Bom. Aham. Enfim, preciso continuar a pesquisa. Ainda há mais a aprender, tenho certeza...
Recover the Past#299.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#300.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#300.dst: Como agradecimento pela ajuda. Tome, uma recompensa. Ah, e... acho que seu amigo está logo ali fora da torre. Vá ver como ele está.
Recover the Past#300.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#301.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#301.dst: Encontre Tasim do lado de fora da torre do Dr. Picard em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#302.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#302.dst: Amaldiçoado. Ele me chamou assim. O que isso significa...?
Recover the Past#302.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#303.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#303.dst: ... Será que nos conhecemos mesmo por puro acaso? Ele fugia de algo e... caiu direto na minha vida.
Recover the Past#303.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#304.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#304.dst: Ele não precisa saber de nada disso. Ele- ele está melhor sem saber.
Recover the Past#304.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#305.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#305.dst: ... Acho que vou para a Província de Gavel. Fica do outro lado do oceano, longe o bastante de... De tudo isso.
Recover the Past#305.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#306.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#306.dst: ... Só estou descansando aqui um pouco. Logo sigo viagem.
Recover the Past#306.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#307.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...
Recover the Past#307.dst: É a caixa de que o Caid falou...

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: It be disappointin' that I wasn't able to accompany ye. Mighta been able to thump the dogs together, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#000.dst: Pena que não pude te acompanhar. Podíamos ter dado uma surra naqueles cães juntos, hein?
Redbeard's Booty#000.speaker: Grook

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever ye landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#001.dst: Isso! Vamos achar o butim e trazer uns dobrões! Eis o mapa que surrupiei. Nade ou faça o que os ratos de terra fazem pra chegar a Pirate Cove. É a primeira casa à direita ao chegar.
Redbeard's Booty#001.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: Do ye remember where to go?

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: No? The crew be loiterin' at Pirate Cove. I'll be along soon, don't ye worry!
Redbeard's Booty#003.dst: Não? A tripulação tá vadiando em Pirate Cove. Logo chego lá, não se preocupe!

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: You are not able to move but you still hear the ongoing conversation.
Redbeard's Booty#004.dst: Você não consegue se mexer, mas ainda ouve a conversa.

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: What? Another clue! This be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#005.dst: O quê? Outra pista! Isso é procurar grook no palheiro, cadê o butim de verdade?! Ninguém ficou rico com um monte de chaves!! Talvez esta joia presa aqui venda...
Redbeard's Booty#005.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: Fale com Marston no oceano em [-{~} {~} -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: Ah, ó de bordo, marujo! Veio espiar o galeão afundado do velho Redbeard também?
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: Foi um belo navio um dia, hein? Dizem que afundou numa das maiores batalhas navais da história! O capitão afundou sob as ondas, pra nunca mais ser visto!
Redbeard's Booty#008.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#009.dst: ...Diz aí. Já quis ir numa caça ao tesouro de verdade? Você tem cara de quem tem olho pra tesouro, hein?
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: Muito bem! Comprei um mapa do tesouro de verdade em Pirate Cove, um ótimo negócio, se quer saber. E, se o sujeito não mentiu, ele leva ao tesouro verdadeiro do temido Redbeard!
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: Claro, sempre cabe mais um! Vai se juntar? Uma mão a mais viria a calhar.
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: Encontre a tripulação de Marston em Pirate Cove, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#013.dst: E é aí que você vai...
Redbeard's Booty#013.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#014.dst: Credo, rapaz... cê não parece pirata pra mim, e eu sou só uma mocinha!
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: Isso aí, chapa. Quem é você, invadindo nossa casa com essa armadura chique e tal?
Redbeard's Booty#015.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#016.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#016.dst: Ah, você tá com o Marston, é? Bem, se insiste, cadê o homem em pessoa?
Redbeard's Booty#016.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: Vem depois? Hm. Bom, mais mãos sempre ajudam. Vamos descer até o meu navio, o Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#018.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#018.dst: Então ele te contou o plano? Vamos nadar em dobrões na volta! Ah, minha bela moça vai ficar tão feliz.
Redbeard's Booty#018.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: Suba a bordo do Black Ring no cais de Pirate Cove.

Redbeard's Booty#021.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#021.dst: Arrá, que pés ligeiros, rapaz! Chegou antes da gente!
Redbeard's Booty#021.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#023.dst: Que tal a gente esperar por ele? Afinal, é ele que tá nos dando a chance dessa caçada.
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: Tô perdendo a paciência... A tripulação toda tá aqui, menos ele!
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: Argh! Cadê o nosso camarada? Tá escurecendo! Vamos ter que deixar o Marston em terra.
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#026.dst: Cê tem o mapa que o Marston comprou?
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#027.dst: Vamos dar uma espiada no mapa e ver pra onde ir.
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#028.dst: Parece que uma dessas ilhas tem o tesouro... Certo, você manda, rato de terra! Trace um rumo pra uma ilha!
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: Ó de bordo, este deve ser o butim. Calma, o Argus tá deixando o navio pronto pra zarpar.
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#031.dst: Arrá, tem algo brilhando aí dentro! Acho que achamos ouro, rapazes.
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: Agora, Martim, apague o rato de terra.
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#033.dst: Espera, tem uma pista na chave! Apresentada ao Galeão arruinado, um verdadeiro caminho surgirá.
Redbeard's Booty#033.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: Grr... Tô perdendo a paciência. O Argus chegou, vamos largar o rato de terra antes que acorde, hein? Esta ilha é escondida por magia, não tem como acharem ele.
Redbeard's Booty#034.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: Beleza! Esta chave... Talvez dê pra trazer o próprio Redbeard de volta à vida... Ele vai aterrorizar os mares de novo, e seremos seus marujos!
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: Saia da ilha oculta e impeça os piratas de roubar o butim de Redbeard.

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: Fale com Marston sobre a tripulação dele em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: Não esperava nada disso... Esses cães são ligeiros, hein?
Redbeard's Booty#038.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#039.dst: Pra rato de terra, você é bem ligeiro. Quando cheguei em Pirate Cove, você já era só um ponto no horizonte.
Redbeard's Booty#039.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: Falando nisso, pelo baú de Davy Jones, o que aconteceu lá fora?!
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: Tá meio machucado! Aposto que encalhou em encrenca com eles também, né?
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#042.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#042.dst: Bem, rapaz! Acho que devia ir atrás deles! Podemos ser um bando arruaceiro, mas motim é algo que não se tolera.
Redbeard's Booty#042.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#043.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#043.dst: Eles não merecem aquele tesouro, rapaz! Nem é meu, já que te perdi. Aquele ouro é seu pra pegar... então pegue!
Redbeard's Booty#043.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#044.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#044.dst: Falando nisso... não tenho nem um tostão no bolso, mas achei este peixe enquanto cê tava fora. Dizem que vale um bom trocado, toma.
Redbeard's Booty#044.speaker: Marston

Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
Reincarnation#000.dst: Fale com Batelu na tumba de Bob.

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.dst: Olá, aventureiro! Também quer resolver o mistério da tumba de Bob? Prazer em conhecê-lo.
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.dst: Me chamo Batelu. Ultimamente tenho estudado estes símbolos estranhos nas paredes.
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.dst: É sobre o Bob. Espero que não acredite nas histórias da morte dele, certo? Bob não poderia morrer tão fácil. Não por algo tão banal quanto um lobo.
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.dst: Ele não era só forte, era absolutamente imatável, um mestre em quase todas as artes.
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.dst: Creio que ele sabia que ia morrer. Como? De quê? Ninguém sabe, mas ele deixou este mundo preparado.
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.dst: Veja, aqui diz que Bob tinha três animais leais. Antes de morrer, ele os espalhou pelo oceano.
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.dst: Acho que esses animais são a chave da verdadeira tumba dele...
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.dst: Vê aquela pequena fenda ali? É a entrada...
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.dst: Infelizmente, ninguém conseguiu tirar o feitiço que a bloqueia.
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I can. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals will come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.dst: Mas eu consigo. Sei como abrir a passagem até Bob. É aqui que os animais vão ser úteis...
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: Bring me [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather], [{~} Baab's Wool] [{~} Mooington's Skin] if you can find them.
Reincarnation#011.dst: Traga [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather], [{~} Baab's Wool] [{~} Mooington's Skin] se conseguir achá-los.

similar.text: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.

Reincarnation#012.src: How is your quest going along?

Reincarnation#013.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, I merely read it. You shall go alone. Be careful.
Reincarnation#013.dst: Não sou digno de entrar. Não completei a tarefa dos animais, só a li. Você vai sozinho. Tome cuidado.

similar.text: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
similar.reason: 名字或框架差一個字就是另一條，原文沒有改

Reincarnation#014.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#014.dst: Acho que Bob fez algo com esses animais. Se pudéssemos reuni-los de algum jeito, poderíamos abrir a passagem.
Reincarnation#014.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#015.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#015.dst: Traga {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool e {~} Mooington's Skin se conseguir achá-los.
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#016.dst: Tenho certeza de que juntos abriremos a passagem. Boa sorte.
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#017.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
Reincarnation#017.dst: Leve {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool e Mooington's Skin de volta para Batelu.

Reincarnation#018.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#018.dst: Ótimo! Já dá para abrir a passagem à verdadeira tumba de Bob...
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#019.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#019.dst: Não sou digno de entrar. Não completei a tarefa dos animais, apenas a li. Você vai sozinho, tome cuidado.
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#021.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#021.dst: Eu sou Bob, mestre das artes de Wynn.
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#022.dst: Vou explicar por que está aqui.
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#023.dst: Meus animais foram meus maiores aliados nas viagens pelo mundo.
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#024.dst: Viajei longe demais, cavei fundo demais e, claro, desafiei o que não devia ser desafiado. Meu tempo em Wynn chegava ao fim.
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#025.dst: Eu também sabia. Mas me recusei a partir sem dar o poder que alcancei aos que fossem dignos dele.
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#026.dst: Com o que me restava de habilidade, transferi meu poder aos meus animais, em três partes. Na esperança de que os dignos de dominá-lo os procurassem.
Reincarnation#026.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#027.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#027.dst: O feitiço que pus na porta deste reino só se quebra para quem reunir meu poder. Mas não deve ter passado despercebido: você não tem o meu poder.
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#028.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#028.dst: A verdade é que você deve passar por uma prova, a prova final. Afie o que aprendeu nas suas viagens e me enfrente. Me enfrente e ganhe seu lugar entre os soldados de Wynn.
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#029.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
Reincarnation#029.dst: Leve {~} Bob's Seal of Approval de volta para Batelu.

Reincarnation#030.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#030.dst: Ah! Você voltou! Diga, o que encontrou lá dentro?
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#031.dst: ...Você enfrentou o próprio Bob em combate? E venceu? Que notável!
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#032.dst: E ele te deu o selo de aprovação dele... Hm. Se for assim, há algo que posso fazer por você.
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#033.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#033.dst: Antes de morrer, Bob deixou suas armas míticas com um amigo de confiança. Deviam, segundo ele, ser guardadas para alguém digno de empunhá-las...
Reincarnation#033.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#034.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#034.dst: Sim... Sim, tenho certeza. Você provou ser digno. Pegue esta relíquia, a Pedra dos Mitos, e leve-a ao Templo das Lendas.
Reincarnation#034.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#035.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#035.dst: Lá dentro, vai encontrar um mercador que vai te oferecer uma arma em troca dela. Desejo sorte nas suas próximas viagens.
Reincarnation#035.speaker: Batelu

Revelations in Fall#000.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000.dst: Eles podiam ser perigosos. Às vezes, eram. Mas, na maioria das vezes, eram heróis. Usavam seu poder para proteger quem precisava.

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: Participe da reunião no acampamento da resistência em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#003.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: Olá a todos. Obrigada por estarem aqui hoje.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: Está cada vez mais claro que há muito pouco que possamos fazer daqui para causar um impacto maior em Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: Temos feito o bem pelo povo de Auburn! Mas nossos recursos são limitados, e nossas chances de agir, mais ainda.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: Além disso, os riscos da operação crescem a cada dia. Não me arrependo de aceitar {u} como membro, mas não é segredo que tê-lo aqui nos expõe a mais vigilância.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: Zeph e {u} souberam ontem que um Inquisidor está chegando à região. Não sabemos exatamente para quê, mas a presença dele põe nossa causa em mais perigo.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine - they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: No festival, recebi notícias de um contato em Roughworks. Há um grupo parecido com o nosso lá, liderado por um velho amigo meu - eles se chamam a Pluma de Aço.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: Eles têm recursos que não temos e estão numa posição bem mais favorável. Se conseguirmos atravessar para Roughworks, aceitaram nos receber e ajudar a planejar nossos passos.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: Então, quais são os próximos passos? Não sei o que espera que a gente faça lá que já não possa fazer aqui.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#011.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: Ainda estou lapidando ideias, mas elas envolvem o Festival da Coroa. Se formos rápidos, vamos pegá-lo em Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: Claro, viajar para outro distrito traz seus próprios riscos e perigos... se algum de vocês quiser ficar aqui, vou respeitar a decisão.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#013.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: Ha! E deixar a senhorita traçar estratégias sozinha? Eu já previa algo assim, então já acertei tudo no trabalho. Vou com a senhorita.
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#014.src: And I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: E eu é que não vou ficar de fora, tá brincando? Eu te sigo aonde você for, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#015.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: E- eu também vou! Q- qual é o sentido de te- ter magia se eu não usar pela nossa c- c- causa?
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#016.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: Eh. Não me vejo sendo muito útil lá fora, pra ser sincero, Synny. E acho que precisa de alguém pra segurar as pontas enquanto estiver fora, de todo jeito. Então eu fico.
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#017.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#017.dst: Eu agradeço, Kaio. Vou partir mais tranquila sabendo que as Folhas ao Vento estão em boas mãos.
Revelations in Fall#017.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Vão precisar... dos meus remédios. Eu vou...
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#021.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you-
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: Sui... você pode ficar, se quiser. Não quero te forçar-
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#022.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#022.dst: N-não! Eu quero ir com vocês! Só... preciso me despedir de algumas pessoas. Antes de irmos.
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#026.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: Fico sempre em dívida com você. Obrigada de novo pela ajuda.
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#027.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: Em Wynn, há histórias de pessoas que usavam magia como você. Era natural para elas, e não precisavam de um foco.

Revelations in Fall#028.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: Ai, ai... Queria poder discordar. Mas tem razão, preciso que venha junto.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: Ainda preciso me preparar antes de partir- mais precisamente, arranjar passagem pela fronteira. Tenho um contato que posso... com sorte, convencer.
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#030.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean-
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: V- você não pode estar fa- falando de-
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: Sim, Zeph, estou. Vai dar tudo certo.
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#032.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#032.dst: Quanto ao resto de vocês, façam seus preparativos. Não sei quanto tempo vai durar a janela de oportunidade, então aproveitem o tempo que resta.
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#033.dst: Hmn... Zeph, por que a preocupação? Todos sabemos que a senhorita Syndra sabe o que faz! Se ela diz que está tudo sob controle, não vejo motivo para duvidar!
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#035.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#035.dst: Ah, não importa! Venham, crianças... e {u}, claro! Vamos todos tirar um tempo para nos despedir. Afinal, não sabemos quando voltaremos!
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#036.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#037.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#037.dst: Sui... nós vamos voltar. Eu garanto! E você sabe que sempre cumpro minha palavra nessas coisas.
Revelations in Fall#037.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#038.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#038.dst: Vai dar tudo certo, Sui. Sempre dá.
Revelations in Fall#038.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#039.dst: ...{u}, d- dá pra falar lá fora?
Revelations in Fall#039.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#040.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#040.dst: Fale com Zeph do lado de fora da base em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#041.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: Não sei se e- eu dou conta disso.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#042.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#042.dst: Mas eu tenho que dar! Eu... eu tenho.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: É que... eu n- não confio no Soberano, e t- t- tenho medo que ele faça a- al- algo com a Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: É- é bobagem, mas... se v- você e eu a- acharmos um jeito de passar o muro sem pedir a ele d- diretamente, dá pra evitar um p- possível con- conflito.
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: E além disso, não tenho n- na- nada melhor pra fazer...
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: So! L- let's head into town and s- s- see if we can-
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: Então! V- vamos até a cidade e v- v- ver se dá pra-
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt- I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Hã... com licença, d-desculpa interromper- ouvi que vocês iam... até a cidade?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#049.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: Sui! É- é, a gente pl- planejava ir.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#050.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: Se... se não for muito incômodo... será que eu podia ir com vocês? Eu, ah... tenho umas pessoas de quem quero... me despedir.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: Ah... o pessoal da R- Ra- da Raposa Vermelha?
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: É... um restaurante que eu, hã, frequento. Os donos são... legais. Queria agradecer a eles, por, ha, tudo.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#053.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: E fica no topo de uma da- das árvores mais al- altas de {p}... então s- se- serve pra minha ideia. Fica lo- logo fora dos portões de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#053.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: Vá até o café Raposa Vermelha, no alto das árvores, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#055.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: V- vamos nos ver na Ra- Raposa Vermelha. Fica lo- lo- logo fora dos Portões de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: E aí, o- o que achou? A vista daqui de cima é b- bonita, n- não é?
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: Eu... trago os outros aqui sempre. Eles, hã, servem a melhor comida de {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#059.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: É... vou s- sen- sentir falta dos lanches de madrugada. Hehe.
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#060.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can-
Revelations in Fall#060.dst: S- Sui, quer que a gente f- fique? Podemos-
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll... go find Chen on my own. You two, um, had something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: N-não! Não, não, está... tudo bem. Eu... vou atrás do Chen sozinha. Vocês dois, hã, tinham algo pra fazer, né?
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: Tínhamos... hã, se t- tem certeza, Sui. Até d- de- depois?
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: S... sim. Hã, boa... boa sorte!
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#064.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#064.dst: ...tá. Bom, {u}, o mo- motivo de virmos aqui... daqui de c- ci- daqui de cima, temos bom acesso aos t- tel- telhados.
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: Eu q- q- quero ver se dá pra pa- passar o muro. Se fi- ficarmos nos telhados, devemos ev- evitar suspeitas...
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#067.dst: Siga Zeph até o galho da árvore em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: Ah, Sui! Que prazer te ver, como sempre!
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#069.dst: Oi, Chen... os, hã, negócios vão bem?
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: Hum, tão bem quanto se pode esperar, eu diria! O Festival sempre traz uma enxurrada de clientes. Então, preparo o de sempre pra você?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: Ah. Hã... é muita gentileza, mas, não, hoje não. Obrigada.
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: Muito bem, muito bem. Bom, já que está aqui, posso perguntar se pensou na minha oferta de emprego?
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: A essa altura você sabe nosso cardápio de cor, então acho mesmo que você se encaixaria muito bem.
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#075.dst: Tá, então... é só s- se- seguir as trilhas verdes !
Revelations in Fall#075.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#076.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: Se você se p- perder, me encontre aqui.
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: Atravesse os telhados de {p} partindo de .

Revelations in Fall#079.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#079.dst: Você, hã, q- quer fazer uma pausa?
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#080.dst: Tá bom, b- boa sorte! Só le- lembre de seguir a trilha verde.
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: E- eu já te sigo, só estou a- aq- aquecendo um pouco antes.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#083.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#083.dst: É só vo- voltar aqui quando quiser co- começar de novo.
Revelations in Fall#083.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: Ha, a- acho que desta vez você chegou a- an- antes de mim!
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#087.dst: Aah! Eu... eu... f- foi... p- po- por pouco.
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: Aquilo foi... a- aquilo foi m- magia, né...? Foi c- co- foi como se meu corpo todo fosse... f- fosse en- envolto por uma, uma b- br- brisa suave...
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: Eu... ha. Aq- aquilo foi- e- e- emocionante, mas... m- mas... N- não- não tem como a gente c- cr- a gente cruzar esses t- te- telhados... um s- su- um susto já basta p- pra mim.
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: Argh... v- vamos só... voltar pra R- Raposa Vermelha...
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: Volte à Raposa Vermelha e fale com Zeph em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#092.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: É que... e- e- eu não gosto disso. Não gosto que a S- Syn- Syndra se coloque em- em perigo desse jeito!
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: Eu... eu devo muito a ela. Se não fosse por ela, e- e- eu ainda estaria pr- preso nas... nas r- ru- ruas. É graças a ela que ainda estou... aqui.
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: É... eu, hã, cresci num- numa aldeia pequena. A- alguém foi acusado de ser a- amaldiçoado, e... meu povo se recusou a e- en- entregar a pessoa sem u- u- se- sem lutar.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: ...aliás, o- onde ela está? A- achei que ela ia nos esperar antes de...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: Ah, o- oi, Chen. Preciso ir, mas você viu a Sui? A gente ia se en- en- encontrar aqui.
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: Sim, a Sui... ela saiu faz pouco tempo. Coitadinha, claramente algo está pesando nela...
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: Acho que ela deve ter ido à lagoa a sudeste... é pra lá que costuma ir quando precisa de ar.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: Ah, e- entendi. O- obrigado pela ajuda!
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: Claro, tudo por vocês, crianças. Passem aqui de novo logo, tá? Faço a travessa família pra vocês, por conta da casa.
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#103.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: Eu... c- claro, a gente... vem sim! Valeu pela o- oferta.
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#104.dst: {u}, posso te pedir um f- fa- favor?
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#105.dst: Você pode ir v- ver como a Sui está, p- por favor? Eu... eu não sei c- como ajudar ela agora...
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: A- al- alguma coisa a preocupa, mas... m- mas ela não quer me contar. Eu t- tentei perguntar, mas...
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: ...mas se você perguntar, t- talvez ela te conte? E- eu não sei. Pelo m- menos vale a tentativa, n- n- né?
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: O- obrigado, {u}. Chen disse que ela e- estava na lagoa a sudeste.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#110.dst: Encontre Sui perto da lagoa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#111.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#111.dst: A-ah, {u}! Eu não... hã, esperava te ver aqui.
Revelations in Fall#111.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#113.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#113.dst: Ah... é. Eu só... precisava de ar. É, ha, muita coisa. S-sair de Auburn, quero dizer! Eu nunca... conheci outro lugar.
Revelations in Fall#113.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#114.dst: Posso... te contar uma coisa? Eu estava... queria falar com você antes, mas, hã, eu... não consegui criar coragem.
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: D-desculpa, eu devia só... ir em frente. Ta- talvez seja mais fácil te mostrar, ha...
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#116.dst: Você é o primeiro, hã, amaldiçoado que eu já... vi. E- e todo mundo tão gentil com, com tudo isso...
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: E pensei, talvez... talvez você pudesse... me ajudar. A mim. A e-entender tudo.
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: Mas... eu não uso, hã, um foco. Pra... pra controlar a água. E-então, quer dizer que sou, uma das... p-perigosas. É... f-foi o que o Mora disse, hã, antes.
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#120.dst: V-você- você não tem como saber!
Revelations in Fall#120.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#122.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#122.dst: Ah... q-que bom. Isso- isso é bom. Fico feliz.
Revelations in Fall#122.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#123.dst: Ah... isso é, ha, muito pra se fazer por alguém. I-invadir uma província? Não consigo imaginar, hã, fazer algo assim...
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#124.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#124.dst: Eu só... tenho medo. Medo de que- de que, se eu tentar usar, eu vá, m-machucar alguém...
Revelations in Fall#124.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: Eu... não sou muito corajosa, haha. Eu não entrei, de verdade, na resistência porque... porque queria enfrentar a Coroa!
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#127.dst: ... Só estou aqui porque segui o Mora. Ele é o corajoso! N-não- não eu. Eu só, ha, não tinha pra onde ir.
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: E- e todo mundo está tão, empolgado com a m-ma-magia! Até, hã, o Mora. E eu aqui, com medo até- até de tentar!
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: É, mas... não- não ia parecer, hã, certo. Se o resto da minha família vai, então, ha, como eu não iria com eles?
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: E se... acontecesse algo com eles- com você - e, e, e- e eu não estivesse, lá? Eu... eu nunca me p-perdoaria!
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: Então... e-então, mesmo com medo... não posso ficar.
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#133.dst: ...eu não sou, hã, muito de lutar. Mas ainda sou boa com r-remédios e curas. Então... posso ajudar.
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: Vamos... pra casa. Preciso dizer ao Zeph que estou bem.
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: Volte às Folhas ao Vento em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#136.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: Eu... eu quero ajudar. Só estou... com medo.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: Hrmm... ah, {u}, justamente a folha que eu procurava!
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#139.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: Estou quase terminando os preparativos da expedição. Suprimentos embalados, despedidas feitas, e assim por diante.
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#140.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#140.dst: Há... uma última coisa, porém. Posso pedir um favor a você?
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#141.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: ...ah, dia corrido, presumo? Prometo que será rápido, se puder me ouvir.
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: Eu havia mencionado antes que suas palavras sobre magia ressoaram em mim! Tenho tirado um tempo para praticar, com a ajuda de noções superficiais de bênçãos militares.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: Mas esse treino me servirá de pouco num combate de verdade. Então, em nome do aprimoramento, peço uma luta de treino contra você!
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#145.dst: Vai me ajudar a identificar e reforçar minhas fraquezas. Talvez faça o mesmo por você!
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: Venha, siga-me até nossa arena de treino!
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: Ufa... você é muito talentoso, devo dizer!
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#150.dst: Não admira que a senhorita Syndra aposte em você, depois de enfrentá-lo!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#151.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Sério! Na hora, não parecia que eu tinha muita chance, mas imagino que ainda estou aprendendo a manejá-la!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: Mas é curioso. Só descobri isso há pouco, e mesmo assim parece que a magia esteve comigo o tempo todo! É como... memória muscular, suponho? Muito em que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: Ha! Não precisa adoçar. Sempre me especializei em golpes pesados, então sofro contra oponentes velozes. Raramente consegui vencer o Zeph num treino!
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: Talvez aí esteja o valor desta magia... achar formas de ampliar a área de efeito, ou desacelerar os alvos? Muito em que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: Excelente pergunta, mas não tenho respostas de verdade. Talvez um pouco do que aprendi de fontes militares tenha ficado comigo?
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: Confio que vai chegar ao Zeph com o tempo. Ele é persistente! Essa qualidade vai servir bem a ele nisso.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Ei, Mora! Você viu- ah, aí está você. Estava te procurando.
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#161.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: Eu tinha um amigo... ele também era de Fruma, e era "amaldiçoado". E também sofria com esse rótulo, como você.

Revelations in Fall#162.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: Mas ele fez as pazes com isso. Usou suas habilidades para fortalecer a si e aos aliados. Ele fez a diferença.

Revelations in Fall#163.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: Certo, {u}, venha comigo. Vamos RESOLVER nossos problemas antes de partir.
Revelations in Fall#163.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: Vamos, vamos! Pro toco gigante, não tenho o dia todo!
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#165.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: ... Ah. Minha nossa. Ela parece estar de mau humor hoje! Suponho que faça sentido, dado...
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: Hmm, como posso dizer...? Ah, deixa pra lá. Melhor seguir ela até a árvore e ver o que quer.
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: Fique de olho nela por mim, sim? Que ela volte pra casa em segurança.
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: Encontre Rex no velho toco de árvore em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: Fique de olho na Rex, sim? Faz tempo que não a vejo tão agitada...
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Que bom, você veio. Demorou, hein!
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#171.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: Então, é o seguinte! Você é um problema.
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#172.dst: Claro, você já provou seu valor cem vezes! De novo e de novo e de novo, mostrou que está do nosso lado.
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: E isso é ótimo! Ótimo e tudo mais! Mas. Mas mas mas mas mas! Você ainda. É. De Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
