Revelations in Fall#174.dst: Ou... originalmente de Fruma, que seja. Esse é o problema, na verdade! Se você fosse só de Wynn, talvez não fosse tão ruim!
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: Tem taaanta gente de Fruma que foi despachada pra Wynn! Eles adoram mandar embora as crianças problemáticas quando não aguentam mais lidar com elas.
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: Eu entendo! Entendo mesmo! Faz sentido! Mas ainda... por que, por que... por que é VOCÊ aqui, e não- não...!
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: Então, eu tinha um irmão, sabe? E tá, ele era um idiota às vezes, mas- mas era o único lá que me entendia de verdade.
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#179.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#179.dst: Foi ele que entalhou meu arco. Soube que eu gostava de arco e flecha, então ele... quando todo mundo me dizia pra focar nos estudos, ele me ajudou a aprender.
Revelations in Fall#179.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#180.dst: Ele odiava todas as regras que a gente tinha lá em cima. Então gostava de quebrá-las. Muito. E um dia a Coroa se cansou. Empacotou ele e mandou pra Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#181.dst: O pior é que nossos pais concordaram! Disseram que trabalho pesado de verdade ia fazer bem pra ele!
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: Eu nunca gostei de lá, mesmo. Demorei pra criar coragem, mas no fim roubei um pouco do nosso dinheiro e comprei uma passagem pra lá.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: Não levei muita coisa. Acho que esperava encontrar ele e morar com ele! Que burrice. Devia ter pensado melhor.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: Ele não estava lá, óbvio. Uns amigos dele disseram que ele continuou fazendo besteira por lá. Foi pego pela Coroa, e decidiram parar de dar segundas chances a ele.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and- and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: Então, ele se foi! Prometeu que um dia me veria de novo, e- e claro que não cumpriu. Acho que eu não era importante o bastante pra ser lembrada.
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: É, eu sei. Eu só... acho que só esperava ser uma exceção.
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: Não fui muito justa com você, né? Não é culpa sua estar aqui e ele não.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: Me dá um tempo, tá? Preciso... sei lá. Só preciso de espaço.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#190.dst: Ha! Ele faria isso mesmo, né...
Revelations in Fall#190.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#191.dst: Tá. Eu... não vou demorar muito. Ninguém nunca vem aqui, mesmo.
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#192.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#192.dst: Volte ao acampamento e termine de arrumar as coisas em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#194.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#194.dst: Só espero que ele esteja por aí, em algum lugar...
Revelations in Fall#194.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#195.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#195.dst: A- aí está você! A gente, hã, temeu que a- al- algo ruim tivesse acontecido.
Revelations in Fall#195.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#196.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#196.dst: Eu... digo... e- eles se preocuparam.
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#198.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: Só estávamos conversando. Deuses, vocês e essa imaginação fértil...
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#200.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#200.dst: Receio que não. Não ouvimos nada desde a reunião desta manhã.
Revelations in Fall#200.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#201.dst: Hã... a gente... desfaz as malas?
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#202.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: Vamos apenas continuar confiando na Syndra, como fizemos tantas vezes! Ela sabe se cuidar.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#203.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go-
Revelations in Fall#203.dst: Argh! Eu sabia que c- con- confiar no Soberano e- era erro! P- p- precisamos ir-
Revelations in Fall#203.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#204.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#204.dst: Com licença- o Soberano? Como assim o S-
Revelations in Fall#204.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#206.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#206.dst: Ai, ai... Cheguei tarde demais, pelo visto.
Revelations in Fall#206.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#207.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#207.dst: Bom, já que veio à tona, é melhor eu me explicar. Primeiro, devo um pedido de desculpas a todos vocês.
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: Mora, tudo bem. Eu ia revelar esse segredo de qualquer jeito.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#210.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: O contato que mencionei hoje cedo - é o Soberano Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#212.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#212.dst: O quê?! Há quanto tempo você- espera, Mora, você sabia?
Revelations in Fall#212.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#213.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: Foi um segredo guardado por necessidade. Quanto ao tempo... digamos que um bom tempo, e fiquemos nisso. Mas estamos deixando {p}, então não há por que esconder mais.
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#214.dst: Sei que todos se preocupam comigo... e não quis somar mais uma preocupação ao dia de hoje. Desculpem.
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though - I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: Sim, estão comigo. Zhiraok me deu o suficiente pra todos. Mas vamos ter que ser rápidos - quero cruzar pra Roughworks antes que ele desconfie do que está acontecendo.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#217.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#217.dst: ...e- então você está bem? D- deu tudo certo?
Revelations in Fall#217.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#218.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#218.dst: Sim, Zeph, estou bem. Já arrumaram tudo? Cruzar a fronteira vai levar um tempo, então precisamos partir pra {p} agora.
Revelations in Fall#218.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: Vamos, depressa. Vamos deixar este capítulo para trás.
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#220.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: Atravesse o portão para Roughworks em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], em {p}.

Revelations in Fall#221.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#221.dst: E-eu e-estou pronto. Tenho que estar.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#222.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#222.dst: Acho que isso está mesmo acontecendo...
Revelations in Fall#222.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#223.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: Vamos nos encontrar no portão para Roughworks e atravessar juntos!
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#224.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: Ah... aí está você. A, hã, fila estava enorme quando chegamos, então, nós... já entramos nela.
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: Tudo está... bem, por enquanto. Acho. Eu... espero.
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#229.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#234.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#238.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#238.dst: Chega disso, crianças. Senhorita Syndra, chegamos a Roughworks, certo?
Revelations in Fall#238.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#239.src: We have. We'll follow the plan - regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before-
Revelations in Fall#239.dst: Chegamos. Vamos seguir o plano - nos reagrupar perto de {p}, a cidade da região. Precisamos ser rápidos, não sei quanto tempo temos antes que-
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#240.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#240.dst: Zero, Syndra. Seu tempo é zero.
Revelations in Fall#240.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#241.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#241.dst: ... Soberano. Rápido e eficiente como sempre.
Revelations in Fall#241.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#242.src: Naturally. You completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#242.dst: Naturalmente. Você errou feio o cálculo ao achar que passaria escondida. Uma variável indesejada não é uma inesperada.
Revelations in Fall#242.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#243.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#243.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#244.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#244.dst: Que lixo. Transladar-se para Roughworks anula por completo o pacto da Coroa... Como se não fossem te ver.
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#245.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#245.dst: Mas quem errou o cálculo fui eu! Seu ângulo era tão óbvio, e eu sempre o ignorava. Seguia confiando em você. Esperando que sossegasse, que encerrasse essa sequência.
Revelations in Fall#245.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#246.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#246.dst: E aqui está você... com um assassino em massa! O amaldiçoado que causou o massacre de Torann!! Que lógica de ordem ínfima é essa?! No que estava PENSANDO?!
Revelations in Fall#246.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#247.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#247.dst: Não é óbvio, Soberano? Quero Sua Majestade destronada. Quero o império dela em ruínas.
Revelations in Fall#247.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#248.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're- You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: Seu trabalho era se infiltrar, não se somar à resistência!! Desde quando passou pro outro lado da equação?! Está subtraindo sua única chance, está- Está desperdiçando tudo o que fiz por você!
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#249.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: Então, depois de tudo o que Ela me fez, esperava que eu aceitasse calada?! Que me contentasse com migalhas, que perdoasse e esquecesse?!
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#250.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#250.dst: Talvez o tolo sempre tenha sido você, Zhiraok, por acreditar.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#251.src: ...so was it all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: ...então era tudo imaginário? Nada real? Eu gostava de você, como amiga. Confidente. E você? Ou... eu era só uma ferramenta útil?
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: Isso... importa. ...ha. Isso importa!! Sabe quanto peso você tinha nas minhas operações do dia a dia? Me pergunto quanto eu tinha nas suas!!
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#254.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown- and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: Não me alegra fazer isso. Sua resistência está presa pelo crime de conspiração contra a Coroa- e seu amaldiçoado, condenado à execução.
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still-
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: Ainda posso mexer uns pauzinhos, Syndra. Arredondar tudo isso. Talvez eu te mantenha como parte do resto se você se entregar. Ainda podemos-
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#256.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#257.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#257.dst: ...por que... me dou ao trabalho. Um amaldiçoado perto de mim... puro lixo. Vamos acabar logo.
Revelations in Fall#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you-
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: S- Syndra, vo- você e- está-
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#263.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just-
Revelations in Fall#263.dst: Vamos. Todos, lembrem do ponto de encontro, só-
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#264.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#264.dst: Vamos mesmo fingir que você não matou um Soberano????
Revelations in Fall#264.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#265.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: Sim, Rex, porque ele não vai ficar caído muito tempo- temos que ir, agora!
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#266.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days- now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: Separem-se, cuidado, sem ser pegos. Nos vemos em três dias- já, VÃO!
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#267.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: Soberano Zhiraok, senhor! Tem uma visita aqui!
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#268.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#268.dst: Mande entrar, e se puder processar estes arquivos, por-favor-e-obrigado? Preciso que o inquisidor opine sobre o problema.
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#269.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short-
Revelations in Fall#269.dst: Tenho um valor finito de tempo pra isso, então vamos ser breves-
Revelations in Fall#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#270.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#270.dst: Olá, Soberano. Desculpe interromper seu horário de trabalho mais uma vez.
Revelations in Fall#270.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#271.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too- You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#271.dst: Vou somar à contagem! E ainda traz o problema direto pro meu escritório- Estou nervoso com o número de vezes que isso aconteceu ultimamente.
Revelations in Fall#271.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#272.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle- Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#272.dst: Direto ao ponto, então. Me diga qual é o seu ângulo- Argh. Qual é o seu pedido.
Revelations in Fall#272.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#273.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#273.dst: Não guarde isso, vai ter uma úlcera. Vou ser rápida- preciso de passagem pra Roughworks. Pra mim e mais cinco pessoas.
Revelations in Fall#273.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#274.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#274.dst: ...está me pedindo a quadratura do círculo. Por que precisa fazer isso, ir pra lá? E tão de repente? Por quê?
Revelations in Fall#274.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#275.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#275.dst: Eu... preciso encontrá-la. Não sei quanto tempo mais vou ter pra tentar.
Revelations in Fall#275.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#276.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#276.dst: Eu sei, eu sei!! Pare de se fazer de obtusa, sabe as consequências de quebrar o mandato, pra nós dois!!
Revelations in Fall#276.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#278.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: ...É só isso? E os outros cinco?
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we- If you- I-
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: Claro. Você e seus vira-latas. Por que não pode só... Deve haver outra solução, se a gente- Se você- Eu-
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#281.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: ...por que eu me dou ao trabalho. Tá. Quer tanto assim, tá bom!! Sabe o que isso vai custar. Só... Lembre. Lembre do que eu fiz por você.
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#282.dst: Obrigada, Zhiraok. Não vou desperdiçar sua bondade.
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns-
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: Soberano Zhiraok! O Inquisidor Renn tem umas dúvidas-
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#284.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#284.dst: Xao, limpe minha agenda. Agora há uma prioridade maior, ele pode esperar.
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#285.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top-
Revelations in Fall#285.dst: Ah! Hã, claro! Se insiste, senhor!! O Inquisidor Renn vai odiar, mas suas ordens são priori-
Revelations in Fall#285.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#286.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: Não, você tem razão, estou sendo irracional. Você sempre tem razão. Limpe tudo menos isso, tudo bem. Volto a isso depois. Variáveis inesperadas, circunstâncias atenuantes...
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#287.src: Sov- ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her-
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: Sobe- ...Zhi-Zhi? Está tudo bem? Você... parece abalado, foi algo que ela disse? Será que não devia ter trazido ela-
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#288.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: Você não fez nada de errado. Ela me deu uma oportunidade de primeira. Um aviso antes de desalinhar minha sequência.
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: Xao, confio em você. Preciso deixar Auburn aos seus cuidados por ora enquanto resolvo isso. Por favor. Dá conta?
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#290.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: ...nossa, eu... É uma honra! Não vou decepcionar, senhor!! Vou deixar tudo nos trinques! Mas por que eu, pra isso?
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#291.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: ...preciso convergir em Roughworks, assumir o trabalho dela por um tempo. E o próximo Festival da Coroa está perto. Sinto que... seria um desserviço perdê-lo.
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#292.src: I don't think I have much of
Revelations in Fall#292.dst: Acho que não tenho muita escolha.
Revelations in Fall#292.full: I don't think I have much of a choice.

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across the rest of these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#296.dst: N- não- não tem como a gente c- cr- a gente cruzar o resto desses t- te- telhados... um s- su- um susto já basta p- pra mim.
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#299.src: I'm in Fruma to find him.

Revelations in Fall#303.src: Mora asked me to make sure y
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: A Mora me pediu pra garantir que você chegasse bem em casa.
Revelations in Fall#303.full: Mora asked me to make sure you got home safe.

Revelations in Fall#306.src: You don't have to come along if you don't want to, you know?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: Você não precisa vir se não quiser, sabia?
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Player

Rise of the Quartron#000.src: ...Go on...I still need you to figure everything out...
Rise of the Quartron#000.dst: ...Vá em frente... Ainda preciso que você descubra tudo...

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: ... This miner looks like he's been dead for years. The clock in his hands is cracked, and doesn't appear to be functional.
Rise of the Quartron#001.dst: ... Este mineiro parece estar morto há anos. O relógio nas mãos dele está rachado e não parece funcionar.

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: And yet... You can hear the clock's continuous ticking throughout the cavern. It's almost mesmerizing...
Rise of the Quartron#002.dst: E ainda assim... Você ouve o tique-taque incessante do relógio na caverna toda. É quase hipnótico...

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: You should take it, you might find a use for it somewhere.
Rise of the Quartron#003.dst: Você devia pegá-lo, pode ser útil em algum lugar.

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Well, glad ye did! A friend o' the boss is welcome 'round here.
Rise of the Quartron#006.dst: Bem, que bom! Um amigo da chefe é bem-vindo por aqui.
Rise of the Quartron#006.speaker: Karoc Miner

Rise of the Quartron#007.src: ... While ye're here, feel like solvin' another issue for us?
Rise of the Quartron#007.dst: ... Já que está aqui, topa resolver outro problema pra gente?
Rise of the Quartron#007.speaker: Karoc Miner

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: Ye see the cave up that hill? S'cursed. Used te be a mine shaft, s'far as I can tell.
Rise of the Quartron#008.dst: Vê a caverna lá no alto do morro? É amaldiçoada. Era um poço de mina, pelo que sei.

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: There's always strange noises comin' from there. We stay away from it. Ye ever feel like explorin', go take a look.
Rise of the Quartron#009.dst: Sempre sai uns barulhos estranhos de lá. A gente fica longe. Se um dia quiser explorar, vá dar uma olhada.
Rise of the Quartron#009.speaker: Karoc Miner

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: [{~}/{~}] Nasea:I wonder if that huge detonation is going to interfere with any more of our projects...it's annoying, but nothing for it.
Rise of the Quartron#010.dst: [{~}/{~}] Nasea:Será que aquela detonação enorme vai atrapalhar mais algum projeto nosso... é irritante, mas fazer o quê.
Rise of the Quartron#010.speaker: Manager Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: I think I'll write an anonymous letter instead. If those rumors about the factory are true, keeping myself secret might be important...
Rise of the Quartron#011.dst: Acho que vou escrever uma carta anônima. Se os boatos sobre a fábrica forem verdade, manter meu anonimato pode ser importante...

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, they're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#012.dst: Agh, isso está piorando! Nunca houve tanta perda... quem quer que seja, está ficando ousado...
Rise of the Quartron#012.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: Dado won't budge about the topic. Maybe Nasea has an idea to get him to confess.
Rise of the Quartron#013.dst: O Dado não abre o bico. Talvez a Nasea tenha uma ideia pra fazer ele confessar.

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: Come back when you have a solid lead on the missing quartz.
Rise of the Quartron#014.dst: Volte quando tiver uma pista concreta sobre o quartzo sumido.

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: You press the flower up against his nose while he's laughing. Dado gets a big whiff of the petals, and immediately his expression goes slack.
Rise of the Quartron#015.dst: Você encosta a flor no nariz dele enquanto ele ri. Dado dá uma boa fungada nas pétalas, e na hora sua expressão fica frouxa.

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: ...uh. Okay, I have no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#016.dst: ...hã. Tá, não faço ideia de por que te contei tudo isso... hã, mas você tem mais daquelas flores? Era bom de verdade...
Rise of the Quartron#016.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: Use the small rail here, push that button on the post. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#017.dst: Use o trilho pequeno aqui e aperte o botão no poste. Vai parecer que você está só... fazendo coisas de humano, sem levantar suspeita.
Rise of the Quartron#017.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: Aah, they're really tough!! Don't let them take down more of my buddies!
Rise of the Quartron#019.dst: Aah, eles são duros na queda!! Não deixem derrubarem mais amigos meus!

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: Why are we fighting face-to-face?! They're destroying us!!
Rise of the Quartron#020.dst: Por que lutamos cara a cara?! Estão acabando com a gente!!

Rise of the Quartron#021.src: What the hell are humans made of?! Overwhelm them!! We hardly have any guys left!
Rise of the Quartron#021.dst: Do que diabos humanos são feitos?! Cerquem eles!! Quase não sobrou ninguém!

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: The door is locked. There has to be a way to get in...
Rise of the Quartron#022.dst: A porta está trancada. Tem que haver um jeito de entrar...

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Looks like someone's notebook. You open to a page that looks interesting...
Rise of the Quartron#023.dst: Parece o caderno de alguém. Você abre numa página interessante...

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: I've finally cracked it- a functional model for my magnum opus, the Harnort Quartron! I even amaze myself, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: Finalmente decifrei- um modelo funcional da minha obra-prima, o Harnort Quartron! Até eu me impressiono, sim, sim!

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: The mech is both made of and has functions to break apart quartz. We'll be able to salvage every bit from the rubble of {p}'s committee building...
Rise of the Quartron#025.dst: O mech é feito de quartzo e tem funções pra despedaçá-lo. Poderemos recuperar cada pedaço dos escombros do prédio do comitê de {p}...

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: The fools in the committee will see their error when their rooms get blown apart in front of them! They'll see my brilliance!
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: Os tolos do comitê vão ver seu erro quando as salas explodirem na frente deles! Vão ver o meu brilhantismo!

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: Large-scale mechs that even Corkus's machines pale in comparison to, the possibilities for them are so much more than just warfare...
Rise of the Quartron#027.dst: Mechs de grande escala diante dos quais até as máquinas de Corkus empalidecem, e as possibilidades vão muito além da guerra...

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: But my subordinates need to hurry with the quartz shipments. The Karoc manager may catch onto us if we don't...and I regret thieving enough already.
Rise of the Quartron#028.dst: Mas meus subordinados precisam se apressar com os envios de quartzo. A gerente de Karoc pode desconfiar se não... e já me arrependo dos roubos.

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: The quartz is charged! Use this to overcharge the door and destroy it!
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: O quartzo está carregado! Use para sobrecarregar a porta e destruí-la!

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: There's a charging slot in the machine.
Rise of the Quartron#030.dst: Há um encaixe de carga na máquina.

Rise of the Quartron#031.src: The door is locked shut, and there's no keyhole anyplace.
Rise of the Quartron#031.dst: A porta está bem trancada, e não há fechadura em lugar nenhum.

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: It's made of quartz, it looks like...the sign says not to overcharge the quartz.
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: Parece feita de quartzo... a placa diz para não sobrecarregar o quartzo.

Rise of the Quartron#033.src: Nasea mentioned that overcharging quartz was dangerous...maybe overcharging the door will destroy it.
Rise of the Quartron#033.dst: A Nasea disse que sobrecarregar quartzo era perigoso... talvez sobrecarregar a porta a destrua.

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Is there a way to charge quartz anyplace nearby?
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: Há algum jeito de carregar quartzo aqui perto?

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: ...so it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: ...então chegamos a isso. Eu sabia o nome de todos esses guardas. Não feri ninguém pelo meu objetivo.
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: One life for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: Uma vida por cem é uma troca justa!!
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You...YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: Aaah! Não responde?! Você- Você... VOCÊ! Destruiu o futuro! O MEU futuro! O futuro de GAVEL!!!
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to go get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: ...você tem muito o que explicar. Primeiro some pra buscar aquela flor Tattle, ou sei lá o quê.
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or mugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: Depois o Dado passou correndo gritando que foi drogado ou assaltado, e fugiu pro cume leste.
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... ...I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: ...aham. Hum. ... ...tá, continua. Hã, tá, dá pra acreditar... ...Nunca acreditaria se você não tivesse me dado a prova.
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: Okay, so I'll cut you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do just one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#041.dst: Tá, vou te fazer uma proposta rápida. Te pago agora por ter descoberto isso, e se fizer só mais uma coisa pra mim, ganha algo extra.
Rise of the Quartron#041.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: Envio {~}A e {~}B, tudo conferido... envios {~}C e {~}A... faltando {~} de quartzo?!
Rise of the Quartron#043.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: Argh, SOME! Pare de ficar espiando por cima do meu ombro- espera, um Humano? Desde quando tá aqui?
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: O quê, gosta de ouvir o som melodioso da minha voz ou algo assim? Ou pretende ajudar?
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: Bem, me sinto lisonjeada de qualquer jeito, e uma ajuda viria bem. Está sumindo quartzo dos meus envios.
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: Óbvio que um dos operários está desviando pra algum lugar, e não posso permitir isso. Então banque o detetive, humaninho.
Rise of the Quartron#047.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: Isso é bem grave- o quartzo tem algo de mágico, sabe. Gosta de absorver poder mágico, então pode ser usado como arma.
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: A gente costuma não usar pra armas porque pode sobrecarregar, mas isso não vem ao caso, né?
Rise of the Quartron#049.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: Todo envio desviado passou pelo Dado. Interrogue ele! Fica atrás da tendona vermelha, perto da casa de bandeiras vermelhas.
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: Fale com Dado e veja se ele é o culpado.

Rise of the Quartron#052.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#052.dst: Tá, estes vão pra divisão P, e... olha, estou ocupado distribuindo estas entregas pra {p}. Vá encher outro, tá?
Rise of the Quartron#052.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: ...quê. Você... acha que eu... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, essa é BOA vindo justo de um humano!
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: "Oh, eu, da espécie mercenária que mata por dinheiro, acuso você, trabalhador de sete anos, de atividade ilegal!" Nossa, seu HIPÓCRITA!
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: Nem estou bravo! Mas, é, sua aberração. Pegou o cara errado, surpresa! Seu cérebro tá funcionando direito aí dentro?
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: Aposto que você tá com uns fios cruzados aí, hein? Volte correndo pra cidade e mate o Wybel de alguém por uns trocados ou sei lá.
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#057.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#057.dst: Volte até Nasea e conte a ela a resposta de Dado.

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#058.dst: Vou arriscar um palpite e dizer que perguntar com educação se ele cometeu o roubo não trouxe resposta nenhuma.
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: O quê, ele te dispensou ASSIM? Credo, eu sabia que ele era babaca, mas sério? Isso é desnecessário.
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: Temos que fazer ele falar... se os envios continuarem sumindo, meus clientes vão procurar outro lugar!
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#061.dst: Precisamos provar que é culpado... espera, veio atrás de ideias COMIGO? Foi pra isso que pedi sua ajuda! Voltei mesmo à estaca zero?
Rise of the Quartron#061.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: Eu... o que faz aqui, hã... Larry? Também te falta quartzo??
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#064.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#064.dst: Ah, é... Lari. Não, o envio de quartzo chegou direitinho...
Rise of the Quartron#064.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: Mas quase não teve efeito. Sua ideia, infelizmente, não deu em nada.
Rise of the Quartron#065.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: Bom, eu avisei que era só uma ideia. Eu gerencio a mina, não pratico magia de purificação. Não ponha a culpa disso em mim.
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: Não quis insinuar isso. Sua ajuda foi apreciada, o destino só tinha outros planos...
Rise of the Quartron#067.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: Bem, de certa forma. Alguém desvia quartzo, mas o suspeito não se intimidou com dez toneladas de armadura, e empacamos. Alguma ideia?
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: ...na verdade, tenho uma solução. A botânica élfica descreve uma flor que cresce razoavelmente perto, a flor "Tattytale".
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: Ela enfraquece a vontade de quem cheira suas pétalas, deixando a pessoa dócil a perguntas. É... desagradável, mas, se for necessário, suponho.
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: Há uma caverna infestada de aranhas e coberta de teias na montanha a oeste. Infelizmente, é o único lugar onde ela cresce fora de {p}.
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: Nasea, como não ajudou, devolvi o quartzo. Agradeço sua ajuda... e me despeço de ambos.
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: Faça Dado confessar usando a flor Tattytale.

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: Ei, o cão de ataque mais odiado de todos! Vem cá, garoto! Quer a esmeralda? Vai matar as moscas lá de casa! Vem, garoto!
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: Ah, flores. Que fofo! Desculpa, mas não cedo a psicopatas nem a bajulação, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: Eu... uf... Por que ISSO?! Tá ofendido porque não gostei das suas flo- O quê? O que eu faço com o quartzo?
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: Hã, não é óbvio? Estou fazendo hora extra e mandando pro Popo, dã. Pra onde mais eu mandaria?
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: O quê- Pra onde o Popo manda? Hã... não faço ideia. Seja quem for, é podre de rico. Me paga mais do que vale minha casa a cada envio!
Rise of the Quartron#080.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#081.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#081.dst: Não sei por que você- O quê? Cadê o Popo? Hã, disse que me veria no viaduto dos trilhos, perto das bandeiras turquesa.
Rise of the Quartron#081.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: Ia ser nosso primeiro encontro, então não sei a cara dele, e ele também nunca me viu.
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: Suba a ladeira dos carrinhos de mina e encontre Popo.

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: Ah, você deve- Espera, deixa pra lá. Eu esperava a visita de outra pessoa.
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: Espera, você é o Dado? Parece que humanos têm mais cérebro que orcs, afinal, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#086.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#086.dst: Tá, ao que interessa. Vou fingir que estou ocupado pra te cobrir enquanto vai à base pras instruções. Lá te passam os detalhes.
Rise of the Quartron#086.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#087.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#087.dst: Você chama muita atenção, mas por sorte humanos adoram se meter em lugares estranhos, então não vai destoar muito.
Rise of the Quartron#087.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#088.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#088.dst: Vá de carrinho de mina até a mansão dos bandidos.

Rise of the Quartron#089.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#089.dst: Suba no carrinho, ele vai sair! Mas disfarce!
Rise of the Quartron#089.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#090.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#090.dst: Interessante, um humano nos nossos planos. Não esperava que a mão de obra se diversificasse tão rápido.
Rise of the Quartron#090.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#091.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#091.dst: Hora do resumo, ah, como adoro explicar isso! Acho que vai achar o que tenho a dizer bem interessante, sim, sim!
Rise of the Quartron#091.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#092.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#092.dst: Veja, quartzo é um material mágico poderoso- mais do que muitos sabem! Absorve e canaliza energia mágica, mas o que mais? Eu tinha que descobrir!
Rise of the Quartron#092.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#093.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#093.dst: Os caipiras do meu departamento de pesquisa me expulsaram por sugerir que avançássemos a pesquisa. Que tipo de cientista tem medo de progredir?!
Rise of the Quartron#093.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#094.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#094.dst: Mas sem um conselho diretor no meu cangote, minha pesquisa me levou exatamente aonde eu esperava, e além, sim, sim!
Rise of the Quartron#094.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#095.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#095.dst: Ei. Convidado vindo pela passagem secreta.
Rise of the Quartron#095.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#097.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#097.dst: Harnort! O Dado sou EU! Esse doido me arrancou a info! Vai afundar nós dois!
Rise of the Quartron#097.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#098.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#098.dst: Guardas!! GUARDAS!! Peguem! Detenham! Amarrem, façam algo!! Nossa pesquisa não pode ir pro ralo, não neste ponto crucial!!
Rise of the Quartron#098.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#099.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#099.dst: HA! Isso é pra aprender a me mostrar aquela flor incrí- HORRÍVEL! Tô fora!
Rise of the Quartron#099.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#100.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.
Rise of the Quartron#100.dst: Invada o laboratório e detenha Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#101.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#101.dst: Você... O sacrifício deles não será em vão! {p} precisa ver do que o quartzo é capaz! EU PRECISO mostrar a eles.
Rise of the Quartron#101.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#102.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#102.dst: Meus Quartrons são o futuro! Eles precisam ver! Terão valido a pena as tramas, os roubos e as pontes queimadas!
Rise of the Quartron#102.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#103.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#103.dst: Mas você- você não podia deixar quieto. Se meteu e jogou fora cem vidas sem piedade pra deter o inevitável!
Rise of the Quartron#103.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#104.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#104.dst: Derrube o Quartron e volte até Nasea com a notícia.

Rise of the Quartron#105.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#105.dst: O futuro de cem homens ou mais!! Humanos merecem queimar no inferno pela destruição inconsequente!
Rise of the Quartron#105.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#106.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#106.dst: A energia das detonações sobrecarrega o quartzo das paredes... O laboratório virou uma armadilha mortal! Faça um favor a todos- FIQUE PARADO E MORRA LOGO!!
Rise of the Quartron#106.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#107.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#107.dst: Aí ele voltou, me perguntando se eu tinha achado mais daquelas flores, e enquanto ele tagarelava a MONTANHA INTEIRA TREMEU.
Rise of the Quartron#107.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#108.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#108.dst: Então, desembucha. Pedi que descobrisse pra onde ia meu quartzo, e você viciou um operário meu e causou um baita deslizamento!!
Rise of the Quartron#108.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#109.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#109.dst: Um mech de quartzo militarizado... credo. Esse cara parece ser uma figura. Acho que no fim não foi culpa sua mesmo.
Rise of the Quartron#109.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#110.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#110.dst: Vou chamar a polícia pra pegar todos aqueles guardas e ele. ...que cara é essa? Até parece que acha que não vai ter ninguém lá. Enfim...
Rise of the Quartron#110.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#111.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#111.dst: Pegue o elevador depois das bandeiras amarelas e entre na área privada, tem minha permissão. Te encontro lá em cima.
Rise of the Quartron#111.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#112.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#112.dst: Encontre Nasea no fim dos trilhos do carrinho de mina.

Rise of the Quartron#114.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#114.dst: Este é o anexo novo da mina, mas demos de cara com um muro. Bem... um muro de cascalho.
Rise of the Quartron#114.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#115.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#115.dst: Então, se você conseguir abrir esta área, vai ter acesso à mina e ao que encontrar nela.
Rise of the Quartron#115.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#116.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#116.dst: Mas tenho que ir, muito trabalho pela frente. Hm. Parece que o núcleo que você me mostrou virou um anel. Coisa de altíssima tecnologia, mas não consigo usar, então pode ficar.
Rise of the Quartron#116.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#117.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#117.dst: Acho que é isso, então! Aqui está seu pagamento. A gente se vê.
Rise of the Quartron#117.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#118.src: Talk to Nasea in the Karoc Quarry at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Rise of the Quartron#118.dst: Fale com Nasea na pedreira de Karoc em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Royal Trials#000.dst: Fale com a Guarda Skyraider em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like ye doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.dst: Pra trás! Ninguém entra até escolherem a rainha pirata. O que um rato de terra faz aqui?
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.dst: Participar? Pirou? De jeito nenhum um rato de terra vai usar a coroa.
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering round chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.dst: Some daqui! Antes que eu chame as garotas pra te estripar. E nada de ficar de papo com as skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.dst: Quer ser rainha pirata, é? Não se preocupe, eu te ajudo.
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.dst: Sabe, as outras piratas não servem pro cargo. São burras e fracas. Só têm a aparência.
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.dst: Você tem tudo! Beleza e talento.
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.dst: Sabe, a guarda também é burra. Um disfarce simples engana ela. O problema é que você não parece nada uma skyraider!
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.dst: Mas você tá com sorte. Uma skyraider vende qualquer coisa pelo preço certo - dá uma volta pela cidade e vê se convence alguém a abrir mão da roupa.
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
Royal Trials#010.dst: Procure pela cidade skyraider em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e encontre uma roupa de pirata.

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.dst: Hã? Um rato de terra rondando nossa base? Que é que cê quer?
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.dst: ... é, acho que dá pra me convencer a te passar ela... por um preço.
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I would trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.dst: Aqui, é isso que eu aceitaria em troca.
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.dst: Se pensa em esmeraldas... [{~} blocos de esmeralda] parece justo, hehe.
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if yer running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.dst: Claro, se tá meio sem grana, que tal me trazer [{~} Dragonling Eggs]? Sabe, o ingrediente. Tô querendo criar uns bichinhos desses!
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.dst: Mas se nenhum dos dois te agradar... sempre quis [{~} Shiny Shell] - brilham tanto! Dá pra achar na caverna a sudeste daqui, do lado das escadas.
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.dst: Me traga um desses três, rato de terra, e a roupa é sua!
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Royal Trials#019.dst: Entregue um item a Egpla em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.dst: E aí, rato de terra, pronto pra pagar? Tô vendo esmeraldas no seu bolso, passa pra cá.
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.dst: Beleza! Era exatamente o que eu procurava. Me dá aqui, deixa eu ver...
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.dst: Ei, rato de terra! É o brilho de uma shiny shell que tô vendo no seu bolso?! Deixa eu ver...
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.dst: Tá bom, rato de terra. A roupa é sua. Peraí, deixa eu me trocar lá dentro.
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.dst: Aqui está, rato de terra. Espero que sirva pra alguma coisa, seja lá pra que você quer.
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.dst: Outra concorrente, é? Essa roupa fica meio estranha em você, mas pode entrar. Anda logo!
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.dst: Argh! Você não pode ser rainha, mal pilota uma aeronave!
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.dst: Não! A rainha sou eu! Valho mais que qualquer uma, suas ratas do céu!
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#030.dst: Ouça o discurso da Supervisora das Provas.

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.dst: Cheguem mais, moças. A próxima Rainha vai ser escolhida!
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.dst: Como sabem, nossa última rainha teve um... fim terrível, morta na própria aeronave por um soldado de Wynn.
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.dst: Mas das cinzas de sua honra, uma nova rainha surgirá! Três provas. É o que todas enfrentam agora.
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.dst: Só uma, a que passar por todas as provas, vai vencer e ganhar o título de Rainha dos Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.dst: Agora, apresento a primeira prova, que testa uma habilidade vital pra ser rainha - o combate!
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#037.dst: Vença a sala do arsenal do desafio de combate.

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#038.dst: Vença a sala da prisão do desafio de combate.

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.
Royal Trials#039.dst: Vença a cabine de comando do desafio de combate.

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.
Royal Trials#040.dst: Ouça o discurso da supervisora das provas.

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.dst: Arr, isso tirou as fracas. Uma rainha precisa ser forte.
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.dst: Agora, ao segundo desafio - a prova de voo! Não dá pra ser rainha se não sabe pilotar sua aeronave!
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer sharpest eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.dst: Abram bem os olhos, garotas, um passo em falso e a morte espera.
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.dst: Esta prova deve eliminar o resto das indignas.
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.dst: Ora, ora, uma amadora passou pelo voo.
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.dst: Bem, vamos ver como se saem na prova final, moças.
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.dst: Você não é pirata se não sabe roubar, mas isto é diferente.
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.dst: Agora é pra valer. Roubar uma mansão de segurança máxima.
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.dst: Sua tarefa é roubar um tesouro inestimável da família mais rica do céu.
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll be left behind.
Royal Trials#052.dst: Vamos esperar com uma aeronave de fuga no ponto de extração, as outras vão ficar pra trás.
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.dst: Lembrem, isto é pra valer, e as consequências do fracasso serão graves. Boa sorte, moças.
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This is the garden we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.dst: Este é o jardim onde abriremos o túnel; vocês terão que achar como entrar na Mansão, talvez pedindo com jeitinho, hehe.
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.dst: Depois terão que se esgueirar por estes corredores até o tesouro - e que os guardas não achem vocês, ou vão trancá-las e jogar a chave fora.
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses around, though...
Royal Trials#056.dst: Este, claro, é o tesouro mítico que vocês devem pegar e cair fora daqui, rapidinho. Mas com certeza vai ter umas defesas extras por perto...
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.dst: E por fim terão que fugir por esta janela bem aqui - vou estar esperando com uma aeronave pra levar todas vocês.
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.dst: Ei, acha que tá pronta pra tentar pegar aquele tesouro, é? É só sair por este buraco e achar um jeito de entrar na mansão.
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.
Royal Trials#060.dst: Esgueire-se pelos guardas e roube o tesouro.

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.dst: Ei, você! O que pensa que tá fazendo, se esgueirando por aqui? Esta é uma área restrita! Vai direto pra cela!
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
Royal Trials#062.dst: Leve o tesouro à supervisora das provas, do lado de fora da janela da mansão.

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.dst: Ei, homens! O tesouro foi roubado! Preparem as defesas!
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.dst: Isso, pegamos o ladrão nojento! Vamos trancar ele até apodrecer!
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.dst: Ah, achei que você podia ser a primeira a voltar. Tem um ar de rainha...
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head into the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second for the others.
Royal Trials#066.dst: Entre na aeronave atrás de mim, mocinha. Vamos esperar um pouco as outras.
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.
Royal Trials#067.dst: Saia da Mansão para a aeronave lá fora.

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.dst: Arrá! Eu sabia que você venceria o resto daquele bando... Conquistou a soberania legítima de nos governar, nossa rainha dos Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.dst: Não se preocupe, a blindagem desta aeronave é das pesadas, e estamos a quilômetros dos canhões deles... Nada a temer, estamos seguras nesta nave.
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.dst: Mas primeiro o principal: vamos olhar dentro dessa caixa chique que você trouxe e ver que tesouros míticos aqueles guardas imundos protegiam, que tal?
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.dst: Agora fico me perguntando se isso não era guardado por algum motivo sinistro. Isto é... Uma senhora arma. Seria mortal se fosse usada.
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.dst: Bem, graças a você, talvez agora seja dos Skyraiders, mas usar esta arma contra a civilização seria terrível demais. Podemos ser piratas, mas não somos desalmadas!
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.dst: Acho que vamos ter que guardar isto bem trancado quando voltarmos. Vamos amarrar esse cataclismo-numa-caixa bem melhor do que aqueles homens idiotas fizeram.
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.dst: Arrá! Chegando agora. Vamos descer e começar a cerimônia, que tal?
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.dst: Apresento com prazer nossa {~}ª Rainha dos Skyraiders. Pelo bem do nosso povo, que o reinado dela passe de duas semanas.
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.dst: Eu, em nome do povo Skyraider, tenho a honra de condecorá-la com a maior honraria dos Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.dst: Use sua soberania pra nos levar às riquezas que merecemos.
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#080.dst: Fale com a supervisora das provas.

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.dst: Vossa Majestade. Que honra ter uma rainha tão bela.
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now that ye've been crown, we must give ye the reward.
Royal Trials#082.dst: Agora que foi coroada, devemos lhe dar a recompensa.
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#085.src: What item would you trade to Egpla for her outfit?
Royal Trials#085.dst: Que item você daria a Egpla pela roupa dela?

Royal Trials#086.src: Landwalker! Have ye found any of the items yet?
Royal Trials#086.dst: Rato de terra! Já achou algum dos itens?
Royal Trials#086.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#087.src: Remember, I'd trade it to ye for [{~} Emerald Blocks], [{~} Dragonling Eggs] or [{~} Shiny Shell] from the cave to the south-east!
Royal Trials#087.dst: Lembre, eu troco por [{~} blocos de esmeralda], [{~} Dragonling Eggs] ou [{~} Shiny Shell] da caverna a sudeste!
Royal Trials#087.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#089.src: Don' waste your time 'round me! You've got trials to attend.
Royal Trials#089.dst: Não perca tempo comigo! Você tem provas pra encarar.
Royal Trials#089.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#090.src: As you walk, you hear arguments between other contestants either side of you...
Royal Trials#090.dst: Enquanto anda, você ouve discussões entre outras concorrentes dos dois lados...

Royal Trials#091.src: Perhaps you could try throwing this at the window?
Royal Trials#091.dst: Talvez você possa tentar jogar isto na janela?

Royal Trials#092.src: What item would you like to throw at the window?
Royal Trials#092.dst: Que item você quer jogar na janela?

Royal Trials#093.src: It doesn't look like your leaf did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#093.dst: Parece que a folha não fez nada... você devia achar outro item pra jogar.

Royal Trials#094.src: It doesn't look like your grape did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#094.dst: Parece que a uva não fez nada... você devia achar outro item pra jogar.

Royal Trials#095.src: It doesn't look like your flower did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#095.dst: Parece que a flor não fez nada... você devia achar outro item pra jogar.

Royal Trials#096.src: It doesn't look like your apple did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#096.dst: Parece que a maçã não fez nada... você devia achar outro item pra jogar.

Royal Trials#097.src: It doesn't look like your egg did anything... you should find another item to throw.
Royal Trials#097.dst: Parece que o ovo não fez nada... você devia achar outro item pra jogar.

Royal Trials#098.src: The rock broke the window! Now you've just got to find a way up there...
Royal Trials#098.dst: A pedra quebrou a janela! Agora só falta achar como subir até lá...

Royal Trials#099.src: Looks like you're inside the Mansion... now you've got to your way to the treasure.
Royal Trials#099.dst: Parece que você está dentro da Mansão... agora precisa chegar até o tesouro.

Royal Trials#100.src: Aye, we caught the dirty thief. We'll 'ave that treasure back, and ye can rot in this cell!
Royal Trials#100.dst: Isso, pegamos o ladrão imundo. Vamos reaver o tesouro, e você vai apodrecer nesta cela!
