Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: Certo... Entendi. E- e- então... como fun- funciona? Temos que re- registrar a missão em a- algum lugar?
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#388.dst: Isso, isso! Normalmente eu iria ao Quill, mas ele está ocupado. Vamos achar o Yusanu primeiro- ele vai... entender. Acho. Mais que o Yulie, pelo menos. Confio que ele fique quieto por ora... sabe?
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: Yuman, eu juro. O Yusanu devia saber que não pode te deixar liderar esse tipo de coisa! Onde estava com a cabeça?
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: Opa, opa, opa! Quanta acusação do nada, mano! Qual é?
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: What gives?! You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: Qual é?! Você sabe qual é- um esquadrão inteiro de fiscais de moradia aparece morto em serviço, e você espera que passe batido?
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: Ahhh. Isso. Bem, você sabe como é. Coisas acontecem, né?
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#394.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#394.dst: Você-... pelo menos finja que leva isso a sério, tá? Logo você devia saber aonde isso vai levar.
Solidarity of Steel#394.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: N- não foi- foi- não foi c- c- culpa dele, eu-
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: Ei, princesa, tá tudo bem. Não precisa me cobrir, tá?
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: Então qual é o plano, Yulie? Reunião pra falar disso, como sempre?
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#398.dst: Suspiro... assim que o Quill acomodar a Aihan, sim. Não deve demorar, então já estão todos reunidos.
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: Ei! O que houve lá fora? Todo mundo está estranho com isso.
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: A gente acabou l- lu- lutando com uns soldados pra salvar a m- m- a mulher que fomos ver...
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: Hum. Só isso? Achei que seria bem pior.
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#403.dst: É... e- e- eles têm medo de isso ch- cha- chamar atenção...
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: Ainda ajudando na cozinha com o jantar! Não temam, eu a coloco a par quando a reunião acabar.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: Ah, olá a todos. Desculpem a demora.
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: Ainda não decidiu, mas aceitou passar a noite. Está muito abalada, coitada. Um descanso vai lhe fazer bem.
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#409.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#409.dst: Mas isso nos leva ao motivo desta reunião. O resgate foi... mal, imagino?
Solidarity of Steel#409.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: Mal é pouco. O exército está em alerta máximo! Interrogaram todos que entravam ou saíam de {p} hoje à tarde- se eu não usasse nosso túnel, ainda estaria preso na fila!
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#411.dst: Isso é um desastre completo. Yuman, o que tem a dizer em sua defesa? A essa altura você devia saber, precisamos-
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#412.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#412.dst: E- ei! N- n- não é- não é c- c- culpa dele! Fui e- eu que-
Solidarity of Steel#412.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: Não, a culpa é minha. Eu era o líder, então tudo que aconteceu é responsabilidade minha. Devia ter... sido mais firme.
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: Nada disso teria acontecido se eu estivesse lá... droga. Momento pior, impossível. Isso é tudo culpa m-
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#415.dst: Tá, chega. Vocês estão agindo feito idiotas! Quem liga de quem foi a culpa? Já aconteceu, então vamos pensar no que fazer.
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: E eu não terminei! Vocês agem como se fosse o fim do mundo uns soldados terem morrido. E daí? Soldados morrem o tempo todo.
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: Mas não morrem assim. Não temos o luxo de ignorar a atenção da Coroa! Se descobrirem o que fazemos aqui embaixo, estamos acabados.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: Mas ainda não descobriram, né? Vocês ainda têm opções. Por exemplo- você é da polícia de detetives! Se surgirem suspeitas, não dá pra despistá-los?
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: Além disso. Se ficar escondido significa fechar os olhos enquanto inocentes sofrem- que tipo de resistência vocês são? Pra que serve tudo isso?
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#421.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#421.dst: Rex... cuidado com as palavras. Não diga nada de que vá se-
Solidarity of Steel#421.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: Pra que SERVE?! Serve pra proteger toda a gente que JÁ temos aqui embaixo! Quill, por favor, me apoie aqui.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: ... Não, Yulie, a Rex tem razão. Mesmo que tenha dito com dureza... temos sido bem passivos nessa luta. Deixamos que pessoas se ferissem, ainda que pela nossa segurança.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#424.dst: Tivemos nossos motivos... e fizemos um bom trabalho, dentro do possível. Mas se temos medo de agir, como algo vai mudar pra melhor?
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: Não é errado sentir frustração, Yulie. Eu também queria que isso tivesse sido feito com mais cuidado... mas algo assim aconteceria cedo ou tarde. Vamos sobreviver, como sobrevivemos a outras dificuldades.
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: ...Mas vamos animar um pouco o clima! O jantar está quase pronto. Yuman, você me disse hoje que estava fazendo uma música nova. Ainda quer tocá-la hoje à noite?
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: Hein? Ah, sim, sim, cara! Posso, com certeza.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: Ahem. Antes de irmos, se me permitem- já que estamos todos aqui, creio que seria útil expor algumas informações relevantes.
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#430.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#430.dst: Quase todos somos novos em Roughworks, então conhecer o terreno pode ajudar.
Solidarity of Steel#430.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: Certo, claro. Eu ia sugerir algo parecido antes de... surgir essa situação.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#432.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#432.dst: Certamente, podemos fazer isso! O que gostariam de saber?
Solidarity of Steel#432.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: Ah, sim. O nome dela é Soosu. É difícil falar muito dela... é bem reclusa, fica trancada na mansão, trabalhando sem parar.
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: Nisso, ela é o oposto de Zhiraok. O ideal é não chamar a atenção dela. Já teremos preocupações de sobra sem pô-la na lista.
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: Seria o melhor, sim. Ela é... meio que um gênio. Sozinha, deu início à Era Industrial, há mais de um século! Quase toda máquina que vocês veem em Fruma deve ter origem nela de algum jeito.
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: Ha! É, é, claro que você sabia disso tudo, mano. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: O- isso é só história escrita, Yuman. Se vai tirar sarro de mim, pelo menos faça direito.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#438.dst: E a bênção dela? Se a encontrarmos, queremos saber do que nos cuidar.
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: Não sei os detalhes... mas sei que permite a ela moldar a matéria à vontade. Até que ponto, ou com que limites... difícil dizer. Ainda assim, essa incerteza é perigosa. Cuidado.
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: Muito bem! Então vamos encerrar e jantar.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: Fale com Sui em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e assista à apresentação de Yuman.

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: A apresentação do Yuman já vai começar. Pegue algo pra comer com a Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: Ah, {u}! Parece que mal te vi por aqui...
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: Eu, hã... o Mora me contou o que houve. Na missão. Fico... feliz que puderam ajudar aquela mulher.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: Eu, ha, meio que queria ter estado lá, pra ajudar. Mas não sei... bem o que eu poderia ter feito.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#446.dst: E-então talvez seja bom! Eu ter estado, hã, ocupada, cozinhando. Pra Pluma de Aço. Tem, ha, muita gente aqui!
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#447.dst: Mas estou aprendendo receitas novas e conhecendo gente nova! Ah, é, você deve ter vindo pela, hã, comida. Aqui! Pegue um pouco.
Solidarity of Steel#447.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: Ah, n-não, eu- bem, sim, adoraria comer, mas vim- vim agradecer ao {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: Não- não se subestime! Ainda não... e-entendo direito, mas lutar contra os guardas assim... assim é perigoso, e- e sei por que alguns não iam querer...
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: A- não, não, não, isso- isso não dá, não posso- tem que levar outras coisas, não posso ir com- com isso, por fav

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: É o cartaz que você colou anunciando as Termas de Pishlas.

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: Mas vieram mesmo assim, e- e- e isso significa muito.
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#454.dst: Parece, hã, que foi uma situação bem feia. Fico feliz que tenham saído bem.
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: H-ha... sim. Eles já foram... i-insistentes antes, mas nunca foram tão- tão- tão, ah, violentos.
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#457.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#457.dst: S-sim, estou. É... novo, e- e diferente, mas todos aqui foram tão gentis, e...
Solidarity of Steel#457.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: É meio- meio estranho... Quase sinto que- que- que não mereço! Porque e- e- eu não... t-trabalhei por isso.
Solidarity of Steel#458.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#459.dst: Hã... não sei bem, como é, viver aqui... mas de onde eu venho, as pessoas se ajudam. Você não devia ter que merecer o direito de viver.
Solidarity of Steel#459.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#460.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#460.dst: V-você deve vir de um lugar bem m-melhor que- que aqui.
Solidarity of Steel#460.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: Ha... é meio r-ridículo, olhando agora. Malditas- m-malditas cotas... ai...
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Oh, it- it's... nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: Ah, não- não é... nada. Só, m-maquinário pesado. Machuquei o ombro quando- quando entrei. É- é c-culpa minha, eu, eu, eu d-devia ter tido m-mais cuidado...
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#465.dst: Hã... eu- eu posso, ha, posso te ajudar.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: Só... suspiro. Me siga e- e confie em mim.
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#470.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#470.dst: E-ei! E- eu só tenho esta camisa, n- não posso- eu-
Solidarity of Steel#470.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#473.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#476.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#476.dst: E-... o-obrigada. Eu não... não sabia que amaldiçoados podiam ser- ser gentis.
Solidarity of Steel#476.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: Hã... e-eu devia ir. Obrigada pela- pela comida, e- e- e por... curar meu ombro. A- agradeço de verdade.
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#479.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#479.dst: Tudo bem. Era o que eu esperava. Fico... feliz por ajudar.
Solidarity of Steel#479.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#480.dst: A- acho que sim! Ha... ao menos ela, hã, não teve medo. Só... nervosa.
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#481.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#481.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#482.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#482.dst: Vá ficar com os outros. Hã, já já eu vou.
Solidarity of Steel#482.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: {u}, que bom que veio. Já jantou?
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: Está bom, não é? O Quill me disse que ela se enturmou bem com os outros cozinheiros.
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#485.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#485.dst: E aí, {u}, também está es- espe- esperando o show do Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#485.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#486.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#486.dst: Ouvi maravilhas do talento musical dele! Mas, ah, também ouvi que a variedade dele, ah, deixa a desejar.
Solidarity of Steel#486.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: Então não se preocupe, pois acaba de ser lembrado, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: Ei, vai ver ele fez uma música sobre você, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: O- o- o quê?! R- Rex, não, e- ele-... isso n- não-... p- por que ele ia se- se-
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: Ha! Relaxa, relaxa, só tô zoando.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#491.dst: Ahem... Atenção, atenção! Todos, venham cá!
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: Fico contente de ver tantos de vocês no jantar de hoje. Parece que fazia tempo que não tínhamos tanta gente!
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: Há notícias a dar, claro... mas antes! Começamos agradecendo aos cozinheiros pela refeição.
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: Todos conhecemos o talento do Fletch, mas o jantar não seria possível sem a ajuda de uma recém-chegada: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: Ah...! Foi, ha, foi- hã. Não foi nada. Foi um prazer! A- ajudar.
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: Jantar à parte, vamos aos avisos!
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#498.dst: Hoje não tivemos um, mas sete recém-chegados! Além da Sui, deem as boas-vindas a Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u} e Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#499.dst: Bem, certamente já correu a notícia do nosso... desentendimento, digamos, com o exército da Coroa. Garanto que está tudo sob controle! A Pluma de Aço segue segura e oculta.
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: Isso significa que as saídas da estação serão mais arriscadas por um tempo. Amanhã cedo teremos orientações atualizadas para quem se voluntariar.
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: Mas, em notícias mais leves, repusemos chocolates e refrigerantes nas bilheterias! Troquem logo antes que acabem - lembrem a regra, um de cada por pessoa.
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: Pois bem! Salvo surpresas neste exato momento, é tudo do relatório de hoje. Como se ofereceu hoje, passo o palco ao Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: Ooooooiiiiiii, povo da Pluma de Aço!
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#504.dst: Bom ver todos vocês como sempre- ei, Taio, tá bonitão! Mei, adorei o cabelo! Jin, meu chapa!
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: Ah... acho que posso apresentar minha música. É nova! Vocês não vão mais poder zoar que sou artista de uma música só, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#506.dst: Faz tempo que trabalho nessa. Nunca achava um jeito de terminar... até agora. Enfim achei inspiração.
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#507.dst: Bom, chega de falar. Lá vai!
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#508.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#508.dst: Hm hm hm! Olha só quem é!
Solidarity of Steel#508.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#511.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#511.dst: Que bom te ver de novo, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#511.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: Você precisa subtrair parte dessa segurança. Não devia levar vinte minutos só pra passar o portão. Precisamos conversar, uma hora atrás.
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: Nossa, senhor boca-grande, que palavras fortes pra quem só devia chegar daqui a umas semanas! Qual é?! Você está cortando meu embalo!
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equati- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#515.dst: Sua agen- Está tendo aulas com Oru? Esta emergência provincial tem um valor bem maior que seu estatuto, Soberana, então estou somando à equaç- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#516.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#516.dst: Mudei minha agenda pra vir antes e caçar uma desertora- Syndra, e seu bando de insurgentes. Já ouviu o nome, não?
Solidarity of Steel#516.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#517.src:
Quill
Are either of you good with cooking?
Solidarity of Steel#517.dst:
Quill
Algum de vocês sabe cozinhar?
Solidarity of Steel#517.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#520.src: Sooo... fellow cursed one. How have you been treated around here.
Solidarity of Steel#520.dst: Entããão... colega amaldiçoado. Como têm te tratado por aqui.
Solidarity of Steel#520.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#521.src: Don't look so surprised, haha! All kinds of outcasts are here, some of us are cursed.
Solidarity of Steel#521.dst: Não faz essa cara de surpresa, haha! Tem todo tipo de excluído aqui, uns amaldiçoados.
Solidarity of Steel#521.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#522.src: We don't judge each other. We are all at risk here so why fight amongst each other. And if you ask me, curses aren't all bad.
Solidarity of Steel#522.dst: Ninguém julga ninguém. Todos corremos risco aqui, então pra que brigar entre nós? E, pra mim, maldições não são de todo ruins.
Solidarity of Steel#522.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#523.src: I've found a use for my earth curse, I help build housing for people here!
Solidarity of Steel#523.dst: Achei um uso pra minha maldição da terra: ajudo a construir casas aqui!
Solidarity of Steel#523.speaker: Jin

Solidarity of Steel#524.src: Hey, hey! Welcome to the Traincart!
Solidarity of Steel#524.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#525.src: Here to spend some food tickets, I take it? What can I get you?
Solidarity of Steel#525.dst: Veio gastar uns vales de comida, imagino? O que vai querer?
Solidarity of Steel#525.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#526.src: Oh, shoot, sorry. I didn't realize you were new! Typically Quill'd give you the rundown when you arrived, but with how hectic things are right now, it must've slipped his mind.
Solidarity of Steel#526.dst: Ah, droga, desculpa. Não sabia que você era novo! Normalmente o Quill explica tudo quando você chega, mas com essa correria toda, deve ter esquecido.
Solidarity of Steel#526.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#527.src: Down here, we've got a system set up to ration out food and other items for anyone who needs it. You'll get a weekly allowance of tickets to spend on whatever you need, instead of paying emeralds.
Solidarity of Steel#527.dst: Aqui embaixo, temos um sistema pra racionar comida e outras coisas pra quem precisar. Você recebe uma cota semanal de vales pra gastar no que precisar, em vez de pagar com esmeraldas.
Solidarity of Steel#527.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#528.src: System's worked well enough so far, ever since Quill devised it. We want everyone to have what they need to live, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#528.dst: O sistema tem funcionado bem desde que o Quill o criou. Queremos que todos tenham o que precisam pra viver, sabe?
Solidarity of Steel#528.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#529.src: Though... hey, if you're out of tickets, nobody'll stop you from getting food if you need it. System's there for convenience, not to enforce a new currency. So don't worry too much about it, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#529.dst: Mas... olha, se acabarem seus vales, ninguém vai te impedir de pegar comida se precisar. O sistema existe pra facilitar, não pra impor uma moeda nova. Então não se preocupe muito, tá?
Solidarity of Steel#529.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#530.src: Got it! I haven't seen your face around here yet, so I take it you're new?
Solidarity of Steel#530.dst: Entendi! Ainda não tinha te visto por aqui, então imagino que seja novo?
Solidarity of Steel#530.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#531.src: Hey, feel free to take it easy a while. We all know it's a bit of an adjustment period, yeah? We'll have you back up on your feet in no time.
Solidarity of Steel#531.dst: Ei, pode ir com calma por um tempo. Todos sabemos que é um período de adaptação, né? Logo você vai estar de pé de novo.
Solidarity of Steel#531.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#532.src: Lots to do around here if you want to chip in. Ask Quill and he'll be able to sort you out.
Solidarity of Steel#532.dst: Tem muito o que fazer aqui se quiser ajudar. Pergunte ao Quill que ele te arranja algo.
Solidarity of Steel#532.speaker: Taio

Solidarity of Steel#533.src: Would this have been the main entrance to the station? If so, it looks to be blocked off.
Solidarity of Steel#533.dst: Seria esta a entrada principal da estação? Se for, parece bloqueada.

Solidarity of Steel#534.src: If you need any clean clothes, water, utensils, even books, you heard that right. Let me know.
Solidarity of Steel#534.dst: Se precisar de roupa limpa, água, utensílios, até livros, é isso mesmo que ouviu. Me avise.
Solidarity of Steel#534.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#535.src: We take your spare tickets and trade them for quality items.
Solidarity of Steel#535.dst: Aceitamos seus vales extras e trocamos por itens bons.
Solidarity of Steel#535.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#536.src: The items are gathered from the outside and brought here fresh!
Solidarity of Steel#536.dst: Os itens são coletados lá fora e chegam fresquinhos!
Solidarity of Steel#536.speaker: Kaya

Solidarity of Steel#538.src: Don't think I've *cough* seen you before.
Solidarity of Steel#538.dst: Acho que não *cof* te vi antes.
Solidarity of Steel#538.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#539.src: *cough* I was once a worker like everyone e-else but I fell ill.
Solidarity of Steel#539.dst: *cof* Eu era um operário como todos os o-outros, mas adoeci.
Solidarity of Steel#539.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#540.src: I wasn't contagious *cough* but I lost all strength and I could no longer do my work.
Solidarity of Steel#540.dst: Não era contagioso *cof*, mas perdi toda a força e não conseguia mais trabalhar.
Solidarity of Steel#540.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#541.src: A citizen of the Roughworks worst n-nightmare... If you can't *cough* work you can't afford housing.
Solidarity of Steel#541.dst: O pior p-pesadelo de um cidadão de Roughworks... Se você não pode *cof* trabalhar, não paga moradia.
Solidarity of Steel#541.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#542.src: I lived on the streets for a while and did things *cough* I wasn't proud of... But the brothers found me and took me here.
Solidarity of Steel#542.dst: Vivi na rua por um tempo e fiz coisas *cof* de que não me orgulho... Mas os irmãos me acharam e me trouxeram pra cá.
Solidarity of Steel#542.speaker: Hana

Solidarity of Steel#544.src: You're not sure if Zeph could take on three soldiers by himself. You should help him.
Solidarity of Steel#544.dst: Você não sabe se o Zeph aguentaria três soldados sozinho. Devia ajudá-lo.

Solidarity of Steel#547.src: Alright, but hurry! Please! I can hear soldiers.
Solidarity of Steel#547.dst: Tá, mas rápido! Por favor! Estou ouvindo soldados.
Solidarity of Steel#547.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#548.src: Woah... wh-what did you pick into this? This- this is too heavy, I- I- I can't carry all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#548.dst: Nossa... o-o que você enfiou aqui? Isso- isso pesa demais, e- e- eu não aguento levar tudo!
Solidarity of Steel#548.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#549.src: Why... did you take these? He- the young man said you had f-food, water, and cooking equipment, r-right?
Solidarity of Steel#549.dst: Por que... você pegou isso? O- o rapaz disse que vocês tinham c-comida, água e coisas de cozinha, n-né?
Solidarity of Steel#549.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#550.src: This... okay. Okay. This is enough. I can-... this will work. It has the- the important things. We can go, now.
Solidarity of Steel#550.dst: Isso... tá. Tá. Isso basta. Eu dou-... isso serve. Tem as- as coisas importantes. Podemos ir agora.
Solidarity of Steel#550.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#551.src: It's- fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#551.dst: Tudo- bem. Era o que eu esperava. Fico... feliz por ajudar.
Solidarity of Steel#551.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#552.dst: A apresentação do Yuman deve começar logo.

Solidarity of Steel#553.src: New Chapter Started: The Steel Feather
Solidarity of Steel#553.dst: Novo capítulo iniciado: A Pluma de Aço

Solidarity of Steel#555.src: You- you didn't find any clothing? I can't leave with- with only one set of clothes! I know I have a shirt somewhere...
Solidarity of Steel#555.dst: V- você não achou roupas? Não posso ir com- com uma muda só! Sei que tenho uma camisa em algum lugar...
Solidarity of Steel#555.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#556.src: There's... nothing to sleep with in- in here. You couldn't f-find a pillow or blanket? I'd e-even take a mattress...
Solidarity of Steel#556.dst: Não tem... nada pra dormir aqui- aqui dentro. Não a-achou travesseiro ou cobertor? Até um colchão s-serviria...
Solidarity of Steel#556.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#557.src: Oh... n-nothing to pass the time... I know I had a book and a deck of cards, I know I did...
Solidarity of Steel#557.dst: Ah... n-nada pra passar o tempo... Sei que eu tinha um livro e um baralho, eu sei...
Solidarity of Steel#557.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#558.src: ...As much as this little place is- is run down, it's... it's home. I can't just leave- I can't. I can't go without... without something to remember it by. Please, please, find my ring or my photograph. Please.
Solidarity of Steel#558.dst: ...Por mais que este cantinho seja- seja velho, é... é meu lar. Não posso só ir embora- não posso. Não posso ir sem... sem algo pra lembrar. Por favor, por favor, ache meu anel ou minha fotografia. Por favor.
Solidarity of Steel#558.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#559.src: Well, there's no rush to be here. Quill's going to be a while still. Why don't you go talk to Sui and grab some food?
Solidarity of Steel#559.dst: Bem, não precisa ter pressa. O Quill ainda vai demorar. Por que não vai falar com a Sui e pegar algo pra comer?
Solidarity of Steel#559.speaker: Syndra

Stable Story#000.src: Hey! Get out of here! Scram! Shoo!

Stable Story#001.src: Moo. Are you trying to run away, human? Moo. Only one of us can leave this place alive. Moo.
Stable Story#001.dst: Muu. Tentando fugir, humano? Muu. Só um de nós sai vivo daqui. Muu.

Stable Story#002.src: I see you don't have any grain on you. Here, take these [{~} Wheat Grains] and use them to feed your new buddy.
Stable Story#002.dst: Vejo que você está sem grãos. Tome estes [{~} Wheat Grains] e use-os para alimentar seu novo amigo.

Stable Story#003.src: I wish you luck in the horse training career, young friend! Make me and Betty proud!
Stable Story#003.dst: Boa sorte como treinador de cavalos, jovem! Deixe a Betty e eu orgulhosos!

Stable Story#004.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!
Stable Story#004.dst: Opa! Quer carona até {p}? Pois é seu dia de sorte! A carroça foi consertada e está novinha!

Stable Story#005.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!
Stable Story#005.dst: É só subir que te levo a {p} num piscar de olhos!

Stable Story#006.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.
Stable Story#006.dst: {p} não fica longe daqui! Chegamos num piscar de olhos, você vai ver.

Stable Story#007.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#007.dst: Normalmente eu cobraria caro por estes cavalos- Sem ofensa, um preço que você não pagaria.
Stable Story#007.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#008.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#008.dst: Um trato, então- Roubaram minha chave do estábulo. Se for ao celeiro em {p}...
Stable Story#008.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#009.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#009.dst: E me devolver a chave, eu, generoso, lhe darei um dos meus cavalos. E o trato é melhor do que você imagina...
Stable Story#009.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#010.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?
Stable Story#010.dst: Hm. Vacas, é? Ah- vai saber!? A vida é cheia de mistérios, né?
Stable Story#010.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#011.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-
Stable Story#011.dst: Enfim. Que o grande bovino lá de cima seja testemunha: se eu vir um arranhão na Betty, eu-
Stable Story#011.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#012.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?
Stable Story#012.dst: Ah! Não posso te dar um cavalo sem explicar como cuidar dessa linda criatura, posso?

Stable Story#013.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!
Stable Story#013.dst: Esses ricaços de {p} não respeitam cavalos, vou te contar!

Stable Story#014.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.
Stable Story#014.dst: Bem! Clique direito no Comedouro e coloque sua [Horse Saddle] ali.

Stable Story#015.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.
Stable Story#015.dst: Use os [{~} Wheat Grains] que te dei para alimentar seu novo amigo.

Stable Story#016.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.

Stable Story#017.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.
Stable Story#017.dst: Cavalos são criaturas sensíveis, sabe. Não ficam fortes da noite pro dia; exigem paciência e uma boa dieta.

Stable Story#018.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.
Stable Story#018.dst: Mas também precisa levá-los para passear e fazer o exercício de que precisam, senão nunca vão atingir todo o potencial.

Stable Story#019.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.
Stable Story#019.dst: Quase esqueci! Se quiser mesmo dominar a arte de treinar cavalos, pode cruzar dois cavalos usando o Comedouro.

Stable Story#020.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!
Stable Story#020.dst: Enfim! Boa sorte na carreira de treinador de cavalos!

Stable Story#021.dst: Fale com Enkser fora de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#022.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#022.dst: Procuro aventureiros fortes! De preferência sem amigos nem família, mas não sou exigente!
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#023.dst: Sou mercador de cavalos. Vivo de vender essas belezuras a aventureiros como você.
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#024.dst: Neste celeiro, vendo os cavalos que crio em {p} pro povo rico de {p}.
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#025.dst: Até que uns baderneiros explodiram um túnel no meu celeiro e levaram MEUS cavalos.
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#026.dst: A Betty vai te ajudar! Ela é forte, mas NEM PENSE em deixar que encostem nela!
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#027.dst: Eu mesmo vou até {p} para garantir a segurança da Betty.
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#028.dst: Agora, é melhor ir andando. {p} fica um bom trecho abaixo por {p}, a leste daqui.
Stable Story#028.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#029.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#029.dst: Leve a [{~} Stable Key] do túnel em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] de volta a Enkser

Stable Story#030.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#030.dst: Ei, já achou minha [{~} Stable Key]? Deve estar em algum lugar de {p}, a leste.
Stable Story#030.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#031.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or-
Stable Story#031.dst: Procuro aventureiros fortes, de preferência sem amigos nem-
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#032.dst: Ei, é você! Achou minha chave?
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just- lounged around.
Stable Story#033.dst: Ah, graças a Deus. E aposto que a Betty fez tudo enquanto você só- ficou à toa.
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Ah, bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just- lounged around.
Stable Story#034.dst: Ah, que bom. E aposto que a Betty fez tudo enquanto você só- ficou à toa.
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#036.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#036.dst: Esqueça isso. Prometi um cavalo, e um cavalo você terá. Muito obrigado.
Stable Story#036.speaker: Enkser

Star Thief#000.src: This pile of gravel appears to have blocked the entrance... Maybe there's a shovel nearby?
Star Thief#000.dst: Esta pilha de cascalho parece ter bloqueado a entrada... Será que tem uma pá por perto?

Star Thief#001.src: [{~}/{~}] Thief: .... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...
Star Thief#001.dst: [{~}/{~}] Ladrão: .... Não me controlo...fjfjfj Esta pedra...

Star Thief#002.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#002.dst: Investigue os boatos de clima estranho perto da Imal Inn em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#003.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#003.dst: Encontre o local da queda do meteoro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#004.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#004.dst: Ei, você! Humano. O que faz aqui?
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#005.dst: Pela lei dos aldeões, toda entidade extraterrestre ou do Vazio é proibida e pertence ao Estado.
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#006.dst: Como você é novo nestas terras, duvido que te processem, ainda mais um guarda de {p}.
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#007.dst: Este meteoro é diferente dos que já vimos. Suspeitamos que o contato direto com ele seja perigoso.
Star Thief#007.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#008.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#008.dst: Mas a radiação mágica não parece te afetar nem um pouco. Não sente nada? Talvez possa me ajudar a localizá-lo.
Star Thief#008.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#009.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.
Star Thief#009.dst: Explore a caverna onde o meteoro caiu.

Star Thief#011.dst: Fuja da caverna que está desabando.

Star Thief#012.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.
Star Thief#012.dst: Siga o rastro que sai da caverna rumo ao leste.

Star Thief#013.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
Star Thief#013.dst: Explore a caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e derrote o ladrão enlouquecido.

Star Thief#014.src: .... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...
Star Thief#014.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#015.src: What is... this feeling... No I won't listen..
Star Thief#015.dst: Que é... essa sensação... Não, não vou ouvir..
Star Thief#015.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#016.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#016.dst: Leve o fragmento de meteoro ao agente secreto em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#017.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#017.dst: Olá de novo. Achou o meteoro lá embaixo? Por que diabos está segurando um pedaço?!
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#018.dst: Entendo. Este material é raríssimo e de grande poder mágico. Meteoros caem por toda Gavel, de cores e potências variadas.
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#019.dst: Não os entendemos por completo, mas sabemos que são perigosos. Todo cientista que os estudou enlouqueceu.
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#020.dst: Os meteoros guardam muitos segredos e poderes, talvez os que precisamos para encerrar sua guerra. Obrigado, eis uma recompensa.
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#021.dst: Olá de novo. Achou o meteoro lá embaixo? Não? Que tal voltar e tentar encontrá-lo?
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#022.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#022.dst: Lembre-se... É só seguir o rastro branco que leva à caverna!
Star Thief#022.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#023.src: I can't... control... my mind... end me.
Star Thief#023.dst: Minha mente... não controlo... me mate.
Star Thief#023.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#026.src: What was that? It seems to have landed nearby, maybe you should go investigate.
Star Thief#026.dst: O que foi isso? Parece ter caído aqui perto, talvez você deva investigar.

Star Thief#027.src: It seems like the meteor crashed into a cave.
Star Thief#027.dst: Parece que o meteoro caiu numa caverna.

Star Thief#028.src: The meteor shard is radiating an odd and unfamiliar magical energy
Star Thief#028.dst: O fragmento irradia uma energia mágica estranha e desconhecida

Star Thief#029.src: Thank you again for your help!
Star Thief#029.speaker: Agent

Supply and Delivery#000.src: Well? Did you buy the supply crate yet?
Supply and Delivery#000.dst: E aí? Comprou a caixa de suprimentos?
Supply and Delivery#000.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#001.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. It's not that hard!
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: Você só precisa ir ao Mercado e comprar a caixa de suprimentos para mim. Não é tão difícil!
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker: Ope

similar.text: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?

Supply and Delivery#002.src: You bought the crate! Good, good. You still need to pick it up from the Trade Market, though!
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: Você comprou a caixa! Bom, bom. Mas ainda precisa retirá-la no Mercado!
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#003.src: Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?
Supply and Delivery#003.dst: Ei! Eu- hã, não pude deixar de notar. Você ainda está aqui. Com a caixa. Precisa levá-la a {p}, lembra?

Supply and Delivery#004.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: Quê? Não me olha assim! Foi uma troca justa e nós dois ganhamos. Eu fiquei com a planta, e você... bom. Ganhou experiência?
Supply and Delivery#004.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#005.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#005.dst: Então, ou você leva os suprimentos pra {p}... ou a gente foge, começa vida nova e evita as consequências dos nossos atos!
Supply and Delivery#005.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#006.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: Opa! Quer carona até {p}? Sinto dizer, mas a carroça quebrou.

Supply and Delivery#007.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: Acho que não demora pra consertarem, mas por enquanto você vai ter que ir por conta própria.

Supply and Delivery#008.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: Esta viagem rápida exige Suprimento e entrega.

Supply and Delivery#009.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: Espero que estas esmeraldas bastem. Além disso... consertamos uma das nossas carroças quebradas, que faz a viagem até {p} e volta.
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#011.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: Ai, caramba... O que eu faço agora...
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: A-ah! O-olá, soldado! Nossa, que coincidência nós dois aqui... em {p}... hoje...
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: Olha, tá, eu entendi! Mas não tenho como te pagar mesmo. O prefeito me mandou buscar uma caixa de suprimentos pra vila.
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: O problema é que... já gastei todo o dinheiro em- hã, compras sem relação. E mesmo com dinheiro, eu não poderia comprar a caixa...
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Aqueles dois que cuidam do mercado me baniram para sempre depois que tentei comprar todo o estoque de pós mágicos do mundo.
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: Olha, não é culpa minha se faço grandes jogadas no mercado. Eu só sou, sabe- mais esperto que todo mundo!
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: ... A questão é. Eu queria muito sua ajuda agora! E- eu prometo que dessa vez te pago de volta.
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: Você só precisa ir ao Mercado e comprar a caixa de suprimentos para mim. Por favor?
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: ... Quê? Também te baniram do mercado?! Que ótimo. E agora, o que a gente faz?
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: Bom, você tem outros amigos pra envolver? Tinha... aquele outro soldado, né? O nome dele era... Tim. Ou algo assim.
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Olha- tá, eu entendi, sou um babaca que esquece nomes! Dá pra pedir pra ele comprar os suprimentos?? Ele é nossa última esperança... acho.
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: Compre a caixa de suprimentos no Mercado em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: Ei, bom trabalho! Agora retire a caixa de suprimentos.
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: Encontre Tasim em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e convença-o a comprar a caixa de suprimentos para você.

Supply and Delivery#025.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: Ah, oi, {u}! Veio só passar o tempo? Ou- essa sua cara diz que veio por outra coisa.
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#026.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: [{~}] Pode comprar uma coisa no Mercado para mim?

Supply and Delivery#027.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: Acho... que sim? Tem algum motivo para você não poder?
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#028.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: ...Você foi banido do mercado? Como conseguiu isso? A gente nem está em {p} há tanto tempo!
Supply and Delivery#028.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#029.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: Você- quê!? Deixa pra lá, prefiro não saber. Vamos, vá na frente. Eu compro... seja lá o que precisa.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#030.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: ...Ah. Bem, isso explica. Mas- tem algum motivo para você não poder retirar?
Supply and Delivery#030.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#031.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Você- quê!? Deixa pra lá, prefiro não saber. Vamos, vá na frente. Eu compro o que o Ope precisar.
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#032.src: Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: Ah, olá. Também veio treinar? Ou- essa sua cara diz que veio por outra coisa.
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#033.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#034.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: Certo. Então só compro a caixa...
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: Aqui está. Boa sorte com... seja lá o que está aprontando.
Supply and Delivery#035.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#036.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: Volte até Ope com a caixa de suprimentos em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#037.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: Perfeito! Agora, rápido, volte aqui antes que aqueles dois percebam que você está comigo!
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#038.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: Pegou o item? Bom. Bom, bom bom.
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#039.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: Ok! Agora vamos ao passo dois. Veja bem, este pacote ainda precisa chegar a {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#040.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#040.dst: E. Bem. É você que está com a caixa, não eu! Então... sabe como é!
Supply and Delivery#040.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#041.src: Fine, I'll take the crate to
Supply and Delivery#041.dst: Tá, eu levo a caixa até

Supply and Delivery#042.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: Ótimo! Você já deve saber o caminho! Não precisa que eu, hã, atrapalhe!
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#043.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: É só levar esses suprimentos a {p}, e. Bem. Tudo vai dar certo.
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Why can't you just take the
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: Por que você não leva a

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: Bom, sabe. Eu não quero mesmo fazer isso. E não vou!
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#047.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: ...não? Não. Tá. Valeu a tentativa. Bom, você já sabe o caminho! Não precisa que eu, hã, atrapalhe! Hehe...
Supply and Delivery#047.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: Ele comprou pra você? Bom. Bom, bom bom. Ok! Isso foi... mais difícil que o esperado.
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: Leve a caixa de suprimentos ao prefeito Alvin em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: Ah, olá! Em que posso ajudar hoje?
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#051.src: I have a supply crate from D

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: Ah... É mesmo. Achei que tinha mandado o Ope buscar isso...
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#053.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: Mais uma travessura dele, imagino. Sinto muito por ter lidado com ele duas vezes.
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#054.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: Quando ele voltar à aldeia, vou ter uma conversa séria com ele... Ah, mas claro, devo te pagar pelo incômodo.
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#055.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Fique à vontade para usá-la quando quiser! Em agradecimento por tudo que fez por nós.
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#057.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: Ele é um bom homem, de verdade. Acredito nisso de todo o coração. Mas tudo bem se você não pensa igual. Não vou te obrigar a lidar com ele se não quiser.
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#058.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: Ai, ai... Acho que foi há uns quinze anos que assumi o cargo, quando o antigo prefeito se afastou.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#059.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: Ele era um homem gentil, sempre cuidando do povo. Mas, quando se aposentou, estava claro que se sentia inquieto na nossa cidadezinha.
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: Bem, assim que me passou o cargo, ele foi direto para {p} e se alistou no exército! Dizem que hoje ele treina soldados.
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, but I've tried to live up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: Ah, mas tentei honrar o legado dele. Gosto de pensar que me saí bem como prefeito!
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: Belo dia para estar de passagem! Aproveite a estadia.
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: You look like an adventurer in need of some work, pal. I have need of your services, but you'll need to be level {~} at least.
Taking the Tower#000.dst: Parece um aventureiro precisando de trabalho, amigo. Preciso dos seus serviços, mas você tem que ser nível {~} pelo menos.
Taking the Tower#000.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#001.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been here to help!
Taking the Tower#001.dst: O Tasim me contou da força corrompida que você venceu. Queria ter vindo ajudar!
Taking the Tower#001.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#002.src: We did it! Let's get back to Lieutenant Van and tell him the news.
Taking the Tower#002.dst: Conseguimos! Vamos voltar ao tenente Van e dar a notícia.

Taking the Tower#003.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Item Upgrader!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: Ah, espera. Temos que passar num lugar antes. Me siga até o Item Upgrader!
Taking the Tower#003.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#004.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to  Water damage!
Taking the Tower#004.dst: Pelo visto, o chefão no alto da torre é fraco a dano de  Água!

Taking the Tower#005.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#005.dst: Você pode aplicar vários pós elementais às armas, o que permite causar tipos de dano que antes não podiam.
Taking the Tower#005.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#006.src: In this case, you can apply a  Water powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#006.dst: Neste caso, você pode aplicar um pó de  Água, para sua arma ser mais eficaz contra os inimigos corrompidos da torre!
Taking the Tower#006.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#007.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and Hold the powder, then Right Click on your weapon. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#007.dst: ...A questão é- tome. Pegue este pó elemental, segure-o e clique direito na sua arma. Me avise quando terminar!

Taking the Tower#009.src: You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.
Taking the Tower#009.dst: Vê este Aprimorador de itens? Ele aprimora pós para graus mais altos.

Taking the Tower#010.src: It can also remove powders from your items, if you need to- don't worry, you'll get your powders back!
Taking the Tower#010.dst: Ele também remove pós dos seus itens, se precisar- relaxa, você recebe os pós de volta!

Taking the Tower#011.src: ...Anyway, Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p}- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#011.dst: ...Enfim, o tenente Van e os outros estão perto daquele grupo de casas em {p}- deve ter visto no caminho.
Taking the Tower#011.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#012.src: It doesn't much matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#012.dst: Não importa muito quem faz o serviço, desde que seja feito. Se virem uma chance- aproveitem!
Taking the Tower#012.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#013.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?
Taking the Tower#013.dst: Se precisarem recuar, ou os corrompidos caírem, voltem aqui! Entendido?
Taking the Tower#013.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#014.src: Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!
Taking the Tower#014.dst: Ei, {u}, aí está você! Vamos, vamos subir aquela torre!

Taking the Tower#015.src: They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#015.dst: Foram, tenente! {u} e eu chegamos ao topo e derrotamos o corrompido.
Taking the Tower#015.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#016.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#016.dst: Fale com Aledar no quartel de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#017.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#017.dst: Ah, {u}! Oi! Que bom ver você e o Tasim de novo. Espero que não tenham vivido muitas aventuras sem mim!
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#018.dst: O Tasim foi para a sala de treino, se estiver procurando por ele. Ele mergulhou de cabeça, o que... é bom! Todos precisamos ficar mais fortes para defender a província.
Taking the Tower#018.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#019.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#019.dst: ...Ah! Já que está aqui- eu ia me juntar ao esquadrão do tenente Van para retomar uma torre tomada por corrompidos. Venha com a gente também!
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: E aí? O que acha? Quer experiência de combate de verdade? Não deve demorar.
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#022.dst: Perfeito. Bem, não há hora melhor que agora! Vamos lá.
Taking the Tower#022.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#023.src: I've got something to do her

Taking the Tower#025.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#025.dst: Bom, ainda vou ficar aqui um tempo. Se mudar de ideia, me avise!
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#026.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#026.dst: Ei, você voltou! Mudou de ideia? Quer atacar uma torre corrompida?
Taking the Tower#026.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#027.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#027.dst: Siga Aledar até o Mestre do pó em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#028.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#028.dst: Certo, então. Me contaram algo sobre a torre que vamos atacar, e podemos nos preparar para isso!
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#029.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#029.dst: Pelo visto, o chefão no alto da torre é fraco a dano! Por isso estamos aqui no Mestre do pó.
Taking the Tower#029.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#030.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#030.dst: Eu, hã... não lembro de cabeça todo o discurso sobre elementos. Se quiser saber mais, fale com o capitão Ragon no quartel. Ele tem um curso inteiro sobre isso!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#031.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#031.dst: ...O que importa é- toma. Pegue este pó elemental e fale com o Powder Master pra aplicá-lo. Me avise quando terminar!
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#032.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#032.dst: Aplique um Pó de Água na sua arma e avise Aledar em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#033.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#033.dst: Pó na arma? Ótimo, então estamos prontos.
Taking the Tower#033.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#034.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#034.dst: Vá na frente! Estou logo atrás de você.
Taking the Tower#034.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#035.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#035.dst: Encontre o esquadrão do tenente Van perto da Torre Furiosa em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#036.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#036.dst: Ah, Aledar! Bom te ver aqui. Quem está com você?
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#037.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#037.dst: É {u}, senhor. Veio se juntar ao ataque, se o senhor permitir.
Taking the Tower#037.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#038.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#038.dst: Hm... Bem, não vejo por que não. Quanto mais, melhor, é o que eu digo.
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
