Tempo Town Trouble#021.dst: Ah, não esse tipo de soldado? Que pena... Mas- olha, é um tiro no escuro, mas... talvez você seja o tipo de soldado que mata um monstro pra gente?
Tempo Town Trouble#021.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#022.src: You- you would!? Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did! You see- we were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there apparently weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#022.dst: Você- você mataria!? Ah, graças aos céus você chegou bem agora! Veja- aquele velho Martyn nos disse para nos instalarmos nesta encosta porque aparentemente não havia criaturas perigosas aqui!
Tempo Town Trouble#022.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#023.src: But every night, the same monster emerges from one of the ruins, and tries to smash the buildings down! Every single night, at the same time!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.dst: Mas toda noite o mesmo monstro sai de uma das ruínas e tenta derrubar as construções! Toda santa noite, na mesma hora!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#024.src: The guards are getting run ragged, and I refuse to be responsible for any deaths when I'm trying to save these folks!
Tempo Town Trouble#024.dst: Os guardas estão exaustos, e me recuso a ser responsável por mortes quando estou tentando salvar essa gente!
Tempo Town Trouble#024.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#025.src: We found the ruin it came out of, too- Er, one of the folks here, Doug, did! Here, let me write down the location for you- no, no, I insist, let me do it!
Tempo Town Trouble#025.dst: Também achamos a ruína de onde ele sai- Hã, um daqui, o Doug, achou! Tome, deixa eu anotar o local pra você- não, não, eu insisto, deixa comigo!
Tempo Town Trouble#025.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#026.src: There's the coordinates in case you forget, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.dst: Aí estão as coordenadas caso esqueça, mas fica no templo logo ali no morro! Por favor, por favor, corra e dê um jeito naquele monstro horrível!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#027.src: The coordinates are in your book, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#027.dst: As coordenadas estão no seu livro, mas é no templo ali no morro! Por favor, por favor, corra e dê um jeito naquele monstro horrível!
Tempo Town Trouble#027.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#029.src: Grr... I KNOW I saw that beast go in here, where the heck is it?!
Tempo Town Trouble#029.dst: Grr... EU SEI que vi aquela fera entrar aqui, cadê ela?!
Tempo Town Trouble#029.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#030.src: Hey soldier, does that disk look like some type of door to you?
Tempo Town Trouble#030.dst: Ei, soldado, esse disco não parece uma espécie de porta?
Tempo Town Trouble#030.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#031.src: I saw some creature that I've been tracking for a few days disappear around here, and I think it's somewhere behind this disk...
Tempo Town Trouble#031.dst: Vi uma criatura que venho rastreando há dias sumir por aqui, e acho que está em algum lugar atrás deste disco...
Tempo Town Trouble#031.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#033.src: Hey, you're able to use magic, right? Maybe using one of your fancy spells on the disk will get it open?
Tempo Town Trouble#033.dst: Ei, você sabe usar magia, né? Talvez lançar um dos seus feitiços chiques no disco o abra?
Tempo Town Trouble#033.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#034.src: Stand on the disk and cast any spell. That should probably get it open, then we can finally kill that freak of nature lurking inside of there!
Tempo Town Trouble#034.dst: Fique sobre o disco e lance qualquer feitiço. Isso deve abri-lo, e aí finalmente matamos a aberração escondida lá dentro!
Tempo Town Trouble#034.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#035.src: Let's see... What kind of secrets do these odd temples house?
Tempo Town Trouble#035.dst: Vejamos... Que segredos esses templos estranhos guardam?
Tempo Town Trouble#035.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#036.src: Use spells to break open the temple at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Tempo Town Trouble#036.dst: Use feitiços para abrir o templo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#037.src: What was going through your noggin, {u}?
Tempo Town Trouble#037.dst: O que se passava na sua cabeça, {u}?
Tempo Town Trouble#037.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#038.src: Do you have any idea what you were doing? Bashing around that room I just sealed off for good?
Tempo Town Trouble#038.dst: Tem ideia do que estava fazendo? Arrebentando a sala que eu tinha acabado de selar para sempre?
Tempo Town Trouble#038.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#039.src: You need to be careful, soldier! This Valley's secrets are NOT to be meddled with.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.dst: Precisa ter cuidado, soldado! Com os segredos deste Vale NÃO se mexe.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#040.src: I assume the mayor of that place called {p} sent you here. You are going to have to tell that lad that his problems just got worse.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.dst: Imagino que o prefeito daquele lugar chamado {p} te mandou. Vai ter que dizer ao rapaz que os problemas dele acabaram de piorar.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#042.src: The only way to keep them at bay effectively is to seal them, like I just did here. But now, that stunt you just pulled sent ripples across the entire Valley. Now, every single Time Trouble is responding to this one's termination!
Tempo Town Trouble#042.dst: O único jeito eficaz de contê-los é selá-los, como acabei de fazer aqui. Mas a façanha que você aprontou mandou ondas pelo Vale inteiro. Agora, cada Problema temporal está reagindo à morte deste!
Tempo Town Trouble#042.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#043.src: Now, one Time Trouble I can handle, but this? I can't keep them all at bay... and now, you went and awakened every single one of those critters.
Tempo Town Trouble#043.dst: Com um Problema temporal eu dou conta, mas com isto? Não consigo conter todos... e agora você foi lá e despertou cada um desses bichos.
Tempo Town Trouble#043.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#044.src: I can fix this seal, so you'll have one less to deal with, but the rest of the Troubles will have to be taken down daily with brute force.
Tempo Town Trouble#044.dst: Posso consertar este selo, então você terá um a menos, mas o resto dos Problemas temporais terá que ser abatido diariamente na força bruta.
Tempo Town Trouble#044.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#045.src: You're going to have to deal with those, soldier. I have far too much to take care of in this valley.
Tempo Town Trouble#045.dst: Você vai ter que lidar com eles, soldado. Tenho coisas demais para cuidar neste vale.
Tempo Town Trouble#045.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#046.src: They'll have to be exterminated every single day. Now, I'm sure the work won't be thankless, perhaps you'll be rewarded by the townsfolk of {p} for taking care of them.
Tempo Town Trouble#046.dst: Terão de ser exterminados todo santo dia. Mas tenho certeza de que o trabalho não será ingrato, talvez o povo de {p} te recompense por cuidar deles.
Tempo Town Trouble#046.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#047.src: Now please, be careful in the Valley. I already have to look after one person, nevermind the mess of time that the Olm were so-
Tempo Town Trouble#047.dst: Agora, por favor, tome cuidado no Vale. Já tenho que cuidar de uma pessoa, sem falar da bagunça temporal que os Olm tão-
Tempo Town Trouble#047.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#048.src: ...I digress, I'm just rambling again. Now, let me bring us back outside this temple, and you should head back to that shanty town.
Tempo Town Trouble#048.dst: ...Estou divagando de novo. Deixe-me nos tirar deste templo, e você volte àquele vilarejo de barracos.
Tempo Town Trouble#048.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#049.src: Report back to the mayor in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#050.src: You're back! I heard some kind of weird chime coming from the temple on the hill- is that a good sign?
Tempo Town Trouble#050.dst: Você voltou! Ouvi um tipo de badalada estranha vindo do templo no morro- isso é bom sinal?
Tempo Town Trouble#050.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#051.src: You did?! Oh, thank goodness... Honestly, Martyn told us he would deal with it, but then he just disappeared off into nowhere!
Tempo Town Trouble#051.dst: Conseguiu?! Ah, graças aos céus... Sinceramente, o Martyn disse que ia cuidar disso, mas aí simplesmente sumiu do mapa!
Tempo Town Trouble#051.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#054.src: And now there's more of them? Why didn't he just tell us?! Now they'll need to be stopped every day to keep them in check!!
Tempo Town Trouble#054.dst: E agora há mais deles? Por que ele não nos contou?! Agora vão ter que ser contidos todo dia para ficarem sob controle!!
Tempo Town Trouble#054.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#055.src: Gah, this is a disaster... It isn't your fault, you didn't know- Wait, what's that boxy thing you have? A [Time Fragment]? ...oh, so the monster dropped it.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.dst: Argh, que desastre... Não é culpa sua, você não sabia- Espera, que coisa quadrada é essa com você? Um [Time Fragment]? ...ah, o monstro deixou cair.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#056.src: Interesting... One of the townsfolk likes to collect those sorts of things! He's that Mysterious Merchant just behind me.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.dst: Interessante... Um morador daqui gosta de colecionar essas coisas! É aquele Mercador Misterioso logo atrás de mim.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#057.src: Go talk with him about those! He might give you something worth your while if you trade them with him.
Tempo Town Trouble#057.dst: Vá falar com ele sobre isso! Ele pode te dar algo que valha a pena se você trocar com ele.
Tempo Town Trouble#057.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#058.src: ...also, while you were away, that strange magic stone up on the hill started glowing. We're not sure what to do with it, really! Might be worth your attention.
Tempo Town Trouble#058.dst: ...e, enquanto você estava fora, aquela pedra mágica estranha no morro começou a brilhar. Não sabemos bem o que fazer com ela! Talvez mereça sua atenção.
Tempo Town Trouble#058.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#060.src: Heya! Heard from the mayor that you helped out the town! Can't thank you enough for that.
Tempo Town Trouble#060.dst: Opa! O prefeito me contou que você ajudou a cidade! Não tenho como agradecer.
Tempo Town Trouble#060.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#061.src: Oh hey, it's you! I hope you've been keeping those Time Troubles at bay.
Tempo Town Trouble#061.dst: Ah, é você! Espero que esteja segurando os Problemas temporais.
Tempo Town Trouble#061.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#062.src: Oh, hey! I hope that monster wasn't too difficult for you to defeat.
Tempo Town Trouble#062.dst: Ah, oi! Espero que o monstro não tenha sido tão difícil de derrotar.
Tempo Town Trouble#062.speaker: Scout

The Bigger Picture#000.src: Since you're so big, you won't fall asleep! Please retrieve some mushroom for me.
The Bigger Picture#000.dst: Como você é tão grande, não vai dormir! Por favor, me traga um pouco de cogumelo.
The Bigger Picture#000.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#001.src: You've taken care of the Razorice problem, now you just need to find that blue mushroom Psilo was talking about...
The Bigger Picture#001.dst: Você resolveu o problema dos Razorice, agora só precisa achar aquele cogumelo azul de que Psilo falou...

The Bigger Picture#002.src: Talk to Psilo in the mushroom cave.
The Bigger Picture#002.dst: Fale com Psilo na caverna de cogumelos.

The Bigger Picture#003.src: Welcome, large human! What's that look for, never seen a Gnome before?! My house may look small, but it's perfect for me!
The Bigger Picture#003.dst: Bem-vindo, humano grande! Que cara é essa, nunca viu um gnomo?! Minha casa pode parecer pequena, mas é perfeita para mim!
The Bigger Picture#003.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#004.src: I actually need some help, you see Razorice plague my home! They are similar to the rats of your province, but vicious and deadly to Gnomes!
The Bigger Picture#004.dst: Na verdade preciso de ajuda, os Razorice infestam minha casa! São parecidos com os ratos da sua província, mas ferozes e mortais para gnomos!
The Bigger Picture#004.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#005.src: An easy fix exists for it though. There are many magical mushrooms in this cave and a rare one called Subtraxerim Utilium is the one we need.
The Bigger Picture#005.dst: Mas há uma solução fácil. Há muitos cogumelos mágicos nesta caverna, e um raro chamado Subtraxerim Utilium é o que precisamos.
The Bigger Picture#005.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#006.src: It emits a sleeping spore that will knock the Razorice out long enough to kill them! I've seen one in the cave but every time I go to get it, I fall asleep!
The Bigger Picture#006.dst: Ele solta um esporo do sono que apaga os Razorice por tempo suficiente para matá-los! Vi um na caverna, mas toda vez que vou pegá-lo, eu durmo!
The Bigger Picture#006.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#007.src: I left a trail of spores from the location. Since you're so big, you won't fall asleep! Please retrieve some mushroom for me.
The Bigger Picture#007.dst: Deixei uma trilha de esporos desde o local. Grande como é, você não vai dormir! Por favor, me traga um pouco do cogumelo.
The Bigger Picture#007.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#008.src: I think I left a trail of rainbow spores last time I tried to collect some, just follow the colours through the cave to find the mushroom!
The Bigger Picture#008.dst: Acho que deixei um rastro de esporos coloridos na última vez que tentei colher, é só seguir as cores pela caverna para achar o cogumelo!
The Bigger Picture#008.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#009.src: Find the Subtraxerim Utilium mushroom in the cave and bring it back to Psilo.
The Bigger Picture#009.dst: Encontre o cogumelo Subtraxerim Utilium na caverna e leve-o de volta a Psilo.

The Bigger Picture#011.src: Did you find any? Wait, something is different about you. Have you gotten smaller? Oh my...
The Bigger Picture#011.dst: Achou algum? Espere, tem algo diferente em você. Você encolheu? Minha nossa...
The Bigger Picture#011.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#013.src: I’m really sorry about this, I didn't think the mushroom would have a different effect on humans! But what did I expect from a mushroom that changes colour?!
The Bigger Picture#013.dst: Sinto muito mesmo, não achei que o cogumelo teria outro efeito nos humanos! Mas o que eu esperava de um cogumelo que muda de cor?!
The Bigger Picture#013.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#014.src: Do not panic. I have a mushroom in my house that wakes people up; logic says that if the sleeping mushroom shrinks you, then this one should make you grow again!
The Bigger Picture#014.dst: Não entre em pânico. Tenho um cogumelo em casa que acorda as pessoas; a lógica diz que, se o cogumelo do sono te encolhe, este deve te fazer crescer de novo!
The Bigger Picture#014.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#015.src: Oh my, you are still shrinking before my eyes. You must hurry to the mushroom. Be careful, though! The Razorice will probably hunt you!
The Bigger Picture#015.dst: Minha nossa, você continua encolhendo diante dos meus olhos. Corra até o cogumelo. Mas cuidado! Os Razorice provavelmente vão te caçar!
The Bigger Picture#015.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#016.src: I keep it on the top shelf, so you will probably have to fight them at some point... If you kill them while you^re there, we can kill two birds with one stone! Just follow the cheese crumbs to find them!
The Bigger Picture#016.dst: Fica na prateleira de cima, então você deve ter que lutar com eles em algum momento... Se matá-los no caminho, matamos dois coelhos com uma cajadada só! Siga as migalhas de queijo para achá-los!
The Bigger Picture#016.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#017.src: Good luck! Oh and, do watch out for my pet zombie.
The Bigger Picture#017.dst: Boa sorte! Ah, e cuidado com meu zumbi de estimação.
The Bigger Picture#017.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#018.src: Find the mushroom in Psilo's house.
The Bigger Picture#018.dst: Encontre o cogumelo na casa de Psilo.

The Bigger Picture#019.src: Get to the mouse nest by following the cheese trail and get rid of the pest.
The Bigger Picture#019.dst: Chegue ao ninho de ratos seguindo a trilha de queijo e livre-se da praga.

The Bigger Picture#020.src: Get to the blue mushroom and return to normal size.
The Bigger Picture#020.dst: Chegue ao cogumelo azul e volte ao tamanho normal.

The Bigger Picture#021.src: Give Psilo the good news about the mice.
The Bigger Picture#021.dst: Dê a Psilo a boa notícia sobre os ratos.

The Bigger Picture#022.src: What the... my house! What did you do?!
The Bigger Picture#022.dst: Mas o quê... minha casa! O que você fez?!
The Bigger Picture#022.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#023.src: Springy plant? Bookshelf levers? Razorice king?! Hold on a moment, slow down and tell me properly.
The Bigger Picture#023.dst: Planta saltitante? Alavancas na estante? Rei Razorice?! Espere um pouco, calma e me conte direito.
The Bigger Picture#023.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#024.src: I see. Well, at least you handled those damned Razorice, and I can actually live inside my house again - not that it'll offer much shelter now you've blown a hole in the side of it!
The Bigger Picture#024.dst: Entendo. Bem, pelo menos você deu conta daqueles malditos Razorice, e posso voltar a morar na minha casa - não que ela vá me abrigar muito agora que você abriu um buraco na lateral!
The Bigger Picture#024.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#025.src: Ah, I suppose that's alright. The mushroom will grow back over to cover it - and righto, your reward!
The Bigger Picture#025.dst: Ah, acho que tudo bem. O cogumelo vai crescer de novo e cobrir - e certo, sua recompensa!
The Bigger Picture#025.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#026.src: Here, take some of our Gnome gold, we have plenty to go around. And sorry about the whole you-getting-shrunk thing, but hey, being small isn't so bad! See you around, human!
The Bigger Picture#026.dst: Tome, leve um pouco do nosso ouro gnomo, temos de sobra. E desculpe por essa história de você encolher, mas ei, ser pequeno não é tão ruim! Até mais, humano!
The Bigger Picture#026.speaker: Psilo

The Breaking Point#000.src: Hey, keep up! We need to get this part into the machine as quickly as we can!
The Breaking Point#000.dst: Ei, acompanhe! Precisamos pôr esta peça na máquina o mais rápido possível!

The Breaking Point#001.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#001.dst: Incrível! Vou nos levar de volta a Kandon Beda com esse capacitor o quanto antes.
The Breaking Point#001.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#002.src: I... see. {u}... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#002.dst: Sei... {u}... Ozoth me diz... que uma Chama Eterna... livrará os Anciões.
The Breaking Point#002.speaker: Ineos

similar.text: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.

The Breaking Point#004.src: You need to get onto the path up to {p}. There should be signposts outside of {p}...
The Breaking Point#004.dst: Você precisa pegar o caminho que sobe até {p}. Deve haver placas fora de {p}...

The Breaking Point#005.src: Speak to General Elix at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in {p}.
The Breaking Point#005.dst: Fale com o General Elix em [{~}, {~}, -{~}], em {p}.

The Breaking Point#006.src: ... Alright, let's see here... Private! Give me a report!
The Breaking Point#006.dst: ... Certo, vejamos... Soldado! Quero um relatório!
The Breaking Point#006.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#007.src: Sir, our readings are positive! Stability is at {~}, and shows no sign of dropping.
The Breaking Point#007.dst: Senhor, leituras positivas! Estabilidade em {~}, sem sinal de queda.
The Breaking Point#007.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#009.src: Excellent. Keep an eye on everything, and let me know if something comes up. Now, I need to go find... -
The Breaking Point#009.dst: Excelente. Fiquem de olho em tudo e me avisem se algo acontecer. Agora, preciso ir buscar... -
The Breaking Point#009.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#010.src: Hmph. And who exactly are you? This site is off-limits to civilians.
The Breaking Point#010.dst: Hunf. E quem exatamente é você? Este local é proibido a civis.
The Breaking Point#010.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#011.src: Adventurer. Of course. Well, as it stands, we're doing rather dangerous work here. I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#011.dst: Aventureiro. Claro. Bem, fazemos um trabalho bem perigoso aqui. Vou ter que pedir que você-
The Breaking Point#011.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#012.src: ... The stabilizer? We're doing rather dangerous work here, keeping the thing beyond that cliff passive. So, I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#012.dst: ... O estabilizador? Fazemos algo perigoso aqui: manter passiva a coisa além daquele penhasco. Então, vou ter que pedir que você-
The Breaking Point#012.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#013.src: General! Stability is dropping, and fast!
The Breaking Point#013.dst: General! A estabilidade cai, e rápido!
The Breaking Point#013.speaker: Private Walder

The Breaking Point#015.src: What?! Of all times for it to-
The Breaking Point#015.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#016.src: Urgh... Soldiers, follow protocol! Secure what you can, leave what you can't! And- you! I haven't forgotten about you. As soon as this all clears up, we'll-
The Breaking Point#016.dst: Argh... Soldados, sigam o protocolo! Salvem o que puderem, deixem o resto! E- você! Não me esqueci de você. Assim que tudo isso se acalmar, nós vamos-
The Breaking Point#016.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#017.src: Gah! This damned Colossus! What I wouldn't give to...
The Breaking Point#017.dst: Argh! Maldito Colosso! O que eu não daria para...
The Breaking Point#017.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#018.src: ... It's over. Walder! Survey the damages to our equipment! Morec! Take count of injuries around the base, make sure everyone's safe!
The Breaking Point#018.dst: ... Acabou. Walder! Avalie os danos ao equipamento! Morec! Conte os feridos pela base, garanta que todos estão bem!
The Breaking Point#018.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#020.src: General! We came as soon as we could- we were down in the library and the exit co- Oh. Wow.
The Breaking Point#020.dst: General! Viemos assim que deu- estávamos lá embaixo na biblioteca e a saída des- Ah. Nossa.

The Breaking Point#021.src: Well, Rhay, you're here now, yes? What do you think, can you fix it? We'll need to get it working before-
The Breaking Point#021.dst: Bem, Rhay, você está aqui agora, certo? O que acha, consegue consertar? Precisamos que funcione antes que-
The Breaking Point#021.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#022.src: Can I- No, of course I can't fix it! Not on my own, especially since we don't have the proper equipment around here! Ugh, how long has it even been since last time?
The Breaking Point#022.dst: Se eu consigo- Não, claro que não consigo consertar! Não sozinha, ainda mais sem o equipamento certo por aqui! Argh, quanto tempo faz desde a última vez?
The Breaking Point#022.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#023.src: It has been... three days... give or take. Rhay... you know we can't keep-
The Breaking Point#023.dst: Faz... três dias... por aí. Rhay... sabe que não podemos continuar-

The Breaking Point#024.src: The stabilizer has been working so far, Ineos! It's some of the finest technology our province has to offer, and it has been working!.
The Breaking Point#024.dst: O estabilizador vem funcionando até agora, Ineos! É uma das melhores tecnologias que nossa província oferece, e tem funcionado!.
The Breaking Point#024.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#025.src: Rhay, you know... as well as I do... that it is getting worse. The Protector is... growing resistant to... your machines. We need... a new plan.
The Breaking Point#025.dst: Rhay, você sabe... tão bem quanto eu... que está piorando. O Protetor... resiste cada vez mais... às suas máquinas. Precisamos... de outro plano.
The Breaking Point#025.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#026.src: Yes, well, as soon as you come up with one, I'll be glad to hear it! But so far, you've barely gotten anything-
The Breaking Point#026.dst: Sim, bem, assim que você tiver um, vou adorar ouvir! Mas até agora você mal conseguiu-
The Breaking Point#026.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#028.src: ... Sorry. I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. General, to answer your question... The stabilizer itself is damaged, but you should have what's needed to repair it here.
The Breaking Point#028.dst: ... Desculpe. Desculpe, não quis dizer isso. General, respondendo à pergunta... O estabilizador está danificado, mas aqui deve haver o necessário para consertá-lo.
The Breaking Point#028.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#029.src: The issue is the controls look like they're fried! And we don't have any replacement parts stored here. We'll have to travel back to Corkus, and...
The Breaking Point#029.dst: O problema é que os controles parecem fritos! E não temos peças de reposição guardadas aqui. Vamos ter que voltar a Corkus, e...
The Breaking Point#029.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#030.src: ... Right. You. You're an adventurer, yes? And you appear to be well-equipped. Then you'll be traveling to Corkus with Rhay, and assist with whatever is needed there.
The Breaking Point#030.dst: ... Certo. Você. É aventureiro, não? E parece bem equipado. Então vai viajar a Corkus com Rhay e ajudar no que for preciso lá.
The Breaking Point#030.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#032.src: Wait, General-... Right. Alright. In that case... I'll give you time to prepare. We'll take the Hot Air Balloon to travel to Corkus, so I'll meet you there. We don't have any time to waste.
The Breaking Point#032.dst: Espere, General-... Certo. Tudo bem. Nesse caso... vou te dar tempo para se preparar. Vamos de balão de ar quente até Corkus, então te encontro lá. Não temos tempo a perder.
The Breaking Point#032.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#033.src: And I will... return to the library. I trust... you will succeed... But we must... prepare for the... worst.
The Breaking Point#033.dst: E eu... voltarei à biblioteca. Confio... que vão conseguir... Mas devemos... nos preparar para o... pior.
The Breaking Point#033.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#035.src: Meet Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#035.dst: Encontre Rhay no balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#036.src: Ah, you're here! Well, if you're ready, then we'd best be off. Just hop aboard this balloon, and the captain will take us where we need to go.
The Breaking Point#036.dst: Ah, você chegou! Bem, se está pronto, é melhor irmos. É só subir neste balão, e o capitão nos leva aonde precisamos.
The Breaking Point#036.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#037.src: I can tell you more while we travel, but we need to get going quick. There's no telling how much time we have before-
The Breaking Point#037.dst: Posso te contar mais durante a viagem, mas precisamos ir logo. Não dá pra saber quanto tempo temos antes que-
The Breaking Point#037.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#038.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#038.dst: Certo, certo. Não ligue pra mim, estou meio tensa por... bem, motivos óbvios. É só subir.
The Breaking Point#038.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#039.src: Right, right. Don't mind me, I'm just a little on edge, for... well, for obvious reasons. Just hop aboard.
The Breaking Point#039.dst: Certo, certo. Não ligue pra mim, estou meio tensa por... bem, por motivos óbvios. É só subir.
The Breaking Point#039.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#040.src: Travel to {p} via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#040.dst: Viaje até {p} pelo balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#041.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#041.dst: Bem, ali está! O próprio Colosso do Cânion. A origem de todos os nossos problemas em {p}.
The Breaking Point#041.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#042.src: Well, there it is! The Canyon Colossus itself. The source of all of our problems here at {p}.
The Breaking Point#042.dst: Bem, ali está! O próprio Colosso do Cânion. A origem de todos os nossos problemas aqui em {p}.
The Breaking Point#042.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#043.src: So! How much do you already know? I know we dragged you into this without telling you much, so... I can fill you in on the details.
The Breaking Point#043.dst: Então! Quanto você já sabe? Sei que te arrastamos pra isso sem contar muito, então... posso te dar os detalhes.
The Breaking Point#043.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#044.src: Oh, he did? Right, that makes sense. Well, you're right in that it's the source of the earthquakes, but there's more to it than that.
The Breaking Point#044.dst: Ah, ele contou? Certo, faz sentido. Bem, você tem razão que ele é a origem dos terremotos, mas há mais do que isso.
The Breaking Point#044.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#045.src: You've seen the {p}, right? Heard of the Fracturing. From what we can tell, what happened to that region a thousand years ago is happening again, here and now.
The Breaking Point#045.dst: Você já viu {p}, certo? Ouviu falar da Fratura. Pelo que percebemos, o que aconteceu àquela região mil anos atrás está acontecendo de novo, aqui e agora.
The Breaking Point#045.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#046.src: Yes, exactly. It's been malfunctioning for a long time now, and it's starting to tear the canyon apart. That's where we come in.
The Breaking Point#046.dst: Sim, exatamente. Ele está com defeito há muito tempo e está começando a rasgar o cânion. É aí que nós entramos.
The Breaking Point#046.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#047.src: Well... To start with, it's an ancient thing. It was built long before even the doguns can remember, and they've lived in this region for thousands of years.
The Breaking Point#047.dst: Bem... Para começar, é uma coisa antiga. Foi construído muito antes do que até os Doguns lembram, e eles vivem nesta região há milhares de anos.
The Breaking Point#047.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#048.src: According to Ineos, the doguns used to be responsible for keeping it calm, but ever since the dwarves came in and started their war, that knowledge has been lost to time.
The Breaking Point#048.dst: Segundo Ineos, os Doguns é que o mantinham calmo, mas desde que os anões chegaram e começaram a guerra, esse conhecimento se perdeu no tempo.
The Breaking Point#048.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#049.src: Which is... a problem! {p} has been malfunctioning for hundreds of years, and it's reaching its breaking point. If we don't stop it, it'll tear the canyon apart.
The Breaking Point#049.dst: O que é... um problema! {p} está com defeito há centenas de anos e está chegando ao ponto de ruptura. Se não o detivermos, vai rasgar o cânion.
The Breaking Point#049.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#050.src: Oh? So you've traveled the canyon, then. Yeah, then you've seen how the canyon twists and changes.
The Breaking Point#050.dst: Ah? Então você já percorreu o cânion. É, então viu como ele se retorce e muda.
The Breaking Point#050.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#051.src: It destroys peoples' homes, it traps them deep within the maze-like valleys... And, more recently, it has been tearing a hole into the void.
The Breaking Point#051.dst: Destrói as casas das pessoas, as prende no fundo dos vales labirínticos... E, mais recentemente, vem abrindo um buraco no Vazio.
The Breaking Point#051.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#052.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try to keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#052.dst: Essa coisa é antiga, e não sabemos como funciona. O melhor que podemos fazer é impedir que chegue ao ponto de ruptura, e evitar que o cânion tenha o mesmo destino de {p}.
The Breaking Point#052.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try and keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#053.dst: Essa coisa é antiga, e não sabemos como funciona. O melhor que podemos fazer é tentar impedir que chegue ao ponto de ruptura, e evitar que o cânion tenha o mesmo destino de {p}.
The Breaking Point#053.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#054.src: So, Gavel's government contacted us in Corkus some time ago, requesting our help to deal with this threat.
The Breaking Point#054.dst: Então, o governo de Gavel nos contatou em Corkus há algum tempo, pedindo ajuda com essa ameaça.
The Breaking Point#054.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#055.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified that Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#055.dst: Nosso conselho aceitou, e começamos a projetar uma máquina que replicasse a magia Dogun que pacificou aquele Colosso há muito tempo.
The Breaking Point#055.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified the Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#056.dst: Nosso conselho aceitou, e começamos a projetar uma máquina que replicasse a magia Dogun que pacificou o Colosso há muito tempo.
The Breaking Point#056.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#057.src: We've had Ineos' help on that front. He and I have been working here in {p} to ensure things are running smoothly. Which... evidently, they are not.
The Breaking Point#057.dst: Tivemos a ajuda de Ineos nisso. Ele e eu trabalhamos aqui em {p} para garantir que tudo corra bem. O que... claramente não está.
The Breaking Point#057.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#058.src: ... We'll be fine! We're going to meet up with my husband at Corkus, and he'll know what to do. He always does.
The Breaking Point#058.dst: ... Vai dar tudo certo! Vamos encontrar meu marido em Corkus, e ele vai saber o que fazer. Ele sempre sabe.
The Breaking Point#058.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#059.src: Our people working there will be able to get us the parts we need to repair the device. This... this isn't the first time it's exploded. I had hoped that this time we would have gotten it stable, but...
The Breaking Point#059.dst: Nosso pessoal lá vai conseguir as peças que precisamos para consertar o aparelho. Esta... esta não é a primeira vez que ele explode. Eu esperava que dessa vez tivéssemos estabilizado, mas...
The Breaking Point#059.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#060.src: But, hey! We have it under control. We're always able to repair it quickly enough to keep it running while the Colossus is active.
The Breaking Point#060.dst: Mas, ei! Temos tudo sob controle. Sempre conseguimos consertá-lo a tempo de mantê-lo funcionando enquanto o Colosso está ativo.
The Breaking Point#060.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#061.src: Oh! Yeah. He's the one responsible for the design and production of this device. He's got a talent for designing these sorts of things, without him... well, we'd be in a much worse situation than we are now.
The Breaking Point#061.dst: Ah! É. Ele é o responsável pelo projeto e fabricação deste aparelho. Tem talento para projetar esse tipo de coisa, sem ele... bem, estaríamos numa situação muito pior que a de agora.
The Breaking Point#061.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#062.src: I'll be glad to see him again. It's been a while since I last had to travel to Corkus, and... Well, I'm confident he'll know what to do here. He always does.
The Breaking Point#062.dst: Vou adorar revê-lo. Faz tempo que não preciso ir a Corkus, e... Bem, tenho certeza de que ele saberá o que fazer aqui. Ele sempre sabe.
The Breaking Point#062.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#063.src: ... Right! Hey, it looks like we're almost there. We'll be able to get this all sorted out, and we'll be back to {p} in no time.
The Breaking Point#063.dst: ... Certo! Ei, parece que estamos quase lá. Vamos resolver tudo isso e voltar a {p} rapidinho.
The Breaking Point#063.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#064.src: Find the contact in the factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#064.dst: Encontre o contato na fábrica em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#065.src: Alright, let's just head on in. My husband should be around here somewhere...
The Breaking Point#065.dst: Certo, vamos entrar logo. Meu marido deve estar por aqui em algum lugar...
The Breaking Point#065.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#066.src: Rhay, love! You're back already? Our next routine maintenance isn't for another- Wait, {u}? What are you doing here?
The Breaking Point#066.dst: Rhay, amor! Já voltou? Nossa próxima manutenção de rotina só é daqui a- Espere, {u}? O que faz aqui?
The Breaking Point#066.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#067.src: I... You two know each other?
The Breaking Point#067.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#068.src: Of course we do - they're the one who helped me with all the Factory stuff! How did you two meet?
The Breaking Point#068.dst: Claro - foi quem me ajudou com toda a história da Fábrica! Como vocês dois se conheceram?
The Breaking Point#068.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#069.src: They just showed up at {p} and agreed to help us with... - Why didn't you bring this up earlier?
The Breaking Point#069.dst: Apareceu em {p} e aceitou nos ajudar com... - Por que você não falou disso antes?
The Breaking Point#069.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#070.src: It must have...- right. Well, if anything that makes you even more qualified to help us out, I guess! I can't believe I didn't recognize you...?
The Breaking Point#070.dst: Deve ter...- certo. Bem, isso só te deixa ainda mais qualificado para nos ajudar, acho! Não acredito que não te reconheci...?
The Breaking Point#070.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#071.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maitenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#071.dst: Ok, certo, voltando à pergunta - o que vocês dois já estão fazendo aqui? Ainda faltam uns dias para a próxima manutenção de rotina, não?
The Breaking Point#071.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#072.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maintenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#072.dst: Ok, certo, voltando à pergunta - o que vocês dois já estão fazendo aqui? Ainda faltam uns dias para a próxima manutenção de rotina, não é?
The Breaking Point#072.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#073.src: I did send you an invite! I gave it to... you know, the one captain who ferries people around! But then you didn't show up to the wedding, so I guess it didn't reach you...
The Breaking Point#073.dst: Mandei convite, sim! Entreguei para... sabe, aquele capitão que leva gente pra lá e pra cá! Mas você não apareceu no casamento, então acho que não chegou...
The Breaking Point#073.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#074.src: Look, you're a hard person to reach! You've been all over the world at this point, including {p} of all places- speaking of, why are you two here?
The Breaking Point#074.dst: Olha, você é difícil de encontrar! Já rodou o mundo todo a essa altura, até {p}, imagine- falando nisso, por que vocês dois estão aqui?
The Breaking Point#074.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#076.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an undetected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#076.dst: Certo! Certo. Me distraí um pouco... Hã, tivemos um problema lá em {p}. Houve um evento sísmico não detectado, e o aparelho ficou muito danificado.
The Breaking Point#076.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#077.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an unexpected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#077.dst: Certo! Certo. Me distraí um pouco... Hã, tivemos um problema lá em {p}. Houve um evento sísmico inesperado, e o aparelho ficou muito danificado.
The Breaking Point#077.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#078.src: We should be able to finish most of the repairs with what materials we have there, but we're missing a Magmaflux Capacitor for the control panel.
The Breaking Point#078.dst: Devemos conseguir terminar a maior parte dos reparos com os materiais de lá, mas falta um Capacitor Magmaflux para o painel de controle.
The Breaking Point#078.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#079.src: ... Oh. That's going to be a problem. We haven't had an opportunity to make more parts yet - it hasn't been long enough since our last maintenance. So... I'm not sure what we-
The Breaking Point#079.dst: ... Ah. Isso vai ser um problema. Ainda não tivemos chance de fazer mais peças - faz pouco tempo da última manutenção. Então... não sei bem o que a gente-
The Breaking Point#079.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#080.src: I overheard the conversation from over there- good to see you Rhay, by the way- But. We may not have any capacitors left up here, but I know where you can get one.
The Breaking Point#080.dst: Ouvi a conversa dali- bom te ver, Rhay, aliás- Mas. Podemos não ter mais capacitores aqui em cima, mas sei onde vocês podem conseguir um.
The Breaking Point#080.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#081.src: We repurposed this factory for our needs, but it was built here to process resources from the mines below.
The Breaking Point#081.dst: Adaptamos esta fábrica para o nosso uso, mas ela foi feita para processar recursos das minas lá embaixo.
The Breaking Point#081.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#082.src: Though it was discontinued, it's very likely that there are still miner mechs down there- and some of the more powerful models made use of very similar circuits to the capacitors we use today.
The Breaking Point#082.dst: Embora tenha sido desativada, é bem provável que ainda haja mechs mineradores lá embaixo- e alguns dos modelos mais potentes usavam circuitos muito parecidos com os capacitores de hoje.
The Breaking Point#082.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#083.src: ...You're right! If they're still down there, we should be able to scrap one of the bots and reuse its circuits. {u}, we can send you down into the mines to find what we need, while we prepare up here!
The Breaking Point#083.dst: ...Você tem razão! Se ainda estiverem lá, dá para desmontar um dos robôs e reaproveitar os circuitos. {u}, podemos te mandar às minas atrás do que precisamos, enquanto nos preparamos aqui em cima!
The Breaking Point#083.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#084.src: Alright... Good luck down there! Find the bot, destroy it, and bring the capacitor back up! Just step on the platform in the middle of the factory when you're ready.
The Breaking Point#084.dst: Certo... Boa sorte lá embaixo! Encontre o robô, destrua-o e traga o capacitor! É só pisar na plataforma no meio da fábrica quando estiver pronto.
The Breaking Point#084.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#086.src: Okay. That's fine, just make it quick! You know we can't waste any time here.
The Breaking Point#086.dst: Ok. Tudo bem, só seja rápido! Você sabe que não podemos perder tempo aqui.
The Breaking Point#086.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#087.src: Retrieve the part from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#087.dst: Recupere a peça na caverna em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#092.src: DIVERTING ALL AVAILABLE UNITS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#092.dst: DESVIANDO TODAS AS UNIDADES PARA DETER O INTRUSO.
The Breaking Point#092.speaker: Mining Robots

The Breaking Point#093.src: THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. REQUESTING AUTHORISATION FOR USE OF LETHAL FORCE AGAINST INTRUDER...
The Breaking Point#093.dst: ÁREA RESTRITA. SOLICITANDO AUTORIZAÇÃO PARA USO DE FORÇA LETAL CONTRA O INTRUSO...
The Breaking Point#093.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#095.src: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#095.dst: ENVIANDO MECHS MINEIROS CONTRA O INTRUSO.
The Breaking Point#095.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#096.src: Return to the hot air balloon at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.
The Breaking Point#096.dst: Volte ao balão de ar quente em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] com o Capacitor Magmaflux.

The Breaking Point#097.src: Good to see you again, {u}. Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
The Breaking Point#097.dst: Bom te ver de novo, {u}. Boa sorte com o Colosso. E Rhay... volte pra casa assim que puder.
The Breaking Point#097.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#099.src: Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
The Breaking Point#099.dst: Leve o Estabilizador Corkian ao General Elix

The Breaking Point#100.src: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
The Breaking Point#100.dst: Bem... foi melhor do que o esperado, na verdade. Ainda não acredito que não me contou que já conhecia o Maxie.
The Breaking Point#100.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#101.src: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
The Breaking Point#101.dst: Nossa. Parece que conseguiram consertar bem a máquina, considerando tudo. Só falta esta peça para ela voltar a funcionar...
The Breaking Point#101.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#102.src: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
The Breaking Point#102.dst: Hunf. Rhay, aí está você. Já que voltou, imagino que tudo correu bem em Corkus?
The Breaking Point#102.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#103.src: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
The Breaking Point#103.dst: Bem o bastante, General! Temos o necessário para consertar o painel de controle. Vamos conseguir religar o estabilizador!
The Breaking Point#103.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#104.src: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
The Breaking Point#104.dst: E então?! O que estão esperando? Terminem os reparos, não podemos perder tempo com esse maldito Colosso pairando sobre nós.
The Breaking Point#104.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#105.src: Yes, sir! Alright. {u}, just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
The Breaking Point#105.dst: Sim, senhor! Certo. {u}, é só encaixar o capacitor bem... ali. Eu garanto que vai funcionar direito.
The Breaking Point#105.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#106.src: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
The Breaking Point#106.dst: Pronto. Agora, vamos religar essa coisa! Walder, fique de olho na estabilidade! E... Rhay. Você tem certeza de que isso vai funcionar?
The Breaking Point#106.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#107.src: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The Breaking Point#107.dst: T-tenho certeza. É nossa última chance. Temos que acreditar que o estabilizador vai aguentar.
The Breaking Point#107.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#108.src: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The Breaking Point#108.dst: Certo, certo... Agora ou nunca... Aguente, estabilizador, aguente!
The Breaking Point#108.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#109.src: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
The Breaking Point#109.dst: ... Ah. Então é... é isso. Acabou. Fracassamos.
The Breaking Point#109.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#110.src: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
The Breaking Point#110.dst: Eu... lamento, Rhay. Eu... esperava que funcionasse. Na verdade... também não tenho... um plano.
The Breaking Point#110.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#111.src: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
The Breaking Point#111.dst: Os Anciões... saberiam... o que fazer... Mas eles se foram... há muito. Nada além de... ruínas restou.
The Breaking Point#111.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#112.src: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and as wise... as the earth itself...
The Breaking Point#112.dst: Os Anciões... Eram... os maiores... dos Doguns. Velhos... como as pedras mais antigas... e sábios... como a própria terra...
The Breaking Point#112.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#113.src: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
The Breaking Point#113.dst: Eram capazes... de magia... além do que qualquer... um de nós alcança. Só eles... acalmavam nosso... Protetor.
The Breaking Point#113.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#114.dst: O que houve com os Anciões?

The Breaking Point#115.src: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
The Breaking Point#115.dst: Foram... selados. Congelados no... gelo mais... profundo. Quando os anões... mataram Garaheth... os Anciões... caíram com ele.
The Breaking Point#115.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#116.src: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
The Breaking Point#116.dst: Tantas atrocidades... A guerra... Meu povo... Mas não é hora... de remoer isso. Há coisas... mais importantes... agora.
The Breaking Point#116.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#117.src: But the war is over. The dwa
The Breaking Point#117.dst: Mas a guerra acabou. Os anõ

The Breaking Point#118.src: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
The Breaking Point#118.dst: Eu... eu não... sabia disso. Meu povo... está livre? Quanto tempo... faz... desde que vi... meu lar?
The Breaking Point#118.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#119.src: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
The Breaking Point#119.dst: Você... Aventureiro. Precisamos... falar com meu povo. Nosso cacique... saberá... como libertar... os Anciões.
The Breaking Point#119.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#120.src: If there's a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, {u}, take the balloon. We'll do what we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
The Breaking Point#120.dst: Se há uma chance... Temos que agarrá-la. Ineos, {u}, peguem o balão. Faremos o que pudermos aqui. Agora, vão! Não há tempo a perder!
The Breaking Point#120.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#121.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#121.dst: Parece que o corpo de Ozoth está tentando impedir que você pegue a Chama Eterna!

The Breaking Point#122.src: Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Breaking Point#122.dst: Encontre Ineos e Rhay no balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Breaking Point#123.src: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
The Breaking Point#123.dst: Nunca... vi as Heights... de cima. Será... que o brilho delas... tem a mesma força... que vista de baixo...
The Breaking Point#123.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#124.src: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
The Breaking Point#124.dst: Espero... que os Anciões... não tenham ido... de vez. Precisamos... da sabedoria deles.
The Breaking Point#124.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#125.src: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
The Breaking Point#125.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#126.src: Travel to {p} with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#126.dst: Viaje até {p} com Ineos pelo balão de ar quente em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#127.src: {u}... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
The Breaking Point#127.dst: {u}... Olá. Que... cena estranha... ver você pousando... em nossa aldeia... numa engenhoca dessas...
The Breaking Point#127.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#128.src: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you to rubble...
The Breaking Point#128.dst: E... aquele é... Ineos? Achamos... que os anões... te reduziram a escombros...
The Breaking Point#128.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#129.src: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
The Breaking Point#129.dst: Eu escapei... É uma longa... história, Korzim. Não temos... tempo. Onde está... seu pai?
The Breaking Point#129.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#130.src: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
The Breaking Point#130.dst: Está... lá embaixo. Estão... libertando os congelados... em New Taloka. Por que... quer falar... com ele?
The Breaking Point#130.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#131.src: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#131.dst: O Protetor... está irado. Precisamos achar... os Anciões. Eles saberão... como acalmá-lo.
The Breaking Point#131.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#132.src: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Breaking Point#132.dst: O... Protetor... Entendo. Vou... levar vocês dois... até ele. Sidio... Raetin... deixo vocês dois... no comando.
The Breaking Point#132.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#133.src: Now, let us... travel. Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#133.dst: Agora... viajemos. Pela chama... e pela pedra...
The Breaking Point#133.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#134.src: Speak to {p}'s King and the Dogun Chieftain at New Taloka at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#134.dst: Fale com o rei de {p} e com o cacique Dogun em New Taloka, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#135.src: We are... here. Taloka was... one of the first to fall... in the war. We have been... working with the dwarves... to restore it.
The Breaking Point#135.dst: Chegamos... aqui. Taloka foi... uma das primeiras a cair... na guerra. Temos... trabalhado com os anões... para restaurá-la.
The Breaking Point#135.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#139.src: Very well. Begin on three. One... Two... Three!
The Breaking Point#139.dst: Muito bem. Comecem no três. Um... Dois... Três!
The Breaking Point#139.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#140.src: Beginning reheating cycle! Stand back from the subject.
The Breaking Point#140.dst: Iniciando ciclo de reaquecimento! Afastem-se do sujeito.
The Breaking Point#140.speaker: Dwarven Technician

The Breaking Point#141.src: ... Where... am... I? How long... has it... been...?
The Breaking Point#141.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#142.src: ...Dwarf... You... you froze me... I will... I will...!
The Breaking Point#142.dst: ...Anão... Você... me congelou... Eu vou... Eu vou...!
The Breaking Point#142.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#143.src: Calm yourself... Delg. Our war... has ended. We are... freed. You have been... freed.
The Breaking Point#143.dst: Acalme-se... Delg. Nossa guerra... terminou. Estamos... livres. Você foi... libertado.
The Breaking Point#143.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#144.src: ... Freedom? Hundreds... of years... of war... And we are... free?
The Breaking Point#144.dst: ... Liberdade? Séculos... de guerra... E estamos... livres?
The Breaking Point#144.speaker: Dogun Delg

The Breaking Point#145.src: Yes. We are free... to roam our home... once more. Edac... Escort Delg... and help him re-adjust... to the heights.
The Breaking Point#145.dst: Sim. Livres... para percorrer nosso lar... de novo. Edac... Leve Delg... e ajude-o a se readaptar... às Heights.
The Breaking Point#145.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#146.src: Ah, {u}! It's good to see you again. We haven't seen you around here since... since the end of it.
The Breaking Point#146.dst: Ah, {u}! Que bom te ver de novo. Não te vemos por aqui desde... desde o fim de tudo.
The Breaking Point#146.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#147.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed bretheren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147.dst: Sim. Temos... trabalhado duro... nestas últimas semanas. Taloka logo... voltará a se erguer. E muitos... dos nossos irmãos selados... voltaram à vida.
The Breaking Point#147.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#148.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#148.dst: Sim. Temos... trabalhado duro... nestas últimas semanas. Taloka logo... voltará a se erguer. E muitos... dos nossos irmãos selados... voltaram à vida.
The Breaking Point#148.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#150.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#150.dst: Você usa o gancho para voltar até o rei num deslumbrante número de trapézio, com piruetas no ar e floreios acrobáticos.

The Breaking Point#151.src: Ah, but we can talk more about that later. Tell me, what brings you here today? Is there something you need from us?
The Breaking Point#151.dst: Ah, mas podemos falar disso depois. Diga, o que te traz aqui hoje? Precisa de algo de nós?
The Breaking Point#151.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#152.src: The situtation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152.dst: A situação... é grave. O Grande Protetor... foi deixado sozinho... por tempo demais. Precisamos... da sabedoria... dos nossos Anciões. Sabe... onde estão selados?
The Breaking Point#152.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#153.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#153.dst: A situação... é grave. O Grande Protetor... foi deixado sozinho... por tempo demais. Precisamos... da sabedoria... dos nossos Anciões. Sabe... onde estão selados?
The Breaking Point#153.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#154.src: The Elders?! Yes, we know where they are sealed. However, retrieving them is no simple task. It would take us years to break past the defenses, and we have countless other doguns to release first.
The Breaking Point#154.dst: Os Anciões?! Sim, sabemos onde estão selados. Mas resgatá-los não é tarefa simples. Levaríamos anos para romper as defesas, e temos incontáveis outros Doguns para libertar antes.
The Breaking Point#154.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#156.src: Ineos... I want our Elders free... as much as you do. But our Protector... has stood firm... for hundreds of years. It can stand... for another-
The Breaking Point#156.dst: Ineos... quero nossos Anciões livres... tanto quanto você. Mas nosso Protetor... se mantém firme... há centenas de anos. Pode aguentar... mais um-
The Breaking Point#156.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#157.src: No... Has it truly... fallen this far..?
The Breaking Point#157.dst: Não... Será que... chegou a esse ponto..?
The Breaking Point#157.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#158.src: ... That was your Protector? How powerful is it, if it can reach this far?
The Breaking Point#158.dst: ... Aquilo era seu Protetor? Quão forte ele é, se chega tão longe?
The Breaking Point#158.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#159.src: If the Protector... could shake even the Heights... It could destroy... half of this province.
The Breaking Point#159.dst: Se o Protetor... pode sacudir até as Heights... Poderia destruir... metade desta província.
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#160.src: Draani... the Elders must be freed. They alone... would know how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#160.dst: Draani... os Anciões precisam ser libertados. Só eles... saberiam acalmá-lo.
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#161.src: Yes... I understand. Very well. {u}, I will take you to the Elders' vault. I hold the keys to open the way forward. Paku, gather your people. See if anyone has alternative solutions.
The Breaking Point#161.dst: Sim... entendo. Muito bem. {u}, vou te levar ao cofre dos Anciões. Tenho as chaves que abrem o caminho. Paku, reúna seu povo. Veja se alguém tem soluções alternativas.
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#162.src: We will... search for one. I cannot... promise that one exists.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: Vamos... procurar uma. Não posso... prometer que exista.
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#163.src: {u}, let us go. It sounds as if we have very little time to waste.
The Breaking Point#163.dst: {u}, vamos. Parece que temos muito pouco tempo a perder.
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: I will make preparations, and meet you at the Vault of Ice.
The Breaking Point#164.dst: Vou fazer os preparativos e te encontro no Cofre de Gelo.
The Breaking Point#164.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#165.src: Enter the Dogun Vault within the lower Freezing Heights at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#165.dst: Entre no Cofre Dogun nas Freezing Heights inferiores em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#166.src: ... Ahem. This is the entrance, then. One of our most closely guarded secrets... I was hoping not to have to confront this reminder for a while yet...
The Breaking Point#166.dst: ... Aham. Esta é a entrada, então. Um dos nossos segredos mais bem guardados... Eu esperava não ter que encarar esta lembrança tão cedo...
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: But it seems we don't have much choice now. I have the keys, let's go inside.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: Mas parece que não temos muita escolha agora. Tenho as chaves, vamos entrar.
The Breaking Point#167.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#168.src: Unlock the Dogun Vault to find the Elders.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: Destranque o Cofre Dogun para encontrar os Anciões.

The Breaking Point#169.src: Rather cold in here, isn't it? A vault carved into a drake's True Ice... I suppose my ancestors hoped to seal these doguns here forever. I'll be glad to disappoint them.
The Breaking Point#169.dst: Bem frio aqui, não? Um cofre esculpido no True Ice de um drake... Meus ancestrais queriam selar esses Doguns aqui para sempre. Será um prazer decepcioná-los.
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: Quickly, then, let us proceed to the primary door. I pray the Elders' will be responsive to our situation with the Colossus.
The Breaking Point#170.dst: Rápido, então, vamos até a porta principal. Espero que os Anciões nos ouçam sobre a situação do Colosso.
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: In any case... Let me see if I can open this second gate. It should be as simple as...
The Breaking Point#171.dst: Enfim... Vejamos se consigo abrir este segundo portão. Deve ser tão simples quanto...
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I have never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#172.dst: Hm. Isso... não funcionou. Esta magia é antiga, e nunca tirei tempo para aprendê-la direito... Certo. Temos alternativas.
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other side of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: Se a memória não me falha, deve haver um acionamento manual do outro lado deste abismo.
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: Hm. Isso... não funcionou. Esta magia é antiga, e nunca tirei tempo para aprendê-la direito... Certo. Temos alternativas.
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#175.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#175.dst: Se a memória não me falha, deve haver um acionamento manual na outra ponta deste abismo.
The Breaking Point#175.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: The issue is that treacherous pool of lava on the way... and I don't think my knees are up to the task of jumping over it all.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: O problema é aquela traiçoeira poça de lava no caminho... e acho que meus joelhos não aguentam pular tudo aquilo.
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: I would never usually do this, but these are desperate times. Here, take my Trusty Grappling Hook. It should help you get over to the switch.
The Breaking Point#178.dst: Eu nunca faria isso, mas os tempos são de desespero. Tome, meu fiel Grappling Hook. Deve ajudar você a chegar ao interruptor.
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#179.dst: Mas tem limites. Só se prende àquelas rochas azuis nas paredes - e vou pegá-lo de volta assim que você terminar, muito obrigado!
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#180.dst: Ei, {u}! Parece que está indo bem, mas se travar, lembre que dá para pular e usar o gancho no ar, isso ajuda nas plataformas mais difíceis!
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#181.dst: Parece que isso destravou, {u}! Volte para cá e eu abro a porta.
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#182.dst: Aí está! Excelente. Usou o gancho como um verdadeiro especialista! Ah, me lembra da vez que-...
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: ...Aham. Excelente trabalho, de fato. Com o acionamento ativado, devo conseguir fazer o resto para abrir o portão.
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: Mas antes, quero meu gancho de volta! Imagine o que aconteceria se você o usasse à vontade por aí.
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: E assim... acho que fomos o mais longe possível.
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: Isto é True Ice, {u}. Marca esta parte das Heights há séculos, desde que um dragão de gelo o criou na conquista dos meus ancestrais.
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#187.src: When were the elders first i

The Breaking Point#188.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#188.dst: Não há como derretê-lo nem queimá-lo. Por isso este lugar foi escolhido para a tumba deles. Receio que não possamos fazer mais nada.
The Breaking Point#188.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#190.dst: Quando caíram os últimos povoados Dogun e Garaheth foi morto pela primeira vez, meus ancestrais devem tê-los selado no fundo do gelo.
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: Os... atos dos anões após vencer a guerra estão bem documentados. Não me surpreenderia se nossos registros chamassem esta prisão de grande vitória.
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#193.dst: Os anões, é claro. Quem mais?
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army who ordered the Elders' imprisonments
The Breaking Point#194.dst: Creio que foi o General Algard, do exército anão, quem mandou prender os Anciões
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... now we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#195.dst: Foi aclamado como herói, claro. Agora... agora devemos colher as consequências dessa decisão.
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: True Ice is a material which cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: True Ice é um material que não pode ser derretido nem queimado de forma alguma. Nem a magia Dogun conseguiu arranhá-lo.
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: ... I imagine this is why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#197.dst: ... Imagino que por isso este lugar foi escolhido para prender os anciões. Uma prisão da qual jamais poderiam escapar.
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#198.dst: Sabe-se que ele se forma naturalmente em condições extremas... Mas este gelo não tem nada de natural.
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: Foi formado pelo sopro de um Ice Drake no meio da guerra- e, bem, como você vê, continua aqui desde então.
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#200.dst: Mais um resquício dos nossos erros passados, suponho...
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: Aham. Enfim- como eu disse, é impossível atravessar o True Ice, mesmo com as chamas mais ardentes.
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: If an Ice Drake formed this
The Breaking Point#202.dst: Se um Ice Drake formou isto

The Breaking Point#203.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#203.dst: Eu... suponho que o sopro de um dragão poderia derretê-lo. A lógica faz sentido.
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#204.dst: Mas sabemos pouco sobre como eram os dragões. Com a extinção, essa informação ficou... inútil. E assim se perdeu.
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: Se alguém sabe mais sobre dragões, são os Doguns.
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#206.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#206.dst: Mas nada disso importa. Afinal, os dragões se foram. Continuamos sem opções.
The Breaking Point#206.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#207.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too big a threat.
The Breaking Point#207.dst: Ora, foram extintos. Com o crescimento das civilizações de Gavel, a fúria e o porte de um dragão eram ameaça demais.
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#208.dst: Alguns foram caçados. Outros morreram de fome. Ovos eram tirados dos ninhos e esmagados nas rochas para os pássaros.
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#209.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flame to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: Agora só restam dragõezinhos - ecos de seus grandiosos ancestrais, com fogo mal suficiente para chamuscar sua armadura.
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#210.src: Not all of the dragons are g

The Breaking Point#212.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#212.dst: Um dragão vivo... Você fez muita coisa, hein? Parou uma guerra, mudou um dragão de lugar.
The Breaking Point#212.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#213.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#213.dst: Bem... se há um dragão vivo em {p}... Então ainda há esperança! {u}, precisamos pedir ajuda a ele.
The Breaking Point#213.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#214.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: Vamos voltar aos outros. Pedi que esperassem fora de {p}... talvez confirmem que o sopro de um dragão resolveria.
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#215.src: Indeed. The fire dragons sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#215.dst: De fato. Os dragões de fogo ficaram do lado deles na guerra. Você já deve ter visto o esqueleto logo fora das Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#216.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#216.dst: Sim, bem... os anões precisavam de algo contra o poder de um dragão de fogo em batalha, então recorreram a escravizar dragões e drakes de outros elementos.
The Breaking Point#216.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#217.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: Como o Ice Drake que criou este cofre e prendeu os Anciões no mais puro dos gelos.
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#218.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#218.dst: ... Bem, havia um ótimo romance sobre uma dessas criaturas do Shiar, que precisava viajar até as Heights com um anel que herdou-
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#219.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#219.dst: Mas confesso que essas perguntas parecem quase irrelevantes. Temos um problema mais urgente, {u}.
The Breaking Point#219.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#220.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#220.dst: Este gelo é mais duro que obsidiana. Os cristais que formam o material são unidos por magia antiga.
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#221.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#221.dst: Quebrá-lo com essas ferramentas não é opção. Talvez haja uma arma capaz disso no fundo do nosso arsenal- afinal, este cofre foi esculpido de algum jeito...
The Breaking Point#221.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#222.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#222.dst: Mas, dadas as circunstâncias, acho que não temos tempo de procurá-la. Mesmo começando agora, nosso arsenal é enorme. Levaria semanas para achar o que precisamos.
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: King Draani
