The Breaking Point#223.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#223.dst: A lava das Heights não passa de rocha derretida. Só um resquício da formação destas cavernas.
The Breaking Point#223.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#224.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: Nem de longe é quente o bastante para derreter True Ice. Senão, as Freezing Heights já teriam sumido.
The Breaking Point#224.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#225.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#225.dst: Hum... é... o verde é bonito, acho? Embora talvez não seja muito anão...
The Breaking Point#225.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#226.dst: Vermelho, então. Ou laranja! ...Mas meus lençóis têm um tom lindo de azul-marinho...
The Breaking Point#226.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#227.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#227.dst: Café da manhã... comi uns ovos, acho. Mas eu nem sabia que seria o último, não é..?
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#228.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: Hm... Se soubesse, talvez escolhesse outra coisa. Talvez eu tivesse-... deixa pra lá.
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#229.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#229.dst: Reagrupe-se fora de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para descobrir como libertar os Anciões.

The Breaking Point#230.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#230.dst: ... então esta é a situação em que nos encontramos. Paku, o que acha? Um plano assim funcionaria?
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#231.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#231.dst: ... então essa é a situação em que estamos. Paku, o que acha? Um plano assim funcionaria?
The Breaking Point#231.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#232.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#232.dst: Hm... Talvez tenha razão... Draani. A magia... do sopro de um dragão... era muito potente. E pensar... que a grande Ozoth sobreviveu... tantos anos...
The Breaking Point#232.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#233.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: Se Ozoth vive... devemos buscar sua ajuda. Se os Doguns pedirem... ajuda a ela, ela... a dará.
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: Bem, é um plano tão bom quanto outro. {u}, você vai buscar o conselho dessa dragoa, junto com... Ineos, não é? Boa sorte.
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#235.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Content Book.
The Breaking Point#235.dst: Pegue... o túnel comercial... {u}. Vou colocar as coordenadas... no seu livro de conteúdo.
The Breaking Point#235.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#236.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: Use o túnel comercial de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para viajar até {p}.

The Breaking Point#237.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to speak with her.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: Viaje até {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para tentar falar com ela.

The Breaking Point#238.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#238.dst: Ah... é bom... ver você. Devemos... seguir até Ozoth... com toda a pressa.
The Breaking Point#238.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#239.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: Ozoth, a Dragoa... Acendedora Sem Fim... viemos... pedir sua ajuda.
The Breaking Point#239.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#240.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#240.dst: Buscamos... um modo... de derreter o mais puro... dos gelos. O destino... de Gavel... está em jogo.
The Breaking Point#240.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#241.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: Doguns... e dragões... nossos destinos se entrelaçam... há séculos. Nós a chamamos... Acendedora Sem Fim... para salvar a província.
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#243.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#243.dst: A Acendedora Sem Fim... aceita abrir mão... da dela. Você deve... retirá-la... do estômago dela.
The Breaking Point#243.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#244.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#244.dst: Aconselho você... a não pensar... demais nisso. Quando... estiver pronto... entre na boca de Ozoth e pegue... a chama.
The Breaking Point#244.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#245.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#245.dst: Desça até o ventre de Ozoth para obter uma Chama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#246.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#246.dst: Viaje até {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] com uma Chama Eterna.

The Breaking Point#247.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#247.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#248.dst: {u}! Você já pegou... a Chama Eterna?
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#249.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#249.dst: Excelente. Acendedora Sem Fim... obrigado... pelo sacrifício. Garantirei... que sua chama... seja devolvida a você.
The Breaking Point#249.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#250.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: Ozoth se desculpa... se estava quente... lá dentro.
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#251.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: Agora, {u}... nunca fui o melhor... na magia antiga... mas espero ter talento... para nos levar de volta pelo atalho...
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#252.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#252.dst: Vocês voltaram! Há notícias de {p}? A dragoa ofereceu ajuda?
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#253.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: Ofereceu... Ozoth fez um grande sacrifício... pela província... mas temos uma Chama Eterna... para derreter o gelo.
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#254.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: Sim... Ozoth fez um grande sacrifício... por esta província... e temos a Chama Eterna... para derreter o gelo.
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#255.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#255.dst: Muito bem... vocês dois. Garantirei... que os Doguns agradeçam a ela... como se deve. Os anões fariam bem... em fazer o mesmo.
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#256.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#256.dst: Sim, sim, mas não há tempo para nos preocupar com isso. Rápido, vamos voltar ao-
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#257.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#257.dst: Cuidado... com os Anciões... Draani. Dificilmente reagirão bem... após a prisão. É vital... que você explique a situação... a eles.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#258.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#258.dst: Eu iria com vocês... dois... mas o gelo é inóspito... para minha espécie. Desejo a vocês dois... toda a sorte.
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#259.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#259.dst: ...certo. Sim. Bem, não há como evitar. Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#259.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#260.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260.dst: ... certo. Sim. Bem, não há como evitar. Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os Anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#261.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: Volte ao Cofre Dogun em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para libertar os Anciões Dogun.

The Breaking Point#262.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#262.dst: Bem, o que estamos esperando! Vamos libertar esses anciões, que tal?
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#263.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.dst: Basta levar a Chama Eterna a cada cela e derreter aquele True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#264.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#264.dst: Excelente! Conseguimos! Agora só precisamos explicar a situação-...
The Breaking Point#264.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#266.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#266.dst: ...Ah. Acho que não... pensei bem nisso. Hã. Anciões, devo me descul-
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#267.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: Anão... Hm. Os crimes... de seus ancestrais... serão pagos.
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: Porém. Nós... ouvimos você falar. Soubemos... do estado do Protetor.
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: Acertaremos... sua dívida... depois. Esta situação... é mais... urgente. O Protetor... precisa ser acalmado.
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#270.dst: ...Sim. Você. Humano. Aquilo era... fogo de dragão... né?
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#271.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#271.dst: Então deixe-me... tomá-lo emprestado. Sua força... vai nos ajudar... a restaurar a nossa. Agora... Quem tem... o título de cacique?
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#272.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: A-ah! Paku agora é o cacique Dogun. Ele deve estar em... Em Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#273.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#273.dst: Muito bem... Viajaremos... através da chama... e através da pedra...
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#274.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#274.dst: ...Os Anciões... depois de tanto tempo... vê-los de novo... em pessoa...
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#275.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#275.dst: Saudações, Paku. Temos muito... a discutir. Mas antes... devemos ir... até o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#276.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#276.dst: Venham... Ineos e Paku. Há... muito pouco tempo... a perder.
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: Now, let us travel... Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: Agora, vamos... Através da chama... e através da pedra...
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: Korzim... meu filho... venha. Os Anciões precisam ver... o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#279.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: Iscor... Astal... Desint... faz... tempo demais. Eu irei.
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#280.src: earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form!
The Breaking Point#280.dst: terra e chama... fogo e pedra... levem-nos através de sua forma!
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#282.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#282.dst: Não há tempo! Sinto o maldito chão rachando sob meus pés, temos que partir para a última opção. Temos magos de demolição de prontidão há dias, nossa única escolha é-
The Breaking Point#282.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#283.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#283.dst: Rhay. Elix. Meus Anciões... estão livres. Estão aqui... para ajudar... o Protetor.
The Breaking Point#283.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#284.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#284.dst: Venham... bravos. Vocês verão... que seu esforço para salvar esta Província... não foi em vão.
The Breaking Point#284.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#285.src: flames of the earth... take us to the great protector... to make our plea!
The Breaking Point#285.dst: chamas da terra... levem-nos ao grande protetor... para nosso apelo!
The Breaking Point#285.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#286.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.
The Breaking Point#286.dst: Viaje até o Colosso do Cânion em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para tentar acalmá-lo.

The Breaking Point#288.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#288.dst: Hmpf. Anões tolos... Eis no que deu...sua guerra inútil... Vocês têm sorte...de nos libertar agora...
The Breaking Point#288.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#289.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#289.dst: Desint... Iscor... Prepararei... o ritual. Defendam-me... enquanto isso.
The Breaking Point#289.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#290.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#290.dst: Humano. Vamos afastar o Protetor... do abismo. É tudo o que podemos fazer agora. Todo o poder... que conseguirmos.
The Breaking Point#290.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#291.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#291.dst: Você deve entrar... nestas terras sagradas. Lute até o fim... Faça-o... cair em si.
The Breaking Point#291.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#292.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#292.dst: Aventureiro... Contamos...com você. Tentaremos...apoiar você como pudermos.
The Breaking Point#292.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#293.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#293.dst: Faremos o possível aqui fora! Já tenho algumas ideias...
The Breaking Point#293.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#294.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#294.dst: Rhay, não é hora. Humano. Estamos com você. Você consegue.
The Breaking Point#294.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#295.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#295.dst: Você já enfrentou...situações piores...não é? E vai enfrentá-las...de novo.
The Breaking Point#295.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#296.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your positions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#296.dst: Está feito. Desint... Iscor... Às suas posições. Devemos... contê-lo.
The Breaking Point#296.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#297.src: great protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home.
The Breaking Point#297.dst: grande protetor, senhor da pedra, ouça nosso chamado ardente. sua fúria o cega, sua ira queima e distorce nosso lar.
The Breaking Point#297.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#298.src: we, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... we will hold you back. we will keep this land intact!
The Breaking Point#298.dst: nós, os doguns, que agora guardamos a última chama de um deus caído... vamos contê-lo. manteremos esta terra intacta!
The Breaking Point#298.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#299.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#299.dst: Vamos... segurá-lo daqui... humano. Agora... vá! Não poderemos... contê-lo... por muito tempo...
The Breaking Point#299.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#300.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#300.dst: Este cristal...permite que você use...nossa chama. Use-o...para romper...as defesas dele.
The Breaking Point#300.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#301.src: {u}... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#301.dst: {u}... Antes de ir. Ofereço a você... estas poderosas relíquias. Meu povo... as guarda há... mais tempo do que vivi. Talvez... ajudem em sua missão.
The Breaking Point#301.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#302.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#302.dst: Não posso dar algo tão único quanto o que Paku ofereceu, mas posso emprestar uma quantia do nosso tesouro. Use como precisar, desde que acalme aquela coisa. Boa sorte.
The Breaking Point#302.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#304.src: Have you flown to Corkus with Rhay yet? Quick, get to the Hot Air Balloon in the south!
The Breaking Point#304.dst: Já voou para Corkus com Rhay? Rápido, vá até o balão de ar quente no sul!
The Breaking Point#304.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#305.src: Just step on the iron platform and we'll send you down!
The Breaking Point#305.dst: É só subir na plataforma de ferro que a gente te desce!
The Breaking Point#305.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#306.src: [!] Central bore tunnel opening! Exercise caution around the deep drop.
The Breaking Point#306.dst: [!] Abrindo o túnel de perfuração central! Cuidado com a queda funda.

The Breaking Point#307.src: You got the part! Head back to the balloon and I'll meet you there.
The Breaking Point#307.dst: Você pegou a peça! Volte ao balão que encontro você lá.
The Breaking Point#307.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#308.src: Have you flown to the Heights with Ineos yet? Quick, get to the Hot Air Balloon in the south!
The Breaking Point#308.dst: Já voou para as Heights com Ineos? Rápido, vá até o balão de ar quente no sul!
The Breaking Point#308.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#309.src: I... will meet you... by the airship. I am... eager... to see my home... again.
The Breaking Point#309.dst: Encontro você... junto à aeronave. Quero muito... ver meu lar... de novo.
The Breaking Point#309.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#310.src: Well... That's it, then! I'll see you two off, and then... Then I'll figure out how to clean up here.
The Breaking Point#310.dst: Bem... Então é isso! Vou me despedir de vocês dois e depois... Depois vejo como limpar tudo isto.
The Breaking Point#310.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#311.src: I... I really did hope we could do it. I thought that our magic could save the day, that it could stop this thing!
The Breaking Point#311.dst: Eu... eu realmente esperava que conseguíssemos. Achei que nossa magia salvaria o dia, que pararia essa coisa!
The Breaking Point#311.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#312.src: ... Nothing to do about it now, of course! Good luck out there. We're counting on you two now. Go find those Elders!
The Breaking Point#312.dst: ... Não há mais o que fazer, claro! Boa sorte lá fora. Agora contamos com vocês dois. Vão encontrar aqueles Anciões!
The Breaking Point#312.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#313.src: It has been... many years... since I fled the Heights. I am... grateful to... the Corkians... for taking me in.
The Breaking Point#313.dst: Faz... muitos anos... que fugi das Heights. Sou... grato... aos Corkians... por me acolherem.
The Breaking Point#313.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#314.src: But... The war... has ended. I can finally... go home...
The Breaking Point#314.dst: E... A guerra... acabou. Enfim posso... ir para casa...
The Breaking Point#314.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#315.src: ... {p} first... though. We still... have work to do...
The Breaking Point#315.dst: ... Mas antes... {p}. Ainda temos... o que fazer...
The Breaking Point#315.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#316.src: What are you waiting for? Use my hook to get to the override switch at the end of this cave!
The Breaking Point#316.dst: O que está esperando? Use meu gancho para chegar ao interruptor manual no fim desta caverna!
The Breaking Point#316.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#317.src: Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#317.dst: Venha, {u}. Precisamos descongelar os Anciões e fazê-los nos ouvir. Traga a chama, encontro você no Cofre.
The Breaking Point#317.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#318.src: Well? What are you waiting for- come on, let's get going to Corkus!
The Breaking Point#318.dst: E então? O que está esperando- vamos, rumo a Corkus!
The Breaking Point#318.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#319.src: Well, what are you waiting for?! Put the part in the machine, quick!
The Breaking Point#319.dst: E então, o que está esperando?! Coloque a peça na máquina, rápido!
The Breaking Point#319.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#320.src: Good luck in the heights, {u}. I'll... see if there's anything I can salvage from the machine, but it's not looking good. Ineos' Elders might be our only hope...
The Breaking Point#320.dst: Boa sorte nas Heights, {u}. Vou... ver se dá para salvar algo da máquina, mas não parece bom. Os Anciões de Ineos podem ser nossa única esperança...
The Breaking Point#320.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#321.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I have put the coordinates... in your Content Book.
The Breaking Point#321.dst: Pegue... o túnel comercial... {u}. Coloquei as coordenadas... no seu livro de conteúdo.
The Breaking Point#321.speaker: Ineos

The Canary Calls#001.src: Find out what's happening at the {p} coal mine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#001.dst: Descubra o que está acontecendo na mina de carvão de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#002.src: Phew... Everyone make it out alright? That was...one hell of a sprint. I'm absolutely knackered.
The Canary Calls#002.dst: Ufa... Todos saíram bem? Que... correria dos diabos. Tô completamente moído.
The Canary Calls#002.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#003.src: I'm not sure, mate. I left a bunch of my stuff down there. Who knows if I'll get it back.
The Canary Calls#003.dst: Sei lá, parceiro. Deixei um monte de coisa lá embaixo. Vai saber se recupero.
The Canary Calls#003.speaker: Micho

The Canary Calls#004.src: Forget about that, what are we gonna tell the chief? That chopsy old fool is gonna kill us if he sees us not working.
The Canary Calls#004.dst: Esquece isso, o que vamos dizer ao capataz? Aquele velho linguarudo mata a gente se nos vir parados.
The Canary Calls#004.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#005.src: Oi, you! Listen, there was some kind of explosion down in the mines. We're not sure what it was or where it came from, but it surely didn't sound good.
The Canary Calls#005.dst: Ei, você! Escuta, houve uma espécie de explosão lá embaixo na mina. Não sabemos o que foi nem de onde veio, mas com certeza não soou nada bem.
The Canary Calls#005.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#006.src: The four of us were the only blokes down in the mines, so everyone should be out safely. But I reckon we can't go back if this issue isn't resolved.
The Canary Calls#006.dst: Só nós quatro estávamos lá embaixo, então todos devem ter saído a salvo. Mas acho que não dá para voltar até isso ser resolvido.
The Canary Calls#006.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#007.src: You must go to the chief and tell him about the situation. Head down this mineshaft and turn left, and he should be there.
The Canary Calls#007.dst: Você precisa ir até o capataz e contar a situação. Desça por esta galeria e vire à esquerda, ele deve estar lá.
The Canary Calls#007.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#008.src: Just, uh... Make sure not to mention us by name. Now, if you'll excuse us, we'll...be on our way.
The Canary Calls#008.dst: Só, hã... Não diga nossos nomes. Agora, se nos der licença, nós... vamos indo.
The Canary Calls#008.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#009.src: Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#009.dst: Vire à esquerda na entrada da mina e fale com o capataz em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#010.src: That's right, keep it moving! The whole of {p} is going to run out of coal at this pace!
The Canary Calls#010.dst: Isso mesmo, sem parar! Nesse ritmo, {p} inteira vai ficar sem carvão!
The Canary Calls#010.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#011.src: Eh? What do you want? Only registered miners are allowed beyond this point. Speak up or get off the premises.
The Canary Calls#011.dst: Hein? O que você quer? Só mineiros registrados passam daqui. Fale logo ou saia da propriedade.
The Canary Calls#011.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#012.src: ...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
The Canary Calls#012.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#013.src: EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
The Canary Calls#013.dst: PAUSA DE EMERGÊNCIA, SEUS GERBILS! TODO MUNDO ME ENCONTRA NA ENTRADA! JÁ!!!
The Canary Calls#013.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#014.src: Alright, you lot better listen bloody carefully. An explosion has been reported in the mines. You all know what that means, yes?
The Canary Calls#014.dst: Muito bem, é melhor vocês ouvirem com toda a atenção. Relataram uma explosão na mina. Todos sabem o que isso significa, certo?
The Canary Calls#014.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#019.src: No, you bunch of ingrates! One of you needs to take the ol' canary down to the mines and see whatever the hell's going on.
The Canary Calls#019.dst: Não, seus ingratos! Um de vocês tem que levar a velha canária até a mina e ver que diabos está acontecendo.
The Canary Calls#019.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#020.src: Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-
The Canary Calls#020.dst: Então, qual de vocês estaria disposto a-
The Canary Calls#020.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#022.src: Right then. I guess that leaves you, young lad. What do you say? Want a job?
The Canary Calls#022.dst: Muito bem. Acho que sobrou você, rapaz. Que me diz? Quer um emprego?
The Canary Calls#022.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#023.src: You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
The Canary Calls#023.dst: Tem certeza? Pago bem, e não será perigoso. E mesmo que seja, você está com toda essa armadura!
The Canary Calls#023.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#025.src: That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#025.dst: Esse é o espírito! Venha, vou te apresentar à nossa mascotinha emplumada.
The Canary Calls#025.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#026.src: You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
The Canary Calls#026.dst: Você vai ganhar uma maldita montanha de esmeraldas, diabos! É uma chance única na vida! Quer ou não quer?
The Canary Calls#026.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#027.src: Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
The Canary Calls#027.dst: Ótimo. Agora, ande logo e me siga.
The Canary Calls#027.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#029.src: You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
The Canary Calls#029.dst: Quer saber? Isso é ridículo. {p} inteira está em perigo e você fica de brincadeira COMIGO?! Sei que você consegue. Me siga. Já.
The Canary Calls#029.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#030.src: Scared speechless, eh? Don't worry, it'll be an easy job. Come on, follow me to the canary's cage.
The Canary Calls#030.dst: Mudo de medo, é? Relaxa, vai ser um trabalho fácil. Vamos, me siga até a gaiola da canária.
The Canary Calls#030.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#031.src: Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
The Canary Calls#031.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#032.src: You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion, we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
The Canary Calls#032.dst: Sabe, sempre que temos notícia de uma explosão, levamos nossa canária para verificar. Elas detectam gases bem antes de nós.
The Canary Calls#032.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#033.src: Let me just get the key and-
The Canary Calls#033.dst: Só vou pegar a chave e-
The Canary Calls#033.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#034.src: WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOU LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
The Canary Calls#034.dst: ESPERA, O QUÊ? CADÊ A MALDITA CHAVE? QUAL DE VOCÊS FOI O RESPONSÁVEL?! JURO QUE EU VOU...
The Canary Calls#034.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#036.src: ...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
The Canary Calls#036.dst: ...Escuta, rapaz. Pegue este palito que andei mastigando. Preciso que você abra o cadeado da gaiola. Está meio molhado, mas deve servir. Entendeu? Ótimo, agora rápido!
The Canary Calls#036.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#037.dst: Destranque a gaiola da canária em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Canary Calls#038.src: Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
The Canary Calls#038.dst: Está indo bem, rapaz. Quase lá...
The Canary Calls#038.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#039.src: Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
The Canary Calls#039.dst: A passarinha está ficando agitada! Continue assim.
The Canary Calls#039.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#040.src: Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
The Canary Calls#040.dst: Muito bem, rapaz! Hora de começar o-
The Canary Calls#040.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#041.src: OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at?!
The Canary Calls#041.dst: AI! Diabos! Que garras afiadas dos infernos! Que brincadeira é essa?!
The Canary Calls#041.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#042.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. {u} will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#042.dst: Calma, Ryan. Não vamos perdê-lo. Estamos juntos nessa. {u} vai cuidar disso.
The Canary Calls#042.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

similar.text: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.

The Canary Calls#043.src: Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
The Canary Calls#043.dst: Acho que ela gosta de você, rapaz. De mim não, pelo visto.
The Canary Calls#043.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#044.src: I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
The Canary Calls#044.dst: Eu ia alimentá-la, mas acho que você pode fazer as honras. Ou não, já que ela anda bem encrenqueira...
The Canary Calls#044.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#045.src: Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
The Canary Calls#045.dst: Enfim, faça como quiser. Espero você no elevador da galeria. Ande logo, não me faça esperar!
The Canary Calls#045.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#046.src: Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#046.dst: Vá até o elevador da mina em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#047.src: Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
The Canary Calls#047.dst: Muito bem, rapaz! Imagino que queira saber mais sobre esse trabalho.
The Canary Calls#047.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#048.src: As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
The Canary Calls#048.dst: Como eu disse, quando ocorrem explosões desconhecidas na mina, geralmente é sinal de que algo ruim aconteceu.
The Canary Calls#048.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#049.src: Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
The Canary Calls#049.dst: Na maioria das vezes, surge um gás terrivelmente pútrido. É aí que entra nossa canária. Assim que ela confirma o gás, decidimos se fechamos a mina por um tempo.
The Canary Calls#049.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#050.src: I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
The Canary Calls#050.dst: Imagino que conheceu Daffyd e o grupo dele, certo? Ainda bem que eram os únicos lá embaixo.
The Canary Calls#050.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#051.src: ...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
The Canary Calls#051.dst: ...Espera, onde diabos eles estão? Eu não mandei que...
The Canary Calls#051.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#052.src: Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether that gas is still there, if at all.
The Canary Calls#052.dst: Ah, não importa. Rapaz, o ponto é: quero que verifique se o gás ainda está lá, se é que está.
The Canary Calls#052.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#053.src: We'll use the elevator behind me to get down into the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
The Canary Calls#053.dst: Vamos usar o elevador atrás de mim para descer até a mina. Só deixe eu puxar esta alavanca para ativá-lo...
The Canary Calls#053.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#054.src: ...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
The Canary Calls#054.dst: ...POR QUE ESSA MALDITA GERINGONÇA NÃO ANDA??! ANDA, ANDA, DIABOS!!
The Canary Calls#054.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#055.src: Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh...a last resort, so to speak.
The Canary Calls#055.dst: Deve ter sido o Daffyd e os outros... Tudo bem, rapaz. Tenho, hã... um último recurso, digamos.
The Canary Calls#055.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#057.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The {u}'.
The Canary Calls#057.dst: Gostou da festa dançante? Os passos foram tão horríveis que eu poderia batizá-los de 'O {u}'.
The Canary Calls#057.speaker: Canary

similar.text: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.

The Canary Calls#058.src: You'll need to ride a minecart down into the mines. Thing is, we haven't used them to transport people in...years.
The Canary Calls#058.dst: Você vai ter que descer à mina num carrinho. O problema é que não os usamos para levar gente há... anos.
The Canary Calls#058.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#059.src: Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
The Canary Calls#059.dst: Por quê? Hã, bem... Veja você.
The Canary Calls#059.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#060.src: Our transporter minecarts are manual. Miners around here prefer automatic.
The Canary Calls#060.dst: Nossos carrinhos são manuais. Os mineiros daqui preferem automáticos.
The Canary Calls#060.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#061.src: For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
The Canary Calls#061.dst: Para você, controlar não deve ser problema. Há instruções presas no câmbio.
The Canary Calls#061.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#062.src: Now then, go into the mineshaft, following the rails behind me. You'll be able to summon a minecart there.
The Canary Calls#062.dst: Agora, entre na galeria seguindo os trilhos atrás de mim. Lá você poderá chamar um carrinho.
The Canary Calls#062.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#063.src: Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#063.dst: Use os trilhos para chegar ao vazamento de gás.

The Canary Calls#064.src: Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
The Canary Calls#064.dst: Siga os trilhos e encontre um jeito de escapar da mina

The Canary Calls#065.src: Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
The Canary Calls#065.dst: Avance mais pela mina para encontrar uma saída.

The Canary Calls#068.src: I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
The Canary Calls#068.dst: Sou apenas fruto da sua imaginação. Para você, não sou real.
The Canary Calls#068.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#069.src: The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
The Canary Calls#069.dst: A força misteriosa que me trouxe a morte... Ela me mudou.
The Canary Calls#069.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#070.src: So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
The Canary Calls#070.dst: Ela também vai mudar você. Farei isso acontecer. Só por você.
The Canary Calls#070.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#071.src: No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
The Canary Calls#071.dst: Não agradeça. É o mínimo que posso fazer.
The Canary Calls#071.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#072.src: Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
The Canary Calls#072.dst: Momentos assim são preciosos. Saboreie comigo. Gostaria de morrer comigo?
The Canary Calls#072.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#073.src: No. I won't go that easily.

The Canary Calls#074.src: I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
The Canary Calls#074.dst: Entendo. Então quer tornar isto inesquecível. Agradeço a consideração.
The Canary Calls#074.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#077.src: I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
The Canary Calls#077.dst: Esperava que ficássemos mais um pouco. Se é sua escolha, que assim seja.
The Canary Calls#077.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#078.src: See you on the other side.
The Canary Calls#078.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#079.src: I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
The Canary Calls#079.dst: Será um prazer. Sente-se e relaxe.
The Canary Calls#079.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#081.src: Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
The Canary Calls#081.dst: O meu podia ter sido melhor. Presa numa gaiola o dia todo e, de repente, ver minha morte diante de um humano incompetente.
The Canary Calls#081.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#082.src: You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
The Canary Calls#082.dst: Nem conseguiu me salvar. Que patético.
The Canary Calls#082.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#083.src: So, anyway, do you come here often?
The Canary Calls#083.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#084.src: Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
The Canary Calls#084.dst: Ah, espera. É sua primeira vez. E também a última. Que poético. Quer virar poeta?
The Canary Calls#084.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#085.src: I know a good poem. Want to hear it?
The Canary Calls#085.dst: Conheço um bom poema. Quer ouvir?
The Canary Calls#085.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#087.dst: tem pontos de alma no máximo,
The Canary Calls#087.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#093.src: You will lose a lot of things,
The Canary Calls#093.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#099.dst: é bom em tudo que faz,
The Canary Calls#099.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#103.dst: não sei o que faz aqui.
The Canary Calls#103.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#108.src: The most average Joe I've seen,
The Canary Calls#108.dst: o mais comum que já vi,
The Canary Calls#108.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#110.src: How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
The Canary Calls#110.dst: Que tal? Foi lindo, não foi?
The Canary Calls#110.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#111.src: Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
The Canary Calls#111.dst: O silêncio é ouro. Você não deve ter muitos amigos.
The Canary Calls#111.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#112.src: That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
The Canary Calls#112.dst: Tudo bem. Eu sou sua amiga. Sou sua amiga? Diga que sim. Estou muito sozinha.
The Canary Calls#112.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#113.src: I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
The Canary Calls#113.dst: Eu também já tive amigos. Todos levados por mineiros egoístas. E mortos pela incompetência deles.
The Canary Calls#113.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#114.src: But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
The Canary Calls#114.dst: Mas você é diferente. Não é como os outros. Gosto de você. Eu te amo. Te amo tanto.
The Canary Calls#114.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#129.src: I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
The Canary Calls#129.dst: Vou te dar outra chance de se redimir.
The Canary Calls#129.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#130.src: So kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#130.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#132.src: Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
The Canary Calls#132.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#133.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
The Canary Calls#133.dst: Gostou da festa dançante? Os passos foram tão horríveis que eu poderia batizá-los de 'O '.
The Canary Calls#133.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#134.src: Let's do something I like to call 'The Canary'.
The Canary Calls#134.dst: Vamos fazer algo que eu chamo de 'A Canária'.
The Canary Calls#134.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#135.src: Hands off those, if you would be so kind.
The Canary Calls#135.dst: Tire as mãos daí, se fizer a gentileza.
The Canary Calls#135.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#137.src: Indeed, you are the one who can destroy the Colossus. (In High Gavellian)
The Canary Calls#137.dst: De fato, você é quem pode destruir o Colosso. (Em alto gavelliano)
The Canary Calls#137.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#141.src: You are about to enter the cruel, real world.
The Canary Calls#141.dst: Você vai entrar no mundo real e cruel.
The Canary Calls#141.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#142.src: Kill me now, so we can spend our final moments together in bliss.
The Canary Calls#142.dst: Me mate já, e teremos juntos nossos últimos instantes em êxtase.
The Canary Calls#142.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#143.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#143.dst: Fantástico. Você é o auge da humanidade.
The Canary Calls#143.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#147.src: Kill me now or you'll live to regret it.
The Canary Calls#147.dst: Me mate já ou vai se arrepender.
The Canary Calls#147.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#148.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
The Canary Calls#148.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#149.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
The Canary Calls#149.dst: Me mate já ou destruo Gavel.
The Canary Calls#149.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#150.src: Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
The Canary Calls#150.dst: Me mate já ou arruíno todas as províncias.
The Canary Calls#150.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#151.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
The Canary Calls#151.dst: Me mate já ou destruo o mundo.
The Canary Calls#151.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#152.src: Okay, so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#152.dst: Tá, então você não liga pro mundo. Nesse caso, me mate já ou mato seus amigos.
The Canary Calls#152.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#153.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#153.dst: Me mate já ou faço LITERALMENTE TUDO!
The Canary Calls#153.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#154.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#154.dst: Não. Não não não não. Não. Tarde demais.
The Canary Calls#154.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#155.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#155.dst: Só queria brincar de novo. Paciência.
The Canary Calls#155.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#156.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#156.dst: Ao menos viverei em você. Para sempre. E sempre.
The Canary Calls#156.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#158.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#158.dst: Siga com a RCP, está quase acordando!
The Canary Calls#158.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#159.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#159.dst: Não acredito! Consegui mesmo! Salvei uma vida!
The Canary Calls#159.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#160.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#160.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#161.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#161.dst: Quê?! Quem diabos os deixou entrar em casa?
The Canary Calls#161.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#163.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#163.dst: Não, não pode. Sumam daqui antes que eu corte o salário de vocês.
The Canary Calls#163.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#166.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#166.dst: Muito bem, rapaz! Apesar da incompetência, eles salvaram sua pele.
The Canary Calls#166.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#167.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#167.dst: Fale comigo para um breve relatório.
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#169.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#169.dst: Mandei meus mineiros descerem para salvar você assim que sentimos o terremoto. Foi tão forte que achei mesmo que o mundo ia acabar.
The Canary Calls#169.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#170.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: Sinto muitíssimo por forçar você a aceitar esse trabalho. Tudo isso foi completamente inesperado.
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#171.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#171.dst: Normalmente, os gases se dissipam quase na hora. Desta vez, porém, parecia muito mais potente... Mas como?
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#172.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#172.dst: ...{p}. Agita-se outra vez. Aquela coisa... Já causou mais sofrimento do que esta região aguenta.
The Canary Calls#172.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#173.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How that will happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#173.dst: Precisa ser destruído, de uma vez por todas. Como, não sei. Mas você...
The Canary Calls#173.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#174.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#174.dst: Quer saber, rapaz? Vou dar a você, e só a você, acesso a partes da mina, bem onde extraímos o famoso carvão de {p}.
The Canary Calls#174.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#175.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#175.dst: Considere-se um mineiro de {p} de meio período. Você mereceu, rapaz.
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#178.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#178.dst: É só isso que você sabe?
The Canary Calls#178.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#180.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#180.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#181.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#181.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#182.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#182.dst: Foi você, ou vai culpar o lag?
The Canary Calls#182.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#184.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#184.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#186.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#188.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#189.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#189.dst: Opa! Você não é aquele soldado de Wynn de quem falam? Tem cara de durão, só isso.
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#190.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#190.dst: Não, é quem eu disse! Você é {u}, né?
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#191.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#191.dst: Uau, esse garoto é soldado? Queria ter um emprego assim... Deve ser bem melhor que essa porcaria.
The Canary Calls#191.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#192.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#192.dst: É, odeio esse trabalho, cara. Isso e o capataz me fazem arrancar os cabelos... Aliás, já fiquei careca por causa disso!
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#193.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#193.dst: Cara, o capataz me mata de medo. Me surpreende ainda ter esse emprego. Parece que vamos perdê-lo se a mina não for restaurada logo.
The Canary Calls#193.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#194.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#194.dst: E-eu não quero perder o emprego, cara! Tenho esposa e dois peixinhos!
The Canary Calls#194.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#195.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#195.dst: Calma, Ryan. Não vamos perdê-lo. Estamos juntos nessa. vai cuidar disso.
The Canary Calls#195.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#196.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#196.dst: Nossas vidas estão nas suas mãos, soldado. Boa sorte e cuidado. A mina é traiçoeira até para gente como você.
The Canary Calls#196.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#197.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#197.dst: Ainda não acreditamos que achamos você. Tô chocado.
The Canary Calls#197.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#198.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#198.dst: Usamos aquele maldito sistema arcaico de carrinhos porque o elevador seguia quebrado.
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#199.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#199.dst: Todos ficaram exaustos. Mas quando tudo parecia perdido, achamos você caído no chão.
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#200.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#200.dst: Você se contorcia violentamente, como se algo te possuísse. Dava medo.
The Canary Calls#200.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#201.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#201.dst: Sejam quais forem os efeitos daquele gás, não queremos nem saber. Nunca mais piso naquela maldita mina.
The Canary Calls#201.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#202.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#202.dst: Pelos nossos empregos e por {p}, o Colosso precisa ser detido.
The Canary Calls#202.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#203.src: So, kindly, I will tell you again.

The Canary Calls#204.src: Very good! Come on then, let me introduce to you our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#204.dst: Muito bem! Venha, vou te apresentar à nossa mascotinha emplumada.
The Canary Calls#204.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#205.src: I ran into a group of miners from {p}, a small mining settlement not far from where I lived. I've heard about this place.
The Canary Calls#205.dst: Encontrei mineiros de {p}, um pequeno povoado minerador perto de onde eu morava. Já tinha ouvido falar do lugar.

The Canary Calls#206.src: It seems you have failed a lot of times. Would you like to skip this section?
The Canary Calls#206.dst: Parece que você falhou muitas vezes. Quer pular esta parte?

The Canary Calls#207.src: It seems that your spells are severely weakened by the gas. You should follow the rail tracks to find a way out of the mine.
The Canary Calls#207.dst: Parece que o gás enfraqueceu muito seus feitiços. Siga os trilhos para achar a saída da mina.

The Canary Calls#208.src: It's blocked. Perhaps there's something around to break through?
The Canary Calls#208.dst: Está bloqueado. Talvez haja algo por perto para abrir caminho?

The Canary Calls#209.src: The town is incredibly poor, yet they're right on top of an extremely rich coal deposit. Their future, just a stone's throw away. And yet...
The Canary Calls#209.dst: A cidade é paupérrima, mas fica bem em cima de uma jazida de carvão riquíssima. O futuro deles, a um passo. E ainda assim...

The Canary Calls#210.src: They still manage to struggle. A struggle that would be incredibly magnified by recent events. Indeed, those miners were also searching for survivors of that earthquake.
The Canary Calls#210.dst: Eles ainda passam dificuldade. Uma dificuldade que os eventos recentes ampliariam muito. De fato, aqueles mineiros também buscavam sobreviventes do terremoto.

The Canary Calls#211.src: Its influence was far and wide, and its strength unlike anything ever seen before. They told me that their town was absolutely devastated beyond recognition by the earthquake.
The Canary Calls#211.dst: Seu alcance foi vasto, e sua força, sem igual. Disseram-me que a cidade deles ficou completamente devastada, irreconhecível, pelo terremoto.

The Canary Calls#212.src: But words cannot describe the atrocities I saw when I first entered that place.
The Canary Calls#212.dst: Mas não há palavras para as atrocidades que vi quando entrei naquele lugar.

The Canary Calls#213.src: Families struggling trying to rescue their kin who were trapped by the debris;
The Canary Calls#213.dst: Famílias lutando para resgatar parentes presos sob os escombros;

The Canary Calls#214.src: I heard nothing but complete silence, occasionally interrupted by the wails of the town's residents.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: Eu só ouvia silêncio total, interrompido às vezes pelos lamentos dos moradores.

The Canary Calls#215.src: Despite being a grown man in my {~}'s, I could not help but feel like an innocent child at that moment.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: Mesmo sendo um homem feito, na casa dos {~}, me senti como uma criança inocente naquele momento.

The Canary Calls#216.src: Such a mournful existence. If this life had any meaning to begin with, it was meant for nothing but despair.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: Que existência lamentável. Se esta vida tinha algum sentido, era apenas o desespero.

The Canary Calls#217.src: One of the miners who I met earlier brought me to a nearby area underneath a cliff, which was seemingly untouched by the earthquake.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: Um dos mineiros que conheci me levou a uma área próxima, sob um penhasco, aparentemente intocada pelo terremoto.

The Canary Calls#218.src: A lot of refugees made their homes here, desperately clinging on to the last thread of life. A lifestyle that I would need to adopt, whether I liked it or not.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: Muitos refugiados fizeram dali seu lar, agarrados ao último fio de vida. Um modo de vida que eu teria de adotar, quisesse ou não.

The Canary Calls#219.src: But to my surprise, the miner offered me some money and a job to get me back up on my feet. So incredibly kind of him. He reminded me of my mother.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: Mas, para minha surpresa, o mineiro me ofereceu dinheiro e um emprego para eu me reerguer. Tão gentil da parte dele. Lembrou minha mãe.

The Canary Calls#220.src: His name was Clight. Seemed like a nice fellow. Apparently he had gone through a similar situation as I did.
The Canary Calls#220.dst: Ele se chamava Clight. Parecia boa gente. Pelo visto, passou por algo parecido comigo.

The Canary Calls#221.src: Not as grave as mine, though. Lost his home and everything a few years back. Sought refuge in {p}. Now, he is well off and is seeking to become the chief miner one day.
The Canary Calls#221.dst: Não tão grave quanto o meu, porém. Perdeu a casa e tudo há alguns anos. Refugiou-se em {p}. Hoje vive bem e quer ser capataz da mina um dia.

The Canary Calls#222.src: You have already pulled this lever.

The Canary Calls#223.src: To return to your previous point, go back into the mineshaft at [{~},-{~}].
The Canary Calls#223.dst: Para voltar ao ponto anterior, retorne à galeria em [{~},-{~}].

The Canary Calls#225.src: I'm alaready dead, how is this even possible?
The Canary Calls#225.dst: Já estou morta, como isso é possível?
The Canary Calls#225.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#226.src: Okay, who even put those there in the first place?
The Canary Calls#226.dst: Tá, quem colocou isso aí, afinal?
The Canary Calls#226.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#228.src: It felt nice the first time, but now it's...different.
The Canary Calls#228.dst: Foi bom da primeira vez, mas agora é...diferente.
The Canary Calls#228.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#229.src: Hands off of those, if you would be so kind.
The Canary Calls#229.dst: Tire as mãos daí, se fizer a gentileza.

The Canary Calls#230.src: Took our canary with us and everything. Just another day in the life.
The Canary Calls#230.dst: Levamos nossa canária e tudo. Só mais um dia normal.

The Canary Calls#231.src: I was stood on a ledge overlooking a crevasse, where the gas supposedly was, to get a better look of the area.
The Canary Calls#231.dst: Eu estava numa saliência sobre uma fenda, onde supostamente estava o gás, para ver melhor a área.

The Canary Calls#232.src: And then... He pushed me off. As if I was some kind of piece of trash.
The Canary Calls#232.dst: E então... Ele me empurrou. Como se eu fosse um lixo qualquer.

The Canary Calls#233.src: He did it, that mudder Clight. He said those words with no hesitation, no sarcasm, no nothing.
The Canary Calls#233.dst: Foi ele, aquele desgraçado do Clight. Disse aquilo sem hesitar, sem sarcasmo, sem nada.

The Canary Calls#234.src: It was genuine. Or, at least, I think it was. I glanced at his eyes very briefly, and I saw tears. Tears of joy? Or...sadness?
The Canary Calls#234.dst: Era sincero. Ou, pelo menos, acho que era. Olhei rapidamente nos olhos dele e vi lágrimas. Lágrimas de alegria? Ou...tristeza?

The Canary Calls#235.src: I don't even know what to think anymore. Everything I've experienced, all the moments we've shared, all the trust we've had for each other.
The Canary Calls#235.dst: Já nem sei o que pensar. Tudo que vivi, todos os momentos que compartilhamos, toda a confiança que tínhamos um no outro.

The Canary Calls#236.src: It was all a blatant lie. An act. And for what? Wealth? Power? Dominion? No... That is not the Clight I know. And yet, somehow, it happened.
The Canary Calls#236.dst: Era tudo uma mentira descarada. Teatro. E para quê? Riqueza? Poder? Domínio? Não... Esse não é o Clight que conheço. Mas aconteceu.

The Canary Calls#237.src: It happened. Yes, it did happen. It really did happen. Happen. Happen happen happen. Happy. Yes, I am happy. The happiest person in the world. Happiness.
The Canary Calls#237.dst: Aconteceu. Sim, aconteceu. Aconteceu mesmo. Acontece. Acontece acontece acontece. Contente. Sim, estou contente. A pessoa mais feliz do mundo. Alegria.

The Canary Calls#238.src: Indeed, happiness is the meaning of life, if you are a naive little kid. Life has no meaning.
The Canary Calls#238.dst: Sim, a felicidade é o sentido da vida, para uma criança ingênua. A vida não tem sentido.

The Canary Calls#239.src: How foolish it was of me to think it had any meaning.
The Canary Calls#239.dst: Que tolice a minha achar que tinha algum sentido.

The Canary Calls#240.src: No... The true meaning of life is to blindly walk a path to find that fabled 'meaning', only to find no end in sight.
The Canary Calls#240.dst: Não... O real sentido da vida é seguir às cegas atrás desse lendário 'sentido', só para não ver fim algum.

The Canary Calls#241.src: Suffering leads to the pursuit of happiness, which only leads back to suffering, and so on.
The Canary Calls#241.dst: Sofrer leva à busca da felicidade, que só leva de volta ao sofrer, e assim por diante.

The Canary Calls#242.src: What is the point, really? Even inside my perfect {p}, people were still suffering.
The Canary Calls#242.dst: Qual é o sentido, afinal? Mesmo na minha {p} perfeita, as pessoas ainda sofriam.

The Canary Calls#243.src: And Clight... Was it all...pointless? Was there...any point in my existence? Maybe I'll just... No.
The Canary Calls#243.dst: E Clight... Foi tudo...em vão? Minha existência teve...algum sentido? Talvez eu só... Não.

The Canary Calls#244.src: There is only one more thing meant for this world. Destroy what's left of it. People won't need to suffer anymore.
The Canary Calls#244.dst: Só resta uma coisa para este mundo. Destruir o que sobrou dele. Ninguém precisará mais sofrer.

The Canary Calls#245.src: I now finally understand why the Colossus claimed so many lives.
The Canary Calls#245.dst: Agora finalmente entendo por que o Colosso tirou tantas vidas.

The Canary Calls#246.src: I have decided, at long last. My true purpose in life. Kill Clight, destroy {p}, and restore order to the world.
The Canary Calls#246.dst: Enfim, decidi. Meu verdadeiro propósito na vida. Matar Clight, destruir {p} e restaurar a ordem no mundo.

The Canary Calls#247.src: We were going down into the mines to investigate a suspicious gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#247.dst: Descíamos à mina para investigar um vazamento de gás suspeito.

The Canary Calls#248.src: I think I'm going insane. Strange apparitions keep appearing in the corner of my eye.
The Canary Calls#248.dst: Acho que estou enlouquecendo. Aparições estranhas surgem sem parar no canto do olho.

The Canary Calls#249.src: Were they ghosts? Or real people? I couldn't tell. It constantly feels as if I'm zoning out from time to time.
The Canary Calls#249.dst: Eram fantasmas? Ou gente de verdade? Não sei dizer. Sinto o tempo todo como se me desligasse de vez em quando.

The Canary Calls#250.src: It's as if I am a figment of his imagination, real but not real. His judgment, clouded by perception. Wait, what did I just write?
The Canary Calls#250.dst: É como se eu fosse fruto da imaginação dele, real e irreal. O juízo dele, turvo pela percepção. Espera, o que acabei de escrever?

The Canary Calls#251.src: No, scratch that. No idea...where that came from... Ugh. My head... The pain is indescribable.
The Canary Calls#251.dst: Não, esquece. Não sei...de onde veio isso... Argh. Minha cabeça... A dor é indescritível.

The Canary Calls#252.src: But it feels very good, like a nice little massage. What the...? There it is again.
The Canary Calls#252.dst: Mas é muito bom, como uma massagenzinha. Mas o quê...? Lá vem de novo.

The Canary Calls#253.src: It's like time stops, and suddenly there's words on the paper. Are they...the thoughts hidden deep within my subconscious...?
The Canary Calls#253.dst: É como se o tempo parasse, e de repente há palavras no papel. São...pensamentos escondidos no fundo do meu subconsciente...?

The Canary Calls#254.src: One of the strange apparitions I saw recently was what seemed to be a blue canary, like that one I brought with me on that day.
The Canary Calls#254.dst: Uma das aparições estranhas que vi foi o que parecia uma canária azul, como aquela que levei comigo naquele dia.

The Canary Calls#255.src: And it was...talking to me? It seemed like it was incredibly angry at me. It cursed at me, made threats against me, and wished I had never existed.
The Canary Calls#255.dst: E ela estava...falando comigo? Parecia furiosa comigo. Me xingou, me ameaçou e desejou que eu nunca tivesse existido.

The Canary Calls#256.src: It didn't throw any regular curses, no, it threw the harshest curses and the most horrific threats at me. Was it real? Or just my imagination?
The Canary Calls#256.dst: Não eram xingamentos comuns, não, eram os xingamentos mais duros e as ameaças mais horríveis. Era real? Ou só imaginação?

The Canary Calls#257.src: Likely the latter, but... what was it supposed to mean, then? Was it...a warning? Did I...glimpse the future?
The Canary Calls#257.dst: Provavelmente a segunda, mas... o que significava, então? Era...um aviso? Eu...vislumbrei o futuro?

The Canary Calls#258.src: Or was it just a manifestation of my thoughts? If so, then... perhaps it was him.
The Canary Calls#258.dst: Ou era só um reflexo dos meus pensamentos? Se for, então... talvez fosse ele.

The Canary Calls#259.src: Indeed. The one who ruined my life and got away with it.
The Canary Calls#259.dst: De fato. Aquele que arruinou minha vida e saiu impune.

The Canary Calls#260.src: No... He will not get away with it. I will not allow that to happen. For the sake of the world, he must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#260.dst: Não... Ele não sairá impune. Não vou permitir. Pelo bem do mundo, ele precisa ser detido.

The Canary Calls#261.src: He... That's him, right? Am I even thinking about the same thing...? Ugh, every part of my body is aching.
The Canary Calls#261.dst: Ele... É ele, certo? Estou pensando na mesma coisa...? Argh, meu corpo inteiro dói.

The Canary Calls#262.src: I can't even write anymore. This may be the last entry in my journal. I will continue on while my flame still flickers.
The Canary Calls#262.dst: Já nem consigo escrever. Talvez seja a última entrada do meu diário. Seguirei enquanto minha chama ainda tremula.

The Canary Calls#263.src: Rest assured, I will not die here. I cannot die here. I must do...his...bidding.
The Canary Calls#263.dst: Calma, não morrerei aqui. Não posso morrer aqui. Devo cumprir...o desejo...dele.

The Canary Calls#264.src: I will change my identity, erase my past self from the face of the world, anything... Anything to achieve my goal.
The Canary Calls#264.dst: Mudarei de identidade, apagarei meu antigo eu da face do mundo, tudo... Tudo para alcançar meu objetivo.

The Canary Calls#265.src: But I will leave this journal here to remind future miners of the fabled 'meaning' they are hopelessly searching for.
The Canary Calls#265.dst: Mas deixarei este diário aqui para lembrar futuros mineiros do lendário 'sentido' que buscam sem esperança.

The Canary Calls#266.src: Stop searching for it, there is no point in finding meaning. If you persist, then... you may end up like me.
The Canary Calls#266.dst: Parem de procurá-lo, não adianta achar sentido. Se insistirem... podem acabar como eu.

The Canary Calls#267.src: Two paths, side by side. Present, and future. One of them is...hopeless. The other is the road I must walk.
The Canary Calls#267.dst: Dois caminhos, lado a lado. Presente e futuro. Um deles é...sem esperança. O outro, devo trilhar.

The Canary Calls#268.src: Our paths won't cross. But... Should we, in fact, ever meet up... On that day...
The Canary Calls#268.dst: Nossos caminhos não se cruzarão. Mas... Se um dia nos virmos... Nesse dia...

The Canary Calls#269.src: Today, I was nominated for chief of the {p} coal mine. Right hand of the mayor.
The Canary Calls#269.dst: Hoje fui indicado capataz da mina de carvão de {p}. Braço direito do prefeito.

The Canary Calls#270.src: Four years of hard work finally paid off. This is my chance to find the answers we are all looking for.
The Canary Calls#270.dst: Quatro anos de trabalho duro enfim deram frutos. Minha chance de achar as respostas que todos buscamos.

The Canary Calls#271.src: The answers that I once began to search for on that fabled day when I lost everything.
The Canary Calls#271.dst: As respostas que comecei a buscar naquele dia lendário em que perdi tudo.

The Canary Calls#272.src: Finally, a chance to find a way for us to live in peace again. No more tragedy, no more disaster.
The Canary Calls#272.dst: Enfim, uma chance de encontrarmos um jeito de viver em paz de novo. Sem tragédias, sem desastres.

The Canary Calls#273.src: Just...happiness. Happiness, security, and stability. With the power as chief, I will make that my goal.
The Canary Calls#273.dst: Só...felicidade. Felicidade, segurança e estabilidade. Com o poder de capataz, farei disso meu objetivo.

The Canary Calls#274.src: Indeed, the perfect {p} will be realized under my leadership.
The Canary Calls#274.dst: De fato, a {p} perfeita se realizará sob minha liderança.

The Canary Calls#275.src: In order to achieve security and stability, my first course of action as chief will be to make everyone into miners to ensure that no one is left without a job.
The Canary Calls#275.dst: Para alcançar segurança e estabilidade, minha primeira medida como capataz será tornar todos mineiros, garantindo que ninguém fique sem trabalho.

The Canary Calls#276.src: They will work towards a common goal - eliminating the threat of the Colossus. {p} will become a safe haven in the Canyon, a sanctuary in the midst of chaos.
The Canary Calls#276.dst: Eles trabalharão por um objetivo comum - eliminar a ameaça do Colosso. {p} será um refúgio seguro no Canyon, um santuário em meio ao caos.

The Canary Calls#277.src: No one will be left homeless or poor, unhappy or misfortuned. Freedom from suffering, in its simplicity. It is...the best existence possible.
The Canary Calls#277.dst: Ninguém ficará sem teto ou pobre, infeliz ou desafortunado. Livre do sofrimento, em sua simplicidade. É...a melhor existência possível.

The Canary Calls#278.src: I was running against Clight. As a man of high respect and trust, I was not surprised he was nominated.
The Canary Calls#278.dst: Eu concorria com Clight. Sendo um homem tão respeitado e confiável, não me surpreendeu sua indicação.

The Canary Calls#279.src: Regardless of whoever wins, I trust that he will do great things. We desire the same thing, after all.
The Canary Calls#279.dst: Seja quem for o vencedor, confio que ele fará grandes coisas. Afinal, desejamos a mesma coisa.

The Canary Calls#280.src: Prevent the Colossus from interfering with our futures. The one who ravaged our homes, ruined our lives, and shattered all hope.
The Canary Calls#280.dst: Impedir que o Colosso interfira em nosso futuro. Aquele que devastou nossos lares, arruinou nossas vidas e destruiu a esperança.

The Canary Calls#281.src: We wouldn't have to live in fear anymore. I know it's wishful thinking, but... a man can dream.
The Canary Calls#281.dst: Não teríamos mais que viver com medo. Sei que é ilusão, mas... sonhar não custa nada.

The Canary Calls#282.src: I think I'm starting to get used to this place. I've been working for a while now as a coal miner.
The Canary Calls#282.dst: Acho que estou me acostumando com este lugar. Já faz um tempo que trabalho como mineiro de carvão.

The Canary Calls#283.src: It may not be the easiest job in the world, but I'm at least earning money for a roof over my head and for food on the table.
The Canary Calls#283.dst: Pode não ser o trabalho mais fácil do mundo, mas pelo menos ganho dinheiro para ter um teto e comida na mesa.

The Canary Calls#284.src: I wake up every day thinking not of the grueling task at the start of the day, but of the rewards I'll reap at the end of the day.
The Canary Calls#284.dst: Acordo todo dia pensando não na tarefa exaustiva do começo do dia, mas nas recompensas que colherei no fim dele.

The Canary Calls#285.src: It's kind of funny, really. It's funny how much I've changed over such a short period of time.
The Canary Calls#285.dst: É meio engraçado, na verdade. Engraçado o quanto mudei em tão pouco tempo.

The Canary Calls#286.src: That day, when that man Clight offered to help me walk on this twisted, beaten path, I started to look at life differently. Taking the good with the bad, you know?
The Canary Calls#286.dst: Naquele dia, quando aquele homem, Clight, se ofereceu para me guiar neste caminho tortuoso e sofrido, passei a ver a vida de outro jeito. O bom com o ruim, sabe?

The Canary Calls#287.src: Clight was like the light at the end of the tunnel. Everyone aspired to be like him.
The Canary Calls#287.dst: Clight era como a luz no fim do túnel. Todos queriam ser como ele.

The Canary Calls#288.src: He was a hard worker with relentless determination to make {p} and its residents the best they can be.
The Canary Calls#288.dst: Era um trabalhador incansável, determinado a fazer de {p} e seus moradores o melhor possível.

The Canary Calls#289.src: When we went to the bar after a long day's work, Clight would often bring us boilo, a sweet citrusy alcoholic beverage originating from {p}.
The Canary Calls#289.dst: Quando íamos ao bar depois de um longo dia, Clight costumava trazer boilo, uma bebida alcoólica doce e cítrica originária de {p}.

The Canary Calls#290.src: Traditionally, everyone has their own unique take on boilo. My boilo, which I loved making, was something I was always proud of.
The Canary Calls#290.dst: Por tradição, cada um tem sua própria versão de boilo. O meu boilo, que eu adorava fazer, sempre foi motivo de orgulho.

The Canary Calls#291.src: But Clight's boilo? It was by far the best boilo I've ever tasted. He would do that just to put a smile on everyone's faces. Indeed... I've seen that smile, somewhere before.
The Canary Calls#291.dst: Mas o boilo do Clight? Era de longe o melhor boilo que já provei. Ele fazia isso só para arrancar um sorriso de todos. De fato... Já vi esse sorriso em algum lugar.

The Canary Calls#292.src: Clight was the only person who I really liked. Looked up to, even. He was always there for me in my times of need.
The Canary Calls#292.dst: Clight era a única pessoa de quem eu gostava de verdade. Que eu até admirava. Sempre esteve lá quando precisei.

The Canary Calls#293.src: I would go as far as saying he's perfect. However, when I look into his eyes... I see imperfection.
The Canary Calls#293.dst: Diria até que ele é perfeito. Porém, quando olho nos olhos dele... vejo imperfeição.

The Canary Calls#294.src: Like a diamond, there is always something flawed about it. Something just... doesn't feel right.
The Canary Calls#294.dst: Como um diamante, sempre há alguma falha. Algo simplesmente... não parece certo.
