The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Ei, tudo bem. Vamos ficar bem.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Sabe, essa sua Oficina é bem melhor do que eu esperava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, obrigado pela ajuda. Você me apresentou um baita talento!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Acredite, sei como é a rejeição. Acho que todo mundo sabe, do seu jeito.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Ela é mais legal que o líder, isso é certo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Tudo isso é... difícil de acreditar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, quando voltar aqui, vai poder levar alguns dos meus aparelhos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.src: We don't have that much time you know!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.dst: A gente não tem tanto tempo assim, viu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.src: Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.dst: Parece que tem uma roupa prontinha aqui!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.src: You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.dst: Você pode dar pra Ava ou procurar mais opções nas outras salas.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.src: There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.dst: Tem umas roupas aqui. Mas estão sujas.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.src: There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.dst: Deve ter algum lugar aqui perto pra lavar isso.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1364.dst: Você começa a lavar as roupas...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.src: Shoot, I think someone's coming!! Come back!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.dst: Droga, acho que vem alguém!! Volta!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.src: You take a look inside the drawer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.dst: Você dá uma olhada na gaveta...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.src: Lucky! There's a Mechanic Outfit in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.dst: Sorte! Tem um traje de mecânico aí.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.src: You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.dst: Você pega um osso com cara de muito gostoso.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.src: There's some sort of armour in that chest. It looks flashy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.dst: Tem uma espécie de armadura naquele baú. Parece chamativa!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.src: It's... Quite hard to move around with that outfit, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.dst: É... bem difícil se mexer com essa roupa, na verdade.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.src: ...Is that someone crying over there? Eh, I'm not sure my social skills can handle that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.dst: ...Aquilo ali é alguém chorando? Hã, não sei se minhas habilidades sociais dão conta.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.src: Woah there, what's that letter? You actually got an invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.dst: Opa, que carta é essa? Você conseguiu mesmo um convite?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.src: I... Wow. Well I'm impressed! I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.src: Did we even need a letter? That armour probably would've done the trick!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.dst: A gente precisava de carta? Essa armadura provavelmente teria resolvido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.src: Well... If you want me to follow you, tell me. I've heard 'bout a receptionist in the far end of the castle, so maybe we should go there?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.dst: Bom... Se quiser que eu te siga, me avise. Ouvi falar de uma recepcionista no fundo do castelo, então talvez a gente deva ir lá?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.src: I heard there was a dealer around here but... We have the letter, so let's just keep goin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.dst: Ouvi dizer que tinha um vendedor por aqui, mas... Temos a carta, então vamos seguindo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.src: Well, no matter! I'll just... See when the council's available and book a meeting...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.dst: Bom, não importa! Vou só... ver quando o Conselho está livre e marcar uma reunião...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.src: How peculiar. I wonder how they got that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.dst: Que curioso. Como será que conseguiu isso...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.src: Hey! I saw you run towards the castle. What did you do?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.dst: Ei! Te vi correndo pro castelo. O que você fez?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.src: ...Wait, what? You went to the receptionist alone, just like that?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.dst: ...Espera, o quê? Você foi sozinho à recepcionista, assim do nada?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.src: An audience is booked, and you didn't even give me the chance to show my cool armour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.dst: A audiência está marcada e você nem me deu chance de mostrar minha armadura irada!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.src: I... I'm really grateful. What a relief. I did some tweaking regarding the machine, so you should come and test with me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.dst: Eu... Sou muito grata. Que alívio. Fiz uns ajustes na máquina, então venha testar comigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.src: As I've said, this is only practice, don't worry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.dst: Como eu disse, isso é só um treino, relaxa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.src: Just tell me when you're up for another round!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.dst: É só me avisar quando quiser outra rodada!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.src: You probably should wait for Ava first.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.dst: Talvez seja melhor esperar a Ava primeiro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.src: My guts are telling me this one's gonna be impressive. I hope he's there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.dst: Meu instinto diz que vai ser impressionante. Espero que ele esteja lá.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.src: Looks like she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.dst: Parece que ela espera o seu sinal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.dst: Até eu estou entrando no clima!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.src: I still can't believe this isn't about your armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.dst: Ainda não acredito que isso não é sobre a sua armadura.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.src: No worries... Well, I'm worrying, but that doesn't mean you have to.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.dst: Relaxa... Bom, eu estou preocupada, mas você não precisa ficar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.src: Alright guys, don't worry... We got this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.dst: Certo, pessoal, relaxem... Está sob controle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.src: I'll just... wait for your signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.dst: Eu só vou... esperar o seu sinal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.src: Hmpf. I certainly am curious now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.src: She's glancing at you. Maybe she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.dst: Ela está te olhando. Talvez espere o seu sinal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.src: EVERYONE! STOP! {u}, I want you to come here and answer something, immediately.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.dst: TODOS! PAREM! {u}, quero que venha aqui e responda uma coisa, agora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.src: You take a deep breath, and-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.src: Looks like Maxie wants to speak to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.dst: Parece que o Maxie quer falar com você.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.src: You're- *cough* so good at handling... priorities, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.dst: Você é- *cof* tão bom em lidar com... prioridades, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.src: Save your energy for later, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.dst: Guarde suas forças pra depois, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.src: Even after... Even after this, I'm sure *cough* he'll keep defending them...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.dst: Mesmo depois... Mesmo depois disso, aposto *cof* que vai defendê-los...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.src: You've been... *cough* tricked by... Quite the individual, {u}. You better redeem yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.dst: Você foi... *cof* enganado por... uma figura e tanto, {u}. É bom se redimir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.src: Efena doesn't seem very pleased to see you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.dst: Efena não parece nada feliz em te ver.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.src: No time to talk, {u}! Just go! There must be a core to hit at the top!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.dst: Sem tempo pra papo, {u}! Vai! Deve ter um núcleo pra acertar no topo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.src: Well, besides the citizens being afraid... I'd say the town's fine. However! I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.dst: Bom, tirando os cidadãos com medo... Diria que a cidade está bem. Porém! Me mandaram achar a Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.src: Somehow... Efena ended up liking her.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.dst: Sei lá como... a Efena gostou dela.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.src: I'm reading, but I'll be done soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.src: Y-you!! I- oh no... I'm... It's over..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.dst: V-você!! Eu- ah, não... Eu... Acabou..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.src: Hey, hey, calm down! I'm here to actually help you... in a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.dst: Ei, ei, calma! Vim te ajudar de verdade... de certa forma.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.speaker: Efena

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#000.dst: Descubra o que está acontecendo no centro de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.dst: Hum.. Talvez dê pra um de grau {~}... Por que está parado aí?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.dst: Por que esse povo todo está aqui? Não me diga que não sabe do concurso do Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.dst: SÉRIO?! É a maior coisa que acontece desde o último concurso, mês passado!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.dst: Quem vencer a grande caça ao tesouro sai em aventura com o próprio Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.dst: Este ano acho que tenho até chance de ganhar!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.dst: Hã? Ah, quer este bilhete? Nem pensar, é meu. Compre o seu naquela lojinha.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
The Hero of Gavel#007.dst: Ei, é a minha caneca que caiu!
The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.dst: Como vou ganhar uma aventura agora?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#012.dst: Consiga um bilhete da Caça ao Tesouro de Siegfried no centro de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.dst: Bilhetes à venda! Você! Quer entrar na grande Caça ao Tesouro de Siegfried?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.dst: A inscrição é grátis, e se ganhar, vai sair em aventura com o próprio Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.dst: Interessado? Ótimo! Olha, é bem simples.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.dst: O bilhete mostra os itens que você precisa achar. São três graus.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.dst: Os dois primeiros são pro povão. Mas se quer MESMO ganhar, precisa de um item de grau {~}.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.dst: Heh, se trouxer os três, a vitória está praticamente garantida!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.dst: Tome o bilhete. Volte com os itens e você entra no sorteio.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#020.dst: Leve os três itens limitados da Coleção Siegfried ao mercador no centro de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.dst: Isso… Uau, todos? Deixa eu dar uma olhada…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.dst: São todos autênticos! Você deve ser ri- digo, deve ser um grande fã do Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.dst: Pronto, você está no sorteio. O evento é no Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.dst: Vire na direção do banco e siga as placas, o vencedor sai quando todos chegarem.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.
The Hero of Gavel#027.dst: Vá ao Golden Eagle Theatre, atrás do Banco de {p}, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para o anúncio dos vencedores.

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.dst: Bem-vindos, bem-vindos todos! Só faltam alguns pra começarmos.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.dst: Ah, aí estão! Acho que agora estamos todos.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.dst: Bem-vindos à CAÇA AO TESOURO mensal do FESTIVAL SIEGFRIED!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.dst: Hoje, celebramos mais uma vez os feitos heroicos de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.dst: Todos vocês, meus caros gavellianos, viajaram por toda a província atrás de itens raros.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.dst: Mas não posso anunciar o vencedor…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.dst: Obrigado a todos por participarem desta fantástica caça ao tesouro por Gavel! Siegfried: O vencedor terá o privilégio de viver comigo uma aventura única, totalmente autêntica!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.dst: E agora, sem mais delongas: anunciarei o vencedor!
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.dst: Vou ganhar, comprei a caneca dele!
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.dst: {u}, vá aos bastidores à minha direita para sua aventura. Obrigado a todos!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!
The Hero of Gavel#052.dst: Encontre Siegfried nos bastidores do Golden Eagle Theatre para sair em aventura!

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome {u}! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.dst: Bem-vindo, {u}! Parabéns por vencer a caça ao tesouro!
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.dst: Hoje, você vai comigo em uma das minhas gloriosas aventuras.
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.dst: E pra chegar lá, vamos na grande Aeronave de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It's up at the airship docks - I'll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.dst: Fica nas docas de aeronaves - vou nos teletransportar!
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#059.dst: Viaje com Siegfried em sua aeronave nas docas de aeronaves de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.dst: Venha, me siga até a aeronave!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.dst: Impressionado com minha pilotagem? Desviar destas ilhas não é desafio nenhum pro poderoso Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.dst: Pilotei uma aeronave assim quando salvei {p} do dragão.
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.dst: Agora estamos indo pra uma caverna no extremo leste da região.
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.dst: Vamos cruzar seus corredores traiçoeiros e derrotar feras terríveis pra chegar ao tesouro no fim.
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.dst: Por que não pega meu mapa no nível de cima da aeronave, e nos preparamos pra aventura.
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map! Thanks.
The Hero of Gavel#067.dst: Quanto fal- Ah, trouxe o mapa! Obrigado.
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.dst: Vamos precisar deste mapa pra navegar pela caverna perigosa.
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.dst: Como consegui isto? Bem-é- Sempre me preparo antes das aventuras!
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we're about to land now - be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.dst: Enfim, vamos pousar - cuidado pra não cair!
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#071.dst: Entre na caverna perigosa no extremo leste de {p} com Siegfried em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.dst: Eis a grande Caverna das Feras Malignas Guarda-Tesouros!
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.dst: Fale comigo quando estiver pronto pra esta aventura perigosa.
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.dst: Esta caverna é perigosíssima, então siga minhas instruções.
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.dst: Tenho décadas de experiência explorando estas cavernas com bravura, sei o que faço.
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#076.dst: Avante! {u}, fique logo atrás de mim!
The Hero of Gavel#076.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Hero of Gavel#077.dst: Siga Siegfried pela caverna no extremo leste de {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.dst: Você demorou pra chegar, hein! Não importa.
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.dst: Exploro cavernas assim com frequência pra livrá-las das feras malignas que vivem nelas.
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.dst: Se não fosse por mim, que as derroto antes que possam--
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.dst: Opa, pare! Parece uma decoração inofensiva, mas é uma armadilha!
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I'll open it with my magical spell. open!
The Hero of Gavel#082.dst: Fique atrás de mim, vou abrir com meu feitiço mágico. abra-se!
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.dst: Rá! Eu te protejo do guardião, você cuida do rato!
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.dst: Ai- quer dizer, há! Foi mais fácil que matar mosca pro poderoso Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.dst: Parece que acabamos aqui! Deve ter sido uma luta muito difícil pra você.
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.dst: As cavernas que exploro estão cheias de feras terríveis como essas.
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.dst: ESPERE! Não se mexa, aquela pedra vai cair!
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.dst: Nossa, foi por pouco! Claro, eu já previa e não corri risco nenhum.
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.dst: Você diria que não dá pra seguir, já que ela bloqueia o caminho. Mas eu resolvo!
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.dst: E adeus, pedra! Só alguém tão poderoso quanto eu faz isso.
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.dst: Agora só falta cruzar uma ponte perigosa sobre o Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.dst: Aa, por que- Opa, cuidado! Parece que a ponte caiu.
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.dst: Mas não é um obstáculo tão grande, pois eu posso, hã, pular esse abismo!
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#099.dst: Pule atrás de Siegfried no poço no fim da caverna.

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#100.dst: Ache um jeito de acordar Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.dst: Aaaagggh MINHAS PERNAS AAAGGH QUE FRIO!
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.dst: Por que não PENSEI, ao assinar aquele CONTRATO IDIOTA, que acabaria aqui!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.dst: Não vão vir nos resgatar, sabia? Estamos sozinhos.
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.dst: Por que tão calmo? NÃO ESTÁ VENDO?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE'RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after 'dying', no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried! If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.dst: ESTAMOS SÓS! Agora é DE VERDADE! Nada de voltar após 'morrer', nada de armadilhas óbvias, nem Siegfried! Se eu morrer aqui, eu MORRO! Sem volta!
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.dst: Eu.. Eu não consigo. Vamos morrer de fome nesta caverna… onde ninguém vai achar nossos corpos.
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.dst: Pare de me olhar! Descubra você como sair daqui, sou só um ator inútil! Me avise se achar algo, eu- preciso ficar sozinho um pouco.
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok, I'll.. follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.dst: Achou algo? Tá, eu.. te sigo, então.
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.dst: QUE BARULHO FOI ESSE?! T- tem certeza que devemos entrar aí?
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.
The Hero of Gavel#115.dst: Avance mais fundo na caverna com Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.dst: Você.. Você nos tirou de lá!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.dst: Achei que nunca íamos achar uma saída…
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.dst: … Bom, acho que temos que seguir. T- Talvez haja uma saída?
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.dst: O- Olha! Tem plantas e luz lá na frente! UMA SAÍDA!
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.
The Hero of Gavel#122.dst: Resgate Siegfried da armadilha OU deixe-o lá.

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.dst: O- O que aconteceu?! Estou preso aqui!
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.dst: … É… uma espécie de armadilha. Sinto o chão esquentando!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-that was terrifying... Y-you saved my life. Thank you, {u}... I wasn't prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.dst: F-foi aterrorizante... V-você me salvou. Obrigado, {u}... Não estava pronto pra um perigo real assim.
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#126.dst: Descanse antes de seguir pela caverna.

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.dst: …O quê? Casas e um poço? Aqui embaixo?
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.dst: Está… vazio. E as casas parecem não ter ninguém há.. séculos.
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.dst: AI! MINHAS PERNAS! E meus braços também! T- Tudo dói demais.. Preciso sentar. Acho que torci o braço pro lado errado.
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.dst: Vou só.. descansar aqui um pouco. P- poderia procurar algo pra comermos? Eu mal.. consigo me mexer.
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.dst: … Isso já foi um sanduíche um dia?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.dst: Bom… duvido que tenha algo melhor por aqui. E- eu aceito.
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.dst: AI!! Acho que quebrei os dentes! É como comer pedra!
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.dst: … A-ai-cho que estou pronto pra- ai- seguir. Vamo-aai-nos.
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.dst: ... Esta é a comida que você achou?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.dst: Acho que é... o melhor que dava pra achar aqui. Você que cozinhou?
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.dst: Vou experimentar, então. Duvido que tenha algo melhor por aqui.
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better, I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.dst: Obrigado, {u}! Estou bem melhor, posso descer mais quando estiver pronto.
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.dst: Acho... que vou comer, se é a única comida que tem.
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.dst: Vejamos... Como é que se come isso?
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.dst: Sabe… meu nome na verdade é Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sounds extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.dst: Soa muito Corkian, eu sei. Me fizeram usar Siegfried porque soa menos estrangeiro, acho.
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.dst: AI! {u}, acho que esta teia é venenosa! Rápido, me tire com um dos seus feitiços!
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you, {u}. I'll.. I'll follow you from now on. Clearly you're more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.dst: Obrigado, {u}. Eu.. Vou te seguir daqui pra frente. Você está mais preparado que eu.
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.
The Hero of Gavel#151.dst: Ache o caminho pelas tocas das aranhas.

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.dst: {u}? Acho que aquela teia gigante está presa nas plataformas das paredes.
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.dst: Acho… Talvez você possa cortá-las? Vou ficar aqui, acho que é o lugar mais seguro. Te chamo se outra aranha me prender.
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.dst: Vamos em frente, não quero ver mais nenhuma aranha.
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.dst: Ei, me espere! Obrigado por me salvar ali.
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.dst: Uau... Isto é enorme! Quem sabe o que era isto?
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can cross them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.dst: O caminho parece seguir por aqueles cacos amarelos, dá pra atravessar?
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#160.dst: Ache um jeito de escapar pela claraboia no fim da caverna.

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.dst: Outra cidade? Ou outra parte da mesma? Não sei..
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.dst: Esta tem até forja e alfaiate.. Era uma aldeia completa!
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#163.dst: Aquilo.. aquilo é luz do sol?
The Hero of Gavel#163.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.dst: {u}, olha! Dá pra ver o céu daqui! T- talvez tenha um jeito de subir!
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can use this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.dst: Acho.. e se der pra usar este gêiser? Parece adormecido, mas sinto que dá pra reativá-lo.
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.dst: Dê uma olhada por aí, vou descansar um pouco. Acho que nunca andei tanto na vida…
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.dst: E-espera.. depois do impulso, a queda vai ser longa. Consegue fazer algo de segurança, tipo um paraquedas ou umas botas bem macias?
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.dst: Já fez algo? Deixa eu ver.
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.dst: Isto parece… usável? Já é alguma coisa.
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.dst: Deve ser o melhor que vamos ter aqui embaixo. Tem certeza de que não precisa de nada? Não? Tá.
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.dst: Mal posso esperar pra ver a cara deles quando voltarmos. Acabamos de salvar o legado de Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? ...{u}, WE DID IT! WE'RE BACK! HAHAAA! I'M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.dst: C-chegamos? ...{u}, CONSEGUIMOS! VOLTAMOS! HAHAAA! TÔ VIVO!
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.dst: Olá! Sou eu, Siegfried, e acabo de deter a ameaça que era esta caverna!
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.dst: Há, que fantasia ótima, hein! Igualzinha a mim!
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#179.dst: O quê? E- eu fui SUBSTITUÍDO?
The Hero of Gavel#179.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don't mind that jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.dst: Há, não ligue praquele palhaço ali. Mas a fantasia dele é impressionante!
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.dst: O-o que houve? Vocês não podem me substituir!
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.dst: Olhe ali! Devem ser fogos pra celebrar minha vitória!
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.dst: Bom, enfim! Você levou um tombo feio naquela caverna. Eu mesmo te carreguei pra fora, deve ter tido alucinações malucas.
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.dst: Mesmo tendo sido erro seu, vou devolver as esmeraldas que gastou na caça ao tesouro.. e mais um pouco de compensação. Serão.. [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.dst: Preciso voltar a {p} para a celebração. Talvez nos vejamos na próxima caça ao tesouro!
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.dst: Olá, humano! Sou eu, Siegfried! Você perdeu por pouco como acabei com maestria com a ameaça desta caverna de monstros!
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.dst: {u}, que bom ver que saiu com vida. Deve ter sido uma bela queda no abismo.
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#192.dst: Claro, eu saí fácil com meus feitiços e meu grande conhecimento de cavernas! Bom, preciso ir. Talvez nos vejamos se vencer a próxima caça ao tesouro!
The Hero of Gavel#192.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#193.src: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items, and some more as compensation.
The Hero of Gavel#193.dst: Como compensação pelo seu infeliz acidente, Siegfried devolverá as esmeraldas gastas na compra dos itens da caça ao tesouro, e mais algumas de compensação.

The Hero of Gavel#194.src: That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried, The Hero of Gavel!
The Hero of Gavel#194.dst: O total é de... {~} esmeraldas líquidas. Pedimos desculpas pelas dificuldades na sua aventura com Siegfried, o Herói de Gavel!

The Hero of Gavel#197.src: I've been saving up for this scavenger hunt all year, there's no way I can lose!
The Hero of Gavel#197.dst: Economizei o ano todo pra esta caça ao tesouro, não tem como eu perder!
The Hero of Gavel#197.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#198.src: Participating in the Siegfried Scavenger Hunt? If you are, the theatre's right behind me.
The Hero of Gavel#198.dst: Vai participar da Caça ao Tesouro de Siegfried? Se sim, o teatro fica logo atrás de mim.
The Hero of Gavel#198.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#199.src: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#199.dst: O vencedor terá o privilégio de viver comigo uma aventura única, totalmente autêntica!
The Hero of Gavel#199.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#201.src: The map's in the upper level of the airship. Ignore anything else you find there.
The Hero of Gavel#201.dst: O mapa está no nível de cima da aeronave. Ignore o resto que encontrar lá.
The Hero of Gavel#201.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#202.src: Maybe you should get the rope too...
The Hero of Gavel#202.dst: Talvez você deva pegar a corda também...

The Hero of Gavel#203.src: This rope may be useful later on...
The Hero of Gavel#203.dst: Esta corda pode ser útil depois...

The Hero of Gavel#204.src: Hey, I told you to stay behind me! I have to enter the cave first!
The Hero of Gavel#204.dst: Ei, eu disse pra ficar atrás de mim! Eu entro na caverna primeiro!
The Hero of Gavel#204.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#205.src: You should jump in after him.

The Hero of Gavel#206.src: [!] This quest uses particles to display some information. It is recommended to have at least some particles enabled to enhance your experience.
The Hero of Gavel#206.dst: [!] Esta missão usa partículas para mostrar informações. Recomenda-se ativar pelo menos algumas partículas para melhorar sua experiência.

The Hero of Gavel#207.src: He's unconscious. Perhaps there's something around here to wake him up?
The Hero of Gavel#207.dst: Está desmaiado. Talvez haja algo por aqui pra acordá-lo?

The Hero of Gavel#209.src: This boulder is stopping the portcullis chains... You'd need a pickaxe to break it, however.
The Hero of Gavel#209.dst: Esta pedra trava as correntes da grade levadiça... Só uma picareta a quebraria.

The Hero of Gavel#210.src: It's an old mining expedition's log:
The Hero of Gavel#210.dst: Diário de uma velha expedição mineira:

The Hero of Gavel#211.src: Supplies are limited, excavation yielding little success.
The Hero of Gavel#211.dst: Suprimentos limitados, escavação com pouco sucesso.

The Hero of Gavel#212.src: We've attempted going around the portcullis, but the beast in the only cave past it killed one of our crew.
The Hero of Gavel#212.dst: Tentamos contornar a grade levadiça, mas a fera da única caverna depois dela matou um dos nossos.

The Hero of Gavel#213.src: Apart from the portcullis, there are no signs of villagers or of the town itself. The team is beginning to doubt its existence.
The Hero of Gavel#213.dst: Além da grade levadiça, nenhum sinal de aldeões ou da cidade em si. A equipe começa a duvidar que ela exista.

The Hero of Gavel#214.src: The return crew is lowering the crane tomorrow, so it's unlikely we can find anything before then. Logs will be left for use of any future excavations.
The Hero of Gavel#214.dst: A equipe de retorno baixa o guindaste amanhã, então é improvável acharmos algo antes disso. Os diários ficarão para uso de futuras escavações.

The Hero of Gavel#215.src: The rest of the log lists geological information about the cave and a supply manifest.
The Hero of Gavel#215.dst: O resto do diário traz dados geológicos da caverna e uma lista de suprimentos.

The Hero of Gavel#216.src: Find a way deeper into the cave and lead Siegfried there with you.
The Hero of Gavel#216.dst: Ache um jeito de ir mais fundo na caverna e leve Siegfried com você.

The Hero of Gavel#218.src: The cage fell! You should go help Siegfried out.
The Hero of Gavel#218.dst: A jaula caiu! Vá ajudar Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#219.src: Siegfried has died in the cage. You'll have to find your way out yourself.
The Hero of Gavel#219.dst: Siegfried morreu na jaula. Você terá que achar a saída sozinho.

The Hero of Gavel#220.src: It seems the trap machinery broke down!
The Hero of Gavel#220.dst: Parece que o mecanismo da armadilha quebrou!

The Hero of Gavel#221.src: This area seems like a good place to rest before moving on. Siegfried would have been overjoyed to see this.
The Hero of Gavel#221.dst: Esta área parece um bom lugar pra descansar antes de seguir. Siegfried teria ficado radiante de ver isto.

The Hero of Gavel#223.src: Maybe that web would fall if you cut the ones supporting it?
The Hero of Gavel#223.dst: Talvez aquela teia caia se você cortar as que a sustentam?

The Hero of Gavel#224.src: It looks like the way forward is across the yellow shards...
The Hero of Gavel#224.dst: Parece que o caminho segue pelos cacos amarelos...

The Hero of Gavel#225.src: Picking up lava with your bare hands seems like a bad idea.
The Hero of Gavel#225.dst: Pegar lava com as mãos nuas parece má ideia.

The Hero of Gavel#226.src: ... Is that sunlight at the other side of the cave?
The Hero of Gavel#226.dst: ... Aquilo do outro lado da caverna é luz do sol?

The Hero of Gavel#227.src: This is a sewing machine.. It still seems to work.
The Hero of Gavel#227.dst: É uma máquina de costura.. Parece que ainda funciona.

The Hero of Gavel#228.src: It's a tailor's notes on how to create some items:
The Hero of Gavel#228.dst: São notas de um alfaiate sobre como fazer itens:

The Hero of Gavel#229.src: To Sarnim - If you really wanted to learn the craft, here's some simple items to get you started.
The Hero of Gavel#229.dst: Para Sarnim - Se queria mesmo aprender o ofício, aqui estão uns itens simples pra começar.

The Hero of Gavel#230.src: Parachute: Some cloth and rope. I haven't found any rope since the shattering, I don't think there's any in the storage either.
The Hero of Gavel#230.dst: Paraquedas: tecido e corda. Não acho corda desde a Ruptura, e acho que também não tem nenhuma no depósito.

The Hero of Gavel#231.src: Soft Boots: Cloth, and some soft slime. I usually get my slime from the spider burrows past the gate.
The Hero of Gavel#231.dst: Botas macias: tecido e um pouco de slime macio. Pego slime nas tocas das aranhas depois do portão.

The Hero of Gavel#232.src: Hard Boots: Cloth and leather. These hurt quite a bit, so be careful. There should be some leather in the storage if you make these.
The Hero of Gavel#232.dst: Botas duras: tecido e couro. Machucam bastante, então cuidado. Deve ter couro no depósito se for fazer estas.

The Hero of Gavel#233.src: It's an old notebook listing some research about geysers:
The Hero of Gavel#233.dst: É um caderno velho com uma pesquisa sobre gêiseres:

The Hero of Gavel#234.src: The geyser was active back before the shattering, but it seems to have filled up.
The Hero of Gavel#234.dst: O gêiser era ativo antes da Ruptura, mas parece ter entupido.

The Hero of Gavel#235.src: It hasn't erupted in weeks. However! My studies on the small geysers have proven lava can activate them again!
The Hero of Gavel#235.dst: Não entra em erupção há semanas. Porém! Meus estudos com gêiseres pequenos provaram que lava pode reativá-los!

The Hero of Gavel#236.src: Hannux still refuses to give me molten metal from his forge, though. My next tests ought to convince him.
The Hero of Gavel#236.dst: Mas o Hannux ainda se recusa a me dar metal derretido da forja. Meus próximos testes devem convencê-lo.

The Hero of Gavel#237.src: It's an old, tattered book labelled 'Sustainable Food in the Caverns, by Hannux and Ilorav'
The Hero of Gavel#237.dst: É um livro velho e rasgado: 'Alimentação sustentável nas cavernas, por Hannux e Ilorav'

The Hero of Gavel#238.src: This document should outline a sustainable method for the continued survival of our town for however long we may be in these caverns.
The Hero of Gavel#238.dst: Este documento descreve um método sustentável para nossa cidade sobreviver por quanto tempo ficarmos nestas cavernas.

The Hero of Gavel#239.src: Multiple varieties of mushrooms have grown in the years after the shattering. These are edible and a primary source of food.
The Hero of Gavel#239.dst: Diversas variedades de cogumelos cresceram nos anos após a Ruptura. São comestíveis e uma fonte principal de alimento.

The Hero of Gavel#240.src: A bioluminescent material allows for trees and grass to grow, albeit very slowly.
The Hero of Gavel#240.dst: Um material bioluminescente faz árvores e grama crescerem, ainda que bem devagar.

The Hero of Gavel#241.src: We recommend taking good care of the trees, grass, and bushes - they may become a valuable source of food in the future.
The Hero of Gavel#241.dst: Recomendamos cuidar bem das árvores, da grama e dos arbustos - podem virar uma valiosa fonte de alimento no futuro.

The Hero of Gavel#242.src: We have also found that there is very little edible plant life outside of our section of the cave.
The Hero of Gavel#242.dst: Também descobrimos que há pouquíssima vegetação comestível fora da nossa parte da caverna.

The Hero of Gavel#243.src: A smaller group was far less lucky than us and ended up in an area with virtually no edible material - we found the remains of their homes in a recent expedition.
The Hero of Gavel#243.dst: Um grupo menor teve bem menos sorte e acabou numa área praticamente sem nada comestível - achamos os restos das casas deles numa expedição recente.

The Hero of Gavel#244.src: A species of spiders and creeping mold has appeared as well. These are not suitable for consumption, and should be left alone. They are peaceful unless attacked.
The Hero of Gavel#244.dst: Também surgiram uma espécie de aranha e um mofo rastejante. Não servem para consumo e devem ser deixados em paz. São pacíficos, a menos que atacados.

The Hero of Gavel#245.src: The rest of the book seems to be repeating the same information but in extreme detail.
The Hero of Gavel#245.dst: O resto do livro parece repetir as mesmas informações, mas com detalhes extremos.

The Hero of Gavel#249.src: Tickets for sale! Get your Siegfried Scavenger Hunt tickets here!
The Hero of Gavel#249.dst: Bilhetes à venda! Bilhetes da Caça ao Tesouro de Siegfried aqui!
The Hero of Gavel#249.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#250.src: You sense you're going back the way you came...
The Hero of Gavel#250.dst: Você sente que está voltando por onde veio...

The Hero of Gavel#251.src: You'd need an explosive to disable this. There don't seem to be any in here, however.
The Hero of Gavel#251.dst: Precisaria de um explosivo pra desativar isto. Mas não parece haver nenhum aqui.

The Hero of Gavel#252.src: You get a sense you're going backwards...
The Hero of Gavel#252.dst: Você sente que está andando pra trás...

The Hero of Gavel#253.src: There's some small caves around here.. Maybe there'll be something edible there?
The Hero of Gavel#253.dst: Tem umas cavernas pequenas por aqui.. Talvez haja algo comestível nelas?
The Hero of Gavel#253.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#254.src: I don't... feel too good. I think.. I can move on though, as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#254.dst: Não estou... me sentindo bem. Acho.. que consigo seguir, assim que estiver pronto.
The Hero of Gavel#254.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#255.src: This oven still seems to be in working order.

The Hero of Gavel#256.src: Those lines of silk from the big web are holding it up. If you cut all three, it might break.
The Hero of Gavel#256.dst: Aqueles fios de seda da teia grande a sustentam. Se cortar os três, ela pode se romper.
The Hero of Gavel#256.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#257.src: You get a sense you're going the wrong way...
The Hero of Gavel#257.dst: Você sente que está no caminho errado...

The Hero of Gavel#258.src: Good thing we got past that chasm! Let's keep going!
The Hero of Gavel#258.dst: Ainda bem que passamos daquele abismo! Vamos em frente!
The Hero of Gavel#258.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#259.src: .. {u}... are you sure those u-uncooked eggs were.. safe?
The Hero of Gavel#259.dst: .. {u}... certeza que aqueles ovos c-crus eram.. seguros?
The Hero of Gavel#259.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#260.src: Ugh.. I don't feel.. very good..
The Hero of Gavel#260.dst: Argh.. Não estou.. me sentindo bem..
The Hero of Gavel#260.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#261.src: I can feel.. something.. ins--- AAAAAAARHGH!
The Hero of Gavel#261.speaker: Gurix

The Hidden City#001.src: A human? Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
The Hidden City#001.dst: Um humano? Agh! Não precisa me arrumar um médico, está tudo sob controle...
The Hidden City#001.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#002.src: It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
The Hidden City#002.dst: É uma perna quebrada. Já estou tratando, mas tenho um serviço pra fazer em outro lugar- e urgente, ainda por cima.
The Hidden City#002.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#003.src: I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
The Hidden City#003.dst: Assim não vou conseguir, mas não importa se sou eu quem vai fazer. Só precisa ser feito.
The Hidden City#003.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#004.src: I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
The Hidden City#004.dst: Não trabalho pros aldeões, fui contratado por outros humanos... tem algo que você precisa manter em segredo.
The Hidden City#004.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#005.src: Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
The Hidden City#005.dst: Jure! Se vai aceitar o serviço, e meu pagamento por ele, vai ter que ficar calado!
The Hidden City#005.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#008.src: There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
The Hidden City#008.dst: Há uma cidade escondida neste cânion. Lá nas montanhas- construída e governada por humanos.
The Hidden City#008.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#009.src: Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans founding cities in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
The Hidden City#009.dst: Os aldeões têm regras muito rígidas sobre humanos fundarem cidades nas terras deles, e isso é MUITO ilegal.
The Hidden City#009.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#010.src: I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
The Hidden City#010.dst: O prefeito me contatou porque sabe que a cidade pode ter sido... comprometida.
The Hidden City#010.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#011.src: The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
The Hidden City#011.dst: O serviço é descobrir quem e por quê, claro. Se isso vazar, o tratado entre nossas raças pode ruir.
The Hidden City#011.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#012.src: I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
The Hidden City#012.dst: Nunca fui à cidade nas montanhas, mas me deram instruções. Aqui, vou anotar o local no seu livro.
The Hidden City#012.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#013.src: Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
The Hidden City#013.dst: Mas não vão te deixar entrar se a área não estiver segura. Não podem arriscar que aldeões entrem.
The Hidden City#013.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#015.src: Head to [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find the human town.
The Hidden City#015.dst: Vá até [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para encontrar a cidade humana.

The Hidden City#016.src: Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
The Hidden City#016.dst: Hum? Ah, outro aventureiro, pelo visto! Desculpe, mas esta descoberta é minha. Tem algo estranho naquela porta...
The Hidden City#016.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#017.src: Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
The Hidden City#017.dst: Gases mortais? Bobagem! Como vê, nós dois estamos respirando muito bem.
The Hidden City#017.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#018.src: You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
The Hidden City#018.dst: Quer que eu vá embora? Por quê, pra ficar com toda a glória? Há, nem pensar!
The Hidden City#018.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#019.src: The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
The Hidden City#019.dst: Só saio daqui se conseguir abrir aquela porta ou se a caverna inteira desabar sobre nós.
The Hidden City#019.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#021.src: Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
The Hidden City#021.dst: Gueh! Tinha que abrir a boca sobre a caverna desabar! Tô fora- se tiver juízo, saia também!
The Hidden City#021.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#022.src: loud mechanical noise can be heard coming from the door
The Hidden City#022.dst: ouve-se um forte barulho mecânico vindo da porta

The Hidden City#023.src: Go up to the door and inspect the noise.
The Hidden City#023.dst: Vá até a porta e investigue o barulho.

The Hidden City#025.src: Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
The Hidden City#025.dst: Obrigado por se livrar daquele aldeão curioso! Achamos que ele nunca ia embora.
The Hidden City#025.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#026.src: I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
The Hidden City#026.dst: Nunca te vi antes. Quem te deu acesso à cidade?
The Hidden City#026.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#027.src: You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
The Hidden City#027.dst: Você veio no lugar do detetive que o prefeito contratou?
The Hidden City#027.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#028.src: Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
The Hidden City#028.dst: Normalmente eu não acreditaria, mas entre. Estamos desesperados.
The Hidden City#028.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#029.src: If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
The Hidden City#029.dst: Se precisar sair e voltar, é só eu abrir o caminho.
The Hidden City#029.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#030.src: You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
The Hidden City#030.dst: É melhor você ir agora. Nosso prefeito pode ficar impaciente.
The Hidden City#030.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#031.src: Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.
The Hidden City#031.dst: Fale com o prefeito Eoric na prefeitura.

The Hidden City#032.src: What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
The Hidden City#032.dst: O que faz aqui? Estou escrevendo uma carta importante, é bom que valha meu tempo.
The Hidden City#032.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#033.src: What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a {p} soldier?
The Hidden City#033.dst: O quê? O Narder te mandou? Por que um soldado de {p}?
The Hidden City#033.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#034.src: I didn't think the army were authorized to know about {p}, especially Fruma recruits.
The Hidden City#034.dst: Achei que o exército não podia saber de {p}, muito menos os recrutas de Fruma.
The Hidden City#034.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#035.src: Anyway, {p}'s secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of a traitor.
The Hidden City#035.dst: Enfim, o segredo de {p} corre grande perigo. Achamos provas de um traidor.
The Hidden City#035.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#036.src: We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
The Hidden City#036.dst: Fechamos todas as saídas. Ninguém sai nem entra sem minha permissão.
The Hidden City#036.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#037.src: We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
The Hidden City#037.dst: Precisamos de um detetive pra farejar o traidor e expô-lo.
The Hidden City#037.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#038.src: Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
The Hidden City#038.dst: Comece perguntando aos cidadãos daqui se viram algo suspeito.
The Hidden City#038.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#039.src: When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
The Hidden City#039.dst: Quando achar o culpado, lembre-se de deixá-lo vivo! Os guardas cuidarão dele.
The Hidden City#039.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#040.dst: Pergunte aos Cidadãos de {p} sobre o bilhete.

The Hidden City#041.src: Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
The Hidden City#041.dst: Desculpe, detetive, mas não vi nada suspeito. Aliás, nem saí de casa na última semana.
The Hidden City#041.speaker: Reder

The Hidden City#042.src: The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in {p}, so it's weird.
The Hidden City#042.dst: A única coisa suspeita que vi foi um homem encapuzado andando por aí. Tem pouca gente em {p}, então é estranho.
The Hidden City#042.speaker: Nichye

The Hidden City#043.src: If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
The Hidden City#043.dst: Se quer descobrir algo, pergunte à Lumilda. Ela está na padaria dela, ao lado da Loja de Pergaminhos.
The Hidden City#043.speaker: Sybeth

The Hidden City#044.src: Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
The Hidden City#044.dst: Ah, detetive! O que te traz à doce Padaria da Lumilda?
The Hidden City#044.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#045.src: Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
The Hidden City#045.dst: Hum, sim, tem um sujeito estranho que passa aqui.
The Hidden City#045.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#046.src: It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
The Hidden City#046.dst: É um encapuzado. Nunca vi o rosto. Um encrenqueiro, se quer saber!
The Hidden City#046.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#047.src: He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
The Hidden City#047.dst: Ele veio algumas vezes, quase sempre escrevendo num pedaço de papel. Esse homem é um mistério. Ninguém sabe nem onde ele mora.
The Hidden City#047.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#048.src: One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#048.dst: Uma vez meu neto não resistiu e seguiu o homem. A última coisa que viu foi ele saindo pela Saída Leste.
The Hidden City#048.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#049.src: Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
The Hidden City#049.dst: Já é um começo, não é, meu bem?
The Hidden City#049.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#050.src: Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#050.dst: Investigue o que houver além da Saída Leste.

The Hidden City#052.src: Ah, you must be the detective. None of those half-witted Eltomites could figure it out.
The Hidden City#052.dst: Ah, você deve ser o detetive. Nenhum daqueles eltomitas tapados conseguiu descobrir.

The Hidden City#053.src: I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.
The Hidden City#053.dst: Acho que o Grook já saiu do cercado, então.

The Hidden City#054.src: This town shouldn't even be here. Humans aren't allowed to own land in Gavel like this.
The Hidden City#054.dst: Esta cidade nem devia existir. Humanos não podem ter terras em Gavel assim.

The Hidden City#055.src: These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.
The Hidden City#055.dst: Esses humanos não quiseram travar sua guerra, então esconderam uma cidade inteira aqui.

The Hidden City#056.src: Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?
The Hidden City#056.dst: Traidor? Não sou traidor. Só quero que a lei seja cumprida onde precisa ser. Nada pessoal, certo?

The Hidden City#057.src: Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
The Hidden City#057.dst: Talvez eles finalmente digam "Ardulf" em vez de "aberração" quando virem o bem que posso fazer por eles!
The Hidden City#057.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#058.src: Read the note on the table.

The Hidden City#064.src: Demanded to use a ship... I refused...
The Hidden City#064.dst: Exigiu usar uma nave... Eu recusei...
The Hidden City#064.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#065.src: He beat me up... And left...
The Hidden City#065.dst: Ele me bateu... E foi embora...
The Hidden City#065.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#067.src: Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.
The Hidden City#067.dst: Suba a Torre da Base Aérea para confrontar o homem encapuzado.

The Hidden City#069.src: What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
The Hidden City#069.dst: O que faz aqui? Por que está protegendo esta cidade ilegal?
The Hidden City#069.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#070.src: The Villagers will not be happy about {p}. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
The Hidden City#070.dst: Os aldeões não vão gostar de {p}. Isso pode prejudicar seriamente a relação entre Gavel e Wynn.
The Hidden City#070.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#071.src: You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
The Hidden City#071.dst: Você não pode me deter. Não mataria um dos seus, mataria?
The Hidden City#071.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#072.src: I will tell the mayor of {p} all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you'll have to do it yourself.
The Hidden City#072.dst: Vou contar tudo sobre este lugar ao prefeito de {p} e cobrar minha recompensa. Vou ficar rico, e se quiser me deter, vai ter que fazer isso você mesmo.
The Hidden City#072.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#073.src: ...you got snuck up on and knocked out. Where are you now?
The Hidden City#073.dst: ...você foi pego de surpresa e nocauteado. Onde está agora?

The Hidden City#074.src: Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.
The Hidden City#074.dst: Fuja da cela e ache um jeito de sabotar a nave.

The Hidden City#076.src: Talk to {p}'s Mayor at the top of {p}.
The Hidden City#076.dst: Fale com o prefeito de {p} no alto de {p}.

The Hidden City#077.src: What brings a human to my office?
The Hidden City#077.dst: O que traz um humano à minha sala?

The Hidden City#078.src: I wrote the location of the city in your content book. There's nothing else I can do to help you.
The Hidden City#078.dst: Anotei o local da cidade no seu livro de conteúdo. Não posso fazer mais nada pra ajudar.
The Hidden City#078.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#080.src: - Mayor's office on the top layer of {p}
The Hidden City#080.dst: - Sala do prefeito no topo de {p}

The Hidden City#081.src: - Remember to set up Dwarven bank account
The Hidden City#081.dst: - Lembrar de abrir conta no banco dos anões

The Hidden City#083.src: The ship you're running is a mess. This is the third time I've had to repair a coolant leak here.
The Hidden City#083.dst: A nave que você opera é uma bagunça. É a terceira vez que conserto um vazamento de refrigerante.

The Hidden City#084.src: The Corkian machines are great, but they aren't eternal. At this rate, you'll need a new ship every winter.
The Hidden City#084.dst: As máquinas Corkian são ótimas, mas não são eternas. Assim, vai precisar de uma nave nova a cada inverno.

The Hidden City#085.src: Is it that hard to understand that no liquid should enter the engine?
The Hidden City#085.dst: É tão difícil entender que nenhum líquido deve entrar no motor?

The Hidden City#087.src: A letter? Oh, that. The one about {p}? Don't look so worried. The secret is safe with me.
The Hidden City#087.dst: Uma carta? Ah, aquela. A de {p}? Não fique tão preocupado. O segredo está seguro comigo.
The Hidden City#087.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The Hidden City#088.src: Yes, I know about {p}. After all, its mayor is my ex-husband.
The Hidden City#088.dst: Sim, sei de {p}. Afinal, o prefeito de lá é meu ex-marido.
The Hidden City#088.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The Hidden City#089.src: It may seem odd, a love between a villager and a human. I know, but our race did not stop us from being in love.
The Hidden City#089.dst: Pode parecer estranho, um amor entre uma aldeã e um humano. Eu sei, mas nossa raça não impediu nosso amor.
The Hidden City#089.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The Hidden City#090.src: The person who left the letter about {p} is our son, Ardulf. As soon as Eoric found out about our child, he panicked and left me.
The Hidden City#090.dst: Quem deixou a carta sobre {p} é nosso filho, Ardulf. Assim que Eoric soube do nosso filho, entrou em pânico e me deixou.
The Hidden City#090.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The Hidden City#091.src: Ardulf will never be accepted as a half breed... Still, I hope he's OK.
The Hidden City#091.dst: Ardulf, mestiço, nunca será aceito... Espero que esteja bem, ao menos.
The Hidden City#091.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The Hidden City#092.src: Huh, oh yeah, one more thing. The switch under the table... go on, press it!
The Hidden City#092.dst: Hum, ah, é, mais uma coisa. O interruptor debaixo da mesa... vá, aperte!
The Hidden City#092.speaker: Thesead's Mayor

The House of Twain (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Twendle at The {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The House of Twain (Quest)#001.src: Oh, hey you there! Are you heading down this road? You know it's a dead end, right?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.dst: Ah, ei, você aí! Vai por esta estrada? Sabe que é um beco sem saída, né?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#002.src: It leads to an old mansion, that has fallen into decay.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.dst: Ela leva a uma velha mansão, que caiu em ruínas.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#003.src: That mansion is the house of my ancestor; Dwendle Twain. It was a house of incredible heritage and magical powers, Dwendle himself was adopted into it.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.dst: Aquela mansão é a casa do meu antepassado, Dwendle Twain. Era uma casa de herança incrível e poderes mágicos; o próprio Dwendle foi adotado por ela.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#004.src: Marius Twain was the leader of the mansion; they fought against evil spirits, I think. The history of the house is not well-known, outside of a novel.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.dst: Marius Twain era o líder da mansão; eles lutavam contra espíritos malignos, acho. A história da casa é pouco conhecida, fora um romance.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#005.src: I want to know the history of the mansion and uncover its secrets, but every time I get close, dark beings prevent me from entering.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.dst: Quero conhecer a história da mansão e desvendar seus segredos, mas sempre que chego perto, seres sombrios me impedem de entrar.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#006.src: I am no soldier, and I don't think I will ever uncover the truth without your help. I can greatly reward you for your help.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.dst: Não sou soldado, e acho que nunca vou descobrir a verdade sem sua ajuda. Posso te recompensar muito bem.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#007.src: My ancestor left our family a large amount of emeralds. Beware though, traveller, the mansion's secrets are incredibly difficult to uncover and the monsters are powerful.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.dst: Meu antepassado deixou à família muitas esmeraldas. Mas cuidado, viajante, os segredos da mansão são dificílimos de desvendar e os monstros são poderosos.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#008.src: Unravel the secrets of the mansion and help me uncover the secrets of my heritage. Bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.dst: Desvende os segredos da mansão e me ajude a descobrir os da minha linhagem. Traga-me [{~} Diário de Twain].
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#009.src: This book has been hidden within the depths of the mansion and is protected by far more than puzzles or walls.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.dst: Este livro está escondido nas profundezas da mansão e é protegido por muito mais que enigmas ou paredes.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.speaker: Twendle
