The House of Twain (Quest)#010.src: I believe the spirits that now haunt the mansion will do anything to protect the book. I'm sure they think it's their own, and the secrets it hides.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.dst: Acho que os espíritos que agora assombram a mansão farão tudo pra proteger o livro. Com certeza acham que ele é deles, e os segredos que guarda.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#011.dst: Leve [{~} Diário de Twain] a Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#012.src: If you already have a Ghostly Cap, you can wear that one and do not have to do any previous steps in order for the quest to work.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.dst: Se você já tem um Ghostly Cap, pode usá-lo e não precisa fazer nenhuma etapa anterior para a missão funcionar.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.speaker: Note

The House of Twain (Quest)#013.src: I guess I put my faith in the right person. My history lies within these pages, and I don't intend to keep them secret. I shall make them public.
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.dst: Acho que confiei na pessoa certa. Minha história está nestas páginas, e não pretendo mantê-las em segredo. Vou torná-las públicas.
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#014.src: Thank you traveller. As promised, here is your reward.
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.dst: Obrigado, viajante. Como prometi, aqui está a recompensa.
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#015.src: I know uncovering the truth is never easy, but keep trying, please bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#015.dst: Sei que descobrir a verdade nunca é fácil, mas insista. Por favor, traga [{~} Diário de Twain].

The House of Twain (Quest)#016.src: Talk to Twendle at the House of Twain at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The House of Twain (Quest)#016.dst: Fale com Twendle na Casa de Twain em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Lost#001.src: Ho, traveller! I need the help of a true explorer. I can see it in your eyes, you are an adventurer like me!
The Lost#001.dst: Ei, viajante! Preciso da ajuda de um verdadeiro explorador. Vejo nos seus olhos, é um aventureiro como eu!
The Lost#001.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#002.src: While you are here, adventurer, I could use your help with something. I have gotten myself into a small predicament in my travels.
The Lost#002.dst: Já que está aqui, aventureiro, você podia me ajudar com uma coisa. Me meti numa pequena enrascada nas minhas viagens.
The Lost#002.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#003.src: You see, me and three others were on a grand expedition to explore the entire canyon! Unfortunately, we ran into a slight problem...
The Lost#003.dst: Sabe, eu e mais três estávamos numa grande expedição pra explorar o cânion inteiro! Infelizmente, tivemos um probleminha...
The Lost#003.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#004.src: The {p} is clearly called that for a reason, within hours, we had lost each other!
The Lost#004.dst: {p} tem esse nome por um motivo: em poucas horas, já tínhamos nos perdido!
The Lost#004.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#005.src: Luckily, we were prepared for it. We each carried a flag so if we ever got lost, we can raise it to be found.
The Lost#005.dst: Por sorte, viemos preparados. Cada um levava uma bandeira pra erguer caso se perdesse, pra ser encontrado.
The Lost#005.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#006.src: They were all meant to come to my blue flag, but they must all be trapped in some predicament! The canyon can be a dangerous place.
The Lost#006.dst: Todos deviam vir até minha bandeira azul, mas devem estar presos em alguma enrascada! O cânion pode ser um lugar perigoso.
The Lost#006.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#007.src: I can see all three red flags from here, but it would be terrible if I went looking and they came back to this flag to find me gone!
The Lost#007.dst: Vejo as três bandeiras vermelhas daqui, mas seria terrível se eu fosse procurar e eles voltassem pra cá e não me achassem!
The Lost#007.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#008.src: Do you think you could go and check if they're all alright? I'm sure I can find some reward for you if you help!
The Lost#008.dst: Acha que pode ir ver se estão todos bem? Com certeza arrumo alguma recompensa pra você se ajudar!
The Lost#008.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#009.src: Find the three lost crew members at the red flags around [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Lost#009.dst: Encontre os três membros perdidos da expedição nas bandeiras vermelhas perto de [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Lost#011.src: HUMAN! YOU, DOWN THERE! HELP ME! I was just trying to find my way back to my friends...
The Lost#011.dst: HUMANO! VOCÊ, AÍ EMBAIXO! ME AJUDA! Eu só estava tentando voltar pros meus amigos...
The Lost#011.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#012.src: When this GIANT BIRD KIDNAPPED ME and threw me in her nest! I think she thinks I'm one of her chicks!
The Lost#012.dst: Aí este PÁSSARO GIGANTE ME RAPTOU e me jogou no ninho! Acho que ela me acha um filhote dela!
The Lost#012.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#013.src: The Canyon's movements must've dislodged her eggs from her nest-
The Lost#013.dst: Os movimentos do cânion devem ter tirado os ovos dela do ninho-
The Lost#013.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#014.src: O-OH GROOK, SHE'S PECKING ME! FIND HER EGGS NEARBY AND THROW THEM UP HERE... QUICKLY!!
The Lost#014.dst: A-AI, GROOK, ELA ESTÁ ME BICANDO! ACHA OS OVOS DELA AQUI E JOGA PRA CIMA... RÁPIDO!!
The Lost#014.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#015.src: YOU HAVE THE EGGS?? GOOD! THROW THEM UP HERE, PLEASE!!!
The Lost#015.dst: ESTÁ COM OS OVOS?? ÓTIMO! JOGA AQUI PRA CIMA, POR FAVOR!!!
The Lost#015.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#016.src: W-WOAH, STAY BACK, BIRD! I have a... uhh... I DON'T HAVE A WEAPON, HUMAN! PLEASE HURRY UP!
The Lost#016.dst: O-OPA, PRA TRÁS, PÁSSARO! Eu tenho uma... hã... NÃO TENHO ARMA, HUMANO! RÁPIDO, POR FAVOR!
The Lost#016.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#017.src: YES YES YES!!! THANK YOU, HUMAN! Oh, thank grook, this bird's leaving me alone now... It worked!
The Lost#017.dst: SIM SIM SIM!!! OBRIGADO, HUMANO! Ah, graças ao grook, o pássaro me deixou em paz... Funcionou!
The Lost#017.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#018.src: I'll head back to Dejol, now... And I'm never going to go near another bird again!
The Lost#018.dst: Vou voltar pro Dejol agora... E nunca mais chego perto de pássaro nenhum!
The Lost#018.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#019.src: A-ah, hello. I'm g-guessing Dejol sent you?
The Lost#019.dst: A-ah, olá. I-imagino que o Dejol te mandou?
The Lost#019.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#020.src: W-Well, I was just walking through the c-canyon, when... the ground suddenly rose up underneath me and launched me all the way up here!
The Lost#020.dst: B-Bom, eu só estava andando pelo c-cânion quando... o chão de repente subiu debaixo de mim e me lançou até aqui em cima!
The Lost#020.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#021.src: N-Now, I'm... embarrassed to admit it, but I'm REALLY afraid of heights, s-so I don't know what to do... Do you have any ideas?
The Lost#021.dst: A-Agora... tenho vergonha de admitir, mas tenho MUITO medo de altura, e-então não sei o que fazer... Tem alguma ideia?
The Lost#021.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#023.src: Y-YOU JERK!! I COULD HAVE DIED!!! WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH YOU???
The Lost#023.dst: S-SEU IDIOTA!! EU PODIA TER MORRIDO!!! QUAL É O SEU PROBLEMA???
The Lost#023.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#024.src: P-Please NEVER do that again! That was the worst thing I've ever done in my entire life!!
The Lost#024.dst: P-Por favor, NUNCA mais faça isso! Foi a pior coisa que já fiz na vida!!
The Lost#024.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#025.src: ...Ugh! I-I'm gonna head back to Dejol now. I hope I NEVER see you again!
The Lost#025.dst: ...Argh! V-vou voltar pro Dejol agora. Espero NUNCA mais te ver!
The Lost#025.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#026.src: Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pickle right now, you see. This house I took refuge in, well... The original owner must have left for a reason!
The Lost#026.dst: Olá! Estou numa enrascada, sabe. Esta casa onde me abriguei, bom... O dono original deve ter ido embora por um motivo!
The Lost#026.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#027.src: It's so sad... So many people are constantly displaced by the canyon's movements destroying their homes every year. I remember hearing a story once, it was about—
The Lost#027.dst: É tão triste... Tanta gente perde a casa todo ano por causa dos movimentos do cânion. Lembro de uma história que ouvi uma vez, era sobre—
The Lost#027.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#028.src: Wait... Hey, do you hear that?
The Lost#028.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#029.src: Hey! You alright down there?! Oh, lord, how are we going to get out of this? I'm up here, come find me.
The Lost#029.dst: Ei! Tudo bem aí embaixo?! Meu Deus, como vamos sair dessa? Estou aqui em cima, venha me achar.
The Lost#029.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#030.src: Oh... Well, this isn't good! The house just went and collapsed on us!
The Lost#030.dst: Ah... Bom, isso não é nada bom! A casa desabou em cima da gente!
The Lost#030.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#031.src: See what I was talking about human? The canyon isn't really a good place to be. Now we're stuck in this pit!
The Lost#031.dst: Viu do que eu falava, humano? O cânion não é bom lugar pra ficar. Agora estamos presos neste buraco!
The Lost#031.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#032.src: Although... there is a crafting table over there... Hey, maybe you could collect some supplies and make something to get us out of here?
The Lost#032.dst: Mas... tem uma bancada de trabalho ali... Ei, que tal juntar materiais e fazer algo pra nos tirar daqui?
The Lost#032.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#033.src: Heh, that's certainly one way to get out of here! You made an entire catapult, huh?
The Lost#033.dst: Heh, esse é com certeza um jeito de sair daqui! Você fez uma catapulta inteira, é?
The Lost#033.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#035.src: Alrighty, I'll be right behind you!
The Lost#035.dst: Beleza, vou logo atrás de você!
The Lost#035.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#036.src: Me first? Okay, I'll do just that!
The Lost#036.dst: Eu primeiro? Tá, é pra já!
The Lost#036.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#038.src: Hey, I made it!! You should come up as well, now.
The Lost#038.dst: Ei, consegui!! Agora suba você também.
The Lost#038.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#039.src: Woah... That's certainly a lot of fun! Anyways, come talk to me.
The Lost#039.dst: Uau... Isso é muito divertido! Enfim, venha falar comigo.
The Lost#039.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#040.src: Thanks for the help, friend! I couldn't have done it without you!
The Lost#040.dst: Obrigado pela ajuda, amigo! Eu não teria conseguido sem você!
The Lost#040.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#041.src: I'm gonna go find my friend Dejol now— wait, you know who he is??
The Lost#041.dst: Vou procurar meu amigo Dejol agora— espera, você conhece ele??
The Lost#041.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#042.src: Oh... Wow, guess it's a small world, huh? That's funny! Maybe I'll see you down there later, then!
The Lost#042.dst: Ah... Uau, o mundo é pequeno, né? Que engraçado! Então talvez te veja lá embaixo depois!
The Lost#042.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#043.src: Return to Dejol at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to tell him of your success
The Lost#043.dst: Volte a Dejol em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] para contar seu sucesso

The Lost#044.src: Ho, adventurer! Looks like you had some adventures helping out my crew!
The Lost#044.dst: Ei, aventureiro! Parece que viveu umas aventuras ajudando minha equipe!
The Lost#044.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#045.src: Thank goodness they all found their way back unharmed. Mostly. Yuge's pride seems to have taken a hit.
The Lost#045.dst: Graças a Deus todos voltaram sem ferimentos. Quase. O orgulho do Yuge parece ter levado um golpe.
The Lost#045.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#046.src: Anyway, we ought to get back to our exploration - and we'll stick closer together this time!
The Lost#046.dst: Enfim, temos que voltar à exploração - e desta vez vamos ficar mais juntos!
The Lost#046.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#047.src: You were a huge help, though so please take this as a reward!
The Lost#047.dst: Você ajudou muito, então aceite isto como recompensa!
The Lost#047.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#048.src: You should probably get down to check if she's okay.
The Lost#048.dst: Talvez você deva descer pra ver se ela está bem.

The Lost#049.src: Looks like you need [{~} Plank of Wood], [{~} Piece of Rope] and [{~} Chunk of Rock] to craft something useful.
The Lost#049.dst: Parece que você precisa de [{~} Tábua de madeira], [{~} Pedaço de corda] e [{~} Bloco de pedra] para fazer algo útil.

The Lost#050.src: Well, that's certainly one way out of here. You should talk to Gordon.
The Lost#050.dst: Bom, esse é com certeza um jeito de sair daqui. Fale com Gordon.

The Lost#051.src: So we're just gonna launch ourselves out of this pit? You got it!
The Lost#051.dst: Então a gente vai se lançar pra fora deste buraco? Pode deixar!
The Lost#051.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#052.src: Who should be launched out of the pit first?
The Lost#052.dst: Quem deve ser lançado do buraco primeiro?

The Lost#054.src: Looks like you've found all three of Dejol's crew members! You should head back to Dejol.
The Lost#054.dst: Parece que você achou os três membros da equipe de Dejol! Volte até Dejol.

The Lost#055.src: Oh, hey there! It's good to see you again. Thanks again for helping me get away from that house— though, I feel kind of bad for the owner...
The Lost#055.dst: Ah, olá! Que bom te ver de novo. Obrigado mais uma vez por me ajudar a sair daquela casa— se bem que fico com dó do dono...

The Lost#056.src: Hey, human! Thanks for helping me with the birds. I managed to sneak down once you gave me the eggs, so... All said and done, now!
The Lost#056.dst: Ei, humano! Obrigado por me ajudar com os pássaros. Consegui descer escondido depois que você me deu os ovos, então... Tudo resolvido!

The Lost#057.src: EEK! A-Are you back to throw me off another cliff, human?? Keep your distance, p-please!
The Lost#057.dst: IIH! V-Voltou pra me jogar de outro penhasco, humano?? Fique longe, p-por favor!

The Lost#058.src: Ho, adventurer! Thanks for your help again!
The Lost#058.dst: Ei, aventureiro! Obrigado de novo pela ajuda!

The Maiden Tower#000.src: Get me that urn, Win person. If I go up there covered in guts, I have reason to believe she won't take it well?
The Maiden Tower#000.dst: Traga aquela urna, pessoa de Win. Se eu subir coberto de tripas, tenho motivos pra crer que ela não vai gostar?

The Maiden Tower#002.src: I found this strange creature along the road outside the tower- it dug up from the ground.
The Maiden Tower#002.dst: Encontrei esta estranha criatura na estrada fora da torre- ela saiu cavando do chão.
The Maiden Tower#002.speaker: Diary

The Maiden Tower#003.src: It looked so spindly and thin- I decided to take it in as a pet. I've called her Fiona.
The Maiden Tower#003.dst: Parecia tão magrinha e frágil- decidi adotá-la como mascote. Dei a ela o nome de Fiona.
The Maiden Tower#003.speaker: Diary

The Maiden Tower#004.src: My father is confused as to what it is, and I am too, but it needs some loving care for certain...
The Maiden Tower#004.dst: Meu pai não sabe o que é, e eu também não, mas com certeza precisa de carinho e cuidado...
The Maiden Tower#004.speaker: Diary

The Maiden Tower#005.src: Fiona quite likes my father, it seems! I keep finding her scratching at his door.
The Maiden Tower#005.dst: Parece que a Fiona adora meu pai! Vivo achando ela arranhando a porta dele.
The Maiden Tower#005.speaker: Diary

The Maiden Tower#006.src: She seems to like to bite, too...it is a habit I'll need to train out of her, given it leaves my skin pale.
The Maiden Tower#006.dst: Ela também parece gostar de morder... é um hábito que terei que tirar dela, já que deixa minha pele pálida.
The Maiden Tower#006.speaker: Diary

The Maiden Tower#007.src: My father has died today... I found Fiona atop him. She must have been trying to comfort him...
The Maiden Tower#007.dst: Meu pai morreu hoje... Encontrei a Fiona em cima dele. Devia estar tentando consolá-lo...

The Maiden Tower#008.src: His funeral rites are being sorted. I cannot write more...at least I will have my dear pet.
The Maiden Tower#008.dst: Preparam o funeral dele. Não consigo escrever mais... ao menos terei minha querida mascote.

The Maiden Tower#009.src: ...Fiona was the problem to begin with. I feel sickly and pale, and it all started when she arrived!!
The Maiden Tower#009.dst: ...A Fiona era o problema desde o início. Me sinto doente e pálida, e começou tudo quando ela veio!!

The Maiden Tower#010.src: I didn't want to admit it- She is the reason my father died, and the reason that I look like death when I look in the mirror!!
The Maiden Tower#010.dst: Eu não queria admitir- Ela é o motivo de meu pai ter morrido, e de eu parecer a morte quando me olho no espelho!!

The Maiden Tower#011.src: The only consolation is that she seems to have disappeared on her own. Good riddance to her!
The Maiden Tower#011.dst: O único consolo é que ela parece ter sumido sozinha. Já vai tarde!

The Maiden Tower#012.src: I dearly need a man to comfort me during these times... Not even a man, anyone will do!!
The Maiden Tower#012.dst: Preciso de um homem que me console agora... Nem precisa ser homem, qualquer um serve!!

The Maiden Tower#013.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky that I'm in a...mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
The Maiden Tower#013.dst: Tá bom. Dê-se por sortudo que estou de... bom humor. Vou conversar em vez de moer seus ossos pro meu pão.
The Maiden Tower#013.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#014.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave well enough alone.
The Maiden Tower#014.dst: Ogros são durões. Gente independente e solitária. Se você não nos incomoda nem se mete na nossa vida, a gente te deixa em paz.
The Maiden Tower#014.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#015.src: And...well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a maiden's voice from inside...
The Maiden Tower#015.dst: E... bom, quando são dois ogros se juntando, é simples. Mas... passei por uma torre alta e ouvi a voz de uma donzela lá dentro...

The Maiden Tower#016.src: If you can help me out, I'd be real grateful. I'm sure I've got somethin' that you'd like in exchange.
The Maiden Tower#016.dst: Se puder me ajudar, eu ficaria muito grato. Com certeza tenho algo que você vai gostar em troca.
The Maiden Tower#016.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#017.src: Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
The Maiden Tower#017.dst: Ohoho! Um admirador? Que sotaque rústico e encantador! Porém... se quereis me conhecer, quero ver vossa devoção, sim?

The Maiden Tower#018.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to the grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
The Maiden Tower#018.dst: Havia uma linda urna que meu pai tinha. Ele a levou para o túmulo, e sinto tanta falta do meu querido pai.
The Maiden Tower#018.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#019.src: I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us...wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
The Maiden Tower#019.dst: Se eu entrar em {p}, vou ser atacado. Se me atacam, eu revido. Vão vir atrás de nós... não quero me apresentar a ela assim. Pegue essa urna pra mim, tá?

The Maiden Tower#021.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about gettin' snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
The Maiden Tower#021.dst: Já separei uma compensação pra você, então não se preocupe em ficar sem crédito. Muito obrigado pela ajuda.
The Maiden Tower#021.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#022.src: Ohoho...you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
The Maiden Tower#022.dst: Ohoho... você é um daqueles humanos de que li, não é? Queria mesmo ser meu pretendente, querido?~

The Maiden Tower#023.src: Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite, too... Oh, you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
The Maiden Tower#023.dst: Ai...meu...Deus! Um ogro grande, forte e robusto!! Nada de conto de fadas, que nada! E tão educado... Ai, vai ser um marido perfeito, hihi~

The Maiden Tower#024.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone that has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
The Maiden Tower#024.dst: Com certeza você vai achar um bom rapaz por aí que te aceite como você é, mas até achar alguém sem nenhum critério, guarde esses lábios bizarros onde eu não veja!!
The Maiden Tower#024.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#025.src: ...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior...but, you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
The Maiden Tower#025.dst: ...E-eu... a-acho que ele era podre por dentro, apesar do... e-exterior suculento... mas você vai me consolar, né, seu humano g-gostosão? Né?! NÉ?!!

The Maiden Tower#027.src: Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
The Maiden Tower#027.dst: Ah! O que faz no meu pântano?! Não sabe que ogros vivem sozinhos por um motivo?
The Maiden Tower#027.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#028.src: Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
The Maiden Tower#028.dst: Hã? Você vem do outro lado do mar, de uma terra chamada Win? Pois cara de winner você não tem, nanico.
The Maiden Tower#028.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#029.src: That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
The Maiden Tower#029.dst: Isto é, até chegar a hora de achar um par. Aí a gente move céus e terras pra ficar junto.
The Maiden Tower#029.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#030.src: Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
The Maiden Tower#030.dst: Ogros não vivem em torres de conto de fadas, nem têm uma voz tão doce que faz flores brotarem!
The Maiden Tower#030.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#031.src: I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
The Maiden Tower#031.dst: Estou tentando descobrir como abordar isso... Estou ficando velho, preciso achar alguém, e ela é a escolhida.
The Maiden Tower#031.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#032.src: Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
The Maiden Tower#032.dst: Siga o caminho pedregoso pra achar a torre. Te encontro lá- prepare-se pra ser o cupido de um ogro.
The Maiden Tower#032.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#033.src: Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#033.dst: Siga as pedras do caminho até a torre em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#034.src: This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
The Maiden Tower#034.dst: É aqui. Ela está lá no topo... Lembre-se, não paro até conhecê-la. Se veio até aqui, vai até o fim.
The Maiden Tower#034.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#035.src: I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
The Maiden Tower#035.dst: Ouço uma voz lá fora! Ah, quem será, eu me pergunto~
The Maiden Tower#035.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#036.src: Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
The Maiden Tower#036.dst: Lá vai... Olá, bela dama da torre! Sou Sherk! Ouvi sua voz na estrada- e preciso conhecê-la pessoalmente! ...isso foi formal o bastante, né?
The Maiden Tower#036.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#037.src: Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
The Maiden Tower#037.dst: Mulher, você não faz ideia do que está dizendo quando pede devoção.
The Maiden Tower#037.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#038.src: Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
The Maiden Tower#038.dst: Recuperai a urna, para eu ter uma lembrança dele. Enfrentai as criptas de {p}, atrás do banco... E provai vossa devoção, pretendente~
The Maiden Tower#038.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#039.src: ...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
The Maiden Tower#039.dst: ...Eu voltarei! Você terá sua urna, sem dúvida! ... ...e eu, um belo chute no traseiro. Não quero um massacre por um pedaço de cerâmica, pessoa de Win.
The Maiden Tower#039.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#040.src: Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#040.dst: Encontre a urna nas Catacumbas de {p}, atrás do banco de {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Maiden Tower#041.src: And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
The Maiden Tower#041.dst: É por isso que pedi sua ajuda. Por mais que sangue fique ótimo na torrada, preciso guardar meus modos para a moça.
The Maiden Tower#041.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#042.src: Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
The Maiden Tower#042.dst: Só mais uma coisa. Duvido que ela espere justo um ogro subindo a torre dela. Não quero que ela fuja de susto.
The Maiden Tower#042.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#043.src: So, Win person. Care to temper her expectations before I arrive? Head up before me.
The Maiden Tower#043.dst: Então, pessoa de Win. Baixa as expectativas dela antes de eu chegar? Vá na frente.
The Maiden Tower#043.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#044.src: Enter the tower and make Sherk confess his love to the maiden.
The Maiden Tower#044.dst: Entre na torre e faça Sherk declarar seu amor à donzela.

The Maiden Tower#045.src: Not exactly, milady! I'm the one seeking your affections- Coming up the ladder. I know I may not be a fairytale husband, but-
The Maiden Tower#045.dst: Não exatamente, milady! Quem busca seu afeto sou eu- Subindo a escada. Sei que não sou um marido de conto de fadas, mas-
The Maiden Tower#045.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#047.src: Aren't your type supposed to be less... Ehm... Clefted? Grizzled? Pale?
The Maiden Tower#047.dst: Donzelas não deviam ser menos... Hã... Queixudas? Grisalhas? Pálidas?
The Maiden Tower#047.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#048.src: Oh, come here, Sherky-pie, give me a big kiss! And no need to worry, there's plenty more in store for my big hubby after that~
The Maiden Tower#048.dst: Ai, vem cá, Sherkinho, me dá um beijão! E não se preocupe, tem muito mais guardado pro meu maridão depois disso~
The Maiden Tower#048.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#049.src: Cor, lady! Even for an ogre you're layin' it on a bit thick! Aah, you see, ogres, and people like you, they have layers, right? And your first one is... Eh... ...rotten.
The Maiden Tower#049.dst: Credo, moça! Até pra um ogro você está exagerando! Ah, veja, ogros e gente como você têm camadas, certo? E a sua primeira é... Hã... ...podre.
The Maiden Tower#049.speaker: Sherk

The Mercenary#000.src: When the corruption first broke out, undead swarmed the city. It was the first town to be destroyed by the undead.
The Mercenary#000.dst: Quando a corrupção estourou, mortos-vivos invadiram a cidade. Foi a primeira cidade destruída pelos mortos-vivos.

The Mercenary#001.src: Looks like the others have gone ahead. You should rendezvous with them closer to the barracks.
The Mercenary#001.dst: Parece que os outros foram na frente. Você deve se reunir com eles mais perto do quartel.

The Mercenary#002.src: Dang, you're right. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#002.dst: Droga, tem razão. Não dá pra esquecer o valor histórico. Bem lembrado.

The Mercenary#003.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I can count.
The Mercenary#003.dst: Já vi soldados caírem e caírem e caírem, e depois se levantarem de novo. Vivi o caos e a morte da batalha mais vezes do que consigo contar.
The Mercenary#003.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#004.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more when compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#004.dst: Acho que vou começar por vocês. O que são mais dois perto de dezenas?
The Mercenary#004.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#005.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're goin' to be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#005.dst: Então eu me rendo! Não vejo sentido em lutar uma batalha inútil. Até porque não vão pagar a gente depois dessa bagunça.
The Mercenary#005.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#009.src: Takan is dead. You should regroup with the others outside the barracks.
The Mercenary#009.dst: Takan está morto. Reagrupe-se com os outros fora do quartel.

The Mercenary#010.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a very dangerous man.
The Mercenary#010.dst: Que bom que conseguimos acabar com ele no fim. As coisas que ele dizia... parecia um homem muito perigoso.
The Mercenary#010.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#011.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan was saying, it was-
The Mercenary#011.dst: Almirante, senhor. Algumas coisas que Takan dizia, eram-
The Mercenary#011.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#012.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in that traitor's words. People like him... all they do is spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#012.dst: Eu não daria muito crédito às palavras daquele traidor. Gente como ele... só cospe veneno sem fundamento, atiçando as massas contra a ordem que mantemos.
The Mercenary#012.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#013.src: He was an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#013.dst: Era um homem amargurado, guardando rancor por uma injustiça imaginária. Não há nada além disso. Sugiro que tirem isso da cabeça.
The Mercenary#013.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#014.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters through to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#014.dst: Mas saber a região já ajuda. Vou ver se consigo fazer alguma carta chegar até ele. Obrigado por me contar.
The Mercenary#014.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#015.src: Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.
The Mercenary#015.dst: Fale com o batedor em {p} em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou encontre um em outra cidade.

The Mercenary#017.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#017.dst: O almirante Amerigo, do exército de Almuj, pede a ajuda de soldados aptos e sem destino de toda a província de Wynn.
The Mercenary#017.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#018.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#018.dst: Sendo direto... eles estão numa enrascada por lá. O exército permanente de {p} foi feito prisioneiro, e o quartel do deserto, tomado.
The Mercenary#018.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#019.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#019.dst: O almirante mandou batedores reunirem soldados livres pra ajudá-lo a... remediar a situação.
The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#020.dst: ... Se quer saber, acho que ele quer resolver isso em silêncio e com discrição. Nem o culpo, sendo as circunstâncias o que são.
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#021.dst: Enfim, se puder, vá pra lá. {p} é a cidade do deserto a leste de {p}, caso nunca tenha visto.
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#022.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#022.dst: Dito isso, vou indo! Ainda há muitos soldados pra achar. Boa sorte, se decidir atender ao chamado!
The Mercenary#022.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#023.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#023.dst: Enfim, se puder, vá ao escritório do almirante. Fica ao lado do banco, não tem erro.
The Mercenary#023.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#024.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#024.dst: Argh, pelo amor de- Estou ocupado, não está vendo? Não tenho tempo pra...
The Mercenary#024.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#025.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#025.dst: Ah. Você é soldado. Ótimo, mais um pra lista. Você falou com o batedor, imagino.
The Mercenary#025.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#026.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#026.dst: Vocês são menos do que eu esperava, mas vai ter que servir. Desça aqui, os outros já estão na sala de instruções.
The Mercenary#026.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#027.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#027.dst: Hmpf. Acho que não vamos conseguir mais soldados que isso. Muito bem!
The Mercenary#027.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#028.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#028.dst: Primeiro, a situação. O comandante Takan de {p} abandonou o posto e assumiu o comando de um grupo de bandidos locais.
The Mercenary#028.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#029.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#029.dst: Sob o comando dele, atacaram nossas tropas no meio da noite e tomaram o quartel a nordeste.
The Mercenary#029.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#030.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#030.dst: Toda a nossa força militar, capturada ou morta! Que vergonha. Mandamos mensageiros a {p}, e eles prometeram apoio...
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#031.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#031.dst: Mas quero isso resolvido rápido e em silêncio. É aí que entram vocês cinco.
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#032.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#032.dst: Vocês vão atacar e se infiltrar no quartel e assassinar nosso comandante traidor. A estratégia fica com vocês; ainda tenho muito a resolver aqui.
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#033.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#033.dst: Uma pergunta, se me permite. Sabemos o motivo do comandante para esse ataque? Não parece coisa dele.
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#034.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#034.dst: ...Não. Não me lembro de nada que motivasse um ataque desses. Mais alguma coisa?
The Mercenary#034.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#036.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#036.dst: Então preciso ir! Boa sorte, soldados. Espero um fim rápido para esse desastre.
The Mercenary#036.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#037.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#037.dst: ...Ora, essa. Bandidos parecem encrenca. Sabemos de que tipo?
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#038.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#038.dst: Faz diferença? Vamos ter que lutar com eles, seja qual for o tipo.
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#039.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#039.dst: Talvez faça, sim... Alguns bandos são mais fortes que outros. Se soubermos antes com qual estamos lidando, talvez-
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#040.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#040.dst: Já estamos parados aqui faz tempo demais. Vamos, vamos chegar mais perto do quartel. Lá a gente bola um plano.
The Mercenary#040.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#043.dst: Encontre-se com o grupo perto do quartel em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#044.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#044.dst: Ora, essa. O lugar está lotado de bandidos...
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#045.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#045.dst: Não vejo problema nenhum! É só jogar explosivos no meio deles e, bum, problema resolvido.
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#047.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#047.dst: Não dá. Você quase com certeza danificaria a construção!
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#048.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#048.dst: Ah, é. Não podemos esquecer o valor histórico. Bem notado.
The Mercenary#048.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#049.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#049.dst: ...Certo. Enfim, não acho que vamos passar por esses bandidos na força bruta. Vamos ter que achar um jeito de contorná-los...
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#050.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#050.dst: Bem, se me permitem- acho que não vou ser muito útil num combate de verdade! Perna machucada e tal. Fica difícil me mexer!
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#051.dst: Então, se entrar direto não vai dar certo, que tal eu criar uma distração? Tenho magia pra isso e seria bem mais útil aqui fora.
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#052.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#052.dst: Pode dar certo... se eu for com você, chamamos a atenção deles enquanto os outros entram por outro lado.
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#053.dst: Boa ideia. Mas como a gente entra? Acho que não tem outra entrada além daquela da frente.
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#055.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.dst: Tomara que isso não vá para onde estou pensando, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#056.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#056.dst: Tá, talvez vá. Mas escuta! Não tem entrada, certo? E se a gente fizer a nossa... explodindo um buraco na parede?
The Mercenary#056.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#057.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#057.dst: ...Tá bom, que seja. Parece que pode funcionar.
The Mercenary#057.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#059.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.dst: Exato! Você precisa confiar mais nos especialistas, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#060.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.dst: Todos temos que fazer sacrifícios, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.dst: Hm. Não, acho que eu não. De todo jeito, parece um plano. {u}, Linton e eu vamos invadir o quartel, então.
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.dst: E eu e Lanu distraímos eles enquanto isso. Parece um plano! Vamos lá.
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.dst: Ora, ora. Parece um bom lugar para abrir caminho, não acha, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.dst: Sim, Linton, serve. {u}, vamos procurar o Takan. Acho que nós dois damos conta dele.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.dst: E eu vou procurar os soldados capturados! Peguei um mapa do quartel da mesa do Amerigo, então vou achá-los fácil!
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.dst: Você-... esquece, não ligo. Só faça seu trabalho, tá?
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.dst: Droga... droga, droga, droga, droga TUDO! Nem um MOMENTO de paz, né, aquele rato do Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.dst: ...será que eu tenho mesmo que fazer tudo sozinho?! É quase como se-
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.dst: Ah, entendi. Entendi o que está acontecendo. Mais cães do Amerigo, vindo cuidar dos negócios dele, é?! Apareçam onde eu possa ver.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.dst: Vocês parecem novatos... ainda não viram a cara da Guerra de perto, não é?
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.dst: Acha isso certo? Acha certo esses MALDITOS almirantes ficarem com toda a riqueza e a fama, quando somos NÓS que lutamos nas trincheiras?!
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#078.dst: E esses IDIOTAS acham que merecem o poder deles? A autoridade?!
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#079.dst: ...Você matou dezenas e ainda mantém outras dezenas presas.
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#080.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#080.dst: E eu faria isso e mais só pra provar meu ponto! Acham que têm poder?! Vou mostrar o que é poder...
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#081.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#081.dst: Afastem-se, Shadow Spears. Quero cuidar desses cães eu mesmo.
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#087.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#087.dst: Esta torre só leva para cima... Vamos, temos que ir atrás dele! Não podemos deixá-lo fugir!
The Mercenary#087.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#088.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.
The Mercenary#088.dst: Continue subindo as escadas do quartel.

The Mercenary#091.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#091.dst: Olha, é óbvio que perdemos. Mesmo que aquele idiota fuja, vocês militares vão achá-lo.
The Mercenary#091.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#092.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#092.dst: Tomem, a chave da torre. Um sinal de boa-fé. Façam o que quiserem com ele, eu não ligo.
The Mercenary#092.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#093.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#093.dst: Eu sempre preferi o irmão dele mesmo. Bem mais quieto.
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#094.dst: Argh, mais bandidos... Eu seguro eles aqui.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#095.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#095.dst: Continue atrás do Takan! Eu fico bem!
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#096.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.
The Mercenary#096.dst: Suba a torre e acabe com Takan.

The Mercenary#097.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#097.dst: Argh... Por que eu fui subir aqui?! Não tenho para onde-
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#098.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#101.dst: ...e aí eu tinha que soltá-los de algum jeito! Então gritei pra eles se prepararem, e-
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#102.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#102.dst: {u}! Aí está você! Que bom que saiu inteiro. Parece que os bandidos estão se dispersando.
The Mercenary#102.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#103.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#103.dst: E o fio da minha história também. Então! Pegaram ele?
The Mercenary#103.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#104.src: He's dead. I have his badge.

The Mercenary#105.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#105.dst: Bom saber. Pelo menos algo de bom saiu de toda essa situação...
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#106.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#106.dst: Ah, de novo não. Você ainda está nessa?
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#107.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#107.dst: Ouvi umas coisas que ele gritava lá de fora. Não pareciam nada agradáveis.
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#108.src:
Lanu:
Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#108.dst:
Lanu:
Tem gente que liga pra história, Mel.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#109.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#109.dst: Bom, eu não ouvi nada. Deve ser o zumbido nos ouvidos. Mas parece que terminamos aqui, né?
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#110.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#110.dst: Parece que sim. Acho que vou ficar para ajudar os soldados a limpar os bandidos que restam.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#111.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#111.dst: Acho que vou ficar também. Não tenho nada melhor pra fazer agora mesmo!
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#112.dst: Bom, vou nessa. Tenho lugares pra ir! Coisas pra fazer! Explosivos pra devolver! Tchau!
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#113.dst: {u}, acho que sobrou pra nós dois voltar a {p} com a notícia! Vamos lá.
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#114.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Mercenary#114.dst: Leve o distintivo de Takan até Amerigo em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#115.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#115.dst: Soldados! Relatório! Não me digam que só vocês dois sobreviveram, droga...
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#116.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#116.dst: Não, senhor, a missão deu certo. Takan está morto.
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#117.dst: Têm certeza? Estão com o distintivo dele, não...?
The Mercenary#117.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#118.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#118.dst: Entendo... trabalho satisfatório, soldados. Vocês e os outros têm a gratidão de {p}.
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#119.dst: Todos serão bem pagos pelo trabalho de hoje. Agora, podem ir. Tenho que buscar meu distintivo de honra por eliminar o ex-comandante Takan.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#120.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#120.dst: Agora entendo por que Takan o odiava tanto.
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#121.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#121.dst: Acho que... vou falar disso com o almirante Aegis quando estiver em {p}.
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#122.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#122.dst: Enfim! Que aventura, hein? Mal posso esperar para contar ao Tasim.
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#123.dst: ...Por falar nele. Teve notícias dele? Não consigo falar com ele de jeito nenhum.
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#124.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#124.dst: Que estranho. Soube que ele estava em {p}, mas não está mais.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#125.src: He went off to Gavel, I thin
The Mercenary#125.dst: Ele foi para Gavel, acho q

The Mercenary#126.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#126.dst: Ele- o quê? Sério? E nem me contou...
The Mercenary#126.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#127.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#127.dst: ...Deve ter esquecido. Tudo bem. Todo mundo anda ocupado por aqui, né?
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#129.dst: Bom, deve estar tudo bem. Uma hora ele aparece! Só precisamos esperar.
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#130.dst: Para onde será que ele foi? Alguma missão em {p}, talvez? Ou será que foi para Gavel...?
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#131.dst: Bom, tanto faz. Foi bom te rever! Mesmo que... bem. Mesmo que tenha sido estranho.
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#133.dst: Bom, acho que vou indo. A gente se vê, {u}!
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Missing Piece#000.src: It says it's for 'the woman on the hill'.
The Missing Piece#000.dst: Diz que é para 'a mulher da colina'.

The Missing Piece#003.src: I have some letters that are addressed to you.
The Missing Piece#003.dst: Tenho umas cartas endereçadas a você.

The Missing Piece#004.src: Move and rotate the selected beam using the directional buttons.
The Missing Piece#004.dst: Mova e gire a viga selecionada com os botões de direção.

The Missing Piece#005.src: You could either confront them or talk to Elise about what to do.
The Missing Piece#005.dst: Você pode confrontá-los ou falar com Elise sobre o que fazer.

The Missing Piece#007.src: It would be best to get the bread and get out of this place quickly.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: O melhor é pegar o pão e sair logo deste lugar.

The Missing Piece#008.src: You are already carrying a bottle.
The Missing Piece#008.dst: Você já está carregando uma garrafa.

The Missing Piece#009.src: The handwriting seems familiar. But, it doesn't say much...
The Missing Piece#009.dst: A letra parece familiar. Mas não diz muita coisa...

The Missing Piece#010.src: Throw a Bottle by {#} RIGHT-CLICKING to aim and then {#} RIGHT-CLICKING again to throw.
The Missing Piece#010.dst: Lance uma garrafa: {#} CLIQUE DIREITO para mirar, outro {#} CLIQUE DIREITO para lançar.

The Missing Piece#012.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#012.dst: Após nocautear,  CLIQUE DIREITO para revistar operários.

The Missing Piece#013.src: Now, how to get up from here...

The Missing Piece#014.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
The Missing Piece#014.dst: Deve ser o cano de que o Bush falou...

The Missing Piece#015.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#015.dst: Hm... Não tem remetente... São todas da mesma pessoa?

The Missing Piece#016.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#016.dst: Pegue sua correspondência na agência dos correios em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#018.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: Não vê que estou ocupado!? Pegue uma senha e espere na fila como deve! Não importa se não há mais ninguém, siga o protocolo!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: Dá para atravessar este vão arrumando as vigas suspensas num caminho.

The Missing Piece#020.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#020.dst: Ah, sim! As cartas. Que cabeça, quase esqueci.

The Missing Piece#022.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#022.dst: Pegue uma senha na máquina de senhas em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#023.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: Você tem que pegar uma senha, igual a todo mundo!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#024.dst: Volte à agência dos correios em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#027.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#027.dst: Já te atendo! Nossa, que impaciência hoje em dia...
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#028.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#028.dst: Já cansou de esperar? Pois alguém resolveu deixar isto uma bagunça para quando eu voltasse!
The Missing Piece#028.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#029.dst: Volto ao escritório ontem de umas merecidas e breves férias de dezoito semanas. E é assim que me agradecem?!
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: Vê a bagunça que meu substituto deixou aqui? E agora eu tenho que arrumar, ou o Inspetor Real arranca minha cabeça!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.dst: Fique sabendo que me formei com honras na Universidade Real de Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#032.dst: Sinceramente, é humilhante me largarem aqui com os... argh... camponeses! Ah, e nem me fale do cheiro!
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#033.dst: Mas enfim, isso não vem ao caso. O que você queria mesmo?
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#034.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#034.dst: É você! Você é quem deixei no comando nas minhas férias, seu patife!
The Missing Piece#034.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#036.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#036.dst: Eu sabia! Um formado como eu jamais poderia estar errado!
The Missing Piece#036.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#038.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#038.dst: Não tente escapar dessa! Um formado como eu jamais poderia estar errado!
The Missing Piece#038.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#041.dst: Não sou só eu que vou me encrencar quando vier a inspeção, você percebe isso, né?
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#043.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#043.dst: Se você arrumar a bagunça que fez... Ninguém nunca vai saber de nada.
The Missing Piece#043.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#044.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#044.dst: Você não se encrenca, o Inspetor Real fica feliz, eu fico feliz. Todo mundo feliz!
The Missing Piece#044.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#048.dst: Então vai separar cartas como se sua vida dependesse disso, patife!
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.dst: Siga o chefe dos correios até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#052.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#052.dst: Separar é tão fácil que até alguém como você deve conseguir.
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#053.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#053.dst: Você só pega os pacotes daquela esteira ali.
The Missing Piece#053.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#054.dst: E coloca onde eles devem ir, ali.
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#055.dst: Pacotes de {p} para {p}, de Auburn para {p}, e por aí vai.
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: Fantástico! Só não faça bagunça, tá?
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#061.dst: Bom, isso foi só o aquecimento! Tem mais, então não vá fazer corpo mole agora!
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: Hmm... Desta vez foi bem, mas cuidado, porque esses últimos pacotes vêm rápido!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#063.dst: Não se ache grande coisa só porque sabe separar uns pacotes!
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#064.dst: O que você está fazendo aí!?
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: Argh! Tente de novo, e desta vez faça direito!
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#066.dst: Não me incomode enquanto trabalho! Não fiz faculdade pra ficar de bobeira com gente como você!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.dst: Siga as instruções do chefe dos correios.

The Missing Piece#068.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#068.dst: Ah, perfeito! Você separou os pacotes!
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#069.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#069.dst: Mas espere, o que é isso, então? Por que tantos pacotes para {p}?
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#070.dst: Você errou a separação, seu tonto!?
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#071.dst: O que há com esses pacotes! Estão cheios de cartas?
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: Hmpf... todos para a mulher da colina... Seja lá o que isso for!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#073.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#073.dst: Ei, você, patife. Isto também faz parte do seu dever, sabia?
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#074.dst: Vá entregar estas cartas! Ou... ou conto ao Inspetor Real o que você fez! Isso mesmo, não mexa comigo!
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#075.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#075.dst: Como vou saber! Descobrir é trabalho seu. Olha, aqui diz 'para a mulher da colina', isso deve bastar, não?
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#076.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#076.dst: Ah, mas está! Tenho muitíssimos amigos, em posições muito altas! Conheci na faculdade, não se esqueça disso!
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#077.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: Ótimo! Resolvido isso, posso enfim voltar ao meu trabalho importantíssimo.
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#078.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#078.dst: Ah, sim. Importantíssimo. Formado na universidade, já mencionei?
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#079.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#079.dst: Vamos, vamos, pode ir. E não volte chorando se não achar essa mulher misteriosa!
The Missing Piece#079.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#080.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#080.dst: Mas se perder a carta sempre posso te dar outra, elas parecem praticamente infinitas mesmo!
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#081.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#081.dst: Descubra algo sobre a mulher da colina perto de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#082.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#082.dst: Está tentando fazer corpo mole? Ainda está com a carta, vá entregá-la!
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#083.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#084.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#084.dst: Não pense que vai escapar! Tenho de sobra!
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#085.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#085.dst: Agora vá resolver isso pra mim, sim? Já tenho preocupações demais sem você fazendo trapalhada!
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#087.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: Procurando alguém, é? Por aqui quem costuma fazer isso são as latas-velhas.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#088.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#088.dst: Uma visita de uma dessas e você ganha férias com tudo pago pela Coroa, se é que me entende.
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#089.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#089.dst: Olha, se fosse o Lars que você procura, eu entregava ele feliz, mas você ainda não disse quem é.
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#090.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#090.dst: Colina por aqui tem de monte, mulher também. Mas elas estão nas fábricas, ralando, não em colina nenhuma que eu saiba.
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#091.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#091.dst: Foi mal, camarada, nessa não posso ajudar. Pergunta pro Lars, ele vive monopolizando a fogueira no beco atrás de mim. Odeio aquele cara...
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#093.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#093.dst: Já te contei tudo, não contei? Vá encher o Lars, não tenho mais nada a dizer.
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#095.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#095.dst: Procuro alguém chamada 'a mulher da colina'. Tenho uma carta para entregar a ela.
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#096.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#096.dst: Uma carta? Num sei nada de mulher da colina nenhuma, mas talvez o Bush ali saiba.
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#097.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#097.dst: Ele costuma saber das coisas... É um sabedor.
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#098.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#098.dst: Mas não fala muito tempo com ele, senão ele começa a pôr ideias estranhas na sua cabeça...
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#100.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#100.dst: Pergunta pro Bush. Já disse que num sei nada.
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#101.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#101.dst: Sou o Bush, prazer. Há algo que deseja saber?
The Missing Piece#101.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#103.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#103.dst: Ah, ela... Este arbusto a conhece bem até demais!
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#104.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#104.dst: Sem ela este arbusto murcharia! Arbusto precisa de água pra crescer. Eu sei, eu sei!
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#105.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#105.dst: Mas antes preciso saber por que precisa saber! Sabe?
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#106.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#106.dst: Uma carta! Se este Bush pudesse saber o que diz... Ai, saber seria uma grosseria...
The Missing Piece#106.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#107.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#107.dst: Entregar cartas, sem dúvida um ofício nobre. Vou te dizer onde ela está, mas em troca diga a ela: o amigo dela voltou à cidade.
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#108.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#108.dst: Tome, deixe eu anotar para você!
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#109.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#110.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#110.dst: Saber por que preciso saber? Nem eu sei... Só sei que preciso saber!
The Missing Piece#110.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#111.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#111.dst: De novo, diga por que precisa saber.
The Missing Piece#111.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#112.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#112.dst: Nada? Que existia gente assim, eu não sabia! Agora sei, agora sei!
The Missing Piece#112.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#115.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#115.dst: Correio? Deve ser a casa errada, querido.
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#117.dst: Bom, se está escrito na carta...
The Missing Piece#117.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#120.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#120.dst: Não costumo receber muitas visitas aqui na colina.
The Missing Piece#120.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.dst: Siga a mulher para dentro até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#125.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#125.dst: Coloque as cartas na mesa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#128.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: Acho que preciso olhar isso de perto.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#129.dst: Por favor, sente-se. Vou preparar algo para beber.
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#131.dst: Você não parece ser daqui, não é?
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#132.dst: Hmm? Bom, não devo bisbilhotar segredos de convidados. Melhor deixar o inexplicável em paz, ha. Não acha?
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#133.dst: Aqui em Roughworks não temos segredos. Pelo menos é o que Sua Majestade quer acreditar, ha.
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#134.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#134.dst: Por isso escolhi morar aqui. Nos bairros, as paredes são mais finas que papel. Tudo se ouve.
The Missing Piece#134.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#135.dst: Aqui em cima na colina é bem mais tranquilo. Desde que a Autoridade das Águas não venha bater, ha.
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#136.dst: Bom, já que está aqui, que tal conversarmos um pouco? Não tem muita gente pra conversar aqui em cima!
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#137.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#137.dst: Pegue o regador lá fora em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#138.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#138.dst: O regador está bem ali fora, no jardim. Há três plantas aqui dentro e três lá fora.
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#139.dst: Regue as plantas de Elise enquanto ela lê as cartas.

The Missing Piece#141.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#141.dst: Ai, que confusão... tentar entender isso está me dando dor de cabeça.
The Missing Piece#141.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#142.dst: Tantas cartas, por tantos anos... quem insistiria tanto em falar comigo?
The Missing Piece#142.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#143.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#143.dst: Hm? Ah, já terminou de regar as plantas? Que rápido!
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#144.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#144.dst: Bom, assim eu não avanço nada, e parece que nós dois precisamos de uma pausa.
The Missing Piece#144.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#145.dst: Ah, está um dia tão lindo hoje... Que tal irmos lá fora aproveitar o jardim um pouco?
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#146.dst: Siga Elise para fora e sente-se em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#148.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#148.dst: Está mesmo lindo hoje, não está?
The Missing Piece#148.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#149.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#149.dst: Ah... flores recém-regadas. Nada supera esse cheiro.
The Missing Piece#149.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#150.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#150.dst: Hm. Está vendo aquela árvore ali?
The Missing Piece#150.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#151.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#151.dst: É a única da espécie em toda Roughworks. Não é linda?
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#152.dst: Foi um presente, mas de quem... É outra coisa que esqueci.
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#153.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
