The Missing Piece#153.dst: É frustrante, tão frustrante... Tantas lembranças preciosas...
The Missing Piece#153.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#155.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#155.dst: Agora não é grande coisa, isso é certo.

The Missing Piece#156.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#156.dst: Bom. Já é linda, não acha?
The Missing Piece#156.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#158.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#158.dst: Ha! Claro que vai, é uma árvore!
The Missing Piece#158.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#159.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: Ah, sabe que não foi o que eu quis dizer.

The Missing Piece#160.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#160.dst: A cada ano que passa... esta árvore vai ficar mais alta, e cada vez mais linda.

The Missing Piece#161.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#161.dst: Vai ter que aguentar muitas tempestades, e alguns dias talvez até ficar sem água. E mesmo assim, vai continuar crescendo.

The Missing Piece#163.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#163.dst: E daqui a dez, quinze, talvez até vinte e cinco anos... vamos enfim poder descansar à sombra dela.

The Missing Piece#164.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#164.dst: Vinte e cinco anos!? Seremos velhas!
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#165.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy. Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#165.dst: Ah, já sei! Podíamos fazer um piquenique sob a copa dela. Não parece bom, {u}?
The Missing Piece#165.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#166.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#166.dst: ... Parece. Parece bom mesmo, Elise. Talvez possamos.

The Missing Piece#167.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#167.dst: Vai, dê mais água. Ou ela nunca vai crescer nem um dedo!

The Missing Piece#171.dst: Deixa pra lá. Não é nada...

The Missing Piece#172.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#172.dst: Só estava pensando... Se um dia eu morrer, queria ser enterrada aqui, debaixo da árvore.

The Missing Piece#173.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#173.dst: Hã? O que te faz pensar nessas bobagens? Ainda temos uma vida longa pela frente, não temos?
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#174.dst: Claro, tem razão. Desculpe, só não estou acostumada a isso...

The Missing Piece#177.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#177.dst: Vamos só aproveitar o sol um pouco. Amanhã tem trabalho de novo.
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#178.dst: Ah... Ha, o que foi isso...?
The Missing Piece#178.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#180.dst: Hm. Acho que vou deixar as preocupações para outro dia. Hoje é um bom dia... não é dia de se preocupar.
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#181.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#181.dst: Aliás, hoje está bonito demais para desperdiçar... ficando parada, quero dizer. Não acha?
The Missing Piece#181.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#182.dst: Siga Elise até o telhado em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#183.dst: Ah... Está vendo aquela fábrica lá longe? Eu trabalhava lá, quando era mais nova...
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#184.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#184.dst: Fazíamos pão em massa pras regiões altas... Trabalho maçante, e ingrato também.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#185.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#185.dst: Você já deve ter notado, mas as coisas por aqui não são fáceis. Tem gente que chega a roubar quando a coisa aperta...
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#186.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#186.dst: Por sorte... nunca precisei. De vez em quando deixavam a gente levar um pouco pra casa.
The Missing Piece#186.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#187.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: Eram bons tempos. Nessas ocasiões, fazíamos um piquenique, eu e- hm. Só eu, acho.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#188.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#188.dst: Pena que é tão difícil de conseguir... os roubos viraram um problema sério, sabe. A Coroa acabou construindo um cofre sob a fábrica para guardar tudo!
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#189.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure.
The Missing Piece#189.dst: Pena que é tão difícil de conseguir... os roubos viraram um problema sério, sabe. A Coroa acabou construindo um cofre sob a fábrica para guardar tudo.
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#190.src: The door is locked. A note is plastered on the front.
The Missing Piece#190.dst: A porta está trancada. Há um bilhete colado na frente.

The Missing Piece#191.src: Now to find a way inside without being caught...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: Agora, achar um jeito de entrar sem ser pego...

The Missing Piece#192.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.dst: Quanto tempo desde a última vez? Anos, com certeza... aquele pão nunca chega a nós, os pobres, ha!
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#193.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#193.dst: Mas seria bom provar de novo, acho... relembrar os velhos tempos.
The Missing Piece#193.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#194.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#194.dst: Bom, já que está fazendo favores pra mim... se importa de ver se consegue um ou dois pães?
The Missing Piece#194.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#195.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#195.dst: É caro, mas pelo preço certo... tenho certeza de que você consegue algum. Você não parece do tipo que sofre com essas coisas, não é, carteiro?
The Missing Piece#195.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#196.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#196.dst: Ha! Bom, faça o que puder, de todo jeito. Quando voltar, tenho um plano para hoje. Que tal?
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#197.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#197.dst: Tente entrar na Fábrica de Pão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#198.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#198.dst: Ah, não... Você sabe! Você sabe! Fale antes com aquele condestável e talvez eu conte mais.
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#199.dst: Se veio mendigar, pode ir embora.
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#201.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#201.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#203.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make the bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#203.dst: Tenho cara de máquina de venda? Vá procurar em outro lugar. Aqui só fazemos o pão, não vendemos.
The Missing Piece#203.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#204.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#204.dst: Cai fora, amigo, não devia ficar zanzando por aí sob a vigia de um condestável.
The Missing Piece#204.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#205.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#205.dst: Mas, mas, mas! Nada de mas. Não me obrigue a fazer algo! A papelada é sempre um saco...
The Missing Piece#205.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#207.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#207.dst: Claro que não... Já temos problemas demais, com o barril roubado semana passada... E as cotas de produção...
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#208.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#208.dst: Você não tem nada melhor pra fazer, não?
The Missing Piece#208.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#210.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#212.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#212.dst: Sabia? Sabia? Há mais de um jeito de entrar em qualquer prédio.
The Missing Piece#212.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#213.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#213.dst: Vou te contar! Mas roubar não é ético, você precisa saber!
The Missing Piece#213.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#214.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#214.dst: Desde que ela não saiba! Ela não vai saber! Entendeu?
The Missing Piece#214.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#215.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#215.dst: Fica logo ali na esquina. Um cano! Agora você sabe! Agora você sabe!
The Missing Piece#215.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#216.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#216.dst: Entre na Fábrica de Pão pelo cano em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#217.dst: Entre de novo na Fábrica de Pão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#218.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#218.dst: Ache um jeito de entrar no Cofre de Pão pelo elevador em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#220.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#220.dst: Hã? Isso não é resposta! Diga quem você é ou eu mesmo vou olhar! E nunca esqueço um rosto, lembre-se disso!
The Missing Piece#220.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#221.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#221.dst: O que um operário faz no meu escritório!? Diga quem você é ou eu mesmo vou olhar! E nunca esqueço um rosto, lembre-se disso!
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#223.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#223.dst: Bem, obrigado por me avisar! Vou investigar o assunto imediatamente!
The Missing Piece#223.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#225.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#225.dst: Atravesse o Cofre de Pão até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#226.dst: Ache um jeito de subir até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#227.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: Acerte as garrafas em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] com uma garrafa.

The Missing Piece#228.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#228.dst: Continue pelo Cofre de Pão até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#229.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#229.dst: Use as vigas para atravessar até [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#231.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#231.dst: ...e conforme nossos protocolos, vamos exigir um registro detalhado dessa ex-funcionária. Anos de serviço, contatos conhecidos, desempenho... tudo.
The Missing Piece#231.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#232.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#232.dst: Naturalmente, colaborarei como puder, bendita seja Sua Graça. Mas pensar que o simples furto de uma caixa chegaria a um nível tão alto...
The Missing Piece#232.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#233.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#233.dst: A caixa não importa. É a funcionária que nos interessa. Outras medidas podem ser necessárias, mas os registros bastam para começar.
The Missing Piece#233.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#234.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#234.dst: ...só a funcionária? Perdoe as perguntas, mas não entendo por que ela interessa à senhora.
The Missing Piece#234.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#235.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#235.dst: Cabe a nós saber, e ao senhor obedecer. Mas diz respeito a uma possível falha de segurança que estamos investigando.
The Missing Piece#235.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#236.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#236.dst: Na minha fábrica? O que está insinuando!?
The Missing Piece#236.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#237.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#237.dst: Não insinuo nada. Preciso lembrá-lo da sua posição? Estou aqui hoje pela vontade de Sua Majestade. Quer mesmo se opor a ela?
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#238.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#238.dst: Eu... Peço humildes desculpas... Não quis-
The Missing Piece#238.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#240.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#240.dst: S-sim, claro. Mas, ainda assim, achei que esse assunto tinha sido encerrado anos atrás! Que ligação poderia ter com-
The Missing Piece#240.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#241.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#241.dst: Chega de rodeios. Meu tempo é curto. Busque os registros dessa tal Elise, imediatamente.
The Missing Piece#241.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#242.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#242.dst: E-entendido, senhora... Vou buscá-los agora mesmo.
The Missing Piece#242.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#243.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#243.dst: Pegue o pão do barril em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#244.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#244.dst: Encontre a saída do Cofre de Pão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#245.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#245.dst: Ora, ora, ora... parece que os ratos não são a única praga deste lugar.
The Missing Piece#245.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#246.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was a dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#246.dst: E eu achando que essa pista não daria em nada! Só registros de anos atrás que não diziam nada que já não soubéssemos... sempre um risco, mas valia conferir.
The Missing Piece#246.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#247.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#247.dst: E aqui está você. Um dos mais procurados da província. Que coincidência estranha, te achar aqui.
The Missing Piece#247.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#248.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#248.dst: Fico pensando... por qual motivo você está aqui?
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#249.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#249.dst: Sei que não devo esperar resposta. Mas no fim não importa. Vamos arrancar isso de você uma hora ou outra.
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#253.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#253.dst: Volte a Roughworks pelo cano em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#254.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#254.dst: Enfrente a inspeção ou fale com Elise em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#255.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#255.dst: Ah, é a Autoridade das Águas! Não sei por que vieram... mas boa coisa não pode ser.
The Missing Piece#255.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#256.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#256.dst: Abra logo! Sabemos que está aí dentro!
The Missing Piece#256.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#257.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#257.dst: Sério, você devia se esconder. Tudo bem, já lidei com gente assim. Eu os mando embora.
The Missing Piece#257.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#259.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#260.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#260.dst: Um segundo! Vou me esconder atrás da planta!
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#264.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#264.dst: Um amigo, é? Então sabe me dizer por que ela não atende a porta!
The Missing Piece#264.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#266.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#266.dst: Alguém como eu!? O que quer dizer com isso?
The Missing Piece#266.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#267.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#267.dst: Ah, vai pagar por esse insulto! Temos autoridade pra impor nossas ordens à força, sabia? Podemos fazer o que quisermos!
The Missing Piece#267.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#269.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#269.dst: Não está em casa, é? Que conveniente. Justo quando a inspeção chega, não está para nos receber!
The Missing Piece#269.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#270.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#270.dst: Até parece que alguém avisou, não acha?
The Missing Piece#270.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#271.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#271.dst: Diga, amigo, você avisou a pessoa de que viríamos?
The Missing Piece#271.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#272.dst: Muito bem, então. Mas ainda precisamos entrar para fazer a busca.
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#273.dst: Se não vai ajudar, é melhor sair do nosso caminho!
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#274.dst: Na fábrica de pão? Não é problema nosso, somos a Autoridade das Águas, não do Pão!
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#275.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#275.dst: Um vazamento enorme de água, é!?
The Missing Piece#275.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#276.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#276.dst: E não está inventando? Não gostamos de mentirosos, fique sabendo.
The Missing Piece#276.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#277.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#277.dst: Inspetora, parece haver uma confusão na Fábrica de Pão.
The Missing Piece#277.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#278.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#278.dst: Hmm... Bom, nesse caso, teremos que verificar. Obrigada pela informação, cidadão.
The Missing Piece#278.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#279.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#279.dst: De passagem! Até parece! Achou mesmo que eu ia cair nessa?
The Missing Piece#279.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#280.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#280.dst: Viemos fazer uma busca. Seu consumo de água excedeu a cota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#280.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#283.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#283.dst: Muito bem. Agora vamos inspecionar sua propriedade. Saia da frente, súdita.
The Missing Piece#283.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#284.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#284.dst: O que é isto? Não admira que exceda o limite de água, tendo plantas ilícitas!
The Missing Piece#284.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#285.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#285.dst: Espere aí... Tem alguém escondido ali atrás! Disse que estava sozinha!
The Missing Piece#285.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#288.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#288.dst: Nããããão, Alphonse! Como... Como pôde fazer isso!?
The Missing Piece#288.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#289.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#289.dst: Vai pagar por isso, seu rato! Em nome de Sua Majestade!
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#290.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and-
The Missing Piece#290.dst: Você está bem!? Ouvi uma confusão, e-
The Missing Piece#290.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#292.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#292.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#294.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#294.dst: Mas que estranho... As autoridades nunca me incomodaram... Ah, vamos entrar por enquanto.
The Missing Piece#294.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#295.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#295.dst: Ache um lugar para se esconder na casa de Elise!

The Missing Piece#298.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#298.dst: Pronto. Agora, que assunto as autoridades de Sua Majestade teriam com esta velhinha?
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#299.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#299.dst: Viemos fazer uma busca. Seu consumo de água excedeu a cota autorizada.
The Missing Piece#299.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#303.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#303.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#304.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#304.dst: Diga, prefere que vasculhemos antes o andar de baixo ou o de cima?
The Missing Piece#304.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#305.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#305.dst: Que gentileza perguntar... mas como não há nada de interesse em lugar nenhum, sugiro que comecem achando um motivo para sair da minha casa.
The Missing Piece#305.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#306.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#306.dst: Não quero fazer vocês perderem tempo, só isso.
The Missing Piece#306.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#307.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#307.dst: O andar de baixo, então. Obrigada pela cooperação.
The Missing Piece#307.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#310.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#310.dst: Ah, qual é o problema de vocês!?
The Missing Piece#310.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#311.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#311.dst: Trabalhei a vida toda nas fábricas! Não posso ter umas flores pra me fazer companhia na velhice?
The Missing Piece#311.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#312.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#312.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#314.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#314.dst: Que gentileza perguntar... mas como lá em cima é meu quarto, prefiro que não inspecionem meus lençóis.
The Missing Piece#314.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#315.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#315.dst: O andar de cima, então. Obrigada pela cooperação.
The Missing Piece#315.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#316.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#316.dst: Que pitoresco. Não fica solitário, morar aqui em cima sozinha?
The Missing Piece#316.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#318.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#318.dst: Enfim, devo informar que você violou o regulamento de uso de água e terá que-
The Missing Piece#318.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#320.src: Well, seems you're in luck this time, subject.
The Missing Piece#320.dst: Bem, parece que desta vez você teve sorte, súdita.
The Missing Piece#320.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#321.src: Some higher authority has overruled our command... we're being recalled.
The Missing Piece#321.dst: Uma autoridade superior anulou nossa ordem... fomos chamados de volta.
The Missing Piece#321.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#322.src: But don't be mistaken. We'll be back!
The Missing Piece#322.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#323.src: Well, you won't be welcome next time!
The Missing Piece#323.dst: Pois da próxima vez não serão bem-vindos!
The Missing Piece#323.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#324.src: Nuisances, all of them... Well, it worked out in the end, didn't it?
The Missing Piece#324.dst: Uns chatos, todos eles... Bom, no fim deu certo, não deu?
The Missing Piece#324.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#325.src: They're gone, you can come out now.
The Missing Piece#325.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#326.src: Come, let's sit down and have a talk.
The Missing Piece#326.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#327.src: Right! The bread! So forgetful these days...
The Missing Piece#327.dst: Isso! O pão! Ando tão esquecida...
The Missing Piece#327.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#328.src: Well? How did it go? Did you get any? I hope it wasn't too much trouble...
The Missing Piece#328.dst: E então? Como foi? Conseguiu? Espero que não tenha dado muito trabalho...
The Missing Piece#328.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#329.src: Oh, wonderful. Thank you. That should be everything we need...
The Missing Piece#329.dst: Ah, maravilha. Obrigada. Deve ser tudo de que precisamos...
The Missing Piece#329.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#331.src: Well, if there was no other way... If the Authority is going to stomp in here looking for plants, taking a loaf of bread in return seems like a fair deal!
The Missing Piece#331.dst: Bom, se não tinha outro jeito... Se a Autoridade pode entrar aqui pisando forte atrás de plantas, levar um pão em troca parece justo!
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#333.src: Ah... How nostalgic. It really does bring me back to those good old days.
The Missing Piece#333.dst: Ah... Que nostalgia. Me leva mesmo de volta àqueles bons tempos.
The Missing Piece#333.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#334.src: There was one time though... We... No, I bought it... Argh, why can't I remember!
The Missing Piece#334.dst: Mas teve uma vez... Nós... Não, eu comprei... Argh, por que não lembro!
The Missing Piece#334.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#335.src: How strange... Again, this feeling... As if- as if there's something I should be remembering... but can't.
The Missing Piece#335.dst: Que estranho... De novo essa sensação... Como se- como se eu devesse lembrar de algo... mas não consigo.
The Missing Piece#335.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#337.src: Do you remember how we first met? All those years ago?
The Missing Piece#337.dst: Lembra como nos conhecemos? Tantos anos atrás?

The Missing Piece#338.src: Of course I do! But... thinking about it now, maybe I was a bit... cold.
The Missing Piece#338.dst: Claro! Mas... pensando agora, talvez eu tenha sido meio... fria.
The Missing Piece#338.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#339.src: You were fine! You were the only one who...
The Missing Piece#339.dst: Você foi ótima! Você foi a única que...

The Missing Piece#341.src: You were the only one who even noticed I was there.
The Missing Piece#341.dst: Você foi a única que notou que eu estava ali.

The Missing Piece#342.src: Ah- hello. I'm {u}, I'm new here. Nice to meet you.
The Missing Piece#342.dst: Ah- oi. Sou {u}, sou nova aqui. Prazer em te conhecer.

The Missing Piece#343.src: The name's Elise, do a good job and I'm sure we'll get along.
The Missing Piece#343.dst: Meu nome é Elise. Faça um bom trabalho e vamos nos dar bem.
The Missing Piece#343.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#344.src: Right, yes. Of course... I'll try my best!
The Missing Piece#344.dst: Certo, sim. Claro... Vou me esforçar!

The Missing Piece#345.src: ... You know what, have this. It'll help you get through the day.
The Missing Piece#345.dst: ... Quer saber, fique com isto. Vai te ajudar a aguentar o dia.
The Missing Piece#345.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#349.src: Really? I was only working there for a month!
The Missing Piece#349.dst: Sério? Eu só trabalhei lá um mês!

The Missing Piece#350.src: Oh, sure... but it was a good month, wasn't it?
The Missing Piece#350.dst: Ah, claro... mas foi um bom mês, não foi?
The Missing Piece#350.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#351.src: And even after you were transferred away... I had something to look forward to at the end of my shifts.
The Missing Piece#351.dst: E mesmo depois que te transferiram... eu tinha algo pelo que esperar no fim do turno.
The Missing Piece#351.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#352.src: Ah... well... now you have something to look forward to when you come home, as well.
The Missing Piece#352.dst: Ah... bom... agora você também tem algo pelo que esperar quando volta pra casa.

The Missing Piece#353.src: Ha! I guess I do, don't I...
The Missing Piece#353.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#354.src: But it all seems so small from up here... doesn't it? Just look at the view!
The Missing Piece#354.dst: Mas tudo parece tão pequeno daqui de cima... não é? Olha só a vista!
The Missing Piece#354.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#355.src: It really is beautiful... up here, it's like nothing else matters except for us.
The Missing Piece#355.dst: É lindo mesmo... aqui em cima, é como se nada mais importasse além de nós.

The Missing Piece#356.src: ...I wish we could stay like this forever...
The Missing Piece#356.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#357.src: ...oh. So do I, Elise... so do I...

The Missing Piece#358.src: Ha, but why do you sound so sad?
The Missing Piece#358.dst: Ha, mas por que essa voz triste?
The Missing Piece#358.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#360.src: It's nothing... we'll stay like this... forever. I promise.
The Missing Piece#360.dst: Não é nada... vamos ficar assim... pra sempre. Prometo.

The Missing Piece#361.src: Her, again... Who is she? Why am I remembering these things?
The Missing Piece#361.dst: Ela, de novo... Quem é ela? Por que lembro dessas coisas?
The Missing Piece#361.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#363.src: Well, there's nothing that can be done about it now, is there? Say, why don't we head out?
The Missing Piece#363.dst: Bom, não há nada a fazer agora, não é? Diga, que tal sairmos?
The Missing Piece#363.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#364.src: Oh, dear. Did I forget to tell you? The bread is for a picnic!
The Missing Piece#364.dst: Ai, nossa. Esqueci de te contar? O pão é para um piquenique!
The Missing Piece#364.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#365.src: I know the perfect place... in fact, you reminded me of it. It has a view over the entire Roughworks, can you believe that?
The Missing Piece#365.dst: Conheço o lugar perfeito... aliás, você me fez lembrar dele. Dá vista para toda Roughworks, acredita?
The Missing Piece#365.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#366.src: Although... Thinking about it, it's a bit far... I don't know if my old legs will carry me all the way there, ha!
The Missing Piece#366.dst: Mas... pensando bem, é meio longe... Não sei se minhas pernas velhas me levam até lá, ha!
The Missing Piece#366.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#367.src: Someone around here has to have the code to this...
The Missing Piece#367.dst: Alguém por aqui deve ter o código disto...

The Missing Piece#368.src: Now all you have to do is get out of this place somehow...
The Missing Piece#368.dst: Agora só falta sair deste lugar de algum jeito...

The Missing Piece#369.src: Maybe if you hit those bottles, it will move the beam.
The Missing Piece#369.dst: Talvez acertando essas garrafas a viga se mexa.

The Missing Piece#373.src: Well, what do you say, then? Just talk to me when you want to head out.
The Missing Piece#373.dst: Então, o que me diz? Fale comigo quando quiser sair.
The Missing Piece#373.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#374.src: Well, what do you say? Shall we head out?
The Missing Piece#374.dst: Então, o que me diz? Vamos?
The Missing Piece#374.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#377.src: Oh, you can really see a lot from up here... Let's go!
The Missing Piece#377.dst: Ah, dá pra ver muita coisa daqui de cima... Vamos!
The Missing Piece#377.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#378.src: Where to? I know just the place for this! Let's see, it's...
The Missing Piece#378.dst: Para onde? Conheço o lugar certo pra isso! Vejamos, fica...
The Missing Piece#378.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#379.src: Hm... I think... Forward! Yes, I think it was straight forward from here. Although, my memory might be a little hazy...
The Missing Piece#379.dst: Hm... Acho que... Em frente! Sim, acho que era em frente daqui. Mas minha memória pode estar meio nebulosa...
The Missing Piece#379.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#380.src: Ah, hm... I think we turn left here...
The Missing Piece#380.dst: Ah, hm... Acho que viramos à esquerda...
The Missing Piece#380.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#381.src: No, wait... It's right, we definitely have to turn right!
The Missing Piece#381.dst: Não, espere... É à direita, temos que virar à direita!
The Missing Piece#381.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#382.src: That house feels familiar... I think... yes, turn right here!
The Missing Piece#382.dst: Aquela casa me é familiar... Acho que... sim, à direita aqui!
The Missing Piece#382.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#383.src: Stop! Hmm... I don't think it's across this bridge, at least. Then that must mean...
The Missing Piece#383.dst: Pare! Hmm... Pelo menos não acho que seja depois desta ponte. Então quer dizer...
The Missing Piece#383.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#384.src: Oh, what's the matter! We'll find it eventually, right? I'm pretty sure it's to the left!
The Missing Piece#384.dst: Ah, que importa! Uma hora a gente acha, não é? Tenho quase certeza de que é à esquerda!
The Missing Piece#384.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#385.src: Yes, this is it! It's just around this corner, I'm sure of it!
The Missing Piece#385.dst: Sim, é aqui! Fica logo depois desta esquina, tenho certeza!
The Missing Piece#385.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#386.src: Here! I remember now... it's in here!
The Missing Piece#386.dst: Aqui! Agora lembro... é aqui dentro!
The Missing Piece#386.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#387.src: I don't remember it being so overgrown, though...
The Missing Piece#387.dst: Mas não lembro de ser tão tomado pelo mato...
The Missing Piece#387.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#388.src: How long has it been? I can't recall the last time I was here...
The Missing Piece#388.dst: Quanto tempo faz? Não lembro a última vez que vim aqui...
The Missing Piece#388.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#390.src: Ah, it's blocked... Well. I didn't want to bring it up, but it seems we're out of options.
The Missing Piece#390.dst: Ah, está bloqueado... Bem. Não queria tocar no assunto, mas parece que não temos opção.
The Missing Piece#390.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#391.src: Oh, there's no need to pretend anymore. I know what you are. You're one of them, aren't you?
The Missing Piece#391.dst: Ah, não precisa mais fingir. Sei o que você é. Você é um deles, não é?
The Missing Piece#391.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#392.src: The cursed, as the Crown calls them. Not that I care!
The Missing Piece#392.dst: Os amaldiçoados, como a Coroa os chama. Não que eu ligue!
The Missing Piece#392.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#393.src: Why should I? I'm old! I have enough to worry about as is...
The Missing Piece#393.dst: Por que ligaria? Sou velha! Já tenho preocupações demais...
The Missing Piece#393.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#394.src: Besides, it's certainly useful in situations like this, isn't it? Be a dearie and do one of your little tricks, won't you?
The Missing Piece#394.dst: Além disso, é bem útil em situações assim, não é? Seja um amor e faça um dos seus truquezinhos, sim?
The Missing Piece#394.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#396.src: That's it... Let me down now, I can walk the rest of the way myself.
The Missing Piece#396.dst: Isso... Agora me põe no chão, o resto do caminho eu faço sozinha.
The Missing Piece#396.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#397.src: It's a little more... well, deserted, than I remember. But that's fine.
The Missing Piece#397.dst: Está um pouco mais... bem, deserto do que eu lembrava. Mas tudo bem.
The Missing Piece#397.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#398.src: We can take this elevator to the top. You'll have to find a way into the control room though... It shouldn't be too hard to reach!
The Missing Piece#398.dst: Podemos pegar este elevador até o topo. Mas você vai ter que achar como entrar na sala de controle... Não deve ser difícil!
The Missing Piece#398.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#399.src: It's that thing up over there. The tunnel on the right will get you to it.
The Missing Piece#399.dst: É aquela coisa lá em cima. O túnel da direita te leva até ela.
The Missing Piece#399.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#402.dst: Chegue ao painel de controle em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#403.src: Can you hear me? I'm down here!
The Missing Piece#403.dst: Está me ouvindo? Estou aqui embaixo!
The Missing Piece#403.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#404.src: Use the controls to get me up! You know how it works, right?
The Missing Piece#404.dst: Use os controles pra me subir! Sabe como funciona, né?
The Missing Piece#404.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#405.src: Use the controls at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to bring Elise up.
The Missing Piece#405.dst: Use os controles em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para subir Elise.

The Missing Piece#408.src: Maybe if... oh, I know. Put something on the up button, then you can clear the blockage... and we'll go up.
The Missing Piece#408.dst: Talvez se... ah, já sei. Ponha algo no botão de subir, aí você tira o bloqueio... e a gente sobe.
The Missing Piece#408.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#409.src: Perfect! Now it will move, if only we can get it unstuck...
The Missing Piece#409.dst: Perfeito! Agora vai se mexer, se conseguirmos desemperrar...
The Missing Piece#409.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#410.src: If you could get up there, somehow...
The Missing Piece#410.dst: Se desse pra subir lá, de algum jeito...
The Missing Piece#410.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#412.src: Oh well, this place seems abandoned anyhow! Who cares about a little destruction?
The Missing Piece#412.dst: Bom, este lugar parece abandonado mesmo! Quem liga pra um pouco de destruição?
The Missing Piece#412.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#413.src: Go up there and see if you can find a way to get this thing going again.
The Missing Piece#413.dst: Suba lá e veja se acha um jeito de fazer isto funcionar de novo.
The Missing Piece#413.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#415.src: Throw a brick at the blockage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#415.dst: Jogue um tijolo no bloqueio em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#416.src: How's it going? Can you see anything?
The Missing Piece#416.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#421.src: Follow Elise to the cliff at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#421.dst: Siga Elise até o penhasco em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#422.src: Ah, isn't this place nice. The breeze, the view, everything.
The Missing Piece#422.dst: Ah, que lugar agradável. A brisa, a vista, tudo.
The Missing Piece#422.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#423.src: You can even see the trees of the {p} swaying from up here...
The Missing Piece#423.dst: Daqui de cima dá até pra ver as árvores de {p} balançando...
The Missing Piece#423.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#424.src: And finally! A place to sit! I'm sorely in need of some relaxation after this eventful day.
The Missing Piece#424.dst: E finalmente! Um lugar pra sentar! Preciso muito relaxar depois deste dia agitado.
The Missing Piece#424.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#425.src: Please, let's sit down and enjoy the view for a bit.
The Missing Piece#425.dst: Por favor, vamos sentar e curtir a vista um pouco.
The Missing Piece#425.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#427.src: Hm. It's strange. All day, I've been... reminiscing, I suppose. And now, seeing this view... it fills me with that same, nostalgic feeling.
The Missing Piece#427.dst: Hm. É estranho. O dia todo eu estive... relembrando, acho. E agora, vendo esta vista... me enche da mesma nostalgia.
The Missing Piece#427.speaker: Elise

similar.text: What are you doing?
... what's happening?

The Missing Piece#431.src: You should probably take your place at the front of the line.
The Missing Piece#431.dst: Você devia ir para o início da fila.

The Missing Piece#432.src: All day, I've been having these... visions of the past. Of these things I can't recall ever happening.
The Missing Piece#432.dst: O dia todo tive essas... visões do passado. De coisas que não lembro de terem acontecido.
The Missing Piece#432.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#433.src: And I... well, truthfully, I'm not sure how to feel about it...
The Missing Piece#433.dst: E eu... bem, sinceramente, não sei o que sentir sobre isso...
The Missing Piece#433.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#434.src: But I know- I know in my heart, that there's something missing... a piece that would make it all fit.
The Missing Piece#434.dst: Mas sei- sei no coração que falta algo... uma peça que faria tudo se encaixar.
The Missing Piece#434.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#436.src: In every dream she's there beside me... but I don't even remember her name. I can't even recall her face...
The Missing Piece#436.dst: Em todo sonho ela está ao meu lado... mas nem lembro o nome dela. Nem consigo lembrar do rosto...
The Missing Piece#436.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#437.src: If she was this important to me... then how could I forget?
The Missing Piece#437.dst: Se ela era tão importante pra mim... como pude esquecer?
The Missing Piece#437.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#440.src: Hurgh... hurgh... One second, I need to catch my breath.
The Missing Piece#440.dst: Uf... uf... Um segundo, preciso recuperar o fôlego.
The Missing Piece#440.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#441.src: Hm... Do you know this person? They're not an inspector... are they?
The Missing Piece#441.dst: Hm... Conhece essa pessoa? Não é um inspetor... é?
The Missing Piece#441.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#442.src: So, as I was going to say—
The Missing Piece#442.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#443.src: Okay, fine! I'll get straight to the point.
The Missing Piece#443.dst: Tá bom, tá bom! Vou direto ao ponto.
The Missing Piece#443.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#444.src: I found more letters to deliver, and I was on my way to deliver them when I saw you two running out! Can you imagine how shocked I was?
The Missing Piece#444.dst: Achei mais cartas pra entregar e estava a caminho quando vi vocês dois saindo correndo! Imaginam o meu choque?
The Missing Piece#444.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#445.src: That being that, I naturally decided to follow you, the good postmaster that I am. You sure didn't make it easy though! I barely managed to make it up here... It's a nice spot, by the way.
The Missing Piece#445.dst: Sendo assim, naturalmente decidi seguir vocês, como bom chefe dos correios que sou. Mas não facilitaram nada! Mal consegui chegar aqui... Lugar bonito, aliás.
The Missing Piece#445.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#446.src: But... how could you have possibly made it up here...?
The Missing Piece#446.dst: Mas... como o senhor conseguiu subir até aqui...?
The Missing Piece#446.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#447.src: Getting up here is nothing to a university graduate like me!
The Missing Piece#447.dst: Subir aqui não é nada para um formado como eu!
The Missing Piece#447.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#450.src: Well, that was all that I came for I suppose. So...
The Missing Piece#450.dst: Bom, acho que vim só pra isso. Então...
The Missing Piece#450.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#451.src: You came all this way just for that!? At least have a piece of bread, or something...!
The Missing Piece#451.dst: Veio até aqui só pra isso!? Pelo menos pegue um pedaço de pão...!
The Missing Piece#451.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#452.src: No, no. I couldn't possibly! Duty calls, the post isn't going to sort itself, and all that... Oh, by Her Majesty, the backlog...
The Missing Piece#452.dst: Não, não. De jeito nenhum! O dever chama, as cartas não se separam sozinhas e tal... Ah, por Sua Majestade, o acúmulo...
The Missing Piece#452.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#453.src: Right! You! I hate to admit it, but it seems you've done your job well enough.
The Missing Piece#453.dst: Isso! Você! Odeio admitir, mas parece que fez seu trabalho direitinho.
The Missing Piece#453.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#454.src: I happened to double check the records and it seems like my substitute, well, may have been someone else entirely!
The Missing Piece#454.dst: Por acaso conferi os registros de novo e parece que meu substituto, bem, pode ter sido outra pessoa!
The Missing Piece#454.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#455.src: No harm, no foul, right? The work's already done! No takesies-backsies! Okay?
The Missing Piece#455.dst: Sem dano, sem culpa, né? O trabalho já está feito! Sem volta! Combinado?
The Missing Piece#455.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#457.src: Huh, what was that? I couldn't hear you! Okay, bye!
The Missing Piece#457.dst: Hã, o que disse? Não ouvi! Tá, tchau!
The Missing Piece#457.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#459.src: But it was certainly nice of them to deliver this letter. Let me take a look.
The Missing Piece#459.dst: Mas foi gentil da parte dele trazer esta carta. Deixe eu ver.
The Missing Piece#459.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#461.src: Oh, I don't understand... What would she have to apologize for?
The Missing Piece#461.dst: Ah, não entendo... Por que ela teria que pedir desculpas?
The Missing Piece#461.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#462.src: Please... {u}, take a breath. You're shaking.
The Missing Piece#462.dst: Por favor... {u}, respire. Você está tremendo.
The Missing Piece#462.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#463.src: Getting caught in a storm like that... really, I could have waited a few hours! You didn't need to push yourself to get here.
The Missing Piece#463.dst: Pegar uma tempestade dessas... sério, eu podia esperar umas horas! Não precisava se forçar pra chegar aqui.
The Missing Piece#463.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#465.src: Yes, I know the weather's bad now... but eventually, it'll get better again. The clouds will clear and the sun will shine again. Right?
The Missing Piece#465.dst: Sim, sei que o tempo está ruim agora... mas uma hora vai melhorar. As nuvens vão passar e o sol vai brilhar de novo. Não é?
The Missing Piece#465.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#467.src: You know, it's not so bad with rain once in a while. Means we don't have to water the flowers, at least! And nothing beats the smell of wet grass after rain, don't you agree?
The Missing Piece#467.dst: Sabe, um pouco de chuva de vez em quando não é ruim. Pelo menos não preciso regar as flores! E nada supera o cheiro de grama molhada depois da chuva, não acha?
The Missing Piece#467.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#468.src: We could do something after it clears up. It's been a while since you visited, so why not go to our spot? I should still have some leftover bread lying around...
The Missing Piece#468.dst: Podemos fazer algo quando abrir o tempo. Faz tempo que você não vem, por que não vamos ao nosso lugar? Ainda devo ter um pão sobrando por aí...
The Missing Piece#468.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#469.src: Elise. You're- please, forgive me- you're in danger. I-
The Missing Piece#469.dst: Elise. Você- me perdoe- você corre perigo. Eu-

The Missing Piece#470.src: I'm in danger? I'm just an ordinary worker, what reason would anyone have to harm me? I'll be fine.
The Missing Piece#470.dst: Em perigo? Sou só uma operária comum, por que alguém ia querer me fazer mal? Vou ficar bem.
The Missing Piece#470.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#471.src: {u}, you're the one pushing herself through this weather, clearly panicking...
The Missing Piece#471.dst: {u}, é você quem está se forçando com esse tempo, claramente em pânico...
The Missing Piece#471.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#472.src: I barely get to see you anymore. And now, out of nowhere, you're here in this state... What's going on? Please, just talk to me.
The Missing Piece#472.dst: Quase não te vejo mais. E agora, do nada, você aparece nesse estado... O que está havendo? Por favor, fale comigo.
The Missing Piece#472.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#473.src: ...ha. I- I haven't been truthful with you, Elise, and- I can explain later. We need to get out of here, before they-
The Missing Piece#473.dst: ...ha. Eu- eu não fui sincera com você, Elise, e- explico depois. Precisamos sair daqui, antes que eles-

The Missing Piece#476.src: Why would they... no, this doesn't make any sense...
The Missing Piece#476.dst: Por que eles iam... não, isso não faz sentido...

The Missing Piece#477.src: Hm. Well, then maybe it's nothing. I'll go see who it is.
The Missing Piece#477.dst: Hm. Bom, então talvez não seja nada. Vou ver quem é.
The Missing Piece#477.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#478.src: As if one wasn't enough... who could possibly be foolish enough to brave a storm just to come visit this little place? Whatever it is, it can wait.
The Missing Piece#478.dst: Como se uma não bastasse... quem seria tolo de enfrentar uma tempestade só pra visitar este lugarzinho? Seja o que for, pode esperar.
The Missing Piece#478.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#481.src: No... No... What are you... Why are you-
The Missing Piece#481.dst: Não... Não... O que vocês... Por que estão-
The Missing Piece#481.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#482.src: Apologies for the disturbance, madam. But I'm afraid we have business to attend to.
The Missing Piece#482.dst: Desculpe o incômodo, senhora. Mas receio que temos um assunto a tratar.
The Missing Piece#482.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#483.dst: O quê... {u}... o que está havendo?
The Missing Piece#483.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#484.src: {u}, {u}, why are they here? Why... why won't you answer me...?
The Missing Piece#484.dst: {u}, {u}, por que estão aqui? Por quê... não me responde...?
The Missing Piece#484.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#485.src: What have you done? I... Please, just explain... I- I...
The Missing Piece#485.dst: O que você fez? Eu... Por favor, só explique... Eu- eu...
The Missing Piece#485.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#486.src: I... how did I overlook this...?

The Missing Piece#487.src: Seems you're not quite the strategic mastermind you thought yourself, Lioness.
The Missing Piece#487.dst: Parece que não é a grande estrategista que pensava, Leoa.
The Missing Piece#487.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#488.src: Elise... if you... if you just cooperate...
The Missing Piece#488.dst: Elise... se você... se só cooperar...

The Missing Piece#489.src: Then... everything will be fine. It... it will.
The Missing Piece#489.dst: Então... vai ficar tudo bem. Vai... vai, sim.

The Missing Piece#491.src: She... What did she do? Why did she wrap me up in it?
The Missing Piece#491.dst: Ela... O que ela fez? Por que me envolveu nisso?
The Missing Piece#491.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#492.src: Everything I remember... it just leaves me with more questions than answers. Why can't I remember her...? Why!?
The Missing Piece#492.dst: Tudo o que lembro... só me deixa com mais perguntas que respostas. Por que não lembro dela...? Por quê!?
The Missing Piece#492.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#493.src: I- I'm just an ordinary factory worker! I woke up early, worked late, slept late... then did it all over again the next day.
The Missing Piece#493.dst: Eu- eu sou só uma operária comum! Acordava cedo, trabalhava até tarde, dormia tarde... e no dia seguinte, tudo de novo.
The Missing Piece#493.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#494.src: I've never said a word about the Crown! Why would they possibly care about... me...?
The Missing Piece#494.dst: Nunca disse uma palavra sobre a Coroa! Por que iam se importar com... comigo...?
The Missing Piece#494.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#495.src: They... they took everything from me. My youth, my body, my time, and... and I never demanded anything in return.
The Missing Piece#495.dst: Eles... tiraram tudo de mim. Minha juventude, meu corpo, meu tempo, e... e nunca exigi nada em troca.
The Missing Piece#495.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#496.src: So, why... why can't I just have this? This one, little thing? Why can't I remember her...?
The Missing Piece#496.dst: Então, por que... por que não posso ter isso? Essa coisinha? Por que não lembro dela...?
The Missing Piece#496.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#497.src: ...oh, it might sound sad... but, looking back at it all like this...
The Missing Piece#497.dst: ...ah, pode parecer triste... mas olhando tudo assim, de longe...
The Missing Piece#497.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#498.src: My life doesn't seem all that great, does it? Ha. Toiling away in a factory for someone else's bread...
The Missing Piece#498.dst: Minha vida não parece grande coisa, né? Ha. Ralando numa fábrica pelo pão dos outros...
The Missing Piece#498.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#499.src: But I can feel her. Even if... even if I can't remember her face, or her name, or her touch... I still feel her. Lingering in my heart. Shining.
The Missing Piece#499.dst: Mas eu a sinto. Mesmo que... mesmo que não lembre do rosto, nem do nome, nem do toque dela... ainda a sinto. No meu coração. Brilhando.
The Missing Piece#499.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#500.src: ...it's all some sort of sick joke, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#500.dst: ...é tudo uma piada de mau gosto, não é?
The Missing Piece#500.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#501.src: They weren't content with all I sacrificed... they had to take even my memories? Is that it...?
The Missing Piece#501.dst: Não bastou tudo o que sacrifiquei... tinham que levar até minhas lembranças? É isso...?
The Missing Piece#501.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#502.src: Wherever you are now... whatever you did... whatever secrets you kept... I hope it was worth it.
The Missing Piece#502.dst: Onde estiver... o que tiver feito... os segredos que guardou... espero que tenha valido a pena.
The Missing Piece#502.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#503.src: I hope you burn this entire place to the ground.
The Missing Piece#503.dst: Espero que você reduza este lugar a cinzas.
The Missing Piece#503.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#504.src: I just wish... we could have spent more time together.
The Missing Piece#504.dst: Só queria... que tivéssemos passado mais tempo juntas.
The Missing Piece#504.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#505.src: For a long time, I went along the path that had been laid before me. I did what was right.
The Missing Piece#505.dst: Por muito tempo, segui o caminho traçado pra mim. Fiz o que era certo.

The Missing Piece#506.src: But then... I met you, Elise.

The Missing Piece#507.src: I... I don't know what to say, {u}...
The Missing Piece#507.dst: Eu... não sei o que dizer, {u}...
The Missing Piece#507.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#510.src: I see... a bird. A pigeon, it's old and gray. Its wings no longer work like they used to...
The Missing Piece#510.dst: Vejo... um pássaro. Um pombo, velho e cinzento. As asas não funcionam mais como antes...
The Missing Piece#510.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#511.src: It wants to fly, but it can't... It's struggling...
The Missing Piece#511.dst: Ele quer voar, mas não consegue... Está se debatendo...
The Missing Piece#511.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#513.src: No, I can't! It's too sad...
The Missing Piece#513.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#515.src: It's sitting beneath the shade of a canopy, singing. Like a cry, almost, mourning.
The Missing Piece#515.dst: Está pousado à sombra de uma copa, cantando. Quase como um choro, um lamento.
The Missing Piece#515.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#516.src: The clouds, dark clouds are gathering. A storm is coming. The bird is looking around, frantically searching. It's scared.
The Missing Piece#516.dst: As nuvens, nuvens escuras se juntam. Vem uma tempestade. O pássaro olha em volta, procurando, desesperado. Tem medo.
The Missing Piece#516.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#517.src: It... It calls out, for something... or someone...
The Missing Piece#517.dst: Ele... Ele chama por algo... ou alguém...
The Missing Piece#517.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#518.src: Who is it calling for, Elise?

The Missing Piece#523.src: I won't forget! I won't forget! I won't! I promised! I promised I'd never forget you!
The Missing Piece#523.dst: Não vou esquecer! Não vou! Não vou! Prometi! Prometi nunca te esquecer!
The Missing Piece#523.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#526.src: You are an ordinary worker from the Roughworks. You work an ordinary job, and lead an ordinary but solitary life.
The Missing Piece#526.dst: Você é uma operária comum de Roughworks. Tem um emprego comum e leva uma vida comum, mas solitária.
The Missing Piece#526.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#528.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her.
The Missing Piece#528.dst: Ela não é nada pra você. Você nunca a conheceu. Nunca vai conhecer.
The Missing Piece#528.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#531.src: You are nothing to her! She is nothing to you! Soon you'll forget she ever existed.
The Missing Piece#531.dst: Você não é nada pra ela! Ela não é nada pra você! Logo vai esquecer que existiu.
The Missing Piece#531.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#532.src: No, I will never forget! She was everything to me! She is everything to me! I will never forget her!
The Missing Piece#532.dst: Não, nunca vou esquecer! Ela era tudo pra mim! Ela é tudo pra mim! Nunca vou esquecê-la!
The Missing Piece#532.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#533.src: You do not know her face, nor her voice, nor her touch.
The Missing Piece#533.dst: Você não conhece o rosto dela, nem a voz, nem o toque.
The Missing Piece#533.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#535.src: She is nothing to you. You have never met her. You will never meet her. You have always been ordinary, you will always be ordinary.
The Missing Piece#535.dst: Ela não é nada pra você. Nunca a conheceu. Nunca vai conhecer. Você sempre foi comum, sempre será comum.
The Missing Piece#535.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#537.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
The Missing Piece#537.dst: Vou perguntar mais uma vez. Sua diretriz foi entendida?
The Missing Piece#537.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#547.src: And I'll never forget it, Elise.
The Missing Piece#547.speaker: Syndra

The Missing Piece#548.src: My legs... feel funny... I think... I think I'm in need of some rest. A long, long rest... I deserve that... don't I?
The Missing Piece#548.dst: Minhas pernas... estão fracas... Acho... acho que preciso descansar. Um longo, longo descanso... Eu mereço... não?
The Missing Piece#548.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#549.src: You'll take me home... won't you? I want to see it, at least once more... The tree.
The Missing Piece#549.dst: Me leva pra casa... não leva? Quero vê-la, pelo menos mais uma vez... A árvore.
The Missing Piece#549.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#552.src: It's grown so tall... and so beautiful. Hasn't it, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#552.dst: Ficou tão alta... e tão linda. Não é, Syndra...?
The Missing Piece#552.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#553.src: If... If only... you could have seen it... like this...
The Missing Piece#553.dst: Se... Se ao menos... você pudesse vê-la... assim...
The Missing Piece#553.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#554.src: Pick some of Elise's flowers around her house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#554.dst: Colha algumas flores de Elise em volta da casa dela em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#556.src: I'm searching for 'the woman on the hill'. Do you happen to know her?
The Missing Piece#556.dst: Procuro 'a mulher da colina'. Por acaso a conhece?
The Missing Piece#556.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#558.src: Ha! But that's why I moved here!
The Missing Piece#558.dst: Ha! Foi por isso que vim pra cá!
The Missing Piece#558.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#559.src: In the living blocks you can never be alone. No time to think, only to work. No dear, it's much better up here.
The Missing Piece#559.dst: Nos blocos nunca se fica só. Sem tempo pra pensar, só pra trabalhar. Não, querido, aqui em cima é bem melhor.
The Missing Piece#559.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#560.src: Lived my whole childhood in one of the towers. I was born there. That was until... until... Well, I've forgotten the reason, ha!
The Missing Piece#560.dst: Passei a infância toda numa das torres. Nasci lá. Até que... até que... Bom, esqueci o motivo, ha!
The Missing Piece#560.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#561.src: My memory isn't so good these days. It must have been twenty-five or so years ago.
The Missing Piece#561.dst: Minha memória não anda boa. Deve ter sido uns vinte e cinco anos atrás.
The Missing Piece#561.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#562.src: But I had a reason... a good one! Ha, it's funny isn't it? At the time it probably seemed like the most important thing in the world.
The Missing Piece#562.dst: Mas eu tinha um motivo... e dos bons! Ha, engraçado, né? Na época devia parecer a coisa mais importante do mundo.
The Missing Piece#562.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#563.src: But now, well, I've gone and forgotten the whole thing, haven't I?
The Missing Piece#563.dst: Mas agora, bem, acabei esquecendo tudo, não é?
The Missing Piece#563.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#564.src: In the Roughworks? My whole life, ha. I'm only fifty... fifty-two, you know. Or maybe it was fifty-three.
The Missing Piece#564.dst: Em Roughworks? A vida toda, ha. Só tenho cinquenta... cinquenta e dois, sabe. Ou talvez cinquenta e três.
The Missing Piece#564.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#565.src: ... Which year is it again? I seem to have lost track.
The Missing Piece#565.dst: ... Que ano é mesmo? Parece que perdi a conta.
The Missing Piece#565.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#566.src: So... goodness, longer than I expected. It must have been... Oh, by Her Grace! What does it matter, the years pass quicker for every one that goes.
The Missing Piece#566.dst: Então... nossa, mais do que eu pensava. Deve ter sido... Ah, por Sua Graça! Que importa, os anos passam mais rápido a cada um que se vai.
The Missing Piece#566.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#567.src: How strange... I feel like I should know who this is from... and yet, I don't.
The Missing Piece#567.dst: Que estranho... Sinto que devia saber de quem é isto... e mesmo assim, não sei.
The Missing Piece#567.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#568.src: Hm. I said I wouldn't pry, but... You don't work for the post, do you? I know your type.
The Missing Piece#568.dst: Hm. Disse que não ia bisbilhotar, mas... Você não é dos correios, é? Conheço seu tipo.
The Missing Piece#568.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#570.src: But... you have piqued my curiosity with these letters...
The Missing Piece#570.dst: Mas... você despertou minha curiosidade com essas cartas...
The Missing Piece#570.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#571.src: Say, 'letter-carrier', won't you be a dearie and water my plants while I read the rest of these letters? Maybe there is something else I can glean from reading them.
The Missing Piece#571.dst: Diga, 'carteiro', seja um amor e regue minhas plantas enquanto leio o resto das cartas? Talvez eu descubra mais alguma coisa nelas.
The Missing Piece#571.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#572.src: I have {~} plants outside and {~} pots inside. Just be sure not to overwater them! The watering can is just outside in the garden.
The Missing Piece#572.dst: Tenho {~} plantas lá fora e {~} vasos aqui dentro. Só não regue demais! O regador está ali fora, no jardim.
The Missing Piece#572.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#573.src: Don't be afraid to ask if you're wondering anything! I don't bite, ha!
The Missing Piece#573.dst: Não tenha medo de perguntar se quiser saber algo! Eu não mordo, ha!
The Missing Piece#573.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#575.src: Elise has probably finished reading those letters by now. You should return to her in the kitchen.
The Missing Piece#575.dst: Elise já deve ter terminado de ler as cartas. Volte até ela na cozinha.

The Missing Piece#577.src: Doesn't look like you're going to get anything out of this guy...
The Missing Piece#577.dst: Não parece que você vai tirar nada desse cara...

The Missing Piece#578.src: But my friend worked here, and...
The Missing Piece#578.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#579.src: Can I at least get a look inside...?
The Missing Piece#579.dst: Posso ao menos dar uma olhada...?
The Missing Piece#579.speaker: Player

The Missing Piece#580.src: In order to steal the bread, you must stay hidden.
The Missing Piece#580.dst: Para roubar o pão, você precisa ficar escondido.

The Missing Piece#581.src: When close to workers, {#} SNEAK to remain hidden.
The Missing Piece#581.dst: Perto dos operários, {#} AGACHE para não ser visto.

The Missing Piece#582.src: You could knock out the workers with this...
The Missing Piece#582.dst: Com isto você poderia nocautear os operários...

The Missing Piece#583.src: When close to workers, {#} LEFT-CLICK with Bottle to knock out.
The Missing Piece#583.dst: Com a garrafa, {#} CLIQUE ESQUERDO num operário para nocautear.

The Missing Piece#584.src: {#} Left-Click with Bottle to Knock Out
The Missing Piece#584.dst: {#} Clique esquerdo com a garrafa para nocautear

The Missing Piece#585.src: After knocking them out, {#} RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#585.dst: Após nocautear, {#} CLIQUE DIREITO para revistar operários.

The Missing Piece#586.src: With this, you can open the grate to the pipe and progress.
The Missing Piece#586.dst: Com isto você pode abrir a grade do cano e seguir em frente.

The Missing Piece#588.src: To stay out of sight of workers, use Bottles to distract them.
The Missing Piece#588.dst: Use garrafas para distrair os operários e não ser visto.

The Missing Piece#589.src: Activate EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN by inputting the activation code.
The Missing Piece#589.dst: Insira o código para ativar o DESLIGAMENTO DE EMERGÊNCIA.

The Missing Piece#590.dst: Nada que valha a pena levar.

The Missing Piece#591.src: The bottle is too high up to reach...

The Missing Piece#592.src: That must be the way in to the vault Elise mentioned.
The Missing Piece#592.dst: Essa deve ser a entrada do cofre que Elise mencionou.

The Missing Piece#593.src: Hey, I left the key in the break room if you need it. Be careful though! Get the Supervisor to disable the oven first, or you'll be toast!
The Missing Piece#593.dst: Ei, deixei a chave na sala de descanso, se precisar. Mas cuidado! Peça ao supervisor pra desligar o forno antes, ou você vira torrada!

The Missing Piece#594.src: A maintenance key. With this you could unlock the maintenace entrance to the oven.
The Missing Piece#594.dst: Uma chave de manutenção. Com ela você pode abrir a entrada de manutenção do forno.

The Missing Piece#595.src: They really ought to improve their security around here...
The Missing Piece#595.dst: Deviam mesmo melhorar a segurança por aqui...

The Missing Piece#597.src: Now, to find the Maintenance Key...
The Missing Piece#597.dst: Agora, achar a chave de manutenção...

The Missing Piece#598.src: EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN code successfully inputted. Press Activation Button to initiate.
The Missing Piece#598.dst: Código de DESLIGAMENTO DE EMERGÊNCIA inserido. Aperte o botão de ativação.

The Missing Piece#599.src: After initiating emergency shutdown, you will have {~} seconds to make it to the vault. Do you want to press the button?
The Missing Piece#599.dst: Ao iniciar o desligamento de emergência, você terá {~} segundos para chegar ao cofre. Quer apertar o botão?

The Missing Piece#600.src: Do you want to infiltrate the Bread Vault through this method?
The Missing Piece#600.dst: Quer se infiltrar no Cofre de Pão por este meio?

The Missing Piece#602.src: This hallway looks heavily guarded. Maybe there's a different path you could take.
The Missing Piece#602.dst: Este corredor parece muito vigiado. Talvez haja outro caminho.

The Missing Piece#603.src: There must be a way to get to that balcony above.
The Missing Piece#603.dst: Deve haver um jeito de chegar àquela sacada.

The Missing Piece#604.src: Switch between selected beams using the switch button.
The Missing Piece#604.dst: Alterne entre as vigas com o botão de troca.

The Missing Piece#605.src: They're having a discussion you can just barely make out...
The Missing Piece#605.dst: Estão conversando, e você mal consegue ouvir...

The Missing Piece#606.src: Finally... The bread you've been looking for.
The Missing Piece#606.dst: Finalmente... O pão que você procurava.

The Missing Piece#615.src: Ha... Well, what's another crime added to the tally? It seems we've become real hardened bandits, haven't we?
The Missing Piece#615.dst: Ha... Bom, o que é mais um crime na conta? Parece que viramos bandidos calejados, não é?
The Missing Piece#615.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#617.src: That's what a life in the Roughworks does to you! Worked my whole life, I have. Ha, for no benefit either.
The Missing Piece#617.dst: É isso que uma vida em Roughworks faz com a gente! Trabalhei a vida toda, sim. Ha, e sem ganhar nada.
The Missing Piece#617.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#618.src: Still as poor as the day I was born! But I have a home... and sometimes even good company. That's enough for silly old me.
The Missing Piece#618.dst: Ainda pobre como no dia em que nasci! Mas tenho um lar... e às vezes até boa companhia. Basta pra esta velha boba.
The Missing Piece#618.speaker: Elise

The Olmic Rune#000.src: It has no fuel left, maybe you can start it again?
The Olmic Rune#000.dst: Está sem combustível, talvez dê pra ligar de novo?

The Olmic Rune#001.src: The crystalized magic on the floor seems unstable. Maybe something can shatter it...
The Olmic Rune#001.dst: A magia cristalizada no chão parece instável. Talvez algo possa estilhaçá-la...

The Olmic Rune#003.src: The strange shard is reacting to the floor...
The Olmic Rune#003.dst: O estranho fragmento reage ao chão...

The Olmic Rune#005.src: Head back to the machine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Olmic Rune#007.src: The loud noise is bound to attract creatures of the expanse.
The Olmic Rune#007.dst: O barulho com certeza vai atrair as criaturas do Expanse.

The Olmic Rune#008.src: It looks like the machine is about to break through!
The Olmic Rune#008.dst: Parece que a máquina está prestes a atravessar!

The Olmic Rune#009.src: Find some sort of fuel in the Ruined City.
The Olmic Rune#009.dst: Encontre algum tipo de combustível em Ruined City.

The Olmic Rune#010.src: Find some sort of fuel in the ruined city
The Olmic Rune#010.dst: Ache algum combustível na cidade em ruínas

The Olmic Rune#011.src: Explore the cave for the fuel
The Olmic Rune#011.dst: Explore a caverna atrás do combustível

The Olmic Rune#012.src: Collect [{~} Fuel Sprites] and bring it back to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#012.dst: Colete [{~} Espíritos de combustível] e leve de volta à máquina.

The Olmic Rune#013.src: Defend the machine from the incoming attackers.
The Olmic Rune#013.dst: Defenda a máquina dos atacantes que se aproximam.

The Olmic Rune#015.src: Now that you have enough fuel, you should return to the machine.
The Olmic Rune#015.dst: Agora que tem combustível suficiente, volte à máquina.

The Olmic Rune#016.src: It looks like a mining machine that's hundreds of years old. What was it mining though?
The Olmic Rune#016.dst: Parece uma máquina de mineração de centenas de anos. Mas o que ela minerava?

The Olmic Rune#017.src: {#} You get the feeling you shouldn't be here...
The Olmic Rune#017.dst: {#} Você sente que não deveria estar aqui...

The Olmic Rune#018.src: It's a strangely shaped keyhole. How cryptic.
The Olmic Rune#018.dst: Fechadura de formato esquisito. Que enigma.

The Order of the Grook#000.src: Eager much? Keep yourself seated for now.
The Order of the Grook#000.dst: Ansioso, é? Fique sentado por enquanto.
The Order of the Grook#000.speaker: Pensa

The Order of the Grook#001.src: Do you...not have any manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
The Order of the Grook#001.dst: Você... não tem modos nenhum?! Entrar assim na casa dos meus pais! Credo!
The Order of the Grook#001.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#003.src: Oh, I know! Here, go into my room real fast, and grab the letter in there.
The Order of the Grook#003.dst: Ah, já sei! Vai rapidinho no meu quarto e pega a carta que está lá.
The Order of the Grook#003.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#004.src: Bring it to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
The Order of the Grook#004.dst: Traz pra mim quando pegar, quero ver se é a certa.
The Order of the Grook#004.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#005.src: Go look for my letter in my bedroom, pretty please.
The Order of the Grook#005.dst: Vai buscar minha carta no meu quarto, por favorzinho.

The Order of the Grook#006.src: My parents were super excited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
The Order of the Grook#006.dst: Meus pais piraram quando a carta entrou voando no quarto, mas escola de magia parece tão chato...
The Order of the Grook#006.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#007.src: The letter says to meet a boat captain on the broken docks next to the Seaskipper, and to "have faith". What does that mean?
The Order of the Grook#007.dst: A carta diz pra encontrar um capitão nas docas quebradas perto do Seaskipper e "ter fé". O que isso quer dizer?

The Order of the Grook#008.src: This weird looking place is actually a magical transportation hub.
The Order of the Grook#008.dst: Este lugar esquisito é na verdade um centro de transporte mágico.

The Order of the Grook#009.src: Each tunnel leads someplace else in the world, but the transportation portals aren't always, ehm...accurate? Let's leave it at that.
The Order of the Grook#009.dst: Cada túnel leva a outro lugar do mundo, mas os portais nem sempre são, hã... precisos? Vamos deixar assim.

The Order of the Grook#010.src: There are also some secret passages around, supposedly...
The Order of the Grook#010.dst: Também tem passagens secretas por aí, dizem...

The Order of the Grook#011.src: Psst. Are you a student at Grookwarts?

The Order of the Grook#012.src: This is the way in. Do you see that weird looking dirt wall?
The Order of the Grook#012.dst: A entrada é aqui. Está vendo aquele muro de terra esquisito?
