The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.dst: Pronto. A conexão com o Nexo está feita, então vamos atravessar.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.dst: Espere! Algo... Algo não está certo...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.dst: É você que invade reinos que não são seus!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst: Siga a estrada rumo ao Nexo da Luz de Orphion.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: {u}!! Para trás! Estou aguentando, mas ele te destrói se chegar perto!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: AGH, CHEGA! Você não tem lugar aqui, coisa imunda!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#090.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#090.dst: Não! Você não vai fugir- Te mato antes disso!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#090.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.dst: Nova missão iniciada: Reino da Luz V - O Reino da Luz

The Realm of Light (Quest)#093.src: Or something that another person wants you to see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#093.dst: Ou algo que outra pessoa quer que você veja?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#095.src: You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.src: Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.dst: Tola. A Fera treme com nossa influência. Esta terra é nossa.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.src: I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.dst: Não perco tempo com aquele espécime. Agora. Encare a morte.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#099.src: You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#099.dst: Não vai. Seu deus sorrirá ao me ver partir.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.src: YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.dst: VOCÊ NÃO PODE FALAR ASSIM DE ORPHION!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.src: We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.dst: Já vencemos. Seu peão não está à altura.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.src: It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.dst: Não acabou... NÃO PODE SER, NÃO OUSE- TOME ISTO!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.src: There's a faint buzzing in your ears...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.dst: Há um leve zumbido nos seus ouvidos...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.src: I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.dst: Tenho uma vaga ideia de para onde vou, mas... Se dou conta dele, talvez tenha força para isso.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.src: I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.dst: Nunca fui boa em despedidas, mas obrigada por tudo. Sei que você vai achar gente tão forte quanto você para salvar Orphion no meu lugar.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.src: I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.dst: Eu- Eu vejo o fim deste... Túnel. Há- Espere...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#108.src: {u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#108.dst: {u}... Achara... Acho que jamais poderei reparar o que te fiz. Um pedido de desculpas não basta.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#108.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.src: You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.dst: Derrote o mob antes de continuar!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.src: If you were to look into a mirror... what would you see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.dst: Se você se olhasse no espelho... o que veria?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#111.src: Though... I feel something on the other side. It seems incredibly... Foul. I can't tell what it is, let's be careful.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#111.dst: Mas... sinto algo do outro lado. Parece incrivelmente... Imundo. Não sei o que é, vamos com cuidado.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#112.src: {u}. I think. I found someone. Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#112.dst: {u}. Acho. Que achei alguém. Que merece morrer. Me ajuda?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#112.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#113.src: {u}... I apologize for leaving you like that. I felt like this was my only chance at defeating this plague - by attacking its core.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#113.dst: {u}... desculpe por te deixar assim. Senti que era minha única chance de vencer esta praga - atacando seu núcleo.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#114.src: By the light what is that thing?! S-Stay away f-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#114.dst: Pela luz, o que é aquilo?! F-Fique longe d-

The Realm of Light (Quest)#115.src: by the light, i summon thee, aether's judgement! aid me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#115.dst: pela luz, eu te invoco, juízo do éter! ajude-me!

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#000.dst: Fale com Maripe em Pishlas em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.dst: Oh! Ora, olá, turista! Imagino que seja turista, pelo menos. Essa roupa não parece daqui. Suponho que tenha ouvido falar das fontes termais!
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.dst: Bem, ah... infelizmente, Pishlas está fechado para reforma. Sabe, está fechado há muito tempo... Minha família cuida dele há gerações, mas os problemas começaram.
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.dst: Com minha mãe doente por tanto tempo, meu pai e toda a família tivemos que largar este lugar para cuidar dela. Ficou caindo aos pedaços.
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.dst: Ela já está bem o bastante para não precisar de alguém do lado o tempo todo, então resolvi devolver a este lugar a glória de antes!
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.dst: Tem dado muito trabalho... e deve abrir logo- mas ainda não terminei. De novo, sinto muito que tenha vindo até aqui à toa.
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.dst: Isso... Isso seria fantástico!! Estou fazendo isso sozinho há meses!! Está QUASE pronto, mas-
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.dst: Vamos, vamos! Vou te mostrar tudo! Vamos lá, vamos lá!!
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home, then!
The Scarred Springs#009.dst: Tomara que dê pra você visitar antes de voltar pra casa!
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.dst: Tá, tá, o que é o próximo da lista... Vai, pensa como o Soberano Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#011.dst: Deixe Maripe te mostrar o lugar em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.dst: Certo! Estas são as piscinas principais- Sinceramente, não sei como tantos sapos chegaram aqui, com o brejo do outro lado da floresta...
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.dst: Mas eles têm que sair. Tá, são fofos, mas ninguém vai querer se banhar com eles... Nem com todas essas folhas caídas nas piscinas.
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.dst: A piscina lateral aqui também precisa ser limpa. As piscinas têm que estar limpas pros hóspedes! E quem sabe até pro Soberano!
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.dst: Já gastei muito tempo consertando estas cabanas. Eu trabalho com carpintaria. Elas estavam muito piores... Fico até feliz que meus avós não chegaram a ver isso assim.
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.dst: Tenho lembranças tão boas de brincar aqui quando era pequeno... O que eles pensariam vendo isto desmoronar? Essa ideia me deu motivação o tempo todo.
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.dst: Seria uma vergonha deixar Pishlas desmoronar de vez. Até o Soberano Zhiraok concordou! Sabia que ele passou aqui quando eu estava começando- Ah, espera! Falta um lugar!
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.dst: A casa de chá! Lanches, bebidas quentes, um lugar pra sentar fora da água... É um dos grandes projetos que faltam. Disso eu cuido- mas, voltando ao Soberano?
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.dst: Ele veio um dia, quando eu começava a arrumar o lugar, e disse que seria um ótimo serviço à comunidade! Já que faz tanto tempo que Pishlas não pode ser usado, digo.
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.dst: Isto era um grande centro comunitário. Perdê-lo foi um golpe pra todo mundo em Auburn... Ele prometeu coisas ótimas se eu conseguir arrumar tudo! Então mãos à obra!
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the southwest you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.dst: Vai recolher os sapos! Tem um lago a sudoeste onde você pode soltá-los. Depois... as folhas! Tire das piscinas. Depois... depois volta aqui e vemos como estamos!
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#023.src: How's it coming? Still working on this. Will be for a bit, but I'm energized! Maybe I can get this done today, even! Uh...right, right! Frogs!
The Scarred Springs#023.dst: Como está indo? Ainda estou nisso. Vai demorar um pouco, mas tô cheio de energia! Talvez eu termine até hoje! Hã... certo, certo! Sapos!
The Scarred Springs#023.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#024.src: Okay, there were five, and you're holding... Alright, so there's {~} left to get!
The Scarred Springs#024.dst: Tá, eram cinco, e você tem... Certo, faltam {~} pra pegar!
The Scarred Springs#024.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#025.src: Release the frogs at the pond in the back at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#025.dst: Solte os sapos no lago dos fundos em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#026.src: Whoa! That...that's sure a way to carry the frogs, haha! Y- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! You look- Wahaha, that's fantastic!! Oh, ohhkay, okay, right!
The Scarred Springs#026.dst: Uou! Isso... isso é que é jeito de levar sapos, haha! V- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! Você tá- Wahaha, que fantástico!! Ai, tááá, tá, certo!
The Scarred Springs#026.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#027.src: There's a pond to the southwest of Pishlas here you can drop them off at! Now, g-get out of here, eheheh! I gotta concentrate, and there's frogs on y- heehehahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.dst: Tem um lago a sudoeste de Pishlas onde você pode soltá-los! Agora s-sai daqui, eheheh! Preciso me concentrar, e tem sapo em v- hihihahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#028.src: Pick up all the leaf piles around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#028.dst: Recolha todos os montes de folhas perto de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#029.src: Okay, frogs are dealt with, now the leaves! There were ten big patches out there I saw. Get in there and scoop them up- Uh, lemme see. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.dst: Tá, sapos resolvidos, agora as folhas! Vi dez montes grandes lá fora. Entra lá e tira tudo- Hã, deixa eu ver. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#030.src: Okay, you got {~} left! Hopefully once you do, I'll be all done over here, and we'll go from there!
The Scarred Springs#030.dst: Tá, faltam {~}! Tomara que quando terminar eu já tenha acabado aqui, e seguimos daí!
The Scarred Springs#030.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#032.src: Okay, there! And STAY in, you darn board... So, how's the work going?
The Scarred Springs#032.dst: Pronto, aí! E FICA aí, tábua maldita... E aí, como vai o trabalho?
The Scarred Springs#032.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#033.src: Frogs dealt with, check...and leaves out of the water, check! Which, ah...well, that means now I need you to get some leaves...to put IN the water, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.dst: Sapos resolvidos, feito... e folhas fora da água, feito! O que, ah... quer dizer que agora preciso que você pegue folhas... pra pôr NA água, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#034.src: What I mean by that, is that I need fresh tea for the teahouse! I've already got some food stowed away for refreshments, but I'll need some drinks to go along with that.
The Scarred Springs#034.dst: Quero dizer que preciso de chá fresco pra casa de chá! Já tenho comida guardada pros lanches, mas vou precisar de umas bebidas pra acompanhar.
The Scarred Springs#034.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#035.src: I might be done in this building, but there's still plenty of things for me to take care of, so I've got to stay behind and really...really focus in on this!
The Scarred Springs#035.dst: Posso ter acabado este prédio, mas ainda tenho muita coisa pra cuidar, então preciso ficar aqui e realmente... realmente me concentrar nisso!
The Scarred Springs#035.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#036.src: It's just that...a lot of this isn't heavy work, but there's just so many tasks on the list that I don't know where to start, so I just can't get it going. You taking care of the other things is helping with that!
The Scarred Springs#036.dst: É que... muito disso nem é trabalho pesado, mas tem tanta tarefa na lista que não sei por onde começar, aí não consigo engrenar. Você cuidar das outras coisas tá ajudando nisso!
The Scarred Springs#036.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#037.src: So, uh, anyway! There's a teahouse off to the northwest, up on a ridge. I know the owner- her name's Marseled, and she makes the best tea in the whole forest!
The Scarred Springs#037.dst: Enfim, hã! Tem uma casa de chá a noroeste, no alto de uma encosta. Conheço a dona- ela se chama Marseled, e faz o melhor chá da floresta inteira!
The Scarred Springs#037.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#038.src: So, your job is to head there for a big bulk order, and then bring it back! I'll ask her about paying it off later, since we trade favors a lot. Tell her I sent you!
The Scarred Springs#038.dst: Então sua tarefa é ir lá buscar um pedido grande e trazer de volta! Depois eu vejo o pagamento com ela, a gente troca muitos favores. Diz que fui eu que mandei!
The Scarred Springs#038.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#040.src: Okay, dust busted, cobwebs cleared, lanterns in the middle of being lit- Oh, hey! Did you get the tea?
The Scarred Springs#040.dst: Tá, poeira fora, teias limpas, lanternas sendo acesas- Ah, oi! Pegou o chá?
The Scarred Springs#040.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#041.src: Marseled's teahouse is off to the northwest, up on the ridge. If you need the exact spot, look in your content book!
The Scarred Springs#041.dst: A casa de chá da Marseled fica a noroeste, na encosta. Precisa do lugar exato? Veja no livro de conteúdo!
The Scarred Springs#041.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#042.src: Welcome, traveler, to my humble teahouse. My name is Marseled. It is always a pleasure to see a new customer.
The Scarred Springs#042.dst: Bem-vindo, viajante, à minha humilde casa de chá. Sou Marseled. É sempre um prazer ver um cliente novo.
The Scarred Springs#042.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#043.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#043.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#044.src: Oh, is that so? Why, that's wonderful! He's spoken with me a few times about working on old Pishlas there. If he wants fresh stock for drinks, he must be confident that it's nearly finished!
The Scarred Springs#044.dst: Ah, é mesmo? Ora, que maravilha! Ele já me falou algumas vezes de reformar o velho Pishlas. Se quer estoque fresco pras bebidas, deve achar que está quase pronto!
The Scarred Springs#044.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#045.src: Admittedly, though, I'm facing some...difficulties. I've not got quite enough to fill up an order like he'll need. You see, ah...there's...
The Scarred Springs#045.dst: Mas admito que estou com algumas... dificuldades. Não tenho o bastante pra um pedido do tamanho que ele precisa. Sabe, ah... é que...
The Scarred Springs#045.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#046.src: It's COCKROACHES! Filthy, ugly, disgusting COCKROACHES!! They keep getting all over the mushrooms and on the tea leaves and I CAN'T touch them, I can't I can't I CAN'T!!
The Scarred Springs#046.dst: São BARATAS! BARATAS imundas, feias, nojentas!! Elas vivem subindo nos cogumelos e nas folhas de chá e eu NÃO consigo tocar nelas, não consigo não consigo NÃO CONSIGO!!
The Scarred Springs#046.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#047.src: They aren't even harming the plants or anything, but I go out to harvest them and they race up to me and crawl all over my feet and up my leggings and aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.dst: Nem estragam as plantas nem nada, mas eu saio pra colher e elas correm até mim, sobem nos meus pés, pela minha calça e aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#048.src: I hate them I hate them I hate them, I hate them so much! I- Er. Um. S-sorry. I...shouldn't act so ill-mannered in front of my customers.
The Scarred Springs#048.dst: Odeio elas odeio elas odeio elas, odeio demais! Eu- Ah. Hum. D-desculpe. Eu... não devia ser tão mal-educada na frente dos clientes.
The Scarred Springs#048.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#049.src: The musrooms are right out front and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to get me started again.
The Scarred Springs#049.dst: Os cogumelos ficam bem na frente e as folhas, encosta abaixo. Deve bastar pra eu recomeçar.
The Scarred Springs#049.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#050.src: I do hate to ask, but...if you could go out and harvest some of the ingredients for me? And deal with the pests? I've tried, but every time I just...panic.
The Scarred Springs#050.dst: Detesto pedir, mas... você poderia colher alguns ingredientes pra mim? E dar um jeito nas pragas? Já tentei, mas toda vez eu... entro em pânico.
The Scarred Springs#050.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#051.src: If you could take care of that problem for me, I'll be able to fill out the order for Maripe... And, hopefully, I won't wake the whole of {p} shrieking over a roach in my pants.
The Scarred Springs#051.dst: Se resolver esse problema pra mim, consigo fazer o pedido da Maripe... E, com sorte, não vou acordar {p} inteira gritando por uma barata na calça.
The Scarred Springs#051.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#052.src: The mushrooms are just out front, and the leaves are down the side of the hill. {~} mushrooms and {~} leaf batches should be enough to fill the order.
The Scarred Springs#052.dst: Os cogumelos ficam bem na frente e as folhas, encosta abaixo. {~} cogumelos e {~} maços de folhas devem bastar pro pedido.
The Scarred Springs#052.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#053.src: Collect {~} mushrooms and {~} leaf batches from the tea farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#053.dst: Colete {~} cogumelos e {~} maços de folhas na plantação de chá em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#054.src: Oh, hey! Did you get the tea yet? I'm trying to get everything in ship-shape here, but I'm running in circles a little...
The Scarred Springs#054.dst: Ah, oi! Já pegou o chá? Tô tentando deixar tudo nos trinques, mas tô andando um pouco em círculos...
The Scarred Springs#054.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#055.src: Oh, ew. She's got roaches in the farm? Yeah, that's rough. Anyways, go get 'em! I'll be, uh... Well, hopefully I'll have this done by the time you deal with that!
The Scarred Springs#055.dst: Eca. Ela tem baratas na plantação? É, que barra. Enfim, pega elas! Eu vou estar, hã... Bom, tomara que eu termine isso até você acabar lá!
The Scarred Springs#055.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#056.src: Bring the tea you collected back to Marseled at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#056.dst: Leve o chá que colheu para Marseled em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#058.src: YES!! Take THAT, you dirty things! No more cockroooaches, no more cockroooaches, yeah, yeah- Er!
The Scarred Springs#058.dst: SIM!! Tomem ISSO, suas nojentas! Chega de baraaatas, chega de baraaatas, é, é- Ahem!
The Scarred Springs#058.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#059.src: ...if you could. Um. Not tell anyone I was...doing that happy dance. Please. I don't think I've done that since I was a child.
The Scarred Springs#059.dst: ...se puder. Hum. Não conte a ninguém que eu fazia... a dancinha feliz. Por favor. Acho que não fazia isso desde criança.
The Scarred Springs#059.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#060.src: A-anyway, I'll pack up that order and bring it down to Pishlas on my own time. I know where it is. Perhaps I can be there for the opening celebrations, too!
The Scarred Springs#060.dst: E-enfim, vou embalar o pedido e levar a Pishlas quando puder. Sei onde fica. Talvez eu vá à festa de inauguração também!
The Scarred Springs#060.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#061.src: I'll be sure to let my customers know. An entire generation has missed out on those hot springs, if my parents speak truly, so this will be an event to cherish, I think!
The Scarred Springs#061.dst: Vou avisar meus clientes, claro. Se meus pais dizem a verdade, uma geração inteira perdeu essas fontes termais, então vai ser um evento memorável, acho!
The Scarred Springs#061.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#062.src: Okay, that's that now, so now- Oh, you're back! Did you get the order all filled out?
The Scarred Springs#062.dst: Tá, isso tá feito, então agora- Ah, você voltou! Conseguiu fechar o pedido?
The Scarred Springs#062.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#063.src: ...oops. You got confused, didn't you. Nah, those ingredients need to go to Marseled, and THEN come here. Good hustle, though! Get those to Marseled for processing!
The Scarred Springs#063.dst: ...opa. Você se confundiu, né? Não, esses ingredientes vão pra Marseled, e DEPOIS vêm pra cá. Mas que agilidade! Leva isso pra Marseled preparar!
The Scarred Springs#063.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#064.src: Bring the tea back to Maripe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#064.dst: Leve o chá para Maripe em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#065.src: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh...L-Look! We have visitors!! Um, I know I'm not setting a great example, but...be quiet, okay? Don't disturb them!
The Scarred Springs#065.dst: Meu Deus, meu Deus... O-olha! Temos visita!! Hã, sei que não dou bom exemplo, mas... fica quieto, tá? Não assusta eles!
The Scarred Springs#065.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#066.src: See? The foxes...! I haven't seen them around here since I was a kid! I- well, if you're a tourist you wouldn't know, I suppose, but this is exciting!
The Scarred Springs#066.dst: Viu? As raposas...! Não vejo elas por aqui desde criança! Eu- bom, se você é turista não deve saber, mas isso é emocionante!
The Scarred Springs#066.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#067.src: There's a really common tale about foxes here- That they're the reincarnation of our ancestors, that their spirits inhabit them. I know it's...well, it's supposed to be just a tall tale, but...
The Scarred Springs#067.dst: Aqui se conta muito que as raposas são a reencarnação dos nossos antepassados, que os espíritos deles vivem nelas. Sei que... bom, era pra ser só uma lenda, mas...
The Scarred Springs#067.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#068.src: I really can't help but feel like seeing them here is a good omen! It's like my grandparents are back again- Er, wait! The tea! I completely forgot, did you get the order placed?
The Scarred Springs#068.dst: Não consigo deixar de sentir que vê-las aqui é um bom presságio! É como se meus avós tivessem voltado- Hã, espera! O chá! Esqueci totalmente, você fez o pedido?
The Scarred Springs#068.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#069.src: Oh, Marseled said she'd bring it by herself? Alright, fantastic! And she said she'd invite folks to the opening too... Funny she did, since that's what I was just about to ask you to do!
The Scarred Springs#069.dst: Ah, a Marseled disse que ela mesma traria? Tá, fantástico! E disse que ia convidar gente pra inauguração também... Engraçado, era justo o que eu ia te pedir!
The Scarred Springs#069.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#070.src: Pishlas is almost back to the way I remember it being when I was younger. I've still got a bit of decorating to do, so I want you to spread the word!
The Scarred Springs#070.dst: Pishlas está quase como eu lembro de quando era pequeno. Ainda falta um pouco de decoração, então quero que você espalhe a notícia!
The Scarred Springs#070.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#071.src: I've got some notes here on where you could find folks I know in {p}. You tell them, put some notices up...
The Scarred Springs#071.dst: Tenho umas anotações aqui de onde achar conhecidos meus em {p}. Você conta pra eles, prega uns avisos...
The Scarred Springs#071.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#072.src: ...and then after the big celebration re-opening, they'll tell their families, and then word will spread from there! Is it odd to say I'm looking forward to the work of maintaining the place?
The Scarred Springs#072.dst: ...e depois da grande festa de reinauguração, eles contam pras famílias, e a notícia se espalha! É estranho dizer que tô ansioso pelo trabalho de manter o lugar?
The Scarred Springs#072.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#073.src: Anyways, head off and start getting the word out! If you don't know where to look, just check my notes! If you lose my notes you can come back and I'll copy them down again for you.
The Scarred Springs#073.dst: Enfim, vai lá e começa a espalhar a notícia! Se não souber onde procurar, é só ver minhas anotações! Se perder as anotações, volta que eu copio de novo pra você.
The Scarred Springs#073.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#074.src: Invite citizens of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to join the opening celebrations.
The Scarred Springs#074.dst: Convide os cidadãos de {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para a festa de inauguração.

The Scarred Springs#075.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#075.dst: Ufa, tá... Ufa. Lembra, eu não sou o Soberano. Não dá pra estar em todo lugar. Preciso ir com calma... tá quase pronto, sem estresse- Ah, oi!
The Scarred Springs#075.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#076.src: Have you spread the word yet? Check my notes to see where the people usually are, and get the news out! You're invited to the grand re-opening too, of course.
The Scarred Springs#076.dst: Já espalhou a notícia? Veja nas anotações onde o pessoal costuma ficar, e conte a novidade! Você também está convidado pra grande reinauguração, claro.
The Scarred Springs#076.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#077.src: Oh, you lost my notes. Don't worry, it happens. Do you think you can find the spots on your own, or do you want me to write a new copy down for you?
The Scarred Springs#077.dst: Ah, perdeu minhas anotações. Relaxa, acontece. Acha que consegue achar os lugares sozinho, ou quer que eu escreva uma cópia nova pra você?
The Scarred Springs#077.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#078.src: Okay, one sec...and...here! Remember to check them for where to go!
The Scarred Springs#078.dst: Tá, um segundo... e... pronto! Lembre de olhar nelas pra onde ir!
The Scarred Springs#078.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#079.src: All the spots I listed are right around {p}, but if you're having trouble, I'll write you up a new set if you ask!
The Scarred Springs#079.dst: Todos os lugares que anotei ficam perto de {p}, mas se estiver com dificuldade, é só pedir que eu escrevo outra!
The Scarred Springs#079.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#080.src: Oh, hello there. I certainly haven't seen you around here before.
The Scarred Springs#080.dst: Ah, olá. Certamente nunca te vi por aqui.
The Scarred Springs#080.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#081.src: Is there something you wanted to speak with me about?
The Scarred Springs#081.dst: Queria falar comigo sobre alguma coisa?
The Scarred Springs#081.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#082.dst: C-como é? O que vai reabrir?
The Scarred Springs#082.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#083.src: Oh, OH! Pishlas? The hot springs? Sorry, it's been so long that I nearly forgot the name.
The Scarred Springs#083.dst: Ah, AH! Pishlas? As fontes termais? Desculpe, faz tanto tempo que quase esqueci o nome.
The Scarred Springs#083.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#084.src: I have such vague memories of going there as a child, but I just couldn't imagine them after seeing how the place was abandoned.
The Scarred Springs#084.dst: Tenho lembranças vagas de ir lá quando criança, mas depois de ver o lugar abandonado, não conseguia mais imaginá-las.
The Scarred Springs#084.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#085.src: Maripe did tell me some time ago he would be working on renovating it. I'm to suppose his work has paid off, then! I'd intended to visit him again soon, but this provides a nice excuse, as well.
The Scarred Springs#085.dst: Maripe me disse há um tempo que ia reformá-lo. Suponho, então, que o esforço dele deu resultado! Pretendia visitá-lo logo, e isso me dá uma boa desculpa também.
The Scarred Springs#085.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#086.src: ...I might have to spread the word to his family for him. Even if Maripe's father is too busy looking after his wife, I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear about this.
The Scarred Springs#086.dst: ...talvez eu mesma deva avisar a família dele. Mesmo que o pai do Maripe esteja ocupado cuidando da esposa, com certeza vai adorar saber disso.
The Scarred Springs#086.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#087.src: Well, I hope to see you there, stranger!
The Scarred Springs#087.dst: Bem, espero te ver lá, forasteiro!
The Scarred Springs#087.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#088.src: Well, this is a sight, for sure! What can we do for you, fella?
The Scarred Springs#088.dst: Ora, que cena, hein! Em que posso ajudar, rapaz?
The Scarred Springs#088.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#090.src: It's been ages, right...? That place, it's been in a state of disrepair for as long as I can recall...
The Scarred Springs#090.dst: Faz séculos, né...? Aquele lugar está em ruínas desde que me lembro...
The Scarred Springs#090.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#091.src: They're finally going to be open again? And fully renovated? Sounds-
The Scarred Springs#091.dst: Elas finalmente vão reabrir? E reformadas? Parece-
The Scarred Springs#091.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#092.src: Sounds tempting. It's been ages since I've been able to bathe in hot water or relax properly...
The Scarred Springs#092.dst: Parece tentador. Faz séculos que não tomo um banho quente nem descanso direito...
The Scarred Springs#092.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#093.src: We'll surely all be there! These old bones could use a nice, long soak, I think!
The Scarred Springs#093.dst: Com certeza vamos todos! Estes ossos velhos merecem um bom e longo banho!
The Scarred Springs#093.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#094.src: The tourist returns! Anything else you wanted to talk about?
The Scarred Springs#094.dst: O turista voltou! Quer falar de mais alguma coisa?
The Scarred Springs#094.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#095.src: Is there anything of interest here?

The Scarred Springs#096.src: Head back to Pishlas to participate in the celebrations at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Scarred Springs#096.dst: Volte a Pishlas para participar da festa em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#097.src: Okay. Phew. Wow. Okay. Alright, alright, it's...
The Scarred Springs#097.dst: Tá. Ufa. Uau. Tá. Certo, certo, é...
The Scarred Springs#097.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#098.src: It's...it's done. It's all... It's all done, wow, I... There's. There's people... And they're here, and they're enjoying it, and, and...
The Scarred Springs#098.dst: Tá... tá pronto. Tá tudo... Tá tudo pronto, uau, eu... Tem. Tem gente... E eles estão aqui, e estão gostando, e, e...
The Scarred Springs#098.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#099.src: And I don't have to think about this anymore, and my parents can relax about having let the place go, and...
The Scarred Springs#099.dst: E não preciso mais pensar nisso, e meus pais podem parar de se culpar por ter largado o lugar, e...
The Scarred Springs#099.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#100.src: And, and, and, the, the Sovereign, he'll, I'll get to tell him I'm done, and I'll get that, and... Ohhh my stars I'm done but I'm even more anxious now that it's done than I was before, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#100.dst: E, e, e, o, o Soberano, ele vai, eu vou poder dizer que terminei, e vou ganhar aquilo, e... Ai, minhas estrelas, terminei mas agora tô mais ansioso que antes, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#100.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#101.src: Okay, come on, keep your head on straight, Maripe! Now's the time to relax a bit... Deep breaths now- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#101.dst: Tá, vamos, cabeça no lugar, Maripe! Agora é hora de relaxar um pouco... Respira fundo- Ah, oi!
The Scarred Springs#101.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#102.src: Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
The Scarred Springs#102.dst: Hã, eu... preciso de um minuto, eheh. Que tal... você, hã, falar com os outros antes, e aí... é?
The Scarred Springs#102.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#103.src: I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
The Scarred Springs#103.dst: Eu diria que mal reconheço o lugar depois da reforma... mas, sinceramente, me sinto em casa, como o filhotinho de raposa que eu era.
The Scarred Springs#103.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#104.src: Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
The Scarred Springs#104.dst: Maripe tentou te elogiar como se você tivesse feito tudo! Quase tive que arrancar dele a confissão de que você só chegou no fim para os últimos retoques.
The Scarred Springs#104.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#105.src: He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
The Scarred Springs#105.dst: Ele sempre foi humilde, mas acho que isso só mostra a gratidão dele. E acredite, eu também sou grata! Acho que você deu o empurrão que ele precisava.
The Scarred Springs#105.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#106.src: Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
The Scarred Springs#106.dst: Ohhhohoho, é aí mesmo. Cara... eu não sabia o que estava perdendo. Pishlas é um nome meio antigo, mas...
The Scarred Springs#106.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#107.src: Phew. I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
The Scarred Springs#107.dst: Ufa. Com certeza vou voltar aqui. Um dia longo caçando Liff, depois uma noite longa de molho... Ah, que rotina gostosa...
The Scarred Springs#107.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#108.src: Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
The Scarred Springs#108.dst: Maripe, hum. Esse garoto mandou bem. Eu mesmo não teria feito melhor, na minha idade. Tem olho pra carpintaria, pra decoração, pro respeito aos antepassados...
The Scarred Springs#108.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#109.src: And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
The Scarred Springs#109.dst: E puxa, ainda tem toalha de graça! Vou ser cliente fiel daqui pra frente, com certeza! Espero que aguente o movimento diário!
The Scarred Springs#109.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#110.src: Wow... I'll have to tell Timot what he's missing out on. This is fantastic. Perfect view, perfect water, perfect service...
The Scarred Springs#110.dst: Uau... Vou contar ao Timot o que ele está perdendo. Isto é fantástico. Vista perfeita, água perfeita, serviço perfeito...
The Scarred Springs#110.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#111.src: Family concerns are definitely more important than a warm bath, but... I'll have to share some leaves with him, buy his ticket for next time. He deserves a free soak.
The Scarred Springs#111.dst: Assuntos de família vêm antes de um banho quente, claro, mas... vou dividir umas folhas com ele e pagar a entrada da próxima vez. Ele merece um banho grátis.
The Scarred Springs#111.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#112.src: Ahhh, that hits the spot... Youngster, do yourself a favor- never get as old as I am. {~} years, I've got...and this... Goodbye, aches, my dear old enemies...
The Scarred Springs#112.dst: Ahhh, isso sim é vida... Jovem, faça um favor a si- nunca fique velho como eu. {~} anos eu tenho... e isso... Adeus, dores, minhas velhas inimigas...
The Scarred Springs#112.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#113.src: It's heavenly to feel them wash away in the water, but boy would I love to not creak when I sit down to begin with. Good on you for helping out, by the way- especially for a tourist!
The Scarred Springs#113.dst: É divino senti-las indo embora na água, mas, nossa, como eu queria nem estalar ao sentar. Aliás, bom trabalho ajudando- ainda mais sendo turista!
The Scarred Springs#113.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#114.src: After the community notice board got vandalized so badly a couple years ago, I thought not to trust it again. I'm quite glad I broke with that and gave it a look now.
The Scarred Springs#114.dst: Depois que o mural comunitário foi tão vandalizado uns anos atrás, decidi não confiar mais nele. Ainda bem que mudei de ideia e dei uma olhada agora.
The Scarred Springs#114.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#115.src: Have you seen the owner of the springs, by the way? He's had a few foxes around him all day- normally, they're not the ones doing the chasing like that!
The Scarred Springs#115.dst: Aliás, viu o dono das termas? Ele passou o dia com umas raposas em volta- normalmente não são elas que ficam correndo atrás assim!
The Scarred Springs#115.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#116.src: Oh, it's lovely to be back. Having visited this place as a teenager, it had always saddened me that it closed. My heart really does go out to Maripe's mother.
The Scarred Springs#116.dst: Ah, que bom voltar. Visitei este lugar na adolescência, e sempre me entristeceu que tivesse fechado. Meu coração vai mesmo para a mãe do Maripe.
The Scarred Springs#116.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#117.src: Honestly, if the Sovereign can manage all his business, his father should've been able to keep up. But either way, Maripe has outdone himself- and the Auburn Amaretto is such a fine vintage!
The Scarred Springs#117.dst: Sinceramente, se o Soberano dá conta de todos os assuntos dele, o pai dele devia ter dado conta. Mas, enfim, Maripe se superou- e o Auburn Amaretto é uma safra tão boa!
The Scarred Springs#117.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#118.src: I've enough years on me to remember how Maripe's grandparents used to run this place. Maripe has outdone himself- this is, at barest minimum, up to their standard. No one can say otherwise.
The Scarred Springs#118.dst: Tenho idade para lembrar como os avós do Maripe cuidavam deste lugar. Maripe se superou- isto está, no mínimo, à altura deles. Ninguém pode dizer o contrário.
The Scarred Springs#118.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#119.src: It always was something of a...blemish, on his family's name, this place. I understand his mother fell ill, and that's certainly no one's fault, but abandoning a family business for any reason...
The Scarred Springs#119.dst: Este lugar sempre foi uma espécie de... mancha no nome da família dele. Sei que a mãe adoeceu, e isso não é culpa de ninguém, mas abandonar um negócio da família por qualquer motivo...
The Scarred Springs#119.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#120.src: People judged them all, whether they realized it or not. Hopefully now with Pishlas open, that will end. It feels as if a cloud has lifted, really. Hmhm, or maybe that's just the tea.
The Scarred Springs#120.dst: As pessoas julgavam todos eles, percebendo ou não. Tomara que agora, com Pishlas aberto, isso acabe. É como se uma nuvem tivesse se dissipado. Hmhm, ou talvez seja só o chá.
The Scarred Springs#120.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#121.src: Either way, this is marvelous work. And I can take my harvest without having to worry about disgusting cockroaches crawling all over me! So thank you for that, as well.
The Scarred Springs#121.dst: De todo modo, é um trabalho maravilhoso. E posso colher sem me preocupar com baratas nojentas subindo em mim! Então obrigada por isso também.
The Scarred Springs#121.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#123.src: I think I said earlier- with so many different little things piling up, I just couldn't think straight. i've been stuck at 'almost done' for a while now.
The Scarred Springs#123.dst: Acho que já disse- com tantas coisinhas acumulando, eu não conseguia pensar direito. Fiquei um bom tempo preso no 'quase pronto'.
The Scarred Springs#123.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#124.src: You showing up, offering to take care of all the little things cluttering up my brainspace...that made this...possible! I don't think I could've done it without you!
The Scarred Springs#124.dst: Você aparecer e se oferecer pra cuidar de todas as coisinhas que entulhavam minha cabeça... isso tornou isto... possível! Acho que não teria conseguido sem você!
The Scarred Springs#124.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#125.src: It really is just like I remembered it being. Everyone getting together and relaxing, talking about whatever strikes their fancy, just letting their woes disappear...
The Scarred Springs#125.dst: Está igualzinho ao que eu lembrava. Todo mundo junto, relaxando, falando do que der na telha, deixando os problemas sumirem...
The Scarred Springs#125.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#126.src: It even feels like I've got my grandparents right here with me. ...though, maybe that's just these two. These foxes have been following me all day...I hope they'll stick around.
The Scarred Springs#126.dst: Até parece que meus avós estão aqui comigo. ...bem, talvez sejam só esses dois. Essas raposas me seguem o dia todo... Espero que fiquem por aqui.
The Scarred Springs#126.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#127.src: It's this feeling of...a weight off my chest, but the knowledge there's a new task ahead of me- keeping up with this place. With Pishlas. It's...refreshing, I think.
The Scarred Springs#127.dst: É essa sensação de... tirar um peso das costas, mas sabendo que tenho uma tarefa nova- manter este lugar. Manter Pishlas. É... revigorante, acho.
The Scarred Springs#127.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#128.src: Do... I know you're just a tourist, but...do you think... Do you think my grandparents would be proud of me? For all this?
The Scarred Springs#128.dst: Você... Sei que é só um turista, mas... você acha... Acha que meus avós teriam orgulho de mim? Por tudo isso?
The Scarred Springs#128.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#130.src: ...oh gosh, I promised myself I wouldn't cry...a-and here I am doing it anyways. Haha... Stars, I'm tired after all this. So, so tired...but. But the good kind of tired, you know?
The Scarred Springs#130.dst: ...nossa, prometi que não ia chorar... e-e cá estou eu chorando. Haha... Minhas estrelas, que cansaço depois de tudo. Tão, tão cansado... mas. Mas um cansaço bom, sabe?
The Scarred Springs#130.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#131.src: You might need to go home soon, since you're just visiting...but come back any time. It'll be free, for you- and these should go pretty far in the {p}, I think. I just- Thank you...so much.
The Scarred Springs#131.dst: Talvez você tenha que voltar logo pra casa, já que está de passagem... mas volte quando quiser. Pra você é grátis- e isto deve render bastante em {p}, acho. Eu só- Obrigado... demais.
The Scarred Springs#131.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#132.src: ...you know...you might have a point. I've been so weighed down by what everyone might think, that I could barely focus on the work. I should try and let that go, shouldn't I?
The Scarred Springs#132.dst: ...sabe... talvez você tenha razão. O que os outros podiam pensar me pesava tanto que eu mal conseguia focar no trabalho. Devia tentar largar isso, né?
The Scarred Springs#132.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#133.src: You know, for a tourist, you sure are generous with the help. So, I should be generous too! How's free access for life...and a personal gift from me sound? Again...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#133.dst: Sabe, pra um turista, você ajuda muito. Então eu também tenho que ser generoso! Que tal entrada grátis pra vida toda... e um presente meu? De novo... muito obrigado!
The Scarred Springs#133.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#134.src: ...heh. I guess that would make sense. But...I'd like to think they would be. I really would.
The Scarred Springs#134.dst: ...heh. Acho que faz sentido. Mas... eu gosto de pensar que teriam. Gosto mesmo.
The Scarred Springs#134.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#135.src: So... For one thing. You get free access! For another...here's a personal gift from me! After all, you didn't HAVE to help...but you did! You'll get a lot more use out of these than I will. SO...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#135.dst: Então... Primeiro: entrada grátis pra você! Segundo... aqui está um presente meu! Afinal, você não PRECISAVA ajudar... mas ajudou! Você vai aproveitar isto muito mais que eu. ENTÃO... muito obrigado!
The Scarred Springs#135.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#136.src: You should release the Frogs at the pond in the back.
The Scarred Springs#136.dst: Você devia soltar os sapos no lago dos fundos.

The Scarred Springs#138.src: You should head back to clean up the pools now.
The Scarred Springs#138.dst: Agora volte para limpar as piscinas.

The Scarred Springs#140.src: You should head back to Maripe.

The Scarred Springs#142.src: Yes indeed. I'm far from the first to run the teahouse, though.
The Scarred Springs#142.dst: Isso mesmo. Mas muitas cuidaram da casa de chá antes de mim.
The Scarred Springs#142.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#143.src: My family has always been in the business of running this place- I do believe this building has stood since the very beginning of our written history.
The Scarred Springs#143.dst: Minha família sempre cuidou deste lugar- creio que este prédio está de pé desde o início da nossa história escrita.
The Scarred Springs#143.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#144.src: Of course, it is only right that someone take in our parents' footsteps and continue the work. Not all my siblings were enthused with the job, but I've taken to it quite smoothly, I think.
The Scarred Springs#144.dst: Claro, é justo que alguém siga os passos dos nossos pais e continue o trabalho. Nem todos os meus irmãos se animaram com o ofício, mas eu me adaptei bem, acho.
The Scarred Springs#144.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#145.src: It would have been unthinkable to leave the teahouse empty. After all, there have been no great tragedies preventing me from putting my attention to the work.
The Scarred Springs#145.dst: Seria impensável deixar a casa de chá vazia. Afinal, nenhuma grande tragédia me impediu de dedicar minha atenção ao trabalho.
The Scarred Springs#145.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#146.src: I do hope they all have found their different pursuits to be as fulfilling as I find following in my family's footsteps to be.
The Scarred Springs#146.dst: Espero que todos tenham achado seus caminhos tão gratificantes quanto eu acho seguir os passos da minha família.
The Scarred Springs#146.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#147.src: A good question. Mine is far from the only teahouse in the forest, after all. All of them have their own specialties... Sampling from different houses is fantastic for gaining new ideas.
The Scarred Springs#147.dst: Boa pergunta. Afinal, a minha está longe de ser a única casa de chá da floresta. Cada uma tem suas especialidades... Provar de casas diferentes é ótimo para ter ideias.
The Scarred Springs#147.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#148.src: I bother by the most traditional methods- there's a particular type of tea leaf I grow here, of course, but my other chief brewing ingredient consists of local mushrooms.
The Scarred Springs#148.dst: Sigo os métodos mais tradicionais- cultivo aqui um tipo específico de folha de chá, claro, mas meu outro ingrediente principal são os cogumelos locais.
The Scarred Springs#148.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#149.src: Many tourists have expressed disbelief at this idea- apparently, mushrooms don't sound palateable or usable for tea, but that isn't true!
The Scarred Springs#149.dst: Muitos turistas não acreditam nessa ideia- pelo visto, cogumelos não soam gostosos nem úteis para chá, mas não é verdade!
The Scarred Springs#149.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#150.src: I think it's simply the idea that some mushrooms are poisonous that warns people away, but I assure you, if what I cultivated was poison I wouldn't be alive to provide it.
The Scarred Springs#150.dst: Acho que é só a ideia de que alguns cogumelos são venenosos que afasta as pessoas, mas garanto que, se o que cultivo fosse veneno, eu não estaria viva para servi-lo.
The Scarred Springs#150.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#151.src: Other teahouses prefer different specialties. I have, for example, had some fantastic ginger tea from this small village by a manor...but I stand by the most traditional methods.
The Scarred Springs#151.dst: Outras casas de chá preferem outras especialidades. Já tomei, por exemplo, um chá de gengibre fantástico numa vilinha perto de uma mansão... mas fico com os métodos tradicionais.
The Scarred Springs#151.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#152.src: There is a tea for every occasion, so I don't believe there is a best one to choose always. However, there is a worst tea. There is...certainly...a worst tea.
The Scarred Springs#152.dst: Há um chá para cada ocasião, então não creio que exista um que seja sempre o melhor. Porém, existe o pior chá. Existe... com certeza... o pior chá.
The Scarred Springs#152.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#154.src: I'm curious. What's your opinion on the teas around here?
The Scarred Springs#154.dst: Fiquei curiosa. O que acha dos chás daqui?
The Scarred Springs#154.speaker: Player

The Scarred Springs#155.src: I'm curious. What's your opinion on the teas around here?
The Scarred Springs#155.dst: Fiquei curiosa. O que acha dos chás daqui?
The Scarred Springs#155.speaker: Player

The Scarred Springs#156.src: Maripe sent me. He's reopening the hot springs and needs to stock the teahouse with a bulk order.
The Scarred Springs#156.dst: Maripe me mandou. Ele vai reabrir as termas e precisa encher a casa de chá com um pedido grande.
The Scarred Springs#156.speaker: Player

The Scarred Springs#157.src: You should bring the ingredients back to Marseled.
The Scarred Springs#157.dst: Você devia levar os ingredientes para Marseled.

The Scarred Springs#158.src: Job's done- The cockroaches are dead, and I have the ingredients for you.
The Scarred Springs#158.dst: Serviço feito- As baratas morreram, e trouxe seus ingredientes.
The Scarred Springs#158.speaker: Player

The Scarred Springs#159.src: Plenty of papers have been posted over, and there's a weathered old advertisement in the middle. Surely it's lost relevance by now, so...
The Scarred Springs#159.dst: Há muitos papéis colados uns sobre os outros, e um anúncio velho e gasto no meio. Com certeza já perdeu a validade, então...

The Scarred Springs#160.src: There. That should be a good spot for it. How much effort did Maripe put into the poster? It really stands out from the rest of the notices.
The Scarred Springs#160.dst: Pronto. Deve ser um bom lugar. Quanto esforço o Maripe pôs nesse cartaz? Ele se destaca muito dos outros avisos.

The Scarred Springs#161.src: There isn't a world that exists where someone doesn't see this advertisement.
The Scarred Springs#161.dst: Não existe mundo em que alguém não veja este anúncio.

The Scarred Springs#162.src: You're now tracking the Lone Person at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!
The Scarred Springs#162.dst: Agora você está rastreando a Pessoa solitária em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!

The Scarred Springs#163.src: You're now tracking the Group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!
The Scarred Springs#163.dst: Agora você está rastreando o Grupo em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]!

The Scarred Springs#164.src: That's everyone! You may as well head back and join in on the fun.
The Scarred Springs#164.dst: São todos! Melhor voltar e entrar na festa.

The Scarred Springs#165.src: There's so many people here! It'd be a shame to not talk to a few of them.
The Scarred Springs#165.dst: Tem tanta gente aqui! Seria uma pena não falar com algumas.

The Scarred Springs#166.src: Maripe's waving in your general direction. He must've calmed down enough to talk coherently now.
The Scarred Springs#166.dst: Maripe acena mais ou menos na sua direção. Deve ter se acalmado o bastante para falar direito.

The Scarred Springs#167.src: Surely they would be. You've done a great job.
The Scarred Springs#167.dst: Com certeza. Você fez um ótimo trabalho.
The Scarred Springs#167.speaker: Player

The Scarred Springs#168.src: It's really all here again. It really is. I...I did this. All my work's finally born fruit!
The Scarred Springs#168.dst: Está tudo aqui de novo. Está mesmo. Eu... eu fiz isso. Todo o meu trabalho deu fruto!
The Scarred Springs#168.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#169.src: It's basking in the shade. It looks pleased with something, but you're not sure what...
The Scarred Springs#169.dst: Está descansando à sombra. Parece satisfeita com algo, mas você não sabe com o quê...

The Scarred Springs#170.src: It's not quite asleep yet. It appears to be shivering in... anticipation?
The Scarred Springs#170.dst: Ainda não dormiu de vez. Parece tremer de... expectativa?

The Scarred Springs#171.src: It looks to be observing Maripe at work with great curiosity.
The Scarred Springs#171.dst: Parece observar Maripe trabalhando com muita curiosidade.

The Scarred Springs#172.src: Everyone listed here is already likely to be enjoying themselves at the hot springs.
The Scarred Springs#172.dst: Todos da lista provavelmente já estão curtindo as termas.

The Scarred Springs#173.src: It's sleeping lightly, as if it could wake up at any moment. Feels like it's keeping an eye on the springs...or like a proud parent surveying their child's work.
The Scarred Springs#173.dst: Dorme um sono leve, como se fosse acordar a qualquer momento. Parece vigiar as termas... ou um pai orgulhoso admirando a obra do filho.

The Scarred Springs#174.src: It's sleeping soundly. Its breaths are soft, like they could lull you to sleep if you listened for long enough...like a proud parent tucking you into bed.
The Scarred Springs#174.dst: Dorme profundamente. A respiração é suave, como se pudesse te fazer dormir se ouvisse por bastante tempo... como um pai orgulhoso te pondo na cama.

The Scarred Springs#175.src: It looks very comfortable in its sleep. Maripe must have been mindful enough to lay a towel below it.
The Scarred Springs#175.dst: Parece bem confortável dormindo. Maripe deve ter tido o cuidado de pôr uma toalha embaixo dela.

The Scarred Springs#176.src: It seems to enjoy watching the visistors.
The Scarred Springs#176.dst: Parece gostar de olhar os visitantes.

The Scarred Springs#177.src: It's slowly dozing off. It appears to be... savoring the moment?
The Scarred Springs#177.dst: Está cochilando aos poucos. Parece... saborear o momento?

The Scarred Springs#178.src: It's basking in the shade. Even despite all the people around, it seems content...or maybe, it's because of all the people around?
The Scarred Springs#178.dst: Está descansando à sombra. Mesmo com tanta gente em volta, parece contente... ou talvez seja justamente por causa de tanta gente?

The Sewers of Ragni#000.src: Soldier! Have you been explorin' the sewers? I hope you're well prepared.
The Sewers of Ragni#000.dst: Soldado! Andou explorando os esgotos? Espero que esteja bem preparado.

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requestin' help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.dst: Soldado! Chegou na hora. Pedimos ajuda há séculos.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorisin' the Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.dst: Com as hordas corrompidas aterrorizando as Planícies, mais e mais gente vem para {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: Issue is, a major sewer pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.dst: Problema: o cano principal do esgoto entupiu. Claro que ninguém quis o serviço.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: I'm going to need ya to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.dst: Vou precisar que você suje as mãos. Preciso de ajuda com o entupimento.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.dst: O plano é este. Entramos, pomos explosivos pequenos para soltar o entupimento, e saímos.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: We're usin' this side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... ya don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.dst: Vamos por este cano lateral. O maior, morro abaixo, bem... melhor não se meter muito nele.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurkin'. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.dst: Fique esperto lá dentro. Qualquer coisa pode estar à espreita. Pronto? Vamos!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: New Quest Started: The Sewers of {p}

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Good, ya caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#009.dst: Bom, me alcançou. Cuidado onde pisa por aqui, soldado.
The Sewers of Ragni#009.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: Our scouts've confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.dst: Os batedores confirmaram que a área está limpa, mas uma curva errada te leva ao velho complexo prisional.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: I... we really don't want t' end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.dst: Eu... a gente não quer mesmo ir parar lá.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#012.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.dst: Tome um explosivo pequeno. Já pus um no entupimento; se só ele não bastar, use este.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: Ah, you're alive! Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#015.dst: Ah, você está vivo! Parece que subestimamos a quantidade de esgoto.
The Sewers of Ragni#015.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, y'know. Back durin' the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#016.dst: ... ah. Este esgoto tem história, sabe. Nos Ataques a {p}, escondiam civis aqui, na velha prisão.
The Sewers of Ragni#016.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Let's get out of here. D'you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#017.dst: Vamos sair daqui. Ainda tem o explosivo que te dei?
The Sewers of Ragni#017.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.dst: Ufa! Parece que a primeira explosão desentupiu o cano, os cidadãos de {p} vão ficar felizes.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: ... I don't know exactly what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.dst: ... Não sei bem o que tem lá dentro, soldado.

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: I can't stop you from explorin' the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.dst: Não posso te impedir de explorar a masmorra, mas recomendo se equipar antes.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in 'em durin' a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#021.dst: Diz a lenda que Bob, o guerreiro lendário, nasceu lá num ataque a {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#021.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people say she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#022.dst: A mãe dele morreu no parto, mas dizem que ficou lá por anos. Apodrecendo. Esperando.
The Sewers of Ragni#022.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#023.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, an' good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#023.dst: Mas é só uma história! Obrigado pela ajuda, soldado, e boa sorte.
The Sewers of Ragni#023.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#024.dst: O Tenente em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] precisa de ajuda.

The Sewers of Ragni#025.src: Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#025.dst: Entre no esgoto em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e encontre o entupimento.

The Sewers of Ragni#026.src: Explore the sewer and find the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.dst: Explore o esgoto e encontre o entupimento.

The Sewers of Ragni#027.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.dst: Enfim, achei o entupimento. Está logo à frente.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#028.src: Find a way to fix the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.dst: Encontre um jeito de desfazer o entupimento.

The Sewers of Ragni#029.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.dst: Encontre a saída deste esgoto sinistro.

The Sewers of Ragni#030.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.dst: Te perdi um pouco lá atrás. Sorte que nos achamos, sinceramente.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#031.src: I lost you for a bit back there. 's lucky we found each other, t' be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#031.dst: Te perdi um pouco lá atrás. Sorte que nos achamos, sinceramente.
The Sewers of Ragni#031.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#032.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#032.dst: Às vezes... às vezes não bastava. Dizem que ainda há... coisas vagando lá. Restos dos massacres.
The Sewers of Ragni#032.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#033.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#033.dst: Ótimo, use nesta parede, parece que dá pra atravessar...
The Sewers of Ragni#033.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#035.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#035.dst: E dê graças por não termos topado com nada muito feio lá dentro. Algumas histórias...
The Sewers of Ragni#035.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#037.src: An' count yourself lucky that we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some o' the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#037.dst: E dê graças por não termos topado com nada muito feio lá dentro. Algumas das histórias...
The Sewers of Ragni#037.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#038.src: ... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#038.dst: ... Não sei bem o que tem lá dentro, soldado.
The Sewers of Ragni#038.speaker: Jenprest

The Shadow of the Beast#000.src: See the blood on the ground? That stuff is fresh. Follow it, see where it leads, and hunt that beast before it does something terrible!
The Shadow of the Beast#000.dst: Vê o sangue no chão? Está fresco. Siga, veja aonde leva, e cace essa fera antes que ela faça algo terrível!
The Shadow of the Beast#000.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#001.src: The blood trail ought to lead you to wherever the beast went. Hunt that thing down for us all!
The Shadow of the Beast#001.dst: O rastro de sangue deve te levar até onde a fera foi. Cace essa coisa pelo bem de todos!
The Shadow of the Beast#001.speaker: Dereg

similar.text: [+{~} Emeralds]

The Shadow of the Beast#003.src: If you are done fixing my house, it looks like there're tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#003.dst: Se já terminou de consertar minha casa, parece que há pegadas para o leste... pegadas grandes. Boa sorte seguindo, e se cuide!
The Shadow of the Beast#003.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#004.src: Looks like there's tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.dst: Parece que há pegadas para o leste... pegadas grandes. Boa sorte seguindo, e se cuide!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#005.src: Aah, there's so many people hurt already, don't make it worse, please!
The Shadow of the Beast#005.dst: Aah, já tem tanta gente ferida, não piore as coisas, por favor!
The Shadow of the Beast#005.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#006.src: Ugh, think Rileen! You have the herbs, what else goes into those poultices...
The Shadow of the Beast#006.dst: Ai, pensa, Rileen! Você tem as ervas, o que mais vai nesses emplastros...
The Shadow of the Beast#006.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#007.src: She just keeps worrying over what she can do. Seems like getting the oil might help her calm down.
The Shadow of the Beast#007.dst: Ela não para de se afligir com o que pode fazer. Pegar o óleo talvez a ajude a se acalmar.

The Shadow of the Beast#008.src: She's still freaking out. She mentioned needing [{~} Salmon Oil] for medicine, and a pond out back full of fish...
The Shadow of the Beast#008.dst: Ela continua apavorada. Disse que precisa de [{~} Salmon Oil] para remédio, e há um lago atrás cheio de peixes...

The Shadow of the Beast#009.src: I think it went into the cave east of here. Go for it! Stop that thing before it causes any more damage!
The Shadow of the Beast#009.dst: Acho que entrou na caverna a leste daqui. Vai lá! Detenha essa coisa antes que cause mais estrago!
The Shadow of the Beast#009.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#010.src: Talk to Dereg in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Shadow of the Beast#010.dst: Fale com Dereg na casa dele em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#011.src: Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
The Shadow of the Beast#011.dst: Ah, você parece durão. Deve ser um desses humanos de que tanto ouço falar, né? Vivem falando da sua gente.
The Shadow of the Beast#011.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#012.src: You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
The Shadow of the Beast#012.dst: Sabe, que são todos briguentos. Duros na queda, e dispostos a matar todo tipo de fera, sabe?
The Shadow of the Beast#012.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#013.src: I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
The Shadow of the Beast#013.dst: Acho que você sabe aonde quero chegar. Uma noite vi uma coisa enorme se arrastando pelo pântano! Alta como as árvores.
The Shadow of the Beast#013.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#014.src: I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
The Shadow of the Beast#014.dst: Não vi os detalhes, mas, pelo tamanho, podia passar por cima das muralhas de {p} e destruir a cidade toda!
The Shadow of the Beast#014.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#015.src: Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
The Shadow of the Beast#015.dst: Claro, tem tanto vigarista por aqui vendendo cueca antimonstro e sei lá o quê que ninguém acredita em mim.
The Shadow of the Beast#015.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#016.src: So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.dst: Então é com você! Hum, supondo que queira ajudar, pelo menos... A única coisa que sei com certeza é que ele estava comendo algo.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#017.src: Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.
The Shadow of the Beast#017.dst: Siga o rastro de sangue deixado pela fera.

The Shadow of the Beast#018.src: Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.dst: Ah, que bagunça! E meu machado quebrou também... como vou consertar isso?!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#019.src: I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.dst: Não posso pagar- AAAH! H-Humano! O que quer?! Não é boa hora!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#020.src: Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
The Shadow of the Beast#020.dst: Alguma coisa destruiu meu curral e arrasou a fazenda inteira!
The Shadow of the Beast#020.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#021.src: And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
The Shadow of the Beast#021.dst: E era Willow maciça, de boa qualidade... uff...
The Shadow of the Beast#021.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#022.src: Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
The Shadow of the Beast#022.dst: Espera, quê? Você está caçando a coisa? Bom, muito bonito, mas pode me ajudar aqui primeiro?
The Shadow of the Beast#022.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#023.src: I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
The Shadow of the Beast#023.dst: Tenho uma ideia de onde ela foi, então... uma mão lava a outra?
The Shadow of the Beast#023.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#024.src: Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
The Shadow of the Beast#024.dst: Tá, isso dá certo, isso dá certo! Preciso ver como consertar isto, e umas vacas fugiram em pânico.
The Shadow of the Beast#024.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#025.src: So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#025.dst: Então você cuida delas enquanto eu replanejo a cerca. Fácil, né?
The Shadow of the Beast#025.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#026.src: Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.dst: Três vacas minhas fugiram. Procure pela fazenda. Estavam comendo, então procure trigo caído no chão!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#027.src: Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.dst: Vai, mexa-se! Te espero bem aqui!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#028.src: Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.
The Shadow of the Beast#028.dst: Cuide das três vacas fugidas perto da casa e na caverna sob a fazenda.

The Shadow of the Beast#029.src: Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
The Shadow of the Beast#029.dst: Ah, já voltou? Nem terminei minhas coisas, cadê as vacas?
The Shadow of the Beast#029.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#031.src: ...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
The Shadow of the Beast#031.dst: ...eheh. Você. Você. Isso é piada, né? Estamos dando risada?!
The Shadow of the Beast#031.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#032.src: WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
The Shadow of the Beast#032.dst: É BRINCADEIRA, NÉ?! PELO AMOR DE TUDO QUE É SAGRADO, DIZ QUE É PIADA!
The Shadow of the Beast#032.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#033.src: WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
The Shadow of the Beast#033.dst: O QUE É ISSO?! VOCÊ É LESADO?!
The Shadow of the Beast#033.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#034.src: NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
The Shadow of the Beast#034.dst: NÃO, ESPERA, É HUMANO, ESSE É O PROBLEMA! BRUTOS IDIOTAS, TODOS!
The Shadow of the Beast#034.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#035.src: DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
The Shadow of the Beast#035.dst: PRECISAVA EU DIZER QUE QUERIA ELAS VIVAS? ISSO NÃO ERA ÓBVIO PRA VOCÊ?!
The Shadow of the Beast#035.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#036.src: Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.dst: Hff...haah...hrrgh...não acredirto...acredirto? Acredito! Não acredito nisso!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#037.src: Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
The Shadow of the Beast#037.dst: Uff, calma, Tolem, calma... ainda dá pra salvar isso...
The Shadow of the Beast#037.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#038.src: Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#038.dst: Certo, duas coisas. Seu novo nome é Idiota, e vou mudar o trato. Você me deve [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#038.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#039.src: You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
