WynnExcavation Site D#068.dst: Siga o caminho à sua esquerda contornando a cidade. Continue até ver um aldeão perto de um túnel. Limparemos seu nome quando tiver fugido.
WynnExcavation Site D#068.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#069.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.dst: No caminho você passará pelo quartel do exército, então prepare-se para lutar. Sou o único guarda aqui para ajudar.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#070.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#070.dst: Agora corra! Não temos tempo a perder!
WynnExcavation Site D#070.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#073.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!
WynnExcavation Site D#073.dst: Pegue isto e corra! Você tem que fugir!

WynnExcavation Site D#074.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.
WynnExcavation Site D#074.dst: Vá até essas coordenadas, não há tempo para explicar, vá! Fecharei o túnel atrás de você.

WynnExcavation Site D#075.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!

WynnExcavation Site D#076.src: Head to the location on the note
WynnExcavation Site D#076.dst: Vá até o local indicado no bilhete

WynnExcavation Site D#078.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#078.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#079.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#079.dst: Não posso deixar você entrar até provar que está mesmo do nosso lado.
WynnExcavation Site D#079.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.dst: Já não sabemos em quem acreditar. Infelizmente, não há como provar sua lealdade.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#081.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.dst: Agora, com licença, tenho que procurar os fragmentos perdidos do mapa de Dernel. Esses olhos devem ter algo a ver com isso...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#082.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.
WynnExcavation Site D#082.dst: Encontre os três fragmentos do mapa seguindo os olhos e volte a Thomas.

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#083.dst: Não posso deixar você entrar, estamos procurando um documento importante. Esses olhos devem ter a ver com isso...
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#084.dst: São... os fragmentos do mapa? Você os achou!
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#085.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#086.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#086.dst: Não há tempo! Temos que juntar esses fragmentos aos nossos!
WynnExcavation Site D#086.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#089.dst: Fale com o líder rebelde Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#090.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#090.dst: Bem-vindo, amigo. Sabia que você descobriria tudo.
WynnExcavation Site D#090.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#091.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#091.dst: Deve estar surpreso ao me ver. A equipe do sítio C se esforçou muito para me matar.
WynnExcavation Site D#091.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#092.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#092.dst: Mas não conseguiu. Fugi, peguei um fragmento de um mapa e descobri para que serve.
WynnExcavation Site D#092.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#093.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#093.dst: Se chegou até aqui, sabe que a Wynn Excavation não é o que parece. Querem dominar o antigo poder de Wynn.
WynnExcavation Site D#093.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#094.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#094.dst: Controlam nossos governos e autoridades e parecem estar {~} passos à frente de quem se opõe a eles.
WynnExcavation Site D#094.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#095.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#095.dst: A menos que cheguemos ao último cristal antes dos escavadores.
WynnExcavation Site D#095.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#096.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#096.dst: Não podem usar um só fragmento de poder sem juntar todos.
WynnExcavation Site D#096.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#097.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#097.dst: A WynnExcavation fez coisas horríveis, e eu já ajudei...
WynnExcavation Site D#097.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#098.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#098.dst: A WynnExcavation vai cair, custe o que custar!
WynnExcavation Site D#098.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#102.dst: Fale com o administrador escavador Uci.

WynnExcavation Site D#103.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#103.dst: Nossa. É você. Não me surpreende, achávamos que você seria tolo o bastante para vir aqui.
WynnExcavation Site D#103.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#104.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#104.dst: Tolo para vir, mas esperto o bastante para chegar.
WynnExcavation Site D#104.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#105.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#105.dst: Você esteve em cada sítio, pegando fragmentos e nos atrapalhando.
WynnExcavation Site D#105.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#106.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#106.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#107.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#107.dst: Que valor têm seus fragmentos se temos os quatro cristais?
WynnExcavation Site D#107.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#109.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#109.dst: O chefe quer falar com você, não o deixe esperando, ele não é um homem paciente.
WynnExcavation Site D#109.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#110.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#110.dst: Ele espera por você, passe por aquela porta.
WynnExcavation Site D#110.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#111.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#111.dst: Meu chefe Uci é meio malvado, mas olha, ser capanga tem suas vantagens!
WynnExcavation Site D#111.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#112.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#112.dst: Isto leva mais fundo nesta masmorra, mas parece que tem que ser ativado do outro lado.
WynnExcavation Site D#112.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#120.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#120.dst: Ora, ora. Parece que enfim chegou.
WynnExcavation Site D#120.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#121.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#121.dst: Talvez esteja chocado em me ver aqui...
WynnExcavation Site D#121.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#123.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#123.dst: Você achar aquele velho tolo no deserto, sobreviver àquela queda.
WynnExcavation Site D#123.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#124.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#124.dst: Você achar aquele caderno e, enfim, me encontrar.
WynnExcavation Site D#124.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#125.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#125.dst: Tudo o que você fez foi planejado pelo cérebro por trás desta organização: eu.
WynnExcavation Site D#125.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#126.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#126.dst: Precisávamos de você, um humano ingênuo com alguma pureza de intenção, para trazer os fragmentos potencializados. Qualquer outro teria fugido com eles e se voltado contra nós. É assim que funciona. Não espero que entenda.. Agora, chega de conversa.
WynnExcavation Site D#126.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#129.dst: Fale com o assistente de Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#131.src: The crystals combine the power of the stars themselves.. an ultimate power... the power to reign over the entire WORLD!
WynnExcavation Site D#131.dst: Os cristais combinam o poder das próprias estrelas.. um poder supremo... o poder de reinar sobre o MUNDO inteiro!
WynnExcavation Site D#131.speaker: Corrupted Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#133.src: I- I- I feel... unstoppable.. this power... will not allow me to lose..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#133.dst: E- e- eu me sinto... imparável.. este poder... não me deixará perder..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#133.speaker: Shadow Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#135.src: DID YOU REALLY THINK YOU COULD WIN?!?! YOU ARE NOTHING COMPARED TO ME! NOTHING!! I WILL EXTERMINATE ALL LIFE, STARTING WITH YOU!! NOW, PERISH!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#135.dst: ACHOU MESMO QUE PODIA VENCER?!?! VOCÊ NÃO É NADA PERTO DE MIM! NADA!! VOU EXTERMINAR TODA A VIDA, A COMEÇAR POR VOCÊ!! AGORA, PEREÇA!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#135.speaker: Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#137.src: I'm no mage, but what you have there may just be one of the most destructive forces in the entire world.
WynnExcavation Site D#137.dst: Não sou mago, mas o que você tem aí pode ser uma das forças mais destrutivas do mundo inteiro.

WynnExcavation Site D#138.src: You... hmm... Ahh yes! I remember you. You're one of the recruits I accepted long ago..
WynnExcavation Site D#138.dst: Você... hmm... Ahh, sim! Lembro de você. É um dos recrutas que aceitei há muito tempo..

WynnExcavation Site D#139.src: Hm... I do wonder sometimes. I don't remember much about my time as a clocksmith, though I don't remember creating that one in particular.
WynnExcavation Site D#139.dst: Hm... Às vezes me pergunto. Não lembro muito da minha época de relojoeiro, mas não lembro de ter feito esse em particular.
WynnExcavation Site D#139.speaker: Retired Clockmaker

WynnExcavation Site D#140.src: You know, there only ever was one man who was a greater clocksmith than me. Though, he's been gone for quite some time as well...
WynnExcavation Site D#140.dst: Sabe, só houve um homem que foi relojoeiro melhor que eu. Mas ele também sumiu há bastante tempo...
WynnExcavation Site D#140.speaker: Retired Clockmaker

WynnExcavation Site D#141.src: Last I remember of him, he locked himself up somewhere in the {p}, raving about some sort of god.
WynnExcavation Site D#141.dst: A última coisa que lembro é que ele se trancou em {p}, delirando sobre algum deus.
WynnExcavation Site D#141.speaker: Retired Clockmaker

WynnExcavation Site D#142.src: Ah, well, I'm sure he had his reasons. Most people do.
WynnExcavation Site D#142.dst: Ah, bem, ele devia ter seus motivos. A maioria tem.
WynnExcavation Site D#142.speaker: Retired Clockmaker

Zhight Island (Quest)#001.src: Hello, esteemed tourist sir or madame! I see you have found my illustrious resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.dst: Olá, estimado turista, senhor ou senhora! Vejo que achou meu ilustre resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#002.src: Normally, you'd need a reservation to stay here, but our human visitors are ALWAYS welcome! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.dst: Em geral é preciso reserva para ficar aqui, mas visitantes humanos SEMPRE são bem-vindos! Hum...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#003.src: ...w-well, actually...wait, no, it's nothing, nothing, friend! I guarantee you'll enjoy your stay here!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.dst: ...b-bem, na verdade... espere, não, não é nada, nada, amigo! Garanto que vai adorar a estadia!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#004.src: Even if m-my usual supplies haven't arrived in weeks, I, um, I'm TOTALLY sure we can accommodate for you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.dst: Mesmo que m-meus suprimentos não cheguem há semanas, eu, hã, tenho TOTAL certeza de que vamos atendê-lo!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#005.src: We can just...um...w-well, I won't impose on you, dearest most welcomest traveller, no sir! Or madame!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.dst: Dá pra... hã... b-bem, não vou incomodar, caríssimo e mui bem-vindo viajante, não, senhor! Ou senhora!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#006.src: B-But, if, perchance, you were to, um...happen to find my supplier, Phief, who hasn't come around in weeks the bas-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.dst: M-Mas se, por acaso, você, hã... achasse meu fornecedor, Phief, que não aparece há semanas, aquele desgra-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#007.src: I! I mean! Nothing, nothing! Just, ehm, our extra reliable supplier often stops by {p} for supplies...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.dst: Eu! Quer dizer! Nada, nada! É que, hum, nosso fornecedor fidelíssimo passa em {p} por suprimentos...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#008.src: S-So, if you just happen to stop by there after your lovely stay here, and tell him to get off his sorry butt and send me my supplies that'd be just peachy!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.dst: E-Então, se passar por lá depois da sua adorável estadia e mandar ele tirar o traseiro da cadeira e me enviar os suprimentos, seria simplesmente ótimo!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#010.src: Hello there. I see Zhight has sent you, correct?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.dst: Olá. Vejo que Zhight o enviou, certo?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#011.src: I do hope he isn't mad at me. I fully intended to bring the supplies to him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.dst: Espero que ele não esteja bravo. Eu pretendia mesmo levar os suprimentos.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#012.src: But things took a turn for the worst quickly, and I no longer have access to my ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.dst: Mas tudo desandou rápido, e não tenho mais acesso ao meu navio.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#013.src: A madman jumped onto my ship, overpowered me, and held me hostage!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.dst: Um louco pulou no meu navio, me rendeu e me fez de refém!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#014.src: He was telling me how he wanted to "take back what was stolen from him", and it looked like he was heading to {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.dst: Ele dizia que queria "retomar o que lhe roubaram", e parecia ir para {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#015.src: I have no clue whether he was deranged, paranoid, or if someone really did take something from him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.dst: Não faço ideia se ele era maluco, paranoico ou se alguém roubou mesmo algo dele.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#016.src: I am certain of one thing. Nobody is going to sail my boat but me. I took my first chance to escape, broke the controls.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.dst: Tenho certeza de uma coisa: ninguém vai pilotar meu barco além de mim. Na primeira chance, fugi e quebrei os controles.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#017.src: And I swam back to land, here. Problem is, I haven't exactly decided how I'll get the ship back for myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.dst: E voltei nadando para a terra, aqui. O problema é que não decidi como vou recuperar o navio.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#018.src: Find Phief's ship, and return it to its rightful owner
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.dst: Encontre o navio de Phief e devolva-o ao legítimo dono

Zhight Island (Quest)#019.src: He told you what?! That fumbleknuckle...
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.dst: Ele disse o quê?! Aquele trapalhão...
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#020.src: We didn't steal the ship from Phief, we were taking back what he stole from us years ago!
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.dst: Não roubamos o navio de Phief, só retomamos o que ele roubou de nós anos atrás!
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#021.src: He attacked us on our way home to {p}, kicked us off the boat, and sailed it to who-knows-where.
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.dst: Ele nos atacou a caminho de casa, em {p}, nos expulsou do barco e foi sabe-se lá pra onde.
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#022.src: We didn't think we would ever get it back, until we started seeing him sailing to that doofbumble Zhight.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.dst: Achávamos que nunca o recuperaríamos, até vê-lo navegando até aquele pateta do Zhight.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#023.src: Luckily, he decided to claim an island so close to {p}, or else we would have never seen him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.dst: Por sorte, ele tomou uma ilha tão perto de {p}, senão nunca o teríamos visto.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#024.src: My father started following him with a small sailboat he made, and decided on the perfect place to attack.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.dst: Meu pai passou a segui-lo num veleirinho que ele mesmo fez e escolheu o lugar perfeito para atacar.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#025.src: But then Phief just had to throw a hissy fit and leave us stranded here.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.dst: Mas Phief tinha que dar um chilique e nos largar aqui.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#026.src: My father took a paddleboat back to {p} to gather supplies. He took the cargo the ship had with him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.dst: Meu pai voltou a {p} num barco a remo atrás de suprimentos. Levou a carga do navio com ele.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#027.src: If you need that, you should go talk to him. His name is Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.dst: Se precisa dela, fale com ele. O nome dele é Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#028.src: Get Zhight's supplies from Czytash at {p}
Zhight Island (Quest)#028.dst: Pegue os suprimentos de Zhight com Czytash em {p}

Zhight Island (Quest)#029.src: Ah, yes, I did find plenty o' supplies on that ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.dst: Ah, sim, achei muitos suprimentos naquele navio.
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#030.src: I assumed it was more of Phief's thiefed goods, so I took it home to use it myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.dst: Achei que era mais coisa afanada pelo Phief, então levei pra casa pra eu usar.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#031.src: It is Zhight's supplies you say?
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#032.src: Aye, of course it had to be that idiot's.
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.dst: Sim, claro que eram daquele idiota.
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#033.src: I guess me thinking he's dumber'n a box o' rocks is no reason for me to let him starve... Here, take the crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.dst: Achar ele mais burro que uma porta não é motivo pra deixá-lo passar fome... Tome, leve o caixote.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#034.src: I haven't opened it yet, so everything is left exactly how he ordered it.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.dst: Ainda não abri, então está tudo do jeito que ele pediu.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#035.src: I wonder what is on that numbskull's menu, that crate smelled rancid. Almost threw it off me boat.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.dst: Que diabos tem no cardápio daquele cabeça-oca? O caixote fedia a podre. Quase joguei do barco.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#036.src: Anyways, good luck on your adventure matey.
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.dst: Enfim, boa sorte na aventura, marujo.
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#037.src: Sorry, what was that? My son?
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#038.src: Ah, I figured it is about time he learned how to maneuver a boat. I fixed everything before I left.
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.dst: Ah, achei que já era hora de ele aprender a pilotar um barco. Consertei tudo antes de partir.
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#039.src: When he returns, he will return a man.
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#040.src: Wait, why am I telling you this? Butt out of my personal life, and just bring the man his crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.dst: Espere, por que estou contando isso? Não se meta na minha vida e leve o caixote pro homem.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#042.src: Ahaaa, esteemed sir! Or madame! I can't actually tell under all that armour...
Zhight Island (Quest)#042.dst: Ahaaa, estimado senhor! Ou senhora! Com essa armadura toda não dá pra saber...
Zhight Island (Quest)#042.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#043.src: ER! I MEAN! N-No trouble at all, esteemed visitor! We at {p} Resort are always welcoming!
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.dst: É! QUER DIZER! N-Nenhum problema, estimado visitante! No Resort {p}, sempre acolhemos!
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#044.src: ...wait, is that the... Oh my! The supply crate! You went out and found Phief?! What an upstanding fellow you are!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.dst: ...espere, isso é... Nossa! O caixote! Você foi atrás do Phief?! Que sujeito honrado você é!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#045.src: Wait, he was a boat thief? Well, good thing you've told me, we can't have pirates here at our resort! I'll blacklist him ASAP!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.dst: Espere, ele roubava barcos? Que bom que me contou, não podemos ter piratas em nosso resort! Vou pôr na lista negra já!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#046.src: You're only a visitor but you've been more help today than anyone else, really, I'm honestly in your debt.
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.dst: É só um visitante, mas ajudou mais hoje do que qualquer um, sério, estou em dívida com você.
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#047.src: So here! The repairs at the Zhight Grand Exchange and Zhight Treasure Tour have just finished, so you can head in and see the fruits of your labor!
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.dst: Então aqui! A reforma da Grande Bolsa de Zhight e do Tour do Tesouro de Zhight acabou, pode entrar e ver os frutos do seu trabalho!
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#048.src: And, as a token of my thanks, some exclusive currency for our resort, Zhight Money, on the house and just for you! I hope you enjoy your stay!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.dst: E, como agradecimento, um pouco da moeda exclusiva do resort, o Zhight Money, por conta da casa, só pra você! Boa estadia!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#049.src: Terribly sorry but the Zhight Grand Exchange is under repairs right now! You can't go in yet!
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.dst: Mil perdões, mas a Grande Bolsa de Zhight está em reforma agora! Ainda não pode entrar!

Zhight Island (Quest)#050.src: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here, it has a red and white sail. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Zhight Island (Quest)#050.dst: Talvez você possa ajudar com isso. O navio deve estar encalhado ao norte daqui, tem vela vermelha e branca. Adoraria voltar a navegar.
Zhight Island (Quest)#050.speaker: Phief

similar.text: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Welcome traveler, to our humble island...

Zhight Island (Quest)#052.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you all the way up here?
Zhight Island (Quest)#052.dst: Hã? Bem, saudações. O que o traz até aqui em cima?
